cd8561fdbcd8fe57c3d4b413f34918377df82688.sourceText: Perry’s sets opening date for its first Arizona restaurant in Gilbert
cd8561fdbcd8fe57c3d4b413f34918377df82688.translatedText: Perry’s 確定其位於吉爾伯特的第一家亞利桑那州餐廳的開業日期

95ac9b06f3482b86f9947584b41d60c0d1cfd30a.sourceText: Perry’s Steakhouse & Grille says its first Arizona location will open June 8 in Gilbert's Northside at SanTan Village. The move gives the Phoenix area another major upscale dining entrant and marks the brand's expansion into its 12th market.
95ac9b06f3482b86f9947584b41d60c0d1cfd30a.translatedText: Perry’s Steakhouse & Grille 表示，其亞利桑那州第一家餐廳將於 6 月 8 日在吉爾伯特北區的 SanTan Village 開業。此舉為菲尼克斯地區帶來了另一個主要的高檔餐飲進入者，並標誌著該品牌向第 12 個市場的擴張。

931a3b56191eca5f25462d90bdd5739f1e5c4a74.sourceText: Perry's Steakhouse & Grille announced that it will open its first Arizona restaurant on Monday, June 8, 2026. The company said the new site will be in Gilbert's Northside at SanTan Village, giving the East Valley a firm opening date for a high-profile restaurant project that had been in the pipeline.
931a3b56191eca5f25462d90bdd5739f1e5c4a74.translatedText: Perry's Steakhouse & Grille 宣布將於 2026 年 6 月 8 日星期一開設第一家亞利桑那州餐廳。該公司表示，新店將位於 SanTan 村的 Gilbert's Northside，從而為東谷一個備受矚目的餐廳項目確定了開幕日期。管道。

a3e43db8cf800914618aee51c8b5a31382490bf6.sourceText: For the brand, the Gilbert opening is more than a single store launch. Perry's described Arizona as its 12th market, so the restaurant is entering the state as part of a wider geographic expansion rather than a one-off experiment. That makes the opening notable for local business watchers tracking which national and regional hospitality brands see the Phoenix metro as worth long-term investment.
a3e43db8cf800914618aee51c8b5a31382490bf6.translatedText: 對該品牌來說，吉伯特的開幕不僅僅是一家商店的推出。 Perry's 將亞利桑那州描述為其第 12 個市場，因此該餐廳進入該州是為了更廣泛的地理擴張，而不是一次性實驗。這使得當地商業觀察家關注哪些國家和地區的酒店品牌認為鳳凰城地鐵值得長期投資。

854dc59103ba01a3a902bdc140ffcaf0aaa4e279.sourceText: The timing also matters for residents. By setting a June opening in mid-April, the company shifted the project from rumor stage to a near-term arrival with a defined timeline, which is especially useful for diners, nearby retailers and commercial landlords watching activity around SanTan Village. In practical terms, the announcement signals continued confidence in Gilbert as a destination for major restaurant concepts.
854dc59103ba01a3a902bdc140ffcaf0aaa4e279.translatedText: 時機對居民來說也很重要。透過在 4 月中旬確定 6 月開業，該公司將該項目從傳聞階段轉變為近期將在明確的時間表內落地，這對於關註三潭村周圍活動的食客、附近零售商和商業業主尤其有用。實際上，這項公告顯示人們對吉爾伯特作為主要餐廳概念目的地的持續信心。

23ded808cca528fe4e3fb8d191227884e3c7b890.sourceText: Scottsdale details first visible upgrades funded by Prop 490
23ded808cca528fe4e3fb8d191227884e3c7b890.translatedText: 斯科茨代爾詳細介紹了第 490 號提案資助的首次可見升級

033bc3b7ffc49f553ecdcbaaa6cc5098d67cbe0b.sourceText: Less than a year after voters approved Scottsdale’s Parks & Preserve sales tax, the city says residents are already seeing upgrades in parks, trails, ballfields, and the McDowell Sonoran Preserve. Officials highlighted new landscaping, court resurfacing, storm repairs, field improvements, and maintenance investments made since the tax took effect in July 2025.
033bc3b7ffc49f553ecdcbaaa6cc5098d67cbe0b.translatedText: 在選民批准斯科茨代爾的公園和保護區銷售稅後不到一年，該市表示居民已經看到公園、步道、球場和麥克道爾索諾蘭保護區的升級。官員們強調了自 2025 年 7 月稅收生效以來的新景觀美化、球場重鋪、風暴修復、場地改善和維護投資。

1b87039ff51525c88cd150b2a2f1086cae182d75.sourceText: Scottsdale says the 0.15% Parks & Preserve sales tax approved under Prop 490 is already translating into visible work across the city. The tax began on July 1, 2025 and is restricted to improving, maintaining, and protecting Scottsdale parks and the McDowell Sonoran Preserve. City leaders are now pointing to early projects as proof that the dedicated funding stream is moving from ballot language into day-to-day results.
1b87039ff51525c88cd150b2a2f1086cae182d75.translatedText: 斯科茨代爾表示，根據 490 號提案批准的 0.15% 公園和保護區銷售稅已轉化為全市可見的工作。該稅於 2025 年 7 月 1 日開始徵收，僅限於改善、維護和保護斯科茨代爾公園和麥克道爾索諾蘭保護區。市領導現在將早期項目作為證據，證明專用資金流正在從選票語言轉向日常結果。

a994c566868e6c890d3328c389c57c47494596bc.sourceText: Among the first improvements, the city says crews have installed more than 240,000 square feet of sod, planted more than 700 flats of vegetation, and added 93 trees. It also reported more than $150,000 in storm-damage repairs, especially along Indian Bend Wash, plus resurfacing work on sport courts at five parks with upgraded basketball features. Ballfields received regrading, irrigation work, new turf, and shade-screen improvements at dugouts.
a994c566868e6c890d3328c389c57c47494596bc.translatedText: 在首批改進中，市政府表示，工作人員已經鋪設了超過 240,000 平方英尺的草皮，種植了 700 多套植被，並增加了 93 棵樹。它還報告了超過 15 萬美元的風暴損壞修復工作，尤其是 Indian Bend Wash 沿線的修復工作，以及五個公園運動場的重新鋪設工作，並升級了籃球功能。球場進行了重新平整、灌溉工作、新草坪和防空洞遮陽網的改進。

4042a2882f896dea9e4ad5a34424b15555e608e5.sourceText: Scottsdale also says it has refreshed facilities with new paint at multiple sites, purchased maintenance equipment to improve response times, and advanced planning work for future upgrades. For residents, the update is an early checkpoint on whether a voter-approved tax is producing measurable neighborhood benefits. For movers and local business owners, it also matters because park quality, trail access, and public-space upkeep are key parts of Scottsdale’s quality-of-life and tourism pitch.
4042a2882f896dea9e4ad5a34424b15555e608e5.translatedText: 斯科茨代爾還表示，它已在多個地點使用新油漆更新了設施，購買了維護設備以縮短響應時間，並為未來的升級提前規劃。對於居民來說，這項更新是一個早期檢查點，用於檢查選民批准的稅收是否正在產生可衡量的社區福利。對於搬家工人和當地企業主來說，這也很重要，因為公園品質、步道通道和公共空間維護是斯科茨代爾生活品質和旅遊宣傳的關鍵部分。

6f1d26b78d2a9f3c5a170f13f911336d20ecfef5.sourceText: EPA summer E15 waiver revives Arizona air-quality fight
6f1d26b78d2a9f3c5a170f13f911336d20ecfef5.translatedText: EPA 夏季 E15 豁免重燃亞利桑那州空氣品質之爭

e747341aab7541cea0819ab3ee8ded452aec648f.sourceText: A new federal waiver will allow sales of E15 gasoline in Arizona during May, a move framed as a way to blunt fuel-price pressure tied to the Iran war. Critics argue the waiver reopens a familiar problem in hot-weather states, because the higher-ethanol blend can evaporate more easily and contribute to ozone formation during Arizona’s summer smog season.
e747341aab7541cea0819ab3ee8ded452aec648f.translatedText: 一項新的聯邦豁免將允許 5 月在亞利桑那州銷售 E15 汽油，此舉旨在緩解與伊朗戰爭相關的燃油價格壓力。批評者認為，這項豁免重新引發了炎熱天氣州的一個常見問題，因為較高濃度的乙醇混合物更容易蒸發，並在亞利桑那州夏季煙霧季節期間促進臭氧的形成。

29b56056bd45d43d676cc549b9bbe1d0fcba940b.sourceText: Arizona is once again in the middle of a long-running debate over fuel prices versus air quality after the Environmental Protection Agency cleared the way for E15 gasoline sales during May. The federal move is intended to reduce price pressure connected to global oil disruption and war-related market strains, but it also revives concerns about whether the blend is appropriate for Arizona’s hottest months.
29b56056bd45d43d676cc549b9bbe1d0fcba940b.translatedText: 在環保署於 5 月為 E15 汽油銷售掃清道路後，亞利桑那州再次陷入關於燃油價格與空氣品質的長期爭論。聯邦政府此舉的目的是減輕與全球石油中斷和戰爭相關的市場壓力相關的價格壓力，但它也重新引發了人們對這種混合物是否適合亞利桑那州最熱月份的擔憂。

c01ceaf5b72c4ecf66112b93a6baa07a4f3b5c29.sourceText: The issue centers on volatility. KTAR, citing Cronkite News reporting, noted that E15 contains a higher ethanol content than standard gasoline and can evaporate more readily in warm temperatures. That matters because the evaporation and combustion process can increase ground-level ozone, a pollutant that already creates problems in Arizona during summer. The state has historically restricted the fuel in hotter months for that reason.
c01ceaf5b72c4ecf66112b93a6baa07a4f3b5c29.translatedText: 問題集中在波動性。 KTAR 引述 Cronkite News 的報導指出，E15 的乙醇含量比標準汽油更高，在溫暖的溫度下更容易蒸發。這很重要，因為蒸發和燃燒過程會增加地面臭氧，而這種污染物在夏季已經在亞利桑那州造成了問題。由於這個原因，該州歷來在較熱的月份限制燃料。

0fe1a59247ece8947f3dbff0bbebd03579875d02.sourceText: Under the usual seasonal pattern, E15 is available in Arizona from September until June 1, while suppliers begin shifting away from the winter blend in April. In the hotter part of the year, gasoline without ethanol is typically used to lower evaporation risk and reduce smog formation. The latest waiver interrupts that approach and follows earlier emergency actions that had already extended E15 sales during prior summer periods.
0fe1a59247ece8947f3dbff0bbebd03579875d02.translatedText: 按照通常的季節性模式，E15 在 9 月至 6 月 1 日期間在亞利桑那州有售，而供應商從 4 月開始不再提供冬季混合酒。在一年中較熱的時候，通常會使用不含乙醇的汽油來降低蒸發風險並減少煙霧形成。最新的豁免中斷了這種做法，並遵循了先前的緊急行動，這些行動已經在夏季之前延長了 E15 的銷售。

49576bd4086ecafd727de054ef86cba26d338d20.sourceText: For Arizona drivers, the immediate attraction is the possibility of some relief at the pump. For regulators, health advocates, and local businesses, the bigger question is whether short-term fuel savings are worth the tradeoff if ozone levels worsen. The policy matters most in metro areas that already struggle with air-quality compliance, where even small changes in fuel chemistry can become a broader public-health and economic issue.
49576bd4086ecafd727de054ef86cba26d338d20.translatedText: 對於亞利桑那州的駕駛者來說，最直接的吸引力是加油站可能會得到一些緩解。對於監管機構、健康倡導者和當地企業來說，更大的問題是，如果臭氧水平惡化，短期節省燃料是否值得。該政策對於那些已經在空氣品質合規問題上苦苦掙扎的大都市地區最為重要，在這些地區，即使燃料化學的微小變化也可能成為更廣泛的公共衛生和經濟問題。

56ce4cdaea69be23397138883f243303432f1ad7.sourceText: ZhengXin Chicken Steak is listed within Mekong Plaza in Mesa. This profile was generated from plaza directory sources and map-based verification, so direct business contact details may still be incomplete.
56ce4cdaea69be23397138883f243303432f1ad7.translatedText: 正新雞排位於梅薩湄公河廣場內。此設定檔是根據廣場目錄來源和基於地圖的驗證產生的，因此直接業務聯絡詳細資訊可能仍然不完整。

cecf4a5ab481b8e63fc1f61eb889ee783df7527e.sourceText: 2. Y. C. Wang, Chinese Intelectuals and the West, 1872-1949 (Chapel Hill: University of North Carolina Press, 1966), p.49.
cecf4a5ab481b8e63fc1f61eb889ee783df7527e.translatedText: 2. 王永昌，《中國知識分子與西方》，1872-1949（教堂山：北卡羅來納大學出版社，1966），第 49 頁。

3b6185a97e9cc9af8b69c7f39cbeb2ff8c730cc2.sourceText: 3. Curt Gentry, Madames of San Fancisco: An Irreverent 'History of the City by the Golden Gate ( New York: Doubleday, 1964 ), p. 52.

026b539db73e082819b02d00f4151e51a98a99da.sourceText: QuikTrip maps out three next-generation Arizona stores for 2027
026b539db73e082819b02d00f4151e51a98a99da.translatedText: QuikTrip 規劃了 2027 年亞利桑那州的三家下一代商店

6417dd53ccc2f3824ed657f5f6e9d943a7238c0d.sourceText: QuikTrip told ABC15 it is planning three new Arizona stores built around its new “Gen 4” format, with locations in Tucson, Queen Creek, and Casa Grande targeted for 2027. The redesign gives the chain a bigger kitchen, brighter layout, and a store footprint positioned between a standard convenience store and a travel center.
6417dd53ccc2f3824ed657f5f6e9d943a7238c0d.translatedText: QuikTrip 告訴 ABC15，它正在計劃圍繞其新的“Gen 4”模式建造三家新的亞利桑那州商店，計劃於 2027 年在圖森、Queen Creek 和 Casa Grande 開設門店。重新設計為該連鎖店提供了更大的廚房、更明亮的佈局以及介於標準便利商店和旅行社之間的商店佔地面積。

d938eee6ae6f76f96553115c6e38e4c04c494f11.sourceText: QuikTrip says Arizona is in line for three of its newly redesigned stores, with projects in Tucson, Queen Creek, and Casa Grande now in development for 2027 openings. The company told ABC15 that these locations will use its new “Gen 4” model rather than the older store format still seen in many current construction projects.
d938eee6ae6f76f96553115c6e38e4c04c494f11.translatedText: QuikTrip 表示，亞利桑那州將開設三家重新設計的商店，其中位於圖森、Queen Creek 和 Casa Grande 的項目目前正在開發中，預計將於 2027 年開業。該公司告訴 ABC15，這些地點將使用其新的「Gen 4」模式，而不是許多目前建設項目中仍在使用的舊商店格式。

169d79cdd0da38de7c0ddfc289d75e8124c5fe45.sourceText: According to the report, QuikTrip’s new concept is the company’s first major store redesign in 15 years. The format debuted this month in Tulsa, and the chain says the model was shaped over a three-year process that incorporated employee input and customer feedback before moving into rollout.
169d79cdd0da38de7c0ddfc289d75e8124c5fe45.translatedText: 據報道，QuikTrip 的新概念是該公司 15 年來首次對商店進行重大重新設計。該模式本月在塔爾薩首次亮相，該連鎖店表示，該模式是在三年的過程中形成的，在推出之前融合了員工的意見和客戶的反饋。

b27ca29de35883d5542fef4e8f5907d6a626042f.sourceText: The Arizona stores are expected to keep the same general concept and sizing described for the Oklahoma launch. QuikTrip said the new units will be larger than a typical neighborhood store but smaller than a full travel center, aiming to handle heavier food service and a more modern customer flow without becoming truck-stop style sites.
b27ca29de35883d5542fef4e8f5907d6a626042f.translatedText: 亞利桑那州的商店預計將保持與俄克拉荷馬州推出時所描述的相同的整體概念和尺寸。 QuikTrip 表示，新單位將比典型的鄰裡商店大，但比完整的旅遊中心小，旨在處理更繁重的餐飲服務和更現代的客流，而不是成為卡車停靠站式的場所。

443e7fd88c68f13bafc04ed025195d6cc4087c43.sourceText: A major part of the redesign is food. QuikTrip told ABC15 that the Gen 4 format nearly doubles the size of the kitchen, reflecting a stronger push into made-to-order meals rather than relying mainly on packaged grab-and-go offerings. The company also highlighted bigger windows and a cleaner, more streamlined layout intended to improve brightness, appearance, and operating efficiency.
443e7fd88c68f13bafc04ed025195d6cc4087c43.translatedText: 重新设计的一个主要部分是食物。 QuikTrip 告訴 ABC15，第 4 代格式幾乎使廚房的大小增加了一倍，反映出對定制餐點的大力推動，而不是主要依賴包裝的即拿即走的產品。該公司還強調了更大的窗戶和更乾淨、更精簡的佈局，旨在提高亮度、外觀和營運效率。

a43040edff26fba128672ef57fb0c9f56472ce6a.sourceText: For Arizona residents and local commercial corridors, the announcement is a sign that QuikTrip sees room to keep expanding in fast-growing parts of the state beyond the Phoenix core. Queen Creek and Casa Grande continue to add rooftops and traffic, while Tucson remains one of the company’s major southern Arizona markets, making all three locations logical test beds for a larger-format store.
a43040edff26fba128672ef57fb0c9f56472ce6a.translatedText: 對於亞利桑那州居民和當地商業走廊來說，這項公告表明 QuikTrip 看到了在鳳凰城核心區以外的該州快速增長地區繼續擴張的空間。 Queen Creek 和 Casa Grande 繼續增加屋頂和客流量，而圖森仍然是該公司在亞利桑那州南部的主要市場之一，這使得這三個地點都成為大型商店的邏輯測試平台。

65c7b8535568f6165c75b8f386a117a554d6b673.sourceText: Scottsdale launches matching marketing fund for Old Town businesses
65c7b8535568f6165c75b8f386a117a554d6b673.translatedText: 斯科茨代爾為老城區企業推出配套行銷基金

0803e6a2e5e7fb8dfb3ebe43846308696144429b.sourceText: Scottsdale’s Tourism & Events Department is offering dollar-for-dollar marketing support to qualifying Old Town businesses. Individual businesses can seek up to $5,000, while collaborative campaigns involving multiple businesses can receive as much as $20,000.
0803e6a2e5e7fb8dfb3ebe43846308696144429b.translatedText: 斯科茨代爾旅遊與活動部門正在為符合條件的老城區企業提供同等的行銷支援。個體企業最高可獲得 5,000 美元，而涉及多個企業的合作活動最高可獲得 20,000 美元。

54917ea44fc567b9dfa379a670b79ec7f05ebf64.sourceText: Queen Creek Olive Mill partners on new Phoenix restaurant
54917ea44fc567b9dfa379a670b79ec7f05ebf64.translatedText: Queen Creek Olive Mill 與鳳凰城新餐廳合作

b943ae88c34868c4d248e32a3d6086eb28db1a0c.sourceText: Queen Creek Olive Mill is teaming with In Good Spirits Hospitality to open an Italian-inspired concept called The Olive Farmer in Phoenix this fall. The project will take over the former Santo Arcadia space near 44th Street and Osborn and is being pitched around local ingredients and a seed-oil-free approach.
b943ae88c34868c4d248e32a3d6086eb28db1a0c.translatedText: Queen Creek Olive Mill 與 In Good Spirits Hospitality 合作，將於今年秋天在鳳凰城開設一家名為 The Olive Farmer 的意大利風格概念店。該項目將接管 44 街和奧斯本附近的前 Santo Arcadia 空間，並圍繞當地原料和無種子油的方法進行宣傳。

c924debd748fc7967ac799b4e636a9a19ebdfa54.sourceText: TSMC says Arizona expansion is central to meeting AI chip demand
c924debd748fc7967ac799b4e636a9a19ebdfa54.translatedText: 台積電表示，亞利桑那州的擴張對於滿足人工智慧晶片需求至關重要

68fbacc14a7de5c517bae4496059f44aee339303.sourceText: TSMC told investors that demand tied to artificial intelligence is strong enough to push the company to raise capital spending this year, and Arizona is a key part of that plan. Executives said the company’s second Arizona fab is already structurally complete and is scheduled to begin volume production of 3-nanometer chips in the second half of 2027.
68fbacc14a7de5c517bae4496059f44aee339303.translatedText: 台積電告訴投資者，與人工智慧相關的需求足夠強勁，足以推動公司今年提高資本支出，而亞利桑那州是該計畫的關鍵部分。高層表示，該公司位於亞利桑那州的第二座工廠已結構完工，計劃於 2027 年下半年開始量產 3 奈米晶片。

b414fca14dd39167901ab6f3cd11de08cfa285b4.sourceText: Aldi joins next phase of Deer Valley mixed-use project in Phoenix
b414fca14dd39167901ab6f3cd11de08cfa285b4.translatedText: 阿爾迪加入鳳凰城鹿谷綜合用途計畫的下一階段

6caea4e1751f7b104583651b63ad1b2b1e972ca5.sourceText: A large Deer Valley development is moving into a new construction phase that pairs industrial space with housing and retail, including an Aldi grocery store. The project adds momentum to north Phoenix growth near Interstate 17 and Turf Paradise, where land assembled years ago is now being built out in stages.
6caea4e1751f7b104583651b63ad1b2b1e972ca5.translatedText: 鹿谷的一個大型開發項目正在進入新的建設階段，將工業空間與住房和零售結合起來，其中包括一家阿爾迪雜貨店。該項目為 17 號州際公路和草坪天堂附近的鳳凰城北部的發展增添了動力，這裡多年前聚集的土地現在正在分階段建設。

e809e46cdb5c0642498fce7ff8666b3cf86ac7b6.sourceText: Hurricane Harbor Phoenix opens for the 2026 season
e809e46cdb5c0642498fce7ff8666b3cf86ac7b6.translatedText: 颶風海港鳳凰城於 2026 年開放

7687b5a931a0956ef01ddaa64ef9e41f013e82dc.sourceText: Hurricane Harbor Phoenix opened for the season with refreshed areas, more shade, and expanded seating at its main cafe. The west Valley water park will operate through late September and is also planning a larger July 4 celebration tied to the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence.
7687b5a931a0956ef01ddaa64ef9e41f013e82dc.translatedText: 颶風海港鳳凰城於本賽季開放，其主要咖啡館的區域煥然一新，有更多的陰涼處，並擴大了座位。西谷水上樂園將運作至 9 月下旬，並計劃在 7 月 4 日舉辦一場規模更大的慶祝活動，紀念《獨立宣言》250 週年。

4309015328bb3f6f3a4d45261e57098496773710.sourceText: Tesoro gives Tucson’s north side a live-music Latin cantina alternative
4309015328bb3f6f3a4d45261e57098496773710.translatedText: Tesoro 為圖森北區提供了一個現場音樂拉丁小酒館的替代品

28df52994c463c84edd0f0026b91914ee6270bc7.sourceText: Tucson Foodie spotlights Tesoro, a Latin restaurant and cantina that transformed a former Mimi’s Café site on the city’s north side into a more energetic dining and nightlife destination. The piece centers on general manager Angel Martinez’s effort to create a place where people can relax, dance, hear live music, and stay out without heading downtown.
28df52994c463c84edd0f0026b91914ee6270bc7.translatedText: 圖森美食家聚焦 Tesoro，這是一家拉丁餐廳和小酒館，改造了該市北側的 Mimi’s Café 舊址成為一個更有活力的餐飲和目的地。作品以總經理 Angel Martinez 為中心，致力於打造一個人們可以放鬆、跳舞、聆聽現場音樂、無需前往市中心即可外出的地方。

a4bad1e110e7ae07225c4b628d0bab9365e96823.sourceText: Sandbox VR selects Gilbert for its first permanent Arizona venue
a4bad1e110e7ae07225c4b628d0bab9365e96823.translatedText: Sandbox VR 選擇吉爾伯特作為其在亞利桑那州的第一個永久場地

1046ae9c96a5bdbe4d5b8a28d7977c0083d5e6e2.sourceText: Sandbox VR says it will open its first permanent Arizona location at SanTan Village in Gilbert on May 15, positioning the East Valley site as a social indoor entertainment option ahead of summer. The company is promoting the launch with online prebooking discounts and a lineup of 11 immersive group experiences.
1046ae9c96a5bdbe4d5b8a28d7977c0083d5e6e2.translatedText: Sandbox VR 表示將於 5 月 15 日在吉爾伯特的 SanTan 村開設其在亞利桑那州的第一個永久場地，將東谷內定位為夏季到來之前的社交場地。該公司正在透過線上預訂折扣和 11 種沉浸式團體體驗陣容來推廣該產品。

06db7c94af565cf125d304631b76b274ed4e3dd3.sourceText: SRP launches its first company-owned solar site in Florence
06db7c94af565cf125d304631b76b274ed4e3dd3.translatedText: SRP 在佛羅倫薩推出了第一個公司擁有的太陽能站點

f802d23ced6ab1e8529bb5f21b88dd56cb086e42.sourceText: Salt River Project said its new Copper Crossing Energy and Research Center solar project in Florence can generate enough electricity to serve about 11,000 Arizona homes annually. The utility is also using the site as a research platform to compare panel performance, durability, and output under Arizona conditions ahead of expected summer demand growth.
f802d23ced6ab1e8529bb5f21b88dd56cb086e42.translatedText: Salt River Project 表示，其位於佛羅倫薩的新 Copper Crossing 能源和研究中心太陽能項目每年可以產生足夠的電力來為亞利桑那州約 11,000 個家庭供電。該公用事業公司還利用該網站作為研究平台，在預期的夏季需求成長之前比較亞利桑那州條件下的電池板性能、耐用性和產量。

e79a8df2678604ff9751dceefb18ba40c4d233e8.sourceText: University of Arizona plans Maricopa workshop on using satellite data for irrigation
e79a8df2678604ff9751dceefb18ba40c4d233e8.translatedText: 亞利桑那大學計劃在馬里科帕舉辦關於使用衛星資料進行灌溉的研討會

97b30776b0eff7a1139cd34103eec303af3a3cae.sourceText: The University of Arizona’s Maricopa Agricultural Center is hosting a May workshop to show growers how to convert OpenET evapotranspiration data into field-level irrigation decisions. The training is designed for Arizona producers trying to make more informed water-use choices during a period of continuing supply stress.
97b30776b0eff7a1139cd34103eec303af3a3cae.translatedText: 亞利桑那大學馬里科帕農業中心將舉辦 5 月份的研討會，向種植者展示如何將 OpenET 蒸散量轉換為田間灌溉決策資料。該培訓是專為亞利桑那州的生產商設計的，他們試圖在持續的供應壓力期間做出更明智的用水選擇。

64d3d3d9fc9b7e00f74b717cb96b6a78faca19ec.sourceText: Pinal County supervisors get a primer on data centers as projects gather near Maricopa
64d3d3d9fc9b7e00f74b717cb96b6a78faca19ec.translatedText: 隨著專案聚集在馬里科帕附近，皮納爾縣的主管人員對資料中心進行了初步了解

3c8c9cfbadb18dc08dfebea99a7f95a322278cbf.sourceText: Pinal County leaders held a work session to understand what incoming data-center proposals could mean for water, power and the local economy. The discussion did not settle the debate, but it showed how quickly Arizona’s AI and cloud infrastructure boom is reaching communities south of the Phoenix metro core.
3c8c9cfbadb18dc08dfebea99a7f95a322278cbf.translatedText: 皮納爾縣領導人舉行了一次工作會議，以了解即將到來的資料中心提案對水、電力和當地經濟意味著什麼。討論並沒有解決爭論，但它表明亞利桑那州的人工智慧和雲端基礎設施熱潮正在以多快的速度蔓延到鳳凰城地鐵核心以南的社區。

664abd294282af7444892a14658482f3424db1d5.sourceText: Maricopa housing slows sharply as listings pile up and prices soften
664abd294282af7444892a14658482f3424db1d5.translatedText: 隨著房源的增加和價格的疲軟，馬里科帕的房屋銷售急劇放緩

7721b6d28ab7c453f1ccfa1770f717b7f349a2b1.sourceText: Fresh local market data shows Maricopa home sales running far behind last year while inventory and price cuts rise. Buyers appear to have gained leverage in the city, even as well-priced homes are still moving relatively quickly.
7721b6d28ab7c453f1ccfa1770f717b7f349a2b1.translatedText: 最新的當地市場數據顯示，馬里科帕的房屋銷售遠遠落後於去年，而庫存和降價則上升。儘管價格合理的房屋仍然相對較快地流動，但買家似乎在這座城市獲得了影響力。

77c05f5ef466d2714de0bb2c108128f1456aaa10.sourceText: Chandler plans Asian American Community Connection event for AAPI Heritage Month
77c05f5ef466d2714de0bb2c108128f1456aaa10.translatedText: 錢德勒計劃在 AAPI 傳統月舉辦亞裔美國人社區聯繫活動

5a54f1a45c972a29cc3a09c09d31e739f9a482e0.sourceText: Chandler is inviting the public to an Asian American Community Connection gathering on May 12 at the ASU Chandler Innovation Center. City officials describe it as a free evening focused on networking, listening and community dialogue in recognition of Asian American and Pacific Islander Heritage Month.
5a54f1a45c972a29cc3a09c09d31e739f9a482e0.translatedText: 錢德勒邀請公眾參加 5 月 12 日在亞利桑那州立大學錢德勒創新中心舉行的亞裔美國人社區聯繫聚會。市政府官員將其描述為一個免費的夜晚，重點關注社交、傾聽和社區對話，以表彰亞裔美國人和太平洋島民傳統月。

f3c622a26fcf8a617c7066762cc5c1ffc6d4c7a4.sourceText: Scottsdale says Prop. 490 sales tax is already funding visible park and preserve upgrades
f3c622a26fcf8a617c7066762cc5c1ffc6d4c7a4.translatedText: 斯科茨代爾表示，第 490 號提案銷售稅已經為可見的公園和保護區升級提供資金

46a55727d83dfad660d0fe3bf81038e7b3e2df25.sourceText: Scottsdale says the voter-approved 0.15% Parks & Preserve sales tax is already producing tangible work less than a year after taking effect. The city points to new sod, plants, trees, storm repairs and preserve maintenance as early proof that the funding stream is changing how quickly park and trail projects can move.
46a55727d83dfad660d0fe3bf81038e7b3e2df25.translatedText: 斯科茨代爾表示，選民批准的 0.15% 公園和保護區銷售稅在生效不到一年後就已經產生了切實的成果。該市指出，新的草皮、植物、樹木、風暴修復和保護區維護是資金流動正在改變公園和步道計畫移動速度的早期證據。

594a4c49fbef4b325d45a1ea490a4fde2b4d03e4.sourceText: Chandler opens registration for spring Code Enforcement Resident Academy
594a4c49fbef4b325d45a1ea490a4fde2b4d03e4.translatedText: 錢德勒開放春季法規執行駐地學院註冊

575748a649c3b22518c59cff947728dcad6b5450.sourceText: Chandler is bringing back its three-week Code Enforcement Resident Academy this spring, with sessions set for May 12, 19 and 26 at Sunset Library. The city says the program is designed to help residents understand how code enforcement works and how neighborhoods can stay safe, clean and well maintained.
575748a649c3b22518c59cff947728dcad6b5450.translatedText: 錢德勒將於今年春天恢復為期三週的法規執行駐地學院，課程定於 5 月 12 日、19 日和 26 日在日落圖書館舉行。該市表示，該計劃旨在幫助居民了解法規執行的運作方式以及社區如何保持安全、清潔和維護良好。

f4f4de78e97054a48170813ef9ceb1473ed967ac.sourceText: Planned ICE detention site in Surprise is cut back sharply
f4f4de78e97054a48170813ef9ceb1473ed967ac.translatedText: 瑟普賴斯 (Surprise) 計畫的 ICE 拘留場所大幅縮減

63264c57bd4600820d43833972b90b3298820d66.sourceText: A proposed immigration detention project in Surprise has been reduced from 1,500 beds to 542 as federal plans run into local resistance and internal DHS review. The Arizona development was cited as part of a broader pullback on controversial warehouse-style detention expansion.
63264c57bd4600820d43833972b90b3298820d66.translatedText: 由於聯邦計畫遇到當地阻力和國土安全部內部審查，瑟普賴斯擬議的移民拘留計畫已從 1,500 個床位減少到 542 個。亚利桑那州的开发项目被认为是对有争议的仓库式拘留设施扩张的更广泛撤回的一部分。

1cc9812d1002f4574230e57c6a376a89ebd1e080.sourceText: Arizona launches $3 million after-school childcare grant program
1cc9812d1002f4574230e57c6a376a89ebd1e080.translatedText: 亞利桑那州推出 300 萬美元的課後兒童保育補助計劃

83a3c03657124da725a12e1bca47a67155a641b3.sourceText: Governor Katie Hobbs announced a $3 million statewide grant round aimed at lowering child-care costs for working families. The Bright Futures AZ Out-of-School Time program will support 59 providers and is expected to reach more than 2,500 children ages 5 to 12.
83a3c03657124da725a12e1bca47a67155a641b3.translatedText: 州長凱蒂·霍布斯 (Katie Hobbs) 宣佈在全州範圍內提供 300 萬美元的補助金，旨在降低工薪家庭的兒童保育成本。 Bright Futures AZ 校外时间计划将为 59 家提供商提供支持，预计覆盖 2,500 多名 5 至 12 岁的儿童。

354a5260b39e04876a2c68ef69609650b642bcc6.sourceText: APS agrees to stop hot-weather power shutoffs at 95 degrees
354a5260b39e04876a2c68ef69609650b642bcc6.translatedText: APS 同意停止 95 度的炎熱天氣斷電

58193cdca2ad25c86b652964124469d0353b1210.sourceText: Arizona Public Service agreed to a new shutoff rule as part of a $7 million settlement with the state. The utility will no longer disconnect residential customers for nonpayment when forecast highs reach 95 degrees or more, expanding protections beyond the old summer calendar window.
58193cdca2ad25c86b652964124469d0353b1210.translatedText: 亞利桑那州公共服務部門同意新的斷電規則，作為與州政府達成的 700 萬美元和解協議的一部分。當預測最高氣溫達到 95 度或更高時，公用事業公司將不再因未付款而斷開住宅客戶的連接，從而將保護範圍擴大到舊夏季日曆窗口之外。

a1ac085bcb4f38fa2a4c19f3674f07f70961f6af.sourceText: Arizona Tech Week launches with statewide schedule and thousands expected
a1ac085bcb4f38fa2a4c19f3674f07f70961f6af.translatedText: 亞利桑那州科技週以全州範圍啟動，預計將有數千人參加

a9ec1b7f2d751f9058cd56f8e7b858077cecc1b6.sourceText: The Arizona Commerce Authority said the inaugural Arizona Tech Week ran April 6 through April 12 as a decentralized statewide event intended to draw thousands of attendees. Organizers positioned it as a showcase for Arizona’s technology leadership and backed it with a shared event and RSVP system for participating hosts.
a9ec1b7f2d751f9058cd56f8e7b858077cecc1b6.translatedText: 亞利桑那州商務局表示，首屆亞利桑那州科技週於 4 月 6 日至 4 月 12 日舉行，作為一項分散的全州範圍活動，旨在吸引數千名參與者。组织者将其定位为亚利桑那州技术领先地位的展示，并为参与东道主提供共享活动和 RSVP 系统。

43952ce6940246b4cc64337c35103848d956282e.sourceText: Burlington breaks ground on Buckeye distribution center
43952ce6940246b4cc64337c35103848d956282e.translatedText: 伯灵顿在 Buckeye 配送中心破土动工

e0204dc3a77715e157003199d09c60b5e181e9b1.sourceText: Burlington Stores has started work on a future distribution center in Buckeye that the Arizona Commerce Authority said is expected to open in 2028. The project is being described as one of the retailer’s most advanced facilities, with automation and upgraded logistics technology built into the operation.
e0204dc3a77715e157003199d09c60b5e181e9b1.translatedText: Burlington Stores 已開始在 Buckeye 建造未來的配送中心，亞利桑那州商務局表示該配送中心預計將於 2028 年開幕。該項目被描述為該零售商最先進的設施之一，營運中內建了自動化和升級的物流技術。

e7768de2c82f1a683e1745e0a809bca6611c41c8.sourceText: Gilbert neighborhood pushes back on proposed Target rezoning
e7768de2c82f1a683e1745e0a809bca6611c41c8.translatedText: 吉爾伯特社區反對擬議的 Target 重新分區

e684e9bf17ce2271e6742a289057b365b8f5e38b.sourceText: A proposal to build a Target near Higley and Ocotillo roads has ignited resistance from nearby Gilbert residents who say the site was long expected to become a smaller shopping center. Supporters argue the project would create jobs and tax revenue, while opponents warn about traffic, noise, and the loss of the area’s neighborhood character.
e684e9bf17ce2271e6742a289057b365b8f5e38b.translatedText: 在 Higley 和 Ocotillo 路附近建立 Target 的提議已被批准此舉引發了附近吉爾伯特居民的抵制，他們表示長期以來一直期望該地點成為一個較小的購物中心。支持者認為該計畫將創造就業機會和稅收，而反對者則警告交通、噪音和該地區社區特色的喪失。

a3db903f9fe7c643f508cc65b5650f62f025176c.sourceText: Arizona mayors unite across party lines on Colorado River fight
a3db903f9fe7c643f508cc65b5650f62f025176c.translatedText: 亞利桑那州市長們跨黨派團結起來，共同對抗科羅拉多河

c7457fa3b8a2c2556f3f085e2231a60abd8e0030.sourceText: ABC15 reports that a bipartisan coalition of Arizona mayors is working together to defend the state’s Colorado River allocation as federal planning discussions continue. Local leaders say the stakes are enormous because one scenario under discussion could leave Arizona with only a fraction of its current access.
c7457fa3b8a2c2556f3f085e2231a60abd8e0030.translatedText: ABC15 報道稱，隨著聯邦規劃討論的繼續，亞利桑那州市長的兩黨聯盟正在共同努力捍衛該州的科羅拉多河分配。當地領導人表示，其中的風險是巨大的，因為正在討論的情況可能會讓亞利桑那州只擁有目前的一小部分。

4f69ac92740fad030daf930184ed72d70e054569.sourceText: Citadelle Center Adds New Dining, Wellness, and Beauty Tenants
4f69ac92740fad030daf930184ed72d70e054569.translatedText: Citadelle 中心增加了新的餐飲、健康和美容租戶

0fabcdbdf64b457d7c19c09165d8e1b0ea7647bc.sourceText: Citadelle Center in Glendale has announced a new wave of tenant growth with the arrivals of Pizzicata, Fit Mind Wellness, and Estetika Beauty Clinic. The updates strengthen the center's mix of food, mental health, beauty, and everyday-service offerings near Arrowhead Ranch.
0fabcdbdf64b457d7c19c09165d8e1b0ea7647bc.translatedText: 格倫代爾的 Citadelle 中心宣布，隨著 Pizzicata、Fit Mind Wellness 和 Estetika Beauty Clinic 的租戶增長浪潮即將到來。這些更新加強了該中心在 Arrowhead Ranch 附近提供的食品、心理健康、美容和日常服務的組合。

4a7c48acd46dcaf54afba5ce6e74a8b8cb76849a.sourceText: FAA schedules Phoenix-area workshops on airspace modernization
4a7c48acd46dcaf54afba5ce6e74a8b8cb76849a.translatedText: FAA 計劃在鳳凰城地區舉辦空域現代化研討會

9f6403887399410e89f5324a147e0fbd57cac885.sourceText: The FAA is planning four virtual public workshops in May tied to the Phoenix Area FAA Modernization Project, which would update satellite-based flight procedures serving Sky Harbor and nearby airports. Residents will be able to hear an overview of the proposal, review findings from the draft environmental assessment, and ask FAA staff questions directly.
9f6403887399410e89f5324a147e0fbd57cac885.translatedText: FAA 計劃在 5 月份舉辦四場與鳳凰城地區 FAA 現代化項目相關的虛擬公共研討會，該項目將更新為天港和附近機場提供服務的衛星飛行程序。居民將能夠聽到該提案的概述，審查環境評估草案的結果，並直接向 FAA 工作人員詢問問題。

e7e75a560173e9f7f78a144038116f10f8a79b50.sourceText: Phoenix Sky Harbor rolls out Earth Month events and sustainability outreach
e7e75a560173e9f7f78a144038116f10f8a79b50.translatedText: 鳳凰城天港推出地球月活動和永續發展外展

49791d511a8bb5510db7d8b6d3e39c5fb5f3f89b.sourceText: Phoenix Sky Harbor is using April to spotlight airport sustainability work, student education and public Earth Day programming. The campaign combines hands-on activities for middle school students with passenger-facing events and a broader message about long-term environmental resilience across the city's aviation system.
49791d511a8bb5510db7d8b6d3e39c5fb5f3f89b.translatedText: 鳳凰城天港正在利用 4 月重點關注機場永續發展工作、學生教育和公共地球日計畫。該活動將中學生的實踐活動與面向乘客的活動結合起來，並傳達有關整個城市航空系統的長期環境復原力的更廣泛訊息。

99ff01603dc9764047dfadff79074356de419ee6.sourceText: Arizona deepens Taiwan ties with investor tour and startup MOU
99ff01603dc9764047dfadff79074356de419ee6.translatedText: 亞利桑那州透過投資者之旅和新創企業諒解備忘錄加深與台灣的聯繫

49cfae3d97fb32c671b14ef8344fd7c2a0280f11.sourceText: Arizona announced a new push to strengthen business ties with Taiwan by hosting a delegation of 30 investors and university leaders across Phoenix, Tucson, Yuma, and Flagstaff. The visit was paired with a memorandum of understanding between the Arizona Commerce Authority and Sustainable Impact Capital to help Taiwanese founders use Arizona as a U.S. landing point, especially in technology-heavy sectors.
49cfae3d97fb32c671b14ef8344fd7c2a0280f11.translatedText: 亞利桑那州宣布將接待由菲尼克斯、圖森、尤馬和弗拉格斯塔夫等地的 30 名投資者和大學領導組成的代表團，以加強與台灣的商業關係。這次訪問與亞利桑那州商務局和永續影響資本簽署了一份諒解備忘錄，以幫助台灣創辦人利用亞利桑那州作為美國登陸點，特別是在科技密集產業。

7704e29f00e440bf6487d0d55d9a4c435639739d.sourceText: Cambria hotel project in Mesa adds rooftop dining and 107 rooms
7704e29f00e440bf6487d0d55d9a4c435639739d.translatedText: 梅薩的坎布里亞酒店專案增加了屋頂餐廳和 107 間客房

a7f0579a633a1955ee1f9cc22f17f92ecbf056af.sourceText: A new Cambria Hotel is under construction in Mesa at 3501 South Ellsworth Road, with plans for 107 guest rooms and a public rooftop bar and restaurant. The project team says the four-story property is targeting an early 2027 opening and is being positioned as an upscale lodging option with amenities aimed at both travelers and local visitors.
a7f0579a633a1955ee1f9cc22f17f92ecbf056af.translatedText: 位於梅薩南埃爾斯沃思路 3501 號的新坎布里亞酒店正在建設中，計劃設有 107 間客房以及公共屋頂酒吧和餐廳。專案團隊表示，這座四層樓飯店的目標是在 2027 年初開業，定位為高檔住宿選擇，提供針對旅客和當地遊客的便利設施。

b9d71bdc1bddd334e0027b9dc4766aa5b5e88665.sourceText: Turquoise Wine Bar plans a Glendale opening
b9d71bdc1bddd334e0027b9dc4766aa5b5e88665.translatedText: Turquoise 酒吧計劃在格倫代爾開業

a5902b0b75f8c565c9bed7148238a859c84c0404.sourceText: A new neighborhood wine bar is headed to Glendale at 23423 N. 67th Avenue, Suite 109. The project is being led by the mother-and-son team of Teresa and Connor Rodewald, who are positioning the venue around a curated wine selection and a welcoming atmosphere.
a5902b0b75f8c565c9bed7148238a859c84c0404.translatedText: 一家新的社區酒吧將在格倫代爾 23423 N. 67th Avenue, Suite 109 開張。該項目由Teresa 和 Connor Rodewald 母子團隊將場地定位為精心挑選的葡萄酒和溫馨的氛圍。

8bace3556616865d64e2aa5fb8471c1d7b4518df.sourceText: Tendit Group files Arizona notice for 143 Phoenix layoffs
8bace3556616865d64e2aa5fb8471c1d7b4518df.translatedText: Tendit Group 向亞利桑那州提交了關於鳳凰城 143 名員工裁員的通知

0db2201f960f64267d2b29a10a15326fef4dd73f.sourceText: The Tendit Group filed a WARN notice in Arizona covering 143 employees at its Phoenix facility on East Rose Garden Lane. The filing gives advance notice of workforce reductions but does not explain the reason, timeline, or specific roles affected.
0db2201f960f64267d2b29a10a15326fef4dd73f.translatedText: Tendit Group 在亞利桑那州提交了一份警告通知，涉及其位於東玫瑰花園巷的鳳凰城工廠的 143 名員工。該文件預先通知了裁員事宜，但沒有解釋原因、時間表或受影響的具體角色。

1bca9cb418c631a281056f4fc35ad6ab77873fe3.sourceText: Project Lean Nation is bringing its first Arizona location to Peoria
1bca9cb418c631a281056f4fc35ad6ab77873fe3.translatedText: Project Lean Nation 正在將其第一個亞利桑那州分店設在皮奧裡亞

64bd19ee3bdc52d96c17935f161fba2b35da00a8.sourceText: Project Lean Nation is planning its Arizona debut in Peoria at 9785 West Happy Valley Road, Suite 1170. The healthy-meals concept was identified locally through social discovery and confirmed on the company’s website, with franchise owners Kyle and Courtney Bridges tied to the new store.
64bd19ee3bdc52d96c17935f161fba2b35da00a8.translatedText: Project Lean Nation 計劃在皮奧裡亞首次亮相，地址為 9785 West Happy Valley Road, Suite 1170。健康膳食概念透過社會發現在當地得到認可，並在公司網站上得到了確認，並擁有特許經營權店主凱爾·布里奇斯 (Kyle Bridges) 和考特尼·布里奇斯 (Courtney Bridges) 與這家新店有聯繫。

5b3b817ee9e2537225f7fd8623dfd973aceeba20.sourceText: The Tendit Group, a multi-state facility services company, has notified Arizona of a significant workforce reduction in Phoenix. According to the report, the company filed a Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification, or WARN, covering 143 employees at its site at 2503 East Rose Garden Lane.
5b3b817ee9e2537225f7fd8623dfd973aceeba20.translatedText: 跨州設施服務公司 Tendit Group 已通知亞利桑那州，菲尼克斯將大幅裁員。該報告稱，該公司提交了一份工人調整和再培訓通知（WARN），涵蓋其位於東玫瑰園巷 2503 號工廠的 143 名員工。

76f0c1605b0708660ba3a6c454b3dd1901ab9fb9.sourceText: WARN filings are meant to provide early notice when larger layoffs or closures are planned, giving workers, state agencies, and local officials some time to prepare for the disruption. In this case, the filing confirms the number of affected employees but does not spell out why the cuts are happening, when they will take effect, or which positions are being eliminated.
76f0c1605b0708660ba3a6c454b3dd1901ab9fb9.translatedText: WARN 備案旨在在計劃進行更大規模的裁員或關閉時提供早期通知，讓工人、國家機構和地方官員有時間為中斷做好準備。在這種情況下，文件確認了受影響的員工人數，但沒有說明裁員的原因、何時生效，或哪些職位被裁減。

a849d1abfc2cb1b792da05003c7bfefb14296518.sourceText: The company describes itself as a single-source provider of exterior maintenance, infrastructure, and property-support services for commercial clients around the country. That means the cuts could matter not only to direct employees, but also to vendors, subcontractors, property managers, and customers that rely on the Phoenix operation as part of a wider service network.
a849d1abfc2cb1b792da05003c7bfefb14296518.translatedText: 該公司將自己描述為一家為全國商業客戶提供外部維護、基礎設施和物業支援服務的單一來源提供者。這意味著裁員不僅對直接員工很重要，而且對依賴菲尼克斯業務作為更廣泛服務網路一部分的供應商、分包商、物業經理和客戶也很重要。

37ea71205f2a95c66f581be06da67dfa2e3f0d06.sourceText: Because the notice concerns a Phoenix facility in the north Maricopa County corridor, the reductions could ripple through a local labor market that includes operations, field service, maintenance, and support roles. For workers, the immediate relevance is obvious: a formal layoff signal has now been recorded with the state. For employers, the filing may also create a near-term pool of experienced job seekers with transferable skills.
37ea71205f2a95c66f581be06da67dfa2e3f0d06.translatedText: 由於該通知涉及北馬里科帕縣走廊的菲尼克斯工廠，裁員可能會波及當地勞動力市場，包括營運、現場服務、維護和支援角色。對於工人來說，直接的相關性是顯而易見的：現在已經向國家記錄了正式的裁員訊號。對於雇主來說，申請還可能在短期內建立一批具有可轉移技能、經驗豐富的求職者。

8d4af5d3cd6e27596e2e2e890cfc8b053a79f656.sourceText: In a week that also brought several Arizona expansion and opening stories, the WARN notice stands out as a reminder that local economic momentum is uneven. New investment and hiring in some parts of the state can coexist with retrenchment in others, making job-market monitoring especially important for Phoenix-area residents.
8d4af5d3cd6e27596e2e2e890cfc8b053a79f656.translatedText: 在亞利桑那州也發生了幾起擴張和開幕故事的一周內，WARN 通知脫穎而出，提醒人們當地經濟勢頭不平衡。該州某些地區的新投資和招聘可能與其他地區的緊縮並存，這使得就業市場監測對於鳳凰城地區的居民特別重要。

5ab3ba3d8988bff14ec5b2b50f6fce296743fce7.translatedText: 現在怎麼樣 鳳凰城

42cba4753803102f60dd522a319e3ddcee008976.sourceText: Chandler has opened registration for the latest session of its Code Enforcement Resident Academy, a short educational program aimed at residents who want a clearer understanding of how city code issues are handled. The spring series will run on three Tuesdays in May: the 12th, 19th and 26th.
42cba4753803102f60dd522a319e3ddcee008976.translatedText: 錢德勒已經開始註冊最新一期的法規執行居民學院，這是一個簡短的教育項目，旨在幫助那些希望更清楚地了解如何處理城市法規問題的居民。春季系列活動將在 5 月的三個星期二進行：12 日、19 日和 26 日。

231c7484a3dad1b48bd002e9ff12ac6917034173.sourceText: Sessions are scheduled from 5:30 p.m. to 7 p.m. at Sunset Library on West Ray Road. The city says the academy is intended to explain the code-enforcement process and give residents practical knowledge that can help them support neighborhood upkeep and quality-of-life standards.
231c7484a3dad1b48bd002e9ff12ac6917034173.translatedText: 會議安排在下午 5:30 開始。至晚上 7 點位於西雷路的日落圖書館。該市表示，學院的目的是解釋規範的執行過程，並為居民提供實用知識，幫助他們支持社區維護和生活品質標準。

8e4ab5c017456114f77c5e5a164cfb155f216ca7.sourceText: This kind of program is especially useful in fast-growing suburbs where new development, aging housing stock and changing neighborhood expectations can all produce confusion about property standards. For Chandler residents, the academy offers a direct line into how the city interprets enforcement, what concerns it prioritizes and how residents can participate more effectively instead of navigating the process blind.
8e4ab5c017456114f77c5e5a164cfb155f216ca7.translatedText: 此類計劃在快速發展的郊區尤其有用，在這些郊區，新開發項目、老化的住房存量和不斷變化的社區期望都會導致人們對房產標準產生困惑。對於錢德勒的居民來說，學院提供了一條直接線索，讓他們了解該市如何解釋執法、優先關注的問題以及居民如何更有效地參與，而不是盲目地參與整個過程。

510cb50869acfd121d1897cb0360923f7f4e1302.sourceText: Salt River Project has opened what it describes as its first owned and operated solar facility, adding a new piece of generation capacity as Arizona braces for another high-demand summer. The Copper Crossing Energy and Research Center photovoltaic project is located in Florence and is expected to produce enough solar power over a year to serve about 11,000 homes in the state.
510cb50869acfd121d1897cb0360923f7f4e1302.translatedText: 鹽河計畫已經開放了其所謂的第一座擁有和運營的太陽能設施，在亞利桑那州準備迎接另一個高需求夏季之際，增加了新的發電能力。 Copper Crossing 能源和研究中心光伏計畫位於佛羅倫薩，預計一年內可產生足夠的太陽能，為該州約 11,000 個家庭提供服務。

8b13b6b0062ddedcbcb3d0bd17a403face2858ff.sourceText: The project is not only a power plant but also a testing ground. SRP said the site uses three different kinds of photovoltaic panels so it can study which technologies hold up best, perform most consistently, and deliver the strongest output across changing weather conditions. The utility has also installed sky cameras to improve cloud-cover estimates and sharpen its solar-production forecasting.
8b13b6b0062ddedcbcb3d0bd17a403face2858ff.translatedText: 該專案不僅是發電廠，也是試驗場。 SRP表示，該站點使用三種不同類型的光伏電池板，因此可以研究哪種技術效果最好、性能最一致，並在不斷變化的天氣條件下提供最強的輸出。該公用事業公司還安裝了天空攝影機，以改善雲量估計並提高太陽能產量預測。

1095e899d6c5d698561d8e382ea4a021ba47b994.sourceText: SRP leadership tied the project directly to grid reliability. The utility said the facility will help it serve customers during what it expects to be record electricity demand this summer, while also giving the company better information about how to deploy solar resources effectively in the future. That combination of immediate supply and longer-term data gathering is important in a state where heat, growth, and power demand are all moving upward together.
1095e899d6c5d698561d8e382ea4a021ba47b994.translatedText: SRP 領導層將該專案與電網可靠性直接連結在一起。該公用事業公司表示，該設施將幫助其在預計今年夏季創紀錄的電力需求期間為客戶提供服務，同時也為該公司提供有關如何在未來有效部署太陽能資源的更好資訊。在熱量、成長和電力需求同時上升的情況下，即時供應和長期數據收集的組合非常重要。

7e75b5ffd1c00d36495e428883faecc1262be2b6.sourceText: The launch also fits into SRP’s longer climate and infrastructure strategy. The utility has said it wants to reach net-zero carbon emissions by 2050 and expects it will need to at least double generation capacity over the next decade to keep up with demand. For Arizona households and businesses, the new Florence project is one more indicator that utilities are trying to add cleaner power without losing sight of reliability during the hottest months of the year.
7e75b5ffd1c00d36495e428883faecc1262be2b6.translatedText: 此次發布也符合 SRP 的長期氣候和基礎設施策略。該公用事業公司表示，希望在 2050 年實現淨零碳排放，並預計未來十年需要將發電能力增加一倍至少才能滿足需求。對於亞利桑那州的家庭和企業來說，新的佛羅倫薩計畫再次表明公用事業公司正在努力增加更清潔的電力，同時又不忽視一年中最熱月份的可靠性。

5971003a52f698f01f86bff0d6b18c55885fb3fb.sourceText: Hong Kong Cafe is listed within Mekong Plaza in Mesa. This profile was generated from plaza directory sources and map-based verification, so direct business contact details may still be incomplete.
5971003a52f698f01f86bff0d6b18c55885fb3fb.translatedText: 香港咖啡廳位於梅薩的湄公河廣場內。此設定檔是根據廣場目錄來源和基於地圖的驗證產生的，因此直接業務聯絡詳細資訊可能仍然不完整。

7701e2101ea2d576dff07ffb2330b603cecbc2a4.sourceText: The City of Chandler’s Connection & Impact Division announced a public event tied to Asian American and Pacific Islander Heritage Month. The Asian American Community Connection is scheduled for May 12 from 4:45 p.m. to 8 p.m. at the ASU Chandler Innovation Center on East Chicago Street.
7701e2101ea2d576dff07ffb2330b603cecbc2a4.translatedText: 錢德勒市的聯繫和影響部門宣布舉辦與亞裔美國人和太平洋島民傳統月相關的公共活動。亞裔美國人社區聯誼活動定於 5 月 12 日下午 4:45 舉行。至晚上 8 點位於東芝加哥街的亞利桑那州立大學錢德勒創新中心。

c7d08c1dfa5fad89147fc6f933cfedff6b2f9ebc.sourceText: City organizers are presenting the program as a free networking opportunity where community members can meet, learn from one another and take part in meaningful conversation. The framing suggests the event is meant to be both celebratory and civic, offering space for residents, professionals and community partners to connect around Chandler’s Asian American presence.
c7d08c1dfa5fad89147fc6f933cfedff6b2f9ebc.translatedText: 城市組織者將該計劃作為一個免費的交流機會，社區成員可以在這裡見面、互相學習並參與有意義的對話。框架表明，該活動既是慶祝性的，也是公民性的，為居民、專業人士和社區合作夥伴提供了圍繞錢德勒的亞裔美國人的存在進行聯繫的空間。

9d956434ec8074584f92898ba3cc1e5eadfa940b.sourceText: For Chandler, the announcement is also a signal about how the city wants to position inclusion programming: not as a closed ceremony, but as a broader community-facing event. That makes it relevant not only for local residents looking for cultural programming, but also for business, nonprofit and civic groups interested in community engagement in the Southeast Valley.
9d956434ec8074584f92898ba3cc1e5eadfa940b.translatedText: 對錢德勒來說，這項公告也顯示了該市希望如何定位包容性節目：不是作為一個閉門儀式，而是作為一個更廣泛的面向社區的活動。這使得它不僅與尋求文化節目的當地居民相關，也與對東南谷社區參與感興趣的商業、非營利和民間團體相關。

a5dcdf17cd96156b6be5fbff993a42aefc4e2a88.sourceText: Scottsdale has opened a new marketing support program aimed squarely at Old Town businesses that depend on visitor traffic. The city’s Tourism & Events Department says approved applicants can receive matching funds for leisure-tourism marketing, with the city contributing dollar-for-dollar toward eligible campaigns. The move is part of Scottsdale’s broader effort to keep Old Town visible and competitive as a regional shopping, dining, and entertainment district.
a5dcdf17cd96156b6be5fbff993a42aefc4e2a88.translatedText: 斯科茨代爾推出了一項新的行銷支援計劃，專門針對依賴遊客流量的老城區企業。該市旅遊與活動部門表示，獲得批准的申請人可以獲得用於休閒旅遊行銷的配套資金，該市將為符合條件的活動提供一美元一美元的資助。此舉是斯科茨代爾為維持老城區作為區域購物、餐飲和娛樂區的知名度和競爭力而做出的更廣泛努力的一部分。

0437831cdd73e20de7564cc180baecbaa104f98b.sourceText: Under the program, a single qualifying business can receive up to $5,000, while a joint campaign involving multiple Old Town businesses can be funded at up to $20,000. The city says the money can be used for a range of tourism-oriented promotion, including traditional advertising, paid social, digital campaigns, outdoor placements, and printed or mailed marketing materials. Businesses must be physically located in Old Town, and groups of businesses can apply together.
0437831cdd73e20de7564cc180baecbaa104f98b.translatedText: 根據該計劃，單一符合條件的企業可以獲得高達 5,000 美元的資助，而涉及多個老城企業的聯合活動可以獲得高達 20,000 美元的資助。該市表示，這筆資金可用於一系列以旅遊為導向的促銷活動，包括傳統廣告、付費社交、數位活動、戶外廣告以及印刷或郵寄的行銷資料。企業必須位於舊城區，企業團體可以一起申請。

e2b7192bd55b8798dccf4248205774c0d9a51744.sourceText: Scottsdale set a hard deadline on use of funds by requiring campaigns to conclude before the city’s fiscal year ends on June 30, 2026. That makes this a short-window tool for merchants and operators who want to boost spring and early-summer demand. For local retailers, restaurants, and hospitality operators, the program is a practical subsidy for customer acquisition at a time when destination districts are fighting hard for discretionary spending.
e2b7192bd55b8798dccf4248205774c0d9a51744.translatedText: 斯科茨代爾對資金使用設定了嚴格的截止日期，要求活動在 2026 年 6 月 30 日該市財政年度結束之前結束。這對於想要刺激春季和初夏需求的商家和經營者來說是一個短期工具。對於當地零售商、餐廳和酒店經營者來說，該計劃是在目的地地區為可自由支配支出而苦苦掙扎之際，為獲取客戶提供的一項實用補貼。

99b6aa47e102eda809ccdd81dd44d4e5e309f900.sourceText: Phoenix Sky Harbor announced a monthlong Earth Month program built around environmental awareness, sustainability and resiliency. The airport framed the effort as part of its broader position as a national leader in airport sustainability, using public events in April to connect day-to-day airport operations with climate, waste, water and energy goals.
99b6aa47e102eda809ccdd81dd44d4e5e309f900.translatedText: 鳳凰城天港機場宣布了一項為期一個月的地球月計劃，該計劃圍繞著環境意識、永續性和彈性進行。機場將這項努力作為其作為機場永續發展國家領導者的更廣泛地位的一部分，利用 4 月的公共活動將日常機場運營與氣候、廢物、水和能源目標聯繫起來。

3b3687dee30229549f54971152108d153f4db2df.sourceText: One of the featured events is SOAR with STEAM, scheduled for April 16 in partnership with Southwest Airlines. The airport said 180 students from Wilson Middle School and Estrella Middle School would take part in activities designed to introduce them to sustainability concepts and aviation-related learning, giving the program an education pipeline angle rather than treating Earth Month only as a passenger campaign.
3b3687dee30229549f54971152108d153f4db2df.translatedText: 其中一個特色活動是 SOAR with STEAM，定於 4 月 16 日與西南航空合作舉辦。機場表示，來自 Wilson 中學和 Estrella 中學的 180 名學生將參加旨在向他們介紹可持續發展概念和航空相關學習的活動，為該計劃提供教育管道角度，而不是僅將地球月視為乘客活動。

17aae75baf2538d4128af90b855179d4a64fc6a9.sourceText: Sky Harbor also planned a public Earth Day activation for April 22 inside the terminals and at the 44th Street PHX Sky Train Station. According to the airport, staff from the Aviation Department's sustainability team, PHX Navigators and the airport mascot Amelia would share information directly with travelers, turning a routine travel day into a visible sustainability outreach opportunity.
17aae75baf2538d4128af90b855179d4a64fc6a9.translatedText: 天港也計劃於 4 月 22 日在航站樓內和 44 街 PHX 空中火車站舉辦公共地球日活動。據機場稱，航空部永續發展團隊的工作人員、PHX Navigators 和機場吉祥物阿米莉亞將直接與旅客分享訊息，將例行旅行日轉變為可見的可持續發展推廣機會。

68f00671a4dc6cd6c9995c3f463092d6d9111cda.sourceText: The release also tied this year's programming to longer-term work already underway. Sky Harbor highlighted its PHX Green Business Partner Program, which earned the 2025 Airports Going Green Award, and said the City of Phoenix Aviation Department is applying sustainability practices not only at Sky Harbor but also at Deer Valley and Goodyear airports. For Arizona residents, the practical takeaway is that the region's main airport is using April events to showcase a broader, ongoing environmental strategy rather than a one-off celebration.
68f00671a4dc6cd6c9995c3f463092d6d9111cda.translatedText: 該版本還將今年的計劃與已經進行的長期工作聯繫起來。 Sky Harbor 強調了其 PHX 綠色業務合作夥伴計劃，該計劃獲得了 2025 年機場綠色發展獎，並表示鳳凰城航空部門不僅在 Sky Harbor，而且還在 Deer Valley 和 Goodyear 機場應用了永續發展實踐。對於亞利桑那州居民來說，實際的收穫是該地區的主要機場正在利用四月的活動來展示更廣泛、持續的環境策略，而不是一次性的慶祝活動。

3c343ed6088953ae7ab3795ac6700db54c36740e.sourceText: As temperatures rise across the Valley, Hurricane Harbor Phoenix has reopened for its 2026 season. KTAR reported that the water park near 43rd Avenue and Pinnacle Peak Road opened to the public at 11 a.m. and is scheduled to run through Sept. 27, giving Arizona families another major warm-weather option as the region heads into its hottest months.
3c343ed6088953ae7ab3795ac6700db54c36740e.translatedText: 隨著整個山谷氣溫上升，颶風「菲尼克斯港」已在 2026 年季節重新開放。 KTAR 報告稱，第 43 大道和 Pinnacle Peak Road 附近的水上樂園於上午 11 點向公眾開放，預計運行至 9 月 27 日，在該地區進入最熱的月份之際，為亞利桑那州的家庭提供了另一個主要的溫暖天氣選擇。

cff2b718304e41ae5ae89b2a3992670ecee78023.sourceText: The park is entering the season with a set of updates aimed less at adding new rides and more at improving the overall guest experience. According to the report, sections of the park have been refreshed and repainted, additional shaded seating has been installed, and seating at Tidal Wave Cafe, the main dining area, has been doubled.
cff2b718304e41ae5ae89b2a3992670ecee78023.translatedText: 公園正在進入季節，進行了一系列更新，目的不是增加新遊樂設施，而是改善整體遊客體驗。據報道，公園的部分區域已進行了翻新和重新粉刷，安裝了額外的遮陽座位，主用餐區 Tidal Wave 咖啡館的座位數量增加了一倍。

6e4b8a1989ca87881fbe6e98b3b260f4df62690f.sourceText: Those changes speak directly to what matters in Phoenix in late spring and summer: heat management, rest areas, and basic comfort. In a market where outdoor attractions compete not only on thrill rides but also on how well they handle sun exposure and crowd flow, extra shade and more places to sit can be meaningful selling points for local visitors and season-pass buyers.
6e4b8a1989ca87881fbe6e98b3b260f4df62690f.translatedText: 這些變化直接說明了鳳凰城春末和夏季最重要的事情：熱量管理、休息區和基本舒適度。在這個市場上，戶外景點的競爭不僅在於驚險刺激的遊樂設施，還在於它們如何應對陽光照射和人流，額外的陰涼處和更多的座位對於當地遊客和季票購買者來說可能是有意義的賣點。

d584c7f4988ee449b0fff041c06fa1943198072a.sourceText: The park also said it plans to broaden its July 4 celebration in 2026 to coincide with the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence, though details had not yet been released. That gives the attraction another marketing hook as it tries to draw repeat visits during the core summer season.
d584c7f4988ee449b0fff041c06fa1943198072a.translatedText: 園區也表示，計劃擴大 2026 年 7 月 4 日的慶祝活動，以配合《獨立宣言》250 週年紀念日，但細節尚未公佈。這為該景點提供了另一個行銷手段，因為它試圖在夏季核心季節吸引重複遊客。

f30435fc1a9b437029df4cc0e02a3654ea6f07f4.sourceText: For Arizona residents, the story is less about a headline-grabbing expansion and more about seasonal readiness. Hurricane Harbor is positioning itself for another long summer by emphasizing comfort upgrades, family appeal, and holiday programming at a time when Valley households are actively choosing where to spend their heat-escape budgets.
f30435fc1a9b437029df4cc0e02a3654ea6f07f4.translatedText: 對於亞利桑那州的居民來說，這個故事不是關於引人注目的擴張，而是更多關於季節性準備。在山谷家庭積極選擇在哪裡花費避暑預算之際，颶風港透過強調舒適度升級、家庭吸引力和假期規劃來為自己的另一個漫長夏季做好準備。

8377201960b68f01be02f131c6d0bb5a7e99de65.sourceText: The University of Arizona’s Maricopa Agricultural Center is set to host the first stop in a three-day irrigation workshop series focused on practical water management. The Maricopa session is scheduled for May 19 from 8 a.m. to noon at the center on West Smith-Enke Road and is aimed at helping growers use satellite-derived information in everyday farm decisions.
8377201960b68f01be02f131c6d0bb5a7e99de65.translatedText: 亞利桑那大學馬里科帕農業中心將舉辦為期三天的灌溉研討會系列的第一站，重點關注實用的水管理。 Maricopa 會議定於 5 月 19 日上午 8 點至中午在 West Smith-Enke 路中心舉行，旨在幫助種植者在日常農場決策中使用衛星獲取的資訊。

6fd3041b1d7f122fe0a69a5cee891e5b35c30827.sourceText: The main tool featured in the workshop is OpenET, a nonprofit platform that provides daily, monthly and annual estimates of actual evapotranspiration across 48 states. In simple terms, organizers say the system helps growers estimate how much water crops are using so they can make irrigation plans based on field conditions rather than guesswork alone.
6fd3041b1d7f122fe0a69a5cee891e5b35c30827.translatedText: 研討會的主要工具是 OpenET，這是一個非營利平台，提供 48 個州實際蒸散量的每日、每月和年度估計值。簡而言之，組織者表示，該系統可以幫助種植者估計作物的用水量，這樣他們就可以根據田間條件製定灌溉計劃，而不僅僅是猜測。

2bf6a8d4d24ef6e109acf737c4ccb9b43d653d4b.sourceText: According to the published agenda, attendees will get an update on Arizona’s current water situation, a walkthrough of how OpenET functions and examples showing how evapotranspiration data can be converted into irrigation hours for flood, pivot and drip systems. Crop examples are expected to include cotton, corn, Sudan grass and alfalfa, making the session directly relevant to regional producers.
2bf6a8d4d24ef6e109acf737c4ccb9b43d653d4b.translatedText: 根據已發布的議程，與會者將了解亞利桑那州當前的用水狀況的最新情況、OpenET 功能的演練以及如何將蒸散數據轉換為洪水、樞軸和滴灌系統的灌溉時間的示例。農作物範例預計包括棉花、玉米、蘇丹草和苜蓿，使會議與區域生產者直接相關。

e635f6c9aed0785a080acffb2a63bb22eab45f57.sourceText: Organizers also appear to be setting realistic expectations. The workshop materials say OpenET should be used to evaluate weekly and seasonal patterns, not treated as a real-time soil-moisture sensor. Participants will be encouraged to compare the platform’s readings with irrigation logs and field observations, and a hands-on segment will let them review their own parcels. Additional sessions are scheduled for Willcox and Yuma, giving the workshop added statewide relevance for Arizona agriculture.
e635f6c9aed0785a080acffb2a63bb22eab45f57.translatedText: 組織者似乎也設定了切合實際的期望。研討會資料稱 OpenET 應該用於評估每周和季節性模式，而不是被視為即時土壤濕度感測器。我們將鼓勵參與者將平台的讀數與灌溉日誌和現場觀察進行比較，並且實踐部分將讓他們檢查自己的包裹。威爾科克斯和尤馬還安排了額外的會議，使研討會增加了亞利桑那州農業在全州範圍內的相關性。

e67dc49eb4e60ed057f67ee2187e2ae0bb9fa7db.sourceText: A long-vacant parcel in Gilbert could become a new Target, but the project first needs a rezoning decision and that has set off a sharp neighborhood fight. ABC15 reported that the land near Higley and Ocotillo roads has been undeveloped for more than two decades, and nearby homeowners say they always expected something smaller and more locally scaled to eventually be built there.
e67dc49eb4e60ed057f67ee2187e2ae0bb9fa7db.translatedText: 吉爾伯特的一個長期空置的地塊可能會成為一個新的塔吉特，但該項目首先需要做出重新分區的決定，這引發了一場激烈的鄰裡鬥爭。 ABC15 報告稱，Higley 路和 Ocotillo 路附近的土地已有二十多年未開發，附近的房主表示，他們一直期望最終能在那裡建造一些更小、更當地規模的東西。

2dfbbae1c17f09daf4c101e6035a7e9f8fb78e28.sourceText: Residents interviewed by the station said a big-box store is not what they want next to their homes. Some said they had hoped for uses such as a grocery store, a coffee shop, or an upscale smaller-format retail mix that would serve the immediate area without changing the visual feel of the neighborhood. One resident said she is moving partly because she does not want a Target outside her front door.
2dfbbae1c17f09daf4c101e6035a7e9f8fb78e28.translatedText: 接受電台訪問的居民表示，他們不希望在自己家旁邊建造一家大型商店。有些人表示，他們希望開設雜貨店、咖啡店或高級小型零售店等用途，為附近區域提供服務，同時又不改變社區的視覺感受。一位居民表示，她搬家的部分原因是她不想讓 Target 出現在她的前門外。

76b2913922a06fa46c8c0a14431c5a449a176093.sourceText: Opponents told ABC15 they are worried about increased traffic, more noise, and the possibility that a larger regional retail draw could bring crime or broader disruption. Several framed the issue as part of a bigger concern that Gilbert is losing the small-town identity that attracted families there in the first place.
76b2913922a06fa46c8c0a14431c5a449a176093.translatedText: 反對者告訴 ABC15，他們擔心交通量增加、噪音增加，以及區域零售規模擴大可能帶來犯罪或更廣泛的破壞。有些人將此問題歸咎於吉爾伯特正在失去最初吸引家庭的小鎮特色。

708b442dad0dacc94a801700b1b7fcc100b180b6.sourceText: The developer’s side says the project fits a retail pattern already allowed in the area and would provide long-term economic benefits. ABC15 reported that the development team pointed to jobs and millions of dollars in potential tax revenue, while also arguing that a traffic study shows the Target could generate fewer vehicle impacts than some other uses already permitted on the property.
708b442dad0dacc94a801700b1b7fcc100b180b6.translatedText: 開發商方面表示，該項目符合該地區已經允許的零售模式，並將提供長期經濟效益。 ABC15 報告稱，開發團隊指出了就業機會和數百萬美元的潛在稅收收入，同時也辯稱，交通研究表明，該目標對車輛的影響可能比該地產已允許的其他一些用途要少。

c49e461a53fc85f4508bd2131321bbb3bb19cd9a.sourceText: Town officials told the station that the next meeting tied to the proposal is scheduled for May 19. That gives residents, business interests, and Gilbert leaders a defined point for the next round of debate over whether one of the Southeast Valley’s remaining vacant corners should stay on a neighborhood scale or shift to a more intensive retail use.
c49e461a53fc85f4508bd2131321bbb3bb19cd9a.translatedText: 鎮官員告訴電視台，與該提案相關的下一次會議定於 5 月 19 日舉行。這為居民、商業利益和吉爾伯特領導人提供了下一輪辯論的明確要點，即東南谷剩餘的空置角落之一是否應該保留在社區範圍內，還是轉向更密集的零售用途。

246b2e17ec58be29ebe4304756628008c7dd3812.sourceText: Citadelle Center, a YAM Properties commercial center at the northwest corner of Utopia Road and 59th Avenue in Glendale, has expanded its tenant lineup with three recent additions: Pizzicata, Fit Mind Wellness, and Estetika Beauty Clinic. The center sits less than a mile from Loop 101 in the Arrowhead Ranch area and is positioning itself as a one-stop destination for dining, wellness, beauty, and services.
246b2e17ec58be29ebe4304756628008c7dd3812.translatedText: Citadelle Center 是 YAM Properties 旗下的商業中心，位於格倫代爾 Utopia 路和 59 大道西北角，最近新增了三個租戶，擴大了租戶陣容：Pizzicata、Fit Mind Wellness 和 Estetika Beauty Clinic。該中心距離 Arrowhead Ranch 地區的 Loop 101 不到一英里，將自己定位為餐飲、健康、美容和服務的一站式目的地。

a5be0d2bf7edb5c4d5782a3368e6874b03f3503c.sourceText: In a statement carried by What Now Phoenix, YAM Properties operations director Marta Kenny said the property continues evolving into a place where visitors can eat, recharge, focus on wellness, and handle routine needs in one location. She said the new businesses reflect the lifestyle and preferences of the surrounding Arrowhead Ranch community, underscoring the landlord's strategy of building a more rounded tenant mix.
a5be0d2bf7edb5c4d5782a3368e6874b03f3503c.translatedText: 在 What Now Phoenix 發表的聲明中，YAM Properties 營運總監 Marta Kenny 表示，該中心正在不斷發展成為遊客可以在一個地點就餐、充電、專注於健康並處理日常需求的地方。她表示，新業務反映了周圍 Arrowhead Ranch 社區的生活方式和偏好，凸顯了房東建立更全面的租戶組合的策略。

d31659e98d17d96d44d91e85719ef6556090b898.sourceText: Pizzicata Glendale brings an Italian restaurant concept rooted in family tradition. Founded by Italian natives Federico Venturini and Chef Viola Tagliaferri, the brand serves Neapolitan-style pizza, Roman pinsa, fresh pasta, and other Italian dishes in an atmosphere intended to evoke a trip to Italy. The Glendale outpost represents the company's newest Arizona expansion.
d31659e98d17d96d44d91e85719ef6556090b898.translatedText: Pizzicata Glendale 帶來了植根於家庭傳統的義大利餐廳概念。該品牌由義大利人 Federico Venturini 和主廚 Viola Tagliaferri 創立，供應那不勒斯風格的披薩、羅馬pinsa、新鮮義大利麵和其他義大利菜餚，營造出義大利之旅的氛圍。格倫代爾前哨基地是該公司在亞利桑那州最新的擴張項目。

967be2dbca27447a048c1695b0f2581622d55a8e.sourceText: Fit Mind Wellness adds counseling and mental-health evaluation services for adults, children, teens, couples, and families. The practice's specialties include relationship issues, first responder evaluations, postpartum and pregnancy loss, depression, anxiety, stress management, work-life balance, trauma, and EMDR therapy. That gives the center a stronger wellness profile beyond traditional retail and food uses.
967be2dbca27447a048c1695b0f2581622d55a8e.translatedText: Fit Mind Wellness 為成人、兒童、青少年、夫婦和家庭增加了諮商和心理健康評估服務。該診所的專長包括人際關係問題、急救人員評估、產後和妊娠流失、憂鬱、焦慮、壓力管理、工作與生活平衡、創傷和 EMDR 治療。這使得該中心在傳統零售和食品用途之外擁有更強大的健康形象。

2c02bc9a0050abf99143d237eca89a06d26a3eed.sourceText: Estetika Beauty Clinic broadens the center's self-care and aesthetics offerings under nurse injector Jelena Radumilo, RN, BSN. The clinic offers cosmetic services and also provides advanced training for medical professionals, with a focus that includes facial balancing and the Russian lip technique. Alongside existing tenants such as Biscuits Café, The Melting Pot, Zipps Sports Grill, Foundry Yoga, Pure Barre Glendale, and Arrowhead Foothills Dentistry, the additions show Citadelle Center continuing to deepen its neighborhood-service role.
2c02bc9a0050abf99143d237eca89a06d26a3eed.translatedText: Estetika 美容診所在護理注射員 Jelena Radumilo（註冊護理師、BSN）的領導下擴大了該中心的自我照顧和美容服務。該診所提供美容服務，也為醫療專業人員提供高級培訓，重點包括臉部平衡和俄羅斯唇部技術。除了 Biscuits Café、The Melting Pot、Zipps Sports Grill、Foundry Yoga、Pure Barre Glendale 和 Arrowhead Foothills Dentistry 等現有租戶外，新增設施表明 Citadelle Center 繼續深化其社區服務角色。

4a3f1189a6d2dd49956ade7548d798c5b16d1c7e.sourceText: Federal immigration detention expansion plans tied to Arizona appear to be shrinking. Arizona Mirror reported that the proposed Surprise facility has been scaled back from 1,500 beds to 542, a substantial reduction that changes the size and likely the local impact of the project. The revision comes as the Department of Homeland Security reexamines contracts and decisions associated with an earlier push for rapid warehouse-style detention growth.
4a3f1189a6d2dd49956ade7548d798c5b16d1c7e.translatedText: 与亚利桑那州相关的联邦移民拘留扩张计划似乎正在缩减。根據《亞利桑那鏡報》報道，擬議的 Surprise 設施已從 1,500 個床位縮減至 542 個，這一大幅減少改變了項目的規模以及可能對當地的影響。此次修订之际，国土安全部正在重新审查与早期推动仓库式拘留快速增长相关的合同和决定。

48a00474972a098f081b038fb22a7b2fe7331622.sourceText: The article places the Surprise project in a wider national slowdown. Communities in multiple states have fought proposed detention conversions over infrastructure, cost and public accountability, and the report says new Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin is reviewing actions taken under his predecessor, Kristi Noem. The story also notes a prolonged DHS funding shutdown, creating more uncertainty around which projects can move ahead and in what form.
48a00474972a098f081b038fb22a7b2fe7331622.translatedText: 这篇文章将“惊喜”项目置于全国范围内更广泛的经济放缓之中。多個州的社區就基礎設施、成本和公共責任等問題反對拘留所的改造，報告稱，新任國土安全部部長馬克韋恩·穆林正在審查其前任克里斯蒂·諾姆領導下採取的行動。該報道也指出，國土安全部的資金長期關閉，為哪些項目可以推進以及以何種形式推進帶來了更多的不確定性。

e6127a6d269fd9a6edf4503232888af3c3b29828.sourceText: For Arizona readers, the main takeaway is that detention planning in both Surprise and other Arizona locations is no longer on a straight line. A facility reduced by nearly two-thirds means different demands on utilities, roads, staffing and local politics than the original proposal implied. Residents, elected officials and nearby businesses now have reason to watch whether the downsized plan stabilizes, is delayed further, or triggers a fresh round of negotiations.
e6127a6d269fd9a6edf4503232888af3c3b29828.translatedText: 對於亞利桑那州的讀者來說，主要的收穫是瑟普賴斯和亞利桑那州其他地點的拘留計劃不再是一條直線。设施减少近三分之二意味着对公用事业、道路、人员配备和当地政治的要求与最初的提案所暗示的不同。居民、民选官员和附近企业现在有理由关注缩减规模的计划是否会稳定、进一步推迟或引发新一轮谈判。

02d16ccef6f9f02953ca280f722c12f229a1a3fe.sourceText: A mixed-use project in north Phoenix is advancing again, with Aldi now tied to the next round of development at Bell 17 Business Center in Deer Valley. The site sits near Interstate 17, Bell Road and 19th Avenue, directly across from Turf Paradise, putting the future grocery component in a fast-growing stretch of the Valley that is adding both jobs and apartments.
02d16ccef6f9f02953ca280f722c12f229a1a3fe.translatedText: 鳳凰城北部的一個綜合用途項目再次推進，阿爾迪現在與鹿谷貝爾 17 商業中心的下一輪開發項目相關。該地塊位於 17 號州際公路、貝爾路和 19 大道附近，正對著草皮天堂，將未來的雜貨店部分置於山谷中快速增長的地帶，增加了就業機會和公寓。

e77c087a36bbcd28b5f74712ac89deb316d3e936.sourceText: The land has been in motion for years. San Diego-based Sunbelt Investment Holdings acquired roughly 90 acres through an Arizona State Land Department auction in 2018 for $26.5 million, then began building out the property in phases rather than all at once. That long timeline matters because it shows how older state land deals are now translating into visible retail and residential construction in Phoenix's northern corridor.
e77c087a36bbcd28b5f74712ac89deb316d3e936.translatedText: 這塊土地已經動工多年。總部位於聖地牙哥的 Sunbelt Investment Holdings 在 2018 年透過亞利桑那州土地部門拍賣以 2,650 萬美元的價格收購了約 90 英畝土地，然後開始分階段建造該地產，而不是一次性全部建設。這麼長的時間表很重要，因為它表明了舊的國有土地交易現在如何轉化為菲尼克斯北部走廊可見的零售和住宅建設。

4305260bc799d540dedb22124bf59a8b177a8413.sourceText: The first phase produced a 101,000-square-foot industrial flex office building at 2001 W. Phelps Road. KTAR reported that the building is leased to California Closets and Buckeye Cleaning Center, giving the project an operating employment base before the broader site is finished.
4305260bc799d540dedb22124bf59a8b177a8413.translatedText: 第一階段在 2001 W. Phelps Road 建造了一座 101,000 平方英尺的工業彈性辦公大樓。 KTAR 報告稱，該建築已出租給加州壁櫥和七葉樹清潔中心，在更廣闊的場地完工之前為該項目提供了一個營運就業基地。

a9d4fc4c9900755526c582ac7ae94509b602917e.sourceText: What comes next is more expansive. Marketing materials described plans for six additional industrial buildings, a multifamily component and retail uses, with Aldi identified as part of that new mix. For local residents and business owners, the story is less about a single store than about how Deer Valley is evolving into a denser live-work-shop district instead of a single-use office park.
a9d4fc4c9900755526c582ac7ae94509b602917e.translatedText: 接下來的事情會更加廣泛。行銷資料描述了另外六座工業建築、多戶住宅和零售用途的計劃，阿爾迪被確定為新組合的一部分。對於當地居民和企業主來說，這個故事與其說是關於一家商店，不如說是關於鹿谷如何演變成一個更密集的生活工作商店區，而不是一次性辦公園區。

8b09d92a444cf744fef951d3e3ce11b0516e502a.sourceText: A former chain restaurant on Tucson’s north side has been remade into something far more animated. Tucson Foodie reports that the old Mimi’s Café space has been transformed into Tesoro, a Latin restaurant and cantina designed to replace a quiet, familiar setting with music, movement, and a more social atmosphere.
8b09d92a444cf744fef951d3e3ce11b0516e502a.translatedText: 圖森北側的一家前連鎖餐廳已被改造成更活躍的場所。 Tucson Foodie 報告稱，舊的 Mimi’s Café 空間已被改造成 Tesoro，這是一家拉丁餐廳和小酒館，旨在用音樂、運動和更具社交氛圍的方式取代安靜、熟悉的環境。

6c3a5375d2d4f390cbaa197d54e1497c24124bb2.sourceText: The article says Tesoro was built around a straightforward idea from general manager Angel Martinez: give people another option for a night out that does not require a trip downtown. Martinez described the goal as creating a place where guests can feel comfortable, linger, dance, and enjoy live music in a part of the city that has fewer venues geared toward that kind of experience.
6c3a5375d2d4f390cbaa197d54e1497c24124bb2.translatedText: 文章稱，Tesoro 是圍繞總經理 Angel Martinez 的一個簡單想法而建立的：為人們提供另一種晚上外出的選擇，而無需前往市中心。馬丁內斯將目標描述為創造一個讓客人感到舒適、流連忘返、跳舞和享受現場音樂的地方，而城市中提供這種體驗的場所較少。

8fa71570a59f25a4c9dcdf5de21c4c7f96ca0224.sourceText: Tesoro’s path to opening was not quick. According to the report, the property had already been in development by 2019, but the project was slowed, like many others, before eventually reaching the point where the restaurant could open in 2023. That longer timeline helps explain why the finished concept is being framed as a meaningful transformation rather than a simple tenant swap.
8fa71570a59f25a4c9dcdf5de21c4c7f96ca0224.translatedText: Tesoro 的開幕之路並不快。根據該報告，該物業已於 2019 年開始開發，但與許多其他項目一樣，該項目在最終達到 2023 年餐廳開業之前就被放慢了速度。較長的時間表有助於解釋為什麼最終的概念被視為有意義的轉變，而不是簡單的租戶交換。

a38be598c91ecf5992501f26a85ed3b3a0972cca.sourceText: For Tucson residents, the project reflects a broader shift in how restaurant operators are thinking about neighborhood geography. Instead of concentrating all nightlife energy downtown, Tesoro is trying to establish the north side as a place where people can gather for food, drinks, and entertainment without making a longer cross-town trip.
a38be598c91ecf5992501f26a85ed3b3a0972cca.translatedText: 對於圖森居民來說，該計畫反映了餐廳經營者對社區地理的思考方式發生了更廣泛的轉變。特索羅並沒有將所有夜生活精力集中在市中心，而是試圖將北區打造成一個人們可以聚集在一起享用美食、飲料和娛樂的地方，而無需進行較長的跨城鎮旅行。

99368d47b1e55354946512d7d26b06ea15dc4685.sourceText: What Now Phoenix said Project Lean Nation is preparing to open its first Arizona location in Peoria. The address listed for the upcoming store is 9785 West Happy Valley Road, Suite 1170, putting the brand in one of the northwest Valley’s newer retail growth corridors.
99368d47b1e55354946512d7d26b06ea15dc4685.translatedText: 現在鳳凰城表示，Project Lean Nation 正準備在皮奧裡亞開設其在亞利桑那州的第一家分店。即將開店的地址為 9785 West Happy Valley Road, Suite 1170，該品牌位於西北山谷較新的零售增長走廊之一。

14583ab6f91b72d94fe4c96b9fe93604211abc40.sourceText: The report noted that the opening surfaced through the Instagram account Upper Westside Phoenix and that the company’s own website backed up the expansion. It also identified Kyle and Courtney Bridges as the franchise owners associated with the Peoria location, giving the project a named local operating team rather than leaving it as a speculative rumor.
14583ab6f91b72d94fe4c96b9fe93604211abc40.translatedText: 該報告指出，該店的開業是透過 Instagram 帳戶 Upper Westside Phoenix 曝光的，並且該公司自己的網站支持了此次擴張。它還確定凱爾和考特尼·布里奇斯是與皮奧裡亞地點相關的特許經營權所有者，為該項目提供了一個指定的當地營運團隊，而不是讓其成為投機性謠言。

cc23b05b2fce5e369a16d8bbb0fd0fe41e8db5e4.sourceText: For Arizona readers, the bigger takeaway is that health-oriented prepared-meal brands still see room to grow in suburban Phoenix. That matters for consumers looking for convenience-focused nutrition options, and for shopping-center owners tracking which categories continue to lease space in fast-growing parts of the Valley.
cc23b05b2fce5e369a16d8bbb0fd0fe41e8db5e4.translatedText: 對於亞利桑那州的讀者來說，更大的收穫是，以健康為導向的預製餐品牌在鳳凰城郊區仍然有成長的空間。這對於尋求以方便為主的營養選擇的消費者以及追蹤哪些類別繼續在矽谷快速增長地區租賃空間的購物中心業主來說都很重要。

e8555027b4306c39e325822510405db224b92fa8.sourceText: Mayors from around Arizona are presenting a united front on Colorado River policy, with Democrats and Republicans joining the same effort to protect the state’s water position. ABC15 framed the move as a rare bipartisan alignment built around a basic local-government concern: keeping enough river water available for Arizona cities and the people and businesses that depend on them.
e8555027b4306c39e325822510405db224b92fa8.translatedText: 亞利桑那州各地的市長們在科羅拉多河政策上形成了統一戰線，民主黨和共和黨也共同努力保護該州的水資源狀況。 ABC15 將此舉描述為罕見的兩黨聯盟，圍繞著當地政府的一個基本關切：為亞利桑那州城市以及依賴這些城市的人民和企業提供足夠的河水。

ce9d5b8efc22fcfe2f22a471200ebec3bc5419a9.sourceText: The report says the pressure point is a set of emerging federal planning discussions that could dramatically reduce Arizona’s share. ABC15 cited the possibility that the state could lose 95% of its access under one scenario, a number severe enough to turn water policy from a technical debate into an immediate political and economic issue for municipalities statewide.
ce9d5b8efc22fcfe2f22a471200ebec3bc5419a9.translatedText: 該報告稱，壓力點是一系列新興的聯邦規劃討論，這些討論可能會大幅減少亞利桑那州的份額。 ABC15 指出，在一種情況下，該州可能會失去 95% 的用水權，這一數字足以將水政策從技術辯論轉變為全州各市迫在眉睫的政治和經濟問題。

8c6e696a5ae78dc9ef59b15753985b7fed882d37.sourceText: Mesa and Phoenix leaders were featured as part of the coverage, underscoring that the concern is not limited to one party, one city, or one part of the state. The mayors’ collaboration reflects the reality that Colorado River shortages would reach across municipal lines, affecting growth planning, housing supply, business recruitment, and long-term infrastructure decisions.
8c6e696a5ae78dc9ef59b15753985b7fed882d37.translatedText: 梅薩和鳳凰城的領導人成為報告的一部分，強調這種擔憂不僅限於一個政黨、一個城市或該州的一個地區。市長們的合作反映了這樣一個現實：科羅拉多河水短缺將跨越市政界限，影響成長規劃、住房供應、企業招聘和長期基礎設施決策。

ddf52aaf702fc6c2a60439d948b2810f7d2e192a.sourceText: For Arizona residents, the story highlights how water negotiations are increasingly shaping day-to-day local policy even before any final federal action is taken. For city halls, it is also a signal that future bargaining over the river may require unusually broad coalitions if Arizona wants to preserve as much certainty as possible for metro Phoenix and other communities tied to the river system.
ddf52aaf702fc6c2a60439d948b2810f7d2e192a.translatedText: 對於亞利桑那州居民來說，這個故事強調了即使在採取任何最終聯邦行動之前，水談判也越來越多地影響著當地的日常政策。對於市政廳來說，這也是一個信號，如果亞利桑那州希望為菲尼克斯都會區和與河流系統相關的其他社區保留盡可能多的確定性，那麼未來的河流討價還價可能需要異常廣泛的聯盟。

66975d44ae68c5668962ae85dc9b9df107399bae.sourceText: CITIZEN VOICE – “Save the Chinese Cultural Center!” MAYORAL CANDIDATE KATE GALLEGO NEEDS FACTS The Chinese American Community throughout metropolitan Phoenix observed the debate last night of the Candidates for Mayor of Phoenix and reminds Ms. Kate Gallego of important facts on the Chinese Cultural Center and Garden. Fact-David Tedesco/True North/668 has never shown/stated an aim to bring high-technology new jobs to Phoenix with a cost of destroying a cultural iconic site vital to the minority Chinese American community. Fact-David Tedesco/True North continued previous management harassment and unfair treatment of major and smaller Chinese American businesses?ending jobs, reducing tax income to the City, and harming minority entrepreneurs. Electricity and telephones were cut; health and safety were further endangered by interrupting exhaust systems. Fact-David Tedesco/True North always indicated that businesses he controlled?Passport Health, Pump It Up, and Realty Executives were going to consolidate: therefore no net gain in employment. Fact-David Tedesco/True North received two permits from City -not one on fencing, but also one to remove the irreplaceable art of the Chinese roofline. Both are challenged in court cases, and City costs have occurred and may rise. In this political season, citizens of Phoenix must take heed. We must remember that the price of liberty is vigilance. Citizens of Phoenix may wish to attend the City Council Meeting on September 19 th to voice views. M. Cheak Yee, English Spokesman
66975d44ae68c5668962ae85dc9b9df107399bae.translatedText: 公民之聲—「拯救中國文化中心！」市長候選人凱特·加勒戈 (Kate Gallego) 需要事實 整個菲尼克斯市的華裔社區觀察了昨晚鳳凰城市長候選人的辯論，並提醒凱特·加勒戈女士有關中國文化中心和花園的重要事實。事實 - David Tedesco/True North/668 從未表現出/聲明過為鳳凰城帶來高科技新就業機會的目標，而代價卻是摧毀對美國少數族裔社區至關重要的文化標誌性遺址。事實-David Tedesco/True North 繼續之前對大型和小型華裔美國企業的管理層騷擾和不公平待遇——導致就業機會減少、城市稅收收入減少、少數族裔企業家受到傷害。電力和電話被切斷；排氣系統中斷進一步危及健康和安全。事實 - David Tedesco/True North 總是表示他控制的企業 Passport Health、Pump It Up 和 Realty Executives 將進行整合：因此就業方面沒有淨增長。事實 - David Tedesco/True North 獲得了曼城的兩份許可——不是關於擊劍的許可，還有一份是為了拆除中國屋頂線的不可替代的藝術。兩者都在法庭案件中受到質疑，市政府的成本已經發生並且可能會上升。在這個政治季節，鳳凰城的公民必須保持警惕。我們必須記住，自由的代價是保持警覺。鳳凰城市民不妨參加9月19日的市議會會議來表達意見。英國發言人 M. 2c13da121c8da1eee3c64cde4991146a5eedfc08.sourceText: Arizona is putting new money into after-school and out-of-school care as affordability pressures continue to hit working families. Governor Katie Hobbs said the state will distribute $3 million through the Bright Futures AZ Out-of-School Time Grant Program, which is administered by the Department of Economic Security. The funding is set to support 59 providers across the state and help serve more than 2,500 children between 5 and 12 years old.
2c13da121c8da1eee3c64cde4991146a5eedfc08.translatedText: 由於工薪家庭繼續面臨負擔能力壓力，亞利桑那州正在向課後和校外託管投入新資金。州長凱蒂霍布斯 (Katie Hobbs) 表示，該州將透過由經濟安全部管理的 Bright Futures AZ 校外時間補助計畫分配 300 萬美元。這筆資金將用於支持全州 59 家服務提供者，並為 2,500 多名 5 至 12 歲的兒童提供服務。

50735d789f7444712804b36dcec316d5db970e1d.sourceText: The announcement framed childcare as an economic issue as much as a family one. State officials said the grants could cut participating families’ childcare costs by roughly two-thirds, a notable reduction at a time when Arizona households are also absorbing higher bills for housing, food and transportation. Hobbs also rolled out a new provider search tool meant to help parents find care options more easily.
50735d789f7444712804b36dcec316d5db970e1d.translatedText: 該公告將兒童照顧視為一個經濟問題，同時也是一個家庭問題。州官員表示，這些補助金可以將參與家庭的兒童照護費用削減約三分之二，在亞利桑那州家庭還需要承擔更高的住房、食品和交通費用的情況下，這一降幅顯著。霍布斯還推出了一個新的提供者搜尋工具，旨在幫助父母更輕鬆地找到護理選擇。

7ab13ca3e279ba214074cdea3d9a9d732c8f361c.sourceText: For Arizona residents, the importance of the program goes beyond a single funding round. After-school coverage is often the hardest gap for working parents to solve, especially when school hours and job schedules do not align. If the grants work as intended, they could help parents stay in the workforce, give providers steadier enrollment, and relieve some of the pressure in communities where affordable childcare remains hard to find.
7ab13ca3e279ba214074cdea3d9a9d732c8f361c.translatedText: 對於亞利桑那州居民來說，該計劃的重要性超出了單輪融資的範圍。放學後的保險往往是在職父母最難解決的問題，尤其是當上課時間和工作安排不一致時。如果贈款按預期發揮作用，它們可以幫助父母留在勞動力隊伍中，為提供者提供更穩定的入學機會，並緩解仍然難以找到負擔得起的兒童保育服務的社區的一些壓力。

5b18ee15d30857ff9cb68281d4a8e3fd4bcea179.sourceText: Burlington Stores has begun construction on a new distribution center in Buckeye, adding another large logistics and industrial project to the fast-growing West Valley. The Arizona Commerce Authority said the facility is expected to open in 2028 and will be designed with a more advanced operating model than many traditional warehouse projects.
5b18ee15d30857ff9cb68281d4a8e3fd4bcea179.translatedText: 伯靈頓商店 (Burlington Stores) 已開始在七葉樹 (Buckeye) 建造一個新的配送中心，為快速發展的西谷 (West Valley) 增添另一個大型物流和工業項目。亞利桑那州商務局表示，該設施預計將於 2028 年開業，並將採用比許多傳統倉庫項目更先進的營運模式進行設計。

9a5200795d7c86ba8a7b077939ea6ac805b2ba77.sourceText: The state’s summary of the project emphasized automation and modern systems, describing the site as one of Burlington’s most advanced facilities to date. That framing suggests the Buckeye center is meant to do more than add square footage: it is intended to support a high-volume, technology-driven supply chain operation that can move merchandise more efficiently across the retailer’s network.
9a5200795d7c86ba8a7b077939ea6ac805b2ba77.translatedText: 該州對該項目的總結強調了自動化和現代化系統，將該設施描述為伯靈頓迄今為止最先進的設施之一。這個框架表明，Buckeye 中心的目的不僅僅是增加面積：它旨在支援大批量、技術驅動的供應鏈運營，可以更有效地在零售商網路中運輸商品。

f08ee2ad11b4963e92b542cabc7ffee81181ccd4.sourceText: For Buckeye and the wider Phoenix metro, the announcement reinforces the area’s role as a logistics corridor for major national brands. West Valley communities have been competing aggressively for industrial development because those projects bring construction activity, long-term employment, and added demand for transportation links, utilities, and nearby commercial services. For local business owners, another large employer in Buckeye can also mean more demand for vendors, contractors, and support services tied to warehouse and distribution activity.
