46ac21e693e0a379e58f1b4d1367151726f50cdd.sourceText: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. used its latest earnings call to make clear that Arizona is no side project in its global build-out. Company leadership said AI-related demand for advanced chips remains exceptionally strong, prompting TSMC to raise its annual capital spending budget from $52 billion to $56 billion. The added spending is aimed in part at expanding capacity for 3-nanometer production, a process node used in high-end smartphones and performance computing systems.
46ac21e693e0a379e58f1b4d1367151726f50cdd.translatedText: 台積電在最新的財報電話會議上明確表示，亞利桑那州並不是其全球擴張中的副業項目。該公司領導層表示，人工智慧相關的先進晶片需求依然異常強勁，促使台積電將年度資本支出預算從 520 億美元提高到 560 億美元。增加的支出部分旨在擴大 3 奈米生產能力，這是用於高階智慧型手機和高效能運算系統的製程節點。

359cc995e14d6363c3f6d47269f8997bfd6266ca.sourceText: Executives said Arizona’s second semiconductor factory will be part of that response. According to KTAR’s report, TSMC chief executive C.C. Wei said the building for the second fab is already complete and that the facility is expected to start volume production in the second half of 2027. That timeline matters because it gives Arizona a firmer place in the company’s roadmap for some of its more advanced manufacturing output, not just older generation chips.
359cc995e14d6363c3f6d47269f8997bfd6266ca.translatedText: 高層表示，亞利桑那州的第二家半導體工廠將成為這項應對措施的一部分。根據 KTAR 報道，台積電執行長 C.C.魏表示，第二座晶圓廠的建設已經完工，該廠預計將於 2027 年下半年開始量產。這一時間表很重要，因為它使亞利桑那州在公司的一些更先進的製造輸出路線圖中佔據了更穩固的地位，而不僅僅是老一代晶片。

44b21c180f9262f084cce763169868e60a1e8531.sourceText: Wei also signaled that the company is willing to adjust its traditional capacity planning approach because of the current demand environment. He said TSMC does not usually add more capacity to a manufacturing node after it reaches its planned target, but he framed the present AI boom as unusual enough to justify further expansion. In practical terms, that suggests customer demand is arriving fast enough to reshape how the company allocates investment across sites, including in the United States.
44b21c180f9262f084cce763169868e60a1e8531.translatedText: 魏也表示，由於當前的需求環境，該公司願意調整其傳統的產能規劃方法。他表示，台積電在達到計畫目標後通常不會增加製造節點的產能，但他認為目前的人工智慧熱潮非常不尋常，足以證明進一步擴張是合理的。實際上，這表明客戶需求的到來速度足夠快，足以重塑該公司在包括美國在內的各個地點分配投資的方式。

ac5f4050e3e4089faa5bf37208628a3953d1de6f.sourceText: For Arizona, the update reinforces how the state’s semiconductor push is becoming tied to the next phase of AI infrastructure rather than only long-term economic development promises. A second fab capable of producing 3-nanometer chips would deepen the Phoenix-area supply chain, create more urgency around workforce training, and increase pressure on nearby suppliers, utilities, and local governments to keep pace. For residents and business owners, the broader takeaway is that Arizona’s chip corridor is moving from construction headline to production planning, with TSMC indicating that national AI demand is helping accelerate that shift.
ac5f4050e3e4089faa5bf37208628a3953d1de6f.translatedText: 對於亞利桑那州來說，這項更新強化了該州的半導體推動與下一階段人工智慧基礎設施的聯繫，而不僅僅是長期的經濟發展承諾。第二座能夠生產 3 奈米晶片的工廠將深化鳳凰城地區的供應鏈，使勞動力培訓更加緊迫，並增加附近供應商、公用事業和地方政府跟上步伐的壓力。對於居民和企業主來說，更廣泛的收穫是亞利桑那州的晶片走廊正在從建設重點轉向生產規劃，台積電錶示國家人工智慧需求正在幫助加速這一轉變。

1617e9f3643abbc10d2722193681d43cf26e6854.translatedText: 亞利桑那州一些最好的烤玉米餅都可以在這裡找到。

8737fd73ba23d2020886d0f7f8c1511f82f0143a.sourceText: Opened in October 1958, this handsome air traffic control tower at Tucson International Airport has greeted travelers, visitors, and residents returning to this scenic Sonoran Desert city for more than 50 years.
8737fd73ba23d2020886d0f7f8c1511f82f0143a.translatedText: 這座位於圖森國際機場的漂亮空中交通管制塔於 1958 年 10 月開放，50 多年來一直歡迎旅客、遊客和居民返回這座風景秀麗的索諾蘭沙漠城市。

d44d7adaa777acdce8de3f4a2f8b4d0eec3c558e.sourceText: Standing 123 feet tall, the tower's most iconic feature is the 10-foot, blue and white letters that vertically spell out “TUCSON” on two sides of the structure, illuminating in neon orange at night, as well as the pinkish-red stripes that decorate the four sides of the structure.
d44d7adaa777acdce8de3f4a2f8b4d0eec3c558e.translatedText: 塔樓高 123 英尺，最具標誌性的特徵是結構兩側垂直拼出“TUCSON”的 10 英尺藍色和白色字母，以及裝飾結構四個側面的粉紅色條紋，在夜間以霓虹橙色照亮。

26ca54abbda8e70dc910702267471afe7168a934.sourceText: In September 2016, after being in service for nearly 58 years, the stylish midcentury tower was retired from air traffic services and replaced by a new, 252-foot-tall control tower situated elsewhere on the airport property. But the original tower remains standing, now a beloved local landmark.
26ca54abbda8e70dc910702267471afe7168a934.translatedText: 2016 年 9 月，在使用了近 58 年後，這座時尚的中世紀塔樓從空中交通服務中退役，並被位於其他地方的一座新的、252 英尺高的控制塔所取代。機場財產。但原來的塔樓仍然矗立著，現在是深受人們喜愛的當地地標。

ce47e8c6a4c985e039652a207b3865cab307c03f.sourceText: Today, the iconic tower, along with the similarly styled midcentury hotel that stands adjacent to it, has been preserved for offices and other uses, and is clearly visible from many parts of the terminal building. To anyone visiting Tucson by air, the historic airport control tower is a treasured and admired architectural landmark.
ce47e8c6a4c985e039652a207b3865cab307c03f.translatedText: 如今，這座標誌性塔樓以及毗鄰的風格類似的中世紀酒店已被保留下來用作辦公室和其他用途，從航站樓的許多地方都可以清晰地看到。對於任何乘飛機遊覽圖森的人來說，歷史悠久的機場控制塔是一個珍貴且令人欽佩的建築地標。

3f421908cb8c88f267af84e836b19358e705f93c.sourceText: The stone circle honors the 19 firemen who perished during the Yarnell Hill Fire.
3f421908cb8c88f267af84e836b19358e705f93c.translatedText: 石圈紀念在亞內爾山火災中喪生的 19 名消防員。

ff00d8e8b79d48219e90685e1909a8c289315643.sourceText: A fantastic resource for information on both Route 66 and the local area.
ff00d8e8b79d48219e90685e1909a8c289315643.translatedText: 有關 66 號公路和當地資訊的絕佳資源。

d0a90edaf4ee565df1e0f6dd8a70b4cf539080f2.sourceText: The last such cabin in Arizona is a rare remnant of a bygone era of medical treatment.
d0a90edaf4ee565df1e0f6dd8a70b4cf539080f2.translatedText: 亞利桑那州最後一間這樣的小屋是過去醫療時代的罕見遺跡。

5a9893d9748700b8e2f26e1068b79e9b50202810.sourceText: Vulture Mine was Arizona’s most productive gold mine, and instrumental to the development of Phoenix.
5a9893d9748700b8e2f26e1068b79e9b50202810.translatedText: 禿鷹礦是亞利桑那州生產力最高的金礦，對開發鳳凰城。

05313665115f4feca17da2d46e87bbd258bc2ec0.sourceText: This Prescott institution is widely considered the oldest bar in Arizona.
05313665115f4feca17da2d46e87bbd258bc2ec0.translatedText: 普雷斯科特酒吧被廣泛認為是亞利桑那州最古老的酒吧。

b75784634d2dfad551e9cb0345c31820e3c99e89.translatedText: 帕洛維德能源教育中心

1a85a9aaa28a06c8453adecba24f49e62d4f2dd6.sourceText: Get up close to a life-sized model of a spent-fuel dry cask and learn how Arizona’s largest power plant operates in a desert.
1a85a9aaa28a06c8453adecba24f49e62d4f2dd6.translatedText: 近距離接觸真人大小的乏燃料乾桶模型，了解亞利桑那州最大的發電廠如何在沙漠中運作。

dcdb87537c72ddf4b798842050846e5af2e1b8c7.sourceText: Once a year, at exactly 11:11 a.m., this monument comes to life.
dcdb87537c72ddf4b798842050846e5af2e1b8c7.translatedText: 每年一次，上午 11:11，這座紀念碑就會煥發活力。

0f89ddcc54f66bb6ca967456ea14a6675b9e9fe2.sourceText: Once disputed as the largest sundial in the world.
0f89ddcc54f66bb6ca967456ea14a6675b9e9fe2.translatedText: 曾經被爭議為世界上最大的日晷。

5ca1d321ac477fb9821af88eecf1959a1676857b.sourceText: This rustic cabin, outfitted with gun slits, was once home to John D. Tewksbury, patriarch of the bloodiest family feud in American history.
5ca1d321ac477fb9821af88eecf1959a1676857b.translatedText: 這間鄉村小屋配有槍縫，曾經是美國歷史上最血腥家族世仇的族長約翰·D·圖克斯伯里 (John D. Tewksbury) 的住所。

f731f1f814021577927e1cb71cc03df6454eafd8.sourceText: Even the architecture of this small, humble structure hints at violence. This Flying “V” Cabin, built in 1880 seems to lack windows, but on closer inspection you see that there are small slits throughout the cabin. These were not designed to let sunlight in but to let gunfire out. In place of windows there are gun ports.
f731f1f814021577927e1cb71cc03df6454eafd8.translatedText: 即使是這個小而簡陋的建築的建築也暗示著暴力。這座建於 1880 年的飛行「V」型客艙似乎沒有窗戶，但仔細觀察就會發現，整個客艙都有細小的縫隙。這些設計不是為了讓陽光進入，而是為了讓槍聲射出。窗戶的位置被槍口取代。

058a054965bbcaf2d82e7e5cc93855c1b346168f.sourceText: The Flying V Cabin has since been moved to the Pioneer Living History Museum in Pioneer Arizona, but it was originally located in Pleasant Valley and was home to John Tewksbury, Sr. Whether you call it the Pleasant Valley War or the Tewksbury-Graham Feud the resident of that small cabin was at the center of a family war that lasted six years and had the largest death toll of any family feud in US history. By the end of the battle nearly every male in both families was dead.
058a054965bbcaf2d82e7e5cc93855c1b346168f.translatedText: Flying V 小屋後來被移至先鋒亞利桑那州的先鋒生活歷史博物館，但它最初位於普萊森特谷，是老約翰·圖克斯伯里的家。無論你稱之為普萊森特谷戰爭或圖克斯伯里-格雷厄姆世仇，那個小小屋的居民都處於一場持續六年、死亡人數最多的家庭戰爭的中心。美國歷史上任何家庭不和的代價。戰鬥結束時，兩個家族的幾乎所有男性都已死亡。

7266e4a3abc2344db513a6fd1c09eb4b3b122b92.sourceText: John Tewksbury, Sr., the resident of the Flying V Cabin, was part Indian and was the patriarch of the Tewksbury clan. However it would be his sons who undertook the battles in the Tewksbury-Graham Feud.
7266e4a3abc2344db513a6fd1c09eb4b3b122b92.translatedText: Flying V 艙的居民老約翰·圖克斯伯里 (John Tewksbury, Sr.) 有印第安血統，是圖克斯伯里氏族的族長。然而，在圖克斯伯里-格雷厄姆世仇中參加戰鬥的卻是他的兒子們。

2b21a152e3b2cc245b78888f3bf4c91659c6b4b4.sourceText: The family feud started like so many others before it. Two neighbors, friends at first, slowly fall into a dispute. It was John Tewksbury, Sr himself who invited Tom Graham out to Arizona to begin ranching. Soon however, even the vast expanse of the Southwest began to feel cramped. Both families started accusing the others of stealing horses and cattle. Egged on by a third rancher named James Stinson, the arguments and accusations turned to arrest warrants.
2b21a152e3b2cc245b78888f3bf4c91659c6b4b4.translatedText: 這場家庭不和就像之前的許多其他家庭不和一樣開始。兩個鄰居起初是朋友，慢慢地陷入了爭執。老約翰·圖克斯伯里邀請湯姆·格雷厄姆到亞利桑那州開始牧場。然而很快，即使是廣闊的西南地區也開始感到局促。兩個家庭都開始指責其他人偷馬和牛。在第三位名叫詹姆斯·斯廷森（James Stinson）的牧場主的慫恿下，爭論和指控變成了逮捕令。

6745ce8c54f27a6152d9dcc3eef0618631bd4087.sourceText: An attempt to settle some of the issues in person quickly turned into a shoot out. In 1885 a Basque sheepherder was killed and robbed by a member of the Graham clan, and suddenly the entire valley took sides. For the next three years it was all out war.
6745ce8c54f27a6152d9dcc3eef0618631bd4087.translatedText: 親自解決一些問題的嘗試很快就變成了槍戰。 1885 年，一名巴斯克牧羊人被格雷厄姆家族的一名成員殺害並搶劫，突然整個山谷都站在了一邊。接下來的三年裡，戰爭全面爆發。

8fb9e93d3a0350d4f45061a6e8c3101cc6800129.sourceText: The Tewksbury-Graham Feud became wildly complicated, involving multiple other ranchers, hired hands, and the investors of both rancher families. In one incident a 19-year-old scout, who was attempting to rally support for the Graham side was captured by a bounty hunter hiding in a cave, who was then killed by an Apache who was stalking the bounty hunter, at which point the Apache was immediately shot by the 19-year-old scout. A group of cowboys called the Hashknife outfit got involved and quickly gained a reputation as the "thievinist, fightinest bunch of cowboys” in the U.S. People were beheaded, ranches were burned to the ground, an assassin was hired, and lynchings, murders, and shootouts became commonplace. The Tewksbury-Graham Feud played like a super-cut of spaghetti Westerns climaxes.
8fb9e93d3a0350d4f45061a6e8c3101cc6800129.translatedText: 圖克斯伯里和格雷厄姆之間的恩怨變得極其複雜，涉及多個其他牧場主、僱工以及兩個牧場主家族的投資者。在一次事件中，一名 19 歲的偵察兵試圖為格雷厄姆一方爭取支持，但被躲在山洞裡的賞金獵人抓獲，隨後這名偵察兵被跟踪賞金獵人的一名阿帕奇人殺死，此時阿帕奇人立即被這名 19 歲偵察兵射殺。一群被稱為「Hashknife」的牛仔參與其中，很快就獲得了美國「竊盜犯、最好鬥的牛仔群」的名聲。人們被斬首，牧場被燒毀，僱用刺客，私刑、謀殺和槍戰變得司空見慣。圖克斯伯里和格雷厄姆之間的恩怨就像是義大利西部片高潮的超級剪輯。

13033bb370ed7b5c270daf27d61f97d279fd0e08.sourceText: This reclusive Hopi village in Arizona has been continuously populated longer than anywhere else in America.
13033bb370ed7b5c270daf27d61f97d279fd0e08.translatedText: 這個位於亞利桑那州的僻靜霍皮族村莊的人口持續居住時間比美國其他任何地方都長。

6f9d87cd6848d36ff915448ed1d68ea1cd12e23a.sourceText: A scrap-metal sculpture recalls an infamous 19th-century camel.
6f9d87cd6848d36ff915448ed1d68ea1cd12e23a.translatedText: 廢金屬雕塑讓人想起一頭惡名昭彰的 19 世紀駱駝。

00ff90f7fc3edbb7cdbb2e7b76c926f43d0688e6.sourceText: This memorial pyramid marker honors one of the United States Government's first official camel riders.
00ff90f7fc3edbb7cdbb2e7b76c926f43d0688e6.translatedText: 這座紀念金字塔標誌旨在紀念美國政府首批官方駱駝騎士之一。

5cf0710cd80b1425309721858335ecf99453555a.sourceText: Where the Old West meets the even Older West.
5cf0710cd80b1425309721858335ecf99453555a.translatedText: 舊西部與較古老的西部相遇的地方。

7ea68e9379f667e60631730fc24a4db044401dac.sourceText: Millions of years of erosion created the feature for which this rock formation is aptly named.
7ea68e9379f667e60631730fc24a4db044401dac.translatedText: 數百萬年的侵蝕創造了這種岩層的特徵，因此得名。

85c1e9f393974ed7dd287c15ccedf2d570fb3735.sourceText: The unusual burial monument of Arizona's first governor.
85c1e9f393974ed7dd287c15ccedf2d570fb3735.translatedText: 亞利桑那州第一任州長的不同尋常的埋葬紀念碑。

e108a27287ebb36424afd248865b0256628af970.sourceText: A museum and tribute to a brave profession.
e108a27287ebb36424afd248865b0256628af970.translatedText: 一座博物館，向勇敢的職業致敬。

25ec89ea5b90589a5eca40d5356684ecd7f4bb73.sourceText: The historic “pink house on the hill” is an architectural gem that now serves as a center for water conservation.
25ec89ea5b90589a5eca40d5356684ecd7f4bb73.translatedText: 歷史悠久的「山上粉紅色的房子」是一座建築瑰寶，現在作為水資源保護中心。

1b39ccc792882b687d5578527b7a5bad4699137c.sourceText: In Phoenix's Papago Park, there is a small hill made of red sandstone with large cavities, called tafoni, caused by erosion. One is so large that it creates an opening to the other side of the rock that can be hiked up to reach great views of the park.
1b39ccc792882b687d5578527b7a5bad4699137c.translatedText: 在鳳凰城的 Papago 公園，有一座由紅色砂岩構成的小山，上面有大的空洞，稱為塔福尼 (tafoni)，是由侵蝕造成的。其中一個非常大，以至於在岩石的另一側形成了一個開口，可以爬上去欣賞公園的美景。

662ac0272f109be022975482548b64b3f202c954.sourceText: The rock features in what is now Papago Park are estimated to be around 20 million years old. Millions of years of erosion created the openings in the sandstone for which this landmark is aptly named. Archaeologists believe that the formation was used by the Indigenous Hohokam people as a sort of calendar. There is evidence that markings in the rock were made to indicate the position of the sun shining through the opening in the rear side of the rock, which differed throughout the seasons.
662ac0272f109be022975482548b64b3f202c954.translatedText: 現在的 Papago 公園中的岩石特徵估計約有 2000 萬年的歷史。數百萬年的侵蝕在砂岩上形成了開口，這個地標也因此得名。考古學家認為，霍霍卡姆原住民使用該結構作為一種日曆。有證據表明，岩石上的標記是用來指示陽光透過岩石後側開口照射的位置的，這些標記在各個季節都有所不同。

a80b195e7407378d5127c1fdab59659ada360a0c.sourceText: The rock formation is reachable either by hiking up a flatter, easier path behind the rock, or a steeper climb straight up the front side. Note that the latter choice is not recommended for inexperienced climbers.
a80b195e7407378d5127c1fdab59659ada360a0c.translatedText: 可以透過沿著岩石後面更平坦、更容易的路徑徒步到達岩層，或直接沿著前側攀登更陡峭的路線。請注意，不建議沒有經驗的登山者選擇後一種選擇。

8b145c5078afaa41819165e64ccf5adbb9ea223e.sourceText: A short interpretive trail about one of the first human cultures in North America.
8b145c5078afaa41819165e64ccf5adbb9ea223e.translatedText: 關於北美最早的人類文化之一的簡短解釋路線。

434cde9dc968433b990ce31f278630ae25024ac6.translatedText: 世界上第一家麥當勞得來速餐廳

60183409d8a64c511966c911d3f249e81c577c2f.sourceText: Out of a desire to feed hungry soldiers, a franchise-altering idea was born.
60183409d8a64c511966c911d3f249e81c577c2f.translatedText: 出於為飢餓的士兵提供食物的願望，一個改變特許經營權的想法誕生了。

ab6729291d874ca5300f97dff76084c199afca74.sourceText: A family-owned store specializing in minerals, geodes, gemstones, and more.
ab6729291d874ca5300f97dff76084c199afca74.translatedText: 專門販售礦物、晶洞、寶石等的家庭商店。

66f8468381216971b0044d9b2b202f20dcadcc6e.translatedText: 詹姆斯·加菲爾德紀念壁爐

d6076aafe1af341525958758a676c262b60e9d83.sourceText: This fireplace-turned-monument pays tribute to the assassinated U.S. president.
d6076aafe1af341525958758a676c262b60e9d83.translatedText: 這座由壁爐改建的紀念碑向被暗殺的美國總統致敬。

6806429a28893a5b7957d60a86dd50338e1ab47c.sourceText: The lost ruins of the forgotten ferry lie hidden beneath the silt.
6806429a28893a5b7957d60a86dd50338e1ab47c.translatedText: 被遺忘的渡輪的廢墟隱藏在淤泥之下。

44db298f361445c10715709c689a288a9b0fca08.sourceText: The remains of a large pueblo village constructed by the Salado culture, who occupied the region more than 600 years ago.
44db298f361445c10715709c689a288a9b0fca08.translatedText: 薩拉多文化建造的大型普韋布洛村莊的遺跡，薩拉多文化在 600 多年前佔領了該地區。

d6be9aa15a339acda82ba370f87786c037660a01.sourceText: Archaeologists believe this panel of petroglyphs depicting descending sheep and other figures in Glen Canyon are 3,000 to 6,000 years old.
d6be9aa15a339acda82ba370f87786c037660a01.translatedText: 考古學家認為，這幅描繪格倫峽谷中下降的羊和其他人物的岩畫已有 3,000 到 6,000 年的歷史。

4a86158144d8d6ec13c9a6140ad91916b906b050.sourceText: This sinkhole in the Arizona desert is filled with carbonated, arsenic-rich water
4a86158144d8d6ec13c9a6140ad91916b906b050.translatedText: 亞利桑那州沙漠中的這個天坑充滿了碳酸化、富含砷的物質水

0e575018c6b14f9b27613dceb1f4f4b1bd632213.sourceText: Red sandstone structures dominate this landscape, which has been inhabited for some 5,000 years.
0e575018c6b14f9b27613dceb1f4f4b1bd632213.translatedText: 紅砂岩結構在這片景觀中占主導地位，這裡已經有人居住了大約 5,000 年。

57d8463243492e6f1ab2cae922253bdcedde275c.sourceText: This comprehensive collection features Native American artifacts dating back centuries.
57d8463243492e6f1ab2cae922253bdcedde275c.translatedText: 這個全面的收藏包含了幾個世紀前的美洲原住民文物。

84040c1ac2ce5ac760941d6d9d41e639d761ed03.sourceText: This abandoned horse racing track was an exercise in hubris from its inception.
84040c1ac2ce5ac760941d6d9d41e639d761ed03.translatedText: 這條廢棄的賽馬場從一開始就是一種傲慢的行為。

48fe2850f34f551e2708f3b7a55e6f0060465ee9.sourceText: The final resting place for an internet icon.
48fe2850f34f551e2708f3b7a55e6f0060465ee9.translatedText: 網路偶像的最後安息之地。

936d3a2fbcbbaa790779291eade466a95e05327a.sourceText: A colony of Mexican free-tailed bats live under the bridge and take flight at sundown all summer long.
936d3a2fbcbbaa790779291eade466a95e05327a.translatedText: 一群墨西哥無尾蝙蝠生活在橋下，整個夏天都會在日落時起飛。

db0e094cccebed51788626f3174f23154499525a.sourceText: First Joe Pagac sculpture; sculpture reflects native Tucson wildlife in an urban setting.
db0e094cccebed51788626f3174f23154499525a.translatedText: 第一個 Joe Pagac 雕塑；雕塑反映了城市環境中的圖森本地野生動物。

ea8ff91e58c5021137f485a2d2f484a17505acb8.sourceText: This once-booming Gold Rush town is now home to a herd of feral donkeys.
ea8ff91e58c5021137f485a2d2f484a17505acb8.translatedText: 這個曾經繁榮的淘金小鎮現在是一群野驢的家。

fa31eb89b5011b71e69cd103f96b5249632c136a.sourceText: Petroglyphs, bird watching, and a 100-year-old Ranch in one location.
fa31eb89b5011b71e69cd103f96b5249632c136a.translatedText: 岩畫、觀鳥和一個有 100 年歷史的牧場集中在一個地方。

4da91b71cb76a7004414f1a0f18197ef9c5b4a32.sourceText: These elusive, isolated rodents evolved into a distinct, locally iconic subspecies.
4da91b71cb76a7004414f1a0f18197ef9c5b4a32.translatedText: 這些難以捉摸、孤立的囓齒動物進化成了獨特的當地標誌性動物亞種。

a8643891bfb695a506ec427223ef72776e2d5472.sourceText: A tribute to one of the last great singing cowboys.
a8643891bfb695a506ec427223ef72776e2d5472.translatedText: 向最後一位偉大的歌唱牛仔之一致敬。

035a0afe2c22b7f9f7b15d46e9115ea395334cc3.sourceText: Hike the unusual hoodoos and rock formations that form this little-known natural wonder.
035a0afe2c22b7f9f7b15d46e9115ea395334cc3.translatedText: 徒步穿越形成這一鮮為人知的自然奇觀的不尋常的石林和岩層。

ae2e62ff87fa25bb1c09a8fb23db9e84e1b25f91.sourceText: A once popular resort—said to be the vacation spot of gangster Al Capone—now remains abandoned in the woods of Arizona.
ae2e62ff87fa25bb1c09a8fb23db9e84e1b25f91.translatedText: 一個曾經很受歡迎的度假勝地——據說是黑幫阿爾卡彭的度假勝地——現在仍然被遺棄在亞利桑那州的樹林裡。

90c91ae7d531e614dcacfbd80fe933a9bbc5eb96.translatedText: Show Low 紙牌遊戲紀念碑

27823b67142aa21e05a6affb79d3c999b0d8e1a2.sourceText: A monument commemorates the importance of a two of clubs in the history of Show Low, Arizona.
27823b67142aa21e05a6affb79d3c999b0d8e1a2.translatedText: 一座紀念碑，紀念亞利桑那州 Show Low 歷史上梅花二的重要性。

e56c2e620f69552f4697c07e7f78bd04eb3d6a23.sourceText: TWA-United Grand Canyon Collision Mass Grave
e56c2e620f69552f4697c07e7f78bd04eb3d6a23.translatedText: 環球航空 - 聯合大峽谷碰撞萬人坑

d651bc9bc21b22309b026cc9a525f2934fa28263.sourceText: Valle Planes of Fame Air Museum
d651bc9bc21b22309b026cc9a525f2934fa28263.translatedText: 榮譽航空的 Valle 飛機博物館

3970c95737540544e29f6d98525f50d790a72700.sourceText: Built in 1927, the now-abandoned airfield once hosted notable pilots including Amelia Earhart and Charles Lindbergh.
3970c95737540544e29f6d98525f50d790a72700.translatedText: 這座現已廢棄的機場建於 1927 年，曾接待過阿米莉亞·埃爾哈特 (Amelia Earhart) 和查爾斯·林德伯格 (Charles Lindbergh) 等著名飛行員。

9003aade6ac7253be40138fb7c52f018c0eff2eb.sourceText: A mass grave for victims of an airline disaster that led to much-needed safety improvements for commercial flights.
9003aade6ac7253be40138fb7c52f018c0eff2eb.translatedText: 為空難受害者建造的萬人坑，該事故導致商業航班急需的安全改進。

3d924b4caebbfb54340cb6847808c0fb63174dde.sourceText: An incredible airplane graveyard sits outside this small museum dedicated to preserving aviation history.
3d924b4caebbfb54340cb6847808c0fb63174dde.translatedText: 這個致力於保存航空歷史的小博物館外面有一個令人難以置信的飛機墓地。

161f20354ec4b090fa8785be811847f1f7fb8173.sourceText: The wreckage of a deadly bomber plane crash can still be found near an Arizona peak.
161f20354ec4b090fa8785be811847f1f7fb8173.translatedText: 致命轟炸機墜毀的殘骸仍然可以在亞利桑那州的一座山峰附近找到。

baa95a5401254c83d4f8485dd86899def4d80505.sourceText: The former home of the army detachment that captured Geronimo.
baa95a5401254c83d4f8485dd86899def4d80505.translatedText: 俘虜傑羅尼莫的陸軍支隊的故居。

0cb16fd55f3e835ac5536ad66c241d13ca162fc3.sourceText: At certain times in the fall and winter, the sunlight makes this natural sandstone arch glow.
0cb16fd55f3e835ac5536ad66c241d13ca162fc3.translatedText: 在秋季和冬季的某些時候，陽光會讓這座天然砂岩拱門閃閃發光。

860e0cc9dedf6c9b7c3ae602ff68fde2e231b0c3.sourceText: A strenuous, unofficial trail leads to spectacular views in one of America's most remote national monuments.
860e0cc9dedf6c9b7c3ae602ff68fde2e231b0c3.translatedText: 一條費力的非官方步道通往美國最偏遠的國家紀念碑之一的壯麗景色。

5ff2b95ebe9e9afa212faa6c7daf1d4767f46b29.sourceText: A remote desert monument marks where a priest and explorer entered what later became Arizona.
5ff2b95ebe9e9afa212faa6c7daf1d4767f46b29.translatedText: 一座偏遠的沙漠紀念碑，標誌著一位牧師和探險家進入後來成為亞利桑那州的地方。

ccbc59d8d664e3ce9482fdffecebbabef91c322d.sourceText: One of the largest open-pit copper mining operations in the entire country.
ccbc59d8d664e3ce9482fdffecebbabef91c322d.translatedText: 全國最大的露天銅礦開採作業之一。

4e636001ee2bfbd9487fb8b41e00be73d77f98e2.sourceText: One man handcrafts "the best sake made outside of Japan" in a tiny desert town on Route 66.
4e636001ee2bfbd9487fb8b41e00be73d77f98e2.translatedText: 一名男子在 66 號公路旁的一座沙漠小鎮上手工釀造「日本以外最好的清酒」。

1edac7c83139a2dda0a6399c4640210338f9f7e9.sourceText: A maze-like landscape of globular rocks surrounding two Arizona lakes.
1edac7c83139a2dda0a6399c4640210338f9f7e9.translatedText: 亞利桑那州兩個湖泊周圍的球狀岩石迷宮般的景觀。

07acdbd69dabcebda265b4968a62341a3e175b22.sourceText: Arizona's first government hub is a rustic cabin now preserved as part of a historical museum.
07acdbd69dabcebda265b4968a62341a3e175b22.translatedText: 亞利桑那州的第一個政府中心是一個鄉村小屋，現在作為歷史博物館的一部分保存下來。

ec2bebc3c67f9f865173d058a9a53a8a01e6b9f5.sourceText: Don Parks’ Yard of Statues and Stuff
ec2bebc3c67f9f865173d058a9a53a8a01e6b9f5.translatedText: 唐·帕克斯 (Don Parks) 的雕像和物品院子

f548d2f2cc7f01511e539e004e1282fd0ac84bfb.sourceText: Phoenix man has two yards full of vintage signs and antiques.
f548d2f2cc7f01511e539e004e1282fd0ac84bfb.translatedText: 鳳凰人有兩個院子，裡面擺滿了復古標誌和古董。

62c4036ed1865f401ef1b40651c60b551f0c1414.sourceText: A Saint Nicholas-themed ghost town in the Mojave desert.
62c4036ed1865f401ef1b40651c60b551f0c1414.translatedText: 莫哈維沙漠中以聖尼古拉斯為主題的鬼城。

03647925c22f8fc9a81341db376f021cd82f85ff.sourceText: This abandoned open-pit copper mine features stunning turquoise mineral pools and excellent rock-hunting opportunities.
03647925c22f8fc9a81341db376f021cd82f85ff.translatedText: 這個廢棄的露天銅礦擁有令人驚嘆的綠松石礦池和絕佳的岩石狩獵機會。

590b9236dfd728a41a66a245a9310b5d10ff5053.sourceText: A memorial to the firefighters who died in an industrial disaster is housed in a small public park.
590b9236dfd728a41a66a245a9310b5d10ff5053.translatedText: 在一個小型公園內設有一座紀念在工業災難中喪生的消防員的紀念碑。

1637d99eaf18d16c4cce5c29d0e3c63e434943db.sourceText: The Ghost Town of Nothing, Arizona
1637d99eaf18d16c4cce5c29d0e3c63e434943db.translatedText: 亞利桑那州，空無一物的鬼城

b7eb23fcb69c553e992c22a439edf388916890b2.sourceText: A century-old miner's quarters turned mansion.
b7eb23fcb69c553e992c22a439edf388916890b2.translatedText: 一棟百年礦工宿舍變成了豪宅。

e82402db11bdc13bab8399b3daaf0f69c09f99d2.sourceText: Although now a decaying ruin, this stone cabin's history includes several notable figures.
e82402db11bdc13bab8399b3daaf0f69c09f99d2.translatedText: 雖然現在是一片腐爛的廢墟，但這座石屋的歷史上有幾位著名人物。

98e24ca758dc013a33b0a065e5e1e6e18c97be89.sourceText: The graffiti-covered ruins of an abandoned trading post in the middle of the Navajo Nation.
98e24ca758dc013a33b0a065e5e1e6e18c97be89.translatedText: 納瓦荷族中部一個廢棄貿易站的塗鴉覆蓋的廢墟。

11c049e09f3ad77505d996512c61a76db1390806.sourceText: This giant steer-skull edifice refuses to die.
11c049e09f3ad77505d996512c61a76db1390806.translatedText: 這座巨大的牛頭骨建築拒絕消亡。

edcb50a2fee9939f3d70d4f8dca51f4f740a5ace.translatedText: 特拉維斯·沃爾頓的電話亭

e7b6808da5ceec9cb692710366e472751bebca2c.sourceText: In 1975, a forestry worker in Arizona claimed to have been abducted by a UFO.
e7b6808da5ceec9cb692710366e472751bebca2c.translatedText: 1975 年，亞利桑那州的一名林業工人聲稱被不明飛行物綁架。

dca58f106cfc4e1acd2f30067de12826fe5968b0.sourceText: Two geoglyphs that are truly unique to North America.
dca58f106cfc4e1acd2f30067de12826fe5968b0.translatedText: 兩個真正北美獨有的地理符號。

142e88a9e3a4e0aa4290e96f8e73c04e0e742107.translatedText: 第309航空航太維修與再生大隊

6a6754fab15a1f709477c8c041476b07ef25413e.sourceText: The world's largest military aircraft cemetery.
6a6754fab15a1f709477c8c041476b07ef25413e.translatedText: 世界上最大的軍用飛機墳場。

c93d441dd83d2f9ca9870786154bab902e86d09e.sourceText: This Native American settlement dates back to the Pueblo II period.
c93d441dd83d2f9ca9870786154bab902e86d09e.translatedText: 這個美洲原住民定居點的歷史可以追溯到普韋布洛二世時期。

870c17fffa00c6bc69714b3aaad8fe1e7e759927.sourceText: This small interfaith chapel lies not far from the rim of the Grand Canyon.
870c17fffa00c6bc69714b3aaad8fe1e7e759927.translatedText: 這座小型跨宗教教堂位於大峽谷邊緣不遠。

4ef12ad414de176a3e5286e6858cecc28db84fe4.sourceText: The remnants of a creative early method of wildfire prevention.
4ef12ad414de176a3e5286e6858cecc28db84fe4.translatedText: 遺物一種創意的早期野火預防方法。

c88e04648dc9d3906516b28c57baebc2245479c3.sourceText: A monument to the one-armed geologist who led the first documented expeditions through the Grand Canyon.
c88e04648dc9d3906516b28c57baebc2245479c3.translatedText: 為紀念帶領第一次有記錄的大峽谷探險隊的獨臂地質學家而建的紀念碑。

613e9c23f0aa16648fce1649ee7d87cf6128aa1a.sourceText: A kaleidoscope gallery and steampunk emporium named for a pioneering journalist.
613e9c23f0aa16648fce1649ee7d87cf6128aa1a.translatedText: 以一位先鋒記者的名字命名的萬花筒畫廊和蒸氣龐克商場。

dd4f168d92184ee58b4372958c2c5923b5374c00.sourceText: A Wild West jailhouse that slid down the mountainside.
dd4f168d92184ee58b4372958c2c5923b5374c00.translatedText: 從山腰滑落的狂野西部監獄。

01837f65baf0fa5367561cf9c1f391ee8bb82c59.sourceText: At 11,500 feet in elevation, there is no toilet in the state closer to the sky than this one.
01837f65baf0fa5367561cf9c1f391ee8bb82c59.translatedText: 海拔 11,500 英尺，該州沒有比這個更接近天空的廁所了。

9883ef6f903f18cc1b7c772cdab0f98ea29607f0.sourceText: Colossal Cave's human history is as intriguing as its geology.
9883ef6f903f18cc1b7c772cdab0f98ea29607f0.translatedText: 巨大洞穴的人類歷史和它的地質一樣令人著迷。

123681188aaa14e95ab06d504215f977ed8a2dba.sourceText: Giant steel and concrete dinosaurs near Route 66 invite passerbys into a mineral shop.
123681188aaa14e95ab06d504215f977ed8a2dba.translatedText: 66 號公路附近的巨型鋼鐵和混凝土恐龍邀請路人走進一家礦物商店。

44d34faa0f017d8e4825a18f40337ced07a8afc0.sourceText: This rusted car found in Petrified Forest National Park's Route 66 exhibit may be the most photographed abandoned car in the country.
44d34faa0f017d8e4825a18f40337ced07a8afc0.translatedText: 在石化森林國家公園的 66 號公路展覽中發現的這輛生鏽的汽車可能是全國被拍照最多的廢棄汽車。

60450dfc4b631106a6a8c69367457dc67d450a9e.sourceText: This sanguine boulevard was named after a deadly cowboy bar fight.
60450dfc4b631106a6a8c69367457dc67d450a9e.translatedText: 這條充滿活力的林蔭大道以一場致命的牛仔酒吧鬥毆命名。

16b393c3d8206ebfd60026802e8b6a681bb05caf.sourceText: Browse an impressive collection of passenger and military aircraft dating back to World War II.
16b393c3d8206ebfd60026802e8b6a681bb05caf.translatedText: 瀏覽一系列可追溯至第二次世界大戰的令人印象深刻的客機和軍用飛機。

e3e74fef9b0f4cb5f5ffef71843d80286011de38.sourceText: Opinions differ as to whether this Arizona tree was actually used as a Wild West jail, but that hasn't stopped the town from capitalizing on it.
e3e74fef9b0f4cb5f5ffef71843d80286011de38.translatedText: 對於這棵亞利桑那州的樹是否實際上被用作狂野西部監獄，眾說紛紜，但這並沒有阻止該鎮利用它。

d31ff49a5409401cf0cf96764ea317671c9ea188.sourceText: This tucked-away cemetery is the final resting place of a prospector who uncovered one of the largest gold mines in Arizona.
d31ff49a5409401cf0cf96764ea317671c9ea188.translatedText: 這個隱蔽的公墓是一位探礦者的最後安息之地，他發現了最大的金礦之一亞利桑那州的礦山。

0443c4c3a83e24cbc266947c957f48967004b9d7.sourceText: All that's left of a former camp and settlement is a plaque commemorating the water source found at this remote site.
0443c4c3a83e24cbc266947c957f48967004b9d7.translatedText: 前營地和定居點僅剩一塊牌匾，紀念在這個偏遠地點發現的水源。

4531152c2f8f396b976b8e345fde386b334fad14.sourceText: An early 20th-century jail not far from the infamous Tombstone, Arizona.
4531152c2f8f396b976b8e345fde386b334fad14.translatedText: 一所 20 世紀早期的監獄，距離臭名昭著的亞利桑那州墓碑鎮不遠。

a387d81f48c4550cf756be86254e72cee1b2b701.sourceText: This unique competition celebrates an American Indian and Canadian First Nation cultural tradition.
a387d81f48c4550cf756be86254e72cee1b2b701.translatedText: 這項獨特的比賽旨在慶祝美洲印第安人和加拿大原住民的文化傳統。

33229c1efd335db5df1b854dc8d76c8ca4a61b83.sourceText: This mural of the late David Bowie features eight colorful panels showcasing Bowie’s various alter egos.
33229c1efd335db5df1b854dc8d76c8ca4a61b83.translatedText: 這幅已故大衛鮑伊的壁畫有八塊彩色面板，展示了鮑伊的各種不同自我。

269e9718ecda9aba5be87c757bc1bbf4cbadad62.sourceText: Every winter, the Heard Museum hosts the World Championship Hoop Dance Contest. Accompanied by a group of musicians, dancers use their hoops to create symbols of eagles, baskets, flowers, insects, and much more in beat to the music.
269e9718ecda9aba5be87c757bc1bbf4cbadad62.translatedText: 每年冬天，赫德博物館都會舉辦世界鐵環舞蹈錦標賽。在一群音樂家的伴奏下，舞者們用鐵環隨著音樂的節拍創造出鷹、籃子、花朵、昆蟲等符號。

c49ffeec235ee2ea2b85063e9810fa5670c113d4.sourceText: The two-day event has numerous participants compete in five age divisions, ranging from those under five to those over 40 years old. The dancers are judged on their precision, rhythm, speed, showmanship, and creativity.
c49ffeec235ee2ea2b85063e9810fa5670c113d4.translatedText: 為期兩天的活動吸引了眾多參與者，分五個年齡組進行角逐，從五歲以下到四十歲以上。評判標準是舞者的精準度、節奏、速度、表演技巧和創造力。

2edece55ec74a9811944c56bea9e8bb9aaabfdf1.sourceText: The event is a blend of athleticism and artistic talent. But it's much more than an entertaining affair. It honors cultural traditions from various American Indian and Canadian First Nation tribes who use hoop dancing as part of their healing ceremonies. Dancers use up to 50 hoops to create a series of mesmerizing movements.
2edece55ec74a9811944c56bea9e8bb9aaabfdf1.translatedText: 這項賽事是運動天賦和藝術才華的融合。但這不僅僅是一件有趣的事。它尊重美洲印第安人和加拿大原住民部落的文化傳統，他們將圈舞作為治療儀式的一部分。舞者使用多達 50 個鐵圈創造出一系列令人著迷的動作。

e6fbad8a36afb17129d71442dcb1c204c7d669b3.sourceText: While at the competition, visitors may also explore the museum and try indigenous dishes from vendors or the museum's restaurant.
e6fbad8a36afb17129d71442dcb1c204c7d669b3.translatedText: 在比賽期間，遊客還可以探索博物館並品嚐供應商或博物館餐廳提供的土著菜餚。

e0f27a6203ee8afa23508cc7a938fe338b51b5c1.sourceText: A Norman-style castle, 1850s Irish cottage, and cultural center in the heart of Phoenix.
e0f27a6203ee8afa23508cc7a938fe338b51b5c1.translatedText: 諾曼風格的城堡、1850 年代的愛爾蘭小屋和位於鳳凰城中心的文化中心。

ca565388382d27dba65e30ea8e0205c708d1bf7d.sourceText: This oversized flute-playing Ancestral Puebloan deity is also a landmark of Southwestern kitsch.
ca565388382d27dba65e30ea8e0205c708d1bf7d.translatedText: 這個超大的吹笛子的普韋布洛祖先神也是西南媚俗的地標。

ec5ccbb5b85547a233aa88921031f5c10e277798.sourceText: Inside this garden, visitors are offered a glimpse into how inhabitants of the region survived centuries ago.
ec5ccbb5b85547a233aa88921031f5c10e277798.translatedText: 在這個花園裡，遊客可以一睹該地區的居民在幾個世紀前是如何生存的。

e7a0dbe61eb1a3e271b8899ef33e4c60c2a9312e.sourceText: One of the most extensive and well-preserved collections of dinosaur footprints in North America.
e7a0dbe61eb1a3e271b8899ef33e4c60c2a9312e.translatedText: 北美最廣泛、保存最完好的恐龍足跡收藏之一。

7ebba53a80d665b6d0657a96a10dd08117e11ff6.sourceText: More than a century old, this trading post resides in the Navajo Nation.
7ebba53a80d665b6d0657a96a10dd08117e11ff6.translatedText: 這個貿易站已有一個多世紀的歷史，位於納瓦荷族部落。

5a21af7a2c625beb4213a0f7056318c762427a47.sourceText: Hike up to this ancestral grain storage site, but don't touch.
5a21af7a2c625beb4213a0f7056318c762427a47.translatedText: 徒步前往這個祖傳的穀物儲存地點，但不要觸摸。

be24bbba740a72192d539200703e3c43f8828787.sourceText: Today the area around Moenave, Arizona in the Navajo Nation is a dusty, windswept expanse with breathtaking desert landscapes but not a tree or drop of water in sight. About 200 million years ago, however, the area was a marshy riverbed that preserved hundreds of footprints from the dinosaurs that trod across it.
be24bbba740a72192d539200703e3c43f8828787.translatedText: 今天，納瓦荷族保留地亞利桑那州莫埃納夫周圍地區是一片塵土飛揚、風吹過的廣闊地區，有著令人驚嘆的沙漠景觀，但看不到一棵樹或一滴水。然而，大約 2 億年前，該地區是一片沼澤河床，保存了數百個恐龍足跡。

a9fdb34dbbf3725085f5d52e880babd10a875591.sourceText: The preserved tracks are from the early Jurassic period. Geologists visiting the site hypothesized that there was likely shallow water flowing over the area when the tracks were made. Some event, possibly a mudslide or the impact of a meteor quickly buried the area and preserved it, and wind and erosion in the millions of years since have slowly uncovered it.
a9fdb34dbbf3725085f5d52e880babd10a875591.translatedText: 保存下來的足跡來自侏儸紀早期。參觀該地點的地質學家推測，在鋪設這些痕跡時，該地區可能有淺水流過。某些事件，可能是泥石流或流星撞擊，迅速掩埋了該地區並將其保存下來，數百萬年的風和侵蝕慢慢地揭示了它。

d35ef19f26d4026bd48c49b4ce76701f749e94cc.sourceText: It is not possible to determine with certainty the specific type of dinosaurs that made the tracks at Moenave but experts have made educated guesses. Fossils of Dilophosaurus wetherilli have been found nearby and they would match the time period and size of many of the footprints at Moenave. Fans of the Jurassic Park movies may remember the Dilophosaurus as being shown to expand its neck frills and spit sticky venom, capabilities that there is no actual evidence of the dinosaur having. In actuality, the Dilophosaurus was much larger than portrayed in the Hollywood blockbusters, reaching sizes of up to 23 feet in length and weighing around 880 pounds, the largest known land predator in North America in its time.
d35ef19f26d4026bd48c49b4ce76701f749e94cc.translatedText: 無法確定在莫埃納夫留下足蹟的恐龍的具體類型，但專家們做出了有根據的猜測。在附近發現了雙脊龍韋瑟利利的化石，它們與莫埃納夫許多腳印的時代和大小相匹配。 《侏羅紀公園》電影的粉絲可能還記得，雙脊龍會擴張脖子上的褶邊並吐出黏稠的毒液，但沒有實際證據表明恐龍具有這種能力。事實上，雙脊龍比好萊塢大片中描繪的要大得多，身長可達 23 英尺，體重約 880 磅，是當時北美已知的最大的陸地掠食者。

5662dd437ab774aa0a78ce5bf5378872b2c89ab0.sourceText: Today the site has no official designation or protection. Handmade signs along the highway direct travelers a few hundred yards down a bumpy dirt road to a parking area where local Navajo people have set up small jewelry booths. Visitors are free to wander among the dinosaur tracks on their own but many of the vendors also offer guided tours for a small donation where some of the better-preserved tracks will be pointed out for you.
5662dd437ab774aa0a78ce5bf5378872b2c89ab0.translatedText: 如今，該網站沒有官方指定或保護。高速公路沿線手工製作的指示牌引導旅客沿著崎嶇不平的土路行駛數百碼到達停車場，當地納瓦霍人在那裡設立了小型珠寶攤位。遊客可以自由地自行在恐龍足跡中漫步，但許多供應商也提供導遊服務，只需支付少量捐款，他們就會為您指出一些保存較好的足跡。

bcac4b87e201e1a7ec130883c4d966b7e3f76da6.sourceText: This Old West hotel, the longest in continuous operation in the state of Arizona, is claimed to be haunted.
bcac4b87e201e1a7ec130883c4d966b7e3f76da6.translatedText: 這家舊西部酒店是亞利桑那州連續運營時間最長的酒店，據稱是鬧鬼。

5ee667c7fee210b819c25caae315c27eb07f39af.sourceText: This open-pit mine is now an abandoned symbol of Bisbee's copper-mining heritage.
5ee667c7fee210b819c25caae315c27eb07f39af.translatedText: 這個露天礦場現在是比斯比銅礦遺產的廢棄象徵。

f0812f3940be5d4013aba47670808b5899d5b8e3.sourceText: Mule Pass: Not Quite the Continental Divide
f0812f3940be5d4013aba47670808b5899d5b8e3.translatedText: 騾子通道：不完全是大陸分水嶺

fae4481bf6d756fe4420edd4227086ecf481d3f4.sourceText: A mistaken marker makes an erroneous claim along the historic Old Divide Road.
fae4481bf6d756fe4420edd4227086ecf481d3f4.translatedText: 錯誤的標記沿著歷史悠久的舊分水嶺做出了錯誤的聲明路。

53def67ec53b001dc2dc422d9b2c304eeb23fe67.sourceText: Stairs often replace streets on the steep slopes of this old mining town.
53def67ec53b001dc2dc422d9b2c304eeb23fe67.translatedText: 在這座古老採礦小鎮的陡坡上，樓梯經常取代街道。

50468cc5a3d8b30c41c8ce65f98153de36a14d39.sourceText: This collection of Wild West movie memorabilia also claims to hold some secrets of the Lost Dutchman's mine.
50468cc5a3d8b30c41c8ce65f98153de36a14d39.translatedText: 這本狂野西部電影紀念品收藏還聲稱掌握著失落的荷蘭人礦井的一些秘密。

7facbe4dc8379e56376a6fb4f98db00012ed470c.sourceText: Hidden on a cattle ranch in Arizona, this bookstore has been celebrating Southwest literature for more than 40 years.
7facbe4dc8379e56376a6fb4f98db00012ed470c.translatedText: 這家書店隱藏在亞利桑那州的一個牧場裡，40 多年來一直致力於推廣西南文學。

7c05368c30d12d2d616d7b3a2784189833de8c14.sourceText: This oasis-like spring in the Sonoran Desert is home to unique, endangered species.
7c05368c30d12d2d616d7b3a2784189833de8c14.translatedText: 索諾蘭沙漠中的這個綠洲般的泉水是獨特的瀕危物種的家園。

677a5727bb258276dd3f3a57f7e98b6449c56aa0.sourceText: Every year, festive decorations appear on this juniper tree located in the median strip of a busy highway.
677a5727bb258276dd3f3a57f7e98b6449c56aa0.translatedText: 每年，這棵位於繁忙高速公路中央地帶的杜松樹上都會出現節日裝飾。

df8c453818efc9dc197c432ad50f7725d9cda144.sourceText: A giant mascot, a car bomb, and the mafia mingle in the history of a defunct restaurant chain.
df8c453818efc9dc197c432ad50f7725d9cda144.translatedText: 一個巨大的吉祥物、一個汽車炸彈和黑手黨在一家已倒閉的連鎖餐廳的歷史中交織在一起。

fffca64449027cebd84416b4962af1a0a695209d.sourceText: This small museum is dedicated to the study of coprolites, or fossilized poop.
fffca64449027cebd84416b4962af1a0a695209d.translatedText: 這個小型博物館致力於研究糞化石或糞便化石。

c1184a68a1ccd17e0491bd8ed8eeb900eb1dbd80.sourceText: Bootleggers ran booze beneath this building before (and after) Route 66 appeared beside it.
c1184a68a1ccd17e0491bd8ed8eeb900eb1dbd80.translatedText: 在 66 號公路出現在其旁邊之前（和之後），走私者在這棟建築物下方偷酒。

6b539dfbf2f7ec396167d73364abeb0eb7d3b274.translatedText: 阿什福克-班布里奇鋼壩

305a321b71d174fcbe30fe218a54c30032261b29.sourceText: The first steel dam in the world and the only one still functional in the United States.
305a321b71d174fcbe30fe218a54c30032261b29.translatedText: 世界上第一座鋼壩，也是美國唯一一座仍在運作的鋼壩。

ff153eeb99c31040b6fe288391cc74161650f3aa.sourceText: Have you ever had a close up and personal visit with dinosaur poop? (Surprise: some of it will look very familiar!) If you're driving through Williams, Arizona along Highway 40, possibly on your way to the Grand Canyon, here's your chance.
ff153eeb99c31040b6fe288391cc74161650f3aa.translatedText: 您曾經近距離接觸過恐龍糞便嗎？ （驚喜：其中一些看起來非常熟悉！）如果您沿著 40 號高速公路開車穿過亞利桑那州的威廉斯，可能正在前往大峽谷的路上，那麼您的機會來了。

2168264f547527a4179005d75663519bbfc86b94.sourceText: The Poozeum (get it?) is weird and scientific, doesn't smell bad, and will thrill any dinosaur-loving kid and adult. It has dozens of displays of big and little poop, and a four-foot-long plop from the Titanosaur, the world's largest pooper. (It's a replica, but still...)
2168264f547527a4179005d75663519bbfc86b94.translatedText: Poozeum（明白了嗎？） 既怪異又科學，聞起來並不難聞，會讓任何喜歡恐龍的孩子和成人感到興奮。它展示了數十個大大小小的糞便，以及世界上最大的糞便泰坦巨龍的四英尺長的糞便。 （是複製品，但還是…）

5066f5ac0a4debba8cc2b5c5823d185d10c956b4.sourceText: Unlike the average person, the museum's curator really knows his s**t. Weirdly, he's been collecting the stuff since he was 14 years old. He'll tell you where he collected the poop, explain the size of each of the poops (and describe the original pooper), how the poop got its shape, why it has that poop-ish color, and with a little prompting, let you touch some of the poop.
5066f5ac0a4debba8cc2b5c5823d185d10c956b4.translatedText: 與一般人不同，博物館的館長真的很懂事。奇怪的是，他從 14 歲就開始收集這些東西了。他會告訴你他在哪裡收集了便便，解釋了每個便便的大小（並描述了原來的便便者），便便的形狀是如何形成的，為什麼它有那種便便的顏色，然後在一點提示下，讓你觸摸一些便便。

950b9aad2a27c7f795f230ff441cab142a5807c6.sourceText: Like any good museum, there's a gift shop with T-shirts, coffee mugs, and other poop-related paraphernalia.
950b9aad2a27c7f795f230ff441cab142a5807c6.translatedText: 像任何好的博物館一樣，這裡有一家禮品店，出售 T 卹、咖啡杯和其他與便便相關的用具。

2a49f61079fa437d819a3e5b9a6f22f6d3d9c9b4.sourceText: The cinder cone volcano with a less than complimentary name.
2a49f61079fa437d819a3e5b9a6f22f6d3d9c9b4.translatedText: 火山渣錐火山的名字可不是那麼好聽的。

eaa3c349e728b23e991ab97389d2b373488fd222.sourceText: This remote desert watering hole has a connection to a curious chapter of American history.
eaa3c349e728b23e991ab97389d2b373488fd222.translatedText: 這個偏遠的沙漠水坑與美國歷史上一個有趣的章節有關。

f5bd5cad9cf9c2c7cd20196f5134b7e4deb5f800.sourceText: Giant quails play and greet visitors at a suburban park.
f5bd5cad9cf9c2c7cd20196f5134b7e4deb5f800.translatedText: 巨型鵪鶉在郊區公園玩耍並迎接遊客。

c060071b8a1e3753e6d5155236a828c5f90e7199.sourceText: The handsome statue is a tribute to the post riders who traversed 52 miles of tough Arizona terrain.
c060071b8a1e3753e6d5155236a828c5f90e7199.translatedText: 這座帥氣的雕像是為了向那些穿越 52 英里亞利桑那州崎嶇地形的郵政騎手致敬。

d71199b1d49dbecc1a8778e3d1f113c033a3f8c8.sourceText: This small memorial is dedicated to the Perryville State Prison firefighters who perished fighting the Dude Fire in 1990.
d71199b1d49dbecc1a8778e3d1f113c033a3f8c8.translatedText: 這座小型紀念碑是獻給佩里維爾州立監獄 (Perryville State Prison) 的消防隊員，他們在 1990 年杜德火災 (Dude Fire) 的戰鬥中喪生。

8a5c530dfb2256f54cdf46e1e9bbc9f878ba83bc.sourceText: A partial tunnel blasted into a steep ridge is all that remains of a failed railway across Arizona.
8a5c530dfb2256f54cdf46e1e9bbc9f878ba83bc.translatedText: 一條部分隧道被炸入陡峭的山脊，是穿越亞利桑那州的一條失敗鐵路的全部遺跡。

05f03fed63f0c6a8630b27cfdb5e086d087a4a55.sourceText: Though the Pony Express Trail is the most famous horseback mail route in the United States , there were a number of other local routes, too. One of note is the Camp Verde to Payson Mail Route, which operated between 1884 and 1914, in what was then, except the last two years, the Arizona Territory.
05f03fed63f0c6a8630b27cfdb5e086d087a4a55.translatedText: 雖然小馬快遞步道是美國最著名的騎馬郵件路線，但還有許多其他當地路線。其中值得注意的是佛得角營至佩森郵件路線，該路線於 1884 年至 1914 年間運營，除最後兩年外，當時的地區屬於亞利桑那領地。

01df14934c1e78312bffe7c63b35c0bcd20e1e58.sourceText: On this trail, the riders traversed 52 miles of rugged terrain, sacks of mail in tow. They thundered across the desert, facing rough weather, the hostile environment, and at times, forged across the Verde River.
01df14934c1e78312bffe7c63b35c0bcd20e1e58.translatedText: 在這條路線上，騎手們拖著一袋袋郵件穿越了 52 英里的崎嶇地形。他們雷鳴般地穿越沙漠，面對惡劣的天氣和惡劣的環境，有時甚至跨越佛得河。

b54e6ebab10576661a9c142d01860690508cd16f.sourceText: In 2004, the city of Payson, Arizona, erected a memorial to this mail route in downtown’s Deming Pioneer Park. The memorial honors the more than 61 horseback-riding mail carriers who traversed the path. It includes a handsome statue of a mail carrier on horseback, an American flag, and a plaque listing the names of the men who rode this rugged route over its 30-year existence.
b54e6ebab10576661a9c142d01860690508cd16f.translatedText: 2004 年，亞利桑那州佩森市在市中心的戴明先鋒公園為這條郵件路線豎立了一座紀念碑。該紀念碑旨在紀念超過 61 名走過這條路的騎馬郵遞員。它包括一尊漂亮的騎馬郵遞員雕像、一面美國國旗，以及一塊牌匾，上面列出了 30 年來沿著這條崎嶇路線騎行的人們的名字。

8348afe538a63ebff80920b89b922c7c1975936a.sourceText: Though the iconic Pony Express is a thing of the past, it’s still possible to send mail via horse in Arizona. Each winter for the past 61 years, riders from across the region have celebrated the state’s historic horseback mail trails with the annual Hashknife Pony Express Ride. With the cooperation of the United States Postal Service, the riders deliver approximately 20,000 pieces of mail by horseback. They pass through Payson while heading toward Scottsdale, their final destination.
8348afe538a63ebff80920b89b922c7c1975936a.translatedText: 儘管標誌性的小馬快遞已成為過去，但在亞利桑那州仍然可以透過騎馬寄郵件。過去 61 年裡的每個冬天，來自該地區的騎手都會通過一年一度的哈什克尼夫小馬快車 (Hashknife Pony Express Ride) 慶祝該州歷史悠久的馬背郵道。在美國郵政局的合作下，騎手們騎馬投遞了大約 20,000 件郵件。他們經過佩森，前往最終目的地斯科茨代爾。

f82b552336b636f3e23c0203f0dceff9af6f8ffa.sourceText: In 1881, businessman James Eddy was struck by inspiration. Northern Arizona was connected to the rest of the country by transcontinental railways and was dense with ponderosa pine forests and a burgeoning timber industry. Southern Arizona, meanwhile, was even more populated, and the isolated mining boomtowns in the deserts were home to some of the richest silver and copper veins in the world. If he could connect the south to the railroad network in the north, he would stand to make a fortune.
f82b552336b636f3e23c0203f0dceff9af6f8ffa.translatedText: 1881 年，商人詹姆斯·艾迪 (James Eddy) 受到了靈感啟發。亞利桑那州北部透過橫貫大陸的鐵路與美國其他地區相連，擁有茂密的黃松林和蓬勃發展的木材工業。同時，亞利桑那州南部的人口更加密集，沙漠中偏僻的採礦新興城鎮是世界上一些最豐富的銀礦和銅礦的所在地。如果他能把南方和北方的鐵路網連接起來，他就能發大財了。

7823d0df7026dff5f7614fb44333ed4a347a5c83.sourceText: The benefit of connecting the two halves of the state would be twofold: sending much-needed lumber and supplies to the communities in the south, and freighting mined minerals back north where they could more easily be shipped to the industrial centers on the coasts. Only one thing stood in the way of Eddy's plan: the Mogollon Rim.
7823d0df7026dff5f7614fb44333ed4a347a5c83.translatedText: 連接該州兩半的好處將是雙重的：向南方的社區運送急需的木材和物資，並將開採的礦物運回北方，在那裡它們可以更容易地運往沿海的工業中心。只有一件事阻礙了艾迪的計畫：莫戈隆邊緣。

911a459d1a49ad40d1f775ac88e5ae88b69c2791.sourceText: The southern boundary of the Colorado Plateau, an elevated region that crosses into four states, is the Mogollon Rim, a massive ridge of steep slopes that cross much of Arizona. When Eddy formed the Arizona Mineral Belt Railroad company, his engineers calculated that to run a railway across the Mogollon Rim at a gentle enough grade for trains he would need to create a tunnel 3,100 feet long and 16 feet wide.
911a459d1a49ad40d1f775ac88e5ae88b69c2791.translatedText: 科羅拉多高原是一個橫跨四個州的高地地區，其南部邊界是莫戈隆邊緣，這是一條橫跨亞利桑那州大部分地區的巨大陡坡山脊。當艾迪成立亞利桑那礦產帶鐵路公司時，他的工程師計算出，要以足夠平緩的坡度穿越莫戈隆環緣，以便火車通過，他需要建造一條長 3,100 英尺、寬 16 英尺的隧道。

dfdaaddd01dc34b63931fbf16a68314099ba187a.sourceText: In 1883, work on the tunnel began. Over 40 men spent all summer blasting a passage through the rock. Only 70 feet of the tunnel had been completed, however, when the company ran out of funds and the work came to a halt. Eddy spent the next several years finding investors and hyping the railroad project, managing to get another 35 miles of track laid when the money ran dry and the work stopped again, this time for good.
dfdaaddd01dc34b63931fbf16a68314099ba187a.translatedText: 1883 年，隧道工程開始。超過 40 個人花了整個夏天的時間在岩石中炸開一條通道。然而，隧道只完成了 70 英尺，公司資金耗盡，工程被迫停止。艾迪在接下來的幾年裡尋找投資者並大力宣傳鐵路項目，當資金耗盡時，工程再次停止，設法鋪設了另外 35 英里的鐵軌，這次是永久的。

e8a2bd32257423e5c8eeedb1adcfb797d83f57d6.sourceText: Over the subsequent years, the 35 miles of track south of Flagstaff were torn up by locals who reused the scrap. Today, the only remaining evidence of Eddy's ambitious but failed project is the partially completed tunnel deep in the Tonto National Forest. Other than some graffiti near the entrance, it still looks more or less exactly as it did when the Arizona Mineral Belt crews left it in 1883. The crumbling structure to the right of the tunnel entrance is the remains of the powder house where the workers stored their explosives while blasting through the ridge.
e8a2bd32257423e5c8eeedb1adcfb797d83f57d6.translatedText: 在接下來的幾年裡，弗拉格斯塔夫以南的 35 英里鐵軌被當地人撕毀，他們重新利用了廢品。如今，艾迪雄心勃勃但失敗的計畫唯一剩下的證據是通托國家森林深處部分完工的隧道。除了入口附近的一些塗鴉外，它看起來或多或少與 1883 年亞利桑那礦帶工作人員離開時的情況一模一樣。隧道入口右側的搖搖欲墜的建築是火藥房的遺跡，工人們在炸穿山脊時在那裡存放炸藥。

d6d820893a8e5c6b6e54a60af21546c2b94e6218.sourceText: The summer of 1990 was extremely hot in Arizona . Temperatures in Phoenix hit a record-breaking 122 degrees Fahrenheit, and even at the higher elevations of northern Arizona, triple-digit temperatures were recorded in some areas. Years of failed wildfire management policies resulted in overgrown and unhealthy forests full of dense underbrush. The forests of northern Arizona were a tinderbox, and on June 25, a bolt of lightning provided the spark that ignited sections of three national forests.
d6d820893a8e5c6b6e54a60af21546c2b94e6218.translatedText: 1990年的夏天，亞利桑那州異常炎熱。鳳凰城的氣溫達到創紀錄的 122 華氏度，甚至在亞利桑那州北部海拔較高的地區，部分地區的氣溫也達到了三位數。多年失敗的野火管理政策導致森林雜草叢生、不健康，充滿茂密的灌木叢。亞利桑那州北部的森林就像一個易燃物，6 月 25 日，一道閃電點燃了三個國家森林的部分區域。

2f95c0a1a902ee751a40ac1ef9a7bc2a92466ef6.sourceText: The response by the United States Forest Service was immediate. Within minutes, aircraft were circling above scouting the perimeters of the fire. Within the hour, tanker planes dumped tons of fire retardant onto the flames. Despite their efforts, weather conditions made controlling the wildfire impossible. It was simply too hot, dry, and windy to control the blaze.
2f95c0a1a902ee751a40ac1ef9a7bc2a92466ef6.translatedText: 美國林務局立即做出了反應。幾分鐘之內，飛機就在火場上空盤旋，偵察火勢週邊。一個小時內，加油機向火焰傾倒了大量阻燃劑。儘管他們做出了努力，但天氣條件使野火無法控制。天氣太熱、太乾燥、風太大，無法控制火勢。

13e3e713ddb96915781a10579d273d2409e91908.sourceText: The next day, over a dozen wildland firefighting crews, including a crew composed of inmates from Perryville State Prison, were called in to fight the wildfire. The Perryville crew was sent to work in Walk Moore Canyon. The community of Bonita Creek sat just above the small canyon and was surrounded by the Tonto National Forest on all sides. The orders to the Perryville crew were to do everything possible to help protect Bonita Creek. Winds picked up in the afternoon and walls of flames 30 feet high began racing through the canyon at an estimated 60 miles per hour. This cut the firefighters off from their designated safety zones. Soon their position was overrun by flames, and they were forced to deploy their emergency fire shelters. Eleven members of the Perryville Crew were entrapped by the fire. The fire killed six of the firefighters; one prison guard and five inmates.
13e3e713ddb96915781a10579d273d2409e91908.translatedText: 第二天，十幾名荒地消防人員被召集來撲滅山火，其中包括由佩里維爾州立監獄的囚犯組成的人員。佩里維爾的工作人員被派往沃克摩爾峽谷工作。博尼塔溪 (Bonita Creek) 社區坐落在小峽谷上方，周圍環繞著通托國家森林 (Tonto National Forest)。對佩里維爾船員的命令是盡一切可能幫助保護博尼塔溪。下午風力增強，30 英尺高的火牆開始以每小時 60 英里的速度穿過峽谷。這切斷了消防員與指定安全區的聯繫。很快，他們的陣地就被火焰淹沒，他們被迫部署緊急消防避難所。佩里維爾船員的 11 名成員被大火困住。火災導致六名消防員死亡；一名獄警和五名囚犯。

f57959a4b9b8189b60ed75c674724f60d38bb701.sourceText: The fire was deemed under control by that July. It burned over 24,000 acres and cost $7.5 million to fight. The governor of Arizona posthumously pardoned the deceased inmate firefighters. At the time, it was the deadliest wildland firefighting disaster in Arizona history. Paul Gleason, superintendent for one of the crews at the Dude Fire, recognized that the way wildland firefighting was conducted was flawed, with not enough emphasis on safety and training. He developed a new model for wildland firefighting that standardized the use of lookouts, communication, escape routes, and safety zones that has since been adopted nationally.
f57959a4b9b8189b60ed75c674724f60d38bb701.translatedText: 那年 7 月，火勢被視為已被控制。這場大火燒毀了超過 24,000 英畝的土地，花費了 750 萬美元進行撲救。亞利桑那州州長死後赦免了已故的囚犯消防員。當時，這是亞利桑那州史上最致命的荒地消防災難。杜德火災 (Dude Fire) 一名工作人員的負責人保羅·格里森 (Paul Gleason) 認識到，荒地消防的實施方式存在缺陷，對安全和培訓的重視不夠。他開發了一種新的荒地消防模式，標準化瞭望台、通訊、逃生路線和安全區的使用，此後已在全國範圍內採用。

e4507f18c48798b17e039c373e1da3c604a82a1a.sourceText: Today, a trail is maintained through Walk Moore Canyon that passes by six memorials marking the spots where each of the firefighters fell. The residents of Bonita Creek wanted to do something more to show their gratitude to the Perryville fire crew and erected a small memorial, with planted trees and the listed names of the deceased.
e4507f18c48798b17e039c373e1da3c604a82a1a.translatedText: 今天，一條穿過摩爾峽谷的小路被維護，經過六個紀念碑，標誌著每位消防員犧牲的地點。博尼塔溪的居民想做更多的事情來表達對佩里維爾消防人員的感激之情，他們豎起了一座小型紀念碑，種植了樹木並列出了死者的名字。

5d314c7faef31ea1267bf2dcbd83033e89f370a1.sourceText: This small, unassuming street is now a canvas for color and creativity.
5d314c7faef31ea1267bf2dcbd83033e89f370a1.translatedText: 這條不起眼的小街道現在成為色彩和創造力的畫布。

b2941ed570e28c0cf96266874445d877130dedd5.sourceText: Before Bisbee, Arizona became a center for the arts it was a mining town, and its history still permeates and scars the landscape. The most visible legacy of Bisbee’s copper mining history is the Lavender Pit, visible from an overlook on the route between Bisbee and Historic Lowell.
b2941ed570e28c0cf96266874445d877130dedd5.translatedText: 在比斯比成為藝術中心之前，亞利桑那州是一個礦業小鎮，其歷史至今仍滲透在這片土地上，並在這裡留下傷痕。比斯比銅礦開採歷史上最明顯的遺產是薰衣草礦坑，從比斯比和歷史悠久的洛厄爾之間的路線上俯瞰即可看到。

821f733409ca756ad839b3f27847ecbabedf785f.sourceText: The name of the pit may conjure up a beautiful sunset and shades of sandstone, but the pit is actually named for mining bigwig Harrison M. Lavender. Lavender was an engineer who rose through the ranks of the Calumet & Arizona Mining Co., which was acquired by the Phelps Dodge Corp., the company that owned Bisbee’s Copper Queen mines. Lavender believed that open-pit mining was the answer to getting more copper ore from Bisbee’s low-grade rock, replacing the existing Sacramento Hill mine. The pit mine opened in 1950. Sadly, Lavender was already dying at this point. He passed away in 1952, and the pit mine was named in his honor.
821f733409ca756ad839b3f27847ecbabedf785f.translatedText: 礦坑的名字可能會讓人想起美麗的日落和砂岩的色調，但該礦坑實際上是以採礦大亨哈里森·M·拉文德（Harrison M. Lavender）命名的。拉文德是一名工程師，在卡魯梅特和亞利桑那礦業公司 (Calumet & Arizona Mining Co.) 中晉升，該公司被菲爾普斯道奇公司 (Phelps Dodge Corp.) 收購，該公司擁有比斯比的銅皇后礦 (Copper Queen)。拉文德認為，露天開採是從比斯比的低品位岩石中獲取更多銅礦石的答案，取代了現有的薩克拉門託山礦。露天礦場於 1950 年開放。遺憾的是，此時 Lavender 已經瀕臨死亡。他於 1952 年去世，礦坑以他的名字命名。

71d6989f0bd2217554f3b272de2cf21dc5183589.sourceText: The pit remained in operation through 1974. It produced more than 600,000 tons of copper, and its expansion led to the demolition of Lowell’s residential district, turning its commercial area into an eerie ghost town . Most notably, it was the home of “Bisbee blue,” a form of uniquely high-quality turquoise. In 1972, Bob Matthews was given a lease to mine turquoise and mined nearly 2,000 pounds by 1974. By then, world copper prices had crashed, and Bisbee’s low-quality copper was an early casualty. Phelps Dodge left, the mines were scuttled and closed, and Bisbee was left for dead before reinventing itself years later.
71d6989f0bd2217554f3b272de2cf21dc5183589.translatedText: 該礦坑一直運作到 1974 年。生產了超過 60 萬噸銅，其擴張導致洛厄爾的住宅區被拆除，商業區變成了一個令人毛骨悚然的鬼城。最值得注意的是，它是「比斯比藍」的故鄉，這是一種獨特的高品質綠松石。 1972 年，鮑勃馬修斯 (Bob Matthews) 獲得了開採綠松石的租約，到 1974 年開採了近 2,000 磅。那時，世界銅價已經暴跌，比斯比的低品質銅成為早期受害者。菲爾普斯·道奇離開了，礦井被鑿毀並關閉，比斯比被留下等死，幾年後又重新煥發了活力。

6f13416cf285c1e19fd1d1362943e815828401dd.sourceText: Today, the Lavender Pit is a popular tourist attraction for those headed to the border. Its turquoise remains rare, and is found in high-end galleries and mimicked in stores throughout town. Visitors to the overlook will be able to observe the pit and read interpretive signage explaining the history of the pit, and the meaning of the red, gray, yellow, and yes, lavender layers of rock that are now forever exposed to nature.
6f13416cf285c1e19fd1d1362943e815828401dd.translatedText: 如今，薰衣草坑已成為前往邊境的熱門旅遊景點。它的綠松石仍然很稀有，在高端畫廊中隨處可見，並在整個城鎮的商店中被模仿。參觀觀景台的遊客將能夠觀察礦坑並閱讀解說標牌，解釋礦坑的歷史，以及紅色、灰色、黃色，以及現在永遠暴露在大自然中的淡紫色岩石層的含義。

dd1a869a9281ee4afa29cdc10d185b420415b716.sourceText: Four tons of weapons merge together in a memorial against violence.
dd1a869a9281ee4afa29cdc10d185b420415b716.translatedText: 四噸重的武器聚集在一座反對暴力的紀念碑上。

14520433bdf3c64eded376ecdf6d251e4458826f.sourceText: Over 100 miles from the ocean, this ship-shaped building was built in honor of the owner's sailor son.
14520433bdf3c64eded376ecdf6d251e4458826f.translatedText: 這座船形建築距離海洋超過 100 英里，是為了紀念船主的水手兒子而建造的。

578900ef3a3363d3321029f96bb05857a143ca94.sourceText: This collection of vintage signs reflects the long and colorful history of this Arizona town.
578900ef3a3363d3321029f96bb05857a143ca94.translatedText: 這組老式標誌反映了這座亞利桑那州小鎮悠久而多彩的歷史。

43131cfdfd8641cb615d1340083f44bef0250abc.sourceText: Rumor had it that these concrete crosses scattered across the Arizona scrubland helped align spy satellites. (They didn’t.)
43131cfdfd8641cb615d1340083f44bef0250abc.translatedText: 有傳言說這些遍布亞利桑那州灌木叢的混凝土十字架有助於對準間諜衛星。 （他們沒有。）

4c4f72e008536a1632bf9044734074a938fc7742.sourceText: An abandoned facility that has become a place of ritualistic satanic worship, or so rumor has it.
4c4f72e008536a1632bf9044734074a938fc7742.translatedText: 一個廢棄的設施，已成為儀式性的撒旦崇拜場所，至少有傳言如此。

9fba9ba5e9b66622ae02a4d8b8f630af9ce97c39.sourceText: You’ll never see the sky the same way after visiting this art installation in Tempe.
9fba9ba5e9b66622ae02a4d8b8f630af9ce97c39.translatedText: 參觀過坦佩的這個藝術裝置後，您將永遠不會以同樣的方式看到天空。

514f72e22dc55983c101b924901592cb004e0d01.sourceText: A camera with an ongoing exposure time of 1,000 years.
514f72e22dc55983c101b924901592cb004e0d01.translatedText: 持續曝光時間長達 1,000 年的相機。

f0790f655b52c48a5ea92235b44a25484a02bcad.sourceText: Over 100 lasers, including huge ones that look straight off a sci-fi set.
f0790f655b52c48a5ea92235b44a25484a02bcad.translatedText: 超過 100 個激光，包括直視地面的巨大雷射科幻場景。

68b276cbef60dc7e0de329de05e3ac082007c74b.sourceText: A colorful, century-old cemetery of the Yaqui Indian Tribe hidden amid the suburban sprawl of Tempe, Arizona.
68b276cbef60dc7e0de329de05e3ac082007c74b.translatedText: 亞基印第安部落的一座色彩繽紛、擁有百年歷史的墓地，隱藏在亞利桑那州坦佩的郊區。

596eaae0d00ca40461c2b555fe3567a53408bf73.sourceText: This historic pink parlor keeps Phoenicians cool with homemade, retro ice creams.
596eaae0d00ca40461c2b555fe3567a53408bf73.translatedText: 這家歷史悠久的粉紅色客廳用自製的復古冰淇淋讓腓尼基人保持涼爽。

e610efb63d886360ac107255efd4c568d32967f0.sourceText: This collection of neon icons is preserving Arizona's history, one sign at a time.
e610efb63d886360ac107255efd4c568d32967f0.translatedText: 這個霓虹燈圖示收藏正在保存亞利桑那州的歷史，一次一個標誌。

295f016c620d5831d0027613a453c67131dbb3c6.sourceText: Great books, great prices, and a truly stripped-down atmosphere.
295f016c620d5831d0027613a453c67131dbb3c6.translatedText: 好書，優惠價格，真正簡約的氛圍。

e00328f15d3ecb0d1f39dfec2a171a4fb65d2e2b.sourceText: The stone-covered graves lie within the ruins of an Old West ghost town.
e00328f15d3ecb0d1f39dfec2a171a4fb65d2e2b.translatedText: 石頭覆蓋的墳墓位於舊西部鬼城的廢墟中。

2eb2a9bd682f31c193b2448d54a9e7f1e8b2da63.sourceText: Near the Arizona border, there's an oasis. Although completely unusual, it is not a mirage. It's Reader's Oasis Books. The warning signs outside the bookstore advise customers to expect to see nudity within. While there are some vintage gentleman's magazines inside, that's not what those signs are referring to.
2eb2a9bd682f31c193b2448d54a9e7f1e8b2da63.translatedText: 靠近亞利桑那州邊境，有一片綠洲。雖然完全不尋常，但這並不是海市蜃樓。這是讀者的綠洲書籍。書店外的警告標誌提醒顧客注意在店內看到裸體。雖然裡面有一些復古紳士雜誌，但這不是那些標誌所指的內容。

d56d357f13a48126393703617a2410ef0c8748d7.sourceText: Proprietor Paul "Sweet Pie" Winer has been running his desert bookstore for decades wearing only a custom crocheted sock (not on either foot) and little else to cover his extremely tanned hide.
d56d357f13a48126393703617a2410ef0c8748d7.translatedText: 店主保羅·「甜派」·維納（Paul“Sweet Pie”Winer）經營他的沙漠書店已有數十年之久，他只穿著定制的鉤編襪子（雙腳都沒有），幾乎沒有其他東西來遮蓋他曬得黝黑的皮膚。

878b029616f394a01f4dd53d58c8c2846f818c02.sourceText: There's no air-conditioning, so you might want to join Paul in removing some articles of clothing while you browse the thousands of titles filling the sprawling stacks and shelves of the shop. On a hot day, you'll realize Sweet Pie is the most sensibly dressed.
878b029616f394a01f4dd53d58c8c2846f818c02.translatedText: 沒有空調，所以你可能想和保羅一起去除一些當您瀏覽商店裡龐大的書架和貨架上的數千種服裝時，您會看到各種服裝。大熱天的時候，你會發現甜派是穿得最得體的。

838b9cabbb64155454d449010e0974dd2200ecfd.sourceText: Sweet Pie is not only a book-loving nudist, he's also an accomplished musician. He will regularly close the register to sit at his piano and play a few songs for customers. You can find his music for sale in the shop. He has some great stories and enjoys taking pictures with customers to promote the store.
838b9cabbb64155454d449010e0974dd2200ecfd.translatedText: 甜派不僅是一位熱愛閱讀的裸體主義者，他還是一位多才多藝的音樂家。他會定期關閉收銀機，坐在鋼琴前為顧客彈奏幾首歌曲。您可以在商店中找到出售他的音樂。他有一些很棒的故事，喜歡與顧客合影來宣傳商店。

138a72523ffac72350c738dd6ea9950278c76921.sourceText: Update as of November 2019: The owner of the shop, Sweet Pie, passed away in May of 2019. The future of the store is uncertain.
138a72523ffac72350c738dd6ea9950278c76921.translatedText: 截至 2019 年 11 月更新：商店老闆 Sweet Pie 於 2019 年 5 月去世。商店的未來不確定。

67cf62b2e9b3ea568b0d50e04957636f0e298084.sourceText: During the mid-1800's when much of the southwest of America was still uninhabited desert, the government decided they would deal with the terrain like the desert dwellers of the Middle East and hire camel drivers, such as Hi Jolly, to carry their goods across the arid terrain.
67cf62b2e9b3ea568b0d50e04957636f0e298084.translatedText: 1800 年代中期，當美國西南部的大部分地區仍是無人居住的沙漠時，政府決定像中東的沙漠居民一樣對待這些地形，並僱用駱駝司機（例如 Hi Jolly）在乾旱地區運送貨物。

8e53627c6d30bd5046317f141c7903dd84b4a4a5.sourceText: Born in Syria as Philip Tedro to a set of Greek parents, Jolly would not get his Americanized name for many years. As an adult Jolly converted to Islam and made the pilgrimage to Mecca, taking the name Hadji Ali. It was after this conversion that the U.S. Calvary forces contracted Jolly to become one of their first riders in the experimental Army Camel Corps. When Jolly came to the states, his name was butchered and confused into "Hi Jolly," the name by which he would forever be remembered.
8e53627c6d30bd5046317f141c7903dd84b4a4a5.translatedText: Jolly 出生於敘利亞，父母都是希臘人，他的名字是 Philip Tedro，多年來一直沒有得到美國化的名字。成年後，喬利皈依了伊斯蘭教，並以哈吉·阿里為名前往麥加朝聖。正是在這次轉變之後，美國加略山部隊與喬利簽約，成為實驗性陸軍駱駝軍團的第一批騎手之一。當喬利來到美國時，他的名字被屠殺並被混淆為“嗨喬利”，這個名字將永遠被人們銘記。

c892f7a31ddd47fd4121d5ff7543a5a44973ae4b.sourceText: While serving with the camel corps, Jolly stood out from the rest of the riders for both his ambition and his cantankerous attitude. So feisty was Jolly that he is said to have driven a camel-drawn carriage right through a picnic he was not invited to.
c892f7a31ddd47fd4121d5ff7543a5a44973ae4b.translatedText: 在駱駝隊服役時，喬利因其野心和脾氣暴躁的態度而在其他騎手中脫穎而出。喬利非常活躍，據說他在一次沒有被邀請參加的野餐中駕駛駱駝車。

81bdc615feb1f2dcaa2e34a4cc9f36f84c0fedf5.sourceText: Eventually the camel corps was disbanded after it was found that the much larger camels spooked the native livestock and horses. Jolly however went on to pursue a number of careers in the states before passing away in Arizona in 1902. Today his grave is marked by a stony pyramid that is topped by an etched metal camel.
81bdc615feb1f2dcaa2e34a4cc9f36f84c0fedf5.translatedText: 最終，在發現體型大得多的駱駝嚇壞了當地的牲畜和馬匹後，駱駝隊被解散了。然而，喬利繼續在美國從事多種職業，直到 1902 年在亞利桑那州去世。如今，他的墳墓上有一座石金字塔，金字塔頂部有一頭蝕刻的金屬駱駝。

3eee6783438f380e21766b272721075307b4dbfe.sourceText: The town of Ehrenberg, Arizona , was once a bustling steamboat stop along the Colorado River. At its prime, more than 500 people called the small settlement home.
3eee6783438f380e21766b272721075307b4dbfe.translatedText: 亞利桑那州埃倫伯格鎮曾經是科羅拉多河沿岸繁忙的汽船停靠站。在鼎盛時期，這個小型定居點居住著 500 多人。

1691c1b5c0bb6345f845ded9f7395f81a30dded7.sourceText: Ehrenberg was created in 1869 and named after Hermann Ehrenberg, a German emigrant. Hermann spent three years working with the Mojave people along the Colorado River from 1863 until his untimely murder in 1866.
1691c1b5c0bb6345f845ded9f7395f81a30dded7.translatedText: 埃倫伯格 (Ehrenberg) 於 1869 年創建，以德國移民赫爾曼·埃倫伯格 (Hermann Ehrenberg) 的名字命名。從 1863 年開始，赫爾曼在科羅拉多河沿岸與莫哈韋人一起工作了三年，直到 1866 年他不幸被謀殺。

ed7fb04d7a5c45f3e3fab7793c6a0b67726d78ab.sourceText: The town thrived as a steamboat stop along the river through the mid-1870s. But things began looking grim when the steamboats were replaced by the modern railroad. Ehrenberg soon became a ghost town.
ed7fb04d7a5c45f3e3fab7793c6a0b67726d78ab.translatedText: 該鎮在 1870 年代中期作為沿河的汽船停靠站而繁榮發展。但當汽船被現代鐵路取代時，情況開始變得嚴重。埃倫伯格很快就變成了一座鬼城。

bb34f23adcb22ae4087a16414428a6147b7cb009.sourceText: All that remains of the original town of Ehrenberg are the stone-covered graves and hand-carved wooden markers scattered across the Pioneer Cemetery. They pay a ghostly homage to the Old West. The cemetery was given a permanent monument by the Arizona Highway Department in 1935.
bb34f23adcb22ae4087a16414428a6147b7cb009.translatedText: 埃倫伯格原鎮的所有遺跡都是石頭覆蓋的墳墓和散佈在先鋒公墓中的手工雕刻的木製標記。他們向古老的西部表達了幽靈般的敬意。 1935 年，亞利桑那州公路部門將這座墓園列為永久紀念碑。

b952c6a29418d36b0a8aae7d45ab3f4f2a206bc7.sourceText: This massive, ancient canal system was built using only sticks and stones.
b952c6a29418d36b0a8aae7d45ab3f4f2a206bc7.translatedText: 這個龐大而古老的運河系統僅使用棍棒和石頭建造。

721bb08eabcbdd503f6bfef5c03a5faebae2d6e3.sourceText: Arizona Central Credit Union is listed near Chandler Ranch in Chandler. This profile was generated from plaza directory sources and map-based verification, so direct business contact details may still be incomplete.
721bb08eabcbdd503f6bfef5c03a5faebae2d6e3.translatedText: 亞利桑那中央信用合作社在錢德勒的錢德勒牧場附近上市。此設定檔是根據廣場目錄來源和基於地圖的驗證產生的，因此直接業務聯絡詳細資訊可能仍然不完整。

f013fca567a72f2d8a772207a2a7e7348a28be9e.sourceText: Finance and practical listing inside Chandler Ranch in Chandler.
f013fca567a72f2d8a772207a2a7e7348a28be9e.translatedText: 錢德勒錢德勒牧場內的財務和實用清單。

71656b572d7d3ff80f80be66f7d90ceb57dc5834.sourceText: BMO is listed within Chandler Ranch in Chandler. This profile was generated from plaza directory sources and map-based verification, so direct business contact details may still be incomplete.
71656b572d7d3ff80f80be66f7d90ceb57dc5834.translatedText: BMO 在錢德勒的錢德勒牧場上市。此設定檔是根據廣場目錄來源和基於地圖的驗證產生的，因此直接業務聯絡詳細資訊可能仍然不完整。

6573ee917fbfde5ef63b7e2fd01b7a2f8b626167.sourceText: The world’s first museum dedicated solely to electric vehicles.
6573ee917fbfde5ef63b7e2fd01b7a2f8b626167.translatedText: 世界上第一個專門展示電動車的博物館。

736f8fae24cec2a283aad35a52fdd35d9132c18d.sourceText: A tribute to the statues of Easter Island along Route 66.
736f8fae24cec2a283aad35a52fdd35d9132c18d.translatedText: 向 66 號公路沿線的復活節島雕像致敬。

f525c2fd60da7c7b764cb2f987cc4d72658476e0.translatedText: 世界上最大的卡奇納娃娃

18ffba3b1ff9ce5d5238922d2a7f4a21f774b434.sourceText: This 39-foot-tall version of a Hopi figure stands in Arizona.
18ffba3b1ff9ce5d5238922d2a7f4a21f774b434.translatedText: 這個 39 英尺高的霍皮人雕像矗立在亞利桑那州。

fc1b3a6e9d0ea7700d8f6fac3528628c6af0c0c8.sourceText: Run by members of the Tohono O'odham Nation, this community farm nurtures traditional desert cultivars.
fc1b3a6e9d0ea7700d8f6fac3528628c6af0c0c8.translatedText: 這個社區農場由 Tohono O'odham 民族成員經營，培育傳統的沙漠品種。

0ec993848b0075e333307057f15a141ac1c41495.sourceText: This memorial includes fragments from one of the greatest tragedies in United States history.
0ec993848b0075e333307057f15a141ac1c41495.translatedText: 這座紀念碑包括美國歷史上最大悲劇之一的片段。

753383ab511cf34b1e114d8c47b3c3f05f52cb62.sourceText: A stark, white-tiled pyramid stands out against the red desert of Papago Park. It's not an Egyptian homage, but rather the grave of Arizona 's first governor, George W. P. Hunt, who served between 1912 and 1933.
753383ab511cf34b1e114d8c47b3c3f05f52cb62.translatedText: 一座樸素的、鋪著白色瓷磚的金字塔在巴巴哥公園的紅色沙漠中顯得格外引人注目。這不是埃及人的致敬，而是亞利桑那州第一任州長喬治 W. P. 亨特 (George W. P. Hunt) 的墳墓，他於 1912 年至 1933 年間任職。

55fec2d7ccd216caaeabf020e4932f40f6625a96.sourceText: Known for his mustache, bald head, and impressive girth (he weighed nearly 300 pounds at the height of 5'9"), he was referred to as "Old Walrus." He's almost ubiquitously seen as a good man, even by modern standards. He was a proponent of women's suffrage, as well as the abolition of child labor. He did all the grocery shopping for his household in an era when this was an uncommon chore for men, and knitted scarves for soldiers abroad during World War I.
55fec2d7ccd216caaeabf020e4932f40f6625a96.translatedText: 以其小鬍子、禿頭和令人印象深刻的腰圍（他身高 5 英尺 9 英寸，體重近 300 磅）而聞名，他被稱為“老海象”。即使以現代標準來看，他也是個好人。在那個時代，這對男人來說是一件不常見的家務，他負責為家裡買所有的雜貨，並在第一次世界大戰期間為國外的士兵編織圍巾。

40598db1c61253b22e008ad4dfbb1f0a534ea809.sourceText: Like most powerful men of the period, Hunt was a Freemason. So it follows that he designed his own burial marker after the Masons' favorite symbol, the pyramid. Hunt was interred in it in 1934, one year after he left office. His wife's remains, as well as her parents' and her sister's, are buried here too.
40598db1c61253b22e008ad4dfbb1f0a534ea809.translatedText: 像那個時期最有權勢的人一樣，亨特是共濟會會員。亨特最喜歡的象徵，金字塔於 1934 年被埋葬於此，他的妻子以及她父母和姐姐的遺骸也埋葬在這裡。

e6d8aa6419a191ff4fd033fb706ec05a707b80f1.sourceText: The pyramid sits atop a steep hill overlooking Papago Park. The hill provides a scenic view of the desert and the Phoenix Zoo, as well as a couple benches upon which visitors can sit and offer their respects to one of Arizona's founding fathers.
e6d8aa6419a191ff4fd033fb706ec05a707b80f1.translatedText: 金字塔坐落在一座陡峭的山頂上，俯瞰著帕帕戈公園。從山上可以欣賞到沙漠和鳳凰城動物園的美景，還有幾張長椅，遊客可以坐在上面向亞利桑那州的一位創始人表示敬意。父親們。

458cd356ab092037b6639273474a504de31184c1.sourceText: The Hall of Flame in Phoenix, Arizona, is a museum dedicated to the men and women who fight fires and the equipment they use to do so. It charts the history of modern fire fighting from some of the earliest examples of fire fighting technology, dating back to 1725, to more modern water and ladder trucks.
458cd356ab092037b6639273474a504de31184c1.translatedText: 亞利桑那州鳳凰城的火焰廳是一座博物館，專門展示那些撲滅火災的男女以及他們使用的設備。它描繪了現代消防的歷史，從最早的消防技術實例（可追溯到 1725 年）到更現代的水車和雲梯車。

042148e37cd11af1361bb27bc2eea234838dab59.sourceText: The main concentration of the Hall of Flame centers around restored fire trucks. These range from horse drawn fire carriages dating from 1865 to the Type 700 rigid frame trucks that served in the United States in the mid to late 1950s. There is also a large collection of international fire equipment from countries all over the world including England, Austria, and Japan.
042148e37cd11af1361bb27bc2eea234838dab59.translatedText: 火焰廳的主要集中區域是修復後的消防車。這些車輛包括 1865 年生產的馬拉消防車和 20 世紀 50 年代中後期在美國服役的 700 型剛性框架卡車。這裡也收藏有大量來自英國、奧地利和日本等世界各國的國際消防設備。

7f857aee1df9c3055c20648d40afeeea5a2f534f.sourceText: The museum also boasts an impressive collection of antique fire helmets. These helmets have been collected from a broad spectrum of countries and time periods. One of the more notable pieces is a German fire helmet that bares a striking resemblance to those goofy helmets with spikes on top that one always sees in old photos of the First World War.
7f857aee1df9c3055c20648d40afeeea5a2f534f.translatedText: 博物館也收藏了令人印象深刻的古董消防頭盔。這些頭盔是從各國和時期收集的。其中一件更引人注目的作品是德國消防頭盔，它與人們在第一次世界大戰的老照片中經常看到的那些頂部帶有尖刺的傻乎乎的頭盔驚人地相似。

546a232e88046b549e5a2d8538fb671372862d3b.sourceText: An important aspect of the Museum is the National Firefighting Hall of Heroes which comprises the museum’s sixth gallery. The Hall of Heroes includes all the names of those firefighters who have lost their lives in the call of duty since 1800. These names are emblazoned on the wall, and also exist on a database that is available to visitors via computer terminals that are located throughout the Hall of Heroes. There is also a special memorial to those firefighters and police officers who lost their lives on September 11th.
546a232e88046b549e5a2d8538fb671372862d3b.translatedText: 博物館的一個重要部分是國家消防英雄大廳，它包括博物館的第六個畫廊。英雄大廳記錄了自 1800 年以來因公殉職的所有消防員的名字。這些名字印在牆上，也存在於資料庫中，遊客可以透過英雄大廳各處的電腦終端存取該資料庫。還有一個專門紀念 9 月 11 日犧牲的消防員和警察的紀念碑。

737245830e708bd7a164efce635374e619f03333.sourceText: As a non-profit organization the Hall of Flame relies on donations from both visitors and patrons. Through its website, one may buy a membership to the museum and help support the upkeep and restoration of the vehicles and collections. Purchases at the museum shop in person or online also help sustain operations.
737245830e708bd7a164efce635374e619f03333.translatedText: 作為一個非營利組織，火焰廳依靠遊客和顧客的捐款。透過其網站，人們可以購買博物館會員資格，並幫助支援車輛和藏品的維護和修復。親自或在線在博物館商店購買也有助於維持運作。

045fd5187c16cdc3fc74d3333b5ed26d041aa447.sourceText: The remains of a boarding school designed to forcibly assimilate Native American children.
045fd5187c16cdc3fc74d3333b5ed26d041aa447.translatedText: 一所旨在強行同化美洲原住民兒童的寄宿學校的遺跡。

f89a0fecd5980d594220f017f73c3498c100635f.sourceText: AA Ozzy Bakery is listed within Mekong Plaza in Mesa. This profile was generated from plaza directory sources and map-based verification, so direct business contact details may still be incomplete.
f89a0fecd5980d594220f017f73c3498c100635f.translatedText: AA Ozzy Bakery 位於梅薩湄公河廣場內。此設定檔是根據廣場目錄來源和基於地圖的驗證產生的，因此直接業務聯絡詳細資訊可能仍然不完整。

b1301b71dc008857b690b7a524bab40905acf189.sourceText: An off-the-beaten path cave with an underground lake.
b1301b71dc008857b690b7a524bab40905acf189.translatedText: 一個人跡罕至的洞穴，有一個地下湖。

98dbb91f5ff7aa8db8bcce9a8765d53f5b25c941.sourceText: The remains of this hell for leather wild west town can still be found in the Arizona desert.
98dbb91f5ff7aa8db8bcce9a8765d53f5b25c941.translatedText: 這個皮革地獄般的狂野西部小鎮的遺跡仍然可以在亞利桑那州的沙漠中找到。

197052b2b41e8f3b06820c9a0515944b90a0c637.sourceText: The highest point in Arizona is an oddly snow-topped peak within the otherwise arid state.
197052b2b41e8f3b06820c9a0515944b90a0c637.translatedText: 亞利桑那州的最高點是乾旱州內一座奇特的白雪山峰。

1ec47bb42229622d5915d2e053302f718c77a1d2.sourceText: An important piece of history from mankind's journey to the moon sits in the lobby of a government science lab.
1ec47bb42229622d5915d2e053302f718c77a1d2.translatedText: 人類登月之旅的重要歷史片段坐落在政府科學實驗室的大廳裡。

2bac58426cfa977deb92b154701e1c2024395025.sourceText: Near the summit of Agassiz Peak, the second-highest peak in Arizona, in the Arizona Snowbowl ski resort in the Coconino National Forest, an amenity to visitors has a curious designation. The public restroom on the slopes of the mountains has been identified as the highest toilet in Arizona .
2bac58426cfa977deb92b154701e1c2024395025.translatedText: 在亞利桑那州第二高峰阿加西峰 (Agassiz Peak) 的山頂附近，位於科科尼諾國家森林 (Coconino National Forest) 的亞利桑那州雪碗 (Arizona Snowbowl) 滑雪勝地，為遊客提供的休閒設施有一個奇怪的名稱。山坡上的公共衛生間已被確定為亞利桑那州最高的廁所。

275f2c728fe73029fc69dfd14f6eee613dab4aa8.sourceText: The toilets are near the summit of the San Francisco Peaks and within the only area of Arizona that is classified as a tundra ecosystem. Within sight is the highest point in Arizona, Humphrey's Peak, which sits at 12,637 feet. If weather and atmospheric conditions cooperate you can even see the North Rim of the Grand Canyon, over 80 miles away.
275f2c728fe73029fc69dfd14f6eee613dab4aa8.translatedText: 該廁所位於舊金山山頂附近，並且位於亞利桑那州唯一被歸類為苔原生態系的區域內。亞利桑那州的最高點漢弗萊峰 (Humphrey's Peak) 就在眼前，海拔 12,637 英尺。如果天氣和大氣條件配合，您甚至可以看到 80 多英里外的大峽谷北緣。

5996356819242ac427520f7b30baf6c168f5d343.sourceText: During the ski season, the toilet is accessible to those with a lift ticket by riding the gondola near the summits of the San Francisco Peaks. During many months of the off-season you can still purchase gondola tickets and enjoy a scenic ride and magnificent views, and if need be, visit the highest toilet in Arizona to relieve oneself.
5996356819242ac427520f7b30baf6c168f5d343.translatedText: 在滑雪季節，持有纜車票的遊客可以在舊金山山頂附近搭乘纜車前往廁所。在淡季的許多個月裡，您仍然可以購買纜車票，享受風景優美的旅程和壯麗的景色，如果需要，還可以去亞利桑那州最高的廁所解手。

e260972c83d2115a62bd217546c1039b1655d1f1.sourceText: The area is within the protected Kachina Peaks Wilderness area and there are many rare species of plant and lichen here that are not found anywhere else in Arizona. For that reason, as signs in the area remind visitors, please stay on designated trails so as to not unknowingly trample on any endangered species or further disturb this delicate ecosystem.
e260972c83d2115a62bd217546c1039b1655d1f1.translatedText: 該地區位於卡奇納峰荒野保護區內，這裡有許多亞利桑那州其他地方沒有的稀有植物和地衣物種。因此，該地區的標誌提醒遊客，請留在指定的步道上，以免在不知不覺中踐踏任何瀕臨滅絕的物種或進一步擾亂這個脆弱的生態系統。

cc04e5af10985ac65d6e62ab2a0f2846326be741.sourceText: Deep in the Kaibab National Forest, in the high elevation deserts of northern Arizona , there is a rare perennial source of freshwater. Petroglyphs on the boulders and cliff faces bordering the springs have been credited to the Cohonina people, who inhabited the area between approximately 700 and 1100. Evidence suggests that the Havasupai people were also familiar with the springs and periodically visited the area.
cc04e5af10985ac65d6e62ab2a0f2846326be741.translatedText: 在亞利桑那州北部高海拔沙漠的凱巴布國家森林深處，有一個罕見的常年淡水來源。泉水邊界的巨石和懸崖面上的岩畫被認為是科霍尼納人的作品，他們在大約 700 至 1100 年間居住在該地區。有證據表明，哈瓦蘇派人也熟悉這些泉水，並定期訪問該地區。

05b35bba32bd307baa5913c39e7820669244c592.sourceText: The spring would later find itself part of a largely unknown piece of the history of the American West. As the United States expanded during the 1800s, the spring became an important stop for pioneers and soldiers traveling westward, as a year-round source of freshwater in the deserts of Arizona became invaluable.
05b35bba32bd307baa5913c39e7820669244c592.translatedText: 該泉水後來發現自己是美國西部歷史上一段鮮為人知的部分的一部分。隨著美國在 1800 年代的擴張，泉水成為了拓荒者和士兵西進的重要一站，因為亞利桑那州沙漠中全年的淡水來源變得非常寶貴。

ff682de55bc6b514b0c3c8c0b77b2676ae2aa3a7.sourceText: In 1857, the United States government dispatched Lieutenant Edward Beale to survey and construct a road between Fort Defiance, Arizona ( New Mexico at the time) and the Colorado River to the west where it formed the boundary with California . But this wasn't the only thing they tasked Beale with—he was given an additional assignment to test the efficacy of camels compared to horses and mules in the American deserts.
ff682de55bc6b514b0c3c8c0b77b2676ae2aa3a7.translatedText: 1857 年，美國政府派遣愛德華·比爾中尉前往亞利桑那州迪法恩斯堡（當時的新墨西哥州）和以西的科羅拉多河之間勘測並修建一條道路，與加利福尼亞州分界線。但這並不是他們給比爾的唯一任務——他還被賦予了一項額外的任務，即在美國沙漠中測試駱駝與馬和騾子的功效。

627422679ce0f68678fb0c6b6c1a34ba58f0d6cd.sourceText: To this end, the U.S. government supplied Beale with 25 camels. While initially skeptical and frustrated at having to shoulder this additional burden alongside his road-building tasks, Beale was surprised at the strength and endurance of the camels and grew to trust them more than his other animals, commenting that he “would rather have one camel than four mules.” Over the subsequent years the U.S. government purchased dozens of more camels for Beale and his crews to continue to test their use.
627422679ce0f68678fb0c6b6c1a34ba58f0d6cd.translatedText: 為此，美國政府向比爾提供了25頭駱駝。雖然比爾最初對在修路任務之外還要承擔額外的負擔感到懷疑和沮喪，但比爾對駱駝的力量和耐力感到驚訝，並開始比他的其他動物更信任它們，並評論說他「寧願擁有一頭駱駝，也不願擁有四頭騾子」。在隨後的幾年裡，美國政府又買了數十頭駱駝供比爾和他的團隊繼續測試使用。

c0ccfbf7cdc58334c06843974845db443bea9f13.sourceText: Between 1857 and 1859, Beale and his crews repeatedly crossed the route of the road they were constructing, improving and expanding it each time and extending the eastern terminus to Fort Smith, Arkansas , and the western terminus to Los Angeles , California. It was in July of 1859 during one of these crossings that Beale's crew stopped to camp at a familiar spring in northern Arizona. Honoring a member of his crew, Beale decided to give a name to the watering hole and named it Laws Springs after Major W. L. Laws. Another member of the crew, Peachy Breckenridge, who was the son of then Vice President John C. Breckenridge, inscribed the new name of the springs on a rock above the water.
c0ccfbf7cdc58334c06843974845db443bea9f13.translatedText: 1857 年至 1859 年間，比爾和他的團隊多次穿越他們正在修建的道路，每次都對其進行改進和擴建，將東部終點延伸至阿肯色州史密斯堡，將西部終點延伸至加利福尼亞州洛杉磯。 1859 年 7 月，在其中一次穿越時，比爾的船員在亞利桑那州北部一處熟悉的泉水處停下來紮營。為了紀念他的一名船員，比爾決定為這個水坑命名，並以 W. L. Laws 少校的名字將其命名為勞斯泉 (Laws Springs)。另一位船員皮奇·布雷肯里奇（Peachy Breckenridge）是時任副總統約翰·C·布雷肯里奇（John C. Breckenridge）的兒子，他在水面上方的一塊岩石上刻下了泉水的新名稱。

d56ac008fd078223771a238556cca4949dcdda85.sourceText: The outbreak of the American Civil War put a stop to both the road construction and the experiment with camels. Edward Beale's wagon road saw heavy use for about 30 years, with some accounts saying that it carried as much traffic across the United States as the more famous Oregon Trail. Surveyors for railroad companies used Beale's road while mapping the route of future transcontinental railways, with some inscribing their initials on the rocks around Laws Spring as they passed. The road began to decline in use when the Atlantic & Pacific Railroad constructed tracks that ran parallel to almost the entire route in 1883.
d56ac008fd078223771a238556cca4949dcdda85.translatedText: 美國內戰的爆發使得道路建設和駱駝實驗都停止了。愛德華·比爾 (Edward Beale) 的馬車道路被大量使用了大約 30 年，一些報導稱，它在美國各地的交通量與更著名的俄勒岡小徑一樣多。鐵路公司的測量員在繪製未來橫貫大陸鐵路的路線時使用了比爾的道路，有些人在經過勞斯泉周圍的岩石上刻下了自己名字的首字母。 1883 年，當大西洋和太平洋鐵路建造幾乎與整條路線平行的軌道時，這條道路的使用率開始下降。
