405334f3cd7491a2754694a64b76e6006eab2a15.sourceText: Take a monster truck tour around an ostrich farm in the middle of the desert.
405334f3cd7491a2754694a64b76e6006eab2a15.translatedText: 搭乘巨型卡車遊覽沙漠中部的鴕鳥農場。

9fa23d239f87eed0ef80363b257858453f407e63.sourceText: On a slump block wall along 7th Street, Phoenix artist Maggie Keane has immortalized David Bowie with a series of vibrant murals . Painted in July 2016, the mural depicts the late musician’s various personas through eight side-by-side portraits that span each of his iconic transformations—from his glam-rock to his Berlin era.
9fa23d239f87eed0ef80363b257858453f407e63.translatedText: 在第七街的一堵貧民區牆上，鳳凰城藝術家瑪吉·基恩 (Maggie Keane) 用一系列充滿活力的壁畫讓大衛·鮑伊 (David Bowie) 永垂不朽。這幅壁畫繪製於 2016 年 7 月，透過八幅並排肖像描繪了這位已故音樂家的各種角色，涵蓋了他的每一個標誌性轉變——從他的華麗搖滾到他的柏林時代。

8acd5bc63c5e0dafe0dff66c5da9b112f8363203.sourceText: Keane, an artist known for her eclectic murals, approached the wall with permission from its owner. The mural has since become a local landmark, surviving fading and tagging (with the help of periodic touch-ups from Keane).
8acd5bc63c5e0dafe0dff66c5da9b112f8363203.translatedText: 基恩是一位以不拘一格的壁畫而聞名的藝術家，在得到主人的許可後走近了這面牆。此後，這幅壁畫在褪色和標記的幫助下倖存下來，成為當地的地標。

272e9d6da36029bba3fbdb5837ca483bd1407acf.sourceText: The mural is only a two-minute drive from the Phoenix Art Museum. It is right off the road and located next to a dance studio. Even though it can be seen from the street, it may be safer to pull in and park. Early morning may be a good time to visit as there are no cars from the business to block the mural.
272e9d6da36029bba3fbdb5837ca483bd1407acf.translatedText: 這幅壁畫距離鳳凰城藝術博物館僅兩分鐘車程。它就在馬路邊，毗鄰一個舞蹈室。儘管可以從街上看到，但停車並停車可能會更安全。清晨可能是參觀的好時機，因為商家沒有車輛擋住壁畫。

941c8cccd3ff14b22bb086531bc04fc1b23650e1.translatedText: 皮卡喬通道之戰紀念碑

9cf767415834034b7356e2646c4c7363744a2336.sourceText: A stone pillar marking the location of the westernmost battle of the American Civil War only honors one side of the conflict.
9cf767415834034b7356e2646c4c7363744a2336.translatedText: 標記美國內戰最西端戰役地點的石柱僅紀念衝突的一方。

392a9e346e12a45540e52126404f573ee04304f6.sourceText: The cowboy and actor died in a wash just south of the monument.
392a9e346e12a45540e52126404f573ee04304f6.translatedText: 牛仔和演員在紀念碑南邊的一次沖刷中喪生。

16bd9a2001e9e61c662c422f18c86a2f81174d85.sourceText: Interstate 10 stretches all the way from California to Florida. Along the way, the southernmost cross-country interstate highway in the U.S. passes through an Arizona town of fewer than 500 people. Picacho is named for the nearby Picacho Mountains, but its claim to fame is the Rooster Cogburn Ostrich Ranch.
16bd9a2001e9e61c662c422f18c86a2f81174d85.translatedText: 10 號州際公路從加州一直延伸到佛羅裡達州。沿途，美國最南端的越野州際公路經過亞利桑那州一座人口不到500人的小鎮。皮卡喬 (Picacho) 因附近的皮卡喬山脈 (Picacho Mountains) 而得名，但最出名的是 Rooster Cogburn 鴕鳥牧場。

80855f99b1d335f90f479bea1037e34fcd9551f8.sourceText: Rooster Cogburn Ostrich Ranch has been owned by the same family for three generations. The farm in the middle of the desert has been open to the public since 1999, when the only attraction was feeding the ostriches. Since then, they’ve added miniature donkeys and goats, deer, ducks, stingrays, and a beloved group of rainbow lorikeets, who live in a 5,000 square foot tropical greenhouse.
80855f99b1d335f90f479bea1037e34fcd9551f8.translatedText: Rooster Cogburn 鴕鳥牧場由同一家族經營了三代。這座位於沙漠中部的農場自 1999 年起就向公眾開放，當時唯一的吸引力就是餵養鴕鳥。從那時起，他們又增加了迷你驢子和山羊、鹿、鴨子、魟魚和一群心愛的彩虹吸蜜鸚鵡，它們生活在 5,000 平方英尺的熱帶溫室中。

9c87302ffc4aac79b283b1056a6138b82fd799b6.sourceText: The operational ostrich farm and petting zoo hybrid has been featured in a number of television shows, and every weekend and some holidays, they offer an educational monster truck tour of the facility which covers the ostrich industry, local wildlife, and the Picacho Mountains.
9c87302ffc4aac79b283b1056a6138b82fd799b6.translatedText: 營運中的鴕鳥農場和動物園混合體已出現在許多電視節目中，每個週末和一些節假日，他們都會提供一次教育性的巨型卡車之旅，內容涵蓋鴕鳥產業、當地野生動物和皮卡喬山。

68825f78918e7eb6bbe1b491ba81afd385dd074d.translatedText: 每天上午 9 點至下午 5 點開放。泥土停車場。

c84c82ab555ded04b25010c05e0680c90511982c.sourceText: One of the world's largest telescopes, stares into the night sky with two huge mirrors.
c84c82ab555ded04b25010c05e0680c90511982c.translatedText: 世界上最大的望遠鏡之一，用兩個巨大的鏡子凝視夜空。

2ee870bb3ded698f7534b5032f0f60889f6658ac.sourceText: More than 300 years ago, a revolt at this Hopi pueblo shaped the future of the American Southwest.
2ee870bb3ded698f7534b5032f0f60889f6658ac.translatedText: 300 多年前，霍皮人村的一場叛亂塑造了美國西南部的未來。

64d7d44aa9acdd262341fd7f4ac7c0160c8eeb20.sourceText: The red-orange cliff walls of Canyon de Chelly in northeastern Arizona are the result of millions of years of land uplifts and stream cutting. The national monument is located on Navajo tribal lands, and these lands have long been home to the Indigenous people of this region. In fact, Canyon de Chelly is one of North America's longest continuously-inhabited landscapes.
64d7d44aa9acdd262341fd7f4ac7c0160c8eeb20.translatedText: 亞利桑那州東北部謝伊峽谷的紅橙色懸崖壁是數百萬年土地隆起和溪流切割的結果。國家紀念碑位於納瓦霍部落土地上，這些土地長期以來一直是該地區土著人民的家園。事實上，謝伊峽谷是北美持續有人居住時間最長的景觀之一。

15b2fb707977e5ce2f0988b9e19e370bc6fadeb4.sourceText: The canyon's earliest known inhabitants were the Ancestral Puebloans, who made use of the rich soil and abundant water sources in the canyon. Though many of the Puebloans had left the area by the 1300s, they were followed by Hopi and Navajo people, who grew crops in the canyon, including corn and peaches. (Today, a Navajo woman is working to restore the peach orchards that once grew in this region.) There are multiple ruins in the canyon walls, many from the Hopi and other Puebloan societies.
15b2fb707977e5ce2f0988b9e19e370bc6fadeb4.translatedText: 峽谷中最早已知的居民是普韋布洛人祖先，他們利用峽谷中肥沃的土壤和豐富的水源。儘管許多普韋布洛人在 1300 年代就離開了該地區，但霍皮人和納瓦霍人緊隨其後，在峽谷種植玉米和桃子等農作物。 （今天，一名納瓦霍婦女正在努力恢復該地區曾經種植的桃園。）峽谷壁上有多個廢墟，其中許多來自霍皮人和其他普韋布洛社會。

77db61bb53d83ea5f68859d81600a3fdb1fa4b37.sourceText: By the late 1700s, European colonists had arrived in the Southwest, and fighting broke out between the colonists, the Navajo, and other Native American groups in the region. In 1805, Canyon de Chelly was the site of a bloody clash between the Navajo and Spanish colonists. In 1863, Kit Carson acting on orders from the United States government, came and burned the farms and rounded up the people in the canyon and marched them out of the canyon to a fort located hundreds of miles away. Approximately 250 Navajo stayed in the canyon on top of one of Fortress Rock, coming down at night to get water and food and going back up, pulling the ladders after them.
77db61bb53d83ea5f68859d81600a3fdb1fa4b37.translatedText: 到 1700 年代末，歐洲殖民者抵達西南部，殖民者、納瓦霍人和該地區其他美洲原住民群體之間爆發了戰鬥。 1805 年，謝伊峽谷是納瓦荷人和西班牙殖民者之間發生血腥衝突的地點。 1863年，基特·卡森奉美國政府之命來到這裡，燒毀了農場，並將峽谷中的人們圍捕起來，並把他們趕出峽谷，送到數百英里外的一座堡壘。大約 250 名納瓦霍人留在堡壘岩頂部的峽谷中，晚上下來取水和食物，然後拉著梯子返回。

e5a4e17b8fea26bd6b45f73005a4fb1fa8830d27.sourceText: The site is now part of Navajo Nation, the largest land area held by a Native American tribe at more than 27,000 square miles. In 1931, Canyon de Chelly was recognized as a national monument encompassing approximately 131 square miles. About 40 families reside within the park's boundaries.
e5a4e17b8fea26bd6b45f73005a4fb1fa8830d27.translatedText: 該遺址現在是納瓦荷族保留地的一部分，納瓦荷族保留地是美國原住民部落擁有的最大土地面積，面積超過 27,000 平方英里。 1931 年，謝伊峽谷被認定為國家紀念碑，佔地約 131 平方英里。大約有 40 個家庭居住在公園範圍內。

c2f853b8456862928f99a0e4284186f6d70dc8b6.sourceText: This scrap yard doubles as a naive art gallery full of found art and farm animals.
c2f853b8456862928f99a0e4284186f6d70dc8b6.translatedText: 這個廢品場兼作一個樸素的藝廊，裡面擺滿了發現的藝術品和農場動物。

a1886af3dc89b0265c6c3c8ee4849f735704d3ca.sourceText: These mid-century motels once housed the workers who built the Glen Canyon Dam.
a1886af3dc89b0265c6c3c8ee4849f735704d3ca.translatedText: 這些中世紀的汽車旅館曾經是建造格倫峽谷大壩的工人的住所。

307014b8e27ca36650c45078bc5b267531f6f072.sourceText: El Tiradito honors a man allegedly murdered for having an affair with his mother-in-law.
307014b8e27ca36650c45078bc5b267531f6f072.translatedText: El Tiradito 紀念一名據稱因與岳母有染而被謀殺的男子。

a6133baf288d6922ee677493a1523f6bce22919a.sourceText: This Old West prison built into the side of a cliff was said to be inescapable.
a6133baf288d6922ee677493a1523f6bce22919a.translatedText: 這座建在懸崖邊的舊西部監獄據說是無法逃脫的。

edd7b25a2804494539f5e2f431bdb9b8b7c6381c.sourceText: White Raven Trading Co. & The Museum of the Strange
edd7b25a2804494539f5e2f431bdb9b8b7c6381c.translatedText: White Raven 貿易公司和奇異博物館

56544793d90022dc7c2fcec9ccfa27a78d5dfd5a.sourceText: This curiosity shop contains a museum filled with bizarre, unique objects.
56544793d90022dc7c2fcec9ccfa27a78d5dfd5a.translatedText: 這家古董店裡有一個博物館，裡面裝滿了各種物品奇異、獨特的物體。

894b99b18f08171b9b0652d872ec99ef4623dacb.sourceText: A lingering bit of Space Race nostalgia lies in the middle of the desert.
894b99b18f08171b9b0652d872ec99ef4623dacb.translatedText: 在沙漠中央，殘留著一絲揮之不去的太空競賽懷舊之情。

a3de55f6d8ad1e3b483aeacc0903af33793f1803.sourceText: A unique collection of artistic rides
a3de55f6d8ad1e3b483aeacc0903af33793f1803.translatedText: 獨特的藝術遊樂設施集合

81aef5b07d69711bce1535b68519f5f30cf39203.sourceText: One of the final grand railway depot hotel complexes is slowly being restored to its former glory.
81aef5b07d69711bce1535b68519f5f30cf39203.translatedText: 最後的大型火車站酒店綜合體之一正在慢慢恢復昔日的輝煌。

5af5bd9ccfbd1e3312b19acfb512e6e82b27d153.sourceText: This public square capitalized on a single Eagles reference to bring some life back to an Arizona town.
5af5bd9ccfbd1e3312b19acfb512e6e82b27d153.translatedText: 這個公共廣場利用了老鷹隊的參考資料，為亞利桑那州的小鎮帶來了一些生機。

68184d9e620a1729afd73d97d33473734184bd44.sourceText: The Jewish section of the famous Boothill Graveyard was abandoned for nearly 100 years.
68184d9e620a1729afd73d97d33473734184bd44.translatedText: 著名的布特希爾墓園的猶太區被廢棄了近 100 年。

fa3e1d4f22604935774edf07306dcb7970282787.sourceText: An excursion train traverses a picturesque red-rock canyon along the Verde River.
fa3e1d4f22604935774edf07306dcb7970282787.translatedText: 遊覽火車沿著佛得角河穿越風景如畫的紅岩峽谷。

32a65e0fcfd093944a348ad8918f4f4e61334ca8.translatedText: 亞利桑那銅藝術博物館

ce793f9fb8a4028df87008b990f921f9fe5492fe.sourceText: The state's only comprehensive museum dedicated to the mineral that defined its history and economy.
ce793f9fb8a4028df87008b990f921f9fe5492fe.translatedText: 該州唯一的綜合博物館，專門展示定義其歷史和經濟的礦物。

ab1a191cac62f93b1f2ba68425ee3f421ebce6df.sourceText: This love letter to Poland serves bracing dill pickle soup and plump pierogis.
ab1a191cac62f93b1f2ba68425ee3f421ebce6df.translatedText: 這封寫給波蘭的情書提供令人振奮的蒔蘿泡菜湯和飽滿的波蘭餃子。

74c29cff4355654d514a4218fc9b5ef5a5de3ee6.sourceText: Vision: To promote and advocate for justice, equity, equality, inclusion, and opportunity for Asian Pacific Americans (APA) in the Arizona legal profession and the community-at-large.
74c29cff4355654d514a4218fc9b5ef5a5de3ee6.translatedText: 願景：在亞利桑那州法律界和廣大社區中促進和倡導亞裔太平洋裔美國人 (APA) 的正義、公平、平等、包容和機會。

e72d9359780b4fc98da361f00b045c3493aa63b7.sourceText: Finance and practical listing near Mekong Plaza in Mesa.
e72d9359780b4fc98da361f00b045c3493aa63b7.translatedText: 梅薩湄公河廣場附近的財務和實用上市。

214eeb9e1f2a8e58b5259feed3e3d28dec949ee3.sourceText: These two metal beams are a surprising sight to behold when entering Winslow from the east along the famed Route 66. They happen to be actual fragments saved from the World Trade Center in New York City.
214eeb9e1f2a8e58b5259feed3e3d28dec949ee3.translatedText: 當沿著著名的 66 號公路從東邊進入溫斯洛時，這兩根金屬梁是令人驚訝的景象。它們恰好是從紐約市世貿中心保存下來的實際碎片。

3b2bb4badc67bbb2fa5257f1ae5e34cb82e6a731.sourceText: This memorial pays a somber tribute to the men and women who lost their lives during the September 11th attacks. It's a truly moving installation consisting of two original beams that were erected to represent the Twin Towers.
3b2bb4badc67bbb2fa5257f1ae5e34cb82e6a731.translatedText: 這座紀念碑向在 9 月 11 日襲擊中喪生的男女致以沉痛的敬意。這是一個真正動人的裝置，由兩根代表雙子星大樓的原始橫樑組成。

ed18f795606076c4a69b350a0217fec28d86df26.sourceText: The plaque located at the memorial reads: "These two steel beams from the World Trade Center, entrusted to the citizens of Winslow by the City of New York, along with this flag that was flown at the Pentagon, stand as the centerpiece of our Remembrance Garden. The words "United We Stand" remind the world that we will not fear terrorism. We hereby dedicate this Garden to Northern Arizona 's promise that 'WE WILL NEVER FORGET".
ed18f795606076c4a69b350a0217fec28d86df26.translatedText: 紀念碑上的牌匾上寫著：「紐約市將這兩根來自世貿中心的鋼樑委託給溫斯洛市民，與五角大樓飄揚的這面旗幟一起，成為我們紀念花園的中心。「團結起來，我們站立」這句話提醒世界，我們不會我們特此將這個花園獻給北亞利桑那州「我們永遠不會忘記」的承諾。

6fdb369e5c5f1f9db4a75049d6b310e7fdb844d1.sourceText: This memorial garden also includes a large piece from the original bridge that once connected to the town.
6fdb369e5c5f1f9db4a75049d6b310e7fdb844d1.translatedText: 這個紀念花園還包括曾經連接城鎮的原始橋樑的一大塊。

0cca05de747a14b2d206260bc385779ea9aa818e.translatedText: 世界上第一個消音器人

937f31080c504fb5f691d4a763ba4a22cd5b6eba.sourceText: The first of the iconic American roadside attractions lives on as a college mascot.
937f31080c504fb5f691d4a763ba4a22cd5b6eba.translatedText: 第一個標誌性的美國路邊景點作為大學吉祥物繼續存在。

623b536474892b8f5ab79a4ae70d11ad6ad84b3a.sourceText: Grown from a seed that went to the moon!
623b536474892b8f5ab79a4ae70d11ad6ad84b3a.translatedText: 從一顆進入月球的種子中生長出來！

f8c5bcfc05abe621bee0ad466778f038c57495bc.sourceText: An ambitious developer built what was once the world's tallest fountain in a Phoenix suburb.
f8c5bcfc05abe621bee0ad466778f038c57495bc.translatedText: 一位雄心勃勃的開發商在鳳凰城郊區建造了曾經世界上最高的噴泉。

29fe908c1848b32a45bd515d229ddd1a9b5b9397.sourceText: A 26-foot-tall jackrabbit celebrates the past and future of the Southwest.
29fe908c1848b32a45bd515d229ddd1a9b5b9397.translatedText: 一隻 26 英尺高的長耳大野兔慶祝了西南方的過去和未來。

e0f8f23985349360fed9fad9fcb3f693ca3617de.sourceText: Enormous photography collection housed in a study center co-founded by Ansel Adams.
e0f8f23985349360fed9fad9fcb3f693ca3617de.translatedText: 由安塞爾亞當斯 (Ansel Adams) 共同創立的學習中心收藏有大量攝影作品。

e43560b3ace35a4bd597ed6d409ee8ff309aad1d.sourceText: Hikers and walkers flock to this historic volcanic butte for its scenic desert views.
e43560b3ace35a4bd597ed6d409ee8ff309aad1d.translatedText: 徒步旅行者和步行者紛紛湧向這座歷史悠久的火山孤峰，欣賞風景如畫的沙漠景觀。

c35721ab27643ff597faace605cee4bf5363fb92.sourceText: This trippy wonderland is the result of one man's obsessive, decades long passion project.
c35721ab27643ff597faace605cee4bf5363fb92.translatedText: 這個夢幻般的仙境是一個人數十年痴迷的熱情項目的結果。

44469395f36a7388ce514877d6d0233cb572111d.sourceText: This small hill features the most notable collection of petroglyphs in Saguaro National Park.
44469395f36a7388ce514877d6d0233cb572111d.translatedText: 這座小山上有仙人掌國家公園最著名的岩畫收藏公園。

33d9e5f833b56dd4f02f8e1483aa806d1886fb2e.sourceText: A disciple of Frank Lloyd Wright built an experimental, partially underground home in the desert.
33d9e5f833b56dd4f02f8e1483aa806d1886fb2e.translatedText: 弗蘭克·勞埃德·賴特 (Frank Lloyd Wright) 的弟子在沙漠中建造了一座實驗性的、部分地下的房屋。

9c17f93f51cb583bead0771703c6099d5f9d9e49.sourceText: One man spent decades making these working scale models of antique cars.
9c17f93f51cb583bead0771703c6099d5f9d9e49.translatedText: 一個人花了幾十年的時間製作這些古董車的工作比例模型。

8140ec037cb0be2fa0edeb8a22db0f6ec0757dec.sourceText: Inside this store, a mysterious statue draws visitors from the world over.
8140ec037cb0be2fa0edeb8a22db0f6ec0757dec.translatedText: 在這家店裡，一座神秘的雕像吸引著來自世界各地的遊客。

a0cdaac9b013b9ef7584e0060c160663d4ec99f3.sourceText: Dozens of elaborate works of automotive art have been preserved at this Arizona museum.
a0cdaac9b013b9ef7584e0060c160663d4ec99f3.translatedText: 這座亞利桑那州博物館保存了數十件精美的汽車藝術作品。

6f6c0c35981809dfac74648e5c6bca9cd515b8a8.sourceText: An improbable sinkhole in the sediments flanking the Beaver Dam Mountains.
6f6c0c35981809dfac74648e5c6bca9cd515b8a8.translatedText: 一個不可思議的天坑海狸壩山脈兩側的沉積物

55f2fdd0d85cd344fef76bbb2bfd7b3b54df71d5.sourceText: This striking church was built from a Frank Lloyd Wright design more than a decade after the master architect's death.
55f2fdd0d85cd344fef76bbb2bfd7b3b54df71d5.translatedText: 這座引人注目的教堂是根據弗蘭克·勞埃德·賴特 (Frank Lloyd Wright) 的設計在這位建築師去世十多年後建造的。

5974e0c702c233b56f80c8f4de28b9d9a9e13a3d.sourceText: A former department store turned into a quirky restaurant.
5974e0c702c233b56f80c8f4de28b9d9a9e13a3d.translatedText: 一家前百貨商店變成了一家奇特的餐廳。

2ac7160a4d9682eb467a7c2bb93531e5d3f9e046.sourceText: A cabinet of curious mathematical models and old calculators.
2ac7160a4d9682eb467a7c2bb93531e5d3f9e046.translatedText: 一櫃子裡放著好奇的數學模型和舊計算器。

3668b7b07b82b18f7ba04f51d5d4f57def8cab73.sourceText: There are only seven known examples of this rare string instrument in the world.
3668b7b07b82b18f7ba04f51d5d4f57def8cab73.translatedText: 這種稀有弦樂器在世界上只有七個已知的例子。

aeb751f98392553798025b5806396948172b3157.sourceText: A towering bronze statue memorializes the founding father of postwar American conservatism.
aeb751f98392553798025b5806396948172b3157.translatedText: 一座高聳的青銅雕像紀念戰後美國保守主義的創始人。

bdf6b056d25eb8ea58ee931d88cd3e87acff0833.translatedText: 弗蘭克·勞埃德·賴特尖塔

4cb0bad20ab91e9ad7fce6f012240a5d6e18f5b4.sourceText: Originally conceived as part of a proposed Arizona State Capitol building in the 1950s, this structure built in 2004 stands as a monument to the architect's legacy.
4cb0bad20ab91e9ad7fce6f012240a5d6e18f5b4.translatedText: 最初被設想為 1950 年代擬建的亞利桑那州議會大廈的一部分，這座建於 2004 年的建築成為了建築師遺產的紀念碑。

69ffd111b1cb6474a0403b77bb14cf943f6c49e7.sourceText: This 125-foot tower was part of a design that architect Frank Lloyd Wright proposed in 1957 as Arizona 's new State Capitol in Papago Park. Called " The Oasis, " Wright's vision included a canopy of honeycombed glass and a delicate spire atop each of the three wings. At the time, the design was rejected by Arizona for being too “modern,” and for many years it sat as one of the hundreds of Wright designs that were never implemented.
69ffd111b1cb6474a0403b77bb14cf943f6c49e7.translatedText: 這座 125 英尺高的塔樓是建築師弗蘭克·勞埃德·賴特 (Frank Lloyd Wright) 於 1957 年提出的亞利桑那州新州議會大廈設計的一部分。巴巴哥公園。賴特的願景被稱為“綠洲”，其中包括一個蜂窩狀玻璃天篷和三個機翼頂部各有一個精緻的尖頂。當時，該設計因過於“現代”而被亞利桑那州拒絕，多年來，它一直是賴特設計的數百個從未實施的設計之一。

9c57e2a4255cf5e38e4981c78e7f33a852764c4b.sourceText: But in 2004, the Promenade Scottsdale wanted a focal point for its shopping center. Working with one of Wright’s apprentices, Arnold Roy, they resurrected the tower elements from the design, and built one on the corner of Frank Lloyd Wright Boulevard and Scottsdale Road.
9c57e2a4255cf5e38e4981c78e7f33a852764c4b.translatedText: 但在 2004 年，斯科茨代爾長廊希望為其購物中心建立一個焦點。他們與賴特的學徒之一阿諾德·羅伊 (Arnold Roy) 合作，從設計中復活了塔樓元素，並在弗蘭克·勞埃德·賴特大道 (Frank Lloyd Wright Boulevard) 和斯科茨代爾路 (Scottsdale Road) 的拐角處建造了一座塔樓。

06992799883b6e8b4821237dbf369fde4e6194aa.sourceText: The tower is constructed from 1,700 individual pieces of steel and weighs 75,000 pounds. The colors of the spire were chosen to represent the colors of turquoise and copper ores that are very prevalent throughout the Arizona landscape. Internal LED lighting turns on each night. It sits amongst several Wright design elements including a pavilion, reflecting pool, and sculpture park containing pieces by Heloise Crista, who joined the Taliesin West collective in 1949 and passed away in 2019.
06992799883b6e8b4821237dbf369fde4e6194aa.translatedText: 該塔由 1,700 塊單獨的鋼材製成，重 75,000 磅。尖塔的顏色被選來代表亞利桑那州景觀中非常普遍的綠松石和銅礦石的顏色。內部 LED 照明每晚都會打開。它坐落在多個賴特設計元素之中，包括涼亭、倒影池和雕塑公園，其中包含 Heloise Crista 的作品，她於 1949 年加入 Taliesin West 集體，並於 2019 年去世。

014341b2343e4f45489f7b233c6623289be2f767.sourceText: The surrounding buildings have incorporated several classic elements of Frank Lloyd Wright's style, including Tree of Life glass windows in restaurants, Wright-inspired gates on several physical plant areas, and even a Wright-inspired bus stop. The spire is about 7 miles north-west of Taliesin West , the winter home that Wright established in 1937.
014341b2343e4f45489f7b233c6623289be2f767.translatedText: 周圍的建築融入了弗蘭克·勞埃德·賴特風格的幾個經典元素，包括餐廳的生命之樹玻璃窗、幾個實體廠區的賴特風格大門，甚至還有一個賴特風格的公車站。尖塔位於西塔里埃森西北約 7 英里處，這是萊特於 1937 年建立的冬季住宅。

56c3f18993f68642c32074e2f63299ebdef479b1.sourceText: In the heart of Winslow, Arizona (famous for its corner and flat-bed Fords) is a grand old dowager. She reclines upon the desert scrub-land, and puts one in mind of simpler times. More elegant times. With her tan stucco walls and red terra cotta tiled roof, her low walls and desert gardens, she seems timeless. This is one matron, though, who has lost none of her former vigor.
56c3f18993f68642c32074e2f63299ebdef479b1.translatedText: 在亞利桑那州溫斯洛的中心（以其轉角福特和平板福特汽車而聞名），有一位宏偉的老太婆。她斜倚在沙漠灌木叢中，讓人想起簡單的時光。更优雅的时光。棕褐色灰泥牆、紅色赤土瓦屋頂、矮牆和沙漠花園，她似乎永恆。不过，这位女士却丝毫没有失去往日的活力。

edcdbc0a0ebb60b057ecc9a3811b7bd652930a12.sourceText: This is La Posada Hotel and Gardens, first opened in 1930. It was one of the jewels in the glittering string of railways hotels and restaurants along the Santa Fe Railroad, built and operated by one Fred Harvey. Harvey, who was said to have "Civilized the West," was credited with introducing a high class glamour to railway travel. He set his sights on Winslow, the Arizona headquarters (then, as now) of the Santa Fe Railway. With a budget rumored to be $2 million ($40 million today) this would be the "last and greatest railroad hotel built in America."
edcdbc0a0ebb60b057ecc9a3811b7bd652930a12.translatedText: 這是拉波薩達飯店及花園，於 1930 年首次開幕。它是聖達菲鐵路沿線一串閃閃發光的鐵路酒店和餐廳中的一顆明珠，由弗雷德·哈維 (Fred Harvey) 建造和經營。哈維被認為是「西方文明」的締造者，他為鐵路旅行帶來了高級魅力。他把目光投向了溫斯洛，即聖達菲鐵路的亞利桑那州總部（當時和現在）。據傳預算為 200 萬美元（現在為 4000 萬美元），這將是“美國建造的最後一家也是最偉大的鐵路酒店。”

dffbf2fad1afe46aea378d9f94a42716fba6f2f0.sourceText: Construction in the 1920s was overseen by chief architect and designer Mary Colter, Harvey's long-time architect, known for her work on such landmark properties as the Phantom Ranch and El Tovar Hotel, both located at the Grand Canyon. Her seamless and evocative blending of Spanish and Native American designs epitomizes the Southwest. Colter not only designed the hotel, but the railroad station it serviced. Allowed to design the landscaping, and choose the furniture, china, and even the maid's uniforms, Colter considered La Posada to be her crowning achievement.
dffbf2fad1afe46aea378d9f94a42716fba6f2f0.translatedText: 1920 年代的建設由首席建築師兼設計師瑪麗·科爾特 (Mary Colter) 監督，她是哈維的長期建築師，瓦爾因設計位於大峽谷的設計師瑪麗·科爾特 (Elvarant) 和牧場 (Elvar Ranch) 和牧場 (Elvar Ranch Hotel) 等地标性建筑而闻名。她將西班牙和美洲原住民的設計無縫地、令人回味地融合在一起，體現了西南部的風格。科爾特不僅設計了酒店，還設計了酒店所服務的火車站。科爾特獲準設計景觀，選擇家具、瓷器，甚至女僕制服，她認為拉波薩達是她的最高成就。

b6624391692c510f0e4f2725d369396683883d51.sourceText: The timing of the hotel's opening could not have been less fortuitous, however. La Posada opened just seven months after the fateful Stock Crash of 1929. This, combined with changes in the way people traveled, and the upheaval caused by World War II, the hotel managed to remain open for only 27 years, finally closing its door to guests in 1957.
b6624391692c510f0e4f2725d369396683883d51.translatedText: 然而，酒店開業的時機絕非偶然。 La Posada 在 1929 年災難性的股市崩盤後僅七個月就開業了。再加上人們出行方式的變化以及第二次世界大戰造成的動亂，該酒店只成功營業了 27 年，最終於 1957 年向客人關門。

ae8fb6d59b4af06d85b95318a1c30c1bf1456437.sourceText: After this, La Posada faced the same challenges as many grand structures have faced, having lost their original purpose. In the early 1960s, the furniture having been auctioned off, La Posada was gutted and converted into the offices for the Santa Fe Railway. The threat of demolition always loomed on the horizon, even up to 1994 when the railway finally announced plans to vacate the storied structure. Fortunately, thanks to the efforts of concerned citizens, La Posada was added to the endangered list of the National Trust for Historic Preservation, saving it from the fate of a tragic Miss Havisham.
ae8fb6d59b4af06d85b95318a1c30c1bf1456437.translatedText: 此後，La Posada 面臨著與許多宏偉建築相同的挑戰，失去了最初的用途。 20 世紀 60 年代初，家具被拍賣，拉波薩達被拆除並改建為聖達菲鐵路的辦公室。拆除的威脅始終隱約可見，甚至直到 1994 年鐵路最終宣布計劃騰出這座高層建築時也是如此。幸運的是，在熱心市民的努力下，拉波薩達被列入國家歷史保護信託基金的瀕危名單，使其免於遭遇郝薇香小姐的悲慘命運。

5634396bdf80d596d435a2c08ef77bc5bb36cde1.sourceText: This recognition brought the hotel to the attention of its current owners, husband and wife Allen Affeldt and Tina Mion. Through great legal and financial difficulty, they finally acquired the property and surrounding grounds in 1997. Through tireless efforts and assiduous research, they have managed to renew the former glory of this glittering jewel of the desert. From the lovely rooms (each named after one of the celebrities who once lodged there) to the famous restaurant and bar, to the lovingly tended gardens, La Posada has reclaimed its crown as the queen of the railway. So, the next time you're traveling west on the Southwest Chief (Amtrak still stops at the La Posada Station) from Gallup, hop off at Winslow and see for yourself how La Posada lives up to its name "Resting Place."
5634396bdf80d596d435a2c08ef77bc5bb36cde1.translatedText: 這項認可使酒店引起了現任業主艾倫·阿費爾特 (Allen Affeldt) 和蒂娜·米恩 (Tina Mion) 夫婦的注意。經過巨大的法律和財務困難，他們終於在1997年獲得了該房產及週邊土地。透過不懈的努力和刻苦的研究，他們成功地使這顆沙漠上的明珠重現了昔日的輝煌。從可愛的房間（每間都以曾經住在那裡的一位名人的名字命名）到著名的餐廳和酒吧，再到精心照料的花園，拉波薩達重新奪回了鐵路女王的桂冠。因此，下次您從蓋洛普 (Gallup) 乘坐西南酋長號 (Amtrak 仍停靠在拉波薩達車站) 向西行駛時，請在溫斯洛 (Winslow) 下車，親眼看看拉波薩達 (La Posada) 是如何名副其實的“休息之地”。

29f6d23757e7dac947b127bbd08834c37c5c6267.sourceText: Stock up on all your horror paraphernalia at this year-round Halloween emporium.
29f6d23757e7dac947b127bbd08834c37c5c6267.translatedText: 在這個全年的萬聖節商場裡儲備所有恐怖用具。

0a5b9f280b2aa52efa5ef51b9806e97001f63334.sourceText: Every Christmas, one Arizona city makes the most of its dry climate by creating an arid desert tannenbaum.
0a5b9f280b2aa52efa5ef51b9806e97001f63334.translatedText: 每年聖誕節，亞利桑那州的一個城市都會充分利用其乾燥的氣候，創造一個乾旱的沙漠坦南鮑姆。

5060e2aee955b29bfe179ee77f1efe8d51bd1c2b.sourceText: A $100,000 tumbleweed decorates an Arizona park and ride that got its priorities a bit tangled.
5060e2aee955b29bfe179ee77f1efe8d51bd1c2b.translatedText: 價值 100,000 美元的風滾草裝飾著亞利桑那州的一個公園和遊樂設施，其優先事項有點混亂。

36561c327e0d89d3cc9b3e29d8add93aa2333788.sourceText: Some 10,000 works of ancient rock art cover these volcanic basalt outcrops near the Gila River.
36561c327e0d89d3cc9b3e29d8add93aa2333788.translatedText: 希拉河附近的火山玄武岩露頭覆蓋著約 10,000 件古代岩石藝術作品。

77ddcf5089e04a2f94e640ac050023b8e0721666.sourceText: After a short-lived attempt to bring America in line with the rest of the world, this road was left in metric.
77ddcf5089e04a2f94e640ac050023b8e0721666.translatedText: 在短暫地嘗試讓美國與世界其他地區保持一致之後，這條路就保留了公制。

a1e33e3330226a7f46082a349132ea7b8be49cc7.sourceText: Last known as the Longhorn Grill, the once-abandoned commercial space in Amado, Arizona has regained new life when it reopened in May 2019 as the Longhorn Grill and Saloon. The striking feature is the main entrance that has visitors walk through the nose of a giant longhorn skull, making it the most iconic buildings in the area.
a1e33e3330226a7f46082a349132ea7b8be49cc7.translatedText: 位於亞利桑那州阿馬多的這個曾經廢棄的商業空間最後被稱為 Longhorn Grill，於 2019 年 5 月以 Longhorn Grill and Saloon 的名稱重新開業，重新獲得了新生。引人注目的特色是主入口，遊客可以從一個巨大的長角牛頭骨的鼻子中走過，這使其成為該地區最具標誌性的建築。

fb0323f5021f28f9850675245c199537552c5b1b.sourceText: The building, which is sculpted to look like a colossal cow skull resting against a huge boulder, was built in the 1970s by an enterprising entrepreneur who clearly knew the power of both novelty architecture and giant skulls. While it previously was most recently a restaurant, the building had actually been a bait shop, a clothing store, and a roofing company. Although none of those businesses seemed as appropriate for the space as the steakhouse it became in 1993.
fb0323f5021f28f9850675245c199537552c5b1b.translatedText: 這座建築的雕塑看起來就像一個巨大的牛頭骨靠在一塊巨大的巨石上，由一位富有進取心的企業家於 20 世紀 70 年代建造，他清楚地知道新奇建築和巨型頭骨的力量。雖然它以前是一家餐館，但該建築實際上是一家誘餌店、一家服裝店和一家屋頂公司。儘管這些企業似乎都不像 1993 年的牛排館那樣適合這個空間。

2b5e271ad995794c969fefe6f06e28b0c82576f9.sourceText: The Longhorn Grill operated until 2012, when it finally faced foreclosure and had to be sold at auction. As late as 2013, the space was said to have been used for parties and the like until it was renovated an reopened in 2019. It now serves breakfast through dinner, 7 days a week.
2b5e271ad995794c969fefe6f06e28b0c82576f9.translatedText: Longhorn Grill 一直營業到 2012 年，最終面臨喪失抵押品贖回權，不得不在拍賣會上出售。據說，遲至 2013 年，該空間也被用於舉辦派對等，直到 2019 年重新裝修並重新開放。現在，每週 7 天供應早餐到晚餐。

ab4a51a8e47518e567c8985b58f2527cecada1a9.sourceText: Despite its rough past, the proud Western roadside icon remains to this day, and even thrives under the new ownership. The concrete, rebar, and stucco that the 30-foot tall horns are made of continues to hold up despite years under the Arizona sun, and the full restoration work on the interior makes an impressive and comfortable place to stop. Feel free to take your picture in front of the skull.
ab4a51a8e47518e567c8985b58f2527cecada1a9.translatedText: 儘管有著坎坷的過去，這一令人自豪的西方路邊標誌至今仍然存在，甚至在新主人的帶領下蓬勃發展。儘管多年在亞利桑那州的陽光下，由混凝土、鋼筋和灰泥製成的 30 英尺高的喇叭仍然保持完好，內部的全面修復工作使之成​​為一個令人印象深刻且舒適的停留場所。請隨意在頭骨前拍照。

dc89001213fe7ab7934e866161afbe26581ee40d.sourceText: Open from 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. on weekdays, 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. on weekends.
dc89001213fe7ab7934e866161afbe26581ee40d.translatedText: 營業時間為上午 8 點至晚上 9 點工作日上午 7 點至晚上 9 點週末。

9c9b061413bf531cfcab25a73fc9f6ea9c746175.sourceText: Last Supper Museum Art & Music Center
9c9b061413bf531cfcab25a73fc9f6ea9c746175.translatedText: 最後的晚餐博物館藝術和音樂中心

4db839fc764c456d4f16f6696229f0e3340d05d8.sourceText: With more than 2,000 pieces, this is world's largest collection of artwork inspired by Leonardo da Vinci's 'The Last Supper.'
4db839fc764c456d4f16f6696229f0e3340d05d8.translatedText: 擁有 2,000 多件作品，是世界上最大的受達文西《最後的晚餐》啟發的藝術品收藏。

310308d82d6dd86028c0c47dd25c7c5a6a2edb21.sourceText: The lobby of this hotel near the U.S.-Mexico border features a stained-glass mural that measures 42 feet long and 6 feet tall.
310308d82d6dd86028c0c47dd25c7c5a6a2edb21.translatedText: 這家飯店靠近美國-墨西哥邊境，大廳設有彩色玻璃壁畫，尺寸為42 英尺長，6 英尺高。

189e26995c24329ddd9d4db1a12b692ebbdd4396.sourceText: This isolated outpost was once the only place to cross the Colorado River for hundreds of miles.
189e26995c24329ddd9d4db1a12b692ebbdd4396.translatedText: 這個孤立的前哨站曾經是跨越數百英里科羅拉多河的唯一地方。

5a03a73a47eb119b9fd0c3e11a57cbff27fa6dbd.sourceText: This unique art installation used boiler tubes from a decommissioned power plant to resemble Antelope Canyon.
5a03a73a47eb119b9fd0c3e11a57cbff27fa6dbd.translatedText: 這個獨特的藝術裝置使用來自退役發電廠的鍋爐管來模仿羚羊峽谷。

b959c2185d514993c0ba7026115218f6355ac727.sourceText: Petroglyph Beach is a remarkable site located in the Glen Canyon National Recreation Area , a scenic park that stretches across Arizona and Utah . Petroglyph Beach stands out as an archaeological treasure and offers visitors a glimpse into the rich history of the region.
b959c2185d514993c0ba7026115218f6355ac727.translatedText: 岩畫海灘 (Petroglyph Beach) 是位於格倫峽谷國家休閒區 (Glen Canyon National Recreation Area) 內的一處著名景點，這是一個橫跨亞利桑那州和猶他州的風景優美的公園。岩畫海灘作為考古寶藏脫穎而出，讓遊客一窺該地區豐富的歷史。

7d1c0e211334775cc78dc3bb63d6952e15be1122.sourceText: Situated on the edge of the Colorado River, Petroglyph Beach is named for the numerous petroglyphs found etched into the walls of Glen Canyon. Petroglyphs are ancient rock carvings made by ancient Native Americans who inhabited the area centuries ago. These carvings depict various symbols, animals, and scenes that hold significant cultural and spiritual meaning.
7d1c0e211334775cc78dc3bb63d6952e15be1122.translatedText: 岩畫海灘位於科羅拉多河邊緣，因在格倫峽谷壁上刻有大量岩畫而得名。岩畫是由幾個世紀前居住在該地區的古代美洲原住民製作的古老岩石雕刻。這些雕刻描繪了具有重要文化和精神意義的各種符號、動物和場景。

cd88e0c789e75e45304c9a3bccc0e8de1003d2c0.sourceText: The beach itself is a serene and tranquil spot where visitors can relax and enjoy the picturesque surroundings before continuing down the river. Exploring Petroglyph Beach offers a unique opportunity to connect with the past and appreciate the artistic expressions of the indigenous people who once thrived in the region. The petroglyphs provide a glimpse into their daily lives, beliefs, and experiences. Visitors can spend hours examining the intricate carvings and pondering the stories they tell.
cd88e0c789e75e45304c9a3bccc0e8de1003d2c0.translatedText: 海灘本身是一個寧靜祥和的地方，遊客可以在繼續順流而下之前放鬆身心並欣賞風景如畫的環境。探索岩畫海灘提供了一個獨特的機會，可以與過去聯繫並欣賞曾經在該地區繁榮發展的土著人民的藝術表現。這些岩畫讓我們得以一睹他們的日常生活、信仰和經歷。遊客可以花幾個小時檢查複雜的雕刻並思考它們所講述的故事。

b1720303c0e6d6c981e495e5c64ef422b5a75263.sourceText: It's important to note that Petroglyph Beach is a protected site, and visitors are encouraged to treat it with respect and care. It is essential to avoid touching or damaging the petroglyphs to preserve them for future generations. Many sites within the National Park Service have specific guidelines and regulations in place to ensure their preservation, so it's advisable to follow any posted instructions.
b1720303c0e6d6c981e495e5c64ef422b5a75263.translatedText: 值得注意的是，岩畫海灘是一個受保護的地點，我們鼓勵遊客尊重和愛護它。必須避免觸摸或損壞岩畫，以便為子孫後代保存它們。國家公園管理局內的許多景點都有具體的指導方針和規定來確保它們的保存，因此建議遵循任何張貼的說明。

de4c272088710ccba1d103bbaf94b6eca84dac31.sourceText: Old aircraft sit outside this small museum, forming an intriguing airplane graveyard. Step inside the museum, and you'll find even more planes and aviation memorabilia that may have otherwise been lost forever.
de4c272088710ccba1d103bbaf94b6eca84dac31.translatedText: 旧飞机坐落在这个小博物馆外面，形成了一个有趣的飞机墓地。走進博物館，您會發現更多可能永遠失去的飛機和航空紀念品。

d52049a640b5e8538c2b8dfdc3fd695167643d74.sourceText: Planes of Fames Museum was born from the passion of Ed Maloney's desire to "preserve, inspire, educate, and honor" the aviation industry. Maloney started the first museum in 1957 with 10 planes. The original location was moved to Chino, California and this second, smaller location is in Valle, Arizona .
d52049a640b5e8538c2b8dfdc3fd695167643d74.translatedText: 飛機名人博物館的誕生源自於艾德‧馬洛尼「保護、啟發、教育與榮耀」航空業的熱情。马洛尼于 1957 年用 10 架飞机创办了第一家博物馆。原來的地點搬到了加州的奇諾，第二個較小的地點位於亞利桑那州的瓦萊。

65ff8cbd4f277ed25d7fb295d54edb488cbf7dc2.sourceText: But just because it's smaller than the original museum doesn't mean it's any less impressive. Visit this museum, and you'll discover an impressive collection of beautifully restored vintage planes. The collection, which continues to grow, includes cars and other war artifacts as well. There are hands-on exhibits within the museum and the airplane boneyard is available to walk through outside for a close up-look at the antiquated equipment.
65ff8cbd4f277ed25d7fb295d54edb488cbf7dc2.translatedText: 但是，僅僅因為它比原來的博物館小，並不意味著它就不那麼令人印象深刻。参观这个博物馆，您会发现一系列令人印象深刻的经过精心修复的老式飞机。該收藏品還在增加，其中還包括汽車和其他戰爭文物。博物馆内有可亲身体验的展品，外面还有飞机坟场，可以近距离观察陈旧的设备。

b1ffe431603cb5ca93ebb2d3432b85569b4b4ca2.sourceText: Many planes have been restored to flying condition and are on display and in the sky annually for an aviation show. In addition to the museum, you'll also find a well-stocked aviation-themed gift shop.
b1ffe431603cb5ca93ebb2d3432b85569b4b4ca2.translatedText: 許多飛機已恢復飛行狀態，每年都會在航空展上展出和上空。除了博物館之外，您還可以找到一家庫存豐富的航空主題禮品店。

85d1057424b2a222757660f2a1795d053017efb2.sourceText: Update as of December 2024: The Valle Wing of Planes of Fame has been closed. The collection has since been moved back to Chino, California.
85d1057424b2a222757660f2a1795d053017efb2.translatedText: 截至 2024 年 12 月更新：名人飛機谷翼區已關閉。該收藏後來被遷回加州奇諾。

9f4adc34d93f12a1949fe452800c8f5cd4c74dfe.sourceText: Hidden inside this Arizona fast food franchise is an in-depth exhibit on the famed WWII counterintelligence program.
9f4adc34d93f12a1949fe452800c8f5cd4c74dfe.translatedText: 這家亞利桑那州的快餐連鎖店隱藏著關於著名的二戰反間諜計劃的深入展覽。

f8fad2553b6372bf731815cd511906371f6e6587.sourceText: These petroglyphs created by ancient Arizonians have withstood centuries of exposure to the elements.
f8fad2553b6372bf731815cd511906371f6e6587.translatedText: 這些由古代亞利桑那人創造的岩畫經歷了幾個世紀的暴露。

65418f48c838ee70f381e033326c21f03540ce51.sourceText: Airplane aficionados rejoice! Heaven has been found and it's on the grounds of the Davis-Montham Air Force Base in Tucson, Arizona.
65418f48c838ee70f381e033326c21f03540ce51.translatedText: 飛機愛好者有福了！天堂已經被發現，就在亞利桑那州圖森市的戴維斯-蒙瑟姆空軍基地。

9b5d2916b924401cb423c57c8a4a179251dd5280.sourceText: The 2,600-acre area, officially called the 309th Aerospace Maintenance and Regeneration Group (AMARG) though popularly known as "the Boneyard," is filled with retired aircraft, including almost every type of plane flown by the United States Armed Forces since World War II.
9b5d2916b924401cb423c57c8a4a179251dd5280.translatedText: 這片佔地 2,600 英畝的區域，正式名稱為第 309 航空航天維護與再生大隊(AMARG)，雖然俗稱“墓地”，但這裡停滿了退役飛機，包括自二戰以來美國武裝部隊駕駛的幾乎所有類型的飛機II.

f00168ca4bb1c5c57e3a5a526451c5fec89d40e6.sourceText: Immediately after World War II, B-29 and C-74 airplanes were parked here in order to salvage parts. The aerospace junkyard has been growing ever since: B-52 bombers from the Cold War are parked next to F-4 fighter/bombers used during the Vietnam War, while civilian planes like 707s bring some diversity to the neighborhood.
f00168ca4bb1c5c57e3a5a526451c5fec89d40e6.translatedText: 二戰剛結束時，B-29和C-74飛機就停在這裡，以搶救零件。此後，航空航太垃圾場不斷擴大：冷戰時期的 B-52 轟炸機停放在越戰期間使用的 F-4 戰鬥機/轟炸機旁邊，而 707 等民用飛機則為附近地區帶來了一些多樣性。

5eb3d80e4fd7cd86c43d39819fca1325b6fc05c4.sourceText: The parts gleaned from the decommissioned planes are used in maintaining and repairing current Joint and Allied/Coalition warfighters. Official figures from the Defense Department estimate that by using replacement parts culled from the Boneyard, every one dollar spent generates eleven dollars in savings through reuse.
5eb3d80e4fd7cd86c43d39819fca1325b6fc05c4.translatedText: 從退役飛機上收集的零件用於維護和修理目前的聯合和盟軍/聯軍戰鬥機。國防部的官方數據估計，透過使用從埋葬場挑選的替換零件，每花費一美元，重複使用可以節省 11 美元。

952cb6487e439e9e5a7d530412fe22e1f5a79ebb.sourceText: Tucson's arid, high-altitude make it an ideal storage place; rust and other deterioration occur here at a much slower rate. Due to its unique landscape, the Boneyard is regularly used by Hollywood to stage post-apocalyptic and action movies.
952cb6487e439e9e5a7d530412fe22e1f5a79ebb.translatedText: 圖森的乾旱、高海拔使其成為理想的儲存場所；生鏽和其他變質在這裡發生的速度要慢得多。由於其獨特的景觀，屍骨場經常被好萊塢用來上演後世界末日和動作電影。

a753fc630fe7563d7c7ad1a063fe933d3fbadca7.sourceText: The world's best exhibit on the Navajo Code Talkers is located in a Burger King in Kayenta, Arizona.
a753fc630fe7563d7c7ad1a063fe933d3fbadca7.translatedText: 世界上最好的納瓦霍密碼對話者展覽位於亞利桑那州凱恩塔的漢堡王。

bce80c23e328dafaf19d53c6014492aff0c27c57.sourceText: In World War II, the U.S. military had a problem. Every code they developed was broken by Japanese cryptographers. Enter: the Navajo Code Talkers. Navajo is a unique tonal language, mutually unintelligible with even its closest linguistic relatives. The first Navajo Language Dictionary was not produced until 1943, making Navajo a particularly good language for speaking in code. (By one estimate at the time, fewer than 30 non-Navajos could speak the language.) The Marines recruited several young men (29 in the first class), pulling them out of reservation boarding school and working with them to build the eventual code.
bce80c23e328dafaf19d53c6014492aff0c27c57.translatedText: 在第二次世界大戰中，美國軍方遇到了問題。他們開發的每一個密碼都被日本密碼學家破解了。輸入：納瓦荷語密碼者。納瓦荷語是一種獨特的聲調語言，即使與其最接近的語言親戚也無法相互理解。第一本納瓦荷語字典直到 1943 年才問世，使納瓦荷語成為一種特別適合用密碼說話的語言。 （根據當時的估計，只有不到 30 名非納瓦霍人會說這種語言。）海軍陸戰隊招募了幾名年輕人（頭等艙 29 人），將他們從預訂寄宿學校中拉出來，並與他們一起制定最終的代碼。

96ee5f9bf5b929d74a9d30374bc36548c4481c27.sourceText: Navajo code talkers were recognized as skilled and accurate. Six Navajo code talkers worked around the clock during the Battle of Iwo Jima, sending and receiving more than 800 messages flawlessly. Major Howard Connor, 5th Marine Division signal officer, later said, "Were it not for the Navajos, the Marines would never have taken Iwo Jima." The Navajo Code was never broken, and technically remained a state secret until the Vietnam War-era.
96ee5f9bf5b929d74a9d30374bc36548c4481c27.translatedText: 納瓦荷語代碼交談者被認為是熟練且準確的。硫磺島戰役期間，六名納瓦荷語密碼員晝夜不停地工作，完美地發送和接收了 800 多個訊息。海軍陸戰隊第五師信號官霍華德·康納少校後來說：「如果沒有納瓦霍人，海軍陸戰隊永遠不會佔領硫磺島。」納瓦霍密碼從未被破解，並且在技術上一直是國家機密，直到越南戰爭時期。

b0a46aa259ae7e687d2ff00e6fff50efda22e20a.sourceText: In 1986, the small reservation town of Kayenta, Arizona got its first fast-food restaurant. It was owned and operated by the son of a Navajo Code Talker, Richard Mike. Mike decided to put the war memorabilia he had collected from his father on display in his new restaurant.
b0a46aa259ae7e687d2ff00e6fff50efda22e20a.translatedText: 1986 年，亞利桑那州凱恩塔的保留小鎮開設了第一家快餐店。它的所有者和經營者是納瓦霍語密碼高手理查德·邁克 (Richard Mike) 的兒子。麥克決定把他從父親那裡收集的戰爭紀念品放在他的新餐廳裡展出。

33a791d107059c413d2e6856cdf72b1e7c3ad56d.sourceText: "We have here in Kayenta more Code Talker memorabilia than the Pentagon does," Mike said in an interview with the Arizona Republic. Mike's father's name? King Mike. Of course.
33a791d107059c413d2e6856cdf72b1e7c3ad56d.translatedText: 「我們在凱恩塔擁有的 Code Talker 紀念品比五角大樓還要多，」麥克在接受《亞利桑那共和報》採訪時說道。迈克的父亲叫什么名字？麥克王.當然。

ced734367cf3f8d3f5a4294a71c9eb1b874fd473.sourceText: This ancient trail has claimed the lives of over 2,000 people.
ced734367cf3f8d3f5a4294a71c9eb1b874fd473.translatedText: 這條古老的小徑已奪去了 2,000 多人的生命。

959630384ff902778e4176635124eb30c576667b.sourceText: An assortment of armored tanks and Howitzer cannons in the middle of the Sonoran Desert.
959630384ff902778e4176635124eb30c576667b.translatedText: 索諾蘭沙漠中部的各種裝甲坦克和榴彈砲。

192121e730e7b014210db68d734e3c1740a34d21.sourceText: For over 1,000 years, travelers have used El Camino del Diablo to cross the harsh Sonoran Desert between settlements in what is now the state of Sonora in Mexico and the Colorado River in what is now Yuma, Arizona. Known as both El Camino del Diablo and El Camino del Muerto—Spanish for the Devil's Highway and Road of the Dead—its names allude to the dangers travelers have faced along this route.
192121e730e7b014210db68d734e3c1740a34d21.translatedText: 1000 多年來，旅行者們沿著暗黑之路穿越嚴酷的索諾蘭沙漠，穿越現在墨西哥索諾拉州的定居點和現在亞利桑那州尤馬的科羅拉多河之間的嚴酷索諾蘭沙漠。它被稱為“El Camino del Diablo”和“El Camino del Muerto”——西班牙語，意思是“魔鬼公路”和“死亡之路”——它的名字暗示了旅行者在這條路線上所面臨的危險。

3dc013b5feef9706a9de02130b46a7d5552b4a72.sourceText: The Sonoran Desert in southern Arizona is one of the harshest environments on the planet, yet humans have managed to live in the area for over 10,000 years. Temperatures over 120 degrees Fahrenheit have been measured there and water is extremely scarce. For the hunter-gatherer population that inhabited the area before European conquest, it was frequently necessary to migrate across the region to where food and water were more readily available. Passing near rare springs and pools in the mountains that seasonally fill with water before reaching the Colorado River, the route of El Camino del Diablo is more determined by the location of water sources than by expediently reaching its final destination.
3dc013b5feef9706a9de02130b46a7d5552b4a72.translatedText: 亞利桑那州南部的索諾蘭沙漠是地球上環境最惡劣的地區之一，但人類已經在該地區生活了 10,000 多年。據測量，那裡的氣溫超過華氏 120 度，而且水資源極其匱乏。對於歐洲征服之前居住在該地區的狩獵採集者來說，經常需要穿越該地區遷移到更容易獲得食物和水的地方。暗黑之路的路線更取決於水源的位置，而不是能否迅速到達最終目的地。

789c377b37901c9b2924bb2e005879e70440d99c.sourceText: Europeans first traveled on road in 1540 when a group of Spanish Conquistadors, led by Melchior D í az, used the route as they marched on to California. For hundreds of years thereafter the trail was used by Spanish soldiers and priests as they attempted to colonize the region. In the 1840s, the road was used by Mexican migrants heading north to California during the Gold Rush. Many of those who used the Devil's Highway proved unable to survive in the harsh desert environment and perished along the way. Since European arrival, it is estimated that over 2,000 people have died while traveling on El Camino del Diablo. In 1870, the Southern Pacific Railroad was connected to Yuma, Arizona and the dangerous route across the Sonoran Desert declined in popularity.
789c377b37901c9b2924bb2e005879e70440d99c.translatedText: 1540 年，歐洲人首次踏上公路旅行，當時梅爾基奧爾·迪亞斯 (Melchior Díaz) 率領的一群西班牙征服者沿著這條路線向加利福尼亞進軍。此後的數百年裡，西班牙士兵和牧師試圖在該地區殖民時使用這條小徑。 1840 年代淘金熱期間，墨西哥移民曾使用這條路向北前往加州。許多走魔鬼公路的人無法在惡劣的沙漠環境中生存，並在途中喪生。自歐洲人抵達以來，估計已有 2,000 多人在黑暗之路 (El Camino del Diablo) 旅行期間死亡。 1870 年，南太平洋鐵路與亞利桑那州尤馬相連，穿越索諾蘭沙漠的危險路線不再受歡迎。

88ee359f33dc0de8f099883441590e42acdfe6d3.sourceText: People still die while traveling El Camino del Diablo today. The road is lined with makeshift grave markers dating from the 1800s to the present day. Increased security along the border between the United States and Mexico has driven popular migration routes away from cities and sanctioned border crossing stations and into the dangerous, uninhabited desert regions.
88ee359f33dc0de8f099883441590e42acdfe6d3.translatedText: 時至今日，在黑暗之路上仍有人死亡。道路兩旁都是 1800 年代至今的臨時墓碑。美國和墨西哥邊境安全的加強，使得流行的移民路線遠離城市和批准的過境站，進入危險的、無人居住的沙漠地區。

9804372a2b629668042820294cd120fa2b024a99.sourceText: Recreational visitors also face risk. There are no amenities, emergency services, or cell phone service out in this remote section of desert, so unprepared visitors are largely forced to deal with any issues they face, including lack of water or vehicular breakdown, on their own. The road has been widened somewhat to accommodate vehicle traffic, but it is still a rough, dirt trail similar to the one used by Native Americans for over 1,000 years. Because of its historic significance, El Camino del Diablo was added to the National Register of Historic Places in 1978 and today traverses the massive Cabeza Prieta National Wildlife Refuge. Those who are well prepared and are willing to brave the harsh environment are rewarded with views of some of the most remote and ecologically pristine desert wilderness in the United States.
9804372a2b629668042820294cd120fa2b024a99.translatedText: 休閒遊客也面臨風險。這個沙漠偏遠地區沒有便利設施、緊急服務或手機服務，因此毫無準備的遊客很大程度上被迫自己處理他們面臨的任何問題，包括缺水或車輛故障。為了適應車輛通行，道路已進行了一定程度的拓寬，但它仍然是一條崎嶇的土路，類似於美洲原住民 1,000 多年來所使用的道路。由於其歷史意義，暗黑之路 (El Camino del Diablo) 於 1978 年被列入國家史蹟名錄，如今橫貫規模龐大的卡貝薩普列塔國家野生動物保護區 (Cabeza Prieta National Wildlife Refuge)。那些做好充分準備並願意勇敢面對惡劣環境的人將獲得美國最偏遠、生態最原始的沙漠荒野的景觀。

fdcabfdac1225b0220e524002a12c5aa3856cbd6.sourceText: For better or worse, the United States remains one of only three countries that have not officially adopted the metric system. America’s refusal to adopt the metric system has not been for lack of trying, however.
fdcabfdac1225b0220e524002a12c5aa3856cbd6.translatedText: 無論好壞，美國仍然是僅有的三個尚未正式採用公制的國家之一。然而，美國拒絕採用公制並不是因為缺乏嘗試。

dab443e7d4edc10b1eb4eba421294104402fe6f8.sourceText: In 1975, Congress passed the Metric Conversion Act, which declared metric as the preferred system of the United States. The U.S. Metric Board was created to implement this conversion. In keeping with this plan, road signs on Interstate 19, connecting Tucson, Arizona, to Nogales, Mexico, were changed so that distances were posted in kilometers. It remains to this day the only highway in America with distances posted solely in kilometers.
dab443e7d4edc10b1eb4eba421294104402fe6f8.translatedText: 1975年，國會通過了《公制轉換法案》，宣佈公制為美國的首選制度。美國公制委員會的成立就是為了實現這種轉換。為了與該計劃保持一致，連接亞利桑那州圖森和墨西哥諾加利斯的 19 號州際公路上的路標發生了變化，距離以公里為單位。直到今天，它仍然是美國唯一一條僅以公里為單位標註距離的高速公路。

4dc93315dac1c18d0c86de4f0e946a5cc7b2cc6e.sourceText: As might be expected, a number of motorists have been confused by the unique distances on the signs, and measures have been taken to replace the metric signs with ones with distances displayed in standard American units of measurement. Luckily, the road has been able to maintain its unique identity thanks to the efforts of locals who didn't want to have to change the signage and directions for their businesses. Presumably they were also dismayed at the thought of losing their singular speedway.
4dc93315dac1c18d0c86de4f0e946a5cc7b2cc6e.translatedText: 正如所料，許多駕駛者對標誌上獨特的距離感到困惑，因此我們已採取措施，將公制標誌替換為以美國標準測量單位顯示距離的標誌。幸運的是，由於當地人不想改變其企業的標誌和方向，這條路得以保持其獨特的身份。想必他們也對失去自己獨特的高速公路感到沮喪。

d6a2b8ba80ef0fecb365c86e02f37569bb6be71e.sourceText: America’s metric experiment proved to be short lived. The Metric Conversion Act and U.S. Metric Board were dismantled only seven years after they were created. Forty years later, America remains committed to its customary system of measurement. However, if you are willing to give an inch and forget about miles, head to Interstate 19 and see what it is like to drive a few kilometers.
d6a2b8ba80ef0fecb365c86e02f37569bb6be71e.translatedText: 美國的公制實驗被證明是短暫的。 《公制轉換法》和美國公制委員會在創立僅七年後就被廢除。四十年後，美國仍然致力於其習慣的測量系統。然而，如果您願意放棄一英寸而忘記英里，可以前往 19 號州際公路，看看行駛幾公里是什麼感覺。

eae2a6ef2e7e14f4af07105a12fe60c8e5134448.sourceText: Online ordering menu for Heng's Kitchen.
eae2a6ef2e7e14f4af07105a12fe60c8e5134448.translatedText: 恆氏廚房線上點餐菜單。

607f179db54400d4c430b618ddb2c3bfa836fa99.sourceText: Online ordering menu for Heng's Kitchen. Welcome to Heng's Kitchen in Mesa, Arizona where we serve Dim Sum, Rice Noodles, and more! Find us at the corner of Main Street and Dobson Road. Order online for carryout or delivery!
607f179db54400d4c430b618ddb2c3bfa836fa99.translatedText: 恆氏廚房線上點餐菜單。歡迎來到位於亞利桑那州梅薩的 Heng's Kitchen，我們供應點心、米粉等！我們位於主街和多布森路的拐角處。線上訂購可外帶或外送！

07f48540a640829f2216a35aa4c0d986dc0d5a7d.sourceText: The Jerky King is listed within Mekong Plaza in Mesa. This profile was generated from plaza directory sources and map-based verification, so direct business contact details may still be incomplete.
07f48540a640829f2216a35aa4c0d986dc0d5a7d.translatedText: The Jerky King 位於梅薩的湄公河廣場內。此設定檔是根據廣場目錄來源和基於地圖的驗證產生的，因此直接業務聯絡詳細資訊可能仍然不完整。

8b99ac3009c8c9b267bab80feb5679e6d19bdd53.sourceText: Ernie Adams was a gearhead from an early age. As a child, he would attach junkyard motors to bicycles and wagons to make running vehicles. In 1962, he came up with the idea of building miniature versions of real cars. By 1965, he was able to build a working scaled-down 1928 Chevy two-door sedan made out of nine old refrigerators and powered by a two-cylinder, 13-horsepower Onan motor.
8b99ac3009c8c9b267bab80feb5679e6d19bdd53.translatedText: 厄尼亞當斯 (Ernie Adams) 從小就是齒輪迷。小時候，他將垃圾場的引擎安裝在自行車和馬車上，以製造行駛的車輛。 1962年，他提出了製造真實汽車的微型版本的想法。到 1965 年，他已經能夠用 9 台舊冰箱製造出一輛按比例縮小的 1928 年雪佛蘭雙門轎車，並由 2 缸 13 馬力 Onan 發動機提供動力。

9874fc0b44e0e4721214524f688684f86b9af120.sourceText: Since then, Adams has built countless 11/16th scale model cars, all of them street-legal and complete with windshield wipers, air conditioning, and radios. In 1979, he ventured into race cars, participating in the first dwarf car race at the 1983 Yavapai County Fair. Before his recent retirement from building cars due to old age, he ventured into building classic touring cars.
9874fc0b44e0e4721214524f688684f86b9af120.translatedText: 從那時起，Adams 製造了無數 11/16 比例的模型汽車，所有這些模型都可以上路行駛，並配有擋風玻璃雨刷器、空調和收音機。 1979 年，他涉足賽車領域，參加了 1983 年亞瓦派縣博覽會上的首屆矮人汽車比賽。在他因年老而從汽車製造業退休之前，他開始涉足製造經典旅行車。

2f02fcb5a46a14df83406bb87f2c3ab155c53aa6.sourceText: Adams and his family, who are originally from Harvard, Nebraska, now operate a museum on their Arizona property showcasing some of his work. He often hangs out at the museum. On site, one can view a short film and book explaining how he creates his vehicles. One can also see his workshop and other cars and related memorabilia he has collected.
2f02fcb5a46a14df83406bb87f2c3ab155c53aa6.translatedText: 來自內布拉斯加州哈佛大學的亞當斯和他的家人現在在亞利桑那州的房產上經營著一家博物館，展示他的一些作品。他常去博物館閒逛。在現場，人們可以觀看一部短片和一本解釋他如何製造車輛的書。人們還可以看到他的工作室以及他收集的其他汽車和相關紀念品。

753b49217f66542a4c9855528ceb11195dbe7064.sourceText: Florence's historic adobe county courthouse was turned into a historic site that honors one of Arizona's most prominent political leaders.
753b49217f66542a4c9855528ceb11195dbe7064.translatedText: 佛羅倫斯歷史悠久的土坯縣法院被改建為歷史遺址，紀念亞利桑那州最著名的政治領袖之一。

ba3e4525ff50fa219770d83faf12bcadc3c77c3e.sourceText: Situated midway between Florence and Oracle Junction, Arizona , deep in the heart of the Sonoran Desert, is a remote roadside park containing a monument to cowboy, actor, and Western star Tom Mix.
ba3e4525ff50fa219770d83faf12bcadc3c77c3e.translatedText: 位於亞利桑那州佛羅倫薩和甲骨文章克申之間、索諾蘭沙漠深處的一個偏僻的路邊公園，裡面有一座牛仔、演員和西部明星湯姆·米克斯的紀念碑。

af3c9b662ddef0d0e158523f2b73ddc834a0a5fa.sourceText: About a 100 yards or so to the south of the marker, on October 12, 1940, Mix wrecked his Cord automobile in the nearby wash while driving at a high speed.The crash cost him his life, though accounts from the time vary as to the exact cause of his death.
af3c9b662ddef0d0e158523f2b73ddc834a0a5fa.translatedText: 1940 年 10 月 12 日，在標記以南約 100 碼處，米克斯在附近的洗車場高速行駛時撞壞了他的 Cord 汽車。這場車禍奪走了他的生命，儘管有記載關於他的具體死因，時間不一。

8c5ebde954a00ac19030ec85977a750e30722e9d.sourceText: Mix's fans were heartbroken, and decided to erect a monument to their beloved star. Ever since, this monument has caught the eye of motorists passing by on Arizona State Highway 79; there's even a geocache placed at the site in the Western star's honor.
8c5ebde954a00ac19030ec85977a750e30722e9d.translatedText: Mix的粉絲傷心欲絕，決定為他們心愛的明星豎立一座紀念碑。從那時起，這座紀念碑就吸引了經過亞利桑那州 79 號公路的駕駛者的注意；甚至還為紀念這位西方明星而在現場放置了一個寶藏。

f52435221d3efaf18823b74935cb1446879e5b3d.sourceText: One of the covered picnic tables next to the monument displays memorabilia about Mix, copies of newspaper accounts of his death, and a register for guests to sign. Just down the road (to the south), the desert wash where Mr. Mix died is aptly named Tom Mix Wash.
f52435221d3efaf18823b74935cb1446879e5b3d.translatedText: 紀念碑旁的一張有頂棚的野餐桌上陳列著有關米克斯的紀念品、他去世的報紙報道副本以及供客人簽名的登記冊。就在路的南邊，米克斯先生去世的沙漠窪地被恰當地命名為湯姆米克斯窪地。

08f3dddc92660a6b436635bba33023f6a91067f9.sourceText: This abandoned bootleg attraction was built to cash in on the popularity of classic TV show, F Troop.
08f3dddc92660a6b436635bba33023f6a91067f9.translatedText: 這個廢棄的盜版景點是為了利用經典電視節目《F Troop》的受歡迎程度而建造的。

890746736468569edcb26117d1bf8c45cefdfc57.sourceText: This immigrant bridge once spanned the Thames but is now a fixture of an Arizona city.
890746736468569edcb26117d1bf8c45cefdfc57.translatedText: 這座移民橋曾經橫跨泰晤士河，但現在是亞利桑那州城市的固定設施。

2c31d472779fa07b1b13d8d13ff303b0e5221718.sourceText: A pair of giant roadside arrows are all that remains of a former Route 66 trading post.
2c31d472779fa07b1b13d8d13ff303b0e5221718.translatedText: 路邊一對巨大的箭頭是前 66 號公路貿易站的遺跡。

f786f657f0e836334eb591f2140ac81c8a04c87a.sourceText: Along the old Route 66 is an abandoned trading post made from old telephone poles, built by a former circus clown.
f786f657f0e836334eb591f2140ac81c8a04c87a.translatedText: 舊 66 號公路沿線有一座廢棄的貿易站，由舊電線桿改建而成，由一名前馬戲團小丑建造。

c817f19560689ab4996aab32561f972d25041aec.sourceText: They're crafted in a giant spinning furnace under a college football stadium.
c817f19560689ab4996aab32561f972d25041aec.translatedText: 它們是在大學橄欖球場下的巨型紡紗爐中製成的。

8b1e13ae01b248975bfb7cfe9078e42a85e4a77d.sourceText: It is not clear whether they considered the alternate names Aveneet or Aventreet.
8b1e13ae01b248975bfb7cfe9078e42a85e4a77d.translatedText: 目前尚不清楚他們是否考慮過使用替代名稱 Aveneet 或 Aventreet。

76571051abea45557c530b26ad712035c46a77e0.sourceText: The first permanent memorial to a unique secret weapon of World War II.
76571051abea45557c530b26ad712035c46a77e0.translatedText: 第一個紀念二戰獨特秘密武器的永久紀念碑。

a7bf85e7b1ef543aec3b40286a47202146846560.sourceText: Religious statues built because of one man's bargain with God fill this peaceful sculpture garden.
a7bf85e7b1ef543aec3b40286a47202146846560.translatedText: 由於一個人與上帝討價還價而建造的宗教雕像充滿了這個寧靜的雕塑花園。

f66ac894f42f0c52865c6eb5bfcc1fdee3fdc26c.sourceText: The largest copper mine in Arizona, this enormous open pit emerges from the hills like an alien landscape.
f66ac894f42f0c52865c6eb5bfcc1fdee3fdc26c.translatedText: 亞利桑那州最大的銅礦，這個巨大的露天礦坑從山上拔地而起，就像一幅陌生的風景。

9375fefdf9436a61eb863319a4356498f2a1028e.sourceText: The remains of this rugged homestead ranch offer a brief glimpse into a bygone era.
9375fefdf9436a61eb863319a4356498f2a1028e.translatedText: 這座崎嶇不平的家園牧場的遺跡讓我們得以一睹過去時代的風采。

7e794ce8e792fca70b4d9c5546412d1a3238ccb8.sourceText: This old selenite mine is dotted with tiny crystals that make it shimmer like it's covered in glitter.
7e794ce8e792fca70b4d9c5546412d1a3238ccb8.translatedText: 這座古老的亞硒酸鹽礦點綴著微小的晶體，使其閃閃發光，就像覆蓋著閃光一樣。

33534a94525325004e3955af4212b998268bea47.sourceText: This huge dam across the Colorado River caused an armed standoff between two U.S. states.
33534a94525325004e3955af4212b998268bea47.translatedText: 這座橫跨科羅拉多河的巨大水壩導致了美國兩個州之間的武裝對峙。

f45bcadd4181cf0d896ac3ab5614481cfbdd59fe.translatedText: 加茲登太平洋玩具火車博物館

89d02cf5658c4913e0544f3ffc0e5d69620ade7e.sourceText: An amazing collection of model trains, collectibles, and artifacts that span the last 100 years.
89d02cf5658c4913e0544f3ffc0e5d69620ade7e.translatedText: 跨越過去 100 年的火車模型、收藏品和文物的驚人收藏。

d2e5832f2fb9c96459e92ab513574b8f4cb9c42e.sourceText: The largest and most well-preserved petroglyph site in the Verde Valley.
d2e5832f2fb9c96459e92ab513574b8f4cb9c42e.translatedText: 佛得角山谷最大且保存最完好的岩畫遺址。

9d752d67f55d405e331dba8c90b8e400c9e09ffd.sourceText: From working out of his garage to the James Beard semifinals, one Tucson baker has kept his fan base—and his grains—local.
9d752d67f55d405e331dba8c90b8e400c9e09ffd.translatedText: 從在車庫裡鍛煉到詹姆斯·比爾德 (James Beard) 半決賽，一位圖森麵包師一直將他的粉絲群和穀物保留在本地。

491c5da7cc89414f909fd36750f8310a1d6da823.sourceText: The final resting place of the businessman-turned-astronomer who helped discover Pluto stands near his observatory.
491c5da7cc89414f909fd36750f8310a1d6da823.translatedText: 這位幫助發現冥王星的商人出身的天文學家的最後安息之地位於他的天文台附近。

6652c3f1c086e25876cfd0fb7350158d42f569fe.sourceText: This quiet chapel was central to a community of settlers who reclaimed an abandoned fort.
6652c3f1c086e25876cfd0fb7350158d42f569fe.translatedText: 這座安靜的教堂是一個開墾廢棄堡壘的定居者社區的中心。

46527482eaea9f39e8937aed430e7cbb324b8e5a.sourceText: Visitors to this public park will also find the ruins of an old western fort.
46527482eaea9f39e8937aed430e7cbb324b8e5a.translatedText: 來到這個公園的遊客還會發現一座古老的西部堡壘的廢墟。

456268bf25ed7ea7394c25b08ec6028fbef5c632.sourceText: Hong Kong Gifts is listed within Mekong Plaza in Mesa. This profile was generated from plaza directory sources and map-based verification, so direct business contact details may still be incomplete.
456268bf25ed7ea7394c25b08ec6028fbef5c632.translatedText: 香港禮品位於梅薩的 Mekong Plaza 內。此設定檔是根據廣場目錄來源和基於地圖的驗證產生的，因此直接業務聯絡詳細資訊可能仍然不完整。

d1d1b8e706163cae570b67d0c9ccddc368633c91.sourceText: This 24-acre park offers a place for meditation in the midst of Sedona's iconic red rocks.
d1d1b8e706163cae570b67d0c9ccddc368633c91.translatedText: 這座佔地 24 英畝的公園在塞多納標誌性的紅色岩石中提供了冥想的場所。

eace4ee4955b6ffbd726867d65aad06b667081e9.sourceText: Crafted in 1911, this steam locomotive spent its entire working life in Flagstaff.
eace4ee4955b6ffbd726867d65aad06b667081e9.translatedText: 這輛蒸汽機車於 1911 年製造，在弗拉格斯塔夫度過了整個工作生涯。

bd9dc54336e13508094491a39cfaa43a52560a82.sourceText: This 1930s log cabin began as a taxidermy museum but is now a popular country music venue.
bd9dc54336e13508094491a39cfaa43a52560a82.translatedText: 這座 1930 年代的小木屋最初是一個動物標本博物館，但現在已成為流行的鄉村音樂場所場地。

ec5beb947a0ec744c38d51804c2e2803a3286273.sourceText: More than 25 fully functional scale replicas of famous lighthouses dot the shores of Lake Havasu.
ec5beb947a0ec744c38d51804c2e2803a3286273.translatedText: 超過 25 座功能齊全的著名燈塔複製品點綴在哈瓦蘇湖沿岸。

3eef8fb8ee0aadd672e90331ad3f51d48b1437de.sourceText: During World War II this was the site of an "honor camp" used as a prison for draft dodgers, Native American conscientious objectors, and Japanese-Americans—including a man who brought his case against the camp to the Supreme Court.
3eef8fb8ee0aadd672e90331ad3f51d48b1437de.translatedText: 二戰期間，這裡是一個「榮譽營」所在地，被用作監獄，關押著逃避兵役者、美洲原住民出於良心拒服兵役者和日裔美國人，其中包括一名向最高法院提起訴訟的男子。

41142fc8027cc3a8ffa67fca1ae64b678c7ffc35.sourceText: A 1930’s courtroom where John Dillinger and his gang went before a judge.
41142fc8027cc3a8ffa67fca1ae64b678c7ffc35.translatedText: 1930 年代的法庭，約翰·迪林格 (John Dillinger) 和他的團夥在此接受法官審判。

90e2fa4a37e918b1cc0dfc03a7dcee8a07b597d9.sourceText: Robert McCall Space Windows at Kilgore Chapel
90e2fa4a37e918b1cc0dfc03a7dcee8a07b597d9.translatedText: 基爾戈爾教堂的羅伯特·麥考爾空間窗戶

f466eb5bc4e4121f53278fb0860203f8113fb717.sourceText: An out of this world experience.

725d842710fb40158a4591d6da2a79c7fcae3311.sourceText: This bomb shelter-themed bar has barely changed since it opened.
725d842710fb40158a4591d6da2a79c7fcae3311.translatedText: 這家防空洞主題酒吧自開業以來幾乎沒有變化。

fc4f6ab9d705d11963c4ddf34cfb3532593bac9f.sourceText: The world's only teal arches exist in a city that cares more about its aesthetic than an Instagram influencer.
fc4f6ab9d705d11963c4ddf34cfb3532593bac9f.translatedText: 世界上唯一的青色拱門存在於一個更關心其美學而不是 Instagram 影響者的城市。

57775d0037a5fe48792448d94edc558a0b590dd4.sourceText: Previously a hot spring, this park remains a site of unique history, wildlife, and geology.
57775d0037a5fe48792448d94edc558a0b590dd4.translatedText: 以前是個溫泉，這個公園仍然擁有獨特的歷史、野生動物和地質。

78f791785b7ec4cd6e69f8aacd9e4e9d3dbbd1a5.sourceText: A historic hydroelectric power plant serves as the unusual backdrop for a public park.
78f791785b7ec4cd6e69f8aacd9e4e9d3dbbd1a5.translatedText: 一座歷史悠久的水力發電廠為公園提供了不尋常的背景。

6892aecd75c49035b281588a54604d614b7747b5.sourceText: One of the best-preserved ghost towns in Arizona speaks to the difficulties of establishing mining towns in the 19th century American West.
6892aecd75c49035b281588a54604d614b7747b5.translatedText: 亞利桑那州保存最完好的鬼城之一講述了在 19 世紀美國西部建立採礦城鎮的困難。

f64f149c298d64782116d783dc695c806cdda237.sourceText: An open-air, roadside eatery celebrating a historic indigenous cuisine of complicated significance.
f64f149c298d64782116d783dc695c806cdda237.translatedText: 一家露天路邊餐館，慶祝歷史悠久的土著美食複雜的意義。

e3caf2c76b6fbc8f979555dc8ac2f5a823d407b3.sourceText: This mesmerizing and surreal landscape features intricate patterns of white and red sandstone.
e3caf2c76b6fbc8f979555dc8ac2f5a823d407b3.translatedText: 這片令人著迷且超現實的景觀以白色和紅色砂岩的複雜圖案為特色。

932440379e6e09dee6a725d99605dda8ef2c5b10.translatedText: 聖澤維爾德爾巴克教堂

2d96ec2d822ba56b52b8510a73ba5c4e4d0ad84b.sourceText: This church on a Tohono O'Odham reservation has stood since 1797.
2d96ec2d822ba56b52b8510a73ba5c4e4d0ad84b.translatedText: 這座教堂位於 Tohono O'Odham 保留地，自 1797 年以來一直矗立。

be31e1e6212098d5e77fa5dc9ae5d3554dca206a.sourceText: The Pima Air & Space Museum’s history has been one of constant growth. The museum’s origins trace back to the 1960s, when the nearby Davis-Monthan Air Force Base began to set aside historic aircraft used during World War II to prevent them from being recycled for scrap. These decommissioned planes were positioned so that people could see them through the base’s fence, but became so popular that plans were made to display them up close in a public museum. The base’s collection of planes was bolstered by acquisitions from as far afield as India, which donated a rare Consolidated B-24 Liberator bomber in 1969.
be31e1e6212098d5e77fa5dc9ae5d3554dca206a.translatedText: 皮馬航空航太博物館的歷史是一部不斷發展的歷史。博物館的起源可以追溯到 20 世紀 60 年代，當時附近的戴維斯-蒙森空軍基地開始將二戰期間使用的歷史飛機放在一邊，以防止它們被回收當廢品。這些退役的飛機被放置在人們可以透過基地圍欄看到它們的位置，但它們變得如此受歡迎，以至於計劃在公共博物館近距離展示它們。該基地的飛機收藏得益於遠至印度的收購，印度於 1969 年捐贈了一架罕見的聯合 B-24 解放者轟炸機。

b5b7fdbc48a82444dfe8671a611b611bb7ec517e.sourceText: The museum opened to the public in 1976, and since then, it’s expanded dramatically. The number of aircraft on display has grown from an initial 48 to nearly 400, spread out over 80 acres of land. “Space” was added to the museum’s name in 1992 to reflect a growing focus on space travel in addition to aviation. The museum now houses a Space Gallery with a lunar rock sample and a replica of the Apollo Capsule. It is also home to NASA’s (now-retired) Stratospheric Observatory for Infrared Astronomy (SOFIA) aircraft, which was used to observe celestial phenomena at high altitudes.
b5b7fdbc48a82444dfe8671a611b611bb7ec517e.translatedText: 博物館於 1976 年對外開放，此後規模急劇擴大。展出的飛機數量從最初的 48 架增加到近 400 架，佔地超過 80 英畝。 1992 年，博物館名稱中添加了“太空”一詞，以反映除航空之外，人們對太空旅行的日益關注。博物館現在設有一個太空畫廊，裡面有月球岩石樣本和阿波羅太空艙的複製品。這裡也是 NASA（現已退役）平流層紅外線天文觀測站 (SOFIA) 飛機的所在地，該飛機用於觀測高空天體現象。

12b11bdc0efdcf09722e16077d52b36d03abd906.sourceText: NASA’s now-retired Other collection highlights include the Arizona Aviation Hall of Fame, which celebrates Arizonans who have made significant contributions to the field, and the oldest-surviving McDonnell-Douglas DC-10, a now-retired model of passenger plane that first flew in 1970.
12b11bdc0efdcf09722e16077d52b36d03abd906.translatedText: NASA 現已退役的其他收藏亮點包括亞利桑那航空名人堂，該名人堂旨在表彰對該領域做出重大貢獻的亞利桑那州人，以及現存最古老的麥道公司DC-10，一款現已退役的客機型號，於 1970 年首飛。

e884ad3b63df06357b28f693b1cbce4100dffccf.sourceText: The Pima Air & Space Museum is open seven days a week except holidays, from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. June through September, and from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. October through May. Tickets are not available for purchase in advance.
e884ad3b63df06357b28f693b1cbce4100dffccf.translatedText: 皮馬航空航天博物館每週 7 天開放（假日除外），開放時間為上午 9 點至下午 3 點。六月至九月，上午 9 點至下午 5 點十月至五月。門票不可提前購買。

2837c760f5c3a1e2c3cb3074949f99e7eeae7a5b.sourceText: The first Protestant church in Arizona and only Gothic Revival style adobe church in the world.
2837c760f5c3a1e2c3cb3074949f99e7eeae7a5b.translatedText: 亞利桑那州第一座新教教堂，也是世界上唯一的哥德復興風格土坯教堂。

e2a4cea09179a980c61f0701064adbdd3c6cad2d.sourceText: In an implausible turn of events, this jailhouse went on the run. The old jail building in Jerome , Arizona can be found more than 200 feet from where it started, following a slow slide down the mountain.
e2a4cea09179a980c61f0701064adbdd3c6cad2d.translatedText: 事情發生了令人難以置信的轉變，這座監獄開始逃亡。亞利桑那州傑羅姆市的舊監獄建築距離起點有 200 多英尺，緩慢滑下山。

9e9d8f467e26f5ab99b500514e3a43453d393cb0.sourceText: Although its been many years since the facility was in use, it certainly spent some time in high demand. An old copper mining camp, Jerome was incorporated in 1898 and like many Wild West towns, soon garnered a reputation for boozing, brawling, and brotheling. Its bad reputation was enough to briefly garner it the title of “Wickedest Town in America.” The gambling and gun fights continued through Jerome’s World War I boom, when there were as many as 15,000 people living and working there. Today, it has only about 400 inhabitants and quite a different temperament.
9e9d8f467e26f5ab99b500514e3a43453d393cb0.translatedText: 雖然該設施已經使用多年，但它的需求量確實很高。傑羅姆 (Jerome) 是一座古老的銅礦營地，成立於 1898 年，與許多狂野西部城鎮一樣，很快就因酗酒、爭吵和妓院而聲名狼藉。它的壞名聲足以讓它短暫地獲得「美國最邪惡的城鎮」的稱號。在傑羅姆第一次世界大戰期間，賭博和槍戰仍在繼續，當時有多達 15,000 人在那裡生活和工作。如今，這裡只有約 400 名居民，性情卻截然不同。

ce5174ad46dce81071046cc93f02d90b3bef0059.sourceText: Jerome is located on a steep hill between Prescott and Flagstaff —perhaps a little too steep. The jail is not the only building in town that isn’t quite where its builder left it. The concrete cell block was once part of a wood and tin building, but pulled away from the rest of the structure after some underground blasting in 1938 shifted the ground beneath a substantial portion of the town Although the jail was deemed unsafe for prisoners and evacuated, its gradual slide down the hill continued unchecked until other buildings had been secured.
ce5174ad46dce81071046cc93f02d90b3bef0059.translatedText: 傑羅姆位於普雷斯科特和弗拉格斯塔夫之間的一座陡峭山坡上——也許有點太陡了。監獄並不是鎮上唯一一棟與建造者留下的位置不一樣的建築。混凝土牢房曾經是一棟木頭和錫製建築的一部分，但在 1938 年的一次地下爆破後，建築物的其餘部分被拆除，導致該鎮大部分地區的地面移動。儘管監獄被認為對囚犯不安全並被疏散，但在其他建築物得到保護之前，它一直在不受控制地從山上逐漸滑落。

96c647450efdad55457475b8d749a1a00cb8684f.sourceText: A little lawless itself, the jail is now stabilized with retaining walls and surrounded by an iron fence, just in case it decides to make another break for it.
96c647450efdad55457475b8d749a1a00cb8684f.translatedText: 監獄本身有點無法無天，現在用擋土牆加固，並用鐵柵欄包圍，以防萬一它決定再次休息一下。

ecaae45c34c91e238801d1db1c66b6dc3e5b071e.sourceText: Phoenix Sky Harbor says the Federal Aviation Administration will hold four virtual workshops in May as part of the Phoenix Area FAA Modernization Project. The effort is led by the FAA and would revise or add satellite-based flight procedures intended to improve safety and make airspace operations more efficient for Phoenix Sky Harbor and surrounding airports.
ecaae45c34c91e238801d1db1c66b6dc3e5b071e.translatedText: 菲尼克斯天港機場表示，作為菲尼克斯地區聯邦航空管理局現代化計畫的一部分，美國聯邦航空管理局將於 5 月舉辦四場虛擬研討會。這項工作由美國聯邦航空管理局 (FAA) 牽頭，將修改或增加基於衛星的飛行程序，旨在提高安全性，並使鳳凰城天港及週邊機場的空域運作更加高效。

d186a214991bff03b3a7af1904ae6adbc8edd850.sourceText: According to the announcement, the workshops will walk the public through how the region's airspace currently functions, what changes the FAA is proposing, and what the agency found in its draft environmental assessment. Each session is also supposed to include time for direct questions so residents can raise concerns or ask for clarification from FAA specialists.
d186a214991bff03b3a7af1904ae6adbc8edd850.translatedText: 根據公告，研討會將向公眾介紹該地區空域目前的運作方式、美國聯邦航空管理局 (FAA) 提議的改變以及該機構在其環境評估草案中發現的內容。每次會議還應該包括直接提問的時間，以便居民可以提出疑慮或要求 FAA 專家進行澄清。

214943e9ff9edc7da86ce1825d5950aa862602e4.sourceText: The airport notes that Spanish interpretation will be available and that pre-registration is not mandatory. People who do register will receive reminder emails and Zoom access information, and the release also says on-site public viewing will be offered for the May 13 and May 19 sessions.
214943e9ff9edc7da86ce1825d5950aa862602e4.translatedText: 機場指出，將提供西班牙文翻譯，並且不強制要求預先註冊。註冊的人將收到提醒電子郵件和 Zoom 訪問訊息，新聞稿還表示，5 月 13 日和 5 月 19 日的會議將提供現場公眾觀看。

90b9358466a86ba95b9e62fc26f219da71bf98e8.sourceText: This is a high-interest Arizona transportation item because flight-path changes can affect noise patterns, airport operations, and nearby neighborhoods across the Valley. For residents, businesses, and local governments around Phoenix-area airports, the workshops are an early chance to understand how the modernization plan could reshape regional air traffic and community impacts.
90b9358466a86ba95b9e62fc26f219da71bf98e8.translatedText: 這是亞利桑那州備受關注的交通項目，因為飛行路徑的變化可能會影響噪音模式、機場運營和整個山谷的附近社區。對於鳳凰城地區機場周圍的居民、企業和地方政府來說，研討會是了解現代化計畫如何重塑地區空中交通和社區影響的早期機會。

ccf60f300b1bfc57d83b0785de2b08089dda6d55.sourceText: Christian church for Chinese from East valley, Gilbert, Mesa, Chandler, Queen Creek, tempe, Scottsdale, greater phoenix
ccf60f300b1bfc57d83b0785de2b08089dda6d55.translatedText: 來自東谷、吉伯特、梅薩、錢德勒、皇后溪、坦佩、斯科茨代爾、大菲尼克斯的華人基督教會

f45b2ca79ae72cd0dfaa5e27b1036f2f34ce256b.sourceText: Winslow, Arizona was once the largest town in the northern part of the state, but after the traffic from Route 66 dried up the town fell into a depression that only an Eagles song could fix.
f45b2ca79ae72cd0dfaa5e27b1036f2f34ce256b.translatedText: 亞利桑那州溫斯洛曾經是該州北部最大的城鎮，但在 66 號公路的交通乾涸之後，該鎮陷入了只有老鷹樂隊的歌曲才能治癒的蕭條。

aa34d6e15209aee7ca3e6194b29d46399e005223.sourceText: During the heyday of tourism along America's historic Route 66, Winslow was a well known spot among the arid Arizona expanse. So well known in fact that the band dads love, and everyone else loves to hate, the Eagles, mentioned the town in their classic rock staple, Take It Easy . Unfortunately things weren't easy for very much longer in Winslow as the trans-national I-40 highway finally opened and their stretch of Route 66 was no longer the necessary thoroughfare it once was. Once the road closed, so did a number of businesses in the town, making the future look bleak.
aa34d6e15209aee7ca3e6194b29d46399e005223.translatedText: 在美國歷史悠久的 66 號公路沿線旅遊業的鼎盛時期，溫斯洛是亞利桑那州乾旱地區的一個著名景點。事實上，老鷹樂團如此出名，讓爸爸們又愛又恨，老鷹樂團在他們的經典搖滾主打歌《Take It Easy》中提到了這個小鎮。不幸的是，隨著跨國 I-40 高速公路終於開通，而且 66 號公路不再像以前那樣是必要的通道，溫斯洛的情況在很長一段時間內都不太容易。道路一旦封閉，鎮上的許多企業也隨之關閉，未來一片黯淡。

040c77efa0dc04dd455d6cbe72f78d2fd8d79c0e.sourceText: Luckily a local group looking to reinvigorate the town remembered the reference in the Eagles song and had the idea to capitalize on it. Thus Standin' On the Corner Park was born. Bringing the scene from the song to life, a bronze statue of a musician in 70's garb stands on the corner with his instrument on his toe. Painted on the brick wall behind him is a tromp l'oeil mural of a woman in a pickup truck reflected in a storefront window. The entire effect is to bring the song's easy breezy story to life.
040c77efa0dc04dd455d6cbe72f78d2fd8d79c0e.translatedText: 幸運的是，一個希望重振小鎮的當地團體記住了老鷹樂隊歌曲中的內容，並想到了利用它的想法。因此，站在街角公園誕生了。街角矗立著一座穿著 70 年代服裝的音樂家銅像，腳趾上踩著樂器，將歌曲中的場景栩栩如生地呈現出來。他身後的磚牆上畫著一幅錯視壁畫，畫的是一名坐在皮卡車裡的女人，倒映在店面的窗戶上。整個效果是將歌曲輕鬆活潑的故事帶入生活。

dda43fb046e4374ac599de77bd63404b8aba4f24.sourceText: The plan worked and Standin' On the Corner Park is now a popular roadside attraction along the now historic Route 66 road, bringing new tourism to the area and allowing a number of local businesses to reopen. Winslow can once again, take it easy.
dda43fb046e4374ac599de77bd63404b8aba4f24.translatedText: 該計劃成功了，Standin' On the Corner Park 現在已成為歷史悠久的 66 號公路沿線的熱門路邊景點，為該地區帶來了新的旅遊業，並允許許多當地企業重新開業。溫斯洛可以再一次放輕鬆。

46e68fb3d8566416d3b3037e91d2e99a85f625ae.sourceText: White Raven Trading Co. Curiosity Shoppe and Museum of the Strange is a culmination of a lifelong obsession with the strange, unusual, and odd. The Museum of the Strange is a free attraction featuring a collection of amazing "weird stuff." It has everything from a reatwo-headed shark to the "world's largest taxidermied frog band" to what's probably the largest public display of "assquatches" (taxidermy deer butts). One of its most macabre items is a Charles Manson painting done in human blood, with some of his actual cremains mixed in, which is one of five of such paintings in existence.
46e68fb3d8566416d3b3037e91d2e99a85f625ae.translatedText: White Raven Trading Co. Curiosity Shoppe 和 Museum of the Strange 是畢生對奇異、不尋常和奇怪事物的痴迷的頂峰。奇異博物館是一個免費景點，收藏著令人驚嘆的「奇怪的東西」。它擁有從真正的雙頭鯊魚到“世界上最大的標本剝制青蛙樂隊”到可能是最大的公開展示的“assquatches”（標本剝制鹿屁股）的一切。其中最令人毛骨悚然的物品之一是查爾斯·曼森 (Charles Manson) 的一幅用人血繪製的畫作，其中混雜著他的一些真實骨灰，這是現存的五幅此類畫作之一。

e54a73d52261008a9e141e272acc48982717d981.sourceText: It's located on historic Allen Street in Tombstone, Arizona. The White Raven Trading Co. is opened every day except Tuesdays from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. The Museum of the Strange is free.
e54a73d52261008a9e141e272acc48982717d981.translatedText: 它位於亞利桑那州墓碑鎮歷史悠久的艾倫街。 White Raven Trading Co. 除週二外每天上午 10 點至下午 6 點營業。奇異博物館免費。

73b5e732caa6fd1620f32c037655783922e5ea5e.translatedText: 一個臭名昭著的狂野西部亡命之徒的偏遠安息之地，他的死亡籠罩在神秘之中。

1c2d07b899b1ca3df0f8ee0ac2af3d46545fbda1.sourceText: Rising out of the Arizona desert, Camelback Mountain is an iconic landform visible across most of the Valley of the Sun. The mountain is named for its signature humps and a ridge that resembles the head of a reclining camel. This mountain, popular with urban hikers, exposes some of the oldest and some of the youngest rocks found in the area in the same place!
1c2d07b899b1ca3df0f8ee0ac2af3d46545fbda1.translatedText: 駝背山從亞利桑那州沙漠拔地而起，是太陽谷大部分地區都可見的標誌性地形。這座山因其標誌性的駝峰和類似於斜躺的駱駝頭的山脊而得名。這座山深受城市徒步旅行者的歡迎，在同一地點暴露了該地區發現的一些最古老和一些最年輕的岩石！

69a3b2d18f872f0666d22f17741a15d0a50543cf.sourceText: The large hump is made up of granite, an igneous rock that formed when molten rock cooled and solidified, deep in the then-still relatively new crust of Arizona, about 1.4 billion years ago. For most of its history, this granite remained buried, but about 25 million years ago, it emerged when the South Mountain range, located 10 miles to the south of Camelback, was gradually uplifted by crustal movements. Great blocks of granite slowly slid down the flanks of the rising South Mountain and out into the Valley, forming the hump of Camelback and other local peaks and buttes including the Papago Buttes in Papago Park, Hayden Butte in Tempe, and Red Mountain near Fountain Hills.
69a3b2d18f872f0666d22f17741a15d0a50543cf.translatedText: 這座巨大的駝峰由花崗岩組成，花崗岩是一種火成岩，是熔岩冷卻和凝固時形成的，位於亞利桑那州當時相對較新的地殼深處，大約 14 億年前。在其歷史的大部分時間裡，這塊花崗岩一直被掩埋，但大約 2500 萬年前，當位於駝峰以南 10 英里的南山脈因地殼運動而逐漸隆起時，它就出現了。大塊的花崗岩慢慢地沿著南山的側翼滑落，進入山谷，形成了駝背峰和其他當地的山峰和孤山，包括帕帕戈公園的帕帕戈山、坦佩的海登山和噴泉山附近的紅山。

db4f476bd7d26ccf763214f96d6a5b5f485884d5.sourceText: The sides of these exposed mountain-sized granite blocks would have been very steep and thus prone to frequent landslides; churning flows of different-sized chunks of granite mixed with deep red sand and gravel, which tumbled down and later solidified into layers of red sedimentary rock that lie atop the granite hump on the west side of Camelback Mountain and form the "head." Not surprisingly, geologists have named these red beds the Camels Head Formation! It is easy to see that these red beds are chock-full of pieces of granite broken off the camel's "hump." The fact that these granite pieces (or clasts) are angular and jagged, instead of rounded, indicates that they did not travel far from their source; they were transported by landslides and not a stream. At about 25 million years old, the Camels Head Formation is one of the youngest rock types found in the Valley of the Sun, but it was derived from some of the oldest rock!
db4f476bd7d26ccf763214f96d6a5b5f485884d5.translatedText: 這些裸露的山體大小的花崗岩塊的側面非常陡峭，因此容易發生頻繁的山體滑坡；不同大小的花崗岩塊與深紅色的沙子和礫石混合在一起翻騰，滾落下來，隨後凝固成一層層紅色沉積岩，位於駝背山西側的花崗岩駝峰上，形成“頭”。毫不奇怪，地質學家將這些紅層命名為駱駝頭地層！很容易看出，這些紅色的床鋪滿了從駱駝的「駝峰」上折下來的花崗岩碎片。這些花崗岩塊（或碎屑）是有棱角和鋸齒狀的，而不是圓形的，這一事實表明它們並沒有離開它們的來源很遠；它們是通過山體滑坡而不是溪流輸送的。駱駝頭岩層大約有 2500 萬年的歷史，是太陽谷發現的最年輕的岩石類型之一，但它源自於一些最古老的岩石！

5523b61bf50402ad573d58c7466cdf27103c47c8.sourceText: Hiking trails gain an elevation of 1,280 ft to reach the 2,704-foot high summit. Echo Canyon Recreation Area occupies the head of the mountain and has many hiking trails. Caves on the north side of the mountain signify that it was likely used by Native Americans before European colonization. A warning to hikers, there are rattlesnakes on the mountain.
5523b61bf50402ad573d58c7466cdf27103c47c8.translatedText: 健行步道海拔 1,280 英尺，可到達 2,704 英尺高的山頂。回音峽谷遊樂區佔據山頭，擁有多條健行步道。山北側的洞穴表明，在歐洲殖民之前，美洲原住民很可能使用過這裡。警告徒步旅行者，山上有響尾蛇。

5e65d35fb9c522bf40daf43c56ccb4d26de9de44.sourceText: Hidden in modern suburbia, the historic Guadalupe Cemetery dates to 1904, around the time the first Yaqui Indians settled in the area. These gravesites tell stories through tributes and personal possessions left by loved ones. Many burst with colors, including flowers and other adornments. Burial mounds sit between a few mesquite trees and under brightly painted murals.
5e65d35fb9c522bf40daf43c56ccb4d26de9de44.translatedText: 歷史悠久的瓜達盧佩公墓隱藏在現代郊區，其歷史可追溯至 1904 年，大約在第一批雅基印第安人在該地區定居的時間。這些墓地透過親人留下的貢品和個人物品來講述故事。許多物品都色彩繽紛，包括鮮花和其他裝飾品。墳墓坐落在幾棵豆科樹之間，下面是色彩鮮豔的壁畫。

6cfbc2550e8cfc7701a9d6b64bd8a31ddc0608e4.sourceText: Due to unrest in their ancestral home in Mexico, the Yaqui established a church and graveyard on this site as their first settlement. However, after disputes over water rights, the settlement was moved to what is now the town of Guadalupe, about a mile and a half to the southwest. But the cemetery remained at the original site, and Guadalupe has buried its deceased at this site for over 100 years. Today, Guadalupe is home to more than 5,000 residents, mostly descendants of the Yaqui.
6cfbc2550e8cfc7701a9d6b64bd8a31ddc0608e4.translatedText: 由於墨西哥祖籍發生騷亂，雅基人在此建立了一座教堂和墓地，作為他們的第一個定居點。然而，由於水權糾紛，定居點被轉移到了現在的瓜達盧佩鎮，距離西南約一英里半。但墓園仍保留在原址，瓜達露佩將死者埋葬於此地已有一百多年的歷史。如今，瓜達盧佩居住著 5,000 多名居民，其中大部分是雅基人的後裔。

7837486d1b4ce82ed26a98505a156888c01cbbc9.sourceText: In the early 1980s, the suburban sprawl of metro Phoenix reached this area of Tempe. Replacing farmland, housing developers completely surrounded the cemetery with contemporary ranch homes with lush lawns, creating a strange juxtaposition with the cemetery.
7837486d1b4ce82ed26a98505a156888c01cbbc9.translatedText: 20 世紀 80 年代初，鳳凰城都會區的郊區擴張延伸至坦佩的這一地區。住房開發商取代了農田，用現代化的牧場住宅和鬱鬱蔥蔥的草坪將墓地完全包圍，與墓地形成了一種奇怪的並置。

90c9bef64d8a3f2ef81611af4eb2fdfe028108e1.sourceText: The original church at the cemetery is no longer standing, but the impressive Our Lady of Guadalupe Church is worth a visit. About two miles from the cemetery, the church was built in 1914 and is the centerpiece of the town square.

0546d0d88e16d36a472f1bf2cffe5357e02e897d.translatedText: 願景：在亞利桑那州法律界和整個社區促進和倡導亞裔太平洋裔美國人 (APA) 的正義、公平、平等、包容和機會。使命：亞利桑那州亞裔美國律師協會 (AAABA) 是一個自願成立的律師協會，成員包括律師、法官、法學教授、法學院學生以及對亞利桑那州法律職業感興趣的社區成員。歡迎來到亞利桑那州亞裔美國律師協會律師名錄，其中包含亞利桑那州各地律師的簡介。您可以按實踐領域、熱門城市甚至語言偏好進行搜尋。首先，請使用搜尋框或查看全部。按名稱搜尋 按城市搜尋 按郵遞區號搜尋 按執業領域搜尋
