37442cf66e9b4cac0159379b5638090c303063d2.sourceText: Located in northeastern Phoenix, on the edge of Scottsdale, this unusual attraction highlights a waterfall created in 1883 during the construction of the Arizona Canal. When contractor William J. Murphy and his team came upon a natural 20-foot drop, they decided to incorporate the drop into a new waterfall. Locals started coming to the spot for picnics and recreation, enjoying the cool mist of the waterfall and the area's shady trees.
37442cf66e9b4cac0159379b5638090c303063d2.translatedText: 這個不尋常的景點位於鳳凰城東北部斯科茨代爾邊緣，以 1883 年亞利桑那運河建設期間形成的瀑佈為特色。當承包商 William J. Murphy 和他的團隊發現一個 20 英尺高的天然落差時，他們決定將這個落差合併到一個新的瀑布中。當地人開始來這裡野餐和休閒，享受瀑布的清涼霧氣和該地區成蔭的樹木。

b53c13159158f0186d1925f1d9f5724116ff3eed.sourceText: In 1902, Phoenix's first hydroelectric power plant was built at the site and was then rebuilt and updated in 1911. The power plant encased the falls, and a dance floor was built on the plant's roof. The plant was shut down in 1950 when necessary repairs and maintenance were deemed too expensive for the plant to continue operation.
b53c13159158f0186d1925f1d9f5724116ff3eed.translatedText: 1902 年，鳳凰城的第一座水力發電廠在此建成，並於 1911 年進行了重建和更新。發電廠包圍了瀑布，並在發電廠的屋頂上建造了一個舞池。該工廠於 1950 年關閉，因為必要的維修和維護成本太高，無法繼續運作。

2b9d517e78f13f495cf11255c7b21c47832066f2.sourceText: Over the ensuing years, interest in the site waxed and waned until the city of Phoenix and the water and power utility Salt River Project (SRP) joined forces to create a new hydroelectric plant and public recreational park featuring art installations and educational materials. The current park opened in 2003. Mags Harries, a sculptor, and her husband Lajos Heder, an architect, designed the falls alongside landscape architect Steve Martino.The park features overlooks and a concrete deck where visitors can sit and feel the waterfall's spray. At the park, there's a boulder from each of the dam sites SRP manages, gears from the original powerhouse, and thematic poetry by Alberto Rios, Arizona's first poet laureate, that's been sandblasted into the concrete. Signs throughout the park explain the history of the site, hydroelectric power, and how the white amur fish helps clear the water of weeds and algae.
2b9d517e78f13f495cf11255c7b21c47832066f2.translatedText: 在接下來的幾年裡，人們對該地點的興趣時強時弱，直到鳳凰城和水力發電公用事業公司鹽河計畫 (SRP) 聯手創建了一座新的水力發電廠和公共休閒公園，以藝術裝置和教育材料為特色。現在的公園於 2003 年開放。雕塑家 Mags Harries 和她的建築師丈夫 Lajos Heder 與景觀設計師 Steve Martino 一起設計了瀑布。公園設有觀景台和混凝土平台，遊客可以坐下來感受瀑布的水花。公園裡有一塊來自 SRP 管理的每個水壩站點的巨石、來自原始發電廠的齒輪，以及亞利桑那州第一位桂冠詩人阿爾貝托·裡奧斯 (Alberto Rios) 的主題詩，這些詩已被噴砂到混凝土中。公園各處的標誌介紹了該地點的歷史、水力發電以及白阿穆爾魚如何幫助清除水中的雜草和藻類。

f0b6b9a259477a93b8a2fffcdf44de2e089557c9.sourceText: Arizona Falls shares a parking lot with G.R. Herberger Park. There are also canal-side trails for walking, running, and bike riding near the falls.
f0b6b9a259477a93b8a2fffcdf44de2e089557c9.translatedText: 亞利桑那瀑布與 G.R. 共用一個停車場。赫伯格公園。瀑布附近還有運河邊的小徑，可供步行、跑步和騎自行車。

e5148b40a832c64fdbcbca58b6ab879dac59be26.sourceText: During World War II, 25 German prisoners of war escaped from an American facility during an event known as the Great Papago Escape . The prisoners dug a tunnel from Camp Papago Park to a canal that leads to the Salt River. They built a raft but discovered upon reaching the river that it was nearly devoid of water. They fled to the surrounding desert, some of them making it within miles of the Mexican border. All of them were caught within a month of their escape.
e5148b40a832c64fdbcbca58b6ab879dac59be26.translatedText: 第二次世界大戰期間，25 名德國戰俘在一次被稱為「巴帕戈大逃亡」的事件中從美國設施中逃脫。囚犯們在帕帕戈營地公園挖了一條隧道，通往通往鹽河的運河。他們搭了一個木筏，但到達河邊時發現木筏幾乎沒有水了。他們逃到周圍的沙漠，其中一些逃到了距離墨西哥邊境幾英里的地方。他們都在逃跑後一個月內被逮捕。

0577cc6c298a7f1a8d5e41e1a3a7869d021e7f5f.sourceText: The exit of the tunnel is memorialized today with a marker that's largely ignored by the many bicyclists and joggers who use the path.
0577cc6c298a7f1a8d5e41e1a3a7869d021e7f5f.translatedText: 今天在隧道出口處立了一個標記，但許多使用這條路的騎自行車者和慢跑者基本上忽略了該標記。

4298a9e85288a3185ba38658f83c23475acc58c6.sourceText: There isn't really an address for the unimposing monument in the dirt next to the canal. It is indicated on Google Maps, at this address . Access the canal where Oak Street dead ends then walk two-blocks north along the wide path.
4298a9e85288a3185ba38658f83c23475acc58c6.translatedText: 在運河旁的泥土中，這個不起眼的紀念碑其實沒有地址。它在 Google 地圖上標有此地址。進入橡樹街盡頭的運河，然後沿著寬闊的小路向北走兩個街區。

32989c6abf96d9e94250e331b2b4f3a3b42f1727.sourceText: Tombstone is best remembered for a Wild West culture comprised of notorious gamblers, gunslingers, and outlaw cowboys, but the majority of residents were actually respectable, law-abiding citizens. Founded in 1877 after silver was discovered in the area, Tombstone had up to 10,000 residents at the height of its mining boom in the 1880s. Some historians indicate this number only reflects white males registered to vote and speculate that the population may have been as high as 20,000 if women, children, and ethnic minorities were counted appropriately. By late 1881, Tombstone had several hundred mining claims, over 100 saloons, and numerous gambling halls and brothels. There were also fancy restaurants, banks, a bowling alley, an opera house, three newspapers, and many other businesses needed to keep a town that size running.
32989c6abf96d9e94250e331b2b4f3a3b42f1727.translatedText: 墓碑鎮因狂野的西部文化而聞名，其中包括臭名昭著的賭徒、槍手和不法牛仔，但大多數居民實際上都是受人尊敬、守法的公民。墓碑鎮於 1877 年在該地區發現銀礦後成立，在 1880 年代採礦業繁榮的鼎盛時期，墓碑鎮擁有多達 10,000 名居民。一些歷史學家指出，這個數字僅反映了登記投票的白人男性，並推測，如果適當計算婦女、兒童和少數民族，人口可能高達 20,000 人。到 1881 年底，墓碑鎮已擁有數百處採礦權、100 多家酒吧以及眾多賭場和妓院。還有高檔餐廳、銀行、保齡球館、歌劇院、三份報紙，以及維持一個如此規模的城鎮運作所需的許多其他企業。

d1b055e174911ae0536fe1d8a3123edaf5bd2f50.sourceText: Episcopalians had been meeting in the Mining Exchange Building and decided it was time for a church. Reverend Talbot organized a building project for the new church but left after only a few months and was replaced by 25-year-old Endicott Peabody, who had just completed his first semester at Episcopal Theological School in Cambridge , Massachusetts . After raising $5,000 from the miners, gamblers, sporting women, business owners, and other citizens, the church was completed and the first service was held on June 18, 1882, with services held every Sunday since. It is the oldest Protestant church in Arizona and the only Gothic Revival style church built out of adobe in the world.
d1b055e174911ae0536fe1d8a3123edaf5bd2f50.translatedText: 聖公會教徒在礦業交易所大樓舉行會議，並決定是時候建立一座教堂了。塔爾伯特牧師為新教堂組織了一項建築工程，但僅幾個月後就離開了，並由 25 歲的恩迪科特·皮博迪接替，他剛剛在馬薩諸塞州劍橋聖公會神學院完成了第一學期的學業。在向礦工、賭徒、體育女性、企業主和其他公民籌集了 5,000 美元後，教會竣工，並於 1882 年 6 月 18 日舉行了第一次禮拜，此後每週日都有禮拜。它是亞利桑那州最古老的新教教堂，也是世界上唯一一座用土坯建造的哥德復興風格教堂。

24c556aa11ff0e9f6a8fcbbec3068b5e64ed6a60.sourceText: Listed in the National Register of Historic Places in 1971, many features of the building are original, including the pews and the Belgian stained glass windows. The timber used for the ceiling and roof was hauled in by ox carts from the Chiricahua Mountains. The original light fixtures are said to have come from a sailing vessel, possibly an 1870s whaling ship. There have been renovations over the years, including electrifying the old lights. The bell tower was replaced after being struck by lightning and the building was stuccoed in 1970 to protect the hand-formed adobe brick.
24c556aa11ff0e9f6a8fcbbec3068b5e64ed6a60.translatedText: 該建築於 1971 年被列入國家歷史名勝名錄，其許多特色都是原創的，包括長椅和比利時彩色玻璃窗。用於天花板和屋頂的木材是用牛車從奇里卡瓦山脈運來的。據說最初的燈具來自一艘帆船，可能是一艘 1870 年代的捕鯨船。多年來，這裡一直在進行翻修，包括為舊燈通電。鐘樓被雷擊後被更換，並於 1970 年粉刷了建築，以保護手工製作的土磚。

e096dcadecd23f591bb2cbecc08fc8df9a5b942b.sourceText: Peabody was from one of the wealthiest families in America, and his life both before and after Tombstone was spent among the wealthy. He was homesick while in Tombstone and left after only six months to return to theological school in Massachusetts. He graduated in 1884 and went on to found the Groton School, where he served as headmaster for 56 years. Notable students included Theodore Roosevelt's four sons and future president Franklin D. Roosevelt. One may wonder if perhaps his time spent with the little congregation in Tombstone influenced his ideas and values about the importance of public service and in turn influenced the course of America.
e096dcadecd23f591bb2cbecc08fc8df9a5b942b.translatedText: 皮博迪出身於美國最富有的家庭之一，墓碑鎮前後的生活都是在富人中度過的。他在墓碑鎮期間想家，僅六個月後就離開，回到麻薩諸塞州的神學院。他於 1884 年畢業，隨後創辦了格羅頓學校，並擔任校長 56 年。著名的學生包括西奧多·羅斯福的四個兒子和未來的總統富蘭克林·羅斯福。人們可能會想知道，他與墓碑鎮一小群會眾一起度過的時光是否影響了他關於公共服務重要性的想法和價值觀，進而影響了美國的進程。

b7e371b01e2e42ceeecf656eed3b838ec6d259e6.sourceText: Its hangar and building now abandoned and nearly forgotten in the Kaibab National Forest, the Red Butte Airfield was the Grand Canyon's original airport, and it hosted some notable guests in its time.
b7e371b01e2e42ceeecf656eed3b838ec6d259e6.translatedText: 紅山機場是大峽谷最初的機場，其機庫和建築現在已廢棄，幾乎被遺忘在凱巴布國家森林中，曾接待過一些當時的著名客人。

d5af7a10b5e4d6a85a9bd655f4f02e357136a393.sourceText: Retired army pilot J. Parker Van Zandt and engineer B. Russell Shaw, who had worked with aviation pioneers the Wright Brothers, opened the airfield in 1927 as Scenic Airlines, Inc. Soon after it opened, the stock market crash that sparked the Great Depression forced them to sell the airfield. The new owners renamed the airfield “Grand Canyon Airlines.” Today, the paint on the hangar has faded enough that both of the original names are faintly visible.
d5af7a10b5e4d6a85a9bd655f4f02e357136a393.translatedText: 曾與航空先驅萊特兄弟共事的退役陸軍飛行員 J. Parker Van Zandt 和工程師 B. Russell Shaw 於 1927 年以 Scenic Airlines, Inc. 的名稱開設了該機場。開業後不久，股市崩盤，引發的大蕭條迫使他們出售機場。新所有者將機場重新命名為“大峽谷航空公司”。如今，機庫上的油漆已經褪色，兩個原來的名字都依稀可見。

e8d1c7fdfd5545c3f408cfe5f91b91b223137cfd.sourceText: Over the years, many notable visitors landed at the historic airfield. Charles Lindbergh, famed for his nonstop flight from New York City to Paris, landed at Red Butte in 1928. Comedian Will Rogers flew out of Red Butte, chartering a scenic flight to observe the striking Arizona landscape from the air. Legendary aviatrix Amelia Earhart spent several days at Red Butte having her plane serviced by the airfield's mechanics.
e8d1c7fdfd5545c3f408cfe5f91b91b223137cfd.translatedText: 多年來，許多著名的遊客曾在這座歷史悠久的機場降落。查爾斯林德伯格 (Charles Lindbergh) 因其從紐約市直飛巴黎的航班而聞名，他於 1928 年降落在紅山 (Red Butte)。喜劇演員威爾羅傑斯 (Will Rogers) 從紅山起飛，包租了一架觀光飛機，從空中觀察亞利桑那州令人驚嘆的風景。傳奇飛行員阿米莉亞·埃爾哈特 (Amelia Earhart) 在紅山 (Red Butte) 待了幾天，讓機場的機械師對她的飛機進行維修。

d4c9a867bfc7b746fa168a27ff3a947d85599f68.sourceText: The current Grand Canyon National Park Airport was opened in 1967 in Tusayan, Arizona. Closer to the canyon and more modern, the new airport quickly became favored over the one at Red Butte. Helicopter tours, firefighting vehicles, ambulance flights, and private planes all use the newer airport seven miles south of the canyon rim.
d4c9a867bfc7b746fa168a27ff3a947d85599f68.translatedText: 目前的大峽谷國家公園機場於 1967 年在亞利桑那州圖薩揚投入使用。新機場更靠近峽谷，也更現代化，很快就比紅山機場更受青睞。直升機旅遊、消防車、救護車和私人飛機都使用峽谷邊緣以南七英里的新機場。

ccf4662dd0789a6ba25eb8160f10f9e896353a12.sourceText: Several of the buildings at the Red Butte Airfield burned down in 1994, and a local ranch used the property until 2003. Although it was added to the National Register of Historic Places in 2007, it is largely passed by unnoticed by the Grand Canyon’s thousands of daily visitors.
ccf4662dd0789a6ba25eb8160f10f9e896353a12.translatedText: 紅山機場 (Red Butte Airfield) 的幾棟建築於 1994 年被燒毀，當地的一個牧場一直使用該地產直至 2003 年。雖然它在 2007 年被列入國家歷史名勝名錄，但大峽谷每天成千上萬的遊客基本上都沒有註意到它。

b698a1d69399468ee8870b5b42fda637725e5518.translatedText: 麥克馬斯-皮爾斯太陽望遠鏡

961b0442318528186040cd17f33c7186caf58cc3.sourceText: The Pinal County Board of Supervisors spent a work session this week digging into a question that is becoming more urgent across Arizona: what large data-center campuses will bring to fast-growing desert communities. The county invited representatives from Arizona State University, APS, SRP and the Arizona Commerce Authority to explain how the facilities operate and what kinds of demands they place on utilities and land use.
961b0442318528186040cd17f33c7186caf58cc3.translatedText: 皮納爾縣監事會本週召開了一次工作會議，深入探討了整個亞利桑那州變得越來越緊迫的問題：大型資料中心園區將為快速成長的沙漠社區帶來什麼。該縣邀請了來自亞利桑那州立大學、APS、SRP 和亞利桑那州商務局的代表解釋這些設施的運作方式以及它們對公用事業和土地使用的要求。

39a9b9014abd8650dff210bc66c4a960c6349769.sourceText: Supervisor Rich Vitiello said the point of the session was educational, especially because multiple projects are being discussed in and around Pinal County. One proposal he referenced is on Porter Road south of Maricopa and the Ak-Chin Indian Community. He framed the conversation as an attempt to move beyond vague public fears and give residents and elected officials a better factual basis for judging whether the projects are beneficial.
39a9b9014abd8650dff210bc66c4a960c6349769.translatedText: 主管 Rich Vitiello 表示，會議的重點是教育性​​的，特別是因為皮納爾縣及其周邊地區正在討論多個項目。他提到的一項提案位於馬里科帕以南的波特路和 Ak-Chin 印度社區。他將這次談話描述為試圖超越公眾模糊的恐懼，並為居民和民選官員提供更好的事實基礎來判斷這些項目是否有益。

38427fbbd6ba26d3f654c0d079de8f1cb134f5ec.sourceText: The session also surfaced the public skepticism county leaders are hearing. Supervisor Jeff Serdy said one of the most common questions is essentially whether the region needs more of these developments at all. The presentation did not produce a simple answer, but speakers said the market is expanding rapidly because of artificial intelligence workloads and growing cloud-storage demand, even as operators claim newer facilities are becoming more efficient in their use of water and electricity.
38427fbbd6ba26d3f654c0d079de8f1cb134f5ec.translatedText: 這次會議也浮現了縣領導所聽到的公眾質疑。主管傑夫瑟迪（Jeff Serdy）表示，最常見的問題之一本質上是該地區是否需要更多此類開發。演講並沒有給出一個簡單的答案，但發言者表示，由於人工智慧工作負載和不斷增長的雲端儲存需求，市場正在迅速擴大，儘管營運商聲稱更新的設施在水和電的使用方面變得更加高效。

7420fbf9295e15f598a006d4359b32adbca45738.sourceText: Water was one of the most important themes for Arizona readers. Sarah Porter of ASU’s Kyl Center for Water Policy said available research has not shown data centers causing an increase in unreplenished groundwater use to date, while also cautioning that measuring actual consumption can be complicated. For residents and business owners in Maricopa and the wider Pinal County corridor, the meeting signals that data-center growth is no longer a distant Phoenix issue; it is becoming a local planning question with direct implications for infrastructure, land values and community acceptance.
7420fbf9295e15f598a006d4359b32adbca45738.translatedText: 水是亞利桑那州讀者最重要的主題之一。亞利桑那州立大學凱爾水政策中心的莎拉波特表示，現有的研究尚未顯示資料中心迄今導致未補充地下水使用量的增加，同時她也警告說，衡量實際消耗量可能很複雜。對於馬里科帕和更廣泛的皮納爾縣走廊的居民和企業主來說，這次會議表明數據中心的增長不再是一個遙遠的鳳凰城問題；它正在成為一個地方規劃問題，對基礎設施、土地價值和社區接受度產生直接影響。

78899c00b50a14e6163efc95615137c500ec45f0.sourceText: Water has always been a point of contention in the arid U.S. Southwest. In 1922, an agreement on water allotment between the seven states in the Colorado River Basin was nearly reached. Every state agreed on how to divvy up the water in the river except Arizona , which held out and refused to sign the Colorado River Compact.
78899c00b50a14e6163efc95615137c500ec45f0.translatedText: 在乾旱的美國西南部，水一直是爭論的焦點。 1922年，科羅拉多河流域七個州之間幾乎就水資源分配達成協議。每個州都就如何分配河流中的水達成了一致，但亞利桑那州除外，該州堅持並拒絕簽署《科羅拉多河契約》。

09d442946284b1371c2da3aaf52932ce0bf7a351.sourceText: Tensions came to a head around a decade later, in 1934, when construction began on the Parker Dam across the Colorado River. The western bank of the river was in California and the eastern bank in Arizona, and the purpose of the dam was to provide water to the growing population of Los Angeles . But Arizona was still unhappy with how negotiations ended on the water allotment of the Colorado River, and Governor Benjamin Baker Moeur decided that a dam partially constructed in Arizona to divert water to California was a bridge too far.
09d442946284b1371c2da3aaf52932ce0bf7a351.translatedText: 大約十年後，即 1934 年，科羅拉多河上的帕克大壩開始建設時，緊張局勢達到了頂峰。河流的西岸在加州，東岸在亞利桑那州，大壩的目的是為洛杉磯不斷增長的人口提供水源。但亞利桑那州仍對科羅拉多河水分配談判的結果感到不滿，州長本傑明·貝克·莫爾 (Benjamin Baker Moeur) 認為，在亞利桑那州部分建造的一座將水引至加州的水壩太過分了。

7f01d1c029c04f30d3346578a818c02ddd729c80.sourceText: Governor Moeur dispatched six soldiers of the Arizona National Guard to the site, who confirmed that construction was indeed taking place on the Arizona side of the river. Arizona's Attorney General advised the governor that the dam could not be constructed on Arizona's soil without their consent, and at that, Moeur declared martial law and called for a much larger contingent of National Guard troops to be sent to the dam site to stop the construction.
7f01d1c029c04f30d3346578a818c02ddd729c80.translatedText: 莫爾州長派遣了六名亞利桑那州國民警衛隊士兵前往現場，他們證實，亞利桑那州一側確實正在施工。亞利桑那州總檢察長告知州長，未經州長同意，不得在亞利桑那州的土地上建造大壩，莫爾隨即宣布戒嚴，並呼籲派遣更多的國民警衛隊前往大壩工地阻止修建。

49283acd204d9476ff93a40b92c1243aa7137dcb.sourceText: One hundred National Guard soldiers, armed with rifles and machine guns, were loaded into wooden ferry boats and sent up the Colorado River to Parker Dam. Newspapers mockingly called the dispatched soldiers the "Arizona Navy," but this name was embraced by Governor Moeur and the owner of the ferry boats, Nellie T. Bush, was officially decreed to be the fleet's admiral.
49283acd204d9476ff93a40b92c1243aa7137dcb.translatedText: 一百名配備步槍和機關槍的國民警衛隊士兵被裝上木渡船，沿著科羅拉多河送往帕克水壩。報紙嘲笑派遣的士兵為“亞利桑那海軍”，但這個名字得到了莫爾州長的認可，渡船的船主內莉·T·布希被正式任命為艦隊海軍上將。

b2092c6f1bbbdf072f0b7c5958665db503a122ca.sourceText: Upon reaching the construction site, the ferry boats got entangled in cables around the dam and had to be freed by Californian workers. Despite this ignominious start, the deployment of the Arizona Navy was successful. The troops occupied the construction site on Arizona's side of the river while Californian and federal officials scrambled to figure out what to do.
b2092c6f1bbbdf072f0b7c5958665db503a122ca.translatedText: 到達施工現場後，渡船被大壩周圍的電纜纏住，不得不由加州工人將其解救。儘管開局不光彩，亞利桑那海軍的部署還是成功的。軍隊佔領了亞利桑那州河邊的建築工地，而加州和聯邦官員則忙著想辦法該怎麼辦。

944048179b48acd19049f5ae7feee4690d7764f5.sourceText: At this point, U.S. Secretary of the Interior Harold Ickes was furious with Governor Moeur, but declared a stop to the construction nonetheless. The Department of the Interior sued Arizona and the case quickly went up to the U.S. Supreme Court. To the astonishment of the federal government and the state of California, the Supreme Court sided with Arizona, stating that the dam had not been specifically authorized by Congress and that California could not build the dam on Arizonan soil without their permission.
944048179b48acd19049f5ae7feee4690d7764f5.translatedText: 此時，美國內政部長哈羅德·伊克斯對莫爾州長感到憤怒，但仍宣布停止施工。內政部起訴亞利桑那州，案件很快就提交到美國最高法院。令聯邦政府和加州驚訝的是，最高法院站在亞利桑那州一邊，稱該大壩並未得到國會的特別授權，未經他們的許可，加州不得在亞利桑那州的土地上建造大壩。

493e239cdedb973098967c65d32fcc50739198e4.sourceText: When Mary Coyle moved to Phoenix from Ohio in 1951, she brought a knack for making ice cream with her from the midwest. Her namesake parlor, Mary Coyle Ol' Fashion Ice Cream, continues to survive and thrive in a smaller, nearby location, 72 years later. At 16% butterfat, the ice cream itself is ultra-rich and is still made on-site to this day using the original recipes that first made Mary a success.
493e239cdedb973098967c65d32fcc50739198e4.translatedText: 1951 年，當瑪麗·科伊爾 (Mary Coyle) 從中西部搬到菲尼克斯時，她帶來了製作冰淇淋的訣竅。 72 年後，她的同名店 Mary Coyle Ol' Fashion Ice Cream 在附近一個較小的地點繼續生存並蓬勃發展。這款冰淇淋本身含有 16% 的乳脂，味道極其濃鬱，至今仍採用最初讓瑪麗成功的原始配方在現場製作。

0f1e3334f60c4eebe81938bb3177e67661d464e7.sourceText: Not only are the options premium, but they're also expansive. The variety of flavors—an unexpected feature for a classic ice cream parlor—is a thrill in and of itself. Choose from a wide range of popular and nostalgic flavors, from black raspberry to black licorice, spumoni to burgundy cherry. Carefully sourced ingredients, such as the nuts in the butter pecan and maple walnut flavors sourced from Mount Hope, in Sedona, make each scoop shine.
0f1e3334f60c4eebe81938bb3177e67661d464e7.translatedText: 不僅選擇優質，而且種類繁多。口味的多樣性——對於經典冰淇淋店來說是一個意想不到的特點——本身就令人興奮。有多種流行和懷舊口味可供選擇，從黑覆盆子到黑甘草，從 spumoni 到勃艮第櫻桃。精心購買的食材，例如來自塞多納希望山的黃油山核桃和楓木核桃口味的堅果，讓每一勺都閃閃發光。

75b20eeb88131af430a42c917fccdc781e445b61.sourceText: The new location's checkerboard floors, neon soda fountain sign, and pink-striped walls (which harken back to the original location) let you know you're in for a deliciously sweet time travel session.
75b20eeb88131af430a42c917fccdc781e445b61.translatedText: 新地點的棋盤地板、霓虹汽水噴泉標誌和粉紅色條紋牆（讓人想起原來的地點）讓你知道你正在經歷一場美味甜蜜的時光旅行。

d4918d787b5c6ab7370b9188f2750085b4e7907e.sourceText: While the ice cream doesn't need any additions, it's hard to go wrong with the maraschino-crowned milkshakes or the over-the-top sundaes.
d4918d787b5c6ab7370b9188f2750085b4e7907e.translatedText: 冰淇淋不需要任何添加，搭配黑櫻桃酒冠奶昔或過度的聖代是很難出錯的。

519985b4a37df159054d22a7ccf46a339c79d822.sourceText: Scottsdale says the city’s dedicated Parks & Preserve sales tax is now showing results on the ground just nine months after voters approved Proposition 490. The measure, a 0.15% sales tax that began on July 1, 2025, is restricted to improving, maintaining and protecting city parks and the McDowell Sonoran Preserve.
519985b4a37df159054d22a7ccf46a339c79d822.translatedText: 斯科茨代爾表示，在選民批准 490 號提案僅 9 個月後，該市專門的公園和保護區銷售稅現已初見成效。該措施於 2025 年 7 月 1 日開始徵收 0.15% 的銷售稅，僅限於改善、維護和保護城市公園和麥克道爾索諾蘭保護區。

0870372fb9fc8c4636c4b413c120639de2765e8e.sourceText: According to the city, the first round of work has included more than 240,000 square feet of new sod, more than 700 flats of plants and 93 newly planted trees. Officials also said crews have completed more than $150,000 in storm-damage repairs, with notable work along the Indian Bend Wash corridor and other public spaces that are heavily used by residents.
0870372fb9fc8c4636c4b413c120639de2765e8e.translatedText: 據該市稱，第一輪工作包括超過240,000平方英尺的新草皮、700多套植物和93棵新種植的樹木。官員們還表示，工作人員已完成了超過 15 萬美元的風暴破壞修復工作，其中印第安彎道洗滌走廊沿線和其他居民頻繁使用的公共空間的工作尤為引人注目。

ee33b9e47cc790405ca91137ef30a96017a284ba.sourceText: For Scottsdale residents, the city is framing the update as an early accountability check on how the new tax is being used. The message is that voters are not waiting years to see the impact: the city says the money is already being translated into cleaner landscapes, repaired facilities, safer recreation areas and better upkeep in one of Scottsdale’s signature outdoor assets.
ee33b9e47cc790405ca91137ef30a96017a284ba.translatedText: 對於斯科茨代爾居民來說，該市正在將這項更新視為對新稅收使用情況的早期問責檢查。傳達的訊息是，選民不會等待數年才能看到其影響：該市表示，這筆錢已經轉化為更清潔的景觀、修復的設施、更安全的休閒區以及斯科茨代爾標誌性戶外資產之一的更好維護。

415f08eac586a1af9997022c8d00f7d0574ed104.sourceText: An Lac is listed within Mekong Plaza in Mesa. This profile was generated from plaza directory sources and map-based verification, so direct business contact details may still be incomplete.
415f08eac586a1af9997022c8d00f7d0574ed104.translatedText: 安拉克 (An Lac) 位于梅萨 (Mesa) 的湄公河广场 (Mekong Plaza) 内。此設定檔是根據廣場目錄來源和基於地圖的驗證產生的，因此直接業務聯絡詳細資訊可能仍然不完整。

We are located one mile east of Price Freeway inside the AZ International Marketplace. Order Online for carryout today!

90e9828d1ea2fde723c5835ce7dafb0099a210cb.sourceText: Accessible only by hiking in and marked only by a kiosk with a map below the cave, Peppersauce Cave feels very different from better-known cave systems that feature guided tours, parking lots, and paths with handrails. A thirteen-month project by volunteers in 2017-2018 removed all of the graffiti in the cave. Efforts are ongoing to keep the cave clean.
90e9828d1ea2fde723c5835ce7dafb0099a210cb.translatedText: 辣椒醬洞穴只能通過徒步進入，並且只能通過洞穴下方帶有地圖的亭子進行標記，辣椒醬洞穴給人的感覺與以導遊、停車場和帶扶手的小路為特色的更知名的洞穴系統非常不同。 2017年至2018年，志工們進行了為期13個月的項目，清除了洞穴中的所有塗鴉。我們正在努力保持洞穴清潔。

c6a1472f83e132e4b3d5d39a166d1dd123417590.sourceText: The cave is located in the Coronado National Forest north of Tucson, Arizona. A 1948 article in The Desert Magazine brought the site, which was reportedly discovered by deer hunters, to the attention of the wider public. You can still see wonders described in the article, including an underground lake, which is the main draw for many visitors, though one should avoid swimming due to E. Coli and coliform being present in the water, and a rock "slide." Ropes and ladders are set up inside to help those exploring get around without needing professional equipment.
c6a1472f83e132e4b3d5d39a166d1dd123417590.translatedText: 該洞穴位於亞利桑那州圖森以北的科羅納多國家森林。 1948 年，《沙漠雜誌》上的一篇文章讓這個據報道是由獵鹿人發現的地點引起了廣大公眾的關注。您仍然可以看到文章中描述的奇觀，包括一個地下湖，它是吸引許多遊客的主要景點，但由於水中存在大腸桿菌和大腸桿菌，人們應該避免游泳，以及岩石「滑梯」。裡面設置了繩索和梯子，幫助那些探索者無需專業設備即可四處走動。

718d192b1ab40f7763c70b2bcc443c90bfd5a0ba.sourceText: If you visit, prepare to get dirty and explore an environment that can get very hot and humid. The entrance to the cave is just past the map posted on the trail and, while small, opens up to a large room. Pens and a notebook have been placed in the Big Room so you can make a record of your visit while preserving this amazing cave experience.
718d192b1ab40f7763c70b2bcc443c90bfd5a0ba.translatedText: 如果您訪問，請準備好弄髒並探索可能變得非常炎熱和潮濕的環境。洞穴的入口就在小路上張貼的地圖旁邊，雖然很小，但通往一個大房間。大房間裡放置了筆和筆記本，以便您記錄您的訪問，同時保留這個令人驚嘆的洞穴體驗。

1cd5810b661a3ecc01fb2ec0f8339d0d0a7662a9.sourceText: Please respect this natural landmark. Take trash with you and please do not place graffiti in or around the cave.
1cd5810b661a3ecc01fb2ec0f8339d0d0a7662a9.translatedText: 請尊重這個自然地標。隨身攜帶垃圾，請勿在洞穴內或周圍塗鴉。

142b8b850f46502bfa48a1643550be02c4a39fec.sourceText: The "Father of Arizona" tried to build a Zoroastrian fire temple on the hill where he's now buried.
142b8b850f46502bfa48a1643550be02c4a39fec.translatedText: 「亞利桑那之父」試圖在他現在埋葬的山上建造一座瑣羅亞斯德教火神廟。

72c6dfee7fd061f8f1328367a9eb3311f5901982.sourceText: Charles Debrille Poston, once known as the Father of Arizona , is a nearly forgotten historical figure today. Regarded as both an esteemed statesman and a wild eccentric in his time, he is now buried in a pyramid tomb atop a hill outside the town of Florence.
72c6dfee7fd061f8f1328367a9eb3311f5901982.translatedText: 查爾斯·德布里爾·波斯頓（Charles Debrille Poston）曾經被稱為亞利桑那州之父，如今幾乎被遺忘的歷史人物。在他那個時代，他既被視為一位受人尊敬的政治家，又是一位狂野的怪人，現在被埋葬在佛羅倫薩鎮外山頂上的一座金字塔墓中。

3d2b645cd075ad36b761cf70f02757c49cb8eb00.sourceText: Poston was born in Kentucky on April 20, 1825. By the time he was 12, he became an orphan. At 19, he moved to Nashville, Tennessee , where he worked as a clerk for the Tennessee Supreme Court. After hearing of the discovery of gold in California, he moved to San Francisco . There he heard about the pending Gadsden Purchase, the United States' purchase of nearly 30,000 square miles in what is today southern Arizona and New Mexico, and raced to be among the first Americans to stake a claim there.
3d2b645cd075ad36b761cf70f02757c49cb8eb00.translatedText: 波斯頓 1825 年 4 月 20 日生於肯塔基州。 12 歲時，他成為孤兒。 19 歲時，他搬到田納西州納什維爾，在那裡擔任田納西州最高法院的書記官。在聽說加州發現金礦後，他搬到了舊金山。在那裡，他聽說了懸而未決的加茲登購買計劃，即美國購買了今天亞利桑那州南部和新墨西哥州近 30,000 平方英里的土地，並競相成為第一批在那裡提出主權要求的美國人之一。

3c3289822682eb9ea2ba50862ec78485952b36e1.sourceText: Taking a boat from San Francisco to the Mexican city of Guaymas, he was shipwrecked and briefly arrested by Mexican officials who worried that he was a scout for a potential American invasion. Upon his release, he made his way north and surveyed potential locations to set up mining claims. After a few years of enticing investors, he returned to Arizona with $2 million and established the Sonora Exploring and Mining Company in 1856.
3c3289822682eb9ea2ba50862ec78485952b36e1.translatedText: 從舊金山乘船前往墨西哥城市瓜伊馬斯時，他遭遇海難，並被墨西哥官員短暫逮捕，墨西哥官員擔心他是美國潛在入侵的偵察員。獲釋後，他向北走去，勘察了潛在的採礦地點。經過幾年的吸引投資者的努力，他帶著 200 萬美元回到亞利桑那州，並於 1856 年成立了索諾拉勘探和採礦公司。

a4c854227b3b17b072ca94b6a843d6374bfc4ee9.sourceText: He began calling himself “Colonel” Poston and ruled his mines as a business, political, and religious leader. He printed his own money and presided over marriages, divorces, and baptisms among the families of his workers. When the Catholic Church heard about this, they sent someone to investigate and a scandal was avoided when Poston agreed to make a $700 donation to the Church and his ceremonies were retroactively made legitimate. Soon his mines were among the most successful in the territory and he became one of the wealthiest men in the area.
a4c854227b3b17b072ca94b6a843d6374bfc4ee9.translatedText: 他開始自稱波斯頓“上校”，並以商業、政治和宗教領袖的身份統治他的礦場。他自己印錢，主持工人家庭的結婚、離婚和洗禮。天主教會聽說此事後，派人前去調查，波斯頓同意向教會捐款700美元，他的儀式也追溯合法化，避免了一場醜聞。很快，他的礦場成為該地區最成功的礦場之一，他也成為該地區最富有的人之一。

832ea56a8daa993eaa26819e0d64c6d58cf771f5.sourceText: When the American Civil War broke out in 1861, Charles Poston was an outspoken supporter of the Union and President Lincoln. It was during this time that he traveled to Washington, D.C., and began advocating on behalf of Arizonans. At this time, Arizona was still part of the New Mexico territory and Poston soon became one of the key figures in convincing Congress and President Lincoln to split the western side of the territory into a separate entity. Afterward, Poston became Arizona's first representative in Congress, although he lost reelection a few years later.
832ea56a8daa993eaa26819e0d64c6d58cf771f5.translatedText: 1861 年美國內戰爆發時，查爾斯·波斯頓 (Charles Poston) 是聯邦和林肯總統的直言不諱的支持者。正是在這段時間，他前往華盛頓特區，並開始代表亞利桑那州人進行宣傳。此時，亞利桑那州仍然是新墨西哥領土的一部分，波斯頓很快就成為說服國會和林肯總統將該領土的西部劃分為單獨實體的關鍵人物之一。隨後，波斯頓成為亞利桑那州第一位國會代表，儘管幾年後他再次被選中。

b63e05fe3e72e153f5fce93e7e3dc1f3f956b3c1.sourceText: After his electoral defeat, he traveled widely. The United States government occasionally recruited him for various diplomatic missions, including to China, India, and the Middle East. It was during this period that he became enraptured by Zoroastrianism. He wrote several books on the subject and may have even converted to the ancient Iranian religion.
b63e05fe3e72e153f5fce93e7e3dc1f3f956b3c1.translatedText: 選舉失敗後，他廣泛旅行。美國政府偶爾會招募他執行各種外交任務，包括前往中國、印度和中東。正是在這段時期，他迷上了瑣羅亞斯德教。他寫了幾本關於這個主題的書，甚至可能已經皈依了古老的伊朗宗教。

b062b6029de42d4af0e0f5d02fd3f1cc51d6ea6a.sourceText: This phone booth is from where Travis Walton called for help and was rescued after his alleged alien abduction experience on November 5, 1975. Walton wrote about his experience in a 1978 book titled Fire in the Sky, which was later made into a movie .
b062b6029de42d4af0e0f5d02fd3f1cc51d6ea6a.translatedText: 這個電話亭是 Travis Walton 在 1975 年 11 月 5 日所謂的外星人綁架經歷後打電話求救並獲救的地方。沃爾頓在 1978 年出版的一本名為《天空之火》的書中講述了他的經歷，該書後來被拍成電影。

815c6ac10fbfc97b948616273e867e44c324c5a4.sourceText: “I never liked it or the attention, but along with the burden comes a certain amount of responsibility,” Walter would later tell journalists. “Lots of people are afraid to speak about what happened to them. This helps them to be vindicated.”
815c6ac10fbfc97b948616273e867e44c324c5a4.translatedText: 「我從來不喜歡它或關注，但伴隨著負擔而來的是一定的責任，」沃特後來告訴記者。 「很多人不敢談論發生在他們身上的事情。這有助於他們得到平反。」

e7a2e17cf12dfece888e4537853fb3cb2a2d6cb2.sourceText: Because of the incident, this phone booth has become a local tourist attraction. A wooden carving of an alien and a UFO-themed mural commemorate what has become one of the most widely publicized accounts of alien abduction in American history.
e7a2e17cf12dfece888e4537853fb3cb2a2d6cb2.translatedText: 因為這起事件，這個電話亭已經成為當地的一個旅遊景點。外星人的木雕和不明飛行物主題的壁畫紀念了美國歷史上最廣為人知的外星人綁架事件之一。

17fe359d369f10414299489bfb2aa78bbc93a5fa.sourceText: Tony DeMarco was inducted into the International Boxing Hall of Fame in Canastota, New York, in 2019. The honor came after a storied 71-fight career that captured the hearts of boxing fans around the world. The former World Welterweight Champion, who fought professionally from 1948 to 1962, was born Leonardo Liotta to Sicilian immigrant parents on January 14, 1932. He grew up in the North End neighborhood of Boston.
17fe359d369f10414299489bfb2aa78bbc93a5fa.translatedText: 托尼·德馬科於 2019 年入選紐約卡納斯托塔國際拳擊名人堂。在獲得這項榮譽之前，他有著傳奇的 71 場比賽生涯，俘獲了世界各地拳擊迷的心。這位前世界次中量級冠軍曾於 1948 年至 1962 年參加職業拳擊比賽，他的父母是西西里移民，出生於 1932 年 1 月 14 日，原名萊昂納多·利奧塔 (Leonardo Liotta)。他在波士頓北端社區長大。

7c2662e900a57470bb829ce91dce2e3b22ed224c.sourceText: Liotta turned professional as a boxer in 1948, at the age of 16, which was under the minimum age of 18 required by the state of Massachusetts. To circumvent the law, he used the birth certificate of a friend, Tony DeMarco, thus establishing a boxing alias he would use throughout his career.
7c2662e900a57470bb829ce91dce2e3b22ed224c.translatedText: 利奧塔於 1948 年成為職業拳擊手，當時年僅 16 歲，低於馬薩諸塞州規定的 18 歲最低年齡。為了規避法律，他使用了朋友托尼·德馬科的出生證明，從而建立了他在整個職業生涯中使用的拳擊別名。

4e046407e799b5389100db09983c68b0393563dd.sourceText: Over the course of his long career, DeMarco, known as the Boston Bomber, fought several top contenders and champions. The high point of his career came on April 1, 1955, when he defeated Johnny Saxton by technical knockout in the 14th round of a scheduled 15-round fight for the World Welterweight Title. He held this title until later that year when, on June 10, fellow future hall of famer Carmen Basilio, defeated him. The Boston Bomber retired from boxing in 1962 with an impressive record of 58 wins, 12 losses, and one draw, with 33 knockouts.
4e046407e799b5389100db09983c68b0393563dd.translatedText: 在他漫長的職業生涯中，被稱為波士頓轟炸機的德馬科曾與幾位頂級競爭者和冠軍進行過戰鬥。 1955 年 4 月 1 日，他的職業生涯達到頂峰，當時他在世界次中量級冠軍爭奪戰的 15 回合比賽中，在第 14 回合中通過技術擊倒擊敗了約翰尼·薩克斯頓 (Johnny Saxton)。他一直保持著這一頭銜，直到同年晚些時候，6 月 10 日，未來的名人堂成員 Carmen Basilio 擊敗了他。 1962年，波士頓轟炸機隊以58勝12負1平、33次擊倒對手的驕人戰績從拳擊界退休。

817d27945484e47c5b6dbe88bf1192f48064c3c3.sourceText: In hopes that the dry desert air would help to relieve his son Vincent's asthma, DeMarco moved to Phoenix in 1963. In 1968, he opened Tony DeMarco's Living Room at 4007 E. Camelback Road in Phoenix. The piano bar and lounge—“Where Good People Meet"—became a popular hangout for transplanted Bostonians and locals alike. Tony DeMarco's Living Room, which featured nightly live music was adorned with pictures of DeMarco's biggest fights, photos of him with various celebrities, and his championship belt. In 1975, tragedy struck, when DeMarco's 14-year-old son was hit by a car and killed. Around the same time, business was down due to nearby development and road construction that made it difficult for patrons to get to the lounge. DeMarco and his family decided to sell the business and return to Boston in 1982.
817d27945484e47c5b6dbe88bf1192f48064c3c3.translatedText: 為了緩解兒子文森特的氣喘病，德馬科於 1963 年搬到了鳳凰城。 1968 年，他在鳳凰城東駝峰路 4007 號開設了托尼德馬科客廳。鋼琴酒吧和休息室——“好人相聚的地方”——成為移居波士頓人和當地人的熱門聚會場所。托尼·德馬科的客廳每晚都有現場音樂表演，裝飾著德馬科最大規模的比賽的照片、他與各種名人的照片以及他的冠軍腰帶。 1975年，悲劇發生了，德馬科14歲的兒子被車撞死。大約在同一時間，由於附近的開發和道路建設導致顧客難以到達休息室，生意下滑。 1982 年，德馬科和他的家人決定出售公司並返回波士頓。

5e9c0202bb9d73b5fd30fd5c7f00922d6940461c.sourceText: The building that housed Tony DeMarco's Living Room is now owned by a U-Haul business. Despite the change, DeMarco is still present, in a large mural and commemorative plaque, which were placed on the west-facing wall by the current owner. DeMarco is also honored in his hometown of Boston with a street named after him, Tony DeMarco Way, and a statue.
5e9c0202bb9d73b5fd30fd5c7f00922d6940461c.translatedText: 托尼·德馬科起居室所在的建築現在歸 U-Haul 企業所有。儘管發生了變化，德馬科仍然存在，出現在現任所有者將其放置在西面牆上的大型壁畫和紀念牌匾上。德馬科在他的家鄉波士頓也獲得了榮譽，有一條以他命名的街道托尼·德馬科路和一座雕像。

6f8b6e3d8d551efa2bdd92d351e0534a2f1a4753.sourceText: This old Baldwin locomotive once served the local lumber industry, hauling huge tree trunks from the forest to the mills.
6f8b6e3d8d551efa2bdd92d351e0534a2f1a4753.translatedText: 這輛古老的鮑德溫機車曾經為當地的木材工業服務，將巨大的樹幹從森林拖運到工廠。

f6cc57ffb814be248a7fda5f5eaa7b9078caeb20.sourceText: Constructed in Pennsylvania in 1911, the train came to Arizona in 1917 when it was purchased by the Arizona Lumber and Timber Company. It passed through various owners until it reached The Stone Forest Company, which folded in 1993.
f6cc57ffb814be248a7fda5f5eaa7b9078caeb20.translatedText: 這列火車於 1911 年在賓夕法尼亞州建造，並於 1917 年被亞利桑那木材公司購買後來到亞利桑那州。它歷經了幾位所有者，直到 1993 年倒閉的石林公司 (The Stone Forest Company) 手中。

848c9b01ed53d797357dd865a0a4647eb2c94626.sourceText: A group of residents, led by Malcomb Mackay, maintained fond memories of the locomotive and raised funds to purchase and restore the relic. It now stands restored next to the Flagstaff AMTRAK station. The locomotive is also attached to a log flatcar. In 1995, the City of Flagstaff purchased Old Two Spot and dedicated it as a monument in 1999.
848c9b01ed53d797357dd865a0a4647eb2c94626.translatedText: 以馬爾科姆·麥凱 (Malcomb Mackay) 為首的一群居民保留了對機車的美好回憶，並籌集資金購買和修復這件文物。現在它已修復，位於弗拉格斯塔夫 AMTRAK 車站旁。該機車也連接到原木平車上。 1995 年，弗拉格斯塔夫市購買了 Old Two Spot，並於 1999 年將其作為紀念碑。

d65bc8efd48322400e26f4dfbfd182f0bca82fb1.sourceText: The name of the train has an unusual origin. The train crew once hung water bags from the cab windows, which wore down the numbers on the side of the train. According to stories, the number 25 on the train became a two, with a worn spot where the five was embossed, hence the name Old Two Spot.
d65bc8efd48322400e26f4dfbfd182f0bca82fb1.translatedText: 火車的名稱有一個不尋常的起源。列車工作人員曾經在駕駛室窗戶上懸掛水袋，這會磨損列車側面的數字。根據傳說，火車上的數字“25”變成了“2”，有一個磨損的地方，上面刻著“5”，因此得名“Old Two Spot”。

ec54043e99a0d9b905d87ea0890fc755d450ac4b.sourceText: The classic children's rhyme, "London Bridge is Falling Down," was once all too true. After standing for over a century over the river Thames, the London Bridge that now stands in Lake Havasu, Arizona had begun to sink into the water before it was purchased by the American city.
ec54043e99a0d9b905d87ea0890fc755d450ac4b.translatedText: 經典童謠「倫敦橋正在倒塌」曾經是千真萬確的。在泰晤士河上矗立了一個多世紀之後，現在矗立在亞利桑那州哈瓦蘇湖的倫敦橋在被美國城市購買之前就已經開始沉入水中。

c58210c7ef9b7e1f9feb5b629f5869a702382168.sourceText: By 1967, the old London Bridge, constructed out of reinforced stone masonry, had begun to deteriorate under the stresses of heavy modern traffic. Rather than just demolish the 1830s relic, the city of London decided that they would sell the span to the highest bidder.
c58210c7ef9b7e1f9feb5b629f5869a702382168.translatedText: 到 1967 年，這座由鋼筋石砌成的舊倫敦橋在現代交通繁忙的壓力下已經開始老化。倫敦市決定將這座跨度出售給最高出價者，而不是僅僅拆除 1830 年代的遺跡。

ea90fef0a398e7e0548cf39bfca38bc8e1615f1a.sourceText: The founder of Lake Havasu City, Robert P. McCullough, caught wind of the sale and saw a great opportunity to put his new community on the map. After bidding over two million dollars for the century-old bridge, it was his. Now he just had to move the whole thing across the globe.
ea90fef0a398e7e0548cf39bfca38bc8e1615f1a.translatedText: 哈瓦蘇湖城的創始人羅伯特·P·麥卡洛 (Robert P. McCullough) 聽到了出售的風聲，並看到了讓他的新社區名聲大噪的絕佳機會。在花了超過兩百萬美元買下這座百年老橋後，它就是他的了。現在他只需要把整個東西搬到全球各地。

a972b72a0cb6cfbd8c8ffd2fca7a101f5c81c5e9.sourceText: The old London Bridge was carefully dismantled, and each of the stones was numbered. Once it was broken down to its pieces, they were shipped to California through the Panama Canal, and then driven down to Arizona. The bridge was then just as carefully put back together again, and Arizona's own London Bridge was opened in 1971.
a972b72a0cb6cfbd8c8ffd2fca7a101f5c81c5e9.translatedText: 舊倫敦橋被小心翼翼地拆除，每塊石頭都被編號。一旦它被分解成碎片，它們就會通過巴拿馬運河運送到加利福尼亞州，然後運往亞利桑那州。隨後這座橋又被小心翼翼地重新組裝起來，亞利桑那州自己的倫敦橋於 1971 年啟用。

42c4e294d2446a218521077a54d503f47183faee.sourceText: Today the immigrant bridge has settled in as part of the Arizona landscape, but it still bears some of the scars of its previous life, such as strafing marks left during World War II.
42c4e294d2446a218521077a54d503f47183faee.translatedText: 如今，這座移民橋已成為亞利桑那州景觀的一部分，但它仍然帶有一些前世的傷痕，例如二戰期間留下的掃射痕跡。

fbd87bc2875b32113afd9279a048ef85a74c3337.sourceText: Traveling across Arizona, one is bound to encounter kachina dolls as souvenirs in gift shops. These figures made from cottonwood roots, however, are not playthings but rather representations of Indigenous Puebloan spirits known as katsinam (singular: katsina ). They are in charge of elements of nature and connect the world of humans with that of spirits. The figures instructed young Puebloans about this central part of their religion.
fbd87bc2875b32113afd9279a048ef85a74c3337.translatedText: 穿越亞利桑那州時，人們一定會在禮品店遇到作為紀念品的卡奇納娃娃。然而，這些由三葉楊根製成的雕像並不是玩具，而是被稱為 katsinam（單數： katsina ）的土著普韋布洛精神的代表。他們掌管自然元素，將人類世界與精神世界連結起來。這些人物向年輕的普韋布洛人講述了他們宗教的核心部分。

d146eb58b2dfcd081d5ceb693e598b33f76542b9.sourceText: As the United States subjugated Native Americans and disrupted their ways of life, many Puebloans turned to tourism to make a living. This included creating Kachina dolls to sell to tourists. Many non-Native Americans were inspired by those artworks and began erecting giant versions of the dolls. In the tradition of small American towns creating "world's largest" novelty sculptures, this statue stands 39 feet tall and weighs 14.5 tons, towering above an otherwise nondescript residential subdivision at the edge of Tonto National Forest .
d146eb58b2dfcd081d5ceb693e598b33f76542b9.translatedText: 隨著美國征服美洲原住民並擾亂他們的生活方式，許多普韋布洛人轉向旅遊業謀生。這包括製作卡奇納娃娃出售給遊客。許多非美洲原住民受到這些藝術品的啟發，開始建造這些娃娃的巨型版本。按照美國小鎮創作「世界上最大」新奇雕塑的傳統，這座雕像高 39 英尺，重達 14.5 噸，高聳於通托國家森林邊緣一處不起眼的住宅小區上方。

196c8a465f3981e0cc25fde706b716541ef0fdce.sourceText: The massive kachina was constructed around 1970 by Carl Ludlow from nine pieces of concrete and steel manufactured in Phoenix and assembled here. It was designed by Raymond Phillips Sanderson, whose work is found throughout Arizona and includes a number of New Deal commissions. The katsina specifically depicted here is the Corn Maiden Dancer, who is involved in the grinding of corn, a staple crop among the Puebloans.
196c8a465f3981e0cc25fde706b716541ef0fdce.translatedText: 這座巨大的卡奇納雕像於 1970 年左右由卡爾·勒德洛 (Carl Ludlow) 用九塊在菲尼克斯製造的混凝土和鋼材建造而成，並在這裡組裝。它是由雷蒙德·菲利普斯·桑德森 (Raymond Phillips Sanderson) 設計的，他的作品遍布亞利桑那州各地，其中包括許多新政委員會的作品。這裡特別描繪的卡齊娜是玉米少女舞者，她參與研磨玉米，這是普韋布洛人的主要作物。

a84975052fc4b2969ae953d1d58aa95a4e56bb5f.sourceText: The statue is the property of the Tonto Hills Volunteer Fire Department, which takes donations to fund its maintenance and fire fighting.
a84975052fc4b2969ae953d1d58aa95a4e56bb5f.translatedText: 這座雕像是通託山志願消防局的財產，該部門接受捐款來資助其維護和消防。

fc2d54628b4f235e0559c06abb1f135446490164.sourceText: Arizona’s largest electric utility is changing its heat-season policy after settling a lawsuit brought by the state. Under the agreement announced by Attorney General Kris Mayes, Arizona Public Service will not disconnect residential service for unpaid bills on days when the forecast high is at least 95 degrees Fahrenheit. That is a meaningful shift from APS’s prior policy, which barred shutoffs only between June 1 and October 15 regardless of the actual forecast.
fc2d54628b4f235e0559c06abb1f135446490164.translatedText: 亞利桑那州最大的電力公司在解決該州提起的訴訟後正在改變其熱季政策。根據總檢察長克里斯梅斯 (Kris Mayes) 宣布的協議，亞利桑那州公共服務部門不會在預計最高氣溫至少為 95 華氏度的日子裡因未付賬單而中斷住宅服務。這與 APS 之前的政策相比是一個有意義的轉變，先前的政策僅禁止在 6 月 1 日至 10 月 15 日期間關閉，無論實際預測如何。

ed33d0e5b27bc99d10a608089ac26c7c7e025a02.sourceText: The settlement totals $7 million. According to the report, $2.7 million will go into a state consumer protection fund, while another $3.4 million will be used to strengthen a program that allows customers to designate another person to receive notice before service is disconnected. The case was driven in part by the 2024 death of an 82-year-old woman whose power had been shut off, a tragedy that turned utility shutoff practices into a statewide consumer-protection issue.
ed33d0e5b27bc99d10a608089ac26c7c7e025a02.translatedText: 和解金額總計 700 萬美元。據報道，270萬美元將投入州消費者保護基金，另外340萬美元將用於加強一項計劃，該計劃允許客戶在服務中斷之前指定另一個人接收通知。此案的部分原因是 2024 年一名 82 歲婦女死亡，她的電源被切斷，這場悲劇將公用事業切斷做法變成了全州範圍內的消費者保護問題。

e840e79132c84baa8b0d8d79f5362fb1d8b76f05.sourceText: For Arizona households, the change matters because dangerous heat now arrives earlier and can linger later than traditional summer billing policies assume. A temperature-triggered rule offers broader protection during spring and fall heat spikes, when many residents still face air-conditioning costs but may not yet fall under seasonal shutoff bans. For residents and advocates, the settlement signals that heat resilience is becoming a year-round policy issue rather than a fixed summer calendar problem.
e840e79132c84baa8b0d8d79f5362fb1d8b76f05.translatedText: 對於亞利桑那州的家庭來說，這項變更很重要，因為危險的高溫現在比傳統的夏季計費政策假設的更早到來，並且可能持續更晚。溫度觸發的規則在春季和秋季高溫高峰期間提供了更廣泛的保護，此時許多居民仍面臨空調費用，但可能尚未受到季節性關閉禁令的影響。對於居民和倡導者來說，和解表明耐熱性正在成為全年政策問題，而不是一個固定的夏季日曆問題。

a8580d2d98b20054557015a24b8f33bc6e4c6b0c.sourceText: Maricopa’s housing market has cooled meaningfully compared with the same period a year earlier. According to data compiled from ARMLS for ZIP codes 85138 and 85139, 88 homes had closed month to date versus 137 in the equivalent 2025 window, a drop of 36 percent. The median sold price also moved lower, sliding from $359,990 last year to $342,000 this year.
a8580d2d98b20054557015a24b8f33bc6e4c6b0c.translatedText: 馬里科帕的房地產市場與去年同期相比明顯降溫。根據 ARMLS 為郵遞區號 85138 和 85139 編制的數據，本月迄今已有 88 戶家庭關閉，而 2025 年同期窗口期為 137 戶，下降了 36%。售價中位數也有所下降，從去年的 359,990 美元下滑至今年的 342,000 美元。

2770a1b1dea06973ccf27e7a4da9c691aea1c011.sourceText: At the same time, choice has expanded for buyers. The city had 383 active listings and about 4.4 months of supply, a much looser environment than the broader Phoenix metro, where the source said supply was closer to 1.59 months. That gap means Maricopa shoppers are seeing more options and less urgency than buyers in tighter Valley submarkets such as Phoenix, Chandler and Tempe.
2770a1b1dea06973ccf27e7a4da9c691aea1c011.translatedText: 同時，買家的選擇範圍也擴大了。該市有 383 套活躍房源，供應期約為 4.4 個月，比更廣泛的鳳凰城大都會寬鬆得多，消息人士稱，鳳凰城的供應期接近 1.59 個月。這種差距意味著馬里科帕的購物者比菲尼克斯、錢德勒和坦佩等更緊張的山穀子市場的買家看到更多的選擇和更少的緊迫感。

673477c08f7c1b72e03fc27b56a04412615d5486.sourceText: Sellers are feeling the pressure. The report said 222 active listings, or 58 percent, had already posted at least one price reduction, and roughly 30 percent of listings had been on the market for 90 days or more. The median active asking price was $365,995, while the median closed price was $342,000, leaving a gap of nearly $24,000 between seller expectations and what buyers were actually paying.
673477c08f7c1b72e03fc27b56a04412615d5486.translatedText: 賣家感受到了壓力。該報告稱，222 個活躍掛牌房源（即 58%）已經發布了至少一次降價，其中約 30% 的掛牌房源已在市場上停留了 90 天或更長時間。活躍要價中位數為 365,995 美元，而收盤價中位數為 342,000 美元，賣家預期與買家實際支付價格之間存在近 24,000 美元的差距。

c089bb95ed06fd8bf2eea873dd2ac70e12be8d61.sourceText: Even in a softer market, pricing discipline still matters. Homes that sold at or above their original asking price moved in a median of 32 days, much faster than overpriced homes, which were taking about 106 days to close. The story also pointed to mortgage rates around 6.39 percent, weaker national purchase activity and commuting fuel costs as pressures affecting demand. For Arizona movers, investors and local agents, Maricopa currently looks more negotiable than many other parts of the metro.
c089bb95ed06fd8bf2eea873dd2ac70e12be8d61.translatedText: 即使在市場疲軟的情況下，定價紀律仍然很重要。以等於或高於原要價出售的房屋平均需要 32 天才能成交，這比價格過高的房屋要快得多，後者大約需要 106 天才能成交。該報告還指出，抵押貸款利率約為 6.39%、全國購買活動疲軟以及通勤燃料成本都是影響需求的壓力。對於亞利桑那州的搬家公司、投資者和當地代理商來說，馬里科帕目前看起來比地鐵的許多其他地區更具談判空間。

56e9983aa0cfa9409aed6bdd6202474bc9f24612.sourceText: Sandbox VR has chosen Gilbert for its first permanent location in Arizona, with a grand opening planned for May 15 at SanTan Village. The company says guests who reserve online before the launch date will receive a 30% discount, an early push to introduce the brand to local residents before the hottest part of the year arrives.
56e9983aa0cfa9409aed6bdd6202474bc9f24612.translatedText: Sandbox VR 選擇 Gilbert 作為亞利桑那州的第一個永久地點，並計劃於 5 月 15 日在 SanTan Village 盛大開幕。該公司表示，在推出日期之前在線預訂的客人將獲得 30% 的折扣，這是在一年中最熱的季節到來之前向當地居民介紹該品牌的早期舉措。

8312078a2785c4af8beaaf2494735b9e6ae06444.sourceText: The concept is built around group-based virtual reality experiences that go beyond typical home headsets. Sandbox VR says it combines full-body motion capture with haptics and other high-end hardware so participants can move through the same digital environment together. The company argues that setup creates a more social and more physically immersive version of VR than what most people can access at home.
8312078a2785c4af8beaaf2494735b9e6ae06444.translatedText: 這個概念是圍繞著基於團體的虛擬實境體驗而建立的，超越了典型的家用耳機。 Sandbox VR 表示，它將全身動作捕捉與觸覺和其他高階硬體結合，因此參與者可以一起在同一個數位環境中移動。該公司認為，這種設置創造了比大多數人在家中可以訪問的更社交、更身臨其境的 VR 版本。

11c296d1df70fc7f13eead542c3c2548e63b88fe.sourceText: Executives tied to the Gilbert opening described the venue as an answer to multiple needs at once: family entertainment, friend-group outings, team events, and a weather-proof indoor activity during the Arizona summer. The site is expected to offer 11 different experiences, widening its appeal beyond a one-time novelty visit.
11c296d1df70fc7f13eead542c3c2548e63b88fe.translatedText: 與吉爾伯特開幕相關的高管將這個場地描述為同時滿足多種需求的答案：家庭娛樂、朋友團體郊遊、團隊活動以及亞利桑那州夏季防風雨的室內活動。該網站預計將提供 11 種不同的體驗，擴大其吸引力，超越一次性的新奇參觀。

e345797c0d92f1ed41c475006d67dcd5558c8bc1.sourceText: For Gilbert and the broader East Valley, the opening fits a larger pattern in which shopping and lifestyle centers are leaning harder into experience-based tenants. Adding a permanent Sandbox VR location gives SanTan Village another draw that is less about traditional retail and more about repeat traffic, social outings, and destination entertainment.
e345797c0d92f1ed41c475006d67dcd5558c8bc1.translatedText: 對於吉爾伯特和更廣泛的東谷來說，此次開業符合一種更大的模式，即購物中心和生活方式中心更加傾向於體驗型租戶。添加永久沙盒 VR 地點為三潭村帶來了另一個吸引力，它不再是傳統零售，而是更專注於重複交通、社交郊遊和目的地娛樂。
