52eff997a058b5ebfaed449fe0f5ee175a86af60.sourceText: Just off Desert View Drive in Grand Canyon National Park are the remains of an 800-year-old former Native American settlement.
52eff997a058b5ebfaed449fe0f5ee175a86af60.translatedText: 大峽谷國家公園的沙漠觀景大道 (Desert View Drive) 附近有一個擁有 800 年歷史的前美洲原住民定居點的遺跡。

c768fc833523b81f8c5e65c27eeb03d28873f6bc.sourceText: Originating from the Pueblo II culture, this settlement is believed to have been established sometime around 1185. Tree ring studies indicated that the site was occupied for only about 25 years. The u-shaped settlement consisted of a living area, storage rooms, and two ceremonial rooms known as Kivas. The site was thought to have been occupied by 15 to 20 people
c768fc833523b81f8c5e65c27eeb03d28873f6bc.translatedText: 該定居點起源於普韋布洛 II 文化，據信建於 1185 年左右。樹木年輪研究表明，該地點僅被佔用了大約 25 年。這個 U 形聚落由一個起居區、儲藏室和兩個被稱為 Kivas 的儀式室組成。該地點據信已被 15 至 20 人佔據

6b80f929792b4b556b4b166c4135063362238f60.sourceText: Only the first few portions of the walls remain, but the site does include plenty of information boards. The site was excavated in 1930, preserved between 1948 and 1965, and added to the National Register of Historic places in 1974.
6b80f929792b4b556b4b166c4135063362238f60.translatedText: 僅保留了牆壁的前幾部分，但該地點確實包含大量資訊板。該遺址於 1930 年被挖掘，1948 年至 1965 年期間得到保護，並於 1974 年被列入國家歷史古蹟名錄。

e79281df79c9023884f7a9d2ae75fa29eb02ebb8.translatedText: 艾倫·P·紐曼 (Alan P Newman) 博士

27dafda39e88f283298be17f24d0a996548ddb07.sourceText: Sitting along High Lonesome Road about 16 miles east of Tombstone, Arizona, the Gleeson Jail was built in 1910. While it survived a town-wide fire in 1912 and the near abandonment of Gleeson by the 1940s, the jail fell into a grave state of disrepair.
27dafda39e88f283298be17f24d0a996548ddb07.translatedText: 格里森監獄坐落在亞利桑那州墓碑鎮以東約 16 英里的高孤獨路 (High Lonesome Road) 上，建於 1910 年。雖然它在 1912 年全鎮範圍的火災中倖存下來，並在 20 世紀 40 年代幾乎被遺棄，但監獄年久失修。

05a25213171483e14ae7e0dcef75666b7ec40b11.sourceText: Restoration began in 2008 and the jail was reopened as a museum featuring early 1900s mining artifacts and local history.
05a25213171483e14ae7e0dcef75666b7ec40b11.translatedText: 於 2008 年開始修復，監獄作為博物館重新開放，以早期的監獄為特色。 1900 年代的採礦文物和當地歷史。

eae6aaaa16317ee4342dd02c8e7e1aa58e9763ed.sourceText: To see how the jail appeared before restoration, seek out the blueprint-matching building resting in disrepair to the northeast near the former mining community of Courtland.
eae6aaaa16317ee4342dd02c8e7e1aa58e9763ed.translatedText: 要了解監獄在修復之前的樣子，請在考特蘭前採礦社區附近的東北部尋找年久失修的與藍圖相符的建築。

b34b8036563a0c388921cb656f137d7ec0e1726a.sourceText: Admission to the jail is free, but donations are gladly accepted.
b34b8036563a0c388921cb656f137d7ec0e1726a.translatedText: 監獄免費入場，但我們很樂意接受捐款。

e6b55f41bdd667b6d08007eb7ce01e072317c13f.sourceText: In 2009, Don Guerra was a grade-school teacher with a yearning for bread. He had previously given up the baking life for grad school. But almost a decade into his teaching career, Guerra found himself longing for the feeling of dough in his hands. So he did what many a fledgling founder does: He set up shop in his garage.
e6b55f41bdd667b6d08007eb7ce01e072317c13f.translatedText: 2009年，唐·格拉（Don Guerra）是一名小學老師，他渴望麵包。他之前為了讀研究所而放棄了烘焙生活。但在他的教學生涯近十年後，格拉發現自己渴望手中的麵團的感覺。因此，他做了許多初出茅廬的創始人所做的事情：在自己的車庫裡開店。

aaa90f879caa2aa72fe24ffefed2061b724dbfe7.sourceText: His first customers and supporters were his neighbors. It's this rootedness in community that motivated Guerra to name his bakery Barrio , after the Spanish word for "neighborhood." Like the bakery's origins, Guerra's ingredients are literally rooted in the community. While his lineup includes traditional European loaves familiar to Great British Bake Off fans, such as olive fougasse , the grains he uses are largely local, either wheats that have learned to thrive in the arid Arizona desert after centuries of adaptation, or native plants.
aaa90f879caa2aa72fe24ffefed2061b724dbfe7.translatedText: 他的第一批客戶和支持者是他的鄰居。正是這種對社區的紮根促使 Guerra 將他的麵包店命名為 Barrio（西班牙語中「鄰裡」的意思）。就像麵包店的起源一樣，Guerra 的原料也確實植根於社區。雖然他的產品系列包括大不列顛烘焙大賽粉絲們熟悉的傳統歐洲麵包，例如橄欖焦渣，但他使用的穀物大部分都是本地的，要么是經過幾個世紀的適應後在乾旱的亞利桑那沙漠​​中茁壯成長的小麥，要么是本地植物。

671e3159b67461940c32c619c1df1592df3c7605.sourceText: Guerra's most famous loaves are evidence of this fusion. His Saturday morning Barrio Mesquite loaf, made with wheat and mesquite flour, bears the spicy taste of the desert. His Pan de Kino , meanwhile, is made with White Sonora, a desert-adapted heritage wheat introduced to southern Arizona in the late 1600s by a Spanish missionary, which is grown especially for Barrio by a local farm. Most iconic among his offerings is the Heritage loaf, distinguished by its blend of native desert grains and the signature stenciled-in saguaro that decorates it. The local environment even plays a key role in the baking process, literally causing Barrio's breads to rise: They are made not from commercial yeast, but from "natural leavening," or a sourdough starter, whose fermentation incorporates ambient yeast and bacteria.
671e3159b67461940c32c619c1df1592df3c7605.translatedText: 格拉最著名的麵包就是這種融合的證明。他週六早上的 Barrio Mesquite 麵包是用小麥和豆科灌木麵粉製成的，帶有沙漠的辛辣味道。同時，他的 Pan de Kino 是用 White Sonora 製成的，White Sonora 是一種適應沙漠的傳統小麥，於 1600 年代末由一位西班牙傳教士引入亞利桑那州南部，由當地一家農場專門為 Barrio 種植。他的產品中最具標誌性的是 Heritage 麵包，其特點是混合了當地沙漠穀物和標誌性的模印仙人掌裝飾。當地環境甚至在烘焙過程中發揮關鍵作用，真正導致 Barrio 的麵包發酵：它們不是由商業酵母製成，而是由「天然發酵劑」或酵母發酵劑製成，其發酵過程中加入了環境酵母和細菌。

fbcc3390c98664b784275d98c6b245057c14f709.sourceText: Guerra's commitment to all things local hasn't stopped him from receiving national recognition, however. In 2019, he was a semifinalist for the Outstanding Baker James Beard award , the Oscar of bread. But more than any award, the proof is in the pudding—or in the Desert Durum loaf. Venture to Barrio Bread on a weekend morning, and you'll see a line of locals snaking around the corner of his shop, each hungry aspirant waiting for a crusty, earthy slice of Tucson.
fbcc3390c98664b784275d98c6b245057c14f709.translatedText: 然而，Guerra 對所有當地事物的承諾並沒有阻止他獲得國家認可。 2019年，他入圍了被譽為“麵包界奧斯卡”的傑出麵包師詹姆斯·比爾德獎半決賽。但比任何獎項更重要的是，證據就在布丁或沙漠硬粒麵包中。週末早上前往 Barrio Bread，你會看到一排當地人在他的商店拐角處蜿蜒而行，每個飢餓的渴望者都在等待一塊硬皮、土味的圖森麵包。

195d2c0c99dae6a147088cc1b5bdb28dc0de8831.sourceText: For those who want to try their hand at re-creating some of Guerra's bready magic—or who want to avoid the line—Barrio offers baking classes .
195d2c0c99dae6a147088cc1b5bdb28dc0de8831.translatedText: 對於那些想要嘗試重現 Guerra 麵包魔法的人，或者想要避免排隊的人，Barrio 提供烘焙課程。

a0294fe3897c3d680f0f46a331467d3100ed4616.sourceText: This open pit mine in southeast Arizona is so large that it swallows up U.S. Route 191. Travelers driving south along the highway will be surprised to emerge from upland pine forests into a desolate, Martian-like landscape. This is the Morenci Mine, one of the largest copper mines in the world.
a0294fe3897c3d680f0f46a331467d3100ed4616.translatedText: 位於亞利桑那州東南部的這個露天礦場非常大，甚至吞噬了美國 191 號公路。沿著高速公路向南行駛的旅客會驚訝地發現，從高地鬆樹林中駛入一片荒涼的、類似火星的景觀。這就是 Morenci 礦，世界上最大的銅礦之一。

583810dcdbebd624b750afab388552fbb34569c5.sourceText: With an annual production of between 700 and 850 million pounds of copper, the Morenci Mine is the largest copper mine in Arizona. It was first explored in the 1860s by gold prospectors, but wilier miners smelt a better opportunity in the mountainous atmosphere. By 1881, the Phelps Dodge Company began operations that would rapidly expand and make Arizona famous as the Copper State.
583810dcdbebd624b750afab388552fbb34569c5.translatedText: Morenci 礦年產銅 700 至 8.5 億磅，是亞利桑那州最大的銅礦。 1860 年代，淘金者首次勘探這裡，但狡猾的礦工在山區氣氛中嗅到了更好的機會。 1881 年，菲爾普斯道奇公司 (Phelps Dodge Company) 開始運營，業務迅速擴張，使亞利桑那州被譽為「銅之州」。

b03612e98acf06ff15ffe94e5f91997192ff2788.sourceText: For over 100 years, the copper mining industry weathered geological challenges and wild market fluctuations, but in the early 1980s, the Morenci mine was the center of a desperate human drama. As the worldwide recession deepened, Phelps Dodge invalidated collective bargaining with the mining unions and thus began the Great Arizona Copper Strike, lasting from 1983 to 1986. At one point, the Arizona governor called up 350 National Guard troops, 450 state troopers, and 160 SWAT sharpshooters to protect the gates to the mine. The political, economic, and social damage done to the surrounding communities continues to be felt today, and are recounted by Anna Ochoa O’Leary in a new book, Mexican Workers and the Making of Arizona .
b03612e98acf06ff15ffe94e5f91997192ff2788.translatedText: 100 多年來，銅礦開採業經受住了地質挑戰和劇烈的市場波動，但在 20 世紀 80 年代初，莫倫西礦場成為了一場絕望的人類戲劇的中心。隨著全球經濟衰退的加深，菲爾普斯道奇宣布與礦業工會的集體談判無效，從而開始了從 1983 年持續到 1986 年的亞利桑那銅礦大罷工。亞利桑那州州長一度召集了 350 名國民警衛隊士兵、450 名州警和 160 名特警神槍手來保護礦場大門。至今，週邊社區所遭受的政治、經濟和社會損害依然存在，安娜·奧喬亞·奧利裡 (Anna Ochoa O’Leary) 在新書《墨西哥工人與亞利桑那州的形成》中對此進行了詳細敘述。

3c318688ecafbd1db511207d8bf51e6c362589c0.sourceText: Today, the mine employs more than 3,000 people and continues to define Arizona’s identity in addition to being loaded with history.
3c318688ecafbd1db511207d8bf51e6c362589c0.translatedText: 如今，該礦擁有超過 3,000 名員工，除了承載著歷史之外，它還繼續定義亞利桑那州的身份。

0b2ce23e0bc9219606e3d919cbcc1c976db9fd03.sourceText: Most people, on getting off the Colorado River at the Pearce Ferry Boat Ramp (River Mile 279), don't realize that from 1876 to 1938, a commercial ferry operation existed approximately 200 feet below them.
0b2ce23e0bc9219606e3d919cbcc1c976db9fd03.translatedText: 大多數人在皮爾斯渡輪坡道（河裡 279 英里）從科羅拉多河上下來時，並沒有意識到從 1876 年到 1938 年，在他們下方約 200 英尺處存在著商業渡輪運營。

53448ab7d7d5ff20f36fb30031e9dcad77de94b1.sourceText: Pearce Ferry was established in 1876 by Harrison Pearce under direction of Brigham Young, the religious leader and second president of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints. The church, looking to expand down into Arizona and New Mexico , needed a way for their settlers to get across the Colorado River. Lee's Ferry was the last safe crossing upstream from the Grand Canyon, and Pearce Ferry was the first just downstream from the canyon.
53448ab7d7d5ff20f36fb30031e9dcad77de94b1.translatedText: 皮爾斯渡輪由哈里森·皮爾斯於 1876 年在宗教領袖和耶穌基督後期聖徒教會第二任主席楊百翰 (Brigham Young) 的指導下建立聖人。教會希望擴展到亞利桑那州和新墨西哥州，需要為他們的定居者找到穿越科羅拉多河的方法。李氏渡口是大峽谷上游的最後一個安全渡口，而皮爾斯渡口是峽谷下游的第一個渡口。

20c152d7ac1397718c166a58019278f4902e590d.sourceText: Pearce, along with John D. Lee, had been directly involved in the 1857 Mountain Meadows Massacre of more than 100 people in a wagon train of Arkansas immigrants on their way to California . While arrest warrants were issued for both Pearce and Lee, only the latter was arrested, tried, and executed for his involvement.
20c152d7ac1397718c166a58019278f4902e590d.translatedText: 皮爾斯和約翰·D·李直接參與了 1857 年的山地梅多斯大屠殺，該事件導致阿肯色州移民前往加利福尼亞州的馬車列車上有 100 多人死亡。雖然對皮爾斯和李都發出了逮捕令，但只有後者因參與其中而被逮捕、審判和處決。

d4b4e1fca0be222b86ada11f93e508fcae65067d.sourceText: Pearce's commercial ferry venture never really took off and achieved the success of Lee's Ferry. In 1883, he sold the ferry operation to Thomas Steen. The ferry continued operating intermittently until the late 1930s, when Lake Mead water levels began reaching the location after the construction of the Hoover Dam. The ferry site remained under the waters of Lake Mead until the lake started receding in the early 2000s.
d4b4e1fca0be222b86ada11f93e508fcae65067d.translatedText: 皮爾斯的商業渡輪事業從未真正起飛，也沒有取得李氏渡輪的成功。 1883 年，他將渡輪業務出售給托馬斯·斯蒂恩 (Thomas Steen)。渡輪繼續間歇性運營，直到 1930 年代末胡佛水壩建成後米德湖水位開始達到該位置。渡輪站點一直位於米德湖水下，直到 2000 年代初期米德湖開始退縮。

33f637ee075ee13069e0b3f5e4fe8db5692687f3.sourceText: The current boat ramp was built in 2010 to deal with the changing lake level. Few river runners taking out at the ramp realize they're actually standing atop about 200 feet of silt deposited by the Colorado River. Somewhere down below them lie the remains of Pearce Ferry.
33f637ee075ee13069e0b3f5e4fe8db5692687f3.translatedText: 目前的船坡道建於 2010 年，以應對不斷變化的湖面水位。很少有在坡道上跑步的河流跑步者意識到他們實際上站在科羅拉多河沉積的約 200 英尺的淤泥之上。在他們下面的某個地方，埋藏著皮爾斯費裡的遺骸。

0dafb51c83acb84a16a2e45afb8564087558e1aa.sourceText: What Now Phoenix reported that Turquoise Wine Bar is preparing to open in Glendale, adding another small-format hospitality concept to the northwest Valley. The planned address is 23423 N. 67th Avenue, Suite 109, placing it in a suburban trade area that continues to attract new food-and-drink tenants.
0dafb51c83acb84a16a2e45afb8564087558e1aa.translatedText: 根據《鳳凰城》報道，Turquoise 酒吧正準備在格倫代爾開業，為西北山谷增添另一個小型酒店概念。規劃的地址是 23423 N. 67th Avenue, Suite 109，將其置於郊區貿易區，繼續吸引新的餐飲租戶。

e9e4f3b96539e10f80f202198f6ce6b3b9df715e.sourceText: The article said the concept is being launched by Teresa and Connor Rodewald, a mother-and-son team. Their pitch for the business centers on a curated wine list and an approachable setting rather than a high-formality tasting room, suggesting a neighborhood-focused model built around repeat local traffic.
e9e4f3b96539e10f80f202198f6ce6b3b9df715e.translatedText: 文章稱，這個概念是由 Teresa 和 Connor Rodewald 母子團隊發起的。他們對商務中心的宣傳是精心策劃的酒單和平易近人的環境，而不是高度正式的品酒室，這表明圍繞著重複的本地交通建立了以社區為中心的模式。

c8eeb275e918f5720dd8410190f01f1dc2ec143c.sourceText: No opening date had been announced at the time of publication. Even so, the item is useful as an early signal for Glendale residents, nearby retail landlords, and small-business watchers because it shows continued demand for specialty beverage concepts outside the urban core of Phoenix.
c8eeb275e918f5720dd8410190f01f1dc2ec143c.translatedText: 在發佈時尚未宣布開業日期。即便如此，該項目對於格倫代爾居民、附近的零售業主和小型企業觀察者來說仍然是一個有用的早期信號，因為它表明了鳳凰城市中心以外對特色飲料概念的持續需求。

a79980a16e90356d93d89058f6c850d007edd51b.sourceText: Tucson Chinese School Tucson Chinese School (TCS) was founded in 1950 over 63 years ago. After generations of hard work, TCS has become a major force in Southern Arizona Chinese education. The quality of teaching in TCS has improved quickly and has become the Southern Arizona Chinese education leader. TCS moved to the Tucson Chinese Cultural Center in 2005. This move allowed TCS to develop the best facilities, the strongest faculty, the highest quality of teaching, and the most complete grades in the Tucson area. Join us this semester to start or continue your language-learning journey. You may sign-up at any point throughout the year. Classes are offered for all levels. To sign up, fill out the registration form linked at the buttons below and send to info@tucsonchinese.org, or bring to the center during regular hours. Additional Documents: Emergency Information Form Tucson Chinese School Curriculum Tucson Chinese School offers classes form pre-school to adult level. Our educational programs, organized into two semesters per year, emphasize character recognition, reading and writing skills, as well as listening and conversation. Speech, writing and spelling contests are all organized throughout the year.
a79980a16e90356d93d89058f6c850d007edd51b.translatedText: 圖森中文學校 圖森中文學校（TCS）成立於1950年，距今已有63年歷史。經過幾代人的努力，TCS已成為南亞利桑那州中文教育的重要力量。 TCS的教學品質提升很快，已成為南亞利桑那州中文教育的佼佼者。 TCS於2005年遷至圖森中國文化中心。此舉使得TCS擁有圖森地區最好的設施、最強的師資、最高的教學品質和最齊全的成績。本學期加入我們，開始或繼續您的語言學習之旅。您可以在一年中的任何時間註冊。提供各個級別的課程。如需註冊，請填寫下方按鈕連結的註冊表並發送至 info@tucsonchinese.org，或在正常時間內攜帶至中心。附加文件： 緊急資訊表 圖森中文學校課程 圖森中文學校提供從學前班到成人級別的課程。我們的教育課程每年分為兩個學期，強調字元辨識、閱讀和寫作技能以及聽力和會話能力。演講、寫作和拼字比賽全年舉辦。

01ab65f287d988824bc70c889a2d885f7ce4a531.sourceText: Jack in the Box is listed near Chandler Ranch in Chandler. This profile was generated from plaza directory sources and map-based verification, so direct business contact details may still be incomplete.
01ab65f287d988824bc70c889a2d885f7ce4a531.translatedText: Jack in the Box 位於錢德勒的錢德勒牧場附近。此設定檔是根據廣場目錄來源和基於地圖的驗證產生的，因此直接業務聯絡詳細資訊可能仍然不完整。

c37ea65db1648baae52b1578391711236721fbb3.sourceText: Signs, signs, everywhere are signs—at the Ignite Sign Art Museum in Tucson's Arroyo Chico neighborhood. What's so special about this collection is the sheer variety of signs on display. There's neon, electric, hand-painted, aluminum, and LED. They run the gamut from historic neon signs to a rescued 76 gas station ball. There are signs from local mom-and-pop grocery stores displayed next to an enormous Arby's hat. It's an eclectic and unexpected assortment, just like Tucson itself.
c37ea65db1648baae52b1578391711236721fbb3.translatedText: 標誌，標誌，到處都是標誌——位於圖森阿羅約奇科街區的點燃標誌藝術博物館。這個系列的特別之處在於展示的標誌種類繁多。有霓虹燈、電動燈、手繪燈、鋁燈和 LED 燈。它們涵蓋了從歷史悠久的霓虹燈標誌到獲救的 76 個加油站球的各種內容。巨大的阿比帽子旁邊展示著當地夫妻雜貨店的招牌。這是一個不拘一格且出人意料的分類，就像圖森本身一樣。

216cf585328ad80c57ac8cfe7872e9c92c52cc70.sourceText: The Ignite museum started as the personal collection of Jude Cook, who has spent his life in the design and sign industry. His work is familiar to any Tucsonan; his company built the city's iconic neon saguaro at Main Street and Drachman, and restored beloved historic signs including the Tropicana, the Picarretta-Davis diving girl, and the Canyon State Motor Lodge.
216cf585328ad80c57ac8cfe7872e9c92c52cc70.translatedText: Ignite 博物館最初是 Jude Cook 的個人收藏，他一生都在設計和標誌行業中度過。他的作品對於任何圖森人來說都很熟悉。他的公司在主街和德拉克曼建造了這座城市標誌性的霓虹仙人掌，並修復了深受人們喜愛的歷史標誌，包括 Tropicana、Picarretta-Davis 潛水女孩和峽谷州立汽車旅館。

44be98d4a8543c48f46e0571d993590e166f3955.sourceText: Over the course of 40 years, Cook collected signs from across Arizona and the U.S., and acquired a reputation as the person to call when you needed an old sign hauled off quick. After his collection grew too large to store, he decided to put it on display for everyone to enjoy. Ignite Sign Art Museum opened to the public in 2018.
44be98d4a8543c48f46e0571d993590e166f3955.translatedText: 在 40 年的時間裡，庫克收集了來自亞利桑那州和美國各地的標誌，並贏得了聲譽，因為當你需要快速拆除舊標誌時，可以打電話給他。當他的收藏變得太多而無法存放後，他決定將其展示出來供大家欣賞。點燃標誌藝術博物館於 2018 年對外開放。

91b028708fcf122f4decc4530b288157615c19ec.sourceText: Visit Ignite on a typical day and you'll see signs in various states of repair and refurbishment. It's a rare opportunity to see what goes into bringing these iconic (and fragile) American icons back to life.
91b028708fcf122f4decc4530b288157615c19ec.translatedText: 在平常的日子裡參觀點燃，您會看到各種修復和翻新狀態的標誌。這是一個難得的機會，可以了解如何讓這些標誌性（且脆弱的）美國標誌重新煥發活力。

5a3a5523be9cda0002eaf653f448e44ee29193b7.sourceText: Located at 901 Old Route 66, and open Monday through Saturday from 10:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., the Ash Fork Route 66 Historic Museum and Visitor Center is both a fun and educational stop along Route 66. The museum welcomes travelers with engaging exhibits such as a vintage model T, the town's original old one-room jail house, and Native American artifacts.
5a3a5523be9cda0002eaf653f448e44ee29193b7.translatedText: 阿什福克 66 號公路歷史博物館和遊客中心位於舊 66 號公路 901 號，週一至週六上午 10:00 至下午 4:00 開放，是 66 號公路沿線的一處有趣且具有教育意義的站點。博物館以引人入勝的展覽歡迎遊客，例如復古模型 T、鎮上原來的舊單間監獄和美洲原住民。

be86a8b6209ad4ec8e8b34cdca852fe65c686dd8.sourceText: There is an outdoor history walk, and lots of opportunities to snap the perfect pic. You are sure to enjoy perusing the gift shop brimming with nostalgic Route 66 treasures, or pausing to rest in the shaded picnic areas. The facilities are clean, and this stop is equally suited to families and road trippers alike. Plus, there is plenty of parking for vehicles of all sizes.
be86a8b6209ad4ec8e8b34cdca852fe65c686dd8.translatedText: 有戶外歷史漫步，有很多機會拍攝完美照片。您一定會喜歡逛逛充滿懷舊 66 號公路珍寶的禮品店，或是在陰涼的野餐區停下來休息。設施乾淨，這個站點同樣適合家庭和公路旅行者。此外，這裡還有充足的停車位，可停放各種尺寸的車輛。

46acdca4c6c03a0b837036bfa053cbdc983d27e5.sourceText: The museum curators are a local couple who have lived in the Ash Fork community their entire lives. They are incredibly knowledgeable and friendly, and are passionate about preserving the history of both this small town and Route 66.
46acdca4c6c03a0b837036bfa053cbdc983d27e5.translatedText: 博物館館長是一對當地夫婦，他們一生都住在 Ash Fork 社區。他們知識淵博、友善，熱衷於保護這座小鎮和 66 號公路的歷史。

c0123580d7644d2164ae64aefdf35b033229369b.sourceText: USA Tae Kwon Do is listed within Dobson Park Plaza Chandler in Chandler. This profile was generated from plaza directory sources and map-based verification, so direct business contact details may still be incomplete.
c0123580d7644d2164ae64aefdf35b033229369b.translatedText: 美國跆拳道 (USA Tae Kwon Do) 位於錢德勒 (Chandler) 的多布森公園廣場錢德勒 (Dobson Park Plaza Chandler) 內。此設定檔是根據廣場目錄來源和基於地圖的驗證產生的，因此直接業務聯絡詳細資訊可能仍然不完整。

e8f62f6278f25cb73eb0d2bf245acfba2e22e95e.sourceText: Located in Tucson, on the Tohono O'odham San Xavier Indian Reservation, is this small, but stunning white mission church. It was completed in 1797 and is still an active place of worship today.
e8f62f6278f25cb73eb0d2bf245acfba2e22e95e.translatedText: 這座小型但令人驚嘆的白色使命教堂位於圖森的托霍諾奧德姆聖澤維爾印第安人保留地。它於 1797 年竣工，至今仍然是一個活躍的禮拜場所。

1a4f11782a1cc0aea2a3368d175af1340280ef4d.sourceText: Inside, the church is decorated with a combination of Spanish and Native American motifs. The ornate altar, painted walls, and wooden benches are vibrant and beautiful. There is a small outer building containing an altar that is covered with religious and personal items left by the faithful who have come to pray.
1a4f11782a1cc0aea2a3368d175af1340280ef4d.translatedText: 教堂內部的裝潢融合了西班牙和美洲原住民的圖案。華麗的祭壇、彩繪牆壁和木凳充滿活力且美麗。有一座小型外部建築，內有一座祭壇，祭壇上覆蓋著前來祈禱的信徒留下的宗教和個人物品。

004420fdf1fc677251f5f3299db3654fe89bc86e.sourceText: Mission San Xavier del Bac was established in 1692 by Jesuit Eusebio Francisco Kino. The mission's first church was built in 1700 about two miles from the current site. After it was demolished in 1770, the church that stands today was built between 1783 and 1797. Much of the labor was completed by the Tohono Oʼodham, an Indigenous people who have lived in the Sonoran Desert for hundreds of years. Today, many of the O'odham have combined traditional cultural practices and beliefs with elements of Catholicism.
004420fdf1fc677251f5f3299db3654fe89bc86e.translatedText: 聖澤維爾德爾巴克傳教團 (Mission San Xavier del Bac) 於 1692 年由耶穌會士尤西比奧·弗朗西斯科·基諾 (Eusebio Francisco Kino) 建立。傳教區的第一座教堂建於 1700 年，距離現址約兩英里。 1770 年拆除後，如今的教堂建於 1783 年至 1797 年間。大部分的工作是由在索諾蘭沙漠生活了數百年的土著居民 Tohono O'odham 完成。如今，許多 O'odham 已將傳統文化習俗和信仰與天主教元素結合。

775265f0fb17b1506a2ef28f747fff2b814892fe.sourceText: Free tours are offered Monday-Saturday starting at 9:30 a.m. until 1 p.m. as long as there is no church service. You can also visit the gift shop and mausoleum. Check the website and plan your trip accordingly before going. If you're lucky, you'll also be able to buy traditional Indian fry bread, with or without various fillings, from vendors near the parking area (most often available on weekends).
775265f0fb17b1506a2ef28f747fff2b814892fe.translatedText: 週一至週六上午 9:30 至下午 1 點提供免費導覽。只要沒有教會禮拜。您還可以參觀禮品店和陵墓。出發前請查看網站並相應地規劃您的行程。如果幸運的話，您還可以從停車場附近的供應商購買傳統的印度炸麵包，無論有或沒有各種餡料（通常在周末出售）。

daa254adb6f77983c42ff3296598757216138870.sourceText: Show Low is a scenic town located in the White Mountains of Arizona . Though it is near lots of outdoor recreation in the Apache-Sitgreaves National Forest and a ski resort, Show Low is perhaps more famous for the curious story of how the town got its name.
daa254adb6f77983c42ff3296598757216138870.translatedText: 肖洛（Show Low）是位於亞利桑那州白山的一個風景秀麗的小鎮。雖然肖洛 (Show Low) 靠近阿帕奇-西特格里夫斯國家森林 (Apache-Sitgreaves National Forest) 的眾多戶外休閒場所和滑雪勝地，但它更出名的可能是該鎮得名的好奇故事。

6e6c307f00a2ebc494dd3dae95a0bb367881ccbe.sourceText: In the 1870s, settlers Corydon Cooley and Marion Clark became partners in a 100,000-acre ranch. They got along well and for several years they each prospered in their business. Their ranch on the Mogollon Rim of the Colorado Plateau was in a verdant forest and received much more precipitation than the low desert that Arizona is more known for, so their ranching endeavors went fairly smoothly. But they were ambitious men, and 100,000 acres was mutually determined to be not enough space for each of their planned activities. Neither could afford to outright purchase the other's share in the ranch.
6e6c307f00a2ebc494dd3dae95a0bb367881ccbe.translatedText: 在 1870 年代，定居者科里登·庫利 (Corydon Cooley) 和馬里昂·克拉克 (Marion Clark) 成為了佔地 100,000 英畝牧場的合夥人。他們相處得很好，幾年來他們的生意都蒸蒸日上。他們的牧場位於科羅拉多高原莫戈隆邊緣，森林茂密，降水量比亞利桑那州著名的低沙漠多得多，所以他們的牧場工作進展得相當順利。但他們都是雄心勃勃的人，100,000 英畝的土地不足以滿足他們每項計劃的活動。雙方都沒有能力直接購買對方的牧場份額。

d3a9f4f7d338bf6ba0b420519bd1d7cbcb107386.sourceText: Instead of settling the matter in a more cliché Old West way, like a duel at high noon, the two business partners decided to wager their share of the ranch on a game of cards. The two met at Cooley's kitchen table one evening in 1876. The game they played was called Seven Up, a variation of the British card game All Fours that was the most popular card game in the United States until poker soon usurped that title.
d3a9f4f7d338bf6ba0b420519bd1d7cbcb107386.translatedText: 這兩個商業夥伴沒有以更陳腔濫調的老西部方式解決問題，就像正午決鬥一樣，而是決定用紙牌遊戲來賭他們的牧場份額。 1876 年的一個晚上，兩人在庫利的廚房餐桌上相識。他們玩的遊戲稱為“Seven Up”，這是英國紙牌遊戲“All Fours”的變體，該遊戲是美國最受歡迎的紙牌遊戲，直到撲克很快取代了這一稱號。

c08cfda8d116977043d4797c2747bcb8991baac0.sourceText: There are different stories told of how their card game went, in some the game went on for hours with no end in sight, in others Cooley was close to winning and Clark made his next offer as a desperate gambit. The stories all end the same way though—Clark, holding a three in his hand, challenged Cooley that whoever showed low would win the game. Cooley agreed and revealed a two of clubs, winning the ranch.
c08cfda8d116977043d4797c2747bcb8991baac0.translatedText: 關於他們的紙牌遊戲如何進行，有不同的故事，有的遊戲持續了幾個小時，看不到結束的跡象，有的則庫利即將獲勝，而克拉克則提出了他的下一個提議，作為孤注一擲的策略。不過，故事的結局都是一樣的——克拉克手裡拿著一個三分球，向庫利發起挑戰，誰表現得低，誰就能贏得比賽。庫利同意了，並透露了兩支球桿，贏得了牧場。

035fe0bf56a29515d853ddb12fdbc572ccee9514.sourceText: Corydon Cooley subsequently renamed the property Show Low Ranch to commemorate how he came to have sole ownership. When a town sprung up around the ranch buildings, the name came with it. Marion Clark amicably packed his things and started another ranching operation nearby. To this day, the main street through downtown Show Low is named Deuce of Clubs. Additionally, it's written in the town charter that if competing candidates for position of mayor of Show Low receive so close a vote total to necessitate a run-off, instead the position is determined by the two sitting down with a deck of cards, alternating drawing cards. The first to draw the two of clubs becomes mayor.
035fe0bf56a29515d853ddb12fdbc572ccee9514.translatedText: 科里登·庫利隨後將這處房產重新命名為 Show Low Ranch，以紀念他如何擁有唯一的所有權。當牧場建築周圍出現一座城鎮時，這個名字就隨之而來。馬里昂·克拉克友好地收拾好自己的東西，並在附近開始了另一場牧場經營。直到今天，穿過 Show Low 市中心的主要街道仍被命名為 Deuce of Clubs。此外，鎮章程中還規定，如果肖洛市長職位的競爭候選人得票數如此接近，需要進行決選，則由兩人坐下來，拿著一副牌，輪流抽牌來決定位置。第一個抽中兩傢俱樂部的人成為市長。

f3196dc180cbd0498edceb48fedf656a394add10.sourceText: H Mart is listed within Mesa Main Marketplace / H Mart in Mesa. This profile was generated from plaza directory sources and map-based verification, so direct business contact details may still be incomplete.
f3196dc180cbd0498edceb48fedf656a394add10.translatedText: H Mart 在梅薩主市場/梅薩的 H Mart 內上市。此設定檔是根據廣場目錄來源和基於地圖的驗證產生的，因此直接業務聯絡詳細資訊可能仍然不完整。

fb1ca486d418b0e59654b183a1e9d13de4a84bdf.sourceText: Driving down Central Avenue in Phoenix is always an enjoyable experience with all of the new, exciting shops, restaurants, and modern high-rise structures constantly popping up. But if one looks to the west of the modern avenue, it would appear the city has been invaded by 12th-century Normans.
fb1ca486d418b0e59654b183a1e9d13de4a84bdf.translatedText: 沿著鳳凰城中央大道行駛總是一種愉快的體驗，所有令人興奮的新商店、餐廳和現代高層建築不斷湧現。但如果向現代大道的西邊看去，這座城市似乎已被 12 世紀的諾曼人入侵。

02f1dc9e66e4feca64fa939adf5a65324c3ae9ef.sourceText: A castle sits nestled between Hance Park and the FOUND:RE hotel. Venture inside the gated grounds, and you'll discover the Irish Cultural Center and McClelland Library, a slice of Ireland (no Vikings included) in the heart of the Arizona desert.
02f1dc9e66e4feca64fa939adf5a65324c3ae9ef.translatedText: 漢斯公園和 FOUND:RE 飯店之間坐落著一座城堡。走進封閉的場地，您會發現愛爾蘭文化中心和麥克萊蘭圖書館，這是愛爾蘭的一部分（不包括維京人），位於亞利桑那州沙漠的中心。

290ba74c20a4011b7f8dd5b82c48ae66584f1895.sourceText: Immediately upon entering the center, visitors come face-to-face with the McClelland Library, designed after a 12th-century Norman castle. The largest of its kind in the Western United States, it houses more than 8,000 books by Irish authors, poets, and genealogical sources, as well as a permanent exhibit on the 9th-century Book of Kells .
290ba74c20a4011b7f8dd5b82c48ae66584f1895.translatedText: 一進入中心，遊客就會看到麥克萊蘭圖書館，它是按照 12 世紀的諾曼城堡設計的。它是美國西部同類中規模最大的圖書館，藏有 8,000 多本愛爾蘭作家、詩人和家譜資料的書籍，還有關於 9 世紀《凱爾經》的永久展覽。

2cc26574f9aad72bf2cdc7f06cd1139d1bcf37d9.sourceText: To the right is the Great Hall, where guests can enjoy Irish dancing, film premieres, and other cultural events. Inside are authentic utensils once used in ancestral Irish homes alongside artwork from Irish and Celtic artists.
2cc26574f9aad72bf2cdc7f06cd1139d1bcf37d9.translatedText: 右側是大廳，客人可以在這裡欣賞愛爾蘭舞蹈、電影首映和其他文化活動。裡面有曾經在愛爾蘭祖先住宅中使用過的正宗器具，以及來自愛爾蘭和凱爾特藝術家的藝術品。

7a816c11f080469efda4682cc43484305c26464d.sourceText: Visitors can also step back in time at the Cottage, a replica of an 1850s Irish home, or reflect at The Great Hunger Memorial, a stone arch dedicated to An Gorta Mór, the Great Famine that spurred mass Irish emigration to the United States.
7a816c11f080469efda4682cc43484305c26464d.translatedText: 遊客還可以在這座 1850 年代愛爾蘭住宅的複製品小屋裡時光倒流，或者在大飢餓紀念碑 (The Great Hunger Memorial) 上反思，這是一座專門紀念 An Gorta Mór 的石拱門，這場大饑荒促使大量愛爾蘭人移民到美國。

18287bef00d228d9f3014a1850501ff8e01825c2.sourceText: This place is a unique hidden gem and a chance to visit Ireland, without leaving the state.
18287bef00d228d9f3014a1850501ff8e01825c2.translatedText: 這個地方是一個獨特的隱藏寶石，也是一個無需離開該州即可遊覽愛爾蘭的機會。

6b49f015e8b320d934f85f66a632cf3fd9a0d2ef.sourceText: Route 66, in its heyday, stretched for over 2,200 miles from Chicago to Los Angeles. But sometimes, the road grew desolate, and maybe no stretch was more isolated than the section found in northeastern Arizona within Petrified Forest National Park. At the site, a small pullout with a rusted 1932 Studebaker recognizes Petrified Forest as the only national park to contain a stretch of Route 66.
6b49f015e8b320d934f85f66a632cf3fd9a0d2ef.translatedText: 66 號公路在全盛時期從芝加哥延伸至洛杉磯，全長 2,200 多英里。但有時，道路變得荒涼，也許沒有任何路段比亞利桑那州東北部石化森林國家公園內的路段更偏僻了。現場有一個小型休憩處，上面有一輛 1932 年生鏽的 Studebaker，承認石化森林是唯一包含 66 號公路一段路段的國家公園。

877bb2d1f535a888947c5b4ce1c2e3567172dc6b.sourceText: Route 66, including this stretch, was commissioned in 1926, and formed from the National Old Trails Road. It connected the U.S. midwest and southwest, and helped make the Petrified Forest and Painted Desert more accessible. Already a national monument as of 1906, much of the forest’s infrastructure was built during the New Deal era through the Civilian Conservation Corps. By 1962, the site was named a national park, but by that point, drivers had already left Route 66 behind. The route had been rendered obsolete by the U.S. Interstate system, including I-40, which runs through the park today.
877bb2d1f535a888947c5b4ce1c2e3567172dc6b.translatedText: 66 號公路（包括這段路段）於 1926 年投入使用，由全國老道公路形成。它連接了美國中西部和西南部，並使石化森林和彩繪沙漠變得更加容易到達。自 1906 年起，該森林已成為國家紀念碑，森林的大部分基礎設施都是在新政時期由民間保護團建造的。 1962 年，該地點被命名為國家公園，但此時司機們已經將 66 號公路拋在了後面。這條路線已被美國州際公路系統淘汰，其中包括如今穿過公園的 I-40 州際公路。

d14ce00749ccdd9c86cc219738f8bb0e9f88ac51.sourceText: This section of Route 66 was closed in 1958, and the highway was decommissioned in 1985. However, the thrill of the drive, with its many neon signs, motels, and muffler men, remained on the minds of many, and a new era of nostalgic tourism dawned. Realizing the draw, Petrified Forest National Park officials established a pullout view in 2006. A row of historic telephone poles marks the bed where the road once stood.
d14ce00749ccdd9c86cc219738f8bb0e9f88ac51.translatedText: 66 號公路的這段路段於 1958 年關閉，高速公路於 1985 年退役。然而，駕車時的刺激感、眾多霓虹燈招牌、汽車旅館和消音員仍然留在許多人的腦海中，並開啟了一個新時代的懷舊旅遊興起。意識到這一吸引力後，石化森林國家公園的官員於 2006 年建立了一個撤出景觀。一排歷史悠久的電線桿標誌著道路曾經所在的地方。

8e6ab81f35327ace5338d1a9d24f43ed6cd0d9b9.sourceText: To complete the exhibit, a 1932 Studebaker was placed along the pullout along the former route. No, the car has not rusted in the Arizona desert for decades. It’s an unnatural art piece, donated to the National Park Service by Frank and Rhonda Dobell of the Arizona Automotive Service of Holbrook, Arizona, to symbolize the allure of travel during that era.
8e6ab81f35327ace5338d1a9d24f43ed6cd0d9b9.translatedText: 為了完成展覽，一輛 1932 年的斯圖貝克 (Studebaker) 被放置在原路線的撤離點上。不，這輛車在亞利桑那州的沙漠裡已經幾十年沒有生鏽了。這是一件非自然的藝術品，由亞利桑那州霍爾布魯克亞利桑那州汽車服務公司的 Frank 和 Rhonda Dobell 捐贈給國家公園管理局，象徵著那個時代旅行的魅力。

520deb4d36e99f451b5251ccc5d2b88d208c1cd3.sourceText: Despite its intentional abandonment, the classic car has spent an impressive amount of time exposed to the elements and remains a popular attraction within the park. An abandoned car enthusiast notes that the Petrified Forest's Studebaker is “probably the most photographed abandoned car in the country.”
520deb4d36e99f451b5251ccc5d2b88d208c1cd3.translatedText: 儘管被有意遺棄，這輛經典汽車已經在自然環境中度過了令人印象深刻的時間，並且仍然是公園內的熱門景點。一位廢棄汽車愛好者指出，石化森林的斯圖貝克「可能是全國被拍照最多的廢棄汽車」。

fd8fbb66a5a1ec3077a49aaeb6ee232503bcc05e.sourceText: “Study the past if you would divine the future.” These words of Confucius clearly resonate with Roderick Wilde, the owner of the world’s largest collection of antique electric vehicles. Dreaming of creating a museum devoted entirely to EVs, Wilde first displayed part of his collection at the 2014 Route 66 International Festival in Kingman, Arizona. The exhibit was so successful that it became a permanent museum inside Kingman’s historic Powerhouse.
fd8fbb66a5a1ec3077a49aaeb6ee232503bcc05e.translatedText: 「如果你能預測未來，就研究過去。」孔子的這句話顯然引起了羅德里克·王爾德的共鳴，他是世界上最大的古董電動車收藏的擁有者。懷爾德夢想創建一座完全專注於電動車的博物館，2014 年，王爾德在亞利桑那州金曼舉行的 66 號公路國際節上首次展示了他的部分收藏。這次展覽非常成功，以至於成為金曼歷史悠久的發電廠內的永久博物館。

459839d1596eb11ef7772464fa7efa38395a2c81.sourceText: Electric vehicles aren’t a 21st-century innovation, they date back to the 19th century. For a brief time in the early 1900s, they even competed with gasoline cars, before cheap fuel and limited battery technology rendered them impractical. For much of the 20th century, electric power was relegated to small vehicles like golf carts, mobility scooters, and “neighborhood electric vehicles.”
459839d1596eb11ef7772464fa7efa38395a2c81.translatedText: 電動車不是 21 世紀的創新，它們的歷史可以追溯到 19 世紀。在 1900 年代初期的一段短暫時間內，它們甚至與汽油車競爭，後來廉價的燃料和有限的電池技術使它們變得不切實際。在 20 世紀的大部分時間裡，電力僅限於高爾夫球車、電動滑板車和「社區電動車」等小型車輛。

17d6dfccd483267d350b41a72d505d9514f7dbae.sourceText: The museum’s collection includes those everyday models alongside celebrity-owned golf carts (including ones belonging to Waylon Jennings and Willie Nelson), a 2008 Tesla Roadster, and a record-breaking electric race car.
17d6dfccd483267d350b41a72d505d9514f7dbae.translatedText: 博物館的藏品包括日常車型以及名人擁有的高爾夫球車（包括 Waylon Jennings 和 Willie Nelson 的高爾夫球車）、一輛 2008 年 Tesla Roadster 以及破紀錄的電動賽車

567b9d62112efbf2ca3a8dd3166f4c5351c6816c.sourceText: Though the Powerhouse space currently displays only part of Wilde’s collection, the museum plans to expand into a larger downtown location in the future.
567b9d62112efbf2ca3a8dd3166f4c5351c6816c.translatedText: Powerhouse位置目前僅展示市中心王爾德的部分藏品，但將來王爾德的部分藏品將僅展示市中心王爾德的部分藏品。

c03c7b6cee8b4353bc2de073d66f172f3b4bf1fe.sourceText: This sycamore tree was planted in 1976 in celebration of America's bicentennial.
c03c7b6cee8b4353bc2de073d66f172f3b4bf1fe.translatedText: 這棵梧桐樹是 1976 年為慶祝美國建國 200 週年而種植的。

16833bbc4106d5c546d5afd0186e9d8e46ed7444.sourceText: Stuart Roosa was a US Forest Service smoke Jumper who became an astronaut on Apollo 14. He carried tree seeds with him on the mission. After his return the seeds were germinated and seedlings were shared and planted all over the world.
16833bbc4106d5c546d5afd0186e9d8e46ed7444.translatedText: Stuart Roosa 是美國林業局的消防員，在阿波羅 14 號上成為太空人。他在執行任務時隨身攜帶了樹種。他回來後，種子發芽了，幼苗被分享並種植在世界各地。

322de85868d01a9b0a6697a7762829f5adbee8f3.sourceText: What a wonderful trip, to visit all of the moon trees! There are 6 other Moon Trees on Atlas Obscura, but many more out there.
322de85868d01a9b0a6697a7762829f5adbee8f3.translatedText: 參觀所有的月亮樹，真是一次美妙的旅行！ Atlas Obscura 上還有其他 6 棵月亮樹，但還有更多。

8a1ab5bd32c9eba8d5f4163d3c9daa7bdc1c3019.sourceText: Hidden away near Humphrey's Peak, the highest point in the state of Arizona, the remains of a plane crash that killed eight people can still be found, a junked memorial to their tragic accident.
8a1ab5bd32c9eba8d5f4163d3c9daa7bdc1c3019.translatedText: 隱藏在亞利桑那州最高點漢弗萊峰附近的那場導致 8 人死亡的飛機失事殘骸至今仍被發現，這是對這場悲慘事故的廢棄紀念碑。

0012e21ab0add708da139adc3b4226f8505c994a.sourceText: During the night of September 25, 1944, a U.S. Army Corps B-24 Liberator Bomber crashed into a boulder field near the top of Humphrey's Peak, obliterating the craft and killing the eight members of crew on board. The remote crash site, located high up, in a largely inaccessible portion of the slopes, was left essentially how it was when the crash occurred, with engine parts and silvery metal sticking out all over among the boulders.
0012e21ab0add708da139adc3b4226f8505c994a.translatedText: 1944 年 9 月 25 日夜間，美國陸軍軍團的一架 B-24 解放者轟炸機墜毀在漢弗萊峰頂部附近的一塊巨石場上，飛機被毀。並殺死了船上的八名船員。偏遠的墜機地點位於高處，在斜坡上一個基本上難以進入的部分，基本上保持著墜機發生時的原樣，發動機零件和銀色金屬在巨石之間伸出。

5b0dfac9498ddcd73d5adc160865ce486be3c8b7.sourceText: Even today, the wreckage remains, although it has become no more accessible. Nonetheless, adventurous hikers who are looking for a unique and hidden memorial to a military tragedy, have still been able to locate the crash. According to some reports, engine parts, structural debris, and even an almost entirely intact wing can still be found littering the rocky field. On a sunny day, pieces may even be seen from the parking lot at the head of the Humphrey's Peak Trail, glinting in the sun. In the 1950s the USFS decided to dynamite the wreckage further distributing it over the mountain; this was due to increasing numbers of interstate travelers reporting a "new plane wreck" reflecting afternoon sunlight on the western flank of Mount Humpherys.
5b0dfac9498ddcd73d5adc160865ce486be3c8b7.translatedText: 即使在今天，殘骸仍然存在，儘管它已經變得不再容易接近。儘管如此，那些正在尋找獨特且隱藏的軍事悲劇紀念碑的冒險徒步旅行者仍然能夠找到墜機地點。據一些報導稱，發動機零件、結構碎片，甚至幾乎完整的機翼仍然散落在岩石地裡。在陽光明媚的日子裡，甚至可以從漢弗萊峰步道 (Humphrey's Peak Trail) 起點的停車場看到在陽光下閃閃發光的碎片。 1950 年代，美國消防局決定將殘骸引爆，並將其進一步分佈在山上；這是由於越來越多的州際旅行者報告稱，漢弗萊斯山西側出現了反射午後陽光的「新飛機殘骸」。

b7c710f1aa032230532a839e375db4f072ad2aee.sourceText: Hikers looking to seek out the wreckage should do so at their own risk. It is apparently not immediately easy to find, and traversing the boulder field can be treacherous. However, those that can locate the torn metal will be privy to one of the more remote memorials in the country.
b7c710f1aa032230532a839e375db4f072ad2aee.translatedText: 想要尋找殘骸的健行者應該自行承擔風險。顯然，要立即找到它並不容易，而且穿過巨石場可能會很危險。然而，那些能夠找到撕裂金屬的人將了解該國較偏遠的紀念館之一。

fb9b12cb329df29d9e3a050d8488e30d89533f9d.sourceText: These days, Globe, Arizona is a quaint, rural outpost with a handful of antique shops, restaurants, and bars—a charming, one-movie-theater type of town. This wasn’t always the case, however. At one point in time, Globe was a veritable “Wild West” town, replete with all the stagecoach robberies, gunfights, and debauchery that often accompanied life on the frontier. When law and order found Globe, the methods of incarceration were still questionable at best, a fact plainly proven at the 1910 Gila County Sheriff's Office and Jail.
fb9b12cb329df29d9e3a050d8488e30d89533f9d.translatedText: 如今，亞利桑那州的格洛布 (Globe) 已成為一個古色古香的鄉村前哨，擁有幾家古董店、餐廳和酒吧，是一個迷人的只有電影院的小鎮。然而，情況並非總是如此。曾幾何時，格洛布是一座名副其實的「狂野西部」小鎮，邊境生活中經常發生驛站馬車搶劫、槍戰和放蕩事件。當法律和秩序建立在 Globe 的時候，監禁的方式充其量仍然是值得懷疑的，這一事實在 1910 年的吉拉縣治安官辦公室和監獄得到了清楚的證明。

2554b6eea60e843cbc5a06eb702e9ae236ca3257.sourceText: In operation until 1981, the jail turned museum retains decades of prisoners’ etchings, including names, dates, symbols, and colorful expressions. The steel cell locking mechanism—allegedly hauled in by mule from Yuma, AZ—was restored to full working order, such that visitors on guided tours can experience (very temporary) lockdown if they so wish. To fully appreciate the role this century-old jailhouse played in Globe, however, it’s important to take a quick look at why the building itself was needed.
2554b6eea60e843cbc5a06eb702e9ae236ca3257.translatedText: 這座由監獄改建的博物館一直運作到 1981 年，保留了數十年的囚犯蝕刻版畫，包括姓名、日期、符號和豐富多彩的表情。據稱由騾子從亞利桑那州尤馬拖運的鋼製單元鎖定裝置已恢復完全正常工作狀態，這樣，如果導遊願意的話，參加導遊的遊客可以體驗（非常暫時的）鎖定。然而，為了充分理解這座有百年歷史的監獄在環球監獄中所扮演的角色，快速了解為什麼需要這棟建築本身是很重要的。

e2b603f0c97b6ab80d30d35ff8fef6feb8ea2f47.sourceText: The land here, originally named besh-ba-gowah , or “place of metal” in Apache, drew settlers westward to mine its abundance of silver and copper deposits. From the time of its founding in 1876, Globe’s mining operations and population steadily swelled across the turn of the century, growing from 2,000 in 1890 to 16,000 in 1910. Given its remote location and proximity to the San Carlos Indian Reservation, Globe became something of an outlaw town, its residents alternately exchanging violence with neighboring Apaches and one another in typical Wild West fashion (the old Globe cemetery is packed with infamous outlaws of yesteryear, from Phin Clanton to Edwin Tewksbury ). Those convicted were initially jailed in Globe’s 1888 courthouse basement, though it quickly became overcrowded. A new courthouse built in 1906 also overflowed in short order (for added context, Globe only stopped using the town Hanging Tree when it caught fire in 1894 ).
e2b603f0c97b6ab80d30d35ff8fef6feb8ea2f47.translatedText: 這片土地最初被命名為 besh-ba-gowah，在阿帕奇語中意為“金屬之地”，吸引定居者向西開採其豐富的銀礦和銅礦。自 1876 年成立以來，格洛布的採礦作業和人口在世紀之交穩步增長，從 1890 年的 2,000 人增加到 1910 年的 16,000 人。由於地處偏遠且靠近聖卡洛斯印第安人保留地，格洛布變成了一個非法城鎮，其居民時而與鄰近的阿帕奇人發生暴力衝突，並以典型的狂野西部風格互相暴力（舊格洛布）公墓裡擠滿了昔日臭名昭著的亡命之徒，從菲恩·克蘭頓到埃德溫·圖克斯伯里。那些被定罪的人最初被關押在環球法院 1888 年的地下室裡，但很快就變得人滿為患。 1906 年建成的新法院大樓也很快就人滿為患（為了補充背景，Globe 直到 1894 年起火後才停止使用小鎮懸樹）。

c846780e6f46e8b564aa514f806cb7e5d7a6c1fd.sourceText: The original jailhouse built in 1910 was meant to be a solution to Globe’s dire incarceration situation. For inmates considered less of a security risk, the jail allowed a “Trusties” system, whereby select inmates could leave during the day to work jobs and return to the jail at night . They could not drink, visit their families, or deviate from their commute. They occupied the more spacious third floor of the jail, sleeping on army cots instead of the steel webbed beds seen in lower floors.
c846780e6f46e8b564aa514f806cb7e5d7a6c1fd.translatedText: 最初的監獄建於 1910 年，旨在解決 Globe 嚴峻的監禁狀況。對於安全風險較小的囚犯，監獄允許實行「信託」制度，選定的囚犯可以在白天離開去工作，晚上返回監獄。他們不能喝酒、探望家人或偏離通勤路線。他們佔據了監獄更寬敞的三樓，睡在軍床上，而不是較低樓層的鋼網床。

e6c496627664608670a8c743367762993a194e8b.sourceText: For those outside the Trusties system, however, conditions at the jail grew increasingly unsatisfactory with time. There was no heating or cooling in the building, despite searing summer highs and frigid winter lows common to any desert environment. To make matters worse, while each cell initially had its own sink and toilet, they were removed in the 1950s due to increased vandalism, leaving around 28 prisoners to one functioning bathroom. And while initially built to house 35 inmates, the population, like its predecessors, quickly exceeded that number, creating a cramped, miserable existence for prisoners here.
e6c496627664608670a8c743367762993a194e8b.translatedText: 然而，对于信托系统之外的人来说，随着时间的推移，监狱的条件越来越令人不满意。尽管夏季酷热、冬季寒冷，这在任何沙漠环境中都是常见的，但大楼内没有供暖或制冷。更糟的是，雖然每個牢房最初都有自己的水槽和廁所，但由於破壞行為增多，這些設施在 20 世紀 50 年代被拆除，只剩下大約 28 名囚犯住在一間正常使用的浴室裡。雖然最初建造時可容納 35 名囚犯，但與它的前身一樣，人口數量很快就超過了這個數字，使這裡的囚犯過著狹窄、悲慘的生活。

bba2df9c6cf64fbf979227fdcc9fb5ee440ff55d.sourceText: In the 1970s, regional newspapers exposed the deplorable conditions therein, leading the jail to finally shutter in 1981. The vacant jail fell into disrepair through the 1990s until it was preserved as the historical facility you can visit today. Just be thankful you can leave on your own accord.
bba2df9c6cf64fbf979227fdcc9fb5ee440ff55d.translatedText: 20 世纪 70 年代，当地报纸揭露了监狱的恶劣条件，导致监狱最终于 1981 年关闭。这座空置的监狱在 1990 年代年久失修，直到它被保留下来，作为您今天可以参观的历史设施。只要慶幸你可以自行離開。

e7bba1920b13b554b5133ba9e34f1b37b095ff95.sourceText: Brassy Arizona pioneers showed their true mettle when they forged the territory’s copper mining industry in the late 19th century. From avaricious pipedreams rose the famous Copper Queen claim in Bisbee, the vertigo inducing cliff-side operations of Jerome, and the vast pits of Morenci, the third largest copper mine in the world. Truly, Arizona’s history and legends can be unearthed from its mining culture.
e7bba1920b13b554b5133ba9e34f1b37b095ff95.translatedText: 黃銅色的亞利桑那州先驅者在 19 世紀末打造該地區的銅礦開採業時展現了他們的真正勇氣。從貪婪的白日夢中，誕生了著名的比斯比銅礦女王宣稱、傑羅姆令人眩暈的懸崖邊作業，以及世界第三大銅礦莫倫西的巨大礦坑。確實，亞利桑那州的歷史和傳說可以從其採礦文化中挖掘出來。

62ddaae472da6b1521c658915d8303418c83c3ae.sourceText: Today, Arizona is the largest copper-producing state in the U.S., heaving up 60-70 percent of the nation’s output. It is also a prodigious supplier of the copper-based mineral, turquoise, which jewelry aficionados will appreciate for giving the Southwest its distinctive blue-green chic.
62ddaae472da6b1521c658915d8303418c83c3ae.translatedText: 如今，亞利桑那州是美國最大的產銅州，產量佔全國的 60-70%。它也是銅基礦物綠松石的巨大供應商，珠寶愛好者會欣賞綠松石，因為綠松石賦予了西南部獨特的藍綠色別緻。

69a459a12dbcea19e643efa2726446cfe3665c6d.sourceText: The state may be better known for the Grand Canyon, but a copper star rightfully has pride of place in the center of the state flag. To top things off, the Arizona state capitol building is capped in copper.
69a459a12dbcea19e643efa2726446cfe3665c6d.translatedText: 該州可能因大峽谷而聞名，但銅星理所當然地在州旗中央佔有一席之地。最重要的是，亞利桑那州議會大廈的頂蓋是銅的。

568fe251b49a9be162f0b7b55e7e3808943b7495.sourceText: Celebrating this heritage is the Copper Art Museum in Clarkdale (a former smelting town near Jerome), which traces the metal’s pedigree around the world and through the millennia, presenting galleries filled floor to ceiling with thousands of objects from the past 500 years.
568fe251b49a9be162f0b7b55e7e3808943b7495.translatedText: 克拉克代爾（傑羅姆附近的一個前冶煉小鎮）的銅藝術博物館慶祝了這一遺產，該博物館追溯了金屬在世界各地和數千年的血統，展示的畫廊從地板到天花板都陳列著過去 500 年的數千件物品。

6ad946db752e8daf9c853748c6bb7f2c29867e93.sourceText: Botticelli’s Venus greets visitors in one room as a reminder that her astrological symbol (and the symbol for sexual desire) is also the alchemist’s symbol for copper. Pots and pans festoon another room representing copper’s role in serving different appetites, and a stillness fills the air in the drinkware collection gallery. Not to be missed is the military art collection which features “trench art” from World War I and II. On display are brass artillery shell casings intricately carved into works of ironic sublimity by soldiers while they waited between paroxysms of battle.
6ad946db752e8daf9c853748c6bb7f2c29867e93.translatedText: 波提切利的維納斯在一個房間裡迎接遊客，提醒人們她的占星符號（以及性慾的符號）也是煉金術士的銅符號。另一個房間裡擺滿了鍋碗瓢盆，代表著銅在滿足不同口味方面的作用，飲料收藏畫廊裡空氣中瀰漫著寂靜。不容錯過的是軍事藝術收藏，其中包括第一次世界大戰和第二次世界大戰的「戰壕藝術」。展出的黃銅砲彈外殼是士兵們在戰鬥間歇期等待時精心雕刻而成的具有諷刺意味的崇高作品。

500397f577e330756426b77397fe73cd2c34d8d2.sourceText: In Clarkdale, the story of copper is the full story of the human condition. To "Cu" there would only make cents.
500397f577e330756426b77397fe73cd2c34d8d2.translatedText: 在克拉克代爾，銅的故事就是人類狀況的完整故事。對「Cu」來說，只會賺到美分。

e28698b52ef2a22b9bb305e948c7a912a24436eb.sourceText: Artifacts from a battleship sunk at Pearl Harbor displayed in the Capitol building of its namesake.
e28698b52ef2a22b9bb305e948c7a912a24436eb.translatedText: 珍珠港事件中沉沒戰艦的文物陳列在同名的國會大廈內。

44d5807d4383ef1e8f1db96c2e6d88965b05abfe.sourceText: The biggest solar telescope in the world helps reveal the secrets of our sun.
44d5807d4383ef1e8f1db96c2e6d88965b05abfe.translatedText: 世界上最大的太陽望遠鏡有助於揭示太陽的秘密。

297d966fedc13230da6ab19eb588954ca09df750.sourceText: A beautiful piece of history in a very remote area that allowed ranchers to move their herds.
297d966fedc13230da6ab19eb588954ca09df750.translatedText: 在一個非常偏遠的地區，有一段美麗的歷史，允許牧場主移動他們的牛群。

0656eb737e0060c172f3f7f30cc83220108aa280.sourceText: One of America's oldest stadiums was also the site of one of the most brutal anti-labor acts in American history.
0656eb737e0060c172f3f7f30cc83220108aa280.translatedText: 美國最古老的體育場之一也是美國歷史上最殘酷的反勞工行為之一的發生地。

f18196270313296206e8606dce407bb1ef93de72.sourceText: Don Parks first began collecting miscellaneous antiques in high school, when his grandfather gifted him a 1923 Ford Model T. In the late 1960s, he began decorating his house with his prized possessions, including a Paul Bunyan Muffler Man purchased from a Bay Area gas station.
f18196270313296206e8606dce407bb1ef93de72.translatedText: 唐·帕克斯 (Don Parks) 第一次開始收集各種古董是在高中，當時他的祖父送給他一輛 1923 年福特 T 型車。 1960 年代末，他開始用自己珍貴的物品裝飾自己的房子，其中包括從灣區加油站購買的保羅·班揚消音器人 (Paul Bunyan Muffler Man)。

8ef289a9fcfbe5ab4c7764b23a9671ff811be35f.sourceText: In 1971, Parks bought his current home. Since, its yard has become filled to the brim with many kinds of outdoor decor, from signage to statues. Over the years, Parks sourced items from second-hand stores, swap meets, and anywhere else that might sell such antiques. The collection's first item, the 23-foot-tall statue of Paul Bunyan, was sold in 2024. Although he does occasionally sell pieces, his collection has generally continued to grow. Parks even bought a second property across the street to more than double the space available, in addition to items he keeps in his houses and backyards.
8ef289a9fcfbe5ab4c7764b23a9671ff811be35f.translatedText: 1971 年，帕克斯買下了他現在的家。從那時起，它的院子裡就充滿了各種各樣的戶外裝飾，從標誌到雕像。多年來，帕克斯從二手商店、舊物交換會以及其他可能出售此類古董的地方採購物品。該系列的第一件作品是 23 英尺高的保羅班揚 (Paul Bunyan) 雕像，於 2024 年售出。儘管他偶爾會出售作品，但他的收藏總體上持續增長。帕克斯甚至在街對面買了第二處房產，除了他在自己的房子和後院存放的物品之外，還購買了第二處房產，使可用空間增加了一倍以上。

e83e526446a8afb596fa78daba9922b7c0a16d0f.sourceText: Many of the statues are taken from pop culture, while others are from the defunct Legend City amusement park near Papago Park. There are also a myriad of highway signs from various states, as well as mock signs for outer space. Spot the McDonald's Golden Arches on one roof, and the dog with a giant pair of glasses on the other.
e83e526446a8afb596fa78daba9922b7c0a16d0f.translatedText: 許多雕像取自流行文化，而其他雕像則來自巴巴哥公園附近已不復存在的傳奇城遊樂園。還有來自各州的無數高速公路標誌，以及外太空的模擬標誌。一個屋頂上有麥當勞的金色拱門，另一個屋頂上有一隻戴著巨大眼鏡的狗。

487edd0eb59812a4493ddd5ad7a6b8a02af5ca0c.sourceText: This is private property, but the owner encourages visitors to admire his collection from the sidewalk. Don may be willing to coordinate tours over the phone. Call (480) 381-6332.
487edd0eb59812a4493ddd5ad7a6b8a02af5ca0c.translatedText: 這是私人財產，但業主鼓勵遊客在人行道上欣賞他的收藏。唐可能願意透過電話協調旅行。請致電 (480) 381-6332。

186d7efc1fd2848d9394191ed5b47544a4b2a8dd.sourceText: On February 24, 1863, the western half of the New Mexico territory of the United States was split to form the new territory of Arizona . The new territory's capital was temporarily housed in the military base of Fort Whipple until appropriate buildings could be built in the nearby to-be capital of Prescott. It was here that Arizona's first territorial governor, John Goodwin, built the Governor's Mansion to house the first government of the southwestern territory.
186d7efc1fd2848d9394191ed5b47544a4b2a8dd.translatedText: 1863年2月24日，美國新墨西哥領土的西半部被分割，形成新的亞利桑那領土。新領地的首都暫時設在惠普爾堡軍事基地，直到附近的未來首都普雷斯科特能夠建造適當的建築。正是在這裡，亞利桑那州第一任領地總督約翰古德溫 (John Goodwin) 建造了州長官邸，以容納西南領地的第一屆政府。

dded52fef9f84098c7027814395178115b99df6d.sourceText: Settlers in the area began pushing for New Mexico to be divided into two territories for a few reasons. The white settlers of New Mexico wanted to partition off a sparsely populated area of their territory and forcibly relocate the Native Americans in New Mexico to there. Meanwhile, the settlers of what would become Arizona bristled at being governed by the faraway New Mexico capital of Santa Fe and wanted a more local government. The federal government, however, was more concerned with the growing tension between the North and the South that would soon erupt into a civil war and didn't take any action.
dded52fef9f84098c7027814395178115b99df6d.translatedText: 該地區的定居者出於某些原因開始推動將新墨西哥州分為兩個領地。新墨西哥州的白人定居者想要隔離他們領土上人口稀少的地區，並強行將新墨西哥州的美洲原住民遷移到那裡。同時，後來成為亞利桑那州的定居者對被遙遠的新墨西哥州首府聖塔菲管轄感到憤怒，並希望建立一個更地方政府化的政府。然而聯邦政府更擔心南北之間日益緊張的局勢，很快就會爆發內戰，沒有採取任何行動。

03ff779761e1fbd7d5a9f9b3bd29a2a883503a44.sourceText: But as it turns out, events during the American Civil War are what finally pushed the federal government to act. In 1861, delegates met in Tucson and declared Arizona a separate territory allied with the Confederacy. Then, in 1862, Confederate troops pushed into New Mexico with the intent of eventually capturing territory in California . President Abraham Lincoln dispatched troops to the region to restore order and Congress split the New Mexico territory so the federal government would have more direct administrative control over the previously neglected Arizona region.
03ff779761e1fbd7d5a9f9b3bd29a2a883503a44.translatedText: 但事實證明，美國內戰期間發生的事件最終促使聯邦政府採取行動。 1861 年，代表們在圖森舉行會議，宣布亞利桑那州為與南部邦聯結盟的獨立領土。隨後，1862 年，南方聯盟軍隊挺進新墨西哥州，意圖最終佔領加州的領土。亞伯拉罕·林肯總統派遣軍隊前往該地區恢復秩序，國會分割了新墨西哥州領土，以便聯邦政府對以前被忽視的亞利桑那州地區擁有更直接的行政控制權。

b95e696f68bbcac75e5a7b4d6ce865f118334727.sourceText: Abraham Lincoln appointed John Noble Goodwin to serve as Arizona's first governor. Goodwin was a politician from Maine who had never before been to the western United States. His first task was to select where the capital would be. Goodwin chose the small frontier settlement of Prescott in northern Arizona instead of the larger town of Tucson, which was perceived as being full of Confederate sympathizers.
b95e696f68bbcac75e5a7b4d6ce865f118334727.translatedText: 亞伯拉罕·林肯任命約翰·諾貝爾·古德溫為亞利桑那州第一任州長。古德溫是一位來自緬因州的政治家，此前從未去過美國西部。他的首要任務是選擇首都在哪裡。古德溫選擇了亞利桑那州北部的邊境小定居點普雷斯科特，而不是較大的城鎮圖森，因為圖森被認為充滿了南方邦聯的同情者。

418d46e5b52e863275d44159e67ed0738c528d16.sourceText: Goodwin had a log cabin built in Prescott to serve as his residence. Although modestly sized by modern standards, in hardscrabble Arizona the building was called a mansion. In the early days of the territory essentially all of the governing of Arizona was done in this log cabin. Goodwin only served as governor until 1866 when he was elected as the territory's non-voting representative in Congress and traveled back east, never to return to Arizona. Goodwin's successor as governor, Richard McCormick, also used the Governor's Mansion as his residence.
418d46e5b52e863275d44159e67ed0738c528d16.translatedText: 古德溫在普雷斯科特建造了一間小木屋作為他的住所。儘管以現代標準來看，這棟建築的規模不大，但在貧困的亞利桑那州，這棟建築被稱為豪宅。在該領土的早期，基本上亞利桑那州的所有管理工作都是在這個小木屋中完成的。古德溫只擔任州長，直到 1866 年被選為該領土在國會的無投票權代表，然後返回東部，再也沒有返回亞利桑那州。古德溫的繼任者理查德·麥考密克也將州長官邸作為他的住所。

4fe78ba8cdaea0a2f2dd3b3bd1b1d7c755fdff06.sourceText: In 1868, Arizona's capital was moved from Prescott to Tucson, although it was moved back to Prescott in 1877 before moving to Phoenix in 1889, where it has been since. Arizona became the 48th state of the United States in 1912. In 1928, the old Governor's Mansion became the home of Sharlot Hall, a poet and historian, and she opened it to the public as a museum. To this day, the Governor's Mansion is the centerpiece of the Sharlot Hall Museum, which has expanded out from the original mansion and now displays a history of Arizona.
4fe78ba8cdaea0a2f2dd3b3bd1b1d7c755fdff06.translatedText: 1868 年，亞利桑那州首府從普雷斯科特遷至圖森，但又於 1877 年遷回普雷斯科特，並於 1889 年遷至菲尼克斯，此後一直在那裡。 1912年，亞利桑那州成為美國第48州。 1928年，舊州長官邸成為詩人和歷史學家夏洛特·霍爾的住所，她將其作為博物館向公眾開放。時至今日，州長官邸仍然是沙洛特霍爾博物館的核心部分，該博物館從原來的官邸擴建而來，現在展示了亞利桑那州的歷史。
