6b9ac06024c56ef20814e47d39823f8870c0f861.sourceText: Just outside of Vail, Arizona , is what is believed to be the largest known dry cave in the United States . Its human history is just as fascinating as its geology.
6b9ac06024c56ef20814e47d39823f8870c0f861.translatedText: 亞利桑那州韋爾郊外有據信是美國已知最大的乾燥洞穴。它的人類歷史和它的地質一樣令人著迷。

8e28bad643222e959aedde2f5bdd2e043f6d7127.sourceText: The mummified bodies of two members of the Hohokam Nation were discovered in Colossal Cave. Local folklore and historic sources also indicate it has been used at least once as a hideout by train robbers, who allegedly stashed gold within its depths.
8e28bad643222e959aedde2f5bdd2e043f6d7127.translatedText: 在巨大洞穴中發現了兩名霍霍卡姆民族成員的木乃伊屍體。當地的民間傳說和歷史資料還表明，它至少曾被火車劫匪用作藏身之處，據稱他們在其深處藏匿了黃金。

3ae177ce877e4fbd50a05688b29e53bacef698de.sourceText: It would’ve made a great hideout spot, too, as Colossal Cave extends approximately 600 feet into the mountain. It’s considered a dry or dead cave because the water source is no longer active, and as a result, the cave’s geological features are no longer growing.
3ae177ce877e4fbd50a05688b29e53bacef698de.translatedText: 它也將成為一個絕佳的藏身處，因為巨大的洞穴向山中延伸了大約 600 英尺。它被認為是一個乾燥或死亡的洞穴，因為水源不再活躍，因此，洞穴的地質特徵不再生長。

a92bab582629933c465611139d4d062fd855282b.sourceText: The geological formations within the cave are quite impressive, though some have been damaged by relic seekers in the past. It’s is also quite comfortable, as the interior temperature remains at a nearly uniform 71 degrees Fahrenheit throughout the year. The fact that Colossal Cave is “fixed in time” and no longer living makes it quite a unique place to visit and tour.
a92bab582629933c465611139d4d062fd855282b.translatedText: 洞穴內的地質構造非常令人印象深刻，儘管有些過去曾被遺跡搜尋者破壞。它也非常舒適，因為室內溫度全年幾乎保持在 71 華氏度。事實上，巨大洞穴「隨著時間的推移而固定」且不再存在，這使其成為一個非常獨特的參觀和遊覽地點。

521bbec662d42f383860a130f0559b28e3385cb3.sourceText: Though previously known to Native Americans, Colossal Cave didn’t gain attention from the colonial settlers until a man named Solomon Lick stumbled upon it in 1879. Prior to 1912, the cave was known by several names, including Five Mile Cave, Arizona Catacombs, and Mountain Springs Cave.
521bbec662d42f383860a130f0559b28e3385cb3.translatedText: 儘管以前為美洲原住民所熟知，但直到 1879 年一位名叫所羅門·利克 (Solomon Lick) 的人偶然發現了它，巨大洞穴才引起了殖民定居者的注意。在 1912 年之前，該洞穴有多個名稱，包括五英里洞穴 (Five Mile Cave)、亞利桑那地下墓穴 (Arizona Catacombs) 和山泉洞穴 (Mountain Springs Cave)。

4c1c8518e43d09a9d928ddd635cce0fc3b7cf4ef.sourceText: During the Depression Era, the Civilian Conservation Corps made improvements to the cave so that it was easier to provide tours. The cave has also been used as the backdrop for a number of low budget films.
4c1c8518e43d09a9d928ddd635cce0fc3b7cf4ef.translatedText: 在大蕭條時期，民間保護隊對洞穴進行了改進，以便更容易提供遊覽服務。該洞穴也被用作許多低成本電影的背景。

d144caa55f1303f0a541591175cf9a5c9ff0d3cb.sourceText: Rock Art Ranch, near Winslow , Arizona , is a privately owned cattle ranch that is a true wonder of the Old West. The property has more than just cattle and bison: It features excavated Anasazi dwellings, a Navajo hogan and sweat lodge, and amazingly well-preserved examples of petroglyphs carved by American natives.
d144caa55f1303f0a541591175cf9a5c9ff0d3cb.translatedText: 岩石藝術牧場 (Rock Art Ranch) 位於亞利桑那州溫斯洛 (Winslow) 附近，是一個私人養牛場，是老西部真正的奇蹟。該地產不僅有牛和野牛，還包括出土的阿納薩茲 (Anasazi) 住宅、納瓦霍霍根 (Navajo hogan) 和汗水小屋，以及保存完好的美國原住民雕刻的岩畫。

cd13c3d23d0d7adb49d610f5e2e37b3bf328d016.sourceText: Archaeological records show that people have been passing through the area for 13,000 years. Hunting and gathering groups, semi nomadic farmers, and later sedentary farmers have left their mark on the land.
cd13c3d23d0d7adb49d610f5e2e37b3bf328d016.translatedText: 考古記錄顯示，13,000 年前就有人經過該地區。狩獵和採集群體、半遊牧農民以及後來的定居農民都在這片土地上留下了他們的印記。

bf609b584ce069997e366b112d7ee651cb48b26d.sourceText: The area is still considered to be an active sacred site; over 3,000 petroglyphs have been found throughout the property, most of which are dated from between 5000 BC to 1400 AD. The petroglyphs, which were made by carving into the rock’s surface, line the walls of an accessible two-mile canyon. Images of animals, people, and unknown symbols are easy to spot. One particularly imposing and beautiful petroglyph is of the Mother Of Game, whose life-sized image graces one of the stone escarpments.
bf609b584ce069997e366b112d7ee651cb48b26d.translatedText: 該地區仍然被認為是一個活躍的聖地；整個莊園內發現了 3,000 多塊岩畫，其中大部分可追溯到公元前 5000 年至公元 1400 年之間。這些岩畫是透過在岩石表面雕刻而成的，排列在可進入的兩英里峽谷的牆壁上。動物、人物和未知符號的圖像很容易被發現。一幅特別雄偉而美麗的岩石畫是“遊戲之母”，其真人大小的圖像裝飾著其中一處石崖。

c233ef95e1a20febf63c8d1573ac3d342e1ca291.sourceText: Brantley Baird, the owner and proprietor who has lived on the ranch since 1948, allows visitors to stop by and see the petroglyphs. Though not academically trained, Baird discovered many of the sites himself and believed it was important to share them with the public. He has a modest but fascinating museum on the grounds that offers American Indian artifacts found on site, as well as cowboy and pioneer items. Baird opens his ranch to academic archeologists that assist in the excavation and interpretation of the artifacts.
c233ef95e1a20febf63c8d1573ac3d342e1ca291.translatedText: 布蘭特利貝爾德 (Brantley Baird) 自 1948 年以來一直居住在牧場上，他允許遊客駐足觀賞岩畫。儘管沒有接受過學術培訓，貝爾德還是自己發現了許多網站，並認為與公眾分享這些網站很重要。他有一個樸素但迷人的博物館，展示現場發現的美洲印第安人文物，以及牛仔和拓荒者的物品。貝爾德向學術考古學家開放他的牧場，協助挖掘和解釋文物。

e9a42da3f3f78768cc0a7eeb5926f30ee63def87.sourceText: President James Garfield was shot by an assassin only a few months into his term in 1881, and died from that wound several months later. Before his death, Garfield had been an ardent supporter of African-American rights. As an officer in the Union Army during the Civil War, he saw the conflict as a righteous crusade against the evils of slavery.
e9a42da3f3f78768cc0a7eeb5926f30ee63def87.translatedText: 1881 年，詹姆斯·加菲爾德總統在上任幾個月後被刺客槍殺，幾個月後因傷死亡。加菲貓去世前一直是非裔美國人權利的熱情支持者。身為內戰期間聯邦軍隊的軍官，他將這場衝突視為針對奴隸制罪惡的正義十字軍。

50f72defc4227837939c7587a9a75d645b89d0f7.sourceText: The 10th U.S. Cavalry, a unit of African-Americans soldiers more familiarly known as the "Buffalo Soldiers," were stationed in Bonita Canyon in the southeastern corner of the Arizona Territory in 1885. The U.S. military was campaigning there against members of the Chiricahua Apache, led by Geronimo, who had managed to escape from their forced confinement on a reservation and were now fighting for self-determination in their ancestral homelands.
50f72defc4227837939c7587a9a75d645b89d0f7.translatedText: 美國第 10 騎兵團是一支由非裔美國人士兵組成的部隊，人們更熟悉的名稱是“布法羅士兵”，1885 年駐紮在亞利桑那州東南角的博尼塔峽谷。美軍在那裡開展反奴隸制活動。由傑羅尼莫 (Geronimo) 領導的奇里卡瓦阿帕奇 (Chiricahua Apache) 成員，他們成功地逃離了在保留地的強制監禁，現在正在為自己祖先的家園爭取自決權而奮鬥。

016e2dbfd2c0b9873211acccf28ba9a7d232533e.sourceText: Because of his lifetime of strong positions on civil rights and abolition, Garfield was a highly regarded figure among the Buffalo Soldiers. So when the military campaign against the Chiricahua Apache and Geronimo never actively reached Bonita Canyon, the soldiers decided to build a memorial to the late president with their spare time. They used the volcanic rhyolite stones in the area to construct a three-tiered monument. On the largest block they wrote a dedication, and on the smaller blocks they carved personal messages, usually their names or initials and the year.
016e2dbfd2c0b9873211acccf28ba9a7d232533e.translatedText: 由於加菲貓一生在民權和廢奴問題上持強硬立場，他在布法羅士兵中是一位備受尊敬的人物。因此，當針對奇里卡瓦阿帕奇和傑羅尼莫的軍事行動從未積極到達博尼塔峽谷時，士兵們決定利用業餘時間為已故總統建造一座紀念碑。他們利用該地區的火山流紋岩建造了一座三層紀念碑。他們在最大的一塊上寫下奉獻詞，在較小的區塊上刻上個人訊息，通常是他們的名字或縮寫和年份。

b30ae15369df2ab68619eae9683955ea2a1768cd.sourceText: In September of 1886, Geronimo surrendered to the U.S. Army and the 10th U.S. Cavalry was recalled from Bonita Canyon. As years passed, the Buffalo Soldiers' memorial to the assassinated president was at risk of being lost. Wind and weather had worn the monument down and visitors to the area had begun to chisel off pieces to keep as souvenirs.
b30ae15369df2ab68619eae9683955ea2a1768cd.translatedText: 1886 年 9 月，傑羅尼莫向美國陸軍投降，美國第 10 騎兵團從博尼塔峽谷被召回。隨著時間的推移，布法羅士兵紀念被暗殺總統的紀念碑面臨著失去的危險。風和天氣已經磨損了這座紀念碑，該地區的遊客開始鑿下一些碎片作為紀念品。

65d0f9182e73f34af5def7fc2a29d9fe902b76a4.sourceText: A man named Neil Erickson, who's Faraway Ranch neighbored the area, began a fruitless effort to save the monument. Erickson spent years writing letters to politicians and military commanders in Washington , D.C., along with members of the Garfield family in Ohio , trying to get the rock monument official recognition and protection, but never received any support in his campaign. Years later, his daughter and her husband, Lillian and Ed Riggs, took over the ranch and came up with a unique idea: to disassemble the threatened monument and incorporate the stones into a fireplace in their ranch house. It would allow the monument to be saved, albeit not in its original form. Reluctantly, in 1920, Erickson allowed Ed and Lillian to go through with their unorthodox plan to save the memorial.
65d0f9182e73f34af5def7fc2a29d9fe902b76a4.translatedText: 一位名叫尼爾·埃里克森（Neil Erickson）的男子是該地區附近的法拉威牧場（Faraway Ranch），他開始了拯救這座紀念碑的努力，但徒勞無功。艾瑞克森花了數年時間給華盛頓特區的政治家和軍事指揮官以及俄亥俄州的加菲貓家族成員寫信，試圖獲得岩石紀念碑的官方認可和保護，但他的競選活動從未得到任何支持。多年後，他的女兒和她的丈夫莉蓮·里格斯 (Lillian Riggs) 和埃德·里格斯 (Ed Riggs) 接管了牧場，並提出了一個獨特的想法：拆除受威脅的紀念碑，並將這些石頭合併到他們牧場房屋的壁爐中。這將使紀念碑得以保存，儘管不是以其原始形式。 1920 年，艾瑞克森不情願地允許艾德和莉蓮實施他們拯救紀念碑的非正統計畫。

977e1a61a389d57e595bf037f32ffedc2cbe47a0.sourceText: Ed Riggs was also integral in the effort to get federal protection for rock pillar formations in the nearby mountains—what he called the “Wonderland of Rocks"—which were preserved as Chiricahua National Monument in 1924. In 1979, the family sold the ranch property to the federal government and it was incorporated into the national monument. Today, visitors to Chiricahua can visit Faraway Ranch and see the fireplace on the ranch house, with its dedication to an assassinated president from long ago, and the carved signatures of the Buffalo Soldiers who briefly inhabited the canyon.
977e1a61a389d57e595bf037f32ffedc2cbe47a0.translatedText: 艾德·里格斯 (Ed Riggs) 也參與了為附近山區的岩柱地層爭取聯邦保護的努力，他稱之為“岩石仙境”，這些山區於 1924 年被保存為奇里卡瓦國家紀念碑。 1979 年，該家族將牧場財產出售給聯邦政府，並將其納入國家紀念碑。如今，奇里卡瓦的遊客可以參觀遙遠牧場，參觀牧場房屋上的壁爐，上面刻著很久以前被暗殺的總統的名字，以及曾短暫居住在峽谷的布法羅士兵的雕刻簽名。

8dafd60859905909e9264c2162d260be2e5fb2e9.sourceText: Banner Urgent Care is listed within Peoria Lee Lee center in Peoria. This profile was generated from plaza directory sources and map-based verification, so direct business contact details may still be incomplete.
8dafd60859905909e9264c2162d260be2e5fb2e9.translatedText: 班納緊急護理 (Banner Urgent Care) 位於皮奧裡亞 (Peoria) 的 Peoria Lee Lee 中心。此設定檔是根據廣場目錄來源和基於地圖的驗證產生的，因此直接業務聯絡詳細資訊可能仍然不完整。

6c771c25f4ac590eee188632e5dedf1b55c9f316.sourceText: There is a Continental Divide marker in the small town of Bisbee . Its high and lonely spot along Old Divide Road seems like it should be the top of Arizona , but its placement doesn't tell the whole story of Mule Pass.
6c771c25f4ac590eee188632e5dedf1b55c9f316.translatedText: 比斯比小鎮有一個大陸分水嶺標記。它位於舊分水嶺路 (Old Divide Road) 上的一個高而偏僻的地方，看起來應該是亞利桑那州的山頂，但它的位置並不能說明穆爾山口 (Mule Pass) 的全部故事。

2d79c580bf6d37ae4784821b9ac7087646e98342.sourceText: When the road over Mule Pass was built in 1913 and 1914, it was done by prison labor. The stubby concrete obelisk that marks the pass was placed here partly to proclaim that fact, as well as memorialize the triumph of pavement over nature. But for some reason the marker added another claim: that Mule Pass was right on top of the Continental Divide, the invisible line separating the watersheds of the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans.
2d79c580bf6d37ae4784821b9ac7087646e98342.translatedText: 1913 年和 1914 年修建穆爾山口 (Mule Pass) 上的道路時，它是由監獄勞工完成的。標記通道的粗短混凝土方尖碑被放置在這裡，部分是為了宣告這一事實，並紀念人行道對大自然的勝利。但由於某種原因，標記又添加了另一個說法：穆爾山口就位於大陸分水嶺的頂部，這是一條分隔大西洋和太平洋分水嶺的無形線。

ffc9c7d852ae276a187a6cbf2093b74d7fb7b0a7.sourceText: That line, however, lies about 120 miles to the east, along a low rise in New Mexico . Whether they flow west into the San Pedro River or east into Whitewater Draw, the rains that fall on Mule Pass both eventually empty out into the Sea of Cortez, and onto the Pacific Ocean.
ffc9c7d852ae276a187a6cbf2093b74d7fb7b0a7.translatedText: 然而，這條線位於以東約 120 英里處，沿著新墨西哥州的一座低矮山丘。無論向西流入聖佩德羅河，或是向東流入懷特沃特德拉，落在穆爾山口的雨水最終都會流入科爾特斯海和太平洋。

17e6a7ea764791b5d55a5af4798464908dd2b2e7.sourceText: Bisbee, Arizona, is a former boom-town that nearly went bust, just down the road from the more famous Tombstone . This small mining community once pulled millions of dollars out of the ground, and until the Mule Pass Tunnel (which runs through the mountain down underneath the marker) was completed in the 1950s, the ride up and over the winding switchbacks of the Mule Mountains was the only way into town from Tucson or Tombstone.
17e6a7ea764791b5d55a5af4798464908dd2b2e7.translatedText: 亞利桑那州比斯比是一個曾經的繁榮小鎮，現在幾乎破產了，就在更著名的墓碑鎮的路上。這個小型採礦社區曾經從地下開採了數百萬美元，直到 20 世紀 50 年代穆爾山口隧道（穿過標記下方的山脈）竣工之前，沿著穆爾山脈蜿蜒的之字形路線向上行駛是從圖森或墓碑鎮進城的唯一途徑。

23baf9530eb23fd5a55dd0e9f8cf387aadbbfaac.sourceText: History hasn’t preserved how or why the erroneous Continental Divide claim came to be memorialized at Mule Pass, but the roadside pull-off is still worth a stop—whether you are looking to the east at Bisbee's Tombstone Canyon, gazing west out over the San Pedro Valley toward the Huachuca Mountains, or simply contemplating geography errors.
23baf9530eb23fd5a55dd0e9f8cf387aadbbfaac.translatedText: 歷史並沒有記錄錯誤的大陸分水嶺主張是如何或為何在穆勒山口被紀念的，但路邊的停車點仍然值得停下來——無論您是向東看比斯比墓碑峽谷，向西眺望聖佩德羅山谷向瓦丘卡山脈，還是只是思考地理錯誤。

ba23e571e884e9ac021edf782af86e8885c6df2e.sourceText: In 1928, the Gadsden Hotel was ravaged by fire, leaving only the elevator intact but with nowhere to go. The remedy was to rebuild the hotel (first was constructed in 1907), but on a much grander scale. No expense was spared: The latest technologies, including early air-conditioning and a state-of-the-art switchboard, were installed, and the most luxurious accommodations were outfitted with every amenity including bathrooms in every room. The new hotel was designed to thrill and inspire its guests, and the centerpiece was the creation of its stained-glass windows of the Sonoran Desert landscape.
ba23e571e884e9ac021edf782af86e8885c6df2e.translatedText: 1928年，加茲登酒店遭遇火災，僅留下電梯完好無損，卻無處可去。補救措施是重建酒店（第一座酒店建於 1907 年），但規模要大得多。不遺餘力：安裝了最新的技術，包括早期的空調和最先進的總機，最豪華的住宿配備了一切便利設施，包括每個房間的浴室。新酒店的設計旨在讓客人感到興奮和鼓舞，其核心是索諾蘭沙漠景觀的彩色玻璃窗。

c288a22b1271f8485c4cd1fe88d70f9931e11798.sourceText: Ralph Baker (1886-1961) designed these eye-dazzling windows while working for L.W. Hoffecker's stained glass studios in El Paso where he moved following a stint in the army during World War I. Baker originally learned his craft from his father, who once operated a workshop in New York City along with his grandfather who was originally a noted artisanal glazier in London . To hone his craft, Baker studied with Louis Comfort Tiffany for more than a year, and distinct Tiffanic influences are evident in the Gadsden windows.
c288a22b1271f8485c4cd1fe88d70f9931e11798.translatedText: 拉爾夫·貝克（1886-1961）在為 L.W. 工作時設計了這些令人眼花繚亂的窗戶。霍夫克 (Hoffecker) 的彩色玻璃工作室位於埃爾帕索 (El Paso)，第一次世界大戰期間，他在軍隊服役一段時間後搬到了那裡。貝克最初是從他的父親那裡學到了他的手藝，他的父親曾與他的祖父一起在紐約市經營一家工作室，祖父原本是倫敦著名的手工玻璃工。為了磨練他的技藝，貝克跟隨路易斯康福特蒂芙尼學習了一年多，加茲登的窗戶明顯受到了蒂芙尼的獨特影響。

2e7eab66967b97687db1d1eb3fb77cee5614812b.sourceText: Framed by the windows is a western-themed painting by Audley Dean Nichols (1875-1941) entitled Cave Creek Canyon - Chiricahua Mountains . Known as one of the “Purple Mountain Painters,” Nichols was a prominent member of a group of artists who popularized and mythologized western landscapes. His work continues to feature conspicuously in exhibitions of western art, and the Gadsden painting is often cited as one of his finest creations.
2e7eab66967b97687db1d1eb3fb77cee5614812b.translatedText: 窗戶旁掛著奧德利·迪恩·尼科爾斯（Audley Dean Nichols，1875-1941 年）創作的一幅西部主題畫作，題為《洞穴溪峽谷 - 奇里卡瓦山脈》。尼科爾斯被稱為「紫金山畫家」之一，他是普及和神化西方風景的藝術家群體中的傑出成員。他的作品繼續在西方藝術展覽中引人注目，加茲登的畫作經常被認為是他最好的創作之一。

42243cda42ec9cfacf184d1428cd02a58a4b4355.sourceText: Baker’s work, likewise, is acclaimed throughout the Southwest, especially the Gadsden installation. Sadly, the Great Depression shattered the stained glass business, and in the 1930s, Baker beveled toward the general and auto glass fields. However, the family business is still around and continues to operate several offices in El Paso to this day.
42243cda42ec9cfacf184d1428cd02a58a4b4355.translatedText: 貝克的作品同樣在整個西南地區廣受好評，尤其是加茲登的裝置作品。遺憾的是，大蕭條摧毀了彩色玻璃產業，在 20 世紀 30 年代，貝克轉向通用玻璃和汽車玻璃領域。然而，家族企業至今仍在埃爾帕索經營多個辦事處。

425f5baf41ac9ba6506617bf8bf8f2a56559c69b.sourceText: Meanwhile, the Gadsden Hotel similarly experienced its share of vicissitudes. At its height, the hotel hosted Hollywood glitterati like Paul Newman and Ava Gardner as studios hustled to satisfy the public’s appetite for old west movies, some of which were filmed in and around Douglas. But, as with all things, the hotel eventually fell into disrepair. Happily, in 2016, the hotel was purchased with the intent to restore its former glory, and it is reemerging a focal point of the city.
425f5baf41ac9ba6506617bf8bf8f2a56559c69b.translatedText: 同時，加茲登酒店也同樣經歷了滄桑。在其鼎盛時期，該酒店接待了保羅紐曼和艾娃加德納等好萊塢名流，而製片廠則忙著滿足公眾對老西部電影的胃口，其中一些電影是在道格拉斯及其周邊地區拍攝的。但是，就像所有事情一樣，這家酒店最終年久失修。令人高興的是，2016 年，酒店被收購，旨在恢復昔日的輝煌，它正在重新成為城市的焦點。

28930260a629a3c04ef786631868ff04cf35b9e5.sourceText: Today, guests entering the cavernous reception hall can once again marvel at the hotel’s artwork and soaring pink marble columns with 24k gold leafing gleaming from the empyrean light permeating Baker’s windows.
28930260a629a3c04ef786631868ff04cf35b9e5.translatedText: 今天，進入寬敞的接待大廳的客人可以再次驚嘆於酒店的藝術品和高聳的粉紅色大理石柱，24k 金箔在貝克窗戶透入的天空光線下閃閃發光。

55942451fbdda24d5afcfdbbd35b444221200abd.sourceText: Tombstone, Arizona’s Boothill Graveyard is famous for the "Wild West" outlaws buried inside. However, this small graveyard is also home to many lesser-known residents of the legendary boomtown.
55942451fbdda24d5afcfdbbd35b444221200abd.translatedText: 亞利桑那州墓碑鎮的布特希爾墓園因埋葬在其中的「狂野西部」亡命之徒而聞名。然而，這個小墓園也是這座傳奇新興城市的許多鮮為人知的居民的家園。

5ffa7d9e584e33e646d03c8dce1e0e05909ca51e.sourceText: The city cemetery was established in 1879 (though it wasn't named Boothill until the 1920's) and it was only open for a few years until 1884, before it filled up with Tombstone's dearly departed. The burial ground included an interesting area separated from the main cemetery, which was set aside for the Jewish residents of Tombstone, and Cochise County. Most western graveyards of the day did not have a section for Jewish internments.
5ffa7d9e584e33e646d03c8dce1e0e05909ca51e.translatedText: 這座城市墓地建於 1879 年（儘管直到 1920 年代才被命名為布特希爾），只開放了幾年，直到 1884 年，才填滿了墓碑鎮的親人。墓地包括一個與主墓地分開的有趣區域，該區域是為墓碑鎮和科奇斯縣的猶太居民保留的。當時大多數西方墓地都沒有猶太人拘禁區。

ab58521deb8b18d46cc7823f076de81905360409.sourceText: The Jewish cemetery was filled by the late 19th century and was mostly abandoned when the new city graveyard was built in 1884. It languished forgotten for the next hundred years.
ab58521deb8b18d46cc7823f076de81905360409.translatedText: 猶太墓地在 19 世紀末已被填滿，並在 1884 年新城市墓地建成後大部分被廢棄。在接下來的一百年裡，它被遺忘了。

43dbe0087b4ed1886e0c2492433415270e7109f4.sourceText: In the 1980s, the neglected Jewish section of Boothill came to light, and the Jewish Friendship Club of Green Valley began efforts to restore the cemetery. In 1991, a memorial to the Jewish Pioneers and Indian Friends was dedicated along with the re-opening of this section of the famous cemetery. The two-tiered monument is made of rocks gathered from the mountains of Arizona.
43dbe0087b4ed1886e0c2492433415270e7109f4.translatedText: 在 20 世紀 80 年代，布特希爾 (Boothill) 被忽視的猶太人區被曝光，猶太友誼俱樂部 (Jewish Friendship Club)綠谷開始努力恢復墓地。 1991 年，隨著這片著名墓地的重新開放，猶太先驅者和印度之友紀念碑落成。這座兩層紀念碑是由從亞利桑那州山區採集的岩石製成的。

d1fff8096f33bb6f47a66f82f1ac37370ada8e43.sourceText: Tucked in a valley in Arizona's majestic Mule Mountains, Bisbee was founded in the late 19th century after the discovery of enormous mineral resources in the area. Having little flat land to work with, the town grew up along the surrounding mountainsides — meaning that stairs were often more sensible thoroughfares than streets in this pre-automobile town.
d1fff8096f33bb6f47a66f82f1ac37370ada8e43.translatedText: 比斯比坐落在亞利桑那州雄偉的穆爾山脈的一個山谷中，於 19 世紀末在該地區發現大量礦產資源後成立。由於沒有什麼平坦的土地可供利用，這座小鎮沿著周圍的山坡發展起來——這意味著在這個汽車出現之前的小鎮裡，樓梯往往比街道更明智。

e8eb09c886fb3feb818cf5efbaf01a7095f3f3f1.sourceText: Most of the staircases found in Bisbee today actually started as dirt paths traversed by mules to carry supplies to the houses perched on the dramatic inclines. Over time the hoof-worn paths were replaced with wooden stairs resembling ladders, which were in turn replaced with concrete stairs by the WPA in the depths of the Great Depression (in fact, the WPA stamp can still be seen today in various places on the stairs). There are many houses in Bisbee that are only accessible by stairs; for this reason, moving companies will often check the location before agreeing to deliver.
e8eb09c886fb3feb818cf5efbaf01a7095f3f3f1.translatedText: 今天在比斯比發現的大部分樓梯實際上都是由騾子穿過的土路開始的，它們將物資運送到坐落在陡峭斜坡上的房屋。隨著時間的推移，被蹄子磨損的小路被類似梯子的木樓梯所取代，而大蕭條時期的 WPA 將這些樓梯替換為混凝土樓梯（事實上，如今在樓梯的不同地方仍然可以看到 WPA 的印記）。比斯比有許多房屋只能透過樓梯到達；因此，搬家公司通常會在同意送貨前檢查位置。

199de035003c8a8917326ca689db58665c6c2c24.sourceText: Each year Bisbee hosts a road race / stair climb called the Bisbee 1000, a 5K that includes a total of 1034 stairs spread over nine different staircases and a total overall elevation change of 1175 feet. An additional event has also been added called the Ice Man Competition, involving carrying a ten-pound block of ice up 155 steps with antique ice tongs in homage to the ice delivery men of yesteryear.
199de035003c8a8917326ca689db58665c6c2c24.translatedText: Bisbee 每年都會舉辦一場名為 Bisbee 1000 的公路競賽/爬樓梯比賽，這項 5K 比賽包括分佈在 9 個不同樓梯上的總共 1034 個樓梯，總的總體海拔變化為 1175 英尺。還增加了一項名為“送冰人比賽”的額外活動，其中包括使用古董冰鉗將 10 磅重的冰塊運上 155 級台階，以向昔日的送冰人致敬。

11ebafe502d1bbc08da71b8784de612d8b375ccd.sourceText: After mining operations stopped in 1975, Bisbee became a popular place for hippies and artists to resettle. Thus, if strolling and sightseeing are more your style, the stairs are a great way to see Bisbee's own version of outsider art, with frequent street art (and stair art) installations. Every house along the path offers its own unique twist, incorporating found items into their gates, yards and homes.
11ebafe502d1bbc08da71b8784de612d8b375ccd.translatedText: 1975 年採礦作業停止後，比斯比成為嬉皮士和藝術家重新定居的熱門地點。因此，如果您更喜歡漫步和觀光，那麼樓梯是欣賞比斯比自己版本的局外人藝術的好方法，其中經常有街頭藝術（和樓梯藝術）裝置。沿途的每棟房屋都有自己獨特的特色，將發現的物品融入它們的大門、院子和房屋中。

a5e6acdb38b36f5d0c46fb3a72d36a43960daf63.sourceText: With thousands of steps scattered through the town, Bisbee is a maze of staircases and desert mountain vistas. There is a wonderful book called "The Bisbee Stairs" by David Ryan which describes 82 stairways with an average of 78 steps each, although some reach over 100. Do note, however, that some stairways are in better shape than others, so step carefully.
a5e6acdb38b36f5d0c46fb3a72d36a43960daf63.translatedText: 鎮上分佈著數千級台階，比斯比是一個由樓梯和沙漠山景組成的迷宮。 David Ryan 寫了一本精彩的書，名為《比斯比樓梯》，其中描述了 82 個樓梯，每個樓梯平均有 78 個台階，儘管有些樓梯超過 100 個。但請注意，有些樓梯的形狀比其他樓梯更好，因此請小心行走。

5dfa9a62bb0f9a1fcd886498be68dc5bfc32fdc7.sourceText: On June 30 , 1956, at 9:01 am, TWA Flight 2 took off from Los Angeles International Airport flying to Kansas City. Three minutes later, United Airlines Flight 718 also took off from Los Angeles headed for Chicago. The two flights would become tragically entwined over the Grand Canyon about an hour and a half later.
5dfa9a62bb0f9a1fcd886498be68dc5bfc32fdc7.translatedText: 1956年6月30日上午9時01分，環球航空2號班機從洛杉磯國際機場起飛，飛往堪薩斯市。三分鐘後，聯合航空718班機也從洛杉磯起飛前往芝加哥。大約一個半小時​​後，兩架航班在大峽谷上空悲慘地糾纏在一起。

969faf69069aee3fa4f6e851ada71232963731fb.sourceText: Shortly after takeoff, the pilot of the TWA plane requested to change his altitude from 19,000 to 21,000 feet to avoid storm clouds. At the time, commercial flights had no direct contact with air traffic controllers after their takeoff, so messages had to be sent to a TWA dispatcher and relayed to controllers. Air traffic controllers denied this request because the United flight was already flying at that altitude.
969faf69069aee3fa4f6e851ada71232963731fb.translatedText: 起飛後不久，環球航空公司飛機的飛行員要求將高度從 19,000 英尺更改為 21,000 英尺，以避免暴風雲。當時，商業航班在起飛後與空中交通管制員沒有直接聯繫，因此必須將訊息發送給環球航空調度員並轉發給管制員。空中交通管制員拒絕了這項請求，因為美聯航航班已經在該高度飛行。

e2ffb4e5c2ff8cbc651e9ecf12076f0812859b29.sourceText: The TWA pilot then requested to fly “1,000 on top,” which meant flying 1,000 feet above the clouds they encountered but being responsible for their own separation from other aircraft. This request was approved by air traffic controllers but the pilot was not adequately warned of the United flight in the same area and on approximately the same flight path. TWA Flight 2 climbed up to 21,000 feet as it passed over the Grand Canyon. United Flight 718 and TWA Flight 2 then each flew around opposite sides of a towering storm cloud in the way of their routes, not knowing the other plane was at the same altitude.
e2ffb4e5c2ff8cbc651e9ecf12076f0812859b29.translatedText: 環球航空公司飛行員隨後要求飛行“1,000 on top”，這意味著在他們遇到的雲層上方 1,000 英尺處飛行，但要對自己與其他飛機的分離負責。這項請求得到了空中交通管制員的批准，但飛行員沒有得到充分警告，美聯航航班將在同一地區且在大致相同的飛行路線上。環球航空 2 號班機飛越大峽谷時爬升至 21,000 英尺。隨後，美聯航 718 號班機和環球航空 2 號班機各自在各自航線上繞著高聳的風暴雲的兩側飛行，並不知道另一架飛機處於同一高度。

48be607076d459889a6b192b1c1e27ab9022fc58.sourceText: At around 10:30 a.m., the two planes clipped each other as they navigated around the cloud, losing control and plummeting into the canyon below. Analysis of the wreckage seems to show that the pilot of the United flight probably saw they were on a collision course with the TWA flight, but only seconds beforehand. While attempting to avoid a crash, the left wing of the United plane struck the tail of the TWA plane. None of the 128 people aboard the two planes survived.
48be607076d459889a6b192b1c1e27ab9022fc58.translatedText: 上午10點30分左右，兩架飛機在雲層中飛行時相撞，失去控制並墜入下面的峽谷。對殘骸的分析似乎表明，美聯航航班的飛行員可能看到他們正在與環球航空公司的航班相撞，但就在幾秒鐘前。在試圖避免墜機時，聯合航空飛機的左翼撞上了環球航空公司飛機的機尾。兩架飛機上的 128 人無一生還。

92846ecf07144e8eb089cf8de494679ed977dfd0.sourceText: At the time, huge parts of the country had no radar tracking flights, including above the Grand Canyon. Planes were not typically equipped with tracking beacons or flight data recorders, so it was not immediately known that a disaster had unfolded. It wasn't until the planes went for some time without manually reporting their position that it was suspected something might be amiss.
92846ecf07144e8eb089cf8de494679ed977dfd0.translatedText: 當時，該國大部分地區沒有雷達追蹤航班，包括大峽谷上空。飛機通常沒有配備追蹤信標或飛行數據記錄器，因此無法立即得知災難已經發生。直到飛機飛行了一段時間而沒有手動報告其位置，才懷疑可能出了問題。

c812bc927529ddee65f32ddbfc384bf271bd9fc9.sourceText: The wreckage was first spotted many hours later by Henry and Palen Hudgin, brothers who flew short taxi flights for Grand Canyon Airlines. They spotted smoke rising from within the canyon but not knowing about the missing planes they dismissed it as a brush fire caused by lightning from the earlier storm. Upon learning of the missing planes, they flew back into the canyon to take a closer look at the smoke and saw the wreckage.
c812bc927529ddee65f32ddbfc384bf271bd9fc9.translatedText: 幾小時後，為大峽谷航空公司飛行短途出租車航班的亨利·哈金和帕倫·哈金兄弟首次發現了殘骸。他們發現峽谷內冒出濃煙，但不知道失蹤的飛機，他們將其視為先前風暴閃電引起的灌木叢火災。得知飛機失蹤後，他們飛回峽谷仔細觀察煙霧，發現了殘骸。

e6e45c6f11f01d40f2faa51d13bfd60da6d89a48.sourceText: This archaeological park, with its partially reconstructed ancient pueblos, botanical garden, and museum, makes for a beautiful and relaxing day trip.
e6e45c6f11f01d40f2faa51d13bfd60da6d89a48.translatedText: 這個考古公園內有部分重建的古代村莊、植物園和博物館，是一次美麗而輕鬆的一日遊。

d26045735d34cdec6717cf2b8503b2f1ebb0561a.sourceText: Besh-Ba-Gowah was built by the Salado people between 1225 and 1400. A small but fascinating museum features local archeological findings and the history of the area and its people. There's also a small gift shop with some unique items.
d26045735d34cdec6717cf2b8503b2f1ebb0561a.translatedText: Besh-Ba-Gowah 由薩拉多人於 1225 年至 1400 年間建造。這是一個小而迷人的博物館，展示了當地的考古發現以及該地區及其人民的歷史。還有一家小禮品店，裡面有一些獨特的物品。

66b7a9f52d24cdeee4771d115ce6348728cfa8d0.sourceText: Strolling along the pathways through the pueblo ruins takes you back in time. Add in the Arizona native plants and a sense of serenity and peace embrace you. If you visit during the blooming seasons, it will be truly spectacular.
66b7a9f52d24cdeee4771d115ce6348728cfa8d0.translatedText: 沿著普韋布洛遺址的小路漫步，帶您回到過去。添加亞利桑那州本土植物，一種寧靜與平和的感覺擁抱您。如果您在花季期間前往，那將是真正的壯觀。

bf99436cb957e44200fe25f6b61bd5a71d0ff7e3.sourceText: Besh-Ba-Gowah is closed on Mondays and Tuesdays from July to September only. Other than that, it is open every day from 9 A.M. to 4:30 P.M. Admission is $5 for adults, $4 for seniors, and free for children aged 12 and under.
bf99436cb957e44200fe25f6b61bd5a71d0ff7e3.translatedText: Besh-Ba-Gowah 僅在 7 月至 9 月的每週一和週二關閉。除此之外，它每天上午 9 點開放。至下午 4:30成人門票 5 美元，老年人 4 美元，12 歲以下兒童免費。

10da931f09eed23267d5943b7ddd464192fa2692.sourceText: Granite rocks are found in many places, and they often erode into spheres if they have numerous joints formed by fractures. What is much more unusual is an area of spherical rocks as large as the Granite Dells, located in central Arizona just outside Prescott.
10da931f09eed23267d5943b7ddd464192fa2692.translatedText: 花崗岩在許多地方都有發現，如果它們有許多由裂縫形成的節理，它們經常會被侵蝕成球體。更不尋常的是位於亞利桑那州中部普雷斯科特郊外的一塊與花崗岩戴爾一樣大的球形岩石區域。

6840c27d5100ea5f887ff70637f5fcb3009f551f.sourceText: The thousands of boulders contrast starkly with the two manmade lakes, with unique coves and islands between the two. It is understandably easy to get lost here, especially as many trails thin out between the rocks.
6840c27d5100ea5f887ff70637f5fcb3009f551f.translatedText: 數千塊巨石與兩個人造湖形成鮮明對比，兩者之間有獨特的海灣和島嶼。在這裡很容易迷路，這是可以理解的，尤其是當許多小徑在岩石之間變得稀疏時。

9cd5b312d6521831bdc1d8c3712728475d52bdfa.sourceText: A local symbol of the Prescott area, the Dells have been a recreational draw since the late 19th century. There was a resort until the 1970s, and actor Tom Mix filmed many western movies here. A railroad also ran through the Dells, and as such many visitors' first impressions of Prescott were the otherworldly rocks here.
9cd5b312d6521831bdc1d8c3712728475d52bdfa.translatedText: 戴爾是普雷斯科特地區的當地像徵，自 19 世紀末以來一直是休閒勝地。直到 20 世紀 70 年代這裡還是一個度假村，演員湯姆米克斯 (Tom Mix) 曾在這裡拍攝過許多西部片。一條鐵路也穿過戴爾斯，因此許多遊客對普雷斯科特的第一印象就是這裡超凡脫俗的岩石。

724b615381e3b173e312ca2d34a945cec20c0aaa.sourceText: More recently, despite presence of uranium in the rocks, resort homes have been built on them. This has caused local controversy, with some development plans blocked for the proposed creation of a regional park.
724b615381e3b173e312ca2d34a945cec20c0aaa.translatedText: 最近，儘管岩石中含有鈾，但人們還是在岩石上建造了度假村住宅。這引起了當地的爭議，一些開發計劃因提議建立區域公園而受阻。

601d0a194431a1e6dfcd4349cd058670c3f9d1d1.sourceText: It is a common myth that the concrete crosses surrounding the city of Casa Grande, Arizona, were used for the CORONA intelligence satellite program. This is not the case. While this target network is interesting, its purpose was not to calibrate the cameras for the CORONA spacecraft, or any spacecraft for that mater.
601d0a194431a1e6dfcd4349cd058670c3f9d1d1.translatedText: 人們普遍認為，亞利桑那州卡薩格蘭德市周圍的混凝土十字架被用於 CORONA 情報衛星計畫。事實並非如此。雖然這個目標網路很有趣，但其目的不是校準 CORONA 太空船或任何相關太空船的相機。

0494f2d047dda21d3f277fd702c19ec83ae20d62.sourceText: These crosses were however constructed for the calibration of aerial photogrammetry cameras to validate maps. While the US Air Force did use the Casa Grande Range for aerial (aircraft) camera calibration for certain mapping cameras, it was not used for space based intelligence camera systems.
0494f2d047dda21d3f277fd702c19ec83ae20d62.translatedText: 然而，這些十字是為了校準航空攝影測量相機以驗證地圖而建造的。雖然美國空軍確實使用卡薩格蘭德靶場對某些測繪相機進行航空（飛機）相機校準，但它並未用於天基情報相機系統。

0728011553ac0c113c7b0d808e3e2eac1617dced.sourceText: The Casa Grande targets were part of what was officially called the Casa Grande Photogrammetric Test Range which, consisted of a 16 x 16 mile grid of 60' targets. Each target was roughly spaced 1 mile apart. These targets provided a fixed spatial grid for photogrammetric calculations for mapping camera calibration/validation.
0728011553ac0c113c7b0d808e3e2eac1617dced.translatedText: 卡薩格蘭德目標是官方稱為卡薩格蘭德攝影測量測試靶場的一部分，該靶場由 16 x 16 英里的 60 英尺目標網格組成。每個目標的間隔約為 1 英里。這些目標為攝影測量計算提供了固定的空間網格，以用於繪製相機校準/驗證。

658c1e0c7f732bb506ab1ada62927e1e61bd2119.sourceText: REGARDING CORONA: First and foremost; the CORONA program was a most highly classified program and as such all technical information was very well controlled and would never have had calibration tools in a public setting. The classification controls were so restrictive that most people working in the program were not privy to the name CORONA until after its declassification in 1995.
658c1e0c7f732bb506ab1ada62927e1e61bd2119.translatedText: 關於電暈：首先也是最重要的； CORONA 計劃是一個高度機密的計劃，因此所有技術資訊都受到很好的控制，並且永遠不會在公共環境中使用校準工具。保密控制非常嚴格，以至於大多數參與該計畫的人員直到 1995 年解密後才知道 CORONA 這個名字。

83eb7c1e6862975018d8df2acf14670759a97815.sourceText: The calibration of the CORONA cameras was conducted in a lab setting (not on the space craft while in flight-as commonly misunderstood). Thus, the accuracy and focal length of the cameras would render the Casa Grande Targets useless for focus calibration.
83eb7c1e6862975018d8df2acf14670759a97815.translatedText: CORONA 相機的校準是在實驗室環境中進行的（而不是在飛行中的太空器上——通常被誤解）。因此，相機的精度和焦距將使卡薩格蘭德目標無法用於焦點校準。

62ebe7e150e88671712eaba6ba8b2ba4995fb451.sourceText: The CORONA cameras were in fact calibrated in lab by raising the film plane by mere fractions of a millimeter based on information gathered from the Controlled Range Network (CORN). These high resolution grid type targets were located in controlled areas (military bases) to prevent outside agencies from having direct access to the process. The CORN program also incorporated mobile targets that could be deployed based on specific mission flight profiles. They [CORN] used varying grayscale and specific color patterns to calculate the edge focus of visible and infrared light exposed film.
62ebe7e150e88671712eaba6ba8b2ba4995fb451.translatedText: 實際上，CORONA 相機是在實驗室中根據從受控範圍網路 (CORN) 收集的資訊將膠片平面升高幾分之一毫米來進行校準的。這些高解析度網格型目標位於受控區域（軍事基地），以防止外部機構直接存取該流程。 CORN 計劃還納入了可以根據特定任務飛行概況部署的移動目標。他們 [CORN] 使用不同的灰階和特定的顏色圖案來計算可見光和紅外線曝光膠片的邊緣焦點。

35d13a28812f5c817d600c74236537a745c175d6.sourceText: Seven hundred feet above the banks of the Colorado River, hikers can find what looks like a collection of square windows cut into the sandstone. The carvings were made around the year 1100 by the Ancestral Puebloan people. The cutouts served as grain storage facilities that were designed to be sealed, protecting food stores from seasonal flooding, rodents, and insects.
35d13a28812f5c817d600c74236537a745c175d6.translatedText: 在科羅拉多河河岸上方 700 英尺處，徒步旅行者可以發現一系列看起來像切入砂岩的方形窗戶的東西。這些雕刻是由祖先普韋布洛人於 1100 年左右製作的。這些切口用作穀物儲存設施，設計為密封的，保護食品商店免受季節性洪水、囓齒動物和昆蟲的侵害。

6639274a5f0067fc6a860d11dab244f4d9441979.sourceText: The ruins are most easily accessed from the Colorado River, at a beach 53 miles downstream from Lee’s Ferry. Once there, it is a moderate two-mile hike up the cliff face.
6639274a5f0067fc6a860d11dab244f4d9441979.translatedText: 從科羅拉多河最容易到達廢墟，位於李氏渡口下游 53 英里的海灘上。到達那裡後，需要沿著懸崖面徒步兩英里。

7c63e9b4e2c2cbf3bc718b08f1c6edc28093e121.sourceText: Although visitors can get quite close to the remains, they are not allowed to touch the stone, in order to preserve what remains.
7c63e9b4e2c2cbf3bc718b08f1c6edc28093e121.translatedText: 雖然遊客可以非常接近遺跡，但為了保護遺跡，他們不可以觸摸石頭。

2aa2d02b1e959302c50aaf5d8ad099ae8150dfcf.sourceText: There is also an unmaintained hiking path down to the ruins that can be accessed from above, called the Nankoweap Trail. However, it is considered by the NPS to be one of the most difficult in the Canyon.
2aa2d02b1e959302c50aaf5d8ad099ae8150dfcf.translatedText: 還有一條未維護的健行路徑，可以從上方進入，到達遺跡，稱為 Nankoweap Trail。然而，它被 NPS 認為是峽谷中最困難的地方之一。

b9ebbe24eee8b8d0957870ca6ee3ba006fc62a66.sourceText: Phoenix cafe listing claimed by the owner; public address, phone, and website details are not yet published.
b9ebbe24eee8b8d0957870ca6ee3ba006fc62a66.translatedText: 鳳凰咖啡館清單由業主聲稱；公共地址、電話和網站詳細資訊尚未公佈。

21d60512b757189e06d84fb9bc9560a0039df910.sourceText: When Leonardo da Vinci painted The Last Supper in the dining hall at the monastery of Santa Maria delle Grazie, he couldn't have known that it would become one of the most frequently referenced and reimagined images in the history of art. In the last 500 years, thousands of Last Suppers have entered the world, with variations that include plaster ghosts in the Nevada desert and Jesus and his disciples eating guinea pig .
21d60512b757189e06d84fb9bc9560a0039df910.translatedText: 當達文西在感恩聖母修道院的餐廳裡創作《最後的晚餐》時，他不可能知道這幅作品會成為藝術史上最常被引用和重新想像的圖像之一。在過去的 500 年裡，數以千計的《最後的晚餐》來到了這個世界，其中包括內華達沙漠中的石膏鬼魂以及耶穌和他的門徒吃豚鼠。

980263bd531c7d336eaca6c36b9ca5c0fd2f6df1.sourceText: The Last Supper Museum in Douglas, Arizona, is the world's largest collection of Last Supper -inspired pieces of art. Every medium is represented, including coal, mother of pearl, volcanic ash, gourd, among many others. Paintings and sculptures from all over the world presenting over 50 countries, located in a 113-year-old building.
980263bd531c7d336eaca6c36b9ca5c0fd2f6df1.translatedText: 位於亞利桑那州道格拉斯的《最後的晚餐》博物館是世界上最大的受《最後的晚餐》啟發的藝術品收藏地。每種媒材都有代表，包括煤炭、珍珠母、火山灰、葫蘆等等。位於一棟擁有 113 年歷史的建築內，展出來自世界各地 50 多個國家的繪畫和雕塑作品。

ac2f3f2a48098fa4f51fa32814edcb4040ee66a1.sourceText: The museum was founded by Eric Braverman. He started collecting Last Supper artwork at a young age, and eventually learned about an Indiana museum with a collection of about 2,000 items inspired by the da Vinci painting. When the owner passed away a few years ago, Braverman acquired his collection and brought it to Arizona, where he opened a museum of his own.
ac2f3f2a48098fa4f51fa32814edcb4040ee66a1.translatedText: 博物館由 Eric Braverman 創立。他年輕時就開始收集《最後的晚餐》藝術品，並最終了解到印第安納州的一家博物館，收藏了約 2,000 件受達文西繪畫啟發的物品。幾年前，主人去世後，布雷弗曼獲得了他的藏品，並將其帶到亞利桑那州，在那裡他開設了自己的博物館。

d825e45b161448611299bf8924dcfe05d05753dc.sourceText: Check the website for hours and visiting information.
d825e45b161448611299bf8924dcfe05d05753dc.translatedText: 查看網站，了解營業時間和參觀資訊。

b9b5debc33688d84de3fc4397993db14891f0d5d.sourceText: Nestled on a hill between two houses in a quiet neighborhood, the Henry Wickenburg Pioneer Cemetery seems almost as forgotten as its famous namesake. Entering the cemetery feels like trespassing, even though there is signage and clearly marked path.
b9b5debc33688d84de3fc4397993db14891f0d5d.translatedText: 亨利威肯堡先鋒公墓坐落在一個安靜街區的兩棟房屋之間的一座小山上，似乎幾乎和它著名的同名墓地一樣被遺忘。進入墓地感覺就像非法侵入，儘管有標誌和清晰標記的路徑。

58b14b0bb4b22b84592a2981b0cf5fe815766c23.sourceText: Henry Wickenburg is best remembered for discovering the Vulture Mine and as the founder of Wickenburg, Arizona . Few people realize that he was largely responsible for the creation of a dusty little agricultural town named Phoenix , now the fifth-largest city in the United States .
58b14b0bb4b22b84592a2981b0cf5fe815766c23.translatedText: 亨利·威肯堡因發現禿鷹礦和亞利桑那州威肯堡的創始人而被人們銘記。很少有人意識到他對建立一個塵土飛揚的農業小鎮菲尼克斯（現在是美國第五大城市）負有主要責任。

0eb63b2e888826e5d6b3304232b545d3f3e613e9.sourceText: Born Johannes Henricus Wickenburg in Essen , Germany on November 21, 1819, Henry arrived at the Port of New York in 1847 and followed the gold rush to San Francisco in 1852. By 1863 Henry had left California for the rugged desert of the newly formed Arizona Territory and set up camp near Hassayampa Creek. In October 1863, he discovered the Vulture Mine, which was the most productive gold mine in Arizona and estimated to have produced as much as $70 million worth of gold during its operation from 1863 to 1942.
0eb63b2e888826e5d6b3304232b545d3f3e613e9.translatedText: 約翰內斯·亨利克斯·威肯堡 (Johannes Henricus Wickenburg) 於 1819 年 11 月 21 日出生於德國埃森，1847 年抵達紐約港，並於 1852 年跟隨淘金來到舊金山。到 1863 年，亨利離開了加州前往新形成的亞利桑那領地的崎嶇沙漠，並在哈薩揚帕溪附近紮營。 1863 年 10 月，他發現了禿鷹礦，這是亞利桑那州產量最高的金礦，估計在 1863 年至 1942 年的營運期間生產了價值 7000 萬美元的黃金。

fb8ca331e1259c9214b0a4151b1fe00ea3f0d2b2.sourceText: The boom towns of Vulture City and Wickenburg that sprang up around the mine were rough mining camps, known for the lawlessness associated with the American Wild West. The surrounding desert wasn’t suitable for agriculture, making it challenging to provide enough food for the miners. Wickenburg businessman Jack Swilling proposed clearing the ancient Hohokam canals in the Salt River Valley, which had been overgrown for centuries, to create an agricultural community. Henry provided much of the financing for “Jack Swilling’s Ditch,” which was the forerunner for the Salt River Project. The clearing of these ancient canals brought the large-scale irrigation required for the creation of an agricultural community large enough to support the Vulture Mine and its surrounding towns. Phoenix was settled in 1867 and thrived as an agricultural center with produce flowing to the mine and wealth from the mine flowing back to Phoenix. Henry’s bankrolling of the canal project was arguably his most long-lasting and impactful accomplishment.
fb8ca331e1259c9214b0a4151b1fe00ea3f0d2b2.translatedText: 礦區周圍興起的禿鷹城和威肯堡等新興城鎮都是簡陋的採礦營地，以美國狂野西部的無法無天而聞名。周圍的沙漠不適合農業，因此很難為礦工提供足夠的食物。威肯堡商人傑克·斯威林提議清理鹽河谷古老的霍霍卡姆運河，該運河已經雜草叢生了幾個世紀，以創建一個農業社區。亨利為「傑克·斯威林溝渠」提供了大部分資金，該溝渠是鹽河計畫的前身。這些古老運河的清理帶來了創建足以支持禿鷹礦及其周邊城鎮的農業社區所需的大規模灌溉。菲尼克斯於 1867 年有人定居，作為農業中心而繁榮發展，農產品流向礦山，而來自礦山的財富又流回菲尼克斯。亨利對運河計畫的資助可以說是他最持久、最有影響力的成就。

5e9ba652151b7db2042e035970ede1b72c7454e6.sourceText: Henry died of a gunshot wound to the head on May 14, 1905. At the time his death was ruled a suicide although the circumstances were suspicious and many people believed he had been murdered. He is buried in the Henry Wickenburg Pioneer Cemetery with five of his friends, Henry Cowell, Lydia Cowell, James C. Todd, James Chase, and William Wise. This private cemetery was located on a hill owned by Henry Wickenburg, overlooking the Hassayampa River valley, the town of Wickenburg, and the Wickenburg home. It was in use from 1902-1928, prior to the creation of the municipal cemetery in 1931, and contains an architectural style known as “bedstead” not commonly used in cemeteries in the southwestern United States. The cemetery was listed on the National Register of Historic Places on April 4, 2011.
5e9ba652151b7db2042e035970ede1b72c7454e6.translatedText: 1905 年 5 月 14 日，亨利死於頭部槍傷。當時，他的死亡被裁定為自殺，儘管當時情況可疑，許多人認為他是被謀殺的。他與他的五個朋友亨利·考威爾、莉迪亞·考威爾、詹姆斯·C·托德、詹姆斯·蔡斯和威廉·懷斯一起被埋葬在亨利·威肯堡先鋒公墓。這座私人墓地位於亨利威肯堡擁有的小山上，俯瞰哈薩揚帕河谷、威肯堡鎮和威肯堡的家。該墓地於 1902 年至 1928 年期間投入使用，早於 1931 年市立公墓的建立，其建築風格被稱為“床架”，這種風格在美國西南部的墓地中並不常見。該墓園於 2011 年 4 月 4 日被列入國家史蹟名錄。

f5b2e54769de332ca65ed02699968196f16408fd.sourceText: For the last 20 years, this family-owned haven for hearty Polish fare has been gracing downtown Glendale with hunter's stew, pierogis, kielbasa, goulash, cabbage rolls, and so much more. (“A Touch of European” might be more aptly named “A Bear Hug from Poland”). Portions are generous, but save room for dessert, which includes house-baked cookies such as angel wings and kolaczki.
f5b2e54769de332ca65ed02699968196f16408fd.translatedText: 過去 20 年來，這家家族經營的豐盛波蘭美食天堂一直為格倫代爾市中心提供獵人燉菜、波蘭餃子、波蘭香腸、燉牛肉、捲心菜捲等美食。 （「歐洲風情」可能更恰當地命名為「來自波蘭的熊抱」）。份量很足，但要留一點空間給甜點，其中包括天使翅膀和 kolaczki 等自製餅乾。

37f9ca6764ed9d07abe272d4beabc73831c6bbe6.sourceText: Chef-owner Waldemar Okula is fiercely proud of his homeland—a fact readily apparent to anyone who's gone on one of his annual culinary tours of Poland. Twice a year, he hosts a cooking class where participants either learn how to make Easter classics like white borscht or a Polish-style Christmas feast.
37f9ca6764ed9d07abe272d4beabc73831c6bbe6.translatedText: 主廚 Waldemar Okula 對他的祖國深感自豪，這一事實對於任何參加過波蘭年度美食之旅的人來說都是顯而易見的。他每年舉辦兩次烹飪課程，參與者可以學習如何製作白色羅宋湯等復活節經典菜餚，也可以學習如何製作波蘭風格的聖誕大餐。

51082fd5e0524376617aa14f51c889af11d74ecf.sourceText: It's BYOB, it's cash only, and it's unlike anything else you'll find in the greater metro Phoenix area. You'll hear the owners speaking Polish amongst themselves and to other diners who've immigrated from the region.
51082fd5e0524376617aa14f51c889af11d74ecf.translatedText: 可以自備酒水，只收現金，與鳳凰城大都會地區的任何其他菜餚都不同。您會聽到店主彼此之間以及與來自該地區的其他食客講波蘭語。

b6d41c8c4a3f8c39485dbb02c34d944974941d11.sourceText: If the specials include a dill pickle soup, order a cup. Do not doubt its power.
b6d41c8c4a3f8c39485dbb02c34d944974941d11.translatedText: 如果特色菜包括蒔蘿泡菜湯，請點一杯。不要懷疑它的力量。

7bde5c049dedc64a6175bbce1f080d4149701376.sourceText: Dinner service ends promptly at 8 p.m., so show up with a nice bottle of red around 6 p.m. and take your sweet time.
7bde5c049dedc64a6175bbce1f080d4149701376.translatedText: 晚餐服務在晚上 8 點準時結束，所以下午 6 點左右帶上一瓶漂亮的紅酒來吧。慢慢享受甜蜜時光。

c2a47373b43d02130396040331552b57749e2e02.sourceText: Just off Highway 95 between Quartzsite and Yuma, a pair of large Howitzer cannons pointed skyward to mark the turn off the highway onto East Imperial Dam road.
c2a47373b43d02130396040331552b57749e2e02.translatedText: 就在 Quartzsite 和 Yuma 之間的 95 號高速公路旁，兩門大型榴彈砲指向天空，標誌著高速公路轉入 East Imperial Dam 路。

5df207a12afa20d3fd034e138af4f12577ef245b.sourceText: The open-air tank and cannon display is about three-quarters of a mile down. Ample parking and bathrooms are available near the displays. The Yuma Proving Grounds main entries are down a bit further with another tank and Apache helicopter on display near the restricted entry.
5df207a12afa20d3fd034e138af4f12577ef245b.translatedText: 露天坦克和火砲展示位於大約四分之三英里處。展覽附近有充足的停車位和浴室。尤馬試驗場的主要入口稍遠一些，在限制入口附近展示另一輛坦克和阿帕奇直升機。

4de33da71781dcb092d884505efd7535e4f8aa62.sourceText: This site is part of the Yuma Proving Grounds military site. No climbing is permitted on vehicles and visitors assume their own risk. Please respect this awesome site and the work of the area service men and women.
4de33da71781dcb092d884505efd7535e4f8aa62.translatedText: 此站點是尤馬試驗場軍事站點的一部分。車輛上禁止攀爬，遊客自行承擔風險。請尊重這個很棒的網站以及該地區男女服務人員的工作。

5a09266497d36ed19dab1c8549176d5ca5cc01d3.sourceText: The Gold King Mansion sits in the Hualapai Mountains in Mohave County, Arizona. Construction on the mansion began in 1930, shortly after a strike had been made on the land in April 1929 and a claim was made to it in July of the same year.
5a09266497d36ed19dab1c8549176d5ca5cc01d3.translatedText: 金王大廈坐落在亞利桑那州莫哈維縣的華拉派山脈。宅邸的建設於 1930 年開始，緊接著 1929 年 4 月這片土地發生罷工，並於同年 7 月提出索賠。

115ec29cc0ecb8c51298036492006569b33a0e39.sourceText: Progress was swift; a camp and road connected to the county highway were built to support the growing operation. As the mine grew, so did expectations as the mine operator, P. M. Woods, reported the company was to install a “big hoist,” “a big gas engine and a compressor… sufficient to operate the drills and pumps,” and an onsite ore mill. The prospective growth of the mine was enticing to financiers who rushed to invest.
115ec29cc0ecb8c51298036492006569b33a0e39.translatedText: 進展很快；建造了一個營地和一條連接縣高速公路的道路，以支持不斷增長的業務。隨著礦山的發展，人們的期望也隨之提高，礦山經營者 P. M. Woods 報告稱，該公司將安裝一台「大型提昇機」、「一台大型燃氣發動機和一台壓縮機……足以操作鑽機和泵」以及一台現場磨礦機。該礦的預期成長吸引了爭相投資的金融家。

d9bb98c3c1fbd55685305a034fc90401fd584288.sourceText: At the end of August 1930, the company announced the building "the first of a series of model bunk houses, using reinforced concrete construction." The houses were, according to the mine superintendent, to "contain an adequate sleeping room to accommodate several miners, a modern bathroom, and be provided with electric light." Multiple of these bunkhouses was intended to be constructed but come October 1930, the mine found a large workforce unnecessary as the mine resulted in only one of the buildings being constructed.
d9bb98c3c1fbd55685305a034fc90401fd584288.translatedText: 1930 年 8 月底，該公司宣佈建造「一系列採用鋼筋混凝土結構的雙層宿舍模型中的第一座」。據礦長稱，這些房屋「應有一間足以容納多名礦工的臥室、一間現代化的浴室，並配有電燈」。原本打算建造多棟這樣的工房，但到了 1930 年 10 月，礦場發現不需要大量勞動力，因為礦場只建造了其中一棟建築。

b907881218dcb2617d344e11d29dfde8d8977804.sourceText: In 1933, a local rancher John Odie visited the mine and found that the mansion was not used to shelter miners as originally intended. Odie claimed the owners “would take prospective stock buyers up there and wine and dine them and put them up in the house." The estate was also furnished less like a miner's quarters and more akin to a resort with elaborate crown molding, copper screen windows, and a concrete fishing pond off the east side of the building.
b907881218dcb2617d344e11d29dfde8d8977804.translatedText: 1933年，當地牧場主約翰·歐迪（John Odie）參觀了礦井，發現這座宅邸並沒有按照原計劃用來庇護礦工。歐迪聲稱，業主「會帶潛在的股票買家到那裡，給他們喝酒吃飯，然後把他們安置在房子裡。」莊園的佈置也不太像礦工宿舍，而更像是一個度假村，有精緻的皇冠造型、銅紗窗和建築物東側的混凝土釣魚池。

e4ca8b39af99a440295b81a8a26355639c4dd479.sourceText: The mine was not nearly as successful as it once was projected to be as their starting capital of $1 million in 1930 was whittled down to $700,000 in 1933 when the last of the mining took place for the decade.
e4ca8b39af99a440295b81a8a26355639c4dd479.translatedText: 該礦並沒有像以前預期的那樣成功，因為 1930 年的啟動資金為 100 萬美元，1933 年最後一次採礦時，該礦的啟動資金被削減至 70 萬美元。

f97f506623752dfc2060c030a5b675a619a54b40.sourceText: Despite inactivity between 1934 and 1941, interest in the mine resurged with the beginning of WWII and P. M. Woods resumed operation with a small crew in October 1942. The mine continued to operate through the war and produced gold, silver, lead, and zinc in small quantities. The mine was in use until 1947 but due to economic changes post-war and the death of P. M. Woods in 1948, the property was in limbo.
f97f506623752dfc2060c030a5b675a619a54b40.translatedText: 儘管 1934 年至 1941 年間該礦一直處於閒置狀態，但隨著二戰的開始，人們對該礦的興趣又重新高漲，並且 P. M. Woods 於 1942 年 10 月帶著少數工作人員恢復了運營。該礦在整個戰爭期間繼續運營，並少量生產了金、銀、鉛和鋅。該礦一直使用到 1947 年，但由於戰後的經濟變化以及 1948 年 P. M. 伍茲 (P. M. Woods) 的去世，該礦區陷入了困境。

89981c41db6ef48992b25e7743890b67d86abf2e.sourceText: Tucked away under the east side of the Arizona Stadium in Tucson, Arizona, this manufacturing laboratory uses novel techniques and technology to construct giant mirrors (up to 27 feet) that have revolutionized telescopes around the world. The lab is responsible for many important telescope mirrors including the Giant Magellan Telescope at the Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory.
89981c41db6ef48992b25e7743890b67d86abf2e.translatedText: 這個製造實驗室隱藏在亞利桑那州圖森市亞利桑那體育場東側下方，採用新穎的工藝和技術建造巨型鏡子（高達 27 英尺），徹底改變了世界各地的望遠鏡。實驗室負責許多重要的望遠鏡反射鏡，包括史密森天文物理觀測站的巨型麥哲倫望遠鏡。

037cf88fcfbd44afcc46cf3b06495771b7a1f1b5.sourceText: In 1980, Dr. Roger Angel created a homemade furnace in his backyard. Dr. Angel was curious about the suitability of borosilicate glass, which is often used in glass ovenware, in constructing honeycomb structures for telescope mirrors. The geometry of a honeycomb allows for a remarkably strong structure to be made with a minimal amount of material and weight. He was able to fuse together two custard cups. He continued with further experiments, which led to using ceramic materials and a rotating kiln to cast three six-foot-wide mirrors.
037cf88fcfbd44afcc46cf3b06495771b7a1f1b5.translatedText: 1980 年，羅傑安吉爾博士在他的後院創建了一個自製熔爐。安吉爾博士對硼矽酸鹽玻璃（通常用於玻璃烤箱器皿）在建造望遠鏡鏡面蜂窩結構中的適用性感到好奇。蜂巢的幾何形狀允許用最少量的材料和重量製造出非常堅固的結構。他能夠將兩個蛋奶凍杯融合在一起。他繼續進行進一步的實驗，最後使用陶瓷材料和旋轉窯鑄造了三塊六英尺寬的鏡子。

9c668a10e792b4d55c2f212007db504418d7cf4c.sourceText: In 1985, with financial support from the U.S. Air Force and the National Science Foundation, Dr. Angel’s efforts were moved to a facility under the University of Arizona football stadium. Initially the lab featured a furnace large enough to make mirrors that were almost 12 feet wide. By 1997, scientists at the lab were building 27-foot mirrors, one of which was used for the Large Binocular Telescope in southeastern Arizona.
9c668a10e792b4d55c2f212007db504418d7cf4c.translatedText: 1985年，在美國空軍和國家科學基金會的財政支持下，安吉爾博士的成果被轉移到亞利桑那大學橄欖球場下的一個設施中。最初，實驗室設有一個足夠大的熔爐，可以製造幾乎 12 英尺寬的鏡子。到 1997 年，實驗室的科學家正在建造 27 英尺的鏡子，其中一面用於亞利桑那州東南部的大型雙筒望遠鏡。

4580e3b45618a02206643977461d51352b375eb8.sourceText: A 27-foot mirror requires 25 tons of glass, which is heated to 2,156°F and spins for a week in the furnace. It takes 11 weeks for the mirror, which remains spinning for the duration, to safely cool. The mirror is removed from the furnace and hosed off to expose the glass honeycomb structure, which makes for a strong, light mirror.
4580e3b45618a02206643977461d51352b375eb8.translatedText: 一面 27 英尺的鏡子需要 25 噸玻璃，這些玻璃被加熱到 2,156°F，並在熔爐中旋轉一周。鏡子需要 11 週的時間才能安全冷卻，鏡子在整個過程中保持旋轉。將鏡子從熔爐中取出並用軟管沖洗，露出玻璃蜂窩結構，從而形成堅固、輕便的鏡子。

d62359e2b1536ff46880f2d44003a9a9f7fbf781.sourceText: The Atlas Obscura Podcast is a short, daily celebration of all the world's strange and wondrous places. Check out this episode about the Richard F. Caris Mirror Laboratory .
d62359e2b1536ff46880f2d44003a9a9f7fbf781.translatedText: Atlas Obscura 播客是一個簡短的每日慶祝世界上所有奇怪而奇妙的地方的節目。觀看有關理查德·F·卡里斯鏡子實驗室的這一集。

41100bc0a90e74a041d854f06be608cce2aab5a6.sourceText: Mesa Chinese restaurant known for spicy Sichuan-style dishes, noodles, and chef specialties.
41100bc0a90e74a041d854f06be608cce2aab5a6.translatedText: 梅薩中餐廳以麻辣川菜、麵條和主廚特色菜而聞名。

d7c6bb5421639b3aa93d2853b4340440084aaaef.sourceText: Chinese restaurant in Mesa serving spicy Sichuan-style dishes, chow fun, pad thai, and chef-specialty plates on Country Club Drive.
d7c6bb5421639b3aa93d2853b4340440084aaaef.translatedText: 梅薩中餐廳位於鄉村俱樂部大道，供應麻辣川菜、炒粉、泰式炒河粉和廚師特色菜。

3b7a912afd7ca964fbbbcd8fb7acf12ffc044077.sourceText: If any place defined the lawless, fickle disposition of the Wild West, it was Canyon Diablo.
3b7a912afd7ca964fbbbcd8fb7acf12ffc044077.translatedText: 如果有哪個地方定義了狂野西部無法無天、變化無常的性格，那就是暗黑破壞神峽谷。

d137e78875fc0d50b401bd364ca8f226f93fd4c9.sourceText: Progress on Arizona's stretch of the transcontinental railroad was temporarily halted in 1882 after reaching the edge of Devil's Canyon, a span that would require a bridge. With an estimated six months of staying put, a railman's work camp emerged, and quickly reached a population of over 2,000.
d137e78875fc0d50b401bd364ca8f226f93fd4c9.translatedText: 亞利桑那州橫貫大陸鐵路的進展在 1882 年到達魔鬼峽谷邊緣後暫時停止，這一跨度需要一座橋樑。預計停留六個月後，一個鐵路工人的工作營出現了，人口很快就達到了 2,000 多人。

170a5488194dce1945faa645de653c97eb009719.sourceText: A hasty business community sprung up to serve the needs of the men working on the bridge; brothels, gambling dens and saloons seemed to satisfy the bulk of the consumer demand. Open 24 hours and with no lawmen to regulate or intervene, the town was a dark and dangerous place that was soon branded Canyon Diablo, its main street christened "Hell Street."
170a5488194dce1945faa645de653c97eb009719.translatedText: 一個倉促的商業社區如雨後春筍般湧現，以滿足橋樑工作人員的需求；妓院、賭場和酒吧似乎滿足了大部分消費者的需求。這座小鎮 24 小時開放，沒有執法人員進行監管或乾預，是一個黑暗而危險的地方，很快就被稱為“暗黑破壞神峽谷”，其主要街道被命名為“地獄街”。

632c1e3b4752ce4f1f6223462fa65400a55b0fff.sourceText: The town showed a passionate disinterest in law and order, and any lawman that attempted to stop the havoc was shortly dispatched. The first marshall clocked in at 3:00 PM and was dead by 8:00. Five more tried and failed, earning a one way ticket to the rapidly growing Boot Hill. A particularly wily marshall lasted an entire month, and remained the record holder.
632c1e3b4752ce4f1f6223462fa65400a55b0fff.translatedText: 這座小鎮對法律和秩序表現出強烈的不感興趣，任何試圖阻止混亂的執法人員都很快被派出。第一個執法人員於下午 3:00 打卡上班，並於 8:00 去世。還有五個嘗試但失敗了，贏得了一張前往快速發展的布特山的單程票。一位特別狡猾的馬歇爾堅持了整整一個月，並且仍然是記錄保持者。

825da6651df51be67aeca09da1c35e76cde569c9.sourceText: When the bridge was finished, Canyon Diablo was deserted as quickly as it had appeared, another lonely ghost town littering the race to the west. Long after Hell Street was left to the ghosts, Route 66 was routed a few miles away, and the area had one last pathetic gasp of life in the form of a bizarre tourist trap called Two Guns , managed by an eccentric hermit named Herman Wolfe, who based his schtick heavily on the extremely dark legend of the nearby Apache Death Cave . It was short-lived.
825da6651df51be67aeca09da1c35e76cde569c9.translatedText: 橋樑完工後，迪亞波羅峽谷一出現就被荒廢了，西邊的比賽中又一座孤獨的鬼城。在地獄街被鬼魂遺棄很久之後，66 號公路就在幾英里外消失了，該地區以一種名為“兩把槍”的奇異旅遊陷阱的形式出現了最後一次可悲的生命，由一位名叫赫爾曼·沃爾夫的古怪隱士管理，他的伎倆很大程度上基於附近阿帕奇死亡洞的極其黑暗的傳說。它是短暫的。

71a91ebbcca9c7433cb6adbf9e9db77732b13067.sourceText: The location now contains the traces of a place that trouble from the beginning: ruins and a few crumbling foundations, the grave of Herman Wolfe, and what's left of his trading post.
71a91ebbcca9c7433cb6adbf9e9db77732b13067.translatedText: 該位置現在包含了一個從一開始就陷入困境的地方的痕跡：廢墟和一些搖搖欲墜的地基，赫爾曼沃爾夫的墳墓，以及他的貿易站的剩餘部分。

38ba448d9534625fb8cb531485341b48917c79d8.sourceText: Have a stay in Tucson, Arizona's Congress Hotel. Just be warned about two things: one, it is lovely and historic, and two, you may get swept up in some sort of reenactment of John Dillinger's capture.
38ba448d9534625fb8cb531485341b48917c79d8.translatedText: 入住亞利桑那州圖森市的國會飯店。請注意兩件事：第一，它很可愛且歷史悠久，第二，您可能會被約翰·迪林格 (John Dillinger) 被捕的某種重演所吸引。

c45e837c668bbd4a6be132948a8435511765e7b9.sourceText: This classic hotel, built in 1919, looks like something straight out of the classiest parts of the Jazz Age. Built on the newly paved Congress Street where it still stands, the swanky hotel even looked classy back in the day. Of course all of this splendor in the otherwise developing town managed to attract some high-profile clientele, including some of ill repute. Namely, John Dillinger and his gang.
c45e837c668bbd4a6be132948a8435511765e7b9.translatedText: 這家經典酒店建於 1919 年，看起來就像直接來自爵士樂時代最經典的地方。這家時髦的酒店建在新舖的國會街上，現在仍然矗立著，在當時看起來甚至很優雅。當然，這個發展中的城鎮的所有這些輝煌成功地吸引了一些知名客戶，其中包括一些聲譽不佳的客戶。即約翰·迪林格 (John Dillinger) 和他的團夥。

79f386b8293204ee60017993b3200b95a6a269e4.sourceText: They were staying in the hotel on the night of January 22, 1934, when a fire started in the hotel. Fleeing for their lives, the outlaws evacuated the building, leaving behind luggage containing their weapons and hundreds of thousands of dollars in cash. As they had checked in under aliases, they tried to maintain their cover, paying off a couple of local firemen to go back for the luggage. However the firefighters managed to piece together who the ne'er do wells were, and they were swiftly arrested by the Tucson Police Department.To commemorate their brush with crime, the hotel hosts the Dillinger Days festival each January. So if you happen to find yourself at the hotel around then and someone asks you to go get their luggage for them, just say no.
79f386b8293204ee60017993b3200b95a6a269e4.translatedText: 1934 年 1 月 22 日晚上，他們正在飯店住宿，這時飯店起火了。為了逃命，歹徒們撤離了大樓，留下了裝有武器的行李和數十萬美元的現金。由於他們是用化名辦理登機手續的，他們試圖維持自己的掩護，付錢給了幾名當地消防員，讓他們回去拿行李。然而，消防隊員設法拼湊出誰是不善行為，他們很快就被圖森警察局逮捕。 為了紀念他們與犯罪的擦肩而過，飯店每年一月都會舉辦迪林傑日 (Dillinger Days) 節日。因此，如果您碰巧發現自己當時在酒店，有人讓您去幫他們拿行李，那就說不吧。

5afe792c9bf6fe7d494e77e3a728a712900906da.sourceText: Today, the hotel has been restored to a regal splendor that stands out even more in the modern age. Although rumors still abound of haunted rooms from decades past.
5afe792c9bf6fe7d494e77e3a728a712900906da.translatedText: 今天，飯店已恢復了皇家的輝煌，在現代顯得更加引人注目。儘管關於幾十年前鬧鬼房間的謠言仍然很多。

3f7420f01b052778c95dbd0f65c6bc13d795a359.sourceText: Cơm Tấm Thuận Kiều is listed within Mekong Plaza in Mesa. This profile was generated from plaza directory sources and map-based verification, so direct business contact details may still be incomplete.
3f7420f01b052778c95dbd0f65c6bc13d795a359.translatedText: Cơm Tấm Thuận Kiều 位於梅薩的 Mekong Plaza 內。此設定檔是根據廣場目錄來源和基於地圖的驗證產生的，因此直接業務聯絡詳細資訊可能仍然不完整。

84ca9d09241be4b0a058fa396aef23f75a579da7.sourceText: Steven Crazy Nails is listed within Peoria Lee Lee center in Peoria. This profile was generated from plaza directory sources and map-based verification, so direct business contact details may still be incomplete.
84ca9d09241be4b0a058fa396aef23f75a579da7.translatedText: Steven Crazy Nails 位於皮奧裡亞的 Peoria Lee Lee 中心。此設定檔是根據廣場目錄來源和基於地圖的驗證產生的，因此直接業務聯絡詳細資訊可能仍然不完整。

0412db2a096d94e8a42819b7527bb83a2f68991d.sourceText: "We’re not talking first-generation, second-generation farmers," says Katie Hilbert, the marketing and sales coordinator at San Xavier Cooperative Farm. "We’re talking 4,000 years."
0412db2a096d94e8a42819b7527bb83a2f68991d.translatedText: 「我們說的不是第一代、第二代農民，」聖澤維爾合作農場的營銷和銷售協調員凱蒂希爾伯特說。 「我們說的是 4,000 年。」

25d67cd8d0d8497195068994fee92e1f8b28389c.sourceText: Hilbert is referring to the families who co-own the San Xavier Co-op, members of the Tohono O'odham Nation who are as rooted in the land as the cactus fruits they gather each year. Since 1971, the co-op's conscientious agricultural practices and harvest of local and desert-adapted produce have nourished and preserved the Tohono O'odham Himdag , or "way of life," that has thrived on this land for generations.
25d67cd8d0d8497195068994fee92e1f8b28389c.translatedText: 希爾伯特指的是共同擁有聖澤維爾合作社的家族，他們是 Tohono O'odham 民族的成員，他們就像他們每年採集的仙人掌果實一樣紮根於這片土地。自 1971 年以來，合作社認真的農業實踐以及收穫當地和適合沙漠的農產品滋養並保存了 Tohono O'odham Himdag（「生活方式」），這種生活方式在這片土地上世代繁衍生息。

71d3c0d19688fd700f514a6bfb6d280613b3ed4f.sourceText: It wasn't always easy. Tohono O'odham people traditionally practiced community agriculture . In the late 1800s, however, the United States government passed laws parcelling community land into separate family plots. Locals began working their own plots, rather than farming for the collective well-being. This, combined with the effects of nearby copper mining and industrial farming, led to a decline in the health of the land and the Santa Cruz River, the life-giving force that had long enabled the Tohono O'odham people to thrive in the parched desert.
71d3c0d19688fd700f514a6bfb6d280613b3ed4f.translatedText: 這並不總是那麼容易。 Tohono O'odham 人傳統上從事社區農業。然而，在 1800 年代末，美國政府通過了法律，將社區土地分割成單獨的家庭土地。當地人開始在自己的土地上耕種，而不是為了集體福祉而耕種。再加上附近銅礦開採和工業化農業的影響，導致土地和聖克魯斯河的健康狀況下降，而聖克魯斯河是長期以來使托霍諾·奧德漢姆人在乾旱的沙漠中繁衍生息的生命力量。

4f79d7bbd7ea1b412926161c738154ffd5cdf30f.sourceText: Since 1971, however, members of the co-op have reclaimed their agricultural heritage. They farm based on respect for the sacredness of water, for elders, for the land, for living creatures, and for plants themselves. These management practices have born literal fruit, in the form of ample harvests.
4f79d7bbd7ea1b412926161c738154ffd5cdf30f.translatedText: 然而，自 1971 年以來，合作社成員重新奪回了他們的農業遺產。他們耕作的基礎是尊重水、長輩、土地、生物和植物本身的神聖性。這些管理實務確實取得了豐碩的成果。

be96f5b45076a35361e419b8373fa1e499a1a1bb.sourceText: Visitors to the co-op's farm store will find the "three sisters" typical of indigenous American agriculture—corn, beans, and squash—but in the form of varieties especially adapted to the parched desert climate. The beans are hearty sun-lovers. The 60-day corn springs quickly into abundance at the touch of the late-summer monsoon. The squash, called ha:l , or "big squash," grows up to 20 pounds. Upon harvest, it's cracked open, cut into strips, and hung to dry for winter. Besides the cultivated food, co-op farmers also gather wild plants, including crimson prickly pear for jellies and juice, and mesquite, which locals mill and mix with water for a sweet, nutty drink.
be96f5b45076a35361e419b8373fa1e499a1a1bb.translatedText: 參觀合作社農場商店的遊客會發現美國本土農業的典型「三姊妹」——玉米、豆類和南瓜——但它們的品種特別適合乾旱的沙漠氣候。豆子是熱情的陽光愛好者。在夏末季風的影響下，為期 60 天的玉米很快就會豐收。這種南瓜被稱為 ha:l 或“大南瓜”，可長至 20 磅。收穫後，將其打開，切成條，掛起來晾乾過冬。除了種植的食物外，合作社農民還採集野生植物，包括製作果凍和果汁的深紅色仙人掌，以及豆科灌木，當地人將其磨碎並與水混合製成甜味堅果飲料。

98709a03028f97949c823f05542dfb64be550879.sourceText: The co-op's commitment to respecting the land and its inhabitants, both human and nonhuman, has paid off. Recently, says Hilbert, for the first time in a long time, the life-giving waters of the Santa Cruz River have started to feed the fields once again. "There are some trickles of water in places, which makes people happy," Hilbert says. "There’s some green coming back to the river."
98709a03028f97949c823f05542dfb64be550879.translatedText: 合作社尊重土地及其居民（無論是人類還是非人類）的承諾已得到回報。希爾伯特說，最近，聖克魯斯河賦予生命的河水長期以來第一次開始再次灌溉農田。 「有些地方有一些細流，這讓人們感到高興，」希爾伯特說。 “有些綠色又回到了河裡。”

4793fdea5eea2edb7872b3188937b669b6ad427f.sourceText: The Arizona Commerce Authority said the state is expanding its relationship with Taiwan through a multi-city visit by a 30-person delegation drawn from investment and higher-education circles. According to the announcement, the group represents industries that matter heavily to Arizona’s growth strategy, including semiconductors, medical biotechnology, aerospace, and artificial intelligence. Their itinerary spans Phoenix, Tucson, Yuma, and Flagstaff, where they are expected to meet local government, utility, education, and economic-development leaders.
4793fdea5eea2edb7872b3188937b669b6ad427f.translatedText: 亞利桑那州商務局表示，該州正在透過一個由來自投資和高等教育界的 30 人代表團組成的多城市訪問來擴大與台灣的關係。根據公告，該組織代表了對亞利桑那州成長策略至關重要的產業，包括半導體、醫療生物技術、航空航太和人工智慧。他們的行程涵蓋鳳凰城、圖森、尤馬和弗拉格斯塔夫，預計他們將在那裡會見當地政府、公用事業、教育和經濟發展領導人。

5417d3c9f68285be3c69b0becffae3ddc16a5791.sourceText: The state also used the visit to formalize a new partnership with Sustainable Impact Capital, a Taiwan-based investor network focused on founders building with AI. ACA and SIC signed a memorandum of understanding meant to position Arizona as a U.S. base for Taiwanese startups looking for market access, local partners, and expansion support. Sandra Watson of the Arizona Commerce Authority and Amos Huang of SIC signed the agreement, with Dennis Lee identified as a witness during an Arizona Tech Week event on April 10.
5417d3c9f68285be3c69b0becffae3ddc16a5791.translatedText: 該州還利用這次訪問與永續影響資本正式建立了新的合作夥伴關係，永續影響資本是一家總部位於台灣的投資者網絡，專注於人工智慧創始人的建設。 ACA 和 SIC 簽署了一份諒解備忘錄，旨在將亞利桑那州定位為台灣新創企業尋求市場准入、當地合作夥伴和擴張支持的美國基地。亞利桑那州商務局的桑德拉·沃森 (Sandra Watson) 和 SIC 的阿莫斯·黃 (Amos Huang) 簽署了該協議，丹尼斯·李 (Dennis Lee) 是 4 月 10 日亞利桑那州科技週活動期間的見證人。

62e9f0be049d7ddb185caeb57ea8706e49966c9b.sourceText: State officials framed the move as part of a broader effort to turn long-running Arizona-Taiwan ties into more company launches, investment, and supply-chain activity on the ground in Arizona. The announcement highlights Arizona’s push to connect overseas founders with local business networks and institutions rather than treating international trade as a one-off export relationship. It also underscores how the state is trying to convert semiconductor momentum into spillover growth for adjacent sectors like advanced manufacturing, biotech, and applied AI.
62e9f0be049d7ddb185caeb57ea8706e49966c9b.translatedText: 州官員將此舉視為更廣泛努力的一部分，旨在將亞利桑那州與台灣的長期關係轉化為更多的公司在亞利桑那州成立、投資和供應鏈活動。這項公告凸顯了亞利桑那州致力於將海外創辦人與當地商業網絡和機構聯繫起來，而不是將國際貿易視為一次性出口關係。它還強調了該州如何將半導體動力轉化為先進製造、生物技術和應用人工智慧等鄰近行業的溢出成長。

8c163fc1e838d1b40d29dafd29a459aeb565ca8f.sourceText: The article points to the scale of the relationship already in place: in 2025, Taiwan overtook both Canada and China to become Arizona’s second-largest trading partner, behind only Mexico, with more than $21.2 billion in total trade. That context matters for Arizona residents and business owners because it suggests the state is not only courting new foreign investment, but building deeper operating ties that can shape future hiring, supplier opportunities, university collaboration, and startup activity. For communities around major Arizona growth corridors, the delegation signals continued international attention on the state’s technology and manufacturing ecosystem.
8c163fc1e838d1b40d29dafd29a459aeb565ca8f.translatedText: 文章指出了雙方關係的規模：2025年，台灣超過加拿大和中國，成為亞利桑那州第二大貿易夥伴，僅次於墨西哥，貿易總額超過212億美元。這種背景對亞利桑那州居民和企業主來說很重要，因為它表明該州不僅在吸引新的外國投資，而且在建立更深的營運聯繫，從而影響未來的招募、供應商機會、大學合作和創業活動。對於亞利桑那州主要成長走廊周圍的社區來說，代表團標誌著國際社會對該州技術和製造生態系統的持續關注。

1cbf7ada3d17e6409836e135506554e65e6ddbce.sourceText: Mesa is slated to get a new hotel development as work moves forward on the Cambria Hotel Mesa. The property is being built at 3501 South Ellsworth Road and is planned as a four-story hotel designed to serve guests looking for a higher-end stay in the East Valley.
1cbf7ada3d17e6409836e135506554e65e6ddbce.translatedText: 隨著梅薩坎布里亞酒店 (Cambria Hotel Mesa) 工程的進展，梅薩預計將獲得新的酒店開發項目。該酒店位於南埃爾斯沃思路 3501 號，規劃為四層樓酒店，旨在為在東谷尋求高端住宿的客人提供服務。

5107929d46752f0cd7c3be3cb7421217179b58ae.sourceText: According to the report, the hotel will include 107 guest rooms along with several features that go beyond a standard overnight property. Plans call for a rooftop restaurant, a lobby bar, an outdoor pool, and other guest amenities, with the opening expected in early 2027.
5107929d46752f0cd7c3be3cb7421217179b58ae.translatedText: 據報道，該酒店將包括 107 間客房以及一些超出標準過夜酒店的功能。計劃建造屋頂餐廳、大廳酒吧、室外游泳池和其他賓客設施，預計於 2027 年初開幕。

e8b07d1ba857f5ee48afb8d5af3e73e0afa24082.sourceText: The source also points to a recent post from O’Reilly Hospitality Management that highlighted the project’s groundbreaking and listed additional features. Those include a fitness center, a grab-and-go market, guest laundry, meeting rooms, and electric-vehicle charging stations. One notable detail for Mesa residents is that the rooftop bar and restaurant are intended to be open to the public, not just hotel guests, with views of the surrounding desert.
e8b07d1ba857f5ee48afb8d5af3e73e0afa24082.translatedText: 該消息人士還指出 O’Reilly Hospitality Management 最近發表的一篇文章，強調了該專案的開創性並列出了其他功能。其中包括健身中心、即買即走市場、客用洗衣房、會議室和電動車充電站。對於梅薩居民來說，一個值得注意的細節是，屋頂酒吧和餐廳旨在向公眾開放，而不僅僅是酒店客人，可以欣賞周圍沙漠的景色。

81b6462e5ec30c6472c768ddd180547bcaf22492.sourceText: The development is backed by Aspect Hospitality Group, Clarity Strategic Opportunities, and O’Reilly Hospitality, while O’Reilly Hospitality Management is expected to handle day-to-day operations. For Mesa, the project signals more hotel and dining investment near a growing part of the city, adding both visitor capacity and a new hospitality venue that could draw local traffic as well.
81b6462e5ec30c6472c768ddd180547bcaf22492.translatedText: 該開發案得到了 Aspect Hospitality Group、Clarity Strategy Opportunities 和 O’Reilly Hospitality 的支持，而 O’Reilly Hospitality Management 預計將處理日常營運。對於梅薩來說，該項目標誌著該市不斷增長的地區附近有更多的酒店和餐飲投資，增加了遊客容量，並建立了一個新的接待場所，也可以吸引當地的交通。

871a90c4c053b8cf69a67a1ecb7c292ff2bd78c4.sourceText: The 2024 Chinese New Year Show (Spring Festival Gala) was held at the Chandler Center for the Arts on February 3, 2024. Organized by The Crane Foundation, Arizona Art Academy, the City of Chandler, and UCA AZ, the event was a resounding success. This annual gala has been a staple in Arizona’s Chinese community for over a decade, earning recognition as a prominent cultural event in mainstream media. With 2024 being the Year of the Dragon, the organizers embraced the theme, kicking off the evening with a grand dance titled “Dragon Soars, Lion Dances.” The program was also invited to perform as the opening act for the Diamondback Asian Heritage Month competition. Thanks to years of dedicated effort, the Arizona Spring Festival Gala has become not only a cultural feast for overseas Chinese during the Lunar New Year but also a window for the general public to experience Asian heritage. Public schools such as Coronado Elementary School, Tarwater Elementary School, and Hamilton High School joined the lineup, adding to the diversity of performances. As the oldest Chinese dance school in the local area, the Arizona Art Academy impressed both the Chandler City Government and the general audience with the quality of their performances. As a charitable event, 250 complimentary tickets were distributed to Chandler City Government, police, firefighters, and educators in appreciation of their outstanding service to the community. Recognized as a cultural brand in Arizona, the Arizona Spring Festival Gala received generous sponsorship from the city of Chandler, Arizona’s Vision, and UCACF. For more highlights from the gala, stay tuned to the Arizona Chinese Community Network’s coverage.
871a90c4c053b8cf69a67a1ecb7c292ff2bd78c4.translatedText: 2024年2月3日，由克瑞基金會、亞利桑那州藝術學院、錢德勒市政府、亞利桑那州UCA主辦的2024年新春晚會在錢德勒藝術中心舉行，活動取得了巨大成功。十多年來，這項年度盛典一直是亞利桑那州華人社區的主要活動，被主流媒體視為重要的文化活動。 2024年是龍年，主辦單位緊扣這個主題，以一場名為「龍騰獅舞」的盛大舞蹈拉開了晚會的序幕。該節目也受邀作為響尾蛇亞洲傳統月比賽的開幕表演。經過多年的傾心努力，亞利桑那州春晚不僅成為海外華人新年的文化盛宴，也成為廣大民眾體驗亞洲傳統的窗口。科羅納多小學、塔爾沃特小學、漢密爾頓高中等公立學校也加入了陣容，增加了表演的多樣性。作為當地歷史最悠久的中國舞蹈學校，亞利桑那藝術學院的表演品質給錢德勒市政府和廣大觀眾留下了深刻的印象。作為一項慈善活動，我們向錢德勒市政府、警察、消防員和教育工作者分發了 250 張免費門票，以感謝他們對社區的傑出服務。亞利桑那春晚被認為是亞利桑那州的文化品牌，並獲得了錢德勒市、亞利桑那州視覺和UCACF的慷慨贊助。更多晚會精彩內容，請關注亞利桑那州華人社區網報。

2b63812dbf6e73266527eda0ea4aa24780038550.sourceText: Built in the mid-1970s, Palo Verde Generating Station isn’t your typical nuclear power plant. Almost all thermal power plants — those that produce steam to spin turbines and generate electricity — are situated near large bodies of water, such as rivers or oceans. But a desert? Many laughed at the thought, but engineers designed an innovative solution that pipes reclaimed wastewater from Phoenix’s 91st Avenue Sewage Treatment Plant over 35 miles west to the power plant. Check out a cross-section of this water pipe, lean into a life-sized version of a reinforced-concrete storage cask, and tour the energy education center to learn more about the plant that generates nearly one-third of Arizona’s electricity.
2b63812dbf6e73266527eda0ea4aa24780038550.translatedText: 帕洛維德發電廠建於 1970 年代中期，並非典型的核電廠。幾乎所有的火力發電廠——那些產生蒸汽來旋轉渦輪機並發電的火力發電廠——都位於大片水域附近，例如河流或海洋。但沙漠？許多人嘲笑這個想法，但工程師設計了一種創新的解決方案，將來自鳳凰城第 91 大道污水處理廠的回收廢水通過管道輸送到發電廠以西 35 英里處。查看該水管的橫截面，靠近真人大小的鋼筋混凝土存儲桶，並參觀能源教育中心，以了解有關該工廠的更多信息，該工廠生產亞利桑那州近三分之一的電力。

c6c307371cbe3cb1e30233087fb0f618aaa8a75f.sourceText: Email pvexhivits@apsc.com or call 623.393.4699 to schedule a visit of the inside portion of the educational center.
c6c307371cbe3cb1e30233087fb0f618aaa8a75f.translatedText: 發送電子郵件至 pvexhivits@apsc.com 或致電 623.393.4699 安排參觀教育中心的內部部分中心。

0d1d02af4d9121cf17858b15bc829d36f23601b4.sourceText: The Vulture Mine, located 12 miles south of Wickenburg, AZ, was home to Arizona's most productive gold mine. It was founded in 1863 by Henry Wickenburg, though due to a dispute over his claim after selling the mine to Benjamin Phelps (and the investors Phelps represented), Wickenburg lost the rights to his claim and was pushed out of camp.
0d1d02af4d9121cf17858b15bc829d36f23601b4.translatedText: 禿鷹礦場位於亞利桑那州威肯堡以南 12 英里處，是亞利桑那州產量最高的金礦所在地。它由亨利·威肯堡 (Henry Wickenburg) 於 1863 年創立，但由於在將礦山出售給本傑明·菲爾普斯 (Benjamin Phelps)（以及菲爾普斯所代表的投資者）後，由於其所有權爭議，威肯堡失去了其所有權並被趕出營地。

67ff993dbfc7cc3ae696222590baf04bcfcdcf09.sourceText: Vulture Mine pushed on without the presence of Henry Wickenburg and produced 360,000 oz of gold and 260,000 oz of silver. Most was mined between 1864 and 1912, though the town wasn't abandoned until 1942 when the Second War Act was passed and all "non-essential" gold mines were shut down.
67ff993dbfc7cc3ae696222590baf04bcfcdcf09.translatedText: 禿鷹礦在亨利威肯堡 (Henry Wickenburg) 不在場的情況下繼續發展，生產了 360,000 盎司黃金和 260,000 盎司白銀。大多數金礦是在 1864 年至 1912 年間開采的，儘管該鎮直到 1942 年《第二次戰爭法案》通過後才被廢棄，所有「非必要」金礦都被關閉。

ec3d7de92b9a72973e407ae16ec86b274388865c.sourceText: The mining camp sat abandoned for decades until the current owners acquired it from the Vulture Mine (which began operations in 2014) and restorations began in 2017. Now 16 original buildings remain and have been stabilized so as to be safe to enter.
ec3d7de92b9a72973e407ae16ec86b274388865c.translatedText: 採礦營地被廢棄了數十年，直到現任所有者從 Vulture 礦（該礦於 2014 年開始運營）收購了它，並於 2017 年開始修復。現在仍保留 16 座原始建築，並已修復。

e7437e44b46c9dc89dc35f865b5539472d5a901c.sourceText: A few key buildings such as the brothel (with an indoor kitchen), assay building (divided into four sections), and power house (which houses a WW1 era submarine diesel engine that powered the town!) are architecturally and historically interesting.
e7437e44b46c9dc89dc35f865b5539472d5a901c.translatedText: 一些關鍵建築，如妓院（帶室內廚房）、化驗大樓（分為四個部分）和發電廠（裡面裝有為城鎮提供動力的一戰時期潛艇柴油發動機！）在建築和歷史上都很有趣。

6703bbcbce6602d264dedb331e1311235f6480e5.sourceText: It's sordid history as a 19th century pioneer saloon, catering to the likes of Wyatt and Virgil Earp, and Doc Holiday and his girlfriend Big Nose Kate, speaks for itself as a point of interest. This saloon is considered the oldest saloon in Arizona, having operated since 1877 and, even though the building was destroyed in the 1900 Whiskey Row fire, it was rebuilt and reopened in 1901. It has continued operation ever since, maintaining its status as the state's oldest operating bar.
6703bbcbce6602d264dedb331e1311235f6480e5.translatedText: 作為一家 19 世紀的先鋒酒吧，這裡有一段骯髒的歷史，專門為懷亞特 (Wyatt) 和維吉爾·厄普 (Virgil Earp)、霍利迪醫生 (Doc Holiday) 和他的女朋友大鼻子凱特 (Big Nose Kate) 等人提供服務，這本身就是一個有趣的地方。這家酒吧被認為是亞利桑那州最古老的酒吧，自 1877 年開始營業，儘管該建築在 1900 年的威士忌街火災中被毀，但它於 1901 年重建並重新開業。此後它一直營業至今，保持了該州最古老的營業酒吧的地位。

29adeba42bfb6e2be059113cc5339eccdede86cc.sourceText: The food is delicious, the friendly staff dress in period clothing, and the whiskey/scotch/bourbon list would make even the hardest of old west gunslingers beg for their mamas.
29adeba42bfb6e2be059113cc5339eccdede86cc.translatedText: 食物美味，友善的員工穿著古裝，威士忌/蘇格蘭威士忌/波本威士忌單品即使是最難吃的酒單也會讓您胃口大開。

875728a2cf6fdc4db263ce87404b7492d927111c.sourceText: While waiting for your dinner, grab your bourbon and take in the memorabilia that lines the walls, serving as a mini museum, if you weren't already busy looking at the leaded glass and the centerpiece of the saloon, the Brunswick bar, which was saved from destruction in the fire of 1900.
875728a2cf6fdc4db263ce87404b7492d927111c.translatedText: 在等待晚餐時，拿起一杯波本威士忌，看看牆上排列的紀念品，這裡就像一個迷你博物館，如果您還沒有忙著觀看含鉛玻璃和酒吧的中心裝飾品，不倫瑞克酒吧，該酒吧在 1900 年的大火中倖免於難。

f3a00e11fd9e8c7466fa6721af0d70df6a81ede1.sourceText: The 24-foot-long bar was built in New Jersey and freighted around the tip of South America to San Francisco, where it was transported by pack mule to Prescott, then the territorial capital of Arizona.
f3a00e11fd9e8c7466fa6721af0d70df6a81ede1.translatedText: 24 英尺長的酒吧在新澤西州建造，並繞南美洲一角運至舊金山，在那裡通過馱騾運輸到當時亞利桑那州首府普雷斯科特。

fccc586a7ca515d227d2ad5d3da4e2ecbe290f69.sourceText: Today, much of the world is fortunate to have sufficient sanitation and methods of treatment to prevent widespread tuberculosis (TB). In the early 20th century, however, this was not the case, and the disease was much more poorly understood and a massive issue. Prior to the discovery of antibiotics, TB patients (known as "lungers") would often seek treatment at sanatoria in places with healthier air. Arizona was especially considered an ideal place because of its warm and dry climate. Several were located in the then-sparsely populated Cave Creek area alone.
fccc586a7ca515d227d2ad5d3da4e2ecbe290f69.translatedText: 如今，世界上大部分地區都幸運地擁有足夠的衛生設施和治療方法來預防結核病 (TB) 的廣泛傳播。然而，在 20 世紀初，情況並非如此，人們對這種疾病的了解要少得多，而且是一個嚴重的問題。在發現抗生素之前，結核病患者（稱為「肺結核患者」）經常會到空氣較健康的地方的療養院尋求治療。亞利桑那州因其溫暖乾燥的氣候而被特別認為是一個理想的地方。有幾處療養院位於當時人口稀少的 Cave Creek 地區。

0c27713a49291191dc69268c30ccde0c189cb6d5.sourceText: With thousands of patients coming to the state, the sanatoria were overloaded with many being forced to stay in tents. Better-equipped sanatoria had proper TB cabins or huts in which "lungers" lived. This particular example from Cave Creek was at the Desmount Sanatarium, which operated during the 1920s and 30s. Most of these structures did not survive long. This one did because it was used for various other purposes afterwards, including housing for construction workers of nearby dams. Finally, in 1990 it was restored moved to its present location at the Cave Creek Museum. Recognized as the last tubercular cabin in Arizona, it was also named to the National Register of Historic Places.
0c27713a49291191dc69268c30ccde0c189cb6d5.translatedText: 隨著數千名患者來到該州，療養院人滿為患，許多人被迫住在帳篷裡。設備較好的療養院有適當的結核病小屋或小屋，供「潛伏者」居住。這個來自 Cave Creek 的特殊例子是德斯蒙特療養院 (Desmount Sanatarium)，該療養院於 1920 年代和 1930 年代運營。大多數這些建築都沒有存活多久。之所以這麼做，是因為它後來被用於各種其他目的，包括為附近水壩的建築工人提供住房。最後，在 1990 年，它被修復並搬到了洞溪博物館 (Cave Creek Museum) 的現址。它被認為是亞利桑那州最後一個結核小屋，也被列入國家歷史名勝名錄。
