7326c12e0588435ae0a7b05c9aed391b2575bc27.sourceText: On June 28, 2013, a lightning strike outside the town of Yarnell, Arizona , sparked the Yarnell Hill Fire. On June 30 , strong winds picked up and, aided by a long drought and temperatures over 100 degrees Fahrenheit, the wildfire began to spread rapidly.
7326c12e0588435ae0a7b05c9aed391b2575bc27.translatedText: 2013年6月28日，亞利桑那州亞內爾鎮外的一次雷擊引發了亞內爾山大火。 6 月 30 日，強風襲來，在長期乾旱和超過 100 華氏度的氣溫的幫助下，野火開始迅速蔓延。

46cf5817af671a6ed4611caf4fd57398c2abb383.sourceText: The Granite Mountain Hotshots were a 20-man wildland firefighting crew based out of Prescott, Arizona, 30 miles from Yarnell. When the fire began to threaten nearby towns, the Granite Mountain Hotshots and several other fire crews were deployed to contain the flames.
46cf5817af671a6ed4611caf4fd57398c2abb383.translatedText: Granite Mountain Hotshots 是一支 20 人的荒地消防隊，駐紮在亞利桑那州普雷斯科特，距離亞內爾 30 英里。當大火開始威脅附近城鎮時，花崗岩山能手和其他幾名消防人員被部署來控制火勢。

a7b2e61b778957f5f1723aec9886a425fc8d308b.sourceText: In the late afternoon, the fire began to shift directions, taking a deadly turn. The crew's lookout was ordered to retreat back and abandon his position to move their vehicles to a safer location. Without their lookout, the remaining 19 members of the fire crew were unable to see that the fire's shifting direction had cut them off from the designated safe zones and that they had nowhere to retreat to. Helicopters attempted to assist from above, but the thick smoke obstructed visibility.
a7b2e61b778957f5f1723aec9886a425fc8d308b.translatedText: 下午晚些時候，火勢開始改變方向，出現致命的轉變。船員的瞭望員被命令撤退並放棄其位置，將車輛轉移到更安全的位置。沒有瞭望，其餘 19 名消防隊員無法看到火勢的變化已經將他們與指定的安全區域隔離開來，他們無處可退。直升機試圖從上方提供援助，但濃煙阻礙了能見度。

b07d5e11c5164a68f06bc6bd7011f611117ce07f.sourceText: Surrounded by steep slopes on three sides and flames racing to them on the other, the trapped members of the Granite Mountain Hotshots did the only thing they still could do: use their tools to create a small clearing in the brush, deploy their emergency fire shelters, and hope for the best.
b07d5e11c5164a68f06bc6bd7011f611117ce07f.translatedText: 三邊被陡坡包圍，另一邊火焰向他們撲來，被困的花崗岩山高手隊員做了他們唯一能做的事情：用他們的工具在灌木叢中開闢出一小塊空地，部署緊急消防避難所，並祈禱最好的結果。

74126b47a4560c7a7e66aa0ea531417031eb669d.sourceText: An hour and a half later, a helicopter was finally able to reach the location of the Granite Mountain Hotshots. Tragically, it was too late. All 19 firefighters at the scene had perished.
74126b47a4560c7a7e66aa0ea531417031eb669d.translatedText: 一個半小時​​後，直升機終於能夠到達花崗岩山高手的所在地。可悲的是，為時已晚。現場19名消防員全數罹難。

4a91a7d871b4a8fc9be611d8fbb1ba60860ce853.sourceText: The Yarnell Hill Fire was 100 percent contained on July 10. It burned more than 8,000 acres and caused $900 million in damage. It was also the deadliest wildfire to United States firefighters since the 1933 Griffith Park Fire and the sixth deadliest disaster to U.S. firefighters overall.
4a91a7d871b4a8fc9be611d8fbb1ba60860ce853.translatedText: 7 月 10 日，Yarnell Hill 大火已得到 100% 控制。大火燒毀了 8,000 多英畝土地，造成了 9 億美元的損失。這也是自 1933 年格里菲斯公園火災以來對美國消防員造成最嚴重死亡的野火，也是對美國消防員造成的第六次最嚴重的災難。

95911077f12b60bfa300301a07788d0710f714bc.sourceText: If you think the Golden Arches were an immutable part of the McDonald's legacy, you'd be wrong.
95911077f12b60bfa300301a07788d0710f714bc.translatedText: 如果您認為金色拱門是麥當勞遺產中不可改變的一部分，那您就錯了。

ef1a7c149ee34cea893c9d99a844c29f9e4f7968.sourceText: In 1993, the city of Sedona allowed McDonald's to open in their town under one condition: They change the color of their logo. In order to preserve the natural beauty of the red rocks in the area and keep the overall aesthetic of the town (because that's something people thought about in the '90s), local officials required that McDonald's change their famous yellow logo to teal. Sedona representatives were concerned the giant golden M would clash with the tones of the surrounding landscape.
ef1a7c149ee34cea893c9d99a844c29f9e4f7968.translatedText: 1993 年，塞多納市允許麥當勞在其城鎮開業，但有一個條件：他們更改徽標的顏色。為了保護該地區紅色岩石的自然美景並保持小鎮的整體美感（因為這是90年代人們的想法），當地官員要求麥當勞將其著名的黃色標誌改為青色。塞多納代表擔心巨大的金色 M 會與周圍景觀的色調發生衝突。

bf68d634c539398875df72d45c2b8670a922c4d8.sourceText: The teal arches, along with teal welcome signs, still stand there today. They're the only teal McDonald's arches in the world.
bf68d634c539398875df72d45c2b8670a922c4d8.translatedText: 青色拱門以及青色歡迎標誌至今仍矗立在那裡。它們是世界上唯一的青色麥當勞拱門。

2e381484125de7d19de47ec323301ad1a715d3c4.sourceText: Launched in 1915, in honor of Arizona, which had attained statehood three years earlier, the USS Arizona was a battleship in the US Navy. Twenty-seven years later, the ship was sunk during the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor, Hawai'i , during World War II. Despite its relatively short career, the Arizona was present for several notable events and today the battleship is memorialized within the Capitol building of its namesake.
2e381484125de7d19de47ec323301ad1a715d3c4.translatedText: 亞利桑那號戰艦於 1915 年下水，是為了紀念三年前建州的亞利桑那號，它是美國海軍的戰艦。二十七年後，這艘船在第二次世界大戰期間日本襲擊夏威夷珍珠港時被擊沉。儘管其職業生涯相對較短，但亞利桑那號還是參加了一些重大事件，今天，這艘戰艦被紀念在同名的國會大廈內。

7fa0da3db96430e2f27e07b2e1a63dc83cafa67c.sourceText: The Arizona spent World War I mostly in the United States, primarily used in training missions and only sailing across the Atlantic Ocean after the armistice ending the war had been signed. The Arizona was part of the convoy escorting President Woodrow Wilson to Europe for the Paris Peace Conference and later part of the fleet that escorted him back to the United States. In 1919, tensions rose between the Greek, Italian, and Turkish governments over the partitioning of land after the war, and the Arizona was positioned between the unhappy parties to ensure the treaty was enforced.
7fa0da3db96430e2f27e07b2e1a63dc83cafa67c.translatedText: 第一次世界大戰期間，亞利桑那號主要在美國度過，主要用於訓練任務，僅在結束戰爭的停戰協定簽署後才跨越大西洋航行。亞利桑那號是護送伍德羅·威爾遜總統前往歐洲參加巴黎和會的護航艦隊的一部分，後來又是護送他返回美國的艦隊的一部分。 1919 年，希臘、義大利和土耳其政府之間因戰後土地分割問題而關係緊張，亞利桑那號被置於不滿雙方之間以確保條約得到執行。

21c9f51a2c1eda370b08be26ed230008e02ce0f8.sourceText: Early in the 1920s, the Arizona was moved to San Pedro, California , which would be her home port for most of the next two decades. In 1924, the Arizona and her crew were part of a scandal in which a sex worker named Madeline Blair was smuggled aboard by sailors and plied her trade in exchange for secret passage from New York to California, where she hoped to become a movie star. Shortly after passing through the Panama Canal, Blair was discovered and sent back to New York by train. Every officer on the ship received a letter of reprimand and 23 sailors were court-martialed, with sentences of up to 10 years handed down.
21c9f51a2c1eda370b08be26ed230008e02ce0f8.translatedText: 1920 年代初，亞利桑那號遷往加州聖佩德羅，在接下來的二十年的大部分時間裡，這裡都是她的母港。 1924 年，亞利桑那號及其船員捲入了一場醜聞，一名名叫馬德琳·布萊爾 (Madeline Blair) 的性工作者被水手偷偷帶上船，並從事其貿易，以換取從紐約到加利福尼亞的秘密通道，她希望在那裡成為一名電影明星。經過巴拿馬運河後不久，布萊爾被發現並搭火車送回紐約。船上的每位軍官都收到了譴責信，23 名水手被送上軍事法庭，最高可判處 10 年徒刑。

c12e213a19e19964fcc1196f68c6ee873255dd47.sourceText: Apart from training exercises, the Arizona was used as a floating embassy, hosting diplomats in foreign ports and in 1931 was even used by President Herbert Hoover during a vacation to the Caribbean. In 1934, the Arizona and her crew starred in the romantic comedy film Here Comes the Navy , which received an Oscar nomination for Best Picture. In 1940, as tensions between the United States and Japan rose, the Arizona was transferred to Hawai'i.
c12e213a19e19964fcc1196f68c6ee873255dd47.translatedText: 除了訓練演習外，亞利桑那號還被用作浮動大使館，在外國港口接待外交官，甚至在 1931 年赫伯特·胡佛總統前往加勒比海度假時也曾使用過。 1934年，亞利桑那號及其船員主演了浪漫喜劇電影《海軍來了》，該片獲得奧斯卡最佳影片提名。 1940 年，隨著美國和日本之間的緊張局勢升級，亞利桑那號被轉移到夏威夷。

e2ae0625b62d0640b75c46c26921cefd2d432176.sourceText: On December 7, 1941, the Navy base at Pearl Harbor was attacked by Japanese military aircraft. Shortly after the attack began, a bomb from a Japanese plane detonated one of the Arizona 's munition stores, resulting in a cataclysmic explosion. Nearly all of the sailors aboard died in the attack—1,177 of the ship's crew of 1,512. Their deaths made up more than half of the total American casualties in the battle.
e2ae0625b62d0640b75c46c26921cefd2d432176.translatedText: 1941 年 12 月 7 日，珍珠港海軍基地遭到日本軍機的攻擊。攻擊開始後不久，一架日本飛機發射的炸彈引爆了亞利桑那號的彈藥庫，引發了災難性的爆炸。在船上 1,512 名船員中，幾乎所有水手都在襲擊中喪生，其中 1,177 人喪生。他們的死亡佔這場戰鬥中美軍傷亡總數的一半以上。

74a6139a21897e9049e869d7d797d79e01dabbd7.sourceText: Most of the ship remains underwater where she was sunk and is managed by the National Park Service as Pearl Harbor National Memorial but several pieces have made it back to the state of her namesake. An anchor, mast, and one of the ship's large guns are in a plaza in front of the Capitol building in downtown Phoenix . Additionally, part of the ship's superstructure, the ship bugle, the flag the ship was flying as it sank, and its ceremonial silverware are displayed in the Arizona Capitol Museum.
74a6139a21897e9049e869d7d797d79e01dabbd7.translatedText: 這艘船的大部分部件仍留在沉沒處的水下，由國家公園管理局作為珍珠港國家紀念館進行管理，但有幾塊部件已經回到了她同名的狀態。鳳凰城市中心國會大廈前的廣場上有一個錨、桅杆和船上的大砲。此外，該船的部分上層建築、船號、沉沒時懸掛的旗幟以及其禮儀銀器均在亞利桑那州國會大廈博物館展出。

7c4c3df957ecd8f2901daa47195277990fa1d4f6.sourceText: The southwestern mining city of Bisbee, Arizona , is an unlikely spot for baseball history. But here in the neighborhood of Warren, visitors can find the historic Warren Ballpark, one of the oldest baseball stadiums in the country. Sadly, this Field of Dreams may be best known today for hosting one of the most nightmarish incidents in American history.
7c4c3df957ecd8f2901daa47195277990fa1d4f6.translatedText: 亞利桑那州西南部的礦業城市比斯比不太可能成為棒球歷史上的一個地方。但在沃倫附近，遊客可以找到歷史悠久的沃倫棒球場，這是全國最古老的棒球場之一。可悲的是，這個夢想之地今天可能因發生了美國歷史上最可怕的事件之一而聞名。

76064208d079f5fa00d75d71e26e7b4d609b6b78.sourceText: Warren Ballpark bills itself as the “oldest multi-sport park in the United States.” Baseball came to Bisbee in 1899, courtesy of the Calumet and Arizona Mining Company (which would later merge with the massive Phelps Dodge Corporation). The company formed a team known as the Copper Kings to play locally. By 1909, a permanent stadium was erected in the Warren Mining District. This area was named for George Warren, a prospector and raging alcoholic who bet his mining stake that he could outrun a horse . As it turned out, horses were fast, and Warren died penniless, but not before lending his name to the neighborhood and ballpark for eternity.
76064208d079f5fa00d75d71e26e7b4d609b6b78.translatedText: 華倫棒球場自稱是「美國最古老的綜合運動公園」。 1899 年，在 Calumet 和亞利桑那礦業公司（後來與規模龐大的菲爾普斯道奇公司合併）的幫助下，棒球運動來到了比斯比。該公司組建了一支名為“Copper Kings”的球隊在當地進行比賽。 1909 年，沃倫礦區建立了一座永久體育場。該地區以喬治沃倫 (George Warren) 命名，他是一位探礦者和狂暴的酒鬼，他用自己的採礦股份打賭自己能跑得比馬跑得快。事實證明，馬匹跑得很快，沃倫去世時身無分文，但在此之前，他的名字永遠留給了社區和棒球場。

63d154f699b611e108e5fe77fad71ae3829d02c1.sourceText: The ballpark opened on June 27, 1909, as the El Paso Browns took on the Bisbee Beautiful. Notably, this makes the ballpark one year older than Rickwood Field , often claimed to be America’s oldest professional ballpark. Therefore, some in Bisbee claim that Warren Ballpark is America’s oldest baseball stadium in continuous use, however, as much of the grandstand was rebuilt in the 1930s, the debate still rages.
63d154f699b611e108e5fe77fad71ae3829d02c1.translatedText: 棒球場於 1909 年 6 月 27 日開放，埃爾帕索布朗隊 (El Paso Browns) 迎戰比斯比美隊 (Bisbee Beautiful)。值得注意的是，這使得球場比里克伍德球場 (Rickwood Field) 還要老一歲，而里克伍德球場經常被稱為美國最古老的職業棒球場。因此，比斯比的一些人聲稱沃倫棒球場是美國持續​​使用的最古老的棒球場，然而，由於大部分看台是在 1930 年代重建的，爭論仍然激烈。

03cd7db8ba1d79ade8366dc5896bc93667f9f507.sourceText: Nonetheless, the venerable park was host to all manner of professional and semi-professional baseball and football teams, including the Bisbee Bees and Bisbee-Douglas Copper Kings , as well as barnstorming teams packed with major league superstars. Today, the park hosts Bisbee’s high school baseball and football teams, including the second-longest rivalry in football, as the Bisbee Pumas square off regularly against the Douglas Bulldogs, their fiercest rival. Each year, the ballpark hosts the Copper Classic, a Base Ball (the original spelling) tournament where teams of men and women compete using vintage uniforms and rules.
03cd7db8ba1d79ade8366dc5896bc93667f9f507.translatedText: 儘管如此，這個古老的公園還是各種職業和半職業棒球隊和橄欖球隊的主場，包括比斯比蜜蜂隊和比斯比-道格拉斯銅王隊，以及擠滿了大聯盟超級巨星的巡迴演講隊。如今，該公園是比斯比高中棒球隊和橄欖球隊的主場，其中包括橄欖球界第二長的對抗賽，比斯比美洲獅隊定期與他們最強勁的對手道格拉斯鬥牛犬隊對決。每年，球場都會舉辦銅經典賽（Copper Classic），這是一項棒球（原始拼字）錦標賽，男女隊伍穿著老式製服和規則進行比賽。

fe3e917ffa20a28a6e03298bc558b9e61ac97be2.sourceText: Unfortunately, the stadium was also the site of one of the grimmest acts in the history of the American labor movement. The Phelps Dodge Corporation had a history of anti-union practices, but by 1917, the International Workers of the World had gained a foothold. Calling for an end to discrimination against foreign workers and minorities, and better pay and working conditions, more than 1,800 miners struck on June 27. Calling the striking workers anarchists and communists, on July 17, the town sheriff, vigilantes, and mostly white miners still loyal to the company struck back, kidnapping over 1,200 men, mostly nonwhite and foreign-born, and marching them to Warren Ballpark under armed guard. Workers who did not quit the strike were then forced into train cars, deported, and abandoned in New Mexico, told never to return .
fe3e917ffa20a28a6e03298bc558b9e61ac97be2.translatedText: 不幸的是，該體育場也是美國勞工​​運動歷史上最殘酷的行為之一的發生地。菲爾普斯道奇公司有反工會的歷史，但到 1917 年，世界國際工人組織已經站穩了腳跟。 6 月 27 日，超過 1,800 名礦工呼籲結束對外籍勞工和少數族裔的歧視，並改善工資和工作條件。 7 月 17 日，鎮警長、義務警員和仍然忠於公司的大多數白人礦工稱罷工工人為無政府主義者和共產主義者，進行了反擊，綁架了 1,200 多名男子，其中大多數是非白人和外國出生的，並在武裝警衛的帶領下將他們押往沃倫棒球場。沒有退出罷工的工人隨後被強迫進入火車車廂，被驅逐出境，並被遺棄在新墨西哥州，並被告知永遠不要回來。

ff172f5784108796e6cb16781705b05c70052d7e.sourceText: More than 300 people, including dozens of Phelps Dodge executives, were charged with a crime, but none were convicted. The injustice led to a rise in labor unrest across the country for years to come, but too late for Bisbee, where the labor movement was crushed forever.
ff172f5784108796e6cb16781705b05c70052d7e.translatedText: 包括數十名菲爾普斯道奇高管在內的 300 多人被指控犯罪，但無人被定罪。這種不公義導致未來幾年全國勞工騷亂加劇，但對比斯比來說為時已晚，那裡的勞工運動被永遠鎮壓。

95f85d1caec7c2966e6edfd7a5d1d424c341a790.sourceText: Across the late 19th and early 20th centuries, a great many towns were established throughout the American West. The draw was mining, and, of course, the riches to be won as a result of successful operations. Plenty of Arizona towns that are today well-populated—from Bisbee to Globe to Wickenburg—started out as risky ventures predicated on the optimism of prospectors. Many other towns, however, proved economically inviable and were summarily abandoned, leaving a peppering of “ghost towns'' across the vast, dry desert—ghost towns like Swansea, Arizona.
95f85d1caec7c2966e6edfd7a5d1d424c341a790.translatedText: 十九世紀末二十世紀初，美國西部各地建立了許多城鎮。吸引力在於採礦，當然還有成功營運所帶來的財富。從比斯比到格洛布再到威肯堡，亞利桑那州的許多城鎮如今人口稠密，最初都是基於探礦者的樂觀態度而進行的冒險活動。然而，事實證明，許多其他城鎮在經濟上已經無法生存，並被立即廢棄，在廣闊、乾燥的沙漠中留下了一些「鬼城」——像亞利桑那州斯旺西這樣的鬼城。

392e70b07215e4da22fe942547a66e0ab0d7957c.sourceText: This once-bustling mining town is today both entirely dilapidated and—being under the care of the Bureau of Land Management (BLM)—entirely visitable. With an interpretive trail and posted signage throughout the abandoned town, those looking to get a glimpse of old Swansea can do so by driving 25-miles through the Eastern Sonoran plains. There are dozens of adobe structures that once served as housing for hard-working miners, an old railroad depot, two cemeteries, and several mine shafts. Its location (far enough away to prevent vandalism, close enough to be visited) and dedicated preservation under BLM makes it one of the best preserved ghost towns in the state.
392e70b07215e4da22fe942547a66e0ab0d7957c.translatedText: 這個曾經繁華的採礦小鎮如今完全破敗不堪，而且在土地管理局 (BLM) 的管理下，完全可以參觀。廢棄小鎮各處都有解說小徑和張貼的標牌，想要參觀的人可以前往這裡。開車穿過東索諾蘭平原 25 英里即可一睹老斯旺西的風采。這裡有數十座土坯建築，曾經是辛勤工作的礦工的住所、一個舊火車站、兩個墓地和幾個礦井。它的位置（足夠遠以防止破壞，又足夠近以便參觀）和 BLM 的專門保護使其成為該州保存最完好的鬼城之一。

610184e5c272ce1834c0cf278e11cc45d7b329bb.sourceText: Prospectors first saw promise here in the 1860s, yet mining facilities didn’t make their way west until the turn of the century. And while the town itself wasn’t formally established until 1909, it allegedly already boasted an electric light company, two cemeteries, a saloon, theater, restaurant, barber shop, and a population of about 500 . A 350-ton furnace, a half-mile water pipeline from the Bill Williams River, and five operating mine shafts kept the resources flowing and the town afloat.
610184e5c272ce1834c0cf278e11cc45d7b329bb.translatedText: 探礦者在 1860 年代首次看到這裡的前景，但採礦設施直到世紀之交才向西發展。雖然該鎮本身直到 1909 年才正式建立，但據稱它已經擁有一家電燈公司、兩座墓地、一家酒吧、劇院、餐廳、理髮店，人口約 500 人。一座重達 350 噸的熔爐、一條來自比爾威廉斯河的半英里輸水管道，以及五個正在運作的礦井，保證了資源的流動和城鎮的運作。

9a21228d0fc84aa2fefec16c6554670454a4e22c.sourceText: For unclear reasons (one source attributes over-promotion by a founding townsman of Welsh origin, who also supposedly named Swansea after his hometown ), financial problems arose in 1911, such that the mines shuttered and many townsfolk left. While the American Smelting and Refining Company bought the mines in 1914 and kept the town on life support, the subsequent Great Depression was the nail in the coffin. Despite a complete absence of economic opportunity, residents lingered here until 1943.
9a21228d0fc84aa2fefec16c6554670454a4e22c.translatedText: 由於不明原因（有消息稱，一位威爾士裔創始城鎮居民的過度促銷，據說他也以家鄉的名字命名為斯旺西），1911 年出現了財務問題，導致礦井關閉，許多城鎮居民離開。雖然美國冶煉和精煉公司在 1914 年購買了這些礦場並維持了該鎮的生命維持，但隨後的大蕭條卻是壓垮這座小鎮的最後一根稻草。儘管完全沒有經濟機會，居民們還是在這裡待了 1943 年。

921d28931705e51d94155d72dec96fcd32a5a867.sourceText: Though the town is a husk of its former self, there’s nothing stopping you from being a Swansea resident for a night: With five designated camping sites maintained by BLM throughout town, anyone able to make the drive is free to camp. Keep in mind that the road is unpaved and in many places uneven—an off-road capable vehicle with high clearance is recommended. Bring ample water and keep an eye out for rusty nails.
921d28931705e51d94155d72dec96fcd32a5a867.translatedText: 雖然這座小鎮已是昔日的廢墟，但沒有什麼能阻止您成為斯旺西居民過夜：BLM 在整個小鎮維護著五個指定露營地，任何能夠開車前往的人都可以免費露營。請記住，道路未鋪砌，並且許多地方不平坦 - 建議使用具有高間隙的越野車輛。帶上充足的水並留意生鏽的釘子。

79c39097d7d6dacb66033a164ed52ab5d3bde1ab.sourceText: Agua Caliente park brings visitors a unique combination of history, wildlife, and geology. Sitting on the site of what was at different times a Native American village, cattle ranch, orchard, and health spa, this quiet park transports visitors into an oasis featuring three restored historic buildings, ample birding opportunities, and an abundance of wildlife.
79c39097d7d6dacb66033a164ed52ab5d3bde1ab.translatedText: 阿瓜卡連特公園為遊客帶來歷史、野生動物和地質的獨特結合。這個安靜的公園坐落在不同時期的美洲原住民村莊、牧場、果園和健康水療中心的遺址上，將遊客帶入一片綠洲，這裡有三座經過修復的歷史建築、充足的觀鳥機會和豐富的野生動物。

7bb30aeac3a86e6e9f44138125b7f40a7bf8c8d4.sourceText: “Agua Caliente” literally means “hot water,” referring to the hot spring that once existed here. However, you won’t find any “Agua Caliente” here anymore. In the 1930s, the spring was blasted in a failed attempt to increase the water flow. Rather than increase the flow, the hot spring merged with a nearby cold spring, collapsing the two into one spring with a year-round temperature of 72 degrees.
7bb30aeac3a86e6e9f44138125b7f40a7bf8c8d4.translatedText: “Agua Caliente”的字面意思是“熱水”，指的是這裡曾經存在的溫泉。然而，你在這裡再也找不到「Agua Caliente」了。 1930年代，由於試圖增加水流量，泉水被爆破。溫泉並沒有增加流量，而是與附近的冷泉合併，將兩者合而為一，全年溫度高達 72 度。

d39d0722cbf8c4fc053e2b97f2170e7f7e540831.sourceText: Evidence exists for the area in the park being inhabited by humans more than 5,000 years ago, with archaeological evidence showing that the site was likely used by hunter-gatherers, and then was the site of a Hohokam village. In the late 1800s, a ranch and orchard were established in the area, selling agricultural products in Tucson and operating as a resort, advertising the “health benefits” of the hot springs, fresh fruit, and recreational and spa activities.
d39d0722cbf8c4fc053e2b97f2170e7f7e540831.translatedText: 有證據表明，公園內的該地區在 5000 多年前就有人類居住，考古證據表明該地點可能是狩獵採集者使用的地方，當時是霍霍卡姆村莊的所在地。 1800年代末，該地區建立了牧場和果園，在圖森出售農產品並作為度假村經營，宣傳溫泉、新鮮水果以及休閒和水療活動的「健康益處」。

d74d4a9f2fb69eaad50dbaa2c454ef96ae6be7ae.sourceText: Today, you might spot a coyote or javelina coming for a quick drink, hear the “chi-ca-go” of quail from the canopies of mesquite trees, or watch a brilliantly white heron hunting for his next meal. Some nights you may be able to look through a telescope (friends of Agua Caliente volunteers run occasional astronomy nights, along with bird and wildlife walks, which you can find the dates for on their website), or you might learn about the history of the ranch and resort from volunteers in the restored 1930s ranch house. Make sure to stop by the “great mesquite” on your stroll through the park—the impressive tree is 200 years old!
d74d4a9f2fb69eaad50dbaa2c454ef96ae6be7ae.translatedText: 今天，您可能會看到土狼或標槍過來喝一杯，聽到鵪鶉在豆科灌木樹冠上發出“chi-ca-go”的聲音，或者看到一隻亮白色的蒼鷺正在尋找下一頓美餐。有些晚上，您可能可以透過望遠鏡觀察（阿瓜卡連特志工的朋友偶爾會舉辦天文之夜，以及鳥類和野生動物散步，您可以在他們的網站上找到日期），或者您可以在修復後的 1930 年代牧場房屋中向志工了解牧場和度假村的歷史。在公園裡漫步時，一定要在“偉大的豆科灌木”前停下來——這棵令人印象深刻的樹已有 200 年的歷史了！

4e94b564bf34aad7dd8c456064eccc617129e94f.sourceText: As you stroll past the spring, it’s not hard to imagine what drew vacationers to this spot. Tall palm trees, the singing of birds, and beautifully restored buildings really do create the feel of an “oasis in the desert.”
4e94b564bf34aad7dd8c456064eccc617129e94f.translatedText: 當您漫步經過春天時，不難想像是什麼吸引了度假者來到這個地方。高大的棕櫚樹、鳥兒的歌聲和修復精美的建築確實營造出「沙漠中的綠洲」的感覺。

faea24b2c07910a82cbff8cc37c869d0d33ea363.sourceText: If the fiberglass rendition of Louie the Lumberjack outside the Walkup Skydome looks familiar, that's because it is actually one of around two hundred Muffler Men found across the United States. International Fiberglass constructed the Muffler Men in the 1960s and 1970s for various roadside businesses across the country. Most have identical faces with or without a beard, and typically hold some object in their hands. Although many of the businesses that originally commissioned them have closed down, they often remain as tourist attractions and symbols of their local communities.
faea24b2c07910a82cbff8cc37c869d0d33ea363.translatedText: 如果 Walkup Skydome 外的伐木工人路易的玻璃纖維表演看起來很熟悉，那是因為它實際上是在美國各地發現的大約 200 個消音器人之一。國際玻璃纖維公司在 1960 年代和 1970 年代為全國各地的各種路邊企業製造了 Muffler Men。大多數人都有相同的臉孔，有或沒有鬍鬚，通常手裡拿著一些物體。儘管許多最初委託建造它們的企業已經倒閉，但它們往往仍然是旅遊景點和當地社區的象徵。

e0308fbc31716232f22ab29cc02e7a41ad1de403.sourceText: In 1962, the very first Muffler Man was constructed by International Fiberglass's predecessor, Prewitt Fiberglass Animals. It was meant to be a statue of legendary giant Paul Bunyan for a customer in Sacramento. When the statue went unpaid for, however, it was sold instead to the Lumberjack Cafe in Flagstaff. International Fiberglass would go on to use Paul Bunyan's mold for all the other Muffler Men.
e0308fbc31716232f22ab29cc02e7a41ad1de403.translatedText: 1962 年，第一台消音器人由國際玻璃纖維公司的前身 Prewitt 玻璃纖維動物公司建造。它本來是為薩克拉門託的一位顧客建造的傳奇巨人保羅·班揚的雕像。然而，當這座雕像沒有得到付款時，它被賣給了弗拉格斯塔夫的伐木工咖啡館。國際玻璃纖維公司繼續將保羅·班揚的模具用於所有其他消音器人。

836304901d23316a7120a53ba881081c7a118b6f.sourceText: After the Lumberjack Cafe rebranded in the late 1970s, it was donated to Northern Arizona University, who repainted it in their own livery. Eventually, the statue and the university's mascot acquired the name Louie from the 1963 song “Louie, Louie.” NAU also acquired a second lumberjack Muffler Man from the Lumberjack Cafe, built several years later. It now lies on the south side the Walkup Skydome, further away from the main entrance and box office. A third smaller wooden lumberjack statue from the cafe also stands at 218 S Milton Road.
836304901d23316a7120a53ba881081c7a118b6f.translatedText: 伐木工人咖啡館在 20 世紀 70 年代末重新命名後，它被捐贈給北亞利桑那大學，後者用自己的製服重新粉刷了它。最終，這座雕像和大學的吉祥物從 1963 年的歌曲“Louie，Louie”中獲得了“Louie”這個名字。 NAU 也從幾年後建成的伐木工咖啡館購買了第二台伐木工消音器人。現在它位於 Walkup Skydome 的南側，距離主入口和售票處更遠。咖啡館裡的第三座較小的木製伐木工人雕像也矗立在南米爾頓路 218 號。

f329f72a649887f5a9b33488aee500d150b4f59e.sourceText: Today all across Holbrook one can find giant statues of dinosaurs in front of stores. They near Petrified Forest National Park, where dinosaur remains have also been found. (Such real dinosaurs are exhibited at the Rainbow Forest Museum inside the park.) Furthermore, the city's location on Route 66 naturally draws tourists eager to snap photos of roadside attractions.
f329f72a649887f5a9b33488aee500d150b4f59e.translatedText: 如今，在整個霍爾布魯克，人們都可以在商店前找到巨大的恐龍雕像。他們靠近石化森林國家公園，在那裡還發現了恐龍遺骸。 （園區內的彩虹森林博物館展出了這樣的真實恐龍。）此外，這座城市位於 66 號公路上，自然吸引了渴望拍攝路邊景點照片的遊客。

5b6fb6b2e31347167c640788bd5ce53c830ba995.sourceText: The first and largest group of mock dinosaurs is at a rockhounding shop south edge of town, surrounded outdoors by an unbelievably large array of petrified wood. They are the work of owner Adam Luna, a welder and amateur "jack-of-all-trades" who first constructed a brontosaurus in 1986. His process involved first building a steel skeleton which be surrounded by rebar netting and a painted concrete outer shell. Positively received by tourists, Luna went on to build more than 11 dinosaurs that now stand outside his store by 2000. The tallest is a larger brontosaurus standing at 25 feet, still a fraction of the real animal's size. He intentionally painted the dinosaurs cartoonishly and smoothly in order to avoid frightening children.
5b6fb6b2e31347167c640788bd5ce53c830ba995.translatedText: 第一批也是最大的一組模擬恐龍位於城鎮南緣的一家獵岩店，室外周圍環繞著令人難以置信的大片矽化木。它們的主人 Adam Luna 是一名焊工和業餘“多才多藝”，他於 1986 年首次建造了雷龍。他的過程首先是建造一個鋼骨架，骨架周圍是鋼筋網和塗漆的混凝土外殼。到 2000 年，Luna 受到了遊客的積極歡迎，隨後又製作了超過 11 隻恐龍，現在這些恐龍就矗立在他的店外。其中最高的是一頭體形較大的雷龍，高 25 英尺，但仍是真實動物大小的一小部分。為了避免嚇到孩子，他刻意把恐龍畫得卡通、流暢。

909c0d2c02de86aa5ad5fc7b3443ece16837747b.sourceText: Luna's statues were successful enough to inspire numerous copycats around town, especially at other petrified wood shops. Some were even made by his own assistants, earning his ire. There was even an International Dinosaur Park where one could drive by various dinosaur models; although it has since closed its statues have moved elsewhere. However, few of these other dinosaurs manage to recreate the unusually smooth concrete skin of the original ones. Luna also made another dinosaur for the Moon Lite Barbershop, run by his son Daniel.
909c0d2c02de86aa5ad5fc7b3443ece16837747b.translatedText: 露娜的雕像非常成功，激發了鎮上無數的模仿者，特別是在其他矽化木商店。有些甚至是他自己的助手製作的，這引起了他的憤怒。甚至還有一個國際恐龍公園，可以駕駛各種恐龍模型；儘管它已經關閉，但其雕像已移至其他地方。然而，很少有其他恐龍能夠重現原始恐龍異常光滑的混凝土皮膚。 Luna 也為他兒子 Daniel 經營的 Moon Lite 理髮店製作了另一隻恐龍。

3b52a97a9fe0c48480847fbc9781853cbd24ad7d.sourceText: The store charges a small fee to take photos with the statues. Its hours are unpredictable and do not necessarily match those on Google Maps, however the dinosaurs are viewable from the street regardless.
3b52a97a9fe0c48480847fbc9781853cbd24ad7d.translatedText: 店裡收取少量與雕像合影的費用。它的營業時間是不可預測的，也不一定與Google地圖上的時間相符，但無論如何，從街上都可以看到恐龍。

92202552ea05dcbc253106560d670284bf9cb6af.sourceText: Considered the last of the great singing cowboys, Rex Allen was born on a ranch forty miles outside Willcox, Arizona, in 1920.
92202552ea05dcbc253106560d670284bf9cb6af.translatedText: 雷克斯艾倫 (Rex Allen) 被認為是最後一位偉大的歌唱牛仔，他於 1920 年出生在亞利桑那州威爾科克斯 (Willcox) 郊外 40 英里的一個牧場上。

456742c9f3ee079f5ecc242e2a2cf382d3d8257c.sourceText: He started off as a vaudeville singer before joining a traveling rodeo, where he honed his skills as a singing cowboy and went on to record a number of successful country music albums. In 1949, he signed with Republic Pictures, launching a film career that included 19 Westerns. Always seen with his loyal horse, Koko, and often accompanied by sidekicks such as Buddy Ebsen and Slim Pickens, he quickly gained the nickname "Arizona Cowboy."
456742c9f3ee079f5ecc242e2a2cf382d3d8257c.translatedText: 他最初是一名歌舞雜耍歌手，後來加入巡迴牛仔競技表演，在那裡磨練了自己作為牛仔歌唱的技巧，並錄製了許多成功的鄉村音樂專輯。 1949 年，他與共和影業簽約，開啟了電影生涯，拍攝了 19 部西部片。人們總是和他忠誠的馬科科一起出現，並且經常有巴迪·埃布森和斯利姆·皮肯斯等夥伴陪伴，他很快就獲得了“亞利桑那牛仔”的綽號。

5cdc15cadc7a929fc28af6d1ccc4db89fc010a90.sourceText: Later, Allen became one of Disney’s most recognizable narrators, known as "the voice of the West," lending his voice to a string of nature films, including Cow Dog , which was nominated for an Academy Award, and The Incredible Journey .
5cdc15cadc7a929fc28af6d1ccc4db89fc010a90.translatedText: 後來，艾倫成為迪士尼最知名的旁白之一，被稱為“西方之聲”，為一系列自然電影配音，包括獲得奧斯卡金像獎提名的《牛犬》和《超人特攻隊》。旅程 .

c1cdc77f136c1be8121ac5e1fc836d8a694ca06a.sourceText: Allen died at the age of 78 in Tucson when, after collapsing from a heart attack, he was accidentally backed over by his caretaker driving Allen's Cadillac. His ashes were scattered around his statue in Railroad Park, and his horse, Koko, was buried at its foot.
c1cdc77f136c1be8121ac5e1fc836d8a694ca06a.translatedText: 艾倫在圖森去世，享年 78 歲，當時他因心臟病發作而昏倒，駕駛艾倫的凱迪拉克時，他的看護人意外地將他倒車。他的骨灰撒在鐵路公園的雕像周圍，他的馬 Koko 也埋在雕像腳下。

e351e804d726d0234d53c4948bab03f01be0b453.sourceText: This bronze statue, created by artist Buck McCain, stands just across from the Rex Allen Museum and Cowboy Hall of Fame.
e351e804d726d0234d53c4948bab03f01be0b453.translatedText: 這座青銅雕像由藝術家巴克·麥凱恩 (Buck McCain) 創作，位於雷克斯·艾倫博物館和牛仔名人堂對面。

3a4490072729a56d9d3f28d995fadfcab7d83f3d.sourceText: Composers and orchestras like to use their lowest instruments sparingly, for maximum impact. Few instruments go lower and are used more sparingly than the huge and strange octobass, one of the rarest classic instruments in existence.
3a4490072729a56d9d3f28d995fadfcab7d83f3d.translatedText: 作曲家和管弦樂團喜歡謹慎使用最低級的樂器，以獲得最大的影響力。很少有樂器比巨大而奇怪的八重低音低音琴更低，而且使用也更加謹慎，它是現存最稀有的經典樂器之一。

c69958c84b7e08ca3e9eb0bfd3c953986014a2c4.sourceText: Invented in 1850 by Jean-Baptiste Vuillaume, the octobass was intended to bring an extremely deep rumble to the orchestra sound. The three-stringed instrument stands between 11 and 12 feet tall, about twice the height of a double bass. This giant bass produces sound so low, some of the notes fall outside the range of human hearing—these vibrations can only be felt.
c69958c84b7e08ca3e9eb0bfd3c953986014a2c4.translatedText: 八重低音低音琴由 Jean-Baptiste Vuillaume 於 1850 年發明，旨在為管弦樂團的聲音帶來極其深沉的隆隆聲。這種三弦樂器高 11 至 12 英尺，大約是低音提琴高度的兩倍。這種巨大的貝斯發出的聲音非常低，有些音符超出了人類的聽覺範圍——這些振動只能被感覺到。

61f29776dda0083c1fe8164a3bc08b41b74984a0.sourceText: The rare instrument is almost too large to play. The strings are too big to press with your fingers, so fretting them requires operating pedals and levers that control capo-like mechanisms to press down the strings. In fact, the octobass originally required two people to play: one on the bow (which, though shorter that the bow of a double bass, is extra heavy) and one working the lever system.
61f29776dda0083c1fe8164a3bc08b41b74984a0.translatedText: 這種罕見的樂器幾乎太大而無法演奏。琴弦太大，無法用手指按下，因此按動它們需要操作踏板和控制桿，這些踏板和槓桿控制變調夾類似的機構來壓下琴弦。事實上，八頭貝斯最初需要兩個人來演奏：一個人負責拉弓（雖然比低音提琴的弓短，但特別重），另一個人負責操縱槓桿系統。

a7841e3d410685a8e2094e54258ae3f2fd797a00.sourceText: Vuillaume originally built three octobasses, two of which are still around. Including contemporary, playable replicas, there are only seven known examples of the instrument in the world, mostly kept in museums, including one at the Musical Instrument Museum in Phoenix , Arizona . The octobass in Phoenix is tuned C0, G0, D1, a range that's two octaves below the cello and one octave below the modern double bass. Its low C note is lower than the lowest note on an 88-key piano, and beyond what most people can hear ( you can give it a listen here ).
a7841e3d410685a8e2094e54258ae3f2fd797a00.translatedText: 維約姆最初製造了三把八低音提琴，其中兩把至今仍在使用。包括當代的、可演奏的複製品在內，世界上已知的該樂器僅有七件，大部分保存在博物館中，其中一件存放在亞利桑那州鳳凰城的樂器博物館。 Phoenix 中的八度低音調音為 C0、G0、D1，音域比大提琴低兩個八度，比現代低音提琴低一個八度。它的低音 C 音低於 88 鍵鋼琴上的最低音，超出了大多數人能聽到的範圍（您可以在此處試聽）。

1a926b5553907120058e12a1d8f366d41b06acbc.sourceText: The Montreal Symphony Orchestra is the only orchestra that owns one of these unusual instruments, and composers still write music for it on occasion. When played today, it is usually by a single person.
1a926b5553907120058e12a1d8f366d41b06acbc.translatedText: 蒙特婁交響樂團是唯一擁有這種不尋常樂器之一的樂團，作曲家有時仍會為其創作音樂。今天玩的時候，通常是一個人玩。

28076f9d4c340f4b5d96d02ce7fe049cbe2ddd28.sourceText: Perched atop an angular modern pillar at the edge of an Arizona parking (by the bus stops) lot is an impressionist piece of prairie trash that cost the local taxpayers tens of thousands of dollars. This pricey piece of modern art created by Joan Waters is officially titled Movimiento del Viento. However, it is known simply as Momentum (at least when it isn't being called mean nick-names by spurned locals).
28076f9d4c340f4b5d96d02ce7fe049cbe2ddd28.translatedText: 在亞利桑那州停車場（公車站旁）邊緣的一根棱角分明的現代柱子上，矗立著一塊印象派的草原垃圾，當地納稅人為此付出了數萬美元的代價。這件由瓊·沃特斯 (Joan Waters) 創作的昂貴現代藝術作品的正式名稱為 Movimiento del Viento。然而，它被簡單地稱為 Momentum（至少當它沒有被當地人唾棄的時候）。

7e724618e55d8e896c38a097fccef138b3d5a1bc.sourceText: Unveiled in 2008, the metal sculpture was intended to reference nearby Tumbleweed Park with its artistically-styled tumbleweed placed 10 feet off the ground on a futuristic pedestal. The pedestal itself stands atop a squat block of carved concrete completing the entire piece. The work was commissioned from a Denver artist; the work cost the city $100,000 in tax dollars. After seeing the rather short result of the city council's choice, the public was less than impressed.
7e724618e55d8e896c38a097fccef138b3d5a1bc.translatedText: 這座金屬雕塑於 2008 年揭幕，旨在參考附近的風滾草公園，其藝術風格的風滾草放置在距離地面 10 英尺的未來主義基座上。基座本身矗立在一塊矮矮的雕刻混凝土塊上，構成了整個作品。該作品是受丹佛一位藝術家委託創作的。這項工作花費了該市 10 萬美元的稅金。在看到市議會的選擇結果相當短暫後，公眾並沒有留下深刻的印象。

0b6ac3189b2f841f5128913428946acc72f5ce0c.sourceText: The piece was given silly nick-names such as "rat's nest" and "hairball" and general displeasure ensued. Even some city council members spoke out, remarking democratically that the artwork was not quite what they were expecting from their grant.
0b6ac3189b2f841f5128913428946acc72f5ce0c.translatedText: 作品被賦予了「老鼠窩」和「毛球」等愚蠢的綽號，隨之而來的是普遍的不滿。甚至一些市議員也發聲，民主地評論說，這件藝術品並不完全符合他們對資助的期望。

64bba65ba55111e3dc7dd21ecd986edb45226355.sourceText: Regardless of the feelings behind the $100,000 tumbleweed, it remains to this day, reminding commuters arriving at the park and ride just how many of their tax dollars blow away in the wind.
64bba65ba55111e3dc7dd21ecd986edb45226355.translatedText: 無論這幅價值 10 萬美元的風滾草背後的感受如何，它至今仍然存在，提醒著到達公園和騎行的通勤者，他們的稅款有多少被風吹走了。

f3f0750cd925b1ea6aa3167346cc1c89b43cdb3c.sourceText: Italian Paolo Soleri came to America to study under renowned architect Frank Lloyd Wright in 1947. From him, Soleri learned a lot regarding the integration of architecture into the landscape, but disagreed immensely with his vision of a spread out, proto-suburban " Broadacre City ." After their relationship fell apart and they parted ways, Soleri decided to build his own studio just 10 miles away from Wright's Taliesin West, where he could advance his own architectural and urban planning vision. Its name, Cosanti, is a portmanteau of the Italian words " cosa " (thing) and " anti " (against), highlighting his opposition to materialism.
f3f0750cd925b1ea6aa3167346cc1c89b43cdb3c.translatedText: 義大利人保羅·索萊裡 (Paolo Soleri) 於 1947 年來到美國，師從著名建築師弗蘭克·勞埃德·賴特 (Frank Lloyd Wright)。從他那裡，索萊裡學到了很多關於建築與景觀融合的知識，但他對他關於建立一個分散的、原始郊區的「Broadacre City」的願景非常不同意。在他們的關係破裂並分道揚鑣後，索萊裡決定在距賴特的塔里埃森西僅 10 英里的地方建立自己的工作室，在那裡他可以推進自己的建築和城市規劃願景。它的名字Cosanti是義大利語「cosa」（事物）和「anti」（反對）的合成詞，凸顯了他對唯物主義的反對。

478d05a1ec6d4d029e1e12c2ce85ab321b435b7c.sourceText: When Soleri founded Cosanti in 1955, this now wealthy suburban area was a rural hinterland of Phoenix . He constructed much of the home using the unique earth-casting technique, in which a concrete shell was built over a dirt mound that was later removed. In an area where air conditioning is considered mandatory for the summer, he experimented with more natural ways to cool his house. One of his favorite methods was building a partially underground and apses (quarter-spheres) that manipulate the angle of the sun. Unlike Wright, Soleri saw his vision of energy-efficient living that minimized its environmental impact as compatible with urban compactness. As such, he devised "arcology" as a way to reconcile these principles and make way for future population growth. This new field was further developed at Arcosanti, his "urban laboratory" built 50 miles to the north.
478d05a1ec6d4d029e1e12c2ce85ab321b435b7c.translatedText: 1955年索萊裡創立Cosanti時，這片如今富裕的郊區是鳳凰城的鄉村腹地。他使用獨特的土澆注技術建造了大部分房屋，在土堆上建造了混凝土外殼，後來將其拆除。在一個夏季必須使用空調的地區，他嘗試了更自然的方法來降溫房子。他最喜歡的方法之一是建造一個部分地下和後殿（四分之一球體）來操縱太陽的角度。與賴特不同的是，索萊裡認為他的節能生活願景是最大限度地減少對環境的影響，並與城市的緊湊性相容。因此，他設計了「生態學」作為協調這些原則並為未來人口成長讓路的一種方式。這一新領域在阿科桑蒂 (Arcosanti) 得到了進一步開發，他的「城市實驗室」建在北邊 50 英里處。

8b2f67f7cd42fe002b9d5e8031c0b5cc7434b2ca.sourceText: Today, a group of artisans still work at Cosanti where they make metal bells, ceramics, and jewelry in Soleri's style. Much of the workshop's unique and surreal architecture is open for regular visits and tours. In its gallery, one can view and buy some of the work made on site and at Arcosanti.
8b2f67f7cd42fe002b9d5e8031c0b5cc7434b2ca.translatedText: 如今，一群工匠仍在 Cosanti 工作，他們按照 Soleri 的風格製作金屬鐘、陶瓷和珠寶。工作室的許多獨特和超現實的建築都開放供定期參觀和遊覽。在其畫廊中，您可以觀看和購買現場和 Arcosanti 製作的一些作品。

899c43d43ee07fc370bb2fb0f52422a0ef8937f2.sourceText: You might be surprised to find a seafaring ship in landlocked Arizona . There indeed is not but this building could easily be mistaken for one, complete with its name, portholes, and an anchor on the hull. Former Casa Grande city councilman C.J. "Blinky" Wilson built this ironically shaped Moderne-style store in honor of his son, who served in the U.S. Navy. Even more peculiarly, it was reportedly designed by a prison inmate at the Arizona State Prison in nearby Florence. This arrangement was made by prison warden and local business owner Art Brooks.
899c43d43ee07fc370bb2fb0f52422a0ef8937f2.translatedText: 您可能會驚訝地發現內陸亞利桑那州有一艘航海船。確實沒有，但這座建築很容易被誤認為是一座建築，包括它的名字、舷窗和船體上的錨。前卡薩格蘭德市議員 C.J.“Blinky”Wilson 為紀念他在美國海軍服役的兒子而建造了這座具有諷刺意味的現代風格商店。更奇特的是，據報道，它是由佛羅倫薩附近亞利桑那州立監獄的一名囚犯設計的。這項安排是由監獄長和當地企業主 Art Brooks 做出的。

d2c7b7ee8b87b49c21ff32491f74060a1f409423.sourceText: From its construction in 1946 until 1981, the building housed Blinky's auto business, Wilson Motors. This is still evident in the auto bays located at the stern of the ship. Since then, it has been home to various other enterprises.
d2c7b7ee8b87b49c21ff32491f74060a1f409423.translatedText: 從 1946 年建造到 1981 年，這棟建築一直是 Blinky 的汽車公司 Wilson Motors 的所在地。這在位於船尾的汽車車庫中仍然很明顯。從那時起，它就成為了其他各種企業的所在地。

7940f566c68b58700a89b33f5e414c3995eca393.sourceText: Although the building was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 2002, it has unfortunately lost many of its original details. There was once a mock smokestack and exterior staircase on top, as well as tires painted like life preservers on the railing. It has also been repainted from blue and white to a much less nautical beige.
7940f566c68b58700a89b33f5e414c3995eca393.translatedText: 儘管該建築於 2002 年被列入國家歷史古蹟名錄，但不幸的是它丟失了許多原始細節。頂部曾經有一個模擬煙囪和外部樓梯，欄桿上還塗上救生圈一樣的輪胎。它也從藍色和白色重新漆成不太航海的米色。

6136ffee4d15e3fe044d8d40f32934ae335abd1e.sourceText: The city of Casa Grande , named after the Hohokam ruins nearby, has a long and colorful history. Founded in 1879 during Arizona ’s mining boom, the town transitioned to an agricultural community in the 1890s when the mining boom slowed. The change helped Casa Grande avoid the dismal fate of many other boom towns in the western U.S.
6136ffee4d15e3fe044d8d40f32934ae335abd1e.translatedText: 卡薩格蘭德市因附近的霍霍卡姆遺址而得名，有著悠久而多彩的歷史。該鎮成立於 1879 年亞利桑那州礦業繁榮時期，在 1890 年代礦業繁榮放緩時轉變為農業社區。這項變革幫助卡薩格蘭德避免了美國西部許多其他新興城鎮的悲慘命運。

75b01ec839d7ee45aabf286df21390e31e8a23b0.sourceText: The Casa Grande Neon Sign Park consists of vintage signs saved and collected from the surrounding area over the years, resulting in a collection that reflects local history. The exception is the Dairy Queen “lips” sign, which was relocated from its home on Route 66 in Holbrook , but is the same style as local DQ signage of the period.
75b01ec839d7ee45aabf286df21390e31e8a23b0.translatedText: 卡薩格蘭德霓虹燈公園由多年來從週邊地區保存和收集的老式標誌組成，形成了反映當地歷史的收藏品。冰雪皇后「嘴唇」標誌是個例外，它是從霍爾布魯克 66 號公路上的老家搬遷過來的，但與當時當地 DQ 標誌的風格相同。

162e98df0f041e14f8c0f686a771ca330acde1c2.sourceText: Several of the signs required extensive restoration, including the Arizona Edison sign, which was missing the neon, and the Goddard Shoe Store sign, whose goose was missing its head. Paul the Waver, standing by the sign for the Horse Shoe Motel, is a reproduction based on a mid-century photograph. The light behind his waving arm indicated when the motel had vacancies.
162e98df0f041e14f8c0f686a771ca330acde1c2.translatedText: 幾個標誌需要大規模修復，包括亞利桑那愛迪生標誌（缺少霓虹燈）和戈達德鞋店標誌（缺少鵝頭）。站在馬蹄汽車旅館標誌旁的猶豫不決的保羅是根據一張中世紀照片複製的。他揮舞的手臂後面的燈光顯示汽車旅館何時有空房。

521a755cfb9937728f0410fc285a1c12530a2e1b.sourceText: Accompanying the signs are bronze story plaques in the shape of the State of Arizona with a green patina background representing the city’s copper mining heritage. There are also custom pedestals incorporating “Pueblo Deco” symbols, a hybrid architectural style popular in the Southwest. The park is accented with vintage license plates and benches made out of tailgates.
521a755cfb9937728f0410fc285a1c12530a2e1b.translatedText: 標誌旁是亞利桑那州形狀的青銅故事牌，綠色銅綠背景代表該市的銅礦開採遺產。還有融入「Pueblo Deco」符號的客製化基座，這是一種在西南部流行的混合建築風格。公園裡裝飾著老式車牌和由後擋板製成的長凳。

b1263ad50be4d7dc1a936bd7979adb006a938421.sourceText: Casa Grande came in second place in an American Express Partners in Preservation program competition and received $144,000 toward the project. It is located in Historic Downtown Casa Grande at the site of Casa Grande’s first school, Central School, which was built in 1917 and torn down in 1974.
b1263ad50be4d7dc1a936bd7979adb006a938421.translatedText: Casa Grande 在美國運通合作夥伴保護計畫競賽中獲得第二名，並獲得了 144,000 美元的專案資金。它位於卡薩格蘭德歷史悠久的市中心，卡薩格蘭德第一所學校中央學校的舊址，該學校建於 1917 年，於 1974 年被拆除。

62c45b2a30781a870db3df85cf588e727a10e1f4.sourceText: Once more on the first Saturday of March, 2018, the Yees in the Phoenix area gathered to celebrate the advent of another Lunisolar Year. The cycle of 12 Living/Life Resemblances entered into the Year of the Dog on February 16th in this case, and the banquet at the Great Wall Hong Kong Cuisine site with another full-house crowd of 40 tables, certainly illustrated the theme of sincere friendship.
62c45b2a30781a870db3df85cf588e727a10e1f4.translatedText: 2018 年 3 月的第一個星期六，鳳凰城地區的 Yees 人再次聚集在一起慶祝另一個陰陽年的到來。十二生肖輪迴在2月16日進入狗年，長城港菜現場又座無虛席，共40桌的宴會，無疑詮釋了真摯友誼的主題。

b9e76f77e2cb5debc05f63d1d6a1d854d741cff1.sourceText: The Yee Surname World President, Mr. Eddie Yee and his wife, from San Francisco was, an especial guest, and he himself expressed the delight to make an address, after decades of living in America, using the rural Four Counties (Szeyup or Siyi) patois, Taishan Cantonese. Our longtime regional friend, Mr. Alan Yee and his wife, once more made the trip from their Los Angeles area to highlight a special relationship indeed. Truly spoken was the Sage, the Master Kong, when he remarked as recorded in the Analects: ”When friends come from afar, is it not pleasant?”
b9e76f77e2cb5debc05f63d1d6a1d854d741cff1.translatedText: 來自舊金山的易姓世界總裁艾迪·易先生和他的妻子是特邀嘉賓，他本人也表示很高興與大家一起共進晚餐。地址，在美國生活了幾十年後，使用農村四縣（四邑或四邑）土語、台山粵語。我們的地區老友艾倫·易先生和他的妻子再次從他們的洛杉磯地區專程前來，以突顯我們之間的特殊關係。孔聖人在《論語》中說：「有朋自遠方來，不亦樂乎？」

9b8da88908c95c0548c2678bdfaaff56b84a1e39.sourceText: The Hon. Kimberly Yee, first Chinese or Asian American woman ever elected to the State Legislature of Arizona but eight short years ago, also delivered brief remarks; it was noted that she is now not only elevated as a State Senator and the Majority Leader for the Republicans, but now is seeking to be elected as the State Treasurer. Mr. Barry Wong, currently serving as the Executive Director of a gubernatorial office for equal opportunity, read a Proclamation for the occasion from Governor Doug Ducey.
9b8da88908c95c0548c2678bdfaaff56b84a1e39.translatedText: 八年前第一位當選亞利桑那州議員的華裔或亞裔美國女性 Kimberly Yee 也發表了簡短的講話。值得注意的是，她現在不僅被提升為州參議員和共和黨多數黨領袖，現在還尋求被選為州財政部長。現任州長平等機會辦公室執行董事的 Barry Wong 先生宣讀了州長 Doug Ducey 的公告。

e3797f35241fad86488d1409e19b39ab59e4b26a.sourceText: Once more, a half dozen scholarships to deserving students progressing in their education were presented, as well as many dozens of generous prizes raffled from China Chili Restaurant, Great Wall itself, and Super L Ranch Market (now relocated to Scottsdale) as well as each table having a gift from the Chinese Restaurant Association of Arizona. And, of course, the widely respected community elder, Mr. John M. Yee, highlighted the occasion, typically too busy to enjoy the excellent cuisine always available at this premier local restaurant in the Cantonese regional style.
e3797f35241fad86488d1409e19b39ab59e4b26a.translatedText: 再次向在學業上取得進步的優秀學生頒發了六份獎學金，以及由 China Chili Restaurant、長城本身和 Super L Ranch Market（現已搬遷至斯科茨代爾）抽獎的數十份豐厚獎品，每桌都有亞利桑那州中餐館協會贈送的禮物。當然，廣受尊敬的社區長者餘先生 (John M. Yee) 也特別強調了這個場合，因為他通常太忙，沒有時間享受這家當地頂級粵菜餐廳提供的美味佳餚。

c899067350254b0f6ac00cf023850dff51977e35.sourceText: The Spring Festival banquet for the year 4716 (in a continuous count, but including times rather legendary, by Dr. Sun Yat-sen, Founder of the Republic of China in 1912 as an absolute break from previous imperial chronological practices of two millennia but very natural for the Christian convert he became in youth) since the reign of Huang Di (the Yellow Ruler), was another characteristic occasion of happy reunion and forward-looking hopes for good health and prosperity and peaceful harmony.
c899067350254b0f6ac00cf023850dff51977e35.translatedText: 4716 年的春節宴會（連續計數，但包括中華民國創建者孫中山先生於 1912年舉辦的頗具傳奇色彩的時代），這絕對打破了以前的帝國主義傳統自黃帝（黃色統治者）統治以來，兩千年來的習俗（但對於年輕時皈依基督教的人來說是很自然的），是另一個幸福團聚的典型時刻，也是對健康、繁榮與和平和諧的前瞻性希望。

389e6bcfe2131aeddbfc6a30fdaf371e71396df7.sourceText: Many Yees have local roots in recent centuries from the Guangdong Province area, and so this Association in Phoenix commemorates a truly fellow countryman — a scholar-official of the Northern Song dynasty (960?1125 C.E.), Yu Jing, or in the Cantonese rendering of his nickname, Yee Fung-toy (Yu Fengcai). That hao derived from his reputation, confirmed by the emperor himself, for inspiring elegant demeanor in a hoary age when courtesy and politesse mattered, when intensive cultivation in poetry, in calligraphy, and in scholarship counted. Truly a Model Ancestor to be emulated and venerated; hopefully, erroneous notions in certain local circles that such respect constitutes any type of divine worship will in time pass — for error, even stubbornly ignorant, generally does.
389e6bcfe2131aeddbfc6a30fdaf371e71396df7.translatedText: 近幾個世紀以來，許多葉氏都在廣東省地區紮根，因此鳳凰城的這個協會是為了紀念一位真正的同胞——北宋（公元960-1125年）的學者官員餘靖，或者用粵語翻譯他的綽號“餘鳳才”。這種豪氣源自於他的聲譽，並得到了皇帝本人的確認，在一個崇尚禮節、注重詩詞、書法和學術的蒼老時代，激發了風采。真正值得效仿和尊敬的模範祖先；希望某些地方圈子裡認為這種尊重構成任何類型的神聖崇拜的錯誤觀念會隨著時間的推移而消失——因為錯誤，即使是頑固的無知，通常也會過去。

2d695945c5aa1206548b0affd361658d20ebd88d.sourceText: The McMath-Pierce Solar Telescope, atop Kitt Peak in Arizona, is the world's largest instrument dedicated to studying the Sun. Designed by Bruce Graham of the prolific Skidmore, Owings, and Merrill architectural firm, the telescope commands an awe-inspiring view with its distinctive 110-foot-tall tower and 200-foot-long diagonal shaft.
2d695945c5aa1206548b0affd361658d20ebd88d.translatedText: 麥克馬斯-皮爾斯太陽望遠鏡位於亞利桑那州基特峰頂，是世界上最大的專門用於研究太陽的儀器。望遠鏡由多產的 Skidmore、Owings 和 Merrill 建築公司的 Bruce Graham 設計，擁有獨特的 110 英尺高塔和 200 英尺長的對角線，可欣賞到令人驚嘆的景色。

7dc8f0d33131f04af8f0ca843c5cb9505daa085b.sourceText: Completed in 1962, the building's main instrument is a heliostat, which tracks the Sun through the sky and focuses its light down through the diagonal shaft. This shaft continues about 50 vertical meters underground to a 1.6-meter primary mirror, forming the largest unobstructed aperture of any optical telescope system. From here, the light travels back up a portion of the shaft to a flat mirror, which then reflects an 85-centimeter wide image of the Sun downward to a subterranean laboratory.
7dc8f0d33131f04af8f0ca843c5cb9505daa085b.translatedText: 於 1962 年竣工，該建築的主要儀器是定日鏡，它在天空中跟踪太陽，並通過對角軸將光線聚焦下來。該豎井在地下垂直延伸約 50 米，到達 1.6 公尺的主鏡，形成光學望遠鏡系統中最大的無障礙孔徑。從這裡，光線沿著軸的一部分返回到平面鏡，然後平面鏡將 85 公分寬的太陽影像向下反射到地下實驗室。

631d94c41a2aa4691eca4ee500a29a28c3719863.sourceText: In addition to being the largest solar telescope in the world, the McMath-Pierce is also unique because it is sensitive enough to observe bright stars at night. The telescope also boasts a low-cost (which translates from astronomical terms to less than $25,000) adaptive optics system. This setup utilizes a rapidly deformable mirror to correct for distortions introduced by the turbulent atmosphere. Using sensors to measure the degree of image distortion, the adaptive optics system adjusts the mirror's shape accordingly and thus turns a blurry image into a clear one.
631d94c41a2aa4691eca4ee500a29a28c3719863.translatedText: 除了是世界上最大的太陽望遠鏡之外，麥克馬斯-皮爾斯望遠鏡的獨特之處還在於它足夠靈敏，可以在夜間觀察明亮的星星。該望遠鏡還擁有低成本（從天文術語轉換為不到 25,000 美元）的自適應光學系統。該裝置利用快速變形鏡來校正由湍流大氣引起的扭曲。自適應光學系統利用感測器測量影像失真程度，相應地調整鏡子的形狀，從而將模糊的影像變成清晰的影像。

b9715035cf650fa3f625f1511adf651c2bcd3ad0.sourceText: One major area of study at the observatory is the structure of sunspots, which are relatively cold, dark spots on the Sun's surface created by intense magnetic activity. Some of the more important discoveries made at McMath-Pierce, however, include the detection of water vapor in the Sun, the measurement of kilogauss magnetic fields (thousands of times stronger than the Earth's) outside of sunspots, and the detection of a natural maser (like a laser, but with microwaves instead of visible light) in the Martian atmosphere.
b9715035cf650fa3f625f1511adf651c2bcd3ad0.translatedText: 這個天文台的一個主要研究領域是太陽黑子的結構，太陽黑子是太陽表面由強烈磁活動產生的相對寒冷的黑點。然而，麥克馬斯-皮爾斯實驗室取得的一些更重要的發現包括探測太陽中的水蒸氣、測量太陽黑子外部的千高斯磁場（比地球強數千倍），以及探測火星大氣中的天然微波激射器（類似於激光，但使用微波而不是可見光）。

c7878d147a90ec596d11c2826d5c70822918bdd0.sourceText: Update as of January 2022: "We are currently not hosting public visitors to the summit or base facilities. With the continuously evolving nature of the pandemic, we currently do not have a reopening date. We will update this page when a reopening date is available. The timeline may be different for each site.".
c7878d147a90ec596d11c2826d5c70822918bdd0.translatedText: 截至 2022 年 1 月更新：“我們目前還沒有隨著疫情的不斷發展，我們將在確定重新開放日期後更新此頁面。”

87e9445984373d478b7fd632a720de2978ec2b45.sourceText: The Verde Valley Ancestral Garden was constructed by the area's only archaeology museum and is free for the public to enjoy. Featuring ancient seeds and plants that the Hohokam, Sinagua, Yavapai, and Apache once harvested, the garden allows visitors to view and learn about plants harvested here centuries ago.
87e9445984373d478b7fd632a720de2978ec2b45.translatedText: 佛得谷祖庭花園由該地區唯一的考古博物館建造，免費供公眾參觀。花園以霍霍卡姆人、西納瓜人、亞瓦派人和阿帕奇人曾經收穫的古老種子和植物為特色，讓遊客可以觀賞和了解幾個世紀前在這裡收穫的植物。

53714c4489744d3b615f691d4bc786acc7e6b99e.sourceText: The garden's extraordinary features are the series of rock terraces, completed by hand, that act as a container for rainwater. With sometimes hefty monsoon seasons in Camp Verde , rain harvested was an important function of ancient gardening. Still today, this ancient rock technology can be used to conserve water for the Verde River. The river, located less than a mile east of the garden, is Arizona 's only federally designated Wild and Scenic River and was the main water source for the indigenous populations. The Verde Valley Ancestral Garden promotes educational learning about the river and also exemplifies gardening techniques to save water.
53714c4489744d3b615f691d4bc786acc7e6b99e.translatedText: 花園的非凡之處在於一系列手工完成的岩石露台，它們充當雨水的容器。佛得角有時會遇到季風季節，收集雨水是古代園藝的重要功能。時至今日，這種古老的岩石技術仍可用於為佛得角河節約用水。這條河位於花園以東不到一英里，是亞利桑那州唯一一條聯邦指定的野生風景河，也是原住民的主要水源。佛得角山谷祖先花園促進了有關河流的教育學習，並體現了節約用水的園藝技術。

61322993a003b6f493b406cd93dc8a681390741d.sourceText: The ancestral garden is a great place for an afternoon picnic or a short hike along the quarter-mile trail. There are benches offered for seating, and trees that allow for shade during the hot summers. Along the trail, visitors will find educational displays that provide details about the various archaeological digs around the garden and the history of the Sinagua. Parking is available in the dirt lot of the trailhead.
61322993a003b6f493b406cd93dc8a681390741d.translatedText: 祖先花園是下午野餐或沿著四分之一英里小徑短途徒步旅行的好地方。這裡有可供休息的長凳，還有可以在炎熱的夏季遮蔭的樹木。沿著小路，遊客會發現教育展覽，其中提供有關花園周圍各種考古發掘和西納瓜歷史的詳細資訊。步道起點的泥土地段設有停車場。

eeece1f5d06dc1c26f2caab996699bc16b02fde9.sourceText: Update as of September 2023: This location is closed indefinitely.
eeece1f5d06dc1c26f2caab996699bc16b02fde9.translatedText: 截至 2023 年 9 月的更新：此地點無限期關閉。

9ef2e6d9a162b7ebc1526b78bc3c4a0db168ecfc.sourceText: In 2019, when employees of the Navajo Generating Station (NGS) were asked to come up with a project to memorialize the power plant that was soon to be decommissioned, they chose to create an art installation using boiler tubes that resemble Antelope Canyon . After the power plant was demolished, a number of 25-foot reheating tubes were removed from the U3 boiler and hand-painted by employees of the city of Page, Arizona .
9ef2e6d9a162b7ebc1526b78bc3c4a0db168ecfc.translatedText: 2019年，當納瓦荷發電廠（NGS）的員工被要求提出一個計畫來紀念即將退役的發電廠時，他們選擇使用類似羚羊峽谷的鍋爐管創作一個藝術裝置。電廠拆除後，亞利桑那州佩吉市的員工從 U3 鍋爐上拆除了多根 25 英尺長的再熱管，並進行了手繪。

197ec7d6a5b69ffd0738247e153fd25212311321.sourceText: The art installation stands tall and proud outside of City Hall and commemorates the impact the Navajo Generating Station left on Page and the surrounding area.
197ec7d6a5b69ffd0738247e153fd25212311321.translatedText: 藝術裝置傲然矗立在市政廳外，紀念納瓦荷發電廠對佩吉及週邊地區造成的影響。

5497307b681e0fa4d8894b78463d9fd4553c1e21.sourceText: The coal-fired power plant provided electricity not only to Page but to other communities in the Southwest for over 40 years and supplied hundreds of long-term reliable jobs. The art installations' resemblance to Antelope Canyon honors the local Indigenous culture and can be interpreted as a symbol of the citizens of Page's new employer, the tourism industry.
5497307b681e0fa4d8894b78463d9fd4553c1e21.translatedText: 燃煤電廠不僅為佩吉市提供電力，也為其他地區提供電力。 40 多年來，該計畫一直在西南部社區提供服務，並提供了數百個長期可靠的就業機會。這些藝術裝置與羚羊峽谷的相似之處在於尊重了當地的原住民文化，也可以被解讀為佩奇的新雇主——旅遊業的公民的象徵。

19a9d25f42a6bc3159b88f0511547bd8d715ed1f.sourceText: This is a free art installation open to the public. Free parking is available at Page City Hall on 697 Vista Avenue.
19a9d25f42a6bc3159b88f0511547bd8d715ed1f.translatedText: 這是一個免費對外開放的藝術裝置。佩吉市政廳 (Page City Hall) 位於 697 Vista Avenue，提供免費停車場。

0c340875f36b1baa3d5540c099ad1a3c85e5659f.sourceText: Set in a peaceful desert valley, the remaining stone walls of this 1930s ranch house in the Tucson Mountains reminds passing hikers of the challenges of a bygone era.
0c340875f36b1baa3d5540c099ad1a3c85e5659f.translatedText: 這座位於圖森山脈的 1930 年代牧場房屋坐落在寧靜的沙漠山谷中，其殘存的石牆讓路過的徒步旅行者想起了過去時代的挑戰。

0a5ed6b2ae5c0aff1e05e19958c9ac5692286efa.sourceText: The Bowen Homestead, also called the Bowen Stone House, was constructed at this secluded and remote location in the early 1930s by Sherry and Ruby Bowen. At the time, Sherry was the city editor at the Arizona Daily Star . The couple decided to move out West for Ruby's health and start a homestead in the hills of the Sonoran Desert, eventually expanding their land to some 2,000 acres.
0a5ed6b2ae5c0aff1e05e19958c9ac5692286efa.translatedText: 鮑文家園，也稱為鮑文石屋，由 Sherry 和 Ruby Bowen 於 1930 年代初在這個僻靜而偏遠的地方建造。當時，雪莉是《亞利桑那每日星報》的城市編輯。為了魯比的健康，這對夫婦決定搬到西部，在索諾蘭沙漠的山上建立家園，最終將他們的土地擴大到約 2,000 英畝。

69480689abed06f92ac18da57624025303060381.sourceText: They built a stone ranch house, of which only the foundation walls remain today, having withstood the desert winds, heat, and storms for more than eight decades. You can see traces of old fireplaces, and the empty frames of what were once huge picture windows where the Bowens would have looked out at the cacti and mesquite trees that dot this rustic landscape, admiring the wild horses, deer, sheep, and other animals that came to graze in the valley.
69480689abed06f92ac18da57624025303060381.translatedText: 他們建造了一座石頭牧場房屋，如今只剩下地基牆，已經承受了八年多的沙漠風、炎熱和風暴。您可以看到舊壁爐的痕跡，以及曾經巨大的觀景窗的空框，鮑恩斯夫婦可以從那裡眺望散佈在鄉村景觀中的仙人掌和豆科灌木樹，欣賞野馬、鹿、羊和其他在山谷裡吃草的動物。

941beab2c47f8925e73911f6188fb6c318fc5909.sourceText: Incorporated into Tucson Mountain Park in 1983, the homestead now greets hikers trekking the Yetman Trail, providing a brief glimpse into the family's rugged existence during the Great Depression and World War II. As an interesting side note, the couple's daughter Gloria, who was born at the ranch, grew up to become a renowned ballerina.
941beab2c47f8925e73911f6188fb6c318fc5909.translatedText: 於 1983 年併入圖森山公園，現在迎接健行者的到來。耶特曼小徑 (Yetman Trail)，讓您可以一睹這個家族在大蕭條和第二次世界大戰期間的艱難生活。有趣的是，這對夫婦的女兒格洛麗亞出生在牧場，長大後成為一位著名的芭蕾舞者。

b31bb88a5b6870508dda6bf7fd66add93c0ce855.sourceText: Wander around the outskirts of Phoenix , Arizona , and you'll come across an alley flanked by wonderful, elaborate murals created by local artists.
b31bb88a5b6870508dda6bf7fd66add93c0ce855.translatedText: 在亞利桑那州鳳凰城的郊區漫步，您會發現一條小巷，兩側都是當地藝術家創作的精美精美的壁畫。

401a4fc2cf1d6971fce7f8ae4521b0b1d51e595c.sourceText: Some of the images showcase scenes from the city, its history, and its people. Others reference popular culture or reflect the artists' own unique designs.
401a4fc2cf1d6971fce7f8ae4521b0b1d51e595c.translatedText: 一些圖像展示了這座城市、它的歷史和它的人民的場景。其他則參考流行文化或反映藝術家自己的獨特設計。

f7be5eba619a8e74f41e1c00d9d6c926656b6288.sourceText: Every year, a festival is held to celebrate this street, where artists add new murals to the existing collection. Dozens of artists descend upon the alley, which continues to serve as a canvas for their creativity. It's a way for the people of Phoenix to bring quite a few splashes of color to their concrete desert oasis.
f7be5eba619a8e74f41e1c00d9d6c926656b6288.translatedText: 每年都會舉辦一個節日來慶祝這條街，藝術家們會在現有的收藏中添加新的壁畫。數十位藝術家來到這條小巷，這裡繼續成為他們發揮創意的畫布。這是鳳凰城人民為他們的混凝土沙漠綠洲增添不少色彩的一種方式。

f48dcd688c9b7b3940c6247cbf3b5edd2000cc2a.sourceText: Oak St is easy to miss and can be a tight squeeze for two cars. So, be patient and courteous as people do live there. It's also not the only set of murals you can find. There are quite a number, on people's fences, behind Barrio Cafe, and wrapped around Collector's Marketplace.
f48dcd688c9b7b3940c6247cbf3b5edd2000cc2a.translatedText: 橡樹街很容易錯過，而且對於兩輛車來說可能會很擁擠。因此，請保持耐心和禮貌，因為人們住在那裡。這也不是您能找到的唯一一組壁畫。在人們的圍牆上、巴里奧咖啡館後面、收藏家市場周圍，有相當多的人。

285b70f1ba99f8f026b41bcf292d63ede7a872b1.sourceText: The Royal Chinese drums and majestic ribbon dance will open the 2023 Spring Festival Gala. As The year of the Rabbit approaches, Arizona Art Academy and City of Chandler invites you to join us in celebrating Chinese New Year on January 15, 2023 at 7pm, at The Chandler Center for the Arts. Our 2023 Chinese New Year show promises to be a magnificent production featuring a glamourous fashion show, concert, classical opera, and amazing dance performances. We take great pride in every detail in our craft, exceeding beyond the boundaries of performing arts, bringing you a world class experience. We want to thank the community and The City of Chandler for supporting us over the last decade. This year our proceeds will go to benefit the Chandler School District and all educators and school staff will be our guests of honor with free admission.
285b70f1ba99f8f026b41bcf292d63ede7a872b1.translatedText: 皇家鼓樂、威風凜凜的彩帶舞將為2023年春聯晚會拉開序幕。隨著兔年的臨近，亞利桑那州藝術學院和錢德勒市誠摯邀請您於 2023 年 1 月 15 日晚上 7 點在錢德勒藝術中心與我們一起慶祝中國新年。我們的2023年中國新年演出必將是一場精彩的演出，包括迷人的時裝秀、音樂會、古典歌劇和令人驚嘆的舞蹈表演。我們對我們工藝的每個細節都感到非常自豪，超越了表演藝術的界限，為您帶來世界一流的體驗。我們要感謝社區和錢德勒市在過去十年中對我們的支持。今年我們的收益將捐給錢德勒學區，所有教育工作者和學校工作人員將成為我們的貴賓並免費入場。

bb0666e2c86bd780f513fdf227080ebc7b3c165c.sourceText: For more information about our show, please contact us at arizonaartacademy@gmail.com or Call (480)788-9584 2023 Chinese New Year Show (2023 Spring Festival Gala) January 15th, Sunday, 2023 @ 7 pm Chandler Center for the Arts

f4b4c22c5e9795a869efdf2e434850f81c62088d.sourceText: CHANDLER, Ariz. – Enjoy Chandler’s A-list teen bands as they take center stage at the Chandler Community Center during Concerts in the Courtyard. This new free event will take place once a month, September through November. Concertgoers can indulge in snacks, lawn games and family-friendly live performances from 6-8 p.m. The schedule of bands is as follows:
f4b4c22c5e9795a869efdf2e434850f81c62088d.translatedText: 亞利桑那州錢德勒 – 欣賞錢德勒的一流青少年樂隊，他們在庭院音樂會期間在錢德勒社區中心佔據中心舞台。這項新的免費活動將於 9 月至 11 月每月舉行一次。下午 6 點至 8 點，音樂會觀眾可以盡情享受小吃、草坪遊戲和適合家庭的現場表演。樂隊時間表如下：

6e687a933ca358cc61fd17835aad8864613a5462.sourceText: “As someone who was once a teenager trying to start a band, I know how difficult it can be to find somewhere to perform,” said Kennedy Terrill, Recreation Coordinator, and event organizer. “I recognized that we have the perfect space here at the Chandler Community Center for these bands to play and get the experience they need to propel their musical career while Chandler residents come together to have a fun, laid back evening with family and friends.”
6e687a933ca358cc61fd17835aad8864613a5462.translatedText: “作為一個肯尼迪曾經嘗試找到樂隊的組織” Terrill) 說道。 「我認識到，我們在錢德勒社區中心擁有完美的空間，供這些樂隊演奏並獲得推動他們的音樂事業所需的經驗，同時錢德勒居民聚集在一起與家人和朋友度過一個有趣、悠閒的夜晚。」

bb9c3c596124f8ad3e2e8aa0b77dfb7028833bcd.sourceText: Chandler residents and nonresidents alike are invited to attend and support our local teen bands. The Chandler Community Center is located at 125 E. Commonwealth Ave. For more information on Concerts in the Courtyard, visit the City of Chandler Teen Programs webpage or call 480-782-2730.

6cb2b9dbad587d3be3979ad32ba7491b6f2f4695.translatedText: 亞利桑那州錢德勒 – 錢德勒市議會已批准...

178b58bd643d813190803a1f579f084a9c77d345.sourceText: CHANDLER, Ariz. – The Chandler City Council has approved a $250,000 agreement with Sigma Tactical Wellness to advance the health and wellness of Chandler police officers through screenings for early detection of heart disease and related conditions.
178b58bd643d813190803a1f579f084a9c77d345.translatedText: 亞利桑那州錢德勒 – 錢德勒市議會已批准與 Sigma Tactical Wellness 達成一項價值 25 萬美元的協議，通過錢德勒市議會發現心臟病相關情況。

4b7a0f547af63030fa31b67e547c2339654a0346.sourceText: This voluntary health and wellness benefit addresses health risks specific to first responders. The preventative screening program will provide officers with a complete understanding of their current metabolic status and individual cardiovascular risk, including exercise and nutrition modification recommendations for their health and wellness.
4b7a0f547af63030fa31b67e547c2339654a0346.translatedText: 這項自願健康和保健福利可解決急救人員特有的健康風險。預防性篩檢計畫將使警員全面了解他們目前的代謝狀況和個人心血管風險，包括針對他們的健康和保健的運動和營養調整建議。

c78f581ae47304c4fcabcb773a85fd7dc09ed3ae.sourceText: Sigma Tactical Wellness says that heart disease is the number one killer of active and retired law enforcement officers. Early detection has shown massive potential in eliminating the catastrophic effects of cardiac disease among first responders.
c78f581ae47304c4fcabcb773a85fd7dc09ed3ae.translatedText: Sigma Tactical Wellness 表示，心臟病是現役和退休執法人員的頭號殺手。早期檢測在消除急救人員心臟病的災難性影響方面顯示出巨大的潛力。

8e4b4b7c59bc6f0f68d104f98e143c9b824f0eea.sourceText: Sigma’s system evaluates early stages of coronary disease and markers used to predict the development of a heart attack. The cardiometabolic health screening incorporates medical evaluation, blood-based inflammatory biomarker detection, vascular imaging and cardiopulmonary exercise testing to identify early onset and late-stage coronary disease. Any follow-up medical testing, consultations and care necessary to address a personal health condition are the responsibility of the police officer.
8e4b4b7c59bc6f0f68d104f98e143c9b824f0eea.translatedText: Sigma 的系統可評估冠心病的早期階段以及用於預測心臟病發作發展的標記。心臟代謝健康篩檢結合了醫學評估、血液發炎生物標記檢測、血管成像和心肺運動測試，以識別早期和晚期冠心病。解決個人健康狀況所需的任何後續醫療檢測、諮詢和護理均由警官負責。

8882cab6ab0680935421c1f97ddaf28d512fda16.sourceText: We often talk about how we want the world changed for better. It is so fortunate that we have this group of >300 people showcasing the exact what it is. 1) We have donated >$50,000 within 4 days of the gofundme launch， with the extraordinary and heartfelt support from the Chinese American community. 2)We have 40+ volunteers working tirelessly day and night to have the 1st order of 100,000 medical face masks placed within 5 days of donation start. Up to now, we have donated 158,000 medical face masks to more than 20 AZ organizations including 12 hospitals/medical centers, 6 police departments/Fires, 2 nursing homes and two major cities in Navajo Nation. This exceeded our original goal of help to donate to 8 local hospitals. 3) We have a great non-profit organization called Hope (Tempe) Chinese School behind all these. It not only provides volunteer resources made of 70% of our lead organizing volunteers but also supplies us the accounting systems including legal liability support, paper work verification, managing gofundme/PayPal transactions, matching verification. They also lended us $50,000 to enable the facemask ordering before gofundme releases its fund to us ( 90 days fund release period). Without Hope Chinese School’s support, the donation would not be this smooth if not impossible at all.
8882cab6ab0680935421c1f97ddaf28d512fda16.translatedText: 我們經常談論我們希望世界如何變得更好。幸運的是，我們有超過 300 人的團隊來展示它的確切內容。 1) 在gofundme上線後的4天內，我們已經捐贈了超過5萬美元，並得到了美國華人社區的非凡和衷心的支持。 2）我們有40多名志工日以繼夜地孜孜不倦地工作，在捐贈開始後的5天內就完成了第一筆10萬隻醫用口罩的訂單。截至目前，我們已向 20 多個亞利桑那州組織捐贈了 158,000 個醫用口罩，其中包括 12 家醫院/醫療中心、6 個警察局/消防局、2 個療養院和納瓦霍族兩個主要城市。這超出了我們最初為當地8家醫院捐款的目標。 3）這一切的背後有一個偉大的非營利組織，叫做希望（坦佩）中文學校。它不僅提供由我們70%的領導組織志工組成的志工資源，還為我們提供包括法律責任支援、文書工作驗證、管理gofundme/PayPal交易、配對驗證在內的會計系統。他們還借出了 50,000 美元，以便在 gofundme 向我們發放資金之前（90 天的資金發放期）可以訂購口罩。如果沒有希望中文學校的支持，這次捐款活動即使不是不可能也不會如此順利。

5fc518786c941d009b0ca53615e7665060757f11.sourceText: 4) AZ Chinese restaurants who still managed to give out $19,200 even though their business are severely impacted by the pandemic. We saw the great contributions from Chinese Restaurant Association and Chinese restaurants everytime community needs them. Their realm and mind of giving life to all the world are real role model for all of us. 5) Tucson Chinese Community worked together with us to support the same cause.
5fc518786c941d009b0ca53615e7665060757f11.translatedText: 4）亞利桑那州的中餐館，儘管生意受到疫情的嚴重影響，但仍設法捐贈了19,200美元。每次社區需要的時候，我們都看到中華餐飲協會和中餐館的巨大貢獻。他們的境界和賦予世界生命的胸懷是我們所有人的真正榜樣。 5) 圖森華人社區與我們一起支持同一個事業。

ce88ac4d07752d482cbafc3c8619b54d20394f09.sourceText: 6) All matching employers who encourage their employees to contribute to the great cause by providing matching funds. No Road is long with good company. 7) Special thanks go to our extraordinary PR team. This year has been certainly a time of much change for everyone. After so many days and nights’ hard work to get the reliable resources for qualified masks and “fast” transportations, we counted our blessings to each connection who can make to enable these. As we reflect on what else we are especially thankful, we keep coming back to our PR team’s unwavering dedication to our precious mission. Your devotion and passion brought best of our ability to make the world better and make us/Chinese American’s contributions known to the people around us and to the world with over 20 English media and enormous Chinese media reports. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for being a big part of our Chinese American Covid-19 Relief AZ family
ce88ac4d07752d482cbafc3c8619b54d20394f09.translatedText: 6) 所有透過提供配套資金鼓勵員工為偉大事業做出貢獻的配套雇主。有良伴，路不長。 7) 特別感謝我們優秀的公關團隊。今年對每個人來說無疑都是一個巨大變化的時期。經過這麼多日夜的辛勤工作，我們獲得了合格口罩的可靠資源和「快速」運輸，我們對每一位能夠實現這些目標的人表示祝福。當我們思考還有哪些事情是我們特別值得感激的時候，我們不斷回想起我們的公關團隊對我們寶貴使命的堅定不移的奉獻精神。你們的奉獻和熱情讓我們盡了最大的努力讓世界變得更美好，讓我們/美籍華人的貢獻被20多家英文媒體和海量中文媒體報道為我們周圍的人和全世界所知。我們衷心感謝您成為我們華裔美國人 Covid-19 Relief AZ 大家庭的重要成員

7e1f5e32cb939503fa0011dd7d35cbe55387a957.sourceText: Thanks all those who donated and contributed to this great cause! This really is one of the great examples making impossible possible! Great and inspiring teamwork, Chinese American Covid 19 Relief AZ group. We are making a difference!
7e1f5e32cb939503fa0011dd7d35cbe55387a957.translatedText: 感謝所有為這項偉大事業捐款和貢獻的人們！這確實是讓不可能成為可能的偉大例子之一！偉大而鼓舞人心的團隊合作，華裔美國人 Covid 19 救援 AZ 小組。我們正在做出改變！

d0c57608594ca0638a20c2ae6ab57441e6c2eae1.sourceText: PHOENIX, AZ (May 14, 2020) — Governor Doug Ducey today announced that following a national search, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) has selected Arizona for its new U.S. advanced semiconductor factory. The project will create over 1,600 new high-tech jobs and generate thousands of additional jobs in the state for suppliers and other companies within the semiconductor industry. TSMC’s total spending on this project, including capital expenditure, will be approximately $12 billion from 2021 to 2029.
d0c57608594ca0638a20c2ae6ab57441e6c2eae1.translatedText: 亞利桑那州鳳凰城（2020 年 5 月 14 日）— 州長 Doug Ducey 今天宣布，經過全國搜索，台積電 (TSMC) 選擇亞利桑那州作為其新的美國先進半導體工廠。該項目將創造超過 1,600 個新的高科技就業崗位，並為該州半導體行業的供應商和其他公司創造數千個就業機會。從 2021 年到 2029 年，台積電在該項目上的總支出（包括資本支出）將約為 120 億美元。

cac707096a39dcb88974dfc643808bc58c8e5a74.sourceText: “We’re incredibly proud that one of the world’s leading technology companies has chosen Arizona for this high-tech project, one with national and global significance,” said Governor Ducey. “TSMC could have picked any place in the world to build this advanced manufacturing factory. They chose Arizona for our unbeatable business climate, already thriving tech sector and ready access to an international supply chain. I’d like to thank TSMC Chairman Dr. Mark Liu for his commitment to Arizona. We are honored to be selected for this project and look forward to building a collaborative long-term relationship with TSMC. I’m very grateful to President Donald Trump for his leadership and tireless efforts to bring more manufacturing back to our shores. I’d also like to thank Secretary Ross, his team at the U.S. Department of Commerce including SelectUSA, and the Trump administration for their partnership.”
cac707096a39dcb88974dfc643808bc58c8e5a74.translatedText: 「我們非常自豪，世界領先的科技公司之一選擇亞利桑那州開展這項具有全國和全球意義的高科技項目，」杜西州長表示。 「台積電可以選擇世界上任何地方來建造這座先進的製造工廠。他們選擇亞利桑那州是因為我們無與倫比的商業環境、已經蓬勃發展的科技行業以及隨時進入國際供應鏈的機會。我要感謝台積電董事長劉馬克博士對亞利桑那州的承諾。 我們很榮幸被選中參與這個項目，並期待與台積電建立長期合作關係。 SelectUSA）以及川普政府的合作夥伴關係。

7976fde44bffdfa3af1fc636db45c588e6f780ec.sourceText: Arizona has long been a hub for the advanced manufacturing and semiconductor industries. The state’s skilled workforce, strong supply chain, strategic geographic location, commitment to pro-innovation policies and unmatched quality of life have continued to drive rapid industry growth and economic momentum. This new U.S. facility will enable TSMC to provide enhanced service to customers and partners and increase its ability to attract global talent.
7976fde44bffdfa3af1fc636db45c588e6f780ec.translatedText: 亞利桑那州長期以來一直是先進製造和半導體行業的中心。該州熟練的勞動力、強大的供應鏈、戰略地理位置、對創新政策的承諾以及無與倫比的生活品質繼續推動行業快速增長和經濟發展勢頭。這座新的美國工廠將使台積電能夠為客戶和合作夥伴提供增強的服務，並提高其吸引全球人才的能力。

b821351b67e7127d171e6b8e1ed7c4e4da5481cc.sourceText: The facility will utilize TSMC’s 5-nanometer technology for semiconductor wafer fabrication and have the capacity to produce 20,000 wafers per month. Construction is planned to begin in 2021 with production targeted to start in 2024. The Arizona facility will be the company’s second manufacturing operation in the United States.
b821351b67e7127d171e6b8e1ed7c4e4da5481cc.translatedText: 該工廠將利用台積電的 5 奈米技術進行半導體晶圓製造，每月可生產 20,000 片晶圓。建設計劃於 2021 年開始，生產預計於 2024 年開始。亞利桑那州工廠將是該公司在美國的第二個製造工廠。

09c8de2f2ad3b965febc46d220e49cff0df52163.sourceText: Several sites in the City of Phoenix are still being evaluated for the location of the fab. The Arizona Commerce Authority will continue working with TSMC, the U.S. administration, the City of Phoenix and the Greater Phoenix Economic Council to finalize all aspects of the project.
09c8de2f2ad3b965febc46d220e49cff0df52163.translatedText: 鳳凰城的幾個地點仍在評估工廠的選址。亞利桑那州商務局將繼續與台積電、美國政府、鳳凰城和大鳳凰城經濟委員會合作，完成該計畫的各個方面。

14927cf9436dbdb116af7cbc435b01493de131ff.sourceText: Connie Weber, Arizona Commerce Authority conniew@AZcommerce.com
14927cf9436dbdb116af7cbc435b01493de131ff.translatedText: 亞利桑那州商務局 Connie Weber conniew@AZcommerce.com

5a5c44c6faee6cf9820351f94ddbe634ce51159b.sourceText: TSMC pioneered the pure-play foundry business model when it was founded in 1987 and has been the world’s largest dedicated semiconductor foundry ever since. The Company supports a thriving ecosystem of global customers and partners with the industry’s leading process technologies and portfolio of design enablement solutions to unleash innovation for the global semiconductor industry. With global operations spanning Asia, Europe, and North America, TSMC serves as a committed corporate citizen around the world. TSMC deployed 272 distinct process technologies and manufactured 10,761 products for 499 customers in 2019 by providing the broadest range of advanced, specialty and advanced packaging technology services. TSMC is the first foundry to provide 5-nanometer production capabilities, the most advanced semiconductor process technology available in the world. The Company is headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan.
5a5c44c6faee6cf9820351f94ddbe634ce51159b.translatedText: 台積電於 1987 年成立，開創了純晶圓代工業務模式，自此成為全球最大的專業半導體晶圓代工廠。該公司利用業界領先的製程技術和設計支援解決方案組合，支援全球客戶和合作夥伴蓬勃發展的生態系統，為全球半導體產業釋放創新活力。台積電的全球業務遍及亞洲、歐洲和北美，是全球堅定的企業公民。 2019 年，台積電部署了 272 種不同的製程技術，透過提供最廣泛的先進、專業和先進封裝技術服務，為 499 家客戶製造了 10,761 種產品。台積電是第一家提供 5 奈米生產能力的代工廠，這是世界上最先進的半導體製程技術。公司總部位於台灣新竹。
