090a0c4bc96270ae4a4f661c6e6e31821be6d14a.sourceText: New Executive Order: “Stay Home, Stay Healthy, Stay Connected”
090a0c4bc96270ae4a4f661c6e6e31821be6d14a.translatedText: 新的行政命令：「待在家裡，保持健康，保持聯繫」

279cbeb3697940785c89621ae882e0f1cf39e769.sourceText: PHOENIX⁠ — “Stay home, Stay healthy, Stay connected” – …
279cbeb3697940785c89621ae882e0f1cf39e769.translatedText: PHOENIX⁠ —「待在家裡，保持健康，保持聯繫」– …

69e41f927a048bbddb9639552d0949447b47cd1f.sourceText: PHOENIX⁠ — “Stay home, Stay healthy, Stay connected” – that’s what the state is asking of fellow Arizonans in the continued effort to slow the spread of COVID-19.
69e41f927a048bbddb9639552d0949447b47cd1f.translatedText: 鳳凰城 — 「待在家裡，保持健康，保持聯繫」——這是該州對亞利桑那州同胞的要求，不斷努力減緩 COVID-19 的傳播。

a3a708589c4024f5963569e2c34758ed30ce58e7.sourceText: The latest Executive Order issued today by Governor Doug Ducey follows new guidance from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) and comes at the recommendation of public health officials who are tracking data specific to Arizona. The Governor’s order promotes increased physical distancing, while encouraging social connectedness among citizens. It takes place at 5:00 p.m. tomorrow, March 31, 2020.
a3a708589c4024f5963569e2c34758ed30ce58e7.translatedText: 道格·杜西 (Doug Ducey) 州長今天發布的最新行政命令遵循疾病管制與預防中心 (CDC) 的新指導，並根據跟踪亞利桑那州特定數據的公共衛生官員的建議而發布。州長的命令促進增加身體距離，同時鼓勵公民之間的社會連結。活動於下午 5:00 舉行。明天，即 2020 年 3 月 31 日。

c9e47cc0b47fba094130f10918aceb11a004b16b.sourceText: “Keeping Arizonans safe and healthy as we slow the spread of COVID-19 remains our top priority,” said Governor Ducey. “Arizona citizens and businesses are already responsibly responding to this crisis. This order builds on the state’s efforts to protect public health by reminding Arizonans to maintain healthy habits and find alternative ways to stay connected with friends and loved ones while spending time at home. Slowing the spread of COVID-19 will ensure we build capacity in our healthcare system, and help protect the lives of those we love most. It’s important to emphasize that there are no plans to shut down grocery stores. People should continue to buy what you need for a week’s worth of groceries. I’m grateful to everyone making adjustments to fight this virus and protect others. Arizona will get through this, and we’ll do it together.”
c9e47cc0b47fba094130f10918aceb11a004b16b.translatedText: 「在減緩 COVID-19 傳播的同時，確保亞利桑那州人民的安全和健康仍然是我們的首要任務，」州長 Ducey 說。 「亞利桑那州公民和企業已經在負責任地應對這場危機。這項命令建立在該州保護公眾健康努力的基礎上，提醒亞利桑那州人保持健康習慣，並尋找其他方式在家裡度過時光時與朋友和親人保持聯繫。減緩 COVID-19的傳播將確保我們建立醫療保健系統的能力，並幫助保護我們最愛的人的生命。

868fe747831444e0ee7f4cb47825f9c56bdcb0d6.sourceText: Under the Executive Order, Arizonans shall limit their time away from their place of residence or property, except:
868fe747831444e0ee7f4cb47825f9c56bdcb0d6.translatedText: 根據該行政命令，亞利桑那州人應限制離開居住地或財產的時間，但以下情況除外：

737151276ac243fd3cbe7b30bbfdc4c23607456c.sourceText: To conduct or participate in essential activities, and/or;
737151276ac243fd3cbe7b30bbfdc4c23607456c.translatedText: 進行或參與基本活動，和/或；

350d132cfb733213e8a52f73c8de25097299466b.sourceText: For employment, to volunteer or participate in essential functions; or
350d132cfb733213e8a52f73c8de25097299466b.translatedText: 為了就業、志願服務或參與基本職能；或

f926decb7fc9330fd3e38380768ec6bf9732b294.sourceText: To utilize any services or products provided by essential business services;
f926decb7fc9330fd3e38380768ec6bf9732b294.translatedText: 利用基本商業服務提供的任何服務或產品；

01408e11b535cb302cc15cf5a8f10de71914fe4b.sourceText: And for employment if as a sole proprietor or family owned business, work is conducted in a separate office space from your home and the business is not open to serve the public.
01408e11b535cb302cc15cf5a8f10de71914fe4b.translatedText: 對於就業而言，如果作為獨資經營者或家族企業，工作是在與您家不同的辦公空間進行，並且該企業不向公眾開放。

d2dc1072c1346fa01aa0eb4bab36e64a99a98040.sourceText: On March 23, Governor Ducey issued an Executive Order clarifying businesses and operations deemed “essential” and providing certainty to business owners, employees and families.
d2dc1072c1346fa01aa0eb4bab36e64a99a98040.translatedText: 3 月 23日，杜西州長發布了一項行政命令，澄清了被視為“必要”的業務和運營，並為業務提供了確定性

c79bc38b6e5df38d6d72af511fe94ce7ffe20406.sourceText: Under today’s order, Arizonans are also encouraged to improve social connectedness by:
c79bc38b6e5df38d6d72af511fe94ce7ffe20406.translatedText: 根據今天的命令，還鼓勵亞利桑那州人通過以下方式改善社會聯繫：

81f8ae324a7f430818740bbe502a3112f8fea927.sourceText: Maintaining ongoing connections and communication with current social supports and structures such as family, friends, neighbors and other social groups;
81f8ae324a7f430818740bbe502a3112f8fea927.translatedText: 與當前的社會支持和結構（如社會支持和結構（如社會家人、鄰居和其他社會支持群體）保持持續的聯繫和溝通；

677a26a8cf4abf0a153e439c263d08dd3f7b9d33.sourceText: Educating fellow Arizonans on the negative health impacts of social isolation;
677a26a8cf4abf0a153e439c263d08dd3f7b9d33.translatedText: 教育亞利桑那州同胞了解社會孤立對健康的負面影響；

65d43a92435e5ce823ab6bc5f3b428333b983c5c.sourceText: And developing habits and activities that increase resilience, such as physical activity, virtual social gatherings, assisting neighbors, implementing or participating in connection campaigns for at risk populations, and participating in volunteer activities.
65d43a92435e5ce823ab6bc5f3b428333b983c5c.translatedText: 以及養成習慣和習慣增強復原力的活動，例如體力活動、虛擬社交聚會、協助鄰居、為高危人群實施或參與聯繫活動以及參與志工活動以及參與志工活動以及參與志工活動以及參與志工活動以及參與志工活動以及參與志工活動以及參與志工活動以及參與志工活動以及參與志工活動。

ad998f2a8ec09759d4af48ce7ee5b5f0adac21c3.sourceText: Under this policy, essential activities include:
ad998f2a8ec09759d4af48ce7ee5b5f0adac21c3.translatedText: 依本政策，基本活動包括：

9c4272035d320d458e01522f1405d0d81b86c4c7.sourceText: Obtaining necessary supplies and services for family, household members and pets, such as groceries, food and supplies for household consumption and use, supplies and equipment needed to work from home, assignments for completion of distance learning and products necessary to maintain safety, sanitation and essential maintenance of the home, residence.
9c4272035d320d458e01522f1405d0d81b86c4c7.translatedText: 為家人、家庭成員和寵物取得必要的用品和服務，例如家庭消費和使用的雜貨、食品和用品、在家工作所需的用品和設備、完成遠距學習的作業以及維護家庭、住所的安全、衛生和基本維護所需的產品。

4c0554a0caa837715e4402a1d4b49824de2226cd.sourceText: Engaging in activities essential for health and safety, including things such as seeking medical, behavioral health or emergency services and obtaining medical supplies or medication.
4c0554a0caa837715e4402a1d4b49824de2226cd.translatedText: 從事對健康和安全至關重要的活動，包括尋求醫療、行為健康或緊急服務以及獲取醫療用品或

cc94776764d4cf510e4f6401efb035b5c2e84852.sourceText: Caring for a family member, friend, or pet in another household or residence, which includes but is not limited to transportation for essential health and safety activities and to obtain necessary supplies and services for the other household.
cc94776764d4cf510e4f6401efb035b5c2e84852.translatedText: 照顧另一個家庭或住所的家庭成員、朋友或寵物，包括但不限於進行必要的健康和安全活動的交通，以及為其他家庭獲取必要的用品和服務。

7fb27e55946fc1eae4957acb330e34b37fe0d15e.sourceText: Engaging in outdoor exercise activities, such as walking, hiking, running, biking or golfing, but only if appropriate physical distancing practices are used.
7fb27e55946fc1eae4957acb330e34b37fe0d15e.translatedText: 參與戶外運動活動，例如步行、健行、跑步、騎自行車或打高爾夫球，但前提是採取適當的保持身體距離的做法。

3249d026fcf63925d3b37fa8094e15417512f76d.sourceText: Attending work in or conducting essential services which includes but is not limited to transporting children to child care services for attending work in an essential service.
3249d026fcf63925d3b37fa8094e15417512f76d.translatedText: 在或提供基本服務，包括但不限於將兒童送往兒童照護服務機構參加基本服務工作。

1b185bf8294e3125a120977cdeca9e50fddc99d9.sourceText: Engaging in constitutionally protected activities such as speech and religion, the democratic process to include voting any legal or court process provided that such is conducted in a manner that provides appropriate physical distancing to the extent feasible.
1b185bf8294e3125a120977cdeca9e50fddc99d9.translatedText: 參與受憲法保護的活動，例如言論和宗教、民主程序，包括對任何法律或法院程序進行投票，前提是此類活動的進行方式在可行的情況下提供適當的身體距離。

213e86dfb2e4332f5ab34aa319681044e0dc0ffb.sourceText: Already, Arizona has taken proactive steps to slow the spread of COVID-19.
213e86dfb2e4332f5ab34aa319681044e0dc0ffb.translatedText: 亞利桑那州已採取積極措施來減緩 COVID-19 的傳播。

5af53260b8506e36a442a619e6de51ffc0544434.sourceText: On March 11, Governor Ducey issued a declaration of a Public Health State of Emergency to prepare for, prevent, respond to, and mitigate the spread of the disease.
5af53260b8506e36a442a619e6de51ffc0544434.translatedText: 3 月 11 日，杜西州長宣布進入公共衛生緊急狀態，以準備、預防、應對和減輕疾病的傳播。

0975cdfb8f7e21222c0681aa75b720d0333b5011.sourceText: On March 15, a statewide school closure was issued in coordination with Superintendent of Public Instruction Kathy Hoffman. Today, it was extended through the end of the school year, following CDC guidance.
0975cdfb8f7e21222c0681aa75b720d0333b5011.translatedText: 3 月 15 日，與公共教育總監凱西·霍夫曼 (Kathy Hoffman) 協調，宣布關閉全州學校。今天，根據 CDC 的指導，該期限延長至學年結束。

160699a84e0af7de7e80e39ebce97bcf68bde0bc.sourceText: Many businesses have already greatly reduced their hours and operations as directed by health officials and in an effort to protect the public health and slow the spread of COVID-19.
160699a84e0af7de7e80e39ebce97bcf68bde0bc.translatedText: 許多企業已經按照衛生官員的指示大幅減少了營業時間和營業時間，以保護公眾健康並減緩 COVID-19 的傳播。

72f4ddaf374fbc7f39ccb11923467e6046977e3a.sourceText: On March 17th, following updated guidance from the CDC, the Arizona Department of Health Services (ADHS) issued updated guidance that included canceling or postponing gatherings of 10 or more people, recommending telework and other alternatives, restricting access to nursing homes, retirement homes and long-term care facilities to provide critical assistance, and providing recommendations to restaurants and eating establishments to mitigate the risk of COVID-19 transmission.
72f4ddaf374fbc7f39ccb11923467e6046977e3a.translatedText: 3 月 17 日，根據 CDC 的最新指導，亞利桑那州衛生服務部 (ADHS) 發布了更新的指導，其中包括取消或推遲聚會10 人或以上，建議遠程辦公和其他替代方案，限制進入療養院、養老院和長期護理機構以提供關鍵援助，並向餐飲場所提供關鍵援助，以降低 COVID-19 的建議。

022dda71570024513f668d0fd82a1a8283ad8597.sourceText: On March 19th, Governor Ducey required restaurants in Arizona counties with confirmed COVID-19 cases to provide dine-out options only and required all bars, gyms and movie theaters in those counties to close. That same day, Governor Duey halted all elective surgeries in the state of Arizona to free up medical resources and maintain the capacity for hospitals and providers to continue offering vital services.
022dda71570024513f668d0fd82a1a8283ad8597.translatedText: 3 月 19 日，杜西州長要求亞利桑那州確診 COVID-19 病例的各縣的餐廳僅提供外出就餐選擇，並要求這些縣的所有酒吧、健身房和電影院關閉。同一天，杜伊州長停止了亞利桑那州的所有擇期手術，以釋放醫療資源並保持醫院和醫療服務提供者繼續提供重要服務的能力。

a54da72c0a64c0e63094fa05e25e0c710bebf7d9.translatedText: UCA 呼籲所有美國人避免使用有關新型冠狀病毒、COVID-19 的分裂、種族或種族主義術語，並團結一致戰勝病毒

6270cda578dbabe6d2fe2e78e4b12cbb31bd2d74.sourceText: United Chinese Americans (UCA), a national coalition of…
6270cda578dbabe6d2fe2e78e4b12cbb31bd2d74.translatedText: 美國華人聯合會 (UCA)，一個由…組成的全國聯盟

462957a934b8e5dc84b96e76f439618bdbd903e1.sourceText: United Chinese Americans (UCA), a national coalition of Chinese Americans in more than 30 states, calls on the American news media, public figures and the American public to refrain from using terms such as “China virus,” “Chinese virus,” “Wuhan virus,” or “Asian virus” to describe the new coronavirus, COVID-19. Such terms often misinform and misguide the public in the fight against this virus, and could lead to bigotry, inflame hatred and even incite violence against Chinese and Asian Americans, as has already been widely reported. UCA will further monitor developments and call out any public figure or institution who continues to use the term “Chinese virus” or its other variants, until such wanton usage ceases. As recently as this past week, and one full month since the World Health Organization (WHO) officially designated the virus’ nomenclature as COVID-19, we unfortunately still hear many public figures and well-known organizations using geographical- and race-specific terms to describe it, despite the fact that the virus infects all races of people and has spread to more than 100 countries. That list includes President Donald Trump, Secretary of State Mike Pompeo, U.S. House Minority Leader Kevin McCarthy, Senator Tim Cotton, Senator Rick Scott, and Fox News. “Continuing to use such terms is wrong, and is unacceptable,” said Haipei Shue, president of UCA. “The virus has a name, and that’s the name that ought to be used.” In a multiethnic democracy like ours, where Chinese Americans have historically been singled out as objects of racism and xenophobia and subjected to damning stereotypes, and at a time when we need our whole society to work together to defeat COVID-19, we must avoid or stop insensitive, divisive, stigmatizing, racial or racist remarks and acts, as we come together to defeat this virus as one nation.
462957a934b8e5dc84b96e76f439618bdbd903e1.translatedText: 美國華人聯合會（UCA）是由30多個州的華裔美國人組成的全國聯盟，呼籲美國新聞媒體、公眾人物和美國公眾不要使用“中國病毒”、“中國病毒”、“武漢病毒”或“亞洲病毒”等術語來描述新型冠狀病毒COVID-19。正如已經廣泛報導的那樣，這些術語經常在抗擊這種病毒的過程中誤導和誤導公眾，並可能導致偏執、煽動仇恨，甚至煽動針對華裔和亞裔美國人的暴力。 UCA將進一步監測事態發展，並對任何繼續使用「中國病毒」或其其他變體一詞的公眾人物或機構進行嚴厲制裁，直至此類肆意使用停止。就在上週，距離世界衛生組織（WHO）正式將該病毒命名為“COVID-19”整整一個月後，我們不幸仍然聽到許多公眾人物和知名組織​​使用特定於地理和種族的術語來描述它，儘管該病毒感染了所有種族的人，並已傳播到100多個國家。名單包括唐納德·特朗普總統、國務卿邁克·蓬佩奧、美國眾議院少數黨領袖凱文·麥卡錫、參議員蒂姆·科頓、參議員里克·斯科特和福克斯新聞。 UCA 主席舒海培表示：“繼續使用此類術語是錯誤的，也是不可接受的。” 「病毒有一個名字，這就是應該使用的名字。」在像我們這樣的多民族民主國家中，華裔美國人歷來被視為種族主義和仇外心理的對象，並受到可怕的成見，當我們需要整個社會共同努力打敗COVID-19時，我們必須避免或停止麻木不仁、分裂、污名化、種族或種族主義的言論和行為，因為我們打敗這種病毒。

8da0464912c620346e18fad13c7f1a074b6a4c25.sourceText: While Odessa, Texas, claims to have the world’s largest jackrabbit statue at eight feet, they have more recently been dwarfed several times over by an abstract steel statue in Scottsdale, Arizona.
8da0464912c620346e18fad13c7f1a074b6a4c25.translatedText: 雖然德州敖德薩號稱擁有世界上最大的長耳大野兔雕像，高 8 英尺，但最近與亞利桑那州斯科茨代爾的一座抽象鋼製雕像相比，它們顯得相形見絀。

6cd012574fb490dc23b61347a8eb19a95e05c1a4.sourceText: Standing 26 feet tall and clocking in at 10 tons, One-Eyed Jack’s name refers not only to its singular eye but an old nickname for the Jack playing card. This is rather appropriate, considering that the jackrabbit itself has been a common sight in the Southwestern United States since time immemorial.
6cd012574fb490dc23b61347a8eb19a95e05c1a4.translatedText: 身高 26 英尺，重達 10 噸，獨眼傑克的名字不僅指其獨特的眼睛，也是傑克撲克牌的古老暱稱。考慮到自古以來，長耳大野兔本身就在美國西南部很常見。

94cac556b35c9ebcfbaaa26efc2663ba1cc45e51.sourceText: One-Eyed Jack was created by the artist John Randall Nelson to invite passersby into Old Town Scottsdale, which prides itself on its Western heritage (although the corner on which it stands was not developed until the 1950s.)
94cac556b35c9ebcfbaaa26efc2663ba1cc45e51.translatedText: 獨眼傑克是由藝術家 John Randall Nelson 創作的，目的是邀請路人參觀斯科茨代爾老城區，這里以其西部遺產而自豪（儘管它所在的街角直到 1950 年代才被開發。）

fbc559607feb7797513ce416dc50170f5a7a2c54.sourceText: However, the statue also tries to be forward-looking in its minimalistic design, inspired by the many innovative art galleries located in the neighborhood. An entirely different view of the sculpture can be seen at night, when it is lit up in bright colors.
fbc559607feb7797513ce416dc50170f5a7a2c54.translatedText: 但是，這座雕像的簡約設計也試圖來自附近具有前瞻性藝術，其設計也試圖來自附近的許多畫廊。晚上，當它被明亮的色彩照亮時，可以看到完全不同的雕塑景觀。

3638ab9b3a33518c7cd4e2e5fe87849d78a2094e.sourceText: Tucked in a sunny corner of Paradise Valley is a stellar example of stained-glass art. In fact, one might argue that the beauty of the Kilgore Chapel’s windows eclipses all other cathedral glass.
3638ab9b3a33518c7cd4e2e5fe87849d78a2094e.translatedText: 天堂谷陽光明媚的角落藏著一座彩色玻璃藝術的典範。事實上，有人可能會說，基爾戈教堂窗戶的美麗讓所有其他大教堂玻璃都黯然失色。

9108172d37b19f99299f4404124539cf675d55bb.sourceText: Designed by noted NASA artist Robert McCall and his wife Louise for the Valley Presbyterian Church, the 35,000 piece mosaic fills a 350-degree space with an atmosphere of heavenly radiance. Dedicated in 1984, the eight encircling panels of this installation took three years to complete, and each 10 foot by 20-foot section weighs more than a ton.
9108172d37b19f99299f4404124539cf675d55bb.translatedText: 由著名 NASA 藝術家羅伯特·麥考爾 (Robert McCall) 和他的妻子路易絲 (Louise) 為山谷長老會教堂設計的這幅馬賽克作品由 35,000 塊馬賽克組成，充滿了 350 度的空間，充滿了天堂般的光芒。該裝置於 1984 年落成，其八塊圍板耗時三年才完成，每塊 10 英尺 x 20 英尺的部分重量超過一噸。

97736816779cce4e7413726f22de051ecfac84a2.sourceText: The unique design harmonizes the gravity of religious devotion with scientific enlightenment using over 110 different colors of glass. As an official artist for NASA, McCall chronicled the United States space program for 35 years through his illustrations and promotional artwork. Probably even more well-known is his artwork for the film 2001: A Space Odyssey and for the Star Trek movie franchise. He also created murals for the National Air and Space Museum, the National Gallery of Art, the Johnson Space Center, and Epcot before passing away in 2010.
97736816779cce4e7413726f22de051ecfac84a2.translatedText: 獨特的設計使用 110 多種不同顏色的玻璃，將宗教信仰的重力與科學啟蒙融為一體。作為 NASA 的官方藝術家，麥考爾透過他的插圖和宣傳藝術作品記錄了美國太空計畫 35 年的歷史。更出名的可能是他為電影《2001：太空漫遊》和《星際爭霸戰》系列電影創作的藝術作品。在 2010 年去世之前，他還為國家航空航天博物館、國家美術館、約翰遜航天中心和未來世界創作了壁畫。

902507e1a180d8fa7eafec3cc678782b337b77e6.sourceText: Margaret Weitekamp, a curator at the Smithsonian, once said that he was famous for inspirational and imaginative work that got “all of the technical details right.” The Kilgore Chapel windows reflect the depth of McCall’s faith and imagination, creating an experience for all parishioners that is truly out of this world.
902507e1a180d8fa7eafec3cc678782b337b77e6.translatedText: 史密森尼博物館館長瑪格麗特·韋特坎普 (Margaret Weitekamp) 曾表示，他以「所有技術細節都正確」的鼓舞人心和富有想像力的作品而聞名。基爾戈教堂的窗戶反映了麥考爾信仰和想像力的深度，為所有教友創造了真正超凡脫俗的體驗。

4f9feb2251d04160e023b365641d218b9cf58e49.sourceText: November 13, 2017customers at the Szechwan Palace Restaurant, located at the Chinese Cultural Center and Garden, were evacuated last night shortly after 9:00 PM when a suspicious item was found outside the restaurant”s entrance. Police taped off the Center and temporarily closed it while they investigated what turned out to be two oxygen tanks and medical-style masks left on the sidewalk about fifty feet from the restaurant entrance. The bomb squad was called to investigate and the Center was eventually reopened after the ”all clear” sign was given about 10:45 PM.
4f9feb2251d04160e023b365641d218b9cf58e49.translatedText: 2017年11月13日位於華府後不久，在餐廳入口外發現了可疑物品。警方用膠帶封鎖了該中心並暫時關閉了該中心，同時調查了距離餐廳入口約 50 英尺的人行道上留下的兩個氧氣瓶和醫用口罩。拆彈小組被叫來進行調查，並在晚上 10:45 左右發出“解除警報”標誌後，該中心最終重新開放。

6f5f4cf1ab82c77caf8d79ec1dc6b73a99d06f29.sourceText: ”True North has made unverified claims of criminal activity at the Center to support their aggressive fencing of the property. They have, however, failed to cite any police reports to support those claims,” said Thomas Simon, Spokesman for Szechwan Palace Restaurant. ”By making public statements about alleged criminal activity, without any proof, to score points in a highly publicized court battle, True North creates an atmosphere which is extremely charged. Therefore, Szechwan Palace, out of abundance of caution, must do the responsible thing and call authorities whenever there is a possibility of risk to its staff or patrons,” Simon added.
6f5f4cf1ab82c77caf8d79ec1dc6b73a99d06f29.translatedText: 「True North 聲稱存在未經證實的犯罪活動中心支持他們對財產的侵略性圍欄。然而，他們沒有引用任何警方報告來支持這些說法，」四川皇宮餐廳發言人托馬斯·西蒙(Thomas Simon)表示。 「透過在沒有任何證據的情況下就涉嫌犯罪活動發表公開聲明，在一場廣為人知的法庭鬥爭中得分，『真北』營造了一種極其緊張的氣氛。因此，出於高度的謹慎，四川皇宮必須採取負責任的行動，並在其工作人員或顧客可能面臨危險時致電當局。」西蒙補充道。

28147bdd627fb7a4c066009145cc8a618b91d250.sourceText: As the Chinese Cultural Center continues to be open for business daily, we remind True North and COFCO management of their fiduciary duties to both the Master Association and the Condominium Association.
28147bdd627fb7a4c066009145cc8a618b91d250.translatedText: 隨著中國文化中心繼續每天營業，我們提醒真北和中糧管理層注意他們對大師協會和公寓協會的信託責任。

ee19e3ffe6f558116310e31665417627d1297d05.sourceText: Though safety and security should be their primary concern, they have launched a campaign to make it appear that the Center has closed. They have had to be repeatedly reminded to turn the parking lights on after dark. The premature announcement on Google and Yelp that the Center is ”permanently closed,” along with the aggressive fencing, lining up of large unlocked dumpsters in the front of the Center, the eviction of the anchor store and the removal of signage from the property all add to their narrative that we are not open for business.
ee19e3ffe6f558116310e31665417627d1297d05.translatedText: 雖然安全和安保應該是他們的首要考慮，但他們發起了一場運動，讓中心看起來像是已經關閉。必須反覆提醒他們在天黑後打開停車燈。在 Google 和 Yelp 上過早宣布該中心“永久關閉”，加上咄咄逼人的圍欄、中心前排成一排未上鎖的大型垃圾箱、驅逐主力商店以及拆除該物業的標牌，所有這些都加劇了他們的說法，即我們不開門營業。

919268b223075c5768b279399af8edaa125f376c.sourceText: The Chinese Cultural Center has been a safe-haven in Phoenix for the last twenty years. This mismanagement hurts business, attracts vagrants and homeless to the area, and can only lead to more situations like last night where we have to interrupt our daily lives to maintain safety and security, compromised by a partial owner of the property who attempts to float the narrative that the Center is closed and unsafe.
919268b223075c5768b279399af8edaa125f376c.translatedText: 在過去的二十年裡，中國文化中心一直是鳳凰城的避風港。這種管理不善損害了生意，吸引了流浪者和無家可歸者來到該地區，只會導致更多像昨晚這樣的情況，我們不得不中斷日常生活以維持安全和安保，而財產的部分業主試圖散佈中心已關閉且不安全的說法。

0d1d73e527751d36417fb27dc8199ed4c1220669.sourceText: Szechwan Palace Restaurant reminds the community that the Chinese Cultural Center is open for business. As owner of the property itself, the Restaurant will maintain a safe, secure and customer friendly environment for all its customers.
0d1d73e527751d36417fb27dc8199ed4c1220669.translatedText: 四川皇宮餐廳提醒社區，中國文化中心正在營業。作為酒店本身的所有者，餐廳將為所有顧客維持一個安全、可靠和顧客友善的環境。

bfd7998cd855f7f23a686c6e48a95488004c2549.sourceText: A historic Boeing B-17 Flying Fortress, a centerpiece of U.S. air power during World War II, flew into Phoenix Deer Valley Airport on Monday.
bfd7998cd855f7f23a686c6e48a95488004c2549.translatedText: 一架歷史悠久的波音 B-17 飛行，二戰期間美國鳳凰城空中力量的核心，於週一飛城機場。

050debfbee6668ad4135c282fdf0e1ebcfe6e951.sourceText: Phoenix was one of the last stops for the aircraft, nicknamed Madras Maiden, as part of a 50-stop tour across the United States sponsored by the the Oklahoma-based Liberty Foundation.
050debfbee6668ad4135c282fdf0e1ebcfe6e951.translatedText: 鳳凰城是最後一站之一這架綽號為「Madras Maiden」的飛機是俄克拉荷馬州自由基金會贊助的 50 站全美巡演的一部分。

55927a5cd42befe94e98ec8a1106dbd85b21bcb6.sourceText: Chief pilot Ray Fowler said the national tour, designed to give the public an up-close look at the classic airplane, began in mid-March. He said he never tires of flying a piece of history.
55927a5cd42befe94e98ec8a1106dbd85b21bcb6.translatedText: 首席飛行員雷·福勒 (Ray Fowler) 表示，這次全國巡演旨在讓公眾近距離觀看這架經典飛機，已於 3 月中旬開始。他說他從不厭倦飛行一段歷史。

f1ae5fbc641ec1bf686f4e11feabf673d994543b.sourceText: ”There’s nothing like getting in it and actually taking a flight and really learning the history that way with the airplane,” Fowler said. ”It’s an amazing piece of machinery and we all pretty much volunteer our time on the weekends to come out and to do this.”
f1ae5fbc641ec1bf686f4e11feabf673d994543b.translatedText: 「沒有什麼比坐上飛機、真正乘坐飛機並真正透過飛機了解歷史更好的了，」福勒說。 「這是一台令人驚嘆的機器，我們幾乎都自願在周末抽出時間來完成這項工作。」

2db5a48969f1bf92888a6438eca0777f603c81f6.sourceText: Fowler, a pilot for Delta and who also has flown F-16 fighter jets for the Air National Guard, noted the B-17s do not have pressurized cabins.
2db5a48969f1bf92888a6438eca0777f603c81f6.translatedText: 福勒是達美航空的一名飛行員，也曾為空軍國民警衛隊駕駛過 F-16 戰鬥機，他指出 B-17 沒有加壓艙。

3e732e5a13a0176555fdff63776d782120ec2eea.sourceText: He said that factor added to the worry for pilots on top of the dangers of the war itself during WWII.
3e732e5a13a0176555fdff63776d782120ec2eea.translatedText: 他說，除了危險之外，這一因素還增加了飛行員的擔憂第二次世界大戰期間的戰爭本身。

ff564f2c1f9987ddc948c3747ef222d5951b30f9.sourceText: There were 12,732 B-17s produced between 1935-45. Of those, 4,735 were lost in combat.
ff564f2c1f9987ddc948c3747ef222d5951b30f9.translatedText: 1935-45 年間生產了 12,732 架 B-17。其中，4,735 人在戰鬥中喪生。

c158fe896cc6afddd299753955b4b8a41a8fbf28.sourceText: The aircraft was not built for luxury, as soldiers were crammed into tight spaces packed with 50-caliber guns, bombs and heavy machinery.
c158fe896cc6afddd299753955b4b8a41a8fbf28.translatedText: 這架飛機並不是為了豪華而製造的，因為士兵們擠在裝滿 50 口徑槍支、炸彈和重型機械的狹小空間裡。

9b581613c720cff04bc1d57e84ea14ffcb0bc807.sourceText: ”It’s such an honor and a privilege to fly this aircraft,” said Jim Lawrence, the Madras Maiden’s co-pilot.
9b581613c720cff04bc1d57e84ea14ffcb0bc807.translatedText: 「駕駛這架飛機真是一種榮幸，」馬德拉斯少女號的副駕駛吉姆勞倫斯 (Jim Lawrence) 說。

7ef3be4e2141b590d3e81eebcaa88371b94bf8b9.sourceText: ”I’ve flown a lot of combat but nothing like what the guys who flew this airplane did.”
7ef3be4e2141b590d3e81eebcaa88371b94bf8b9.translatedText: 「我參加過很多次戰鬥，但與駕駛這架飛機的人相比，沒有什麼比這更好的了。」

4f091e52d4b230b02407742d4fdf991fc5bafb83.sourceText: Lawrence, 71, served in the military as a fighter pilot deploying to Vietnam, Bosnia, Iraq and Afghanistan.
4f091e52d4b230b02407742d4fdf991fc5bafb83.translatedText: 勞倫斯，71 歲，曾在軍隊中擔任戰鬥機飛行員，部署到越南、波斯尼亞、伊拉克和阿富汗。

c9a92ad5309d4f138ae0d3825cf50f8556345a8a.sourceText: For Lawrence, the opportunity to fly this plane was amazing, but the history behind it was something even more significant.
c9a92ad5309d4f138ae0d3825cf50f8556345a8a.translatedText: 對勞倫斯來說，駕駛這架飛機的機會是驚人的，但它背後的歷史更為重要。

a2fc759c10d0be546e8a9d55c85a48b3a3c497e4.sourceText: The Flying Fortress is owned by the Liberty Foundation and is one of only 12 B-17s that are still flying, according to the organization.
a2fc759c10d0be546e8a9d55c85a48b3a3c497e4.translatedText: 飛行堡壘由自由基金會擁有，據該組織稱，它是僅有的 12 架仍在飛行的 B-17 飛機之一。

2288eec1a1c77d2cb1d104612c50766f666aa236.sourceText: The Madras Maiden was built toward the end of World War II and never saw combat in that war.
2288eec1a1c77d2cb1d104612c50766f666aa236.translatedText: 馬德拉斯少女號是在第二次世界大戰即將結束時建造的，從未見過

5bd0d877b786bc90edba8d3e5ea077b502ec5e0f.sourceText: From 1944-1959, it was a research and development aircraft that was equipped to be a ”Pathfinder” airplane. Inside, it was outfitted with an H2X ”Mickey” radar system and is the only Pathfinder aircraft left in existence, according to Liberty.
5bd0d877b786bc90edba8d3e5ea077b502ec5e0f.translatedText: 從1944年到1959年，這是一架研發飛機，裝備為「探路者」飛機。根據《自由報》報道，它的內部配備了 H2X「米奇」雷達系統，是現存唯一的探路者飛機。

8cdf55c366ba90ebed4fd24c497f93be0b518e2e.sourceText: The B-17 has undergone many jobs through the years including a cargo transport hauling produce, a fire ant sprayer with the U.S. Department of Agriculture and as an exhibit for three aviation museums.
8cdf55c366ba90ebed4fd24c497f93be0b518e2e.translatedText: B-17 多年來經歷了許多工作，包括運輸農產品的貨物運輸、美國農業部的火蟻噴霧器以及作為三個航空博物館的展覽。

ad77416418f501b0374eebac83817e48ea58ff17.sourceText: Phoenix-area residents can tour the Madras Maiden on Nov. 4-5 at the Deer Valley Airport, Cutter Aviation Hangar, 732 W. Deer Valley Road. The aircraft usually takes flight between 10 a.m. and 3 p.m., then is available for the tours after the last flight.
ad77416418f501b0374eebac83817e48ea58ff17.translatedText: 菲尼克斯地區的居民可以11 月 4 日至 5 日在鹿谷機場 Cutter Aviation 機庫（地址：732 W. Deer Valley Road）參觀馬德拉斯少女號。飛機通常在上午 10 點至下午 3 點之間起飛，最後一班航班後即可提供旅遊服務。

2e5ede79af53dfc5d1c7830ad371e85724480447.sourceText: The cost to take a flight is $450 for non-members of the Liberty Foundation. Members pay $410. Donations are accepted during tours.
2e5ede79af53dfc5d1c7830ad371e85724480447.translatedText: 非自由基金會會員的搭乘航班費用為 450 美元。會員支付 410 美元。參觀期間接受捐款。

53ed49aca930fed2a80d760db07b0fa82095839c.sourceText: Money collected from the event goes to preserving the airplane and continuing to display it across the country for airplane enthusiasts.
53ed49aca930fed2a80d760db07b0fa82095839c.translatedText: 從活動中收集到的資金將用於保護飛機並繼續在全國各地為飛機愛好者展示它。

9f898d80f33854f2e465bdfde269a54ac4d4c015.sourceText: ”We don’t keep it flying, you do,” Fowler said. ”The only way we survive is the public knows we’re out here.”
9f898d80f33854f2e465bdfde269a54ac4d4c015.translatedText: 「我們不讓它繼續飛行，而是你，」福勒說。 「我們生存的唯一方法是讓公眾知道我們在這裡。」

4030ea6a7736b202e84838218931922f5fd171bf.sourceText: For more information, call 918-340-0243 or visit the web site at libertyfoundation.org.
4030ea6a7736b202e84838218931922f5fd171bf.translatedText: 如需了解更多信息，請致電 918-340-0243 或訪問網站 libertyfoundation.org。

Kevin Brady (R-TX) (L) and House Majority Whip Rep Steve Scalise (R-LA) (R) listen during a news President Trump promised to cut taxes for the middle class, but some would end up paying more under the ”Tax Cuts and Jobs Act,” according to a report released Friday night by Congress’s Joint Committee on Taxation, the official scorekeepers tasked with determining how much any tax legislation would add to the debt and how it would impact the poor, middle class and wealthy.
9d792bb2ed9e52cc99a297c5508cff4b90fed897.translatedText: 繳納更高的稅金？ Alex Wong／Getty Images美國眾議院議長保羅·瑞安（R-WI）（中）以眾議院籌款委員會主席、眾議員凱文·布雷迪（R-TX）（左）和眾議院多數黨鞭代表身份發言史蒂夫·斯卡利斯（R-LA）（右）在聽新聞時，特朗普總統承諾為中產階級等級減稅，但根據國會稅務聯合委員會週五晚上發布的一份報告，有些人最終會根據《減稅和就業法案》支付更多費用，該委員會的官方記分員負責確定任何稅收立法將增加多少債務，以及它將如何影響窮人、中產階級和富人。

7ca28ce8a7f52b84fcff052c8d077b3e3e2ec89c.sourceText: The Trump administration says it has a ”bright line test”that the president won’t support any tax bill that does not give the middle class relief on their taxes. The ”Tax Cuts And Jobs Act”that House Republicans released Thursday appears to violate that vow, at least for some middle-class taxpayers.
7ca28ce8a7f52b84fcff052c8d077b3e3e2ec89c.translatedText: 川普政府表示，它有一個「明線測試」表明，總統不會支持任何不給予中產階級減稅的稅收法案。眾議院共和黨週四發布的《減稅和就業法案》似乎違反了這項誓言，至少對一些中產階級納稅人來說是如此。

1e664c50b0faaf1855ef3d2713bb3a9cd0a02f5d.sourceText: The JCT found that the GOP bill would add nearly $1.5 trillion to the debt over the next decade and that, on average, families earning between $20,000 and $40,000 a year and between $200,000 to $500,000 would pay more in individual income taxes in 2023 and beyond.
1e664c50b0faaf1855ef3d2713bb3a9cd0a02f5d.translatedText: JCT 發現，共和黨法案將在未來十年增加近 1.5 兆美元的債務，平均而言，年收入在 20,000 至 40,000 美元之間的家庭以及年收入在 200,000 至 500,0000 美元之間的家庭以及年收入在 200,000 至 500,0000 美元之間的家庭債務將增加 1.5 億美元的債務。 2023 年及以後繳納更多個人所得稅。

ee1f4410ea453a7a0430872eb9958c1961c5a311.sourceText: Subscribe to the Post Most newsletter: Today most popular stories on The Washington Post
ee1f4410ea453a7a0430872eb9958c1961c5a311.translatedText: 訂閱該貼文 最時事通訊：今日《華盛頓郵報》上最受歡迎的故事

a42a1ae150ffb396a357c427eb3a8dad6ce5ab3d.sourceText: JCT does not explain why these families see an increase, but it is likely that it’s in part because some tax credits aimed at helping the middle class expire in 2023, including the Family Flexibility Credit. Republicans are currently debating whether to extend this credit, but that would require revenue from somewhere else. Some are banking on Congress not allowing the credit to expire when the time comes. Upper middle-class families are also losing popular tax breaks like the state and local income tax (SALT) deduction, which may explain why they get higher tax bills.
a42a1ae150ffb396a357c427eb3a8dad6ce5ab3d.translatedText: JCT 並沒有解釋為什麼這些家庭會出現成長，但很可能部分是因為一些旨在幫助中產階級的稅收抵免將於 2023 年到期，其中包括家庭彈性信貸。共和黨人目前正在討論是否延長這項信貸，但這需要從其他地方獲得收入。有些人指望國會不會允許信貸在時機成熟時到期。中上階層家庭也失去了州和地​​方所得稅 (SALT) 減免等受歡迎的稅收減免，這也許可以解釋為什麼他們的稅單會更高。

9daea8bff9a4e0ab9ea66186b9d4f8093e518acc.sourceText: It’s possible that other families will also see their tax bills jump under the plan. JCT only reports what happens to the average taxpayer in each income bracket. Experts across the political spectrum, including the Tax Policy Center, plan to release more detailed reports in the coming days showing what happens to large and small families, rich and poor, and those that claim big medical deductions under the GOP plan.
9daea8bff9a4e0ab9ea66186b9d4f8093e518acc.translatedText: 其他家庭也可能會看到他們的稅單在該計劃下大幅上漲。 JCT 僅報告每個收入階層的普通納稅人的情況。包括稅務政策中心在內的各個政治領域的專家計劃在未來幾天發布更詳細的報告，顯示大小家庭、富人和窮人以及那些根據共和黨計劃要求大額醫療扣除的人會發生什麼。

e790c7a282b0dbbb704cc4220b08eb0dc878ae73.sourceText: House Republicans argue that the JCT analysis undercounts the benefits to the middle class.
e790c7a282b0dbbb704cc4220b08eb0dc878ae73.translatedText: 眾議院共和黨人認為 JCT 分析低估了中產階級的福利。

8ad072675fdb29e6ed9d9b88115d84fb12295156.sourceText: But Democratic tax experts say most of the benefits go to the richest Americans.
8ad072675fdb29e6ed9d9b88115d84fb12295156.translatedText: 但民主黨稅務專家表示，大部分福利都流向了最富有的美國人。

0e36d99723e58f3a2387bc44fa381a8be07861ee.sourceText: ”JCT estimates show that this bill is heavily tilted toward the wealthy,”says Lily Batchelder, a tax law professor at New York University and former member of President Obama’s National Economic Council.
0e36d99723e58f3a2387bc44fa381a8be07861ee.translatedText: 「JCT 的估計表明，這項法案嚴重向富人傾斜，」紐約大學稅法教授、奧巴馬總統國家經濟委員會前成員莉莉·巴切爾德 (Lily Batchelder) 表示。

95071ee241a321e0da2d058797a7f9703ba26a06.sourceText: Batchhelder used the JCT analysis to look at who gets the biggest income boost from the GOP plan. She found that millionaires would see their after-tax incomes rise by 2.2 percent after a decade, and that is without factoring in how wealthy families benefit for the elimination of the estate tax. Families earning $50,000 to $70,000?the middle of the middle?would see only a 0.6 percent rise, and families earning $20,000 to $40,000 get no benefit.
95071ee241a321e0da2d058797a7f9703ba26a06.translatedText: Batchhelder 使用 JCT 分析來了解誰從共和黨計劃中獲得了最大的收入成長。她發現，十年後百萬富翁的稅後收入將增加 2.2%，而且這還不包括富裕家庭因取消遺產稅而受益的情況。收入在 50,000 美元到 70,000 美元（中間的中間）的家庭只會看到 0.6% 的增長，而收入在 20,000 美元到 40,000 美元的家庭則沒有任何好處。

8b8e96feae37b0301f8fa8f695903f1de13ce3ee.sourceText: Tucson, Arizona, is a city built on an orderly grid. Most of the North-South streets are named Avenues and the East-West ones are Streets. However, a quirky handful of outliers run diagonally and are called “Stravenues,” shortened on signage simply as Strav. or Stra.
8b8e96feae37b0301f8fa8f695903f1de13ce3ee.translatedText: 亞利桑那州圖森是一座建立在有序網格上的城市。大多數南北走向的街道被命名為 Avenues，東西向的街道被命名為 Streets。然而，有一些奇怪的異常點呈對角線延伸，被稱為“Stravenues”，在標誌上簡稱為“Strav”。或 Stra。

afbf7103f187d99677cf117ed0ac31e92fed009c.sourceText: Cherrybell Stravenue was the first of the lot. It’s a short half-mile stretch of asphalt that cuts across a square lot to connect with the Tucson central post office. Cherrybell dates to 1949, according to a reporter at the Tucson Daily Citizen who felt the momentousness of the newly named road warranted an entry into the historical record.
afbf7103f187d99677cf117ed0ac31e92fed009c.translatedText: Cherrybell Stravenue 是其中的第一條。這是一段半英里長的瀝青路，橫跨一塊正方形地段，與圖森中央郵局相連。 《圖森每日公民報》的一名記者表示，Cherrybell 的歷史可以追溯到 1949 年，他認為這條新命名的道路意義重大，值得載入歷史記錄。

962521916532cd47199b663464ff30f38ff47197.sourceText: The local Uniform Naming and Numbering Committee agreed that a combination of Street and Avenue was the best way to square the circle for the sake of consistency. It’s not clear whether they also considered the alternate names Aveneet or Aventreet.
962521916532cd47199b663464ff30f38ff47197.translatedText: 當地統一命名和編號委員會一致認為，為了保持一致性，將 Street 和 Avenue 組合起來是圓方的最佳方式。目前尚不清楚他們是否也考慮使用替代名稱 Aveneet 或 Aventreet。

19d62802ac7fde1cdcda0879ea2f18012ae2d09c.sourceText: Within a few months of the Cherrybell Stravenue decision, the floodgates were thrown open and fresh Stravenues began appearing across the city. Today there are about 30 Stravenues in Tucson, but none anywhere else.
19d62802ac7fde1cdcda0879ea2f18012ae2d09c.translatedText: 在 Cherrybell Stravenue 做出決定後的幾個月內，閘門被打開，新的 Stravenue 開始出現在整個城市。如今，圖森大約有 30 條 Stravenue，但其他地方都沒有。

02aafe0ada268b7c98f9a64354db39b8f638a8cc.sourceText: CHINESE AMERICAN COMMUNITY RESPONDS TO DEVELOPER ”To Relocate is Demolition…To Relocate is Discrimination” Phoenix, AZ September 10, 2017: Tenants and the community at the Phoenix Chinese Cultural Center on 44 th Street near Van Buren are responding to the half-truths and misconceptions put out by the new owners of the property where the Chinese Cultural Center and Garden are located. The Phoenix City Council is slated to consider a Citizen Petition Related to the Chinese Cultural Center on Tuesday, September 12, 2017 at 2:30 PM. In an attempt to distort the true nature of their actions, True North Companies (The New Owner) put out a press release filled with untruths that are at best less than factual and are designed to portray them as the reasonable party, while all the while they have disrespected the historic and cultural nature of the Center and the people who love it. The Chinese United Association of Greater Phoenix (CUAGP) deeply regrets the Statement made by True North Companies which makes allegations and interpretations designed to deceive the press and the public. It is important that the record be accurately viewed as both Phoenix and the American people both understand fairness and deserve truth. We can 1. CLAIM OF TRUE NORTH COMPANIES: ”The Cultural Center, built in 1997, has significantly struggled for many years with numerous failed businesses and very low occupancy.” THE TRUTH: The Center enjoyed high occupancy, rents paid and prospering for many years after it opened in 1997. Only after senior management changed did the vibrancy of the Center change, as well. The new management began to treat the tenants with disdain and disrespect and this created an unwelcoming environment. As a result, tenants took their businesses elsewhere or simply closed altogether. The original anchor supermarket was sold and the new store management operated without issue until it was evicted by True North Companies within the last month. The Market was never late with rent payments and indeed spent many thousands of dollars to improve the property, including a substantial investment in air conditioning. The largest Chinese restaurant in the Center was similarly locked out and denied an opportunity to serve thousands of devoted patrons. CLAIM ONE FACT CHECK OF TRUE NORTH’s PRESS RELEASE: 5 Pinocchio’s 2. CLAIM OF TRUE NORTH COMPANIES: The Chinese American community ”abandoned” the Center. THE TRUTH: The Chinese American community never ”abandoned” the Center; moreover there remain several Chinese-related businesses on site and operating today–it is inaccurate and self-serving for the owner to describe the property as permanently closed. Proof of the support amongst the Chinese American community for this historic and culturally important property can be seen on TV newscasts and newspaper articles and social-media outlets worldwide. It is ridiculous and insulting for this venture capitalist to accuse us of abandoning our Center. Time will tell the story of a community that intends to support their history and culture at all cost. CLAIM TWO FACT CHECK OF TRUE NORTH’s PRESS RELEASE: 5 Pinocchio’s 3. CLAIM OF TRUE NORTH COMPANIES: That the Chinese Community had considered their ”Offers”and had failed to agree to them. THE TRUTH: Negotiations between the local Chinese American community had barely begun before the September 6, press release; all the ”Offers”therein are entirely newly devised and do not represent any items previously discussed. It should be noted that all the items listed as ”Offers”were first seen by us in the press release and therefore are news to all of us. The Chinese American community is still hoping for a win-win-win solution to this important problem. We sit ready to discuss viable options. CLAIM THREE FACT CHECK OF TRUE NORTH’s PRESS RELEASE: 5 Pinocchio’s 4. CLAIM OF TRUE NORTH COMPANIES THAT MOVING THE CHINESE CULTURAL CENTER AND GARDEN TO ANOTHER LOCATION WOULD BE A VIABLE SOLUTION. THE TRUTH: Relocation is Demolition…Relocation is Discrimination. The United Nations has listed the craftsmanship used in the building of the Phoenix Chinese Cultural Center as an Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity. Several of the pavilions inside the Garden have also been designated by the United Nations as Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity due to being exact replicas of ancient Chinese buildings. The craftsmanship used to design and install the roof tiles and wood timber is of ancient origin. These pieces can’t be simply deconstructed like some modern-day Legos set. To take them apart and move them would destroy them, therefore relocation is demolition. It just is not realistic or feasible to expect that such intricate design and workmanship can be moved about at a whim. To suggest so is both naive and disrespectful at the same time. Also, to suggest that the Garden can be protected but the rest of the property and/or its Chinese relationship can be removed and relocated elsewhere is like a doctor saying we had to amputate your feet and hands but you are still whole. The Garden and the rest of the property were designed as one, the yin and yang make one, but separated neither can be whole. They are inseparable and to think otherwise is fantasy. Relocation is Discrimination: True North provides relocation to a Phoenix park area as a solution to this problem of historic nature. To even suggest that the answer here is for the Chinese American community to simply move closer to the City is discriminatory in the most obvious of ways. Big Business telling the immigrant community to move to the other side of town is as if to say ”we’re got a place appropriate for you,” and, ”so sorry, but you don’t belong here.” The Chinese American community rejects this whistle call of discrimination by True North Companies and calls on all good and fair-minded individuals to do so as well. CLAIM FOUR FACT CHECK OF TRUE NORTH’s PRESS RELEASE: 5 Pinocchio’s OFFER TO PURCHASE: The Asian American community believes that preserving the Phoenix Chinese Cultural Center and Garden is so important to this generation and generations to come that we have offered to purchase the property from True North Companies, allowing them to make a reasonable profit. We are a reasonable people, a people that respects culture and history…a people willing to look for a win win solution to problems, but also a people willing to battle if necessary. This is a fight between Big Business and History and Culture. We are fighting for every Phoenician and every American who believes that where we come from is an indication of where we are heading and therefore history and culture and how we treat it is a determining factor in where our future and that of our children ends up. Contact: Phil Gordon, philgordon10@gmail.com; T.Simon(480)758-2863;thomassimon124@gmail.com
02aafe0ada268b7c98f9a64354db39b8f638a8cc.translatedText: 美國華人社區回應開發商「搬遷就是拆除…搬遷就是歧視」 亞利桑那州鳳凰城 2017 年 9 月 10 日：範布倫附近 44 街的鳳凰城中國文化中心的租戶和社區正在回應中國文化中心和花園所在房產的新業主提出的半真半假和誤解。鳳凰城議會定於 2017 年 9 月 12 日星期二下午 2:30 審議與中國文化中心相關的公民請願書。為了歪曲其行為的真實本質，真北公司（新東家）發布了一份充滿謊言的新聞稿，這些謊言至多不符合事實，旨在將他們描繪成理性的一方，同時他們一直不尊重該中心的歷史和文化性質以及熱愛該中心的人們。大鳳凰城華人聯合會（CUAGP）對真北公司發表的旨在欺騙新聞界和公眾的指控和解釋的聲明深感遺憾。重要的是，要準確地看待這項記錄，因為鳳凰城和美國人民都理解公平並應該得到真相。我們可以 1. 真正的北方公司聲稱：「文化中心建於 1997 年，多年來一直在苦苦掙扎，許多企業倒閉，入住率極低。」真相：自1997年開業以來，該中心多年來出租率高、租金高、生意興隆。直到高層更換後，中心的活力才改變了。新管理層開始蔑視和不尊重租戶，這造成了一個不受歡迎的環境。結果，租戶將業務轉移到其他地方，或乾脆完全關閉。原來的主力超市被賣掉，新店的管理運作沒有問題，直到上個月被 True North 公司驅逐。市場從不遲付租金，並且確實花費了數千美元來改善房產，包括對空調的大量投資。中心最大的中餐館同樣被鎖在門外，無法為數千名忠實顧客提供服務。聲稱真實北方新聞稿的一項事實查核：5 匹諾曹 2. 真實北方公司的聲明：華裔美國人社區「放棄」了該中心。真相：華裔美國人社區從未「放棄」該中心；此外，現場還保留著幾家與中國相關的企業，並且至今仍在營業——業主將房產永久關閉的描述是不准確和自私的。在世界各地的電視新聞廣播、報紙文章和社交媒體上可以看到美國華裔社區對這一具有重要歷史和文化意義的遺產的支持。這位創投家指責我們放棄我們的中心，這是荒謬和侮辱的。時間會講述一個不惜一切代價支持其歷史和文化的社區的故事。聲稱對真北新聞稿的兩項事實核查：5 匹諾曹的聲明 3. 真北公司的聲明：華人社區已考慮過他們的“提議”，但未能同意。真相：在 9 月 6 日的新聞稿發布之前，當地華裔社區之間的談判才剛開始；其中所有「優惠」都是全新設計的，並不代表之前討論過的任何項目。應該指出的是，所有列為「優惠」的項目都是我們在新聞稿中首次看到的，因此對我們所有人來說都是新聞。美國華人社區仍希望能夠以雙贏的方式解決這個重要問題。我們準備好討論可行的選擇。聲稱對真北新聞稿的三個事實查核：5 《匹諾曹》4。真北公司聲稱將中華文化中心和花園移至另一個地點將是可行的解決方案。真相：搬遷就是拆除……搬遷就是歧視。聯合國已將鳳凰城中國文化中心建築技藝列為人類非物質文化遺產。園內的多個涼亭也因精確複製中國古代建築而被聯合國指定為人類非物質文化遺產。用於設計和安裝屋頂瓦片和木材的工藝具有古老的起源。這些作品不能像現代的樂高積木一樣被簡單地解構。把它們拆開、搬遷就會毀掉它們，所以搬遷就是拆遷。指望如此複雜的設計和工藝可以隨心所欲地移動是不切實際或不可行的。提出這樣的建議既幼稚又不尊重。另外，建議花園可以受到保護，但其餘財產和/或其與中國的關係可以被移除並搬遷到其他地方，就像醫生說我們必須截掉你的腳和手，但你仍然是完整的。花園和其他財產被設計為一個整體，陰陽合一，但分開都不能成為整體。它們是密不可分的，否則就是幻想。搬遷就是歧視：True North 提供搬遷到鳳凰城公園區的服務，作為解決這個歷史性問題的方案。甚至暗示這裡的答案是讓華裔美國人社區簡單地向金融城靠攏，這在最明顯的方面都是歧視。大企業告訴移民社區搬到城鎮的另一邊，就好像在說“我們有一個適合你的地方”，並且“很抱歉，但你不屬於這裡”。美國華裔社區拒絕接受True North公司的這種歧視行為，並呼籲所有善良和公正的個人也這樣做。聲稱對真北新聞稿的四項事實核查：5 匹諾曹的購買要約：亞裔美國人社區認為，保護鳳凰城中國文化中心和花園對這一代和子孫後代非常重要，因此我們提出從真北公司購買該房產，使他們能夠獲得合理的利潤。我們是一個理性的民族，一個尊重文化和歷史的民族……一個願意尋求雙贏解決問題的民族，但也是一個願意在必要時戰鬥的民族。這是大企業與歷史文化之間的鬥爭。我們正在為每一個腓尼基人和每一個美國人而戰，他們相信我們來自哪裡，就表明我們要去哪裡，因此歷史和文化以及我們如何對待它是我們和我們孩子的未來的決定性因素。聯絡方式：菲爾·戈登，philgordon10@gmail.com； T.西蒙(480)758-2863;thomassimon124@gmail.com

941bf7e78518091d3672814eefade398df3e56cc.sourceText: Asian American Community Meeting a Great Success STATEMENT BY RAYMOND TANG, PRESIDENT CHINESE UNITED ASSOCIATION OF GREATER PHOENIX On July 21, 2017, Arizona State Senate Majority Leader Kimberly Yee hosted a meeting with Asian American community leaders and members to moderate a discussion about a public health proposal. Chinese United Association of Greater Phoenix (CUAGP) was present with officers and advisers as participants in this meeting. A Senate Concurrent Resolution 1012 (SCR 1012) was suggested by the Asian Pacific Community in Action (APCA) non-profit organization through its Executive Director Mr. Lloyd Asato. APCA has provided vital community services for health and medical assistance for nearly 20 years locally to the Asian population in Arizona. SCR 1012 was a resolution with no specified requirements to express in a formal manner the view that health services would be improved with more information on the diverse Asian American and Pacific Islander communities served by APCA. While SCR 1012 was never adopted in the House of Representatives and did not move through the entire legislative process, it was formally adopted with consensus by the Arizona Senate. Senator Yee provided background at the meeting about the resolution that was brought to her office at the request of APCA which advocates for improved Asian American health needs. She said she recommended the issue be addressed as a resolution versus a bill to communicate the public health issue that was brought to her attention and that she has no plans to re-introduce the proposal or anything similar to it in the next session of the Arizona Legislature in January of 2018. Senator Yee suggested that APCA should consult with the community in the future if it believed any similar measure might be helpful to the population it serves. APCA representatives in attendance at the meeting agreed that such community meetings would take place going forward. Community members and leaders expressed their great satisfaction with these clarifications and the Senator extended hospitality to all present to visit and tour the Legislature whenever convenient. The meeting was a great success to open up dialogue between the various Asian American community organizations brought together by Senate Majority Leader Kimberly Yee. CUAGP is an umbrella organization that has been since 1968 coordinating now 19 non-profit service clubs that promote the cultural heritage, the educational benefit, and rights/welfare of the local Chinese American community. It has membership composed of Chinese Americans of all origins?U.S.-born, as well as new immigrants from mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong and world-wide. Of course it has many members from the older established mainland immigrants from the Four Counties of Guangdong Province. CUAGP always promotes the benefit and future of all in every way possible; and we always act and oppose any steps from any direction which would be detrimental to our community interests.
941bf7e78518091d3672814eefade398df3e56cc.translatedText: 亞裔美國人社區會議取得巨大成功 大菲尼克斯中華聯合會會長唐雷蒙致辭 2017 年 7 月 21 日，亞利桑那州參議院多數黨領袖金佰利 (Kimberly Yee) 主持了與亞裔美國社區領導人和成員的會議，主持了有關公共衛生提案的討論。大鳳凰城華人聯合會（CUAGP）的官員和顧問出席了本次會議。亞太行動共同體 (APCA) 非營利組織透過其執行董事 Lloyd Asato 先生建議通過參議院第 1012 號並發決議 (SCR 1012)。近 20 年來，APCA 一直為亞利桑那州的亞裔居民提供重要的健康和醫療援助社區服務。 SCR 1012 是一項決議，沒有具體要求以正式方式表達這樣的觀點：透過更多有關 APCA 服務的多元化亞裔美國人和太平洋島民社區的信息，可以改善衛生服務。雖然 SCR 1012 從未在眾議院獲得通過，也沒有完成整個立法程序，但它已被亞利桑那州參議院以協商一致方式正式通過。易參議員在會議上介紹了應 APCA 要求提交給她辦公室的決議的背景，該協會主張改善亞裔美國人的健康需求。她說，她建議將該問題作為決議而不是法案來解決，以傳達引起她注意的公共衛生問題，並且她不打算在 2018 年 1 月的亞利桑那州立法機構下一次會議上重新提出該提案或任何類似的內容。 Yee 參議員建議，如果 APCA 認為任何類似措施可能對其所服務的人口有所幫助，則將來應與社區協商。出席會議的 APCA 代表同意今後將繼續舉行此類社區會議。社區成員和領導人對這些澄清表示非常滿意，參議員熱情歡迎所有出席者在方便的時候參觀和參觀立法機關。這次會議非常成功，開啟了由參議院多數黨領袖金伯利·易召集的各個亞裔美國人社區組織之間的對話。 CUAGP 是一個傘式組織，自 1968 年以來一直在協調 19 個非營利服務俱樂部，以促進當地華裔美國社區的文化遺產、教育效益和權利/福利。它的成員包括出生在美國的各種血統的華裔美國人，以及來自中國大陸、台灣、香港和世界各地的新移民。當然，它有很多成員是來自廣東省四縣的老牌大陸移民。 CUAGP始終以各種可能的方式促進所有人的利益和未來；我們始終採取行動並反對任何有損我們社區利益的行為。

8941bb3be09f18172a5834c52eb9b81ca9f41b48.sourceText: Grouping health data for all Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders, as is currently done, can hide real differences between sub-groups. For example, there are substantial differences in the incidences of diabetes. When all the data is combined, it hides high rates of diabetes in Filipino, Indian and Samoan communities. If communities and their health providers do not know about these high rates, patients may continue to be left unaware and potentially suffer from preventable medical complications from their condition. No community wants to see an increase in declining health and death rates.
8941bb3be09f18172a5834c52eb9b81ca9f41b48.translatedText: 正如目前所做的那樣，對所有亞裔美國人和太平洋島民的健康數據進行分組可能會隱藏亞組之間的真正差異。例如，糖尿病的發生率有顯著差異。當所有數據結合起來時，它隱藏了菲律賓、印度和薩摩亞社區的高糖尿病發病率。如果社區及其醫療服務提供者不知道這些高發病率，患者可能會繼續不知情，並可能因病情而遭受可預防的醫療併發症。沒有社區希望看到健康狀況和死亡率不斷下降。

87e09fb7126e32521c2009adc4d5e625700854a4.sourceText: This SCR made a recommendation to study this issue and there were no requirements. I have a longstanding record for advocating for data privacy and have sponsored and passed bills to enhance the privacy of personal data. This SCR served to bring to light an important public health message as it affects our Asian community. No action would be taken going forward that would not consider required state and federal health and privacy laws.
87e09fb7126e32521c2009adc4d5e625700854a4.translatedText: 此 SCR 提出了研究此問題的建議，但沒有任何要求。我長期以來一直倡導資料隱私，並發起並通過了增強個人資料隱私的法案。該 SCR 揭示了影響我們亞洲社區的重要公共衛生訊息。今後不會採取任何不考慮所需的州和聯邦健康和隱私法的行動。

53972d61babb705573892ad0f4d4c02d9e8b44db.sourceText: For the second time, two international parks renewed their sister parks agreement strengthening outdoors ties between two ideologically-divided countries. The United States and China initially signed a sister park agreement between Grand Canyon National Park and Yuntaishan World Geopark on November 1, 2007. This year, they renewed their five-year agreement at a ceremony held at the Grand Canyon.
53972d61babb705573892ad0f4d4c02d9e8b44db.translatedText: 兩個國際公園第二次續簽姊妹公園協議，加強了兩個意識形態分裂國家之間的戶外連結。美國和中國最初於2007年11月1日簽署了大峽谷國家公園和雲台山世界地質公園之間的姊妹公園協議。今年，雙方在大峽谷舉行的儀式上續簽了五年的協議。

d930e7ffd973747d457f7d9eb0e873c1aa821194.sourceText: The Grand Canyon National Park, located in Arizona, and Yuntaishan World Geopark, located at Jiaozuo City in the Henan Province of east-central China, share similar landscapes which make them ideal for sisterhood. The parks have:

e06fc9eefcf6a7fca83625c19694c390bf572b7c.sourceText: (Phoenix, Arizona) Arizona Governor Doug Ducey has proclaimed May 2017 as ‘Asian/Pacific American Heritage Month.’ This annual May recognition was first established by an act of Congress in 1990 to celebrate and pay tribute to the contributions that generations of Asian/Pacific Americans have made to American history, society and culture. This month, the state of Arizona recognizes and honors the significant contributions made by Asian Americans, Native Hawaiians and Pacific Islanders in many fields of endeavor including entrepreneurship and business, science and technology, health care and medicine, military service, agriculture, education, the arts, law and public service which has benefitted the state and nation.
e06fc9eefcf6a7fca83625c19694c390bf572b7c.translatedText: （亞利桑那州菲尼克斯） 亞利桑那州州長道格·杜西 (Doug Ducey 20175 年 20175 年）宣布 20175 年 20175 年州長道格·杜西 (Doug D）月為「亞裔/太平洋裔美國人傳統月」。這項一年一度的 5 月表彰活動首次由國會於 1990 年通過一項法案設立，旨在慶祝並向幾代亞裔/太平洋裔美國人對美國歷史、社會和文化的貢獻表示敬意。本月，亞利桑那州表彰並表彰亞裔美國人、夏威夷原住民和太平洋島民在創業和商業、科學技術、醫療保健和醫學、軍事服務、農業、教育、藝術、法律和公共服務等許多領域做出的重大貢獻，這些貢獻使該州和國家受益。

17f4c6026dd70a0d7b0955d89c733e2d2d681f80.sourceText: Sam Huang’s election to the Chandler City Council could be viewed a number of ways.
17f4c6026dd70a0d7b0955d89c733e2d2d681f80.translatedText: Sam Huang 當選錢德勒市議員可以從多種角度來看。

f3f54648aebaaeca8448ee9de20e4454b0a1f325.sourceText: It could be seen as an example of perseverance. Huang ran for a council seat in 2012 and 2014, losing both times, only to try again in 2016. This time he was the second-highest vote-getter among eight candidates, winning a seat outright in the primary and avoiding a runoff election.
f3f54648aebaaeca8448ee9de20e4454b0a1f325.translatedText: 這可以被視為堅持不懈的例子。黃在2012年和2014年競選議會席位，兩次落敗，直到2016年再次嘗試。這一次，他在八名候選人中得票第二高，在初選中直接贏得一個席位，避免了決選。

48939d80567717da3567e1e76744aa1e1fc79aad.sourceText: It might also be seen as proof that having the most money doesn’t always matter. Campaign finance reports filed with the city showed that several candidates raised more than Huang. Among the top fundraisers, only incumbent Councilwoman Nora Ellen was elected outright in the primary.
48939d80567717da3567e1e76744aa1e1fc79aad.translatedText: 這也可能被視為擁有最多錢並不總是重要的證據。向市政府提交的競選財務報告顯示，幾位候選人籌集的資金超過了黃。在頂級籌款人中，只有現任女議員諾拉艾倫 (Nora Ellen) 在初選中徹底當選。

9d72d4ee462620871ed8d7df3ed737a276abac11.sourceText: It also can be seen as a message to the Valley’s Asian-American community, as well as other minority groups, that there is a place for them in local politics.
9d72d4ee462620871ed8d7df3ed737a276abac11.translatedText: 這也可以被視為向矽谷的亞裔美國人社區以及其他少數群體發出的信息，即他們在當地政治中佔有一席之地。

f15433ff28e793a5d447793541137be9593fc523.sourceText: For Huang, a native of Taiwan who came to the U.S. with his wife in the early 1990s, the latter message may be the most important.
f15433ff28e793a5d447793541137be9593fc523.translatedText: 對於 20 世紀 90 年代初與妻子一起來到美國的台灣人黃來說，後一個訊息可能是最重要的。

4892aec7b5b16fe428833cda810953985215e73a.sourceText: ‘I think it has great impact on them,’ Huang said. ‘The Asian-American community has a very low voter turnout … but if they see I can get elected, they have more reason to get involved.”
4892aec7b5b16fe428833cda810953985215e73a.translatedText: 「我認為這對他們影響很大，」黃說。 「亞裔美國人社區的選民投票率很低……但如果他們看到我能當選，他們就有更多理由參與其中。」

c8b3cec2fa0e5a42fea9690ed06136c499434d7e.sourceText: Huang, a retired school principal who is active in Asian-American organizations in the Phoenix area, said many Asian-Americans prioritize work and education in their households. Politics is a different matter, he said.
c8b3cec2fa0e5a42fea9690ed06136c499434d7e.translatedText: 活躍於鳳凰城地區亞裔美國人組織的退休校長黃說，許多亞裔美國人把工作和家庭教育放在首位。政治則是另一回事，他說。

dae4888eda96bddde6d135167ada3c13865c2c82.sourceText: ‘When the focus is on politics, they kind of retreat,” Huang said. ‘They become very silenced. They feel it’s not their thing. They feel it’s for other people to make the decisions.”
dae4888eda96bddde6d135167ada3c13865c2c82.translatedText: 黃說：「當焦點集中在政治上時，他們就會退縮。他們變得非常沉默。他們覺得這不是他們的事。他們覺得應該由其他人來做決定。」

67c4d84f5e0764a929f9fde340d836ff175043fa.sourceText: A 2015 report by Third Way, a nonpartisan policy organization based in Washington, D.C., identified similar challenges with low voter registration and turnout among Asian-Americans and Hispanics.
67c4d84f5e0764a929f9fde340d836ff175043fa.translatedText: 總部位於華盛頓特區的無黨派政策組織 Third Way 2015 年的選民報告和投票率還存在類似的投票率。亞裔美國人和西班牙裔美國人。

dd95b77d42634b77dda83cc0bd4a3425d57b32de.sourceText: Only 47 percent of Asian-Americans voted in the 2012 presidential election, compared with 48 percent of Hispanic voters, 66 percent of black voters and 64 percent of non-Hispanic white voters, according to the report.
dd95b77d42634b77dda83cc0bd4a3425d57b32de.translatedText: 根據該報告，只有 47% 的亞裔美國人在 2012 年總統選舉中投票，而西班牙裔選民的投票率為 48%，黑人選民為 66%，非西班牙裔白人選民為 64%。據報道，

68c4d72f4a7dea00ff082dc10108ef11dad8154b.sourceText: Fewer Asian-Americans (56 percent) were registered to vote than Hispanic voters (58 percent), blacks (73 percent) and non-Hispanic whites (73 percent), according to Third Way. The report concluded a higher proportion of foreign-born Asian-Americans ‘has contributed to less inclusion in the political system.”
68c4d72f4a7dea00ff082dc10108ef11dad8154b.translatedText: 登記投票的亞裔美國人 (56%) 少於西班牙裔美國人根據 Third Way 的數據，選民（58%）、黑人（73%）和非西班牙裔白人（73%）。報告的結論是，外國出生的亞裔美國人比例較高，「導致了政治體系的包容性下降。」

69c3392efa51a0f5d242d55643dca67778fd4e11.sourceText: The U.S. Asian-American population was estimated at 17 million in 2010, according to Third Way. In Chandler, about 9.4 percent of residents are identified as Asian-American, according to the most recent demographic information on the city’s website.
69c3392efa51a0f5d242d55643dca67778fd4e11.translatedText: 根據 Third Way 的數據，2010 年美國亞裔美國人人口估計為 1,700 萬。根據該市網站上的最新人口統計信息，在錢德勒，約 9.4% 的居民被認定為亞裔美國人。

dd7cb80cbc8f3319ef25be7f81dd5355638ffbf7.sourceText: Huang said his victory was the result of support from a variety of groups, including many Hispanic voters who also may feel disenfranchised.
dd7cb80cbc8f3319ef25be7f81dd5355638ffbf7.translatedText: 黃說，他的勝利是各種群體支持的結果，其中包括許多也可能感到自己被剝奪了選舉權的西班牙裔選民。

99f3e421a598eac036eb672896eae372148cce91.sourceText: ‘I think after my election, they may feel, ‘Oh, I’m also part of the United States. I’m an American,’ ‘ he said. ‘I think it’s important not only for Asian-Americans, but every American. You are part of this society. You’re part of this country so you should contribute your knowledge.”
99f3e421a598eac036eb672896eae372148cce91.translatedText: 「我認為在我當選後，他們可能會覺得，『哦，我也是美國的一部分。我是美國人，」他說。 「我認為這不僅對亞裔美國人很重要，而且對每個美國人都很重要。你是這個社會的一部分。你是這個國家的一部分，所以你應該貢獻你的知識。」

13a94bd6b60c5c0c521848829a586aa975579b8f.sourceText: Albert Lin, president of the Arizona Asian American Association, said Huang’s win will help the group in its effort to encourage more Asian-American participation in Valley elections.
13a94bd6b60c5c0c521848829a586aa975579b8f.translatedText: 亞裔美國人協會主席阿爾伯特·林表示，更多人將參與該地區選舉的美國亞裔美國人協會。

b2648c7cf4feed42939fe32d32fc53af2efd41fd.sourceText: ‘Politics in my opinion is public service and it should not be a dirty word,” Lin said. ‘Whether they are elected or not is secondary to me. The most important thing is participation.”
b2648c7cf4feed42939fe32d32fc53af2efd41fd.translatedText: 「在我看來，政治是公共服務，這不應該是一個骯髒的詞，」林說。 「他們是否當選對我來說是次要的。最重要的是參與。」

be79c8f63889c061d47b2f061cc2e19bfe942258.sourceText: Huang said he hopes that message extends to people of every ethnic background.
be79c8f63889c061d47b2f061cc2e19bfe942258.translatedText: 黃說，他希望這一訊息能夠傳播到各個種族背景的人們。

692bb49ac95bc9127e88a0dfae551996d66aed0f.sourceText: ‘I was not able to win with just Asian votes, no way,’Huang said. ‘There were a lot of Caucasian and Hispanic residents who voted for me. We all get together now. We’re different Americans, but we’re one America.’
692bb49ac95bc9127e88a0dfae551996d66aed0f.translatedText: 「我不可能只靠亞裔選票獲勝，這是不可能的，」黃說。 「有很多白人和西班牙裔居民投票給我。我們現在都在一起了。我們是不同的美國人，但我們是一個人美國。」

eb5423932acea65677561fb49f690ef65822b214.sourceText: Superior Court Judge Sentences Assault Defendant for Brutal Attack on Chinese ASU Student By John H. Tang Superior Court Judge Julie LaFave of the Maricopa County Superior Court sentenced Kalie McIntyre Rutledge, 22, for brutally assaulting ASU Chinese graduate student victim Xiaolin Shi, 25, and her friend on a light rail train. Rutledge was arrested and charged with a felony aggravated assault and misdemeanor assault. She pleaded guilty and was charged with the least serious felony under the law. Rutledge was sentenced to three months in jail and three years of probation. Rutledge did not like hearing Mandarin spoken from the two and began yelling racial slurs at the two riders. When Shi and her companion left the train, Rutledge got off with them and began punching Shi in the face and yelling more racial obscenities as she fell to the ground. Shi was injured with a severe concussion and a severe 2-centimeter wide fracture in the area surrounding her right eye. She still has memory lapses and has a hard time reading. Walking straight has been a problem and the injury to her eye is still a problem. Shi has already paid out of pocket $2,000 and possible future medical surgery costing an estimated $7,500. Attorney Bernard Wu of Phoenix was very instrumental in helping with the legal aspects of the assault case and met with Xiaolin Shi and her colleagues about the litigation of the situation. About 25 supporters of Shi attended the morning sentencing hearing in Superior Court in Phoenix, which included President Raymond Tang of Phoenix Chinese United Association, National Executive Rudy Yee of Phoenix Chinese American Citizens Alliance (PCACA), President Amanda Chua of the Asian American Bar Association, Phoenix Police Officer Chris Abril, Phoenix Asian Community Liaison, and the ASU Chinese support group was instrumental in making sure justice was done in the sentence of Katie Rutledge who committed, what the Chinese community feels was a racial hate crime. Chinese Community leaders and volunteers went to court to support the victim Xiaolin Shi.
eb5423932acea65677561fb49f690ef65822b214.translatedText: 高等法院法官因殘酷襲擊亞利桑那州立大學中國學生而對襲擊被告判刑 馬里科帕縣高等法院的高等法院法官朱莉·拉法夫 (Julie LaFave) 對 22 歲的凱莉·麥金太爾·拉特利奇 (Kalie McIntyre Rutledge) 作出了判決，罪名是在輕軌列車上殘酷襲擊了亞利桑那州立大學研究生 25 歲的男性。拉特利奇被捕並被指控犯有嚴重攻擊重罪和攻擊輕罪。她承認有罪，並被指控犯有法律規定的最嚴重的重罪。拉特利奇被判處三個月監禁和三年緩刑。拉特利奇不喜歡聽到兩人說普通話，開始對兩位車手大喊種族歧視的語言。當石和她的同伴離開火車時，拉特利奇和他們一起下車，並開始打石的臉，並在她倒下時大喊更多種族歧視的髒話。施女士受到嚴重腦震盪，右眼周圍有一道2公分寬的嚴重骨折。她仍然記憶力衰退，閱讀困難。直行已經成為一個問題，而且她眼睛的受傷仍然是一個問題。施已經自掏腰包支付了 2,000 美元，未來可能進行的醫療手術費用估計為 7,500 美元。鳳凰城的吳伯納德律師在毆打案件的法律方面提供了很大的幫助，並就該情況的訴訟與施曉琳和她的同事進行了會面。約25名施的支持者出席了上午在鳳凰城高等法院舉行的上午量刑聽證會，其中包括鳳凰城華人聯合總會會長雷蒙德·唐（Raymond Tang）、鳳凰城華裔美國公民聯盟（PCACA）全國執行官魯迪·葉（Rudy Yee）、亞裔美國律師協會主席阿曼達·蔡（Amanda Chua）、鳳凰城警官克里斯·阿布里城警官Abril）、鳳凰城亞裔社區聯絡員，以及亞利桑那州立大學華人支持小組，他們在確保對凱蒂·拉特利奇（Katie Rutledge）的判決中發揮了重要作用，凱蒂·拉特利奇犯下了華人社區認為是種族仇恨的罪行犯罪。華人社區領袖和志工到法庭聲援受害者施小林。

e36a72e82c08318500eec1894277422f21e1f04d.sourceText: AZ Senate Welcomes American Legion Thomas Tang Post 50 (Phoenix, Arizona) – The Color Guard of the American Legion Thomas Tang Post 50 presented the Colors at the opening of the Arizona Senate session on Tuesday, April 12, 2016. Participating in the ceremonies were Rudy Yee, Frank Ong, George Ong, Eddie Yue, Post Commander Jim Ong, Jr., father of Senate Assistant Research Analyst Jeffrey Ong and Jack Yee, father of Senator Kimberly Yee. Senator Yee led the legislative assembly in the Pledge of Allegiance upon the presentation of the Colors. Following the Presentation of the Colors, the President of the Senate, Andy Biggs, introduced the Legionnaires. As they were recognized, the Arizona Senators on the Floor of the Senate and the audience in the public gallery, rose from their seats and gave the members from the American Legion Thomas Tang Post 50 a standing ovation in appreciation of their military service to the United States of America. The Thomas Tang Post 50 was originally chartered as American Legion Phoenix Post 50 with a membership of 44 World War II veterans in 1950. The Post was rededicated in 1996 as Thomas Tang Post 50 in honor of Judge Thomas Tang, a former United States Army veteran. Pictured is the American Legion Thomas Tang Post 50 presenting the Colors with Senator Kimberly Yee standing at her desk during the opening of the Arizona Senate on Tuesday, April 12, 2016. Pictured from left to right are Eddie Yue, Rudy Yee, Post Commander Jim Ong Jr., Jeffrey Ong, Senate President Andy Biggs, Senator Kimberly Yee, Jack Yee, George Ong and Frank Ong at the Arizona Senate.
e36a72e82c08318500eec1894277422f21e1f04d.translatedText: 亞利桑那州參議院歡迎美國軍團 Thomas Tang Post 50（亞利桑那州菲尼克斯）——2016 年 4 月 12 日星期二，美國軍團 Thomas Tang Post 50 的旗袍衛隊在亞利桑那州參議院會議開幕式上展示了旗袍。參加儀式的有 Rudy Yee、Frank Ong、George Ong、Eddie Yue、郵政指揮官 Jim Ong, Jr.、參議院助理研究分析師 Jeffrey Ong 和 Jack Yee 的父親。參議員金佰利爾的父親。餘議員在宣誓就職後帶領立法會宣誓效忠。國旗介紹完畢後，參議院議長安迪·比格斯介紹了軍團士兵。當他們受到表彰時，參議院樓層的亞利桑那州參議員和公眾席上的觀眾起立，向美國軍團托馬斯·唐第 50 號成員起立鼓掌，感謝他們為美利堅合眾國做出的軍事貢獻。 Thomas Tang Post 50 最初於 1950 年被特許為美國軍團鳳凰城 Post 50，成員包括 44 名二戰老兵。該郵政於 1996 年重新命名為 Thomas Tang Post 50，以紀念前美國陸軍退伍軍人 Thomas Tang 法官。圖為美國退伍軍人協會 Thomas Tang Post 50 在 2016 年 4 月 12 日星期二亞利桑那州參議院開幕期間，參議員 Kimberly Yee 站在她的辦公桌前展示顏色。圖由左至右依序為亞利桑那州參議院的 Eddie Yue、Rudy Yee、郵政指揮官 Jim Ong Jr.、Jeffrey Ong、參議院主席 Andy Biggs、參議員 Kimberly Yee、Jack Yee、George Ong 和 Frank Ong。

2ac11217a45ad244a27d7c690ec5849df5527b0a.sourceText: Interview with Greg Stanton, Mayor of Phoenix, in the Celebration of 30 Years of Friendship between the Cities of Chengdu and Phoenix by Phoenix Sister Cities Chengdu Committee
2ac11217a45ad244a27d7c690ec5849df5527b0a.translatedText: 在鳳凰城友好城市成都市委員會

0872c92bc072869a67a45285ff74753dd165a390.sourceText: After some talk about Beijing and the resort city of Dalian, Stanton said, ”I do have four more years left as mayor. Chengdu is a very important sister city and I’m looking forward to visiting it. I think there is a trip being planned in the next couple of years and I definitely plan to be a part of it.” Phoenix and Chengdu are similar in that they are both important cities but are not as well-known as they should be. ”When people in China think of the United States, they think of New York and Los Angeles and maybe Chicago, but not Phoenix. In thirty years, Phoenix will definitely be among the top three or four cities, both demographically and economically. Chengdu is also a hugely important world-class city. Many Fortune 500 companies have operations there. If you’re doing business in China and you’re someplace other than Beijing and Shanghai, then you’re probably going to be in Chengdu.”
0872c92bc072869a67a45285ff74753dd165a390.translatedText: 的慶祝成都與鳳凰城友好30週年活動上採訪鳳凰城市長格雷格·斯坦頓（Greg Stanton）在談到北京和度假城市大連後，史丹頓說：「我的市長任期還有四年。成都是一個非常重要的友好城市，我很期待去參觀。我認為未來幾年有一次旅行計劃，我絕對計劃成為其中的一部分。」鳳凰城和成都的相似之處在於，它們都是重要的城市，但知名度卻不高。 「當中國人想到美國時，他們會想到紐約和洛杉磯，也許還會想到芝加哥，但不會想到菲尼克斯。三十年後，無論是人口還是經濟，菲尼克斯肯定會躋身前三、四名城市之列。成都也是一個非常重要的世界級城市。許多財富 500 強公司都在那裡設有業務。如果你在中國做生意，而且你在北京

87abc92980788f2069a34d629f855cdf06c5a79b.sourceText: As an example of international cooperation, Stanton mentions that the Marriott Hotel is being paid for with Chinese investment money. ”Chinese investment is benefiting Phoenix right now. But in order to get the Chinese investment, you gotta tell your story. You’ve got to get out there; you’ve got to bring visitors here from Chengdu and let them see what’s happening here, so they’ll feel confident in their investment.” ”The relationship with Chengdu is a longstanding one of thirty years. When we send teachers to Chengdu and other sister cities, it makes them better teachers for their students back here to be able to talk about their international experiences. And we’ve done artist exchanges.” ”When it comes to issues of climate change, I’m super-excited about forging additional economic relationships with the companies and people of Chengdu. Forget what the federal government can do. What we as cities can do is to reduce our impact on global warming and climate change. What we can do is encourage resilience and try to make our cities better prepared for it.” ”Obviously we have a growing Asian community moving to Phoenix. It helps to build a global mindset in this community. We’ve got to participate in the global economy.” ”Chinese people are entrepreneurial almost by nature and we’ve got to take advantage of that. If a Chinese business wants to open up in downtown Phoenix, we make that possible. We don’t have programs that are particularly geared toward the Asian community other than we want to promote small businesses in general. We want to make it as easy as possible to do business with the City, to get permits so that they can get up and run as soon as possible.”
87abc92980788f2069a34d629f855cdf06c5a79b.translatedText: 作為國際合作的一個例子，史丹頓提到萬豪酒店是用中國的投資資金建造的。 「中國的投資現在正在讓鳳凰城受益。但為了獲得中國的投資，你必須講述你的故事。你必須走出去；你必須把遊客從成都帶到這裡，讓他們看看這裡發生了什麼，這樣他們才會對自己的投資充滿信心。」「與成都的關係已經有三十年了。當我們派老師到成都和其他城市友好時，這使他們成為了國際的藝術家能夠談論他們的國際經驗。」 「談到氣候變遷問題，我對與成都的企業和人民建立更多的經濟關係感到非常興奮。忘記聯邦政府能做什麼。我們作為城市能做的是減少對全球變暖和氣候變遷的影響。我們能做的是鼓勵韌性並努力讓我們的城市為此做好更好的準備。」 「顯然，我們有越來越多的亞洲社區搬到了鳳凰城。這有助於在這個社區中建立全球思維。 「中國人幾乎天生就具有創業精神，我們必須利用這一點。如果中國企業想在鳳凰城市中心開業，我們會讓這成為可能。除了我們希望促進一般小企業發展之外，我們沒有特別針對亞裔社區的計劃。我們希望讓與市政府做生意盡可能容易，獲得許可，以便他們能夠盡快開業和運營。」

0e57a860ced08aa31ee57c4d218bf271354dd1d2.translatedText: 您是入籍美國公民嗎？身為美利堅合眾國公民，憲法賦予您在美國選舉中投票的特權。

cc1fd59216af0bded5180e03e376c48d14503d73.sourceText: Unlike an employee benefit at work or student benefit at school or even an auto club benefit where its lack of use has no real consequence on your daily lives, failure to use the voting benefit given by the U.S. Constitution to citizens does have immediate and long term impact and consequences on your liberties whether by the federal, state, county or city governments.
cc1fd59216af0bded5180e03e376c48d14503d73.translatedText: 與工作中的僱員福利或學校的學生福利甚至汽車俱樂部福利不同，如果不使用這些福利不會對您的日常生活產生真正的影響，則不使用美國憲法賦予公民的投票權確實會對您的自由產生直接和長期的影響和後果，無論是聯邦、州、縣還是市政府。

696765f7b7e05d4d7429c9a54761517bb5d320a3.sourceText: By Barry Wong, Chairman, AzGOP Asian American Coalition (Scottsdale, Ariz.) In this presidential election year and understanding the importance of full engagement in American government, Asian Americans are making greater inroads in the American and Arizona political landscape. On January 22, 2016 Asian American community members were noticeably present at the Arizona Republican Party Chairman’s Awards Dinner at the Hilton Scottsdale Resort & Spa. This annual event draws Party officers, leaders and workers from throughout Arizona to celebrate GOP accomplishments and recognize GOP hard working volunteers. Among the award recipients were: Dr. CT Wright, Senator Barry Goldwater Award; Carole Joyce, Lifetime Achievement Award, and Jae Chin, Korean Community leader and AzGOP Asian American Coalition board member, AzGOP Chairman’s Special Recognition. The AzGOP Asian American Coalition and community leaders had a significant impact at the dinner with over 20% of the attendance (110 guests) and hosted tables (11 tables) at this 500 person gathering. Asian American-hosted tables were: Chinese Community (Hosts: Albert Lin, Helen Zhang); Taiwanese Community (Shen-Yi Michelle Chang); Bangladeshi Community (Farhana Ahmed, Raphael Ahmed); Filipino American Business Chamber of Commerce of Az (Marie Cunning); Indian Community (Venkat Kommineni); Indian Community (Jagadesan ”Jeggy” Krishnamurthy); Korean Community (Jae Chin); NewGen Worldwide, GreenCard Fund and AAHOA (Dinesh Dan Rama); Pakistani Community (Sardar Babar); Vietnamese Community (Kevin Dang, Mai Le); and AzGOP Asian American Coalition (Barry Wong). Elected officials were present in support of the GOP including Congressmen Trent Franks, Matt Salmon and David Schweikert; former Congressman Barry Goldwater, Jr.; State Senator Adam Driggs and State Representative Jay Lawrence. ”The Republican Party espouses and stands for freedom, liberty, free enterprise, limited government and low taxes and regulations,” said AzGOP Chairman Robert Graham. ”We welcome and embrace peoples of all background and are proud of our growth from the Asian American communities in Arizona.”The Asian American community, comprised of unique and distinct communities, has coalesced and is working as a group collaboratively to engage in the political process for the benefit of their individual and the collective community.
696765f7b7e05d4d7429c9a54761517bb5d320a3.translatedText: 作者：Barry Wong，亞利桑那州共和黨亞裔美國人聯盟主席（亞利桑那州斯科茨代爾） 在這個總統選舉年，亞裔美國人了解充分參與美國政府的重要性，他們正在美國和亞利桑那州的政治格局中取得更大的進展。 2016 年 1 月 22 日，亞裔美國社區成員引人注目地出席了在斯科茨代爾希爾頓溫泉度假酒店舉行的亞利桑那州共和黨主席頒獎晚宴。這項一年一度的活動吸引了來自亞利桑那州各地的黨官員、領導人和工人來慶祝共和黨的成就並表彰共和黨辛勤工作的志工。獲獎者包括：CT Wright 博士、參議員 Barry Goldwater 獎；卡羅爾·喬伊斯 (Carole Joyce) 獲得終身成就獎，Jae Chin 獲得韓國社區領袖、AzGOP 亞裔美國人聯盟董事會成員、AzGOP 主席特別表彰。 AzGOP 亞裔美國人聯盟和社區領袖在晚宴上產生了重大影響，出席人數超過 20%（110 名嘉賓），並在這場 500 人聚會中主持了餐桌（11 桌）。由亞裔美國人主持的桌有：華人社區（主持人：Albert Lin、Helen Zhang）；台灣社區（Shen-Yi Michelle Chang）；孟加拉國社區（Farhana Ahmed、Raphael Ahmed）；亞利桑那州菲律賓裔美國商會（Marie Cunning）；印度社區 (Venkat Kommineni)；印度社區（Jagadae）； AAHOA (Dinesh Dan Rama)；巴基斯坦社區（Sardar Babar）；越南社區（Kevin Dang、Mai Le）；和 AzGOP 亞裔美國人聯盟（Barry Wong）。出席會議的民選官員支持共和黨，包括國會議員特倫特·弗蘭克斯 (Trent Franks)、馬特·薩爾蒙 (Matt Salmon) 和大衛·施韋克特 (David Schweikert)；前國會議員小巴里·戈德華特；州參議員亞當·德里格斯和州眾議員傑伊·勞倫斯。阿茲共和黨主席羅伯特·格雷厄姆表示：“共和黨擁護並主張自由、自由、自由企業、有限政府以及低稅收和低監管。” “我們歡迎並擁抱各種背景的人民，並為我們在亞利桑那州的亞裔美國人社區的成長感到自豪。”亞裔美國人社區由獨特而獨特的社區組成，他們已經聯合起來，作為一個集體協作，為了個人和集體社區的利益而參與政治進程。

62c9c4352604ab33f2ad09c06aa3d0cdcdf8fbba.sourceText: Yee Fung Toy picnic a big hit with local community The Yee Fung Toy annual picnic offered great food and much fun for all who participated in the event. The gala affair was held at Margaret Hance Park in Phoenix on Sunday, October 25. There was plenty of good picnic food for all who attended the annual Yee Fung Toy picnic. About 300 people attended the event and everyone enjoyed the food and each others company. Theresa Yung was having a great time at the Yee Fung Toy picnic as she shows off her food at the outdoors event.. Everyone attending the Yee Fung Toy picnic had a great time meeting other friends and getting together for a great lunch. All the kids that attended the Yee Fung Toy picnic won a prize presented to them by Valley leader and Yee Elder John M. Yee. The kids enjoyed their prizes and eating hot dogs and hamburgers at the annual event. Phoenix Police Asian Liaison Chris Abril made a kid a special Phoenix Officer at the Yee Fung Toy picnic. Officer Abril has been a special member of the Asian community and has been attending many Asian functions throughout the year.
62c9c4352604ab33f2ad09c06aa3d0cdcdf8fbba.translatedText: 怡豐玩具野餐活動深受當地社區歡迎 怡豐玩具一年一度的野餐活動為所有參加活動的人提供了美味佳餚和樂趣。晚會於 10 月 25 日星期日在鳳凰城的瑪格麗特漢斯公園舉行。一年一度的怡豐玩具野餐會為所有參與者提供了充足的野餐美食。大約有300人參加了這次活動，每個人都享受美食和彼此的陪伴。 Theresa Yung 在怡豐玩具野餐會上玩得很開心，她在戶外活動中展示了她的食物。參加怡豐玩具野餐的每個人都與其他朋友見面並聚在一起享用了一頓豐盛的午餐。所有參加怡豐玩具野餐會的孩子們都獲得了山谷領袖、怡豐長老John M. Yee 頒發的獎品。孩子們在一年一度的活動中享受了他們的獎品並吃著熱狗和漢堡。鳳凰城警察亞洲聯絡員克里斯·阿布里爾 (Chris Abril) 在怡豐玩具野餐會上讓一個孩子成為了特別的鳳凰城警官。阿布里爾警官是亞洲社區的特殊成員，全年出席了許多亞洲活動。

daa84e8ea5cb8f95cf39f0ac388b6e87275e8d5f.sourceText: Grotesque, fantastical, delirious conversions of ordinary cars into everything from yachts to rockets to double-decker hearses straight out of the darkest Gothic nightmare. Art Car World in Douglas, Arizona, opened to the public in 2023, but it's been decades in the making.
daa84e8ea5cb8f95cf39f0ac388b6e87275e8d5f.translatedText: 將普通汽車怪誕、奇幻、瘋狂地改裝成從遊艇到火箭再到雙層靈車的一切，直接來自最黑暗的哥德式噩夢。位於亞利桑那州道格拉斯的藝術汽車世界於 2023 年向公眾開放，但它的準備已經有幾十年了。

8fd23aa619f6636dbd0a485ebe5f91746bc53f3e.sourceText: Owner Harrod Blank is one of the personalities driving the art car movement. He presents his cars all around the world and has helped organize an art car camp at Burning Man. Not all of the cars at the museum are his own creations, though. Blank has collected works created by other car-tists and given them a place where they would be safe from the elements and their unique beauty preserved for others to appreciate.
8fd23aa619f6636dbd0a485ebe5f91746bc53f3e.translatedText: 車主哈羅德·布蘭克 (Harrod Blank) 是推動藝術汽車運動的名人之一。他在世界各地展示他的汽車，並幫助在火人節組織了一個藝術汽車營。不過，並非博物館裡的所有汽車都是他自己的作品。 Blank 收集了其他汽車藝術家創作的作品，並為它們提供了一個安全的地方，讓它們免受自然因素的影響，並保留其獨特的美感供其他人欣賞。

65c16dbefa6c624fb4581303259c183e0059d7f7.sourceText: One is covered completely in stained glass and mosaic, completely in metal objects of mind-boggling diversity, and hiding 48 working but completely original music boxes. Some are covered completely in litter picked up from the roadside yet made artistically whole. The variety and quality is mind-boggling.
65c16dbefa6c624fb4581303259c183e0059d7f7.translatedText: 其中一個完全被彩色玻璃和馬賽克覆蓋，完全被令人難以置信的多樣性金屬物體覆蓋，並隱藏了 48 個工作但完全原創的音樂盒。有些完全被從路邊撿來的垃圾覆蓋，但又被藝術化地完整起來。品種和品質令人難以置信。

6b8e49fc05b611ebb3c18a37efdf4ec742c6ce11.sourceText: A grateful community recently bid farewell to Valley Asian Leader Madeline Ong Sakata (right) at the Great Wall Restaurant. A bouquet of flowers was presented to Madeline from some of her admirers in appreciation for her many efforts as a civil rights leader for the Asian community in the Greater Phoenix area. More than 125 of Madeline’s closest friends,business associates, and family helped celebrate her many years of devoted community service. Several valley leaders such as Barry Wong and Judge Brian Ishikawa discussed their professional relationship with Madeline and how influential she has been to their respective communities and the Phoenix Metro area.
6b8e49fc05b611ebb3c18a37efdf4ec742c6ce11.translatedText: 感恩社區最近在長城餐廳告別了山谷亞洲領導人Madeline Ong Sakata（右）。瑪德琳的一些崇拜者向她獻上一束鮮花，感謝她作為大鳳凰城地區亞裔社區的民權領袖所做的許多努力。超過 125 位瑪德琳最親密的朋友、商業夥伴和家人幫助慶祝了她多年來熱心的社區服務。 Barry Wong 和 Brian Ishikawa 等幾位山谷領導人討論了他們與 Madeline 的專業關係以及她對各自社區和鳳凰城都會區的影響力。

b364562e98c2e083e41edefaee2661200c99e9f0.sourceText: Former Presiding Southeast Juvenile Judge Brian K. Ishikawa was one of several guest speakers at Madeline Ong Sakata’s appreciation farewell dinner at the Great Wall Restaurant.
b364562e98c2e083e41edefaee2661200c99e9f0.translatedText: 前東南少年法官 Brian K. Ishikawa 是 Madeline Ong Sakata 在長城餐廳舉行的答謝晚宴上的幾位演講嘉賓之一。

57e41ac7d2d65ab222e056699c1e57e05f126058.sourceText: Phoenix Chinese Community leaders were on hand in the erection of a long needed memorial marker acknowledging the memory of early Phoenix Chinese Pioneers who settled in the area around 1886 to about 1914. The erection of the marker took about two years of planning with the help of the Phoenix Chinese Welfare Council headed by President Homer Zhang, Chinese United Association of Greater Phoenix President David Yee, Ong Ko Met Association President James Tang, and Phoenix Pioneer Cemetery Association President Mark Lamm. The joint memorial project also included organizational members from the Phoenix Chinese American Citizens Alliance and the Yee Fung Toy Association.
57e41ac7d2d65ab222e056699c1e57e05f126058.translatedText: 鳳凰城華人社區領導人親臨現場，豎立了一個長期需要的紀念標誌，以紀念鳳凰城中1914年至1914年左右1914年的先驅者。在鳳凰城華人的幫助下，該標誌的豎立花了大約兩年的時間進行規劃福利理事會由張會長、大鳳凰城華人聯合總會會長餘大偉、王高美會會長鄧俊傑、鳳凰城先鋒公墓協會會長馬克·拉姆領導。聯合紀念計畫還包括來自鳳凰城華裔美國公民聯盟和怡豐玩具​​協會的組織成員。

aaf63b01a772d12c1b14351965d3e50b7333a32a.sourceText: Those attending the historic erection of the memorial monument were John H. Tang, Cheak Yee, Raymond Tang, Homer Zhang, Sterling, Foster, Joe Yue, Mark Lamm, David Yee, Benny Yee, Denise Foster, Cathy Johnson, James Tang, Rudy Yee, and David Cui.
aaf63b01a772d12c1b14351965d3e50b7333a32a.translatedText: 參加紀念紀念碑的歷史性豎立的人員包括 John H. Tang、Cheak Yee、Raymond Tang、Homer Zhang、Sterling、Foster、Joe Yue、Mark Lamm、David Yee、Benny Yee、Denise Foster、Cathy Johnson、James Tang、Rudy Yee 和David崔.

51a2a615d4e0d14e6e76eb8e3d5dbc6bc8706aa7.sourceText: Phoenix Pioneer Cemetery Association President Mark Lamm indicated that there is a list of about 50 Chinese pioneers who are buried at the historic site located at 1317 W. Jefferson, south of the old restored Smjrthwaite home.
51a2a615d4e0d14e6e76eb8e3d5dbc6bc8706aa7.translatedText: 鳳凰城先驅公墓協會主席馬克·拉姆表示，大約有50名中國先驅者的名單被埋葬在位於西杰斐遜街1317號的歷史遺址，位於舊修復的斯姆傑韋特故居以南。

dd277ebcafe2ded2dac8f0e8012616fd5c2d2943.sourceText: ”A lot of the old Chinese cemetery markers are gone, because many of them were made of wood and did not survive the desert heat and other elements”, said PCA President Mark Lamm. ” The new stone marker will last for many more years showing where the early Chinese Pioneers were buried.” Phoenix Chinese United President David Yee said, ”Chinese families can now come to a place where they can pay proper respects to those who lived here many years ago”
dd277ebcafe2ded2dac8f0e8012616fd5c2d2943.translatedText: PCA 主席馬克·拉姆 (Mark Lamm) 表示：“許多古老的中國墓地標記都消失了，因為其中許多是木頭製成的，無法經受沙漠炎熱和其他因素的影響。” “新的石碑將持續很多年，顯示早期中國拓荒者的埋葬地點。”鳳凰城華人聯誼會長餘，“中國人現在可以向中國人的埋葬地點”。
