3005ccb2b059b68cf28e803f3fbd2e56cf846102.sourceText: Asian Pacific Community in Action provided free shingles vaccines to uninsured community members at their new offices in Central Phoenix on Saturday, 1 August 2015. Shingles infections are caused by a virus and results in very a painful rash and blisters. People over 50 are especially at risk. In total 73 community members received shingles vaccinations, two dozen also received free hepatitis A and B virus vaccinations. Vaccines were provided by Maricopa County Public Health. APCA staff and medical interpreters provided in-language care in Mandarin, Cantonese, Vietnamese, Hindi, Gujarati, and Korean. APCA provides training to bi-lingual community members interested in careers as medical interpreters. For more information please visit http://bit.ly/BBIHSEPT2015.
3005ccb2b059b68cf28e803f3fbd2e56cf846102.translatedText: 亞太社區行動組織於 2015 年 8 月 1 日星期六在鳳凰城中部的新辦公室向未投保的社區成員免費提供帶狀皰疹疫苗。帶狀皰疹感染是由病毒引起的，會導致非常痛苦的皮疹和水泡。 50 歲以上的人尤其面臨風險。共有 73 名社區成員接種了帶狀皰疹疫苗，還有 20 人還免費接種了甲型和乙型肝炎病毒疫苗。疫苗由馬里科帕縣公共衛生部門提供。 APCA 工作人員和醫療口譯員提供普通話、粵語、越南語、印地語、古吉拉特語和韓語的語言護理。 APCA 為對醫療口譯員職業感興趣的雙語社群成員提供培訓。欲了解更多信息，請訪問http://bit.ly/BBIHSEPT2015。

081b62a5a45e6cd1bfd797462791e997e1f55687.sourceText: PCACA scores big with Bowlathon for student scholarships Phoenix Chinese American Citizens Alliance (PCACA) had many bowlers involved in their 3rd Bowlathon student scholarship fund raiser on Saturday, April 18, at Let It Roll Bowl in Phoenix. Getting everyone enthused in the event were (Front LtoR) Mayen Tang, Roberta Yee, Eva Li, (Top LtoR) Marshall Wong, Richard Yee, Elaine Wong, and Rudy Yee. Everyone involved had a great time and were a part of winning door prizes and many raffle prizes. All proceeds went to the organization’s student scholarship fund. (LtoR) Gracie Li, Jonathan Chien, and Ashley Ong prepare to team up for bowling in the PCACA 3ed Bowlathon event at Let It Roll Bowling Alley in Phoenix. Many teams scored big in the PCACA Bowlathon at Let It Roll Bowl. Team members (LtoR) Moon Hom, Jim Rhodeos, Wesley Ong, Donna Mah, Jeff Tang, and Gary Mah prepare to bowl big scores in the bowling event. Jacob Ong is determined to get a strike ball for his team at the PCACA Bowlathon on Saturday, April 18, at Let It Roll Bowling Alley in Phoenix. Many teams participated for prize money and raffle prizes at the event. Outstanding kids bowled and did quite well in the PCACA Bowlathon. Those involved were (LtoR) were Anthony Paisley, Gabriel Yee, Daniel Yee, and Caleb Yee with other kid bowlers. Many bowlers participated for the many raffle prizes given at the PCACA Bowlathon at Let It Roll Bowling Alley. Gabriel Yee helps PCACA President Elaine Wong pick out the lucky tickets for over 40 prizes given out at the event.
081b62a5a45e6cd1bfd797462791e997e1f55687.translatedText: PCACA 在 Bowlathon 學生獎學金活動中大獲成功 4 月 18 日星期六，鳳凰城華裔美國公民聯盟 (PCACA) 在鳳凰城的 Let It Roll Bowl 舉辦了第三屆 Bowlathon 學生獎學金籌款活動，吸引了眾多投球手參與。讓每個人都對這次活動充滿熱情的是（前左）Mayen Tang、Roberta Yee、Eva Li、（上左）Marshall Wong、Richard Yee、Elaine Wong 和 Rudy Yee。每位參加者都度過了愉快的時光，並贏得了門獎和許多抽獎獎品。所有收益都捐給了該組織的學生獎學金基金。 （左至右）Gracie Li、Jonathan Chien 和 Ashley Ong 準備在鳳凰城 Let It Roll Bowling Alley 舉行的 PCACA 3ed Bowlathon 賽事中組隊打保齡球。許多球隊在 Let It Roll Bowl 舉辦的 PCACA Bowlathon 比賽中取得了巨大的成績。團隊成員（從左到右）Moon Hom、Jim Rhodeos、Wesley Ong、Donna Mah、Jeff Tang 和 Gary Mah 準備在保齡球比賽中打出高分。 Jacob Ong 決心在 4 月 18 日星期六在菲尼克斯的 Let It Roll 保齡球館舉行的 PCACA Bowlathon 比賽中為他的球隊贏得好球。許多隊伍參加了這項活動，爭奪獎金和抽獎獎品。優秀的孩子們在 PCACA 保齡球馬拉鬆比賽中打了保齡球並取得了不錯的成績。參與其中的人員包括（從左到右）安東尼·佩斯利、加布里埃爾·葉、丹尼爾·葉、迦勒·葉以及其他兒童保齡球手。許多保齡球愛好者參加了在 Let It Roll Bowling Alley 舉行的 PCACA Bowlathon 比賽中獲得的抽獎活動。 Gabriel Yee 幫助 PCACA 主席 Elaine Wong 挑選活動中頒發的 40 多個獎品的幸運彩票。

6a6da37826c732562ea313a5da69c7e0c4f6297a.sourceText: Another annual event is the Pure Brightness Ceremony, a Chinese traditional occasion honoring the dead. This ceremony usually occurs on April 5. For a couple of years it was puzzling to the PCA(Pioneers?Cemetery Association) members when they arrived to work at the cemetery, as to who was burning incense and wax candles in front of the gates at P&MMP(Pioneer and Military Memorial Park). The mystery was solved when William Tang, a visiting scholar from China, was asked to interpret the Chinese characters on a tombstone at City Cemetery. From him, it was learned that the Pure Brightness Ceremony is performed by the descendants of the dead, and serves to prevent evil spirits from entering the cemetery site. The PCA has since then made every effort to have the cemetery gates open to the Chinese for the Pure Brightness Ceremony.
6a6da37826c732562ea313a5da69c7e0c4f6297a.translatedText: 另一項年度活動是清明大典，這是中國祭奠死者的傳統活動。這個儀式通常在4月5日舉行。幾年來，PCA（先鋒公墓協會）成員在到達公墓工作時一直很困惑，到底是誰在P&MMP（先鋒和軍事紀念公園）的大門前燒香和蠟燭。當來自中國的訪問學者William Tang被要求解讀城市公墓墓碑上的漢字時，這個謎團就解開了。從他那裡得知，清明儀式是由死者的後裔舉行的，目的是防止邪靈進入墓地。此後，PCA盡一切努力讓墓園大門向華人開放，舉行清明大典。

c9964e1e06074532007da0231058c0e8a08534a1.sourceText: The members of the Pioneers?Cemetery Association (PCA) had, for a number of years, been puzzled by the occasional presence of ashes, melted candles, and partially burned, thin sticks found at the gates of the cemeteries at the Pioneer & Military Memorial Park (P&MMP). These items were found at temporarily isolated intervals, i. e., once every spring, and would be present when PCA members of the arrived to work at the cemeteries. Another puzzle was the interpretation of the Chinese characters on a tombstone at the P&MMP. This tombstone is located within what has come to be known as the Chinese Circle and is part of City Cemetery. In an effort to have the inscription on the tombstone interpreted, the senior author invited William Tang, a visiting Chinese scholar at Arizona State University, to the cemeteries. The results of Tang’s interpretation and additional studies into the history of the individual buried there will be presented under separate title. However, as a spin off of this investigation, the mystery of the first puzzle was solved. According to Tang, the materials found at the entries to the cemeteries resulted from an ancient Chinese ceremony in honor of the dead known as the Pure Brightness Festival, or Qing Ming. The remains found were the burned remnants of paper money, hand made wax candles, and sticks of incense.
c9964e1e06074532007da0231058c0e8a08534a1.translatedText: 多年來，先鋒公墓協會 (PCA) 的成員一直對在先鋒軍事紀念公園 (P&MMP) 墓地門口偶爾發現的灰燼、融化的蠟燭和部分燒毀的細棍子感到困惑。這些物品是在暫時隔離的時間間隔內發現的，即。例如，每年春天一次，當 PCA 成員到達墓地工作時，他們就會在場。另一個難題是 P&MMP 墓碑上漢字的解釋。該墓碑位於後來被稱為華人圈的地方，是城市公墓的一部分。為了解讀墓碑上的銘文，資深作者邀請了亞利桑那州立大學的中國訪問學者唐威廉來到墓園。唐的解釋和對埋葬在那裡的個人歷史的進一步研究的結果將在單獨的標題下呈現。然而，作為這項調查的副產品，第一個謎題的謎團被解開了。據唐說，在墓地入口處發現的材料來自中國古代紀念死者的儀式，稱為「清明節」。發現的遺骸包括燒焦的紙幣、手工製作的蠟燭和香。

The workshop will present effective strategies for introducing and practicing targeted grammatical points and vocabulary through topic-based language teaching. Traditionally, the chairman of the AzGOP organizes a dinner event the evening prior to the meeting to present awards recognizing hard working Party volunteers, clubs and organizations. AzGOP Chairman Robert Graham led the awards dinner this year.
5cbc6a90fedede07981acbc1d32e11d2b0d3f030.translatedText: 亞利桑那州共和黨 (AzGOP) 每兩年舉行一次強制性會議，以選舉官員並開展業務。按照傳統，阿茲特克共產黨主席會在會議前一天晚上組織晚宴活動，頒發獎項以表彰辛勤工作的黨誌願者、俱樂部和組織。 AzGOP 主席羅伯特·格雷厄姆主持了今年的頒獎晚宴。

cb845897adb257f67b26ea95ca9db4698e157023.sourceText: AWARD PRESENTATION. Awards presented included ”Outstanding Party Worker,” ”Best Republican Club,”’ Lifetime Achievement” and ”Senator Barry Goldwater Award.” Special for the evening: without advance notice but with great fanfare, Chairman Graham and his wife, Julia (chair of the awards committee), announced Barry Wong as the recipient of the ”Exceptional Dedication & Service to the Republican Party’Award for his work leading the Party’s outreach effort as chairman of the AzGOP Asian American Coalition.
cb845897adb257f67b26ea95ca9db4698e157023.translatedText: 頒獎典禮。頒發的獎項包括「傑出黨務工作者」、「最佳共和黨俱樂部」、「終身成就獎」和「參議員巴里·戈德華特獎」。當晚特別節目：在沒有提前通知的情況下，主席格雷厄姆和他的妻子朱莉婭（頒獎委員會主席）大張旗鼓地宣布巴里·黃（Barry Wong）獲得“對共和黨的傑出奉獻和服務”獎，以表彰他作為阿茲共和黨亞裔美國人聯盟主席領導共和黨外展工作的工作。

3e519b8b284297737bceddcb64ef3d0935890075.sourceText: Wong thanked Chairman Graham for his leadership and genuine commitment to ethnic community outreach. ”This award would not be possible if not for the collaboration and dedication of each Asian ethnic community Coalition board member to the GOP effort,” said Wong. ”I am merely the facilitator and coordinator linking the various Asian communities to the GOP.” Wong then introduced each Asian ethnic community and table host highlighting Asian diversity and strong presence at the dinner.
3e519b8b284297737bceddcb64ef3d0935890075.translatedText: 黃感謝格雷厄姆主席的領導和對少數族裔社區外展的真誠承諾。黃說：「如果沒有每位亞裔社區聯盟董事會成員對共​​和黨努力的合作和奉獻，這個獎項是不可能實現的。」「我只是將各個亞洲社區與共和黨聯繫起來的促進者和協調者。」然後，黃介紹了每個亞裔社區和餐桌主持人，強調了晚宴上的亞洲多樣性和強大影響力。

fad18bbc50fe0ac1984951a5f9b66609e14fb3f3.sourceText: ASIAN COALITION. Chairman Graham, upon his election in 2013, established as among his goals reaching out and connecting with the many ethnic and racial communities in Arizona including the fast growing Asian American community. He created the AzGOP Asian American Coalition (Coalition) and appointed Party officer and former legislator and corporation commissioner Wong as its chairman.
fad18bbc50fe0ac1984951a5f9b66609e14fb3f3.translatedText: 亞洲聯盟。格雷厄姆主席在 2013 年當選後，將與亞利桑那州的許多民族和種族社區（包括快速發展的亞裔美國人社區）進行接觸和聯繫作為其目標之一。他創建了 AzGOP 亞裔美國人聯盟（聯盟），並任命黨官員、前立法者和公司專員 Wong 為主席。

5e6c8c4950ca723484321e11edd92788fcdba200.sourceText: Working in collaboration with Wong and community board members of the Coalition, Chairman Graham in the past two years has met leaders and attended many community events of the diverse Arizona Asian communities including Bangladesh, Chinese, Filipino, Indian, Korean, Pakistani, Taiwanese and Vietnamese communities.
5e6c8c4950ca723484321e11edd92788fcdba200.translatedText: 在過去兩年中，Graham 主席與 Wong 和聯盟社區委員會成員合作，會見了亞利桑那州亞裔社區的領導人，並參與了許多社區活動，包括孟加拉國人、中國人、菲律賓人、印度人、韓國人、巴基斯坦人、台灣人和越南人社區。

8856c0a69e0d22c705168befe60cf45f7cd2bd3b.sourceText: DINNER INFLUENCE. Over 20% of the guests (12 tables) attending the Chairman’s Awards Dinner came from the Arizona Asian American community including the following and the table hosts:
8856c0a69e0d22c705168befe60cf45f7cd2bd3b.translatedText: 晚餐影響。參加主席頒獎晚宴的嘉賓（12桌）超過20%來自亞利桑那州亞裔美國人社區，包括以下人員和桌主：

89d6a8dddc37d481ab367811ba25e83027bb8f1d.sourceText: Bangladesh (Raphael & Farhana Ahmed, Coalition members), Filipino (Marie Cunning, Coalition member), Indian (Venkat Kommineni, Coalition member), Korean (Jae Chin, Coalition member), Pakistani (Sardar Babar, Coalition member), Taiwanese (Michelle Chang, Coalition member), Vietnamese (Kevin Dang, Mai Le, Coalition members (2 tables)); also, Dinesh ”Dan”Rama (southwest regional director, Asian American Hotel Owners Association), Astria Wong (Coalition member), Sam Huang (candidate for Chandler City Council) and Barry Wong (Coalition chairman).
89d6a8dddc37d481ab367811ba25e83027bb8f1d.translatedText: 孟加拉（Raphael & Farhana Ahmed，聯盟成員）、菲律賓（Marie Cunning，聯盟成員）、印度（Venkat Kommineni，聯盟成員）、韓國（Jae Chin，聯盟成員）、巴基斯坦（Sardar Babar，聯盟成員）、台灣（Michelle Chang，聯盟成員）、越南（Kevin Dang、Mai Le，聯盟桌子（2 張 Le，）桌子）； ”Dan”Rama（亞裔美國酒店業主協會西南區域總監）、Astria Wong（聯盟成員）、Sam Huang（錢德勒市議會候選人）和 Barry Wong（聯盟主席）。

bcc5ab441e62e903afa9d3aec22a930eb38d17af.sourceText: By hosting tables, these attendees and their guests not only supported the chairman and the Republican Party but also made a statement that as Americans and Arizonans of many Asian ethnic backgrounds they are full participants in mainstream institutions and organizations.
bcc5ab441e62e903afa9d3aec22a930eb38d17af.translatedText: 透過主持餐桌，這些與會者及其嘉賓不僅支持主席和共和黨，而且還聲明，作為許多亞裔背景的美國人和亞利桑那州人，他們是主流的全面參與者機構和組織。

880b33b2667fbd7093cc1800f0c07f56acf7ea02.sourceText: The evening was festive with Party officials and volunteers from throughout Arizona present. Elected officials attending included Congressmen Paul Gosar and David Schweikert and former Congressman (Calif.) Barry Goldwater, Jr. Also, many state senators, representatives and city council members including Sen. Kelli Ward, Rep. Steve Montenegro and Chandler Councilman Jack Sellers.
880b33b2667fbd7093cc1800f0c07f56acf7ea02.translatedText: 來自亞利桑那州各地的黨官員和志工出席了晚會，氣氛熱烈。出席的當選官員包括眾議員保羅·戈薩爾 (Paul Gosar) 和大衛·施韋克特 (David Schweikert) 以及前加州眾議員巴里·戈德華特 (Barry Goldwater, Jr.)。此外，還有許多州參議員、眾議員和市議員，包括參議員凱利·沃德 (Kelli Ward)、眾議員史蒂夫·蒙特內格羅 (Steve Montenegro) 和錢德勒市議員傑克·塞勒斯 (Jack Sellers)。

6a52554751826448b1a836c0d2676ba5b2114738.sourceText: The Asian American community was well represented and made a positive impression on the Arizona Republican Party regulars and its chairman.
6a52554751826448b1a836c0d2676ba5b2114738.translatedText: 亞裔美國人社區的代表人數眾多，給亞利桑那州共和黨常客及其主席留下了積極的印象。

907515c307cc11b4d21a0cb1cf1adbbf5653fed8.sourceText: In 1993, ASU anthropologists K.J Schroeder and his archaeological excavation team excavated the cemetery and unearthed some Chinese coins, bone made tools, jade, small Bodhisattvas and other objects. The archaeologist published the book, ”Pioneer & Military Memorial Park Archaeological Project in Phoenix Arizona 1990-1992.” Among the early tombstones in the cemetery, there is only one with Chinese inscription –”Grave of Xiang Yuan Tang, Kaiping Dai Lou Village.” With little clues about this tomb, the archaeologist reached out to the Tempe Chinese school principal, William Tang. Mr. Tang published a message in the local Chinese newspaper, hoping to find the descendants of the tomb in order to study the life, thoughts and family of the tomb owner and to promulgate the glorious history of the Chinese pioneers. But 20 years passed by, the tombstone mystery had remained unsolved.
907515c307cc11b4d21a0cb1cf1adbbf5653fed8.translatedText: 1993年，亞利桑那州立大學人類學家K.J Schroeder和他的考古發掘器隊挖掘了墓地，出土了一些中國錢幣、骨製工具、其他玉薩器、小菩薩和其他物體工具。這位考古學家出版了《1990-1992 年亞利桑那州鳳凰城先鋒與軍事紀念公園考古計畫》一書。墓園早期墓碑中，只有一處有中文銘文－「開平戴樓村向遠堂之墓」。由於對這座墳墓的線索很少，考古學家聯繫了坦佩中文學校校長威廉唐(William Tang)。唐先生在當地中文報紙上留言，希望找到墓園的後人，研究墓主的生活、思想和家庭，弘揚中華開國先鋒的光輝歷史。但20年過去了，墓碑之謎仍未解開。

15595c659885b180b2f33d4c66486aecb96b44fc.sourceText: Famous artist Caroline Young (Center) recently visited the valley at a special showing in Scottsdale. Attending the special event were ( LtoR ) Tellyen Tang, Eileen Yeung, and Lily Yee. Caroline Young’s delicate watercolors on silk pay homage to a classical Chinese technique called the ‘delicate style’. Her paintings share the culture of a civilization over five thousand years old, as well as to give some insight into the motivation, aspirations and ethos of modern-day China.
15595c659885b180b2f33d4c66486aecb96b44fc.translatedText: 著名藝術家Caroline Young（中）最近在斯科茨代爾的一場特別展覽中參觀了山谷。出席特別活動的有 (LtoR) Tellyen Tang、Eileen Yeung 和 Lily Yee。卡洛琳楊（Caroline Young）精緻的絲綢水彩畫向一種被稱為「精緻風格」的中國古典技術致敬。她的畫作分享了五千年文明的文化，也讓我們深入了解現代中國的動機、願望和精神。

297a11b33416e604749a6123d5c44683f0f2ffb2.sourceText: The Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Arizona held its holiday business networking mixer on December 10, 2014 at TGIF Restaurant in Chase Field, home of the Arizona Diamondbacks professional baseball team, in Phoenix. Also, chamber corporate sponsor, APS, represented by Tiffany Rodriguez. Chamber business mixers provide an opportunity for chamber members and guests to establish, renew and maintain business contacts and relationships.
297a11b33416e604749a6123d5c44683f0f2ffb2.translatedText: 亞利桑那州中華商會於2014年12月10日在亞利桑那州大通球場的TGIF餐廳舉行了假日商務聯誼會響尾蛇職業棒球隊，位於鳳凰城。商會會長吳伯納德、官員及會員等50餘位嘉賓出席。特別嘉賓包括錢德勒市當選議員雷內·洛佩茲、鳳凰城姐妹城市總裁兼首席執行官保拉·韋斯特以及鳳凰城姐妹城副總裁里克·杰拉德。此外，商會企業贊助商 APS，由 Tiffany Rodriguez 代表。商會商務交流活動為商會會員和嘉賓提供了建立、更新和維持業務聯繫和關係的機會。

0fff27ff7fa04ff7d5f9fa3e433c3d1367fa0fbf.sourceText: The event capped off a busy year for the Chamber which included its annual Spring Banquet in April at the Great Wall Restaurant which brings together business, community and government leaders and chamber members; business networking mixers throughout the year; and a signature event in partnership with Arizona State University’s W.P. Carey School of Business: a seminar ”Handling Gift Giving When Doing Business in China.”
0fff27ff7fa04ff7d5f9fa3e433c3d1367fa0fbf.translatedText: 此次活動為商會忙碌的一年畫上了圓滿的句號，其中包括四月份在長城餐廳舉行的年度春季宴會，雲集了商界、社區和政府領導以及商會會員；全年商務社交活動；以及與亞利桑那州立大學 W.P. 合作舉辦的標誌性活動。凱裡商學院：「在中國做生意時處理禮品贈送」研討會。

f75b42b27e15cd2b22fc5811aa6a4a5b0f825b49.sourceText: ”The Chinese Chamber had another successful year for its members,” said Wu. ”We are proud to build upon the legacy of its founders.”
f75b42b27e15cd2b22fc5811aa6a4a5b0f825b49.translatedText: 「中國商會的會員們又度過了成功的一年，」吳說。 “我們很自豪能夠繼承其創始人的遺產。”

09fa8bad4f4c94a1753c68db27b0f1eea9b16704.sourceText: Special this year was a celebration of the Chamber’s 75th Anniversary at the Spring Banquet. The Chamber was founded in 1939 by a small group of Chinese immigrant merchants. Its members, similarly situated as the founders, supported each other by sharing business experiences, concerns and solutions with the goal of supporting their families and succeeding in their newly adopted country. Decades later, another generation is leading the Chamber and is implementing new ideas and establishing opportunities to support its members.
09fa8bad4f4c94a1753c68db27b0f1eea9b16704.translatedText: 今年的特別活動是在新春宴會上慶祝總商會成立75週年。該商會於1939年由一小群中國移民商人創立。其成員與創始人的處境相似，透過分享商業經驗、關注點和解決方案來相互支持，以支持他們的家庭並在新的國家取得成功。幾十年後，另一個世代正在領導商會，並正在實施新想法並創造機會來支持其會員。

01d93aebceb2d7eb6bd776bce347d1005a525489.sourceText: For more information about the Chinese Chamber visit www.ccocoarizona.org.

5cc0a154a5c74bce265f67e5b45c1465a527d6dd.sourceText: Phoenix, AZ — Asian American community leaders attended a fundraiser dinner in support of Senator Kimberly Yee’s re-election campaign for the Arizona Senate on October 21, 2014. The event was held at the Great Wall Restaurant and featured a patriotic-themed program.
5cc0a154a5c74bce265f67e5b45c1465a527d6dd.translatedText: 亞利桑那州菲尼克斯 — 2014 年 10 月 21 日，亞利桑那州參議員金連任大公會議，支持參議員 Kimberly Yee 參加參議院募款晚宴。活動在長城餐廳舉行

c0926295cc123e5f1cee6423262ad7302a7d0fc6.sourceText: The evening event opened with a presentation of the colors by the American Legion Thomas Tang Post 50, followed by the pledge of allegiance led by Jack J.F. Yee, father of Senator Kimberly Yee, and the singing of the National Anthem by Beverly Wu. Guests then participated in the singing of patriotic songs led by Jack J.F. Yee who served as the master of ceremonies. He shared his thoughts of how proud he was to have been born in America. He emphasized that the United States is an exceptional country which offers the best opportunities for success, that with a strong work ethic and excellence in education, any person can realize the American Dream.
c0926295cc123e5f1cee6423262ad7302a7d0fc6.translatedText: 晚會以美國退伍軍人協會 50 歲的托馬斯·唐 (Thomas Tang Post 50) 的色彩展示拉開帷幕，隨後由參議員金佰利 (Kimberly Yee) 的父親傑克·J·F·易 (Jack J.F. Yee) 喜樂。隨後，嘉賓們參與由餘家輝擔任司儀的愛國歌曲演唱。他分享了他對自己出生在美國感到多麼自豪的想法。他強調，美國是一個特殊的國家，提供了最好的成功機會，憑藉著強烈的職業道德和卓越的教育，任何人都可以實現美國夢。

7bf7adcecb7f1fc1458ab214199df24ef9f1bca8.sourceText: The opening speaker was Arizona State Republican Party Chairman Robert S. Graham who acknowledged Senator Yee as a ”rising star” of the Republican Party. He said that when they were in Washington, D.C. earlier in the year, Yee was recognized nationally for her work, and GOP party officials announced that she is someone who will continue to play a major role in shaping the party’s future.
7bf7adcecb7f1fc1458ab214199df24ef9f1bca8.translatedText: 亞利桑那州共和黨主席羅伯特·格雷厄姆（Robert S. Graham）致開幕詞，他稱讚餘參議員是共和黨的“後起之秀”。他說，今年早些時候，當他們在華盛頓特區時，易的工作得到了全國的認可，共和黨官員宣布她將繼續在塑造該黨的未來方面發揮重要作用。

9885c9a3d69446c189fd5ac3263819ae3d1bae6d.sourceText: Arizona Senate President Andy Biggs, who holds a bachelor’s degree in Asian Studies and a law degree from the University of Arizona, was the keynote speaker and spoke of Senator Yee’s experience in many policy areas and emphasized her passion for education policy issues. He addressed the importance of making an impact in our own communities.
9885c9a3d69446c189fd5ac3263819ae3d1bae6d.translatedText: 擁有亞利桑那大學亞洲研究學士學位和法學學位的亞利桑那州參議院議長安迪·比格斯（Andy Biggs）作為主講人，談到了易參議員在許多政策領域的經驗，並強調了她對教育政策問題的熱情。他談到了對我們自己的社區產生影響的重要性。

bab20cb045cced69e3fcd9f20217d8321492b99a.sourceText: Senator Yee closed the evening’s formal program by thanking the guests and sharing her family’s history in America, the land fondly referred to as ”Gold Mountain.” She shared about one of the most important lessons she was taught by her parents. She said, ”I was taught to appreciate your family’s history, your heritage and your culture so that you can be confident in who you are in order to boldly pursue every opportunity that comes your way. We can be stronger when we stand on the shoulders of those who preceded us.”
bab20cb045cced69e3fcd9f20217d8321492b99a.translatedText: 餘參議員感謝來賓並分享了她家族在美國的歷史，這片土地被親切地稱為“金山”。她分享了她父母教給她的最重要的課程之一。她說，「我被教導要欣賞你的家族歷史、你的傳統和你的文化，這樣你就可以對自己充滿信心，從而大膽地追求你遇到的每一個機會。當我們站在前人的肩膀上時，我們就會變得更強大。」

4fcee1464fbeea0d7c2837f594355f82934778e0.sourceText: ”I hope to return to the State Senate and continue to work for the people of my district and represent not only the community where I live, but also the Asian American community. I am committed to keeping our families safe, creating more jobs and strengthening education to provide opportunities for every family,” Yee said.
4fcee1464fbeea0d7c2837f594355f82934778e0.translatedText: 「我希望回到州參議院，繼續為我所在選區的美國社區，不僅代表我所在的社區，不僅代表我所在的社區，不僅代表我所在的社區，不僅代表我所在的社區，不僅代表我所在的社區，不僅代表我所在社區，不僅代表我所在的社區。說。

4c0ee1dc1d7a7bfb3a508bed1eb7873e1dbf4614.sourceText: By Barry Wong (Phoenix, Ariz.) ”Opportunity for All” is a prominent tagline used by the Doug Ducey for Governor campaign. The candidate had a chance to demonstrate his commitment to that phrase recently at the ”Asian American Leadership Roundtable with Doug Ducey” gathering at the University Club of Phoenix. Ducey talked about his position on issues such as education reform, the economy and economic development, tax reduction and low business regulations. He emphasized that he would be a governor of all the people of Arizona regardless of a person’s background, race, ethnicity or place of origin. The Roundtable had the usual exchange of questions and answers from audience members to the candidate. However, the uniqueness of this Roundtable was the time dedicated for each Asian ethnic community group, one-by-one, to educate and introduce Ducey to their respective communities. The Bangladesh community was led by Mahabub Rahim, M.D., Chinese by Garry Ong, Filipino by Leo Aromin, Indian by Venkat Kommineni, Korean by Jae Chin, Pakistani by Sardar Babar, Vietnamese by Kevin Dang and other Asians by Albert Lin. Ducey was focused and attentive as each community leader stepped forward to talk about their people, culture, history in Arizona, issues important to them and participation in the state as Arizonans and Americans. ”Each Asian community leader at the Roundtable was impressed by Doug’s interest in learning about their individual communities,”said Barry Wong, former legislator and corporation commissioner, and Co-chair, Asian Americans for Ducey. ”It is rare in this state that a candidate for high office would take the time and express genuine interest in learning about the unique ethnic groups which are commonly and collectively referred to as ‘Asians.’ ”Election Day is Tuesday, November 4, 2014. Polls open at 6:00am and close at 7:00pm; if you are in line by 7:00pm you will be allowed to vote. Remember to take government issued identification (driver license, ID-only card, passport) to the Poll. For election information (Poll location, voter registration status, description of ballot content) visit www.azsos.gov. Your vote is your voice.
4c0ee1dc1d7a7bfb3a508bed1eb7873e1dbf4614.translatedText: 作者：Barry Wong（亞利桑那州菲尼克斯）「人人享有機會」是 Doug Ducey 競選州長時使用的一句顯著口號。這位候選人最近有機會在鳳凰城大學俱樂部舉行的「道格·杜西的亞裔美國人領導力圓桌會議」上展示了他對這句話的承諾。杜西談到了他在教育改革、經濟和經濟發展、減稅和低商業監管等問題上的立場。他強調，他將成為亞利桑那州全體人民的州長，無論一個人的背景、種族、民族或原籍地。圓桌會議按照慣例，觀眾向候選人交換了問題和答案。然而，本次圓桌會議的獨特之處在於，我們專門為每個亞洲族裔社區群體一一教育杜西並將其介紹給各自的社區。孟加拉國社區由 Leo Aromin 醫學博士領導，中國人由 Garry Ong 領導，菲律賓人由 Leo Aromin 領導，印度人由 Venkat Kommineni 領導，韓國人由 Jae Chin 領導，巴基斯坦人由 Sardar Babar 領導，越南人由 Kevin Dang 領導，其他亞洲人由 Albert Lin 領導。當每位社區領袖上前談論他們在亞利桑那州的人民、文化、歷史、對他們來說重要的問題以及作為亞利桑那人和美國人參與該州時，杜西全神貫注、專心致志。 「圓桌會議上的每位亞裔社區領袖都對道格對了解各自社區的興趣印象深刻，」前立法者和公司專員、杜西亞裔美國人聯合主席巴里·黃 (Barry Wong) 說。 「在這個州，很少有高級職位候選人會花時間並表示真正有興趣了解通常統稱為『亞洲人』的獨特族裔群體。」選舉日為 2014 年 11 月 4 日星期二。投票於上午 6:00 開始，晚上 7:00 結束；如果您在晚上 7:00 之前排隊，您將被允許投票。請記得攜帶政府核發的身份證明（駕照、身分證、護照）前往投票站。有關選舉資訊（投票地點、選民登記狀態、選票內容說明），請造訪 www.azsos.gov。你的投票就是你的聲音。

113c9d026aa9d8190f495282bea7ad9111beafd7.sourceText: Experimental Chinese brush paintings by students of instructor Joan Yen went on display for public viewing on Monday, October 27, in the Chinle Building at Glendale Community College North located in north Glendale. Seventeen students presented their best paintings honoring the memory of their former teacher Joan Yen. Joan’s family attended the opening reception as honored guest of the art exhibition and was very impressed with all of the student’s creativity. Joan gave them the motivation to create with their feelings and it showed in the exhibit. ”I was very impressed and proud with what I saw in the creativity of the paintings of the students, said Joan’s husband, Richard Yen. ”They were certainly motivated by Joan in their work and all a great work of art.” As an instructor of Chinese art for many years at Scottsdale Community College Yen retired and continued teaching adult classes at Shemer Art Studio in Scottsdale, and Phoenix College. All of her Experimental Chinese Brush Art Painting classes became very popular and filled to capacity. Today, the class is continued and is taught by Phoenix College instructor Joy Baker. Student Karl Milbauer said, ”By sharing the history and traditions of Chinese painting and calligraphy, Joan gave us the gift of a strong foundation to evolve our own art while maintaining a connection to the past.” The Joan Yen Student Chinese Art Exhibition will be on display at GCC North from October 27 to November 13. Glendale Community College North is located at 5727 W. Happy Valley Road in Glendale.
113c9d026aa9d8190f495282bea7ad9111beafd7.translatedText: 10 月 27 日星期一，講師 Joan Yen 學生的實驗性中國水墨畫在位於格倫代爾北部的格倫代爾社區學院北的 Chinle 大樓向公眾展示。十七名學生展示了他們最好的畫作，以紀念他們的前老師甄瓊。瓊的家人作為藝術展的貴賓參加了開幕招待會，並對學生的創造力留下了深刻的印象。瓊給了他們用情感創作的動力，這點在展覽中得到了體現。瓊的丈夫理查德·顏 (Richard Yen) 表示：「學生們的繪畫創造力給我留下了深刻的印象，也讓我感到自豪。他們的工作當然受到了瓊的激勵，而且都是偉大的藝術作品。」作為在斯科茨代爾社區學院擔任多年中國藝術講師的顏氏退休後，繼續在斯科茨代爾謝默藝術工作室和鳳凰學院教授成人課程。她的實驗水墨畫課程都非常受歡迎，而且爆滿。今天，課程繼續，由鳳凰學院講師喬伊貝克授課。學生卡爾·米爾鮑爾 (Karl Milbauer) 表示：「透過分享中國書畫的歷史和傳統，瓊為我們提供了堅實的基礎，讓我們能夠發展自己的藝術，同時保持與過去的聯繫。」甄瓊學生中國藝術展將於10月27日至11月13日在GCC North展出。 Glendale Community College North位於Glendale W. 74042cecdc2df1b418f94a31cc7215d5e33d9fa7.sourceText: By Barry Wong Asian American is the fastest growing ethnic group in Arizona and is becoming more active in civic and political participation.
74042cecdc2df1b418f94a31cc7215d5e33d9fa7.translatedText: 作者：Barry Wong 亞裔美國人是亞利桑那州成長最快的族裔群體，在公民和政治參與方面也越來越活躍。

cf033245b1d90834e82e771e5d9d9fd9820a0431.sourceText: A national poll recently released by Asian Pacific Islander American Vote (APIAVote) and others show that at least 60%, and up to as many as 77%, of Asian American registered voters are planning to vote in the 2014 Midterm election. Further, 46% do not affiliate with a political party, compared to 37% that are Democrat and 17% Republican.
cf033245b1d90834e82e771e5d9d9fd9820a0431.translatedText: 亞太島民美國投票組織（APIAVote）等機構最近發布的一項全國民意調查顯示，至少 60%、高達 77% 的亞裔登記選民計劃在 2014 年中期選舉中投票。此外，46% 的人不屬於任何政黨，相較之下，37% 的人屬於民主黨，17% 的人屬於共和黨。

006806b677104569cdbac4f2caa47ef25bc2832a.sourceText: ”This growing base of Asian American voters remains mostly undecided,”said Christine Chen, executive director of APIAVote. ”Many are disengaged from politics because parties and candidates are not directly addressing them; our polling shows these votes are up for grabs.”
006806b677104569cdbac4f2caa47ef25bc2832a.translatedText: 「亞裔美國選民群體不斷擴大，但大多尚未做出決定，」APIAVote 執行董事 Christine Chen 表示。 “許多人脫離了政治，因為政黨和候選人沒有直接向他們講話；我們的民意調查顯示，這些選票是可以爭奪的。”

293a019920fd0bdae428a2e0a1963e848b535763.sourceText: Arizona politics and candidates have been active with the Asian American community ahead of that poll. Doug Ducey, candidate for Governor, has included Asian Americans as part of his campaign team. He secured the endorsements of State Senator Kimberly Yee and former legislator and corporation commissioner Barry Wong. His campaign coalition efforts have included the Asian American community with formation of ”Asian Americans for Ducey”; his Asian American coalition co-chairs include Kevin Dang and Mai Le (Vietnamese community), Jae Chin (Korean community), Garry Ong (Chinese community), Venkat Kommineni (Indian community), Marie Cunning (Filipino community), Peter Chan (Tucson’s Chinese community), Tony Kao (Taiwanese community), Albert Lin (Asian community) and Barry Wong (Asian/Chinese community) and others.
293a019920fd0bdae428a2e0a1963e848b535763.translatedText: 在這次民調之前，亞利桑那州政界和候選人一直積極與亞裔美國人社區互動。州長候選人道格杜西 (Doug Ducey) 將亞裔美國人納入其競選團隊。他獲得了州參議員 Kimberly Yee 和前立法議員兼公司專員 Barry Wong 的支持。他的競選聯盟努力包括亞裔美國人社區與「亞裔美國人支持杜西」的組成；他的亞裔美國人聯盟聯合主席包括 Kevin Dang 和 Mai Le（越南社區）、Jae Chin（韓國社區）、Garry Ong（華人社區）、Venkat Kommineni（印度社區）、Marie Cunning（菲律賓社區）、Peter Chan（Tony Chan） Wong（亞洲/華人社區）以及

e057e7ea7081e55c9ba20e97ad6986db195a853a.sourceText: ”Arizona’s Asian American community is an invaluable part of the state,” said Ducey. ”This multi-faceted community has many languages and unique cultures; our common focus on improving education allows us to collectively drive Arizona’s economy through hard work, entrepreneurship and determination. We share many of the same values and our undeniable commitment to improving our community is what brings us all together as Arizonans.”
e057e7ea7081e55c9ba20e97ad6986db195a853a.translatedText: 「亞利桑那州的亞裔美國人社區是該州的寶貴組成部分，」杜西說。 「這個多元化的社區擁有多種語言和獨特的文化；我們對改善教育的共同關注使我們能夠透過辛勤工作、創業精神和決心共同推動亞利桑那州的經濟發展。我們擁有許多相同的價值觀，而我們對改善社區的不可否認的承諾使我們亞利桑那人團結在一起。”

88a0ae2b6cf1380c211778388fc5b03f58f37fcc.sourceText: Further evidence of Arizona already understanding the importance of the Asian American vote: Arizona Republican Party Chairman Robert Graham, a graduate of the Thunderbird School of Global Management, established the AzGOP Asian American Coalition last year shortly after he was elected party chairman. ”Asian Americans have a long history in Arizona and are an important part of making our state a vibrant place to live, work and play,”said Graham. ”The Republican Party recognizes and respects the diversity that Asian Americans contribute.”
88a0ae2b6cf1380c211778388fc5b03f58f37fcc.translatedText: 亞利桑那州已經了解亞裔美國人投票的重要性的進一步證據是：亞利桑那州共和黨主席羅伯特·格雷厄姆畢業於雷鳥全球管理學院，去年當選黨主席後不久，他成立了亞利桑那州共和黨亞裔美國人聯盟。 「亞裔美國人在亞利桑那州有著悠久的歷史，他們是使我們的州成為一個充滿活力的生活、工作和娛樂場所的重要組成部分，」格雷厄姆說。 「共和黨承認並尊重亞裔美國人貢獻的多樣性。」

dd554116136157274152b9bb5389197346e4eaa3.sourceText: Asian Americans are an emerging force in politics and can make the difference in close elections. Some in Arizona politics are ahead of the curve. Early ballots will be in the mailbox soon and Election Day is Tuesday, November 4, 2014. Your vote is your voice.

c7701f67666988a2f1a399ac2f53cf821a14503e.sourceText: Featuring Concert Pianist Qingqing Ye on October 19th Fall in Music with the Scottsdale Philharmonic in its New Season, Featuring Concert Pianist Qingqing Ye (Scottsdale, AZ) Come and step into the fall season in Scottsdale Philharmonic’s 2014 Season opening concert, 4:00PM Sunday, October 19th, 2014 at Scottsdale Bible Church, 7601 E. Shea Blvd. The admission is FREE, while VIP tickets are available at $15/ each (more details at 480-951-6077) and your donation are highly appreciate, as always, to keep the music in community. The opening concert is programed with public’s highly favorites: Mozart’s Overture from the Magic Flute, Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A Minor, Op.16, and Schubert’s Symphony No. 5 in Bb Major. Featured concert pianist Qingqing Ye is to perform the Norwegian composer Edvard Grieg’s renowned Piano Concerto in A minor with the symphony. The work is among Grieg’s earliest important works, written by the 24-year-old composer in 1868. Grieg’s concerto is often compared to the Piano Concerto of Robert Schumann?it is in the same key, the opening descending flourish on the piano is similar, and the overall style is considered to be closer to Schumann than any other single composer. The Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, was the only concerto Grieg completed. A true gifted young artist who has received top prizes from national to international piano competitions, Ye has astonished the audience and critics by the depth of his musical insight, dazzling technique as well as his magnetic stage presence. He was appointed as the Artist-In-Resident by the Scottsdale Philharmonic after his performing Liszt’s first piano concerto in Eb major with the orchestra in the season of 2013. Starting his piano training at the tender age of four, Ye received his Bachelor’s Degree in piano performance from Bowling Green State University under Maxim Mogilevsky and Master’s Degree in piano performance from Northwestern University under Alan Chow. Currently he is a doctoral candidate in piano performance at ASU under the guidance of Professor Walter Cosand and serving as a faculty associate for ASU School of Music Prep Program. Besides being awarded the full scholarship from both institutes, he is also a recipient of the National Scholarship by the YAMAHA Music Foundation of China, the first prize winner at the 2006 Masterworks International Music Festival competition in Indiana, as well as the first prize at the 2005 Lima Young Artists Piano Competition in Ohio. Ye has become one of the most vigorous artists in the valley–his solo recitals could be heard in Tempe Center for the Art, Scottsdale Center for the Performing Arts, and Chandler Center for the Arts. He also has been invited to teach master classes and perform in some highly acclaimed universities in China, e.g. Chongqing Normal University and Beifang (North) University of Nationalities. The concert will take place at Scottsdale Bible Church on Oct. 19th at 4pm. For more information, please visit at http://www.scottsdalephilharmonic.com/

Shea Blvd) 7601 希爾茲代爾開幕的愛茨代爾館 7601 年樂團中舉行。入場免費，而 VIP 門票每張 15 美元（更多詳情請致電 480-951-6077），我們將一如既往地感謝您的捐款，讓音樂留在社區。開幕音樂會將演奏深受大眾喜愛的曲目：莫札特的《魔笛序曲》、葛利格的A小調鋼琴協奏曲Op.16和舒伯特的降B大調第五號交響曲。特邀音樂會鋼琴家葉青青將與交響曲一起演奏挪威作曲家愛德華·葛利格著名的A小調鋼琴協奏曲。該作品是格里格最早的重要作品之一，由24歲的作曲家於1868年創作。葛利格的協奏曲經常被拿來與羅伯特·舒曼的鋼琴協奏曲相比較，因為兩者的調性相同，鋼琴上的開頭下降花式也相似，整體風格被認為比任何其他單一作曲家更接近舒曼。 A小調鋼琴協奏曲，作品。 16號是格里格唯一完成的協奏曲。葉先生是一位真正有天賦的年輕藝術家，曾在國內和國際鋼琴比賽中獲得過最高獎項，他以深刻的音樂洞察力、令人眼花繚亂的技巧以及磁性的舞台表現力讓觀眾和評論家驚嘆不已。 2013年演出季，他與斯科茨代爾愛樂樂團合作演奏了李斯特的降E大調第一鋼琴協奏曲，並被任命為斯科茨代爾愛樂樂團的常駐藝術家。葉四歲開始接受鋼琴訓練，在馬克西姆·莫吉列夫斯基的指導下獲得鮑靈格林州立大學鋼琴演奏學士學位，並在周艾倫·週的指導下獲得西北大學鋼琴演奏碩士學位。目前，他是亞利桑那州立大學鋼琴演奏博士生，師從 Walter Cosand 教授，並擔任亞利桑那州立大學音樂學院預科課程的教員。除獲得兩院全額獎學金外，他還獲得中國雅馬哈音樂基金會國家獎學金、2006年印第安納州Masterworks國際音樂節比賽一等獎、2005年俄亥俄州利馬青年藝術家鋼琴比賽一等獎。葉已成為山谷中最有活力的藝術家之一——他的獨奏音樂會可以在坦佩藝術中心、斯科茨代爾表演藝術中心和錢德勒藝術中心聽到。他也受邀在中國一些知名大學教授大師班並表演。重慶師範大學、北方民族大學。音樂會將於 10 月 19 日下午 4 點在斯科茨代爾聖經教堂舉行。欲了解更多信息，請訪問 http://www.scottsdalephilharmonic.com/

2759a18e678151723000cf7e20e56f59a4b0d2cd.sourceText: The purpose of the Arizona Asian Pacific American Women Giving Circle (AAPAW) is to support and empower Asian Pacific women and girls in Arizona and enhance their outcomes in the areas of socio-emotional and physical health, economics and education. Ms Grace Lau, founder of the Circle is also the CEO of PacWest Financial Management. Arizona Community Foundation (ACF) and Asian Americans/Pacific Islanders in Philanthropy (AAPIP) will do matching grants for funding from members of the Circle. Up till now, the Circle has pooled a total of $40,000 and is ready to contribute to the relevant non-profit making organizations that are in need.
2759a18e678151723000cf7e20e56f59a4b0d2cd.translatedText: 亞利桑那州亞太裔美國女性捐贈圈 (AAPAW) 的目的是支持和賦權亞利桑那州的健康和身體教育、女性和女孩的健康和身體健康、社會經濟和身體教育、她們在社會和國家教育領域的健康、女性和情感領域的健康、社會經濟和身體教育和女性的健康領域。 Circle創辦人Grace Lau女士也是PacWest Financial Management的執行長。亞利桑那社區基金會 (ACF) 和亞裔美國人/太平洋島民慈善事業 (AAIP) 將為圈子成員的資金提供配套贈款。截至目前，Circle已籌集善款4萬美元，準備向有需要的相關非營利組織捐款。

1c8ae3c7498e2648e6554d21b3ad0a69ae895d31.sourceText: For information, ACF is Arizona’s premier charitable partner trusted by thousands of generous Arizonans. The Foundation has now over $600 million assets under management. Since 1978, Arizona donors have entrusted their charitable dollars and dreams to the ACF who has awarded more than $500 million in grants and scholarships.
1c8ae3c7498e2648e6554d21b3ad0a69ae895d31.translatedText: 了解一下，ACF是亞利桑那州首屈一指的慈善合作夥伴，深受成千上萬慷慨的亞利桑那州人信賴。該基金會目前管理著超過 6 億美元的資產。自 1978 年以來，亞利桑那州的捐助者將他們的慈善資金和夢想託付給 ACF，ACF 已頒發了超過 5 億美元的助學金和獎學金。

2b6ede0393f5b46b016ef58bd88049882aed35ec.sourceText: AAPIP is a national member-supported philanthropic advocacy organization which engages communities and philanthropy to address unmet needs; serves as a resource for and about AAPI communities; supports and facilitates giving by and to AAPI communities; and incubates new ideas and approaches to building democratic philanthropy.
2b6ede0393f5b46b016ef58bd88049882aed35ec.translatedText: AAIP 是一個由全國會員支持的慈善倡導組織，它吸引社區和慈善事業來解決未滿足的需求；充當 AAPI 社區的資源以及有關 AAPI 社區的資源；支持並促進 AAPI 社區的捐贈；並孵化建立民主慈善事業的新思想和新方法。

8f031d820140c741f0cc8b2a3bdfdc0404eaadfd.sourceText: (September 21, 2014 Tempe, ASU) China Forum has kept facilitating dialogue, generating great insights and bringing in richer understanding of Working with China in the Global Market in its sixth year with its distinguished panel speakers. Presented by the ASU Confucius Institute (ASU CI), School of International Letters and Cultures (SILC) and the United Chinese Association of Arizona (UCAA), 2014 China Forum was held in the Memorial Union Turquoise Ballroom of ASU Tempe campus, Sunday, 1:30 to 3:30 p.m., September 21. The symposium is a part of the Mid-Autumn Celebration, which continued in the Memorial Union’s Arizona Ballroom from 4-6 p.m. Representatives of the Consulate General of People’s Republic of China in Los Angeles, government dignitaries, and community leaders joined this celebration.
8f031d820140c741f0cc8b2a3bdfdc0404eaadfd.translatedText: （2014年9月21日，亞利桑那州立大學坦佩）中國論壇不斷促進對話，第六年，傑出的小組演講嘉賓對與中國在全球市場上的合作產生了深刻的見解並帶來了更豐富的理解。由亞利桑那州立大學孔子學院（ASU CI）、國際文學與文化學院（SILC）和亞利桑那州華人聯合會（UCAA）主辦的2014年中國論壇於9月21日（週日）下午1:30至3:30在亞利桑那州立大學坦佩校區紀念聯盟綠松石宴會廳舉行。本次研討會是中秋慶祝活動的一部分，中秋慶祝活動於2019年9月21日在亞利桑那州立大學紀念聯盟亞利桑那宴會廳繼續舉行。下午 4 點至 6 點中國駐洛杉磯總領事館代表、政府政要、社區領袖參加了此次慶典。

72978c7a7f2d49fb06d1e6e55637fb270f3aa8aa.sourceText: Emily Tadano and Daniel Shum from Najafi Inc. decoded Working with China in the Global Market through long shots of Chinese media space market. Najafi Companies is an international private investment firm based in Phoenix, Arizona, with offices in Los Angeles, New York, Paris, Toronto, London and holdings in sectors including consumer, media, technology, industrial, and real estate across seven countries. China Opportunities: Cultural Products and Media Industries shed lights on the burgeoning Chinese entertainment market and macro opportunities in the media space. The presentation also sketched an exciting scene of Hollywood’s pursuing Chinese customers in the climate of China’s actively promoting Chinese culture abroad. Randal Schulhauser, Sr. Product Development Manager at Medtronic, Inc., presented audiences with Medtronic’s summary history in North America and growth in Greater China over the past four decades. Medtronic’s operation in the past 18 years in China, especially, has been no short than an album of the diverse and depending approach of China working with the world in
72978c7a7f2d49fb06d1e6e55637fb270f3aa8aa.translatedText: Najafi Inc.的Emily Tadano和Daniel Shum透過中國媒體空間市場的長鏡頭解讀了在全球市場中與中國合作。 Najafi Companies 是一家總部位於亞利桑那州鳳凰城的國際私人投資公司，在洛杉磯、紐約、巴黎、多倫多、倫敦設有辦事處，並在七個國家/地區持有消費品、媒體、技術、工業和房地產等領域的股份。中國機會：文化產品和媒體產業揭示了蓬勃發展的中國娛樂市場和媒體領域的宏觀機會。發表會也勾勒出在中國積極向海外推廣中華文化的大背景下，好萊塢追捧中國客戶的激動人心的一幕。美敦力公司高級產品開發經理Randal Schulhauser向觀眾介紹了美敦力過去四十年在北美的歷史總結以及在大中華區的發展。尤其是美敦力過去18年在中國的運作，不啻為一部中國與世界合作的多元化、相互依存的畫冊。

6f8bd7ac781cbbaa8ecb002a20f9c5ad1c219e16.sourceText: which leading global players like Medtronic can find ever expanding opportunities. Randal is a holder of 4 patents with another 6 applications filed at the US Patent Office. Published multiple articles in peer reviewed literature. He is currently a board member for the Arizona Bioindustry Association (AZBio), board member for the Arizona Chapter of the American Diabetes Association (ADA), and industry representative for the American Heart Association (AHA). Jeff Wu, the Executive VP& Chief Marketing Officer at Pactera, closed up the forum by sharing the exciting Pactera Story: Path to Globalization. Pactera, the largest China based IT service company, has more than 22,000 professionals to serve larger engagements and provide a wider range of Business / IT consulting, solution, and outsourcing services to its global clients. Pactera’s meteoric rise in China Banking Solutions market in 2013 was a shining point in the industry and has successfully became the second largest domestic player, and overall third largest vendor in the China banking industry IT solutions market since 2013. Jeff Wu indicted that ”globalization seeks new market, new technology, cost efficiency, and IT service companies are the backbone behind all themes” His unique view towards acquisition and the global market as well as insights from his 20-plus years of IT marketing expertise were well received by audiences.
6f8bd7ac781cbbaa8ecb002a20f9c5ad1c219e16.translatedText: 像美敦力這樣的全球領導者可以找到不斷擴大的機會。 Randal 擁有 4 項專利，並向美國專利局提交了另外 6 項申請。在同行評審文獻中發表多篇文章。他目前是亞利桑那州生物工業協會 (AZBio) 的董事會成員、美國糖尿病協會 (ADA) 亞利桑那州分會的董事會成員以及美國心臟協會 (AHA) 的行業代表。文思海輝執行副總裁兼首席行銷長吳傑夫在論壇結束時分享了令人興奮的文思海輝故事：全球化之路。文思海輝是中國最大的 IT 服務公司，擁有超過 22,000 名專業人員，可以服務更大規模的業務，並為其全球客戶提供更廣泛的業務/IT 諮詢、解決方案和外包服務。 2013年文思海輝在中國銀行業IT解決方案市場的快速崛起成為業界的亮點，成功成為國內第二大廠商，自2013年以來成為中國銀行業IT解決方案市場整體第三大供應商。吳傑夫表示，“全球化尋求新市場、新技術、成本效率，IT服務公司是所有主題背後的支柱”，他對收購和全球市場的獨特看法以及20多年IT營銷專業知識的見解受到好評由觀眾。

d8d41294522514e7a4b42ffb72eb88db83d5fe59.sourceText: Distinguished speakers?enthusiastic speeches, invaluable insights and in-depth analysis with discussions generated great enthusiasm and further understanding towards the Chinese market in the globalization process. A China Forum luncheon for dignitaries and speakers preceded the forum in honor of the five speakers at the event. Other guests included Paula West, President of Phoenix Sister Cities, Christina Mackay, Director of Economic Development at the City of Phoenix, Allen Yang, VP of UHaul, Doug Bruhnke, CEO of Growth Nation, Steven Tu, Chief Architect of Intel Corp and Dave Cano, Sr. Engineering Manager at Medtronic.
d8d41294522514e7a4b42ffb72eb88db83d5fe59.translatedText: 各位演講嘉賓熱情洋溢的演講、寶貴的見解、深入的分析與討論，引發了人們對全球化進程中的中國市場的極大熱情和進一步的了解。論壇開始前，中國論壇為貴賓和演講者舉辦了午餐會，以表彰本次活動的五位演講者。其他嘉賓包括鳳凰城友好城市主席Paula West、鳳凰城經濟發展總監Christina Mackay、UHaul副總裁Allen Yang、Growth Nation執行長Doug Bruhnke、英特爾公司首席架構師Steven Tu、美敦力高級工程經理Dave Cano。

Special thanks to the forum planning committee chairs, Fannie Tam of ASU Confucius Institute and Tony Tam, committee member Kevin Wang, Jian Fei, Allen Yang and numerous volunteers for making this event a great success.

c48df720e0cc86730e7088ce9d2ea645d4b88c56.sourceText: By Barry Wong (Scottsdale/Phoenix) Asian Americans are making inroads in American politics. The Arizona Republican Party hosted a dinner event featuring Utah Senator Mike Lee at the Scottsdale Plaza Resort on September 12, 2014.
c48df720e0cc86730e7088ce9d2ea645d4b88c56.translatedText: 作者：Barry Wong（斯科茨代爾/菲尼克斯） 亞裔美國人正在侵入美國政治。 2014 年 9 月 12 日，亞利桑那州共和黨在斯科茨代爾廣場度假村舉辦了一場由猶他州參議員麥克李 (Mike Lee) 主持的晚宴活動。

5f561f3bcd9d41d7be90cd0d339a2b1332a0a46c.sourceText: The Asian American Coalition of the Arizona Republican Party was well represented at the event. GOP Chairman Robert Graham publicly acknowledged the large contingent of Coalition members and their guests attending. He said, ”the Arizona Republican Party has been working hard to include Arizonans from all backgrounds including the Asian American communities and they have welcomed me and the Party to their many community gatherings.”
5f561f3bcd9d41d7be90cd0d339a2b1332a0a46c.translatedText: 亞利桑那州共和黨的亞裔美國人聯盟派代表出席了這場活動。共和黨主席羅伯特·格雷厄姆公開承認大批聯盟黨成員及其嘉賓出席。他說，「亞利桑那州共和黨一直在努力吸引來自各種背景的亞利桑那州人，包括亞裔美國人社區，他們歡迎我和該黨參加他們的許多社區聚會。」

a509d747f35bd926265212d7d6b785cff82a4360.sourceText: Coalition Chairman Barry Wong has been working closely with leaders of many Asian communities emphasizing the importance of political engagement and voting in Arizona and America. ”Leaders in Arizona’s various Asian communities understand the importance of participating in the American system of politics and the power of voting,” said Wong. ”Attending Party events and meeting Party leaders and members is part of engagement.”
a509d747f35bd926265212d7d6b785cff82a4360.translatedText: 聯盟主席巴里·黃一直與許多亞裔社區的領導人密切合作，強調政治參與和投票在亞利桑那州和美國的重要性。 「亞利桑那州各亞裔社區的領導人都了解參與美國政治體系和投票權的重要性，」黃說。 「參加黨的活動並且會見黨的領導人和黨員是參與的一部分。」

4c529514ade743666d77ab881376fe348fa21561.sourceText: Coalition members attending and their guests included: from the Vietnamese Community – Kevin Dang, Mai Le, Dr. Sang Nguyen and Eileen Nguyen; Indian Community – Venkat Kommineni and Jegadesan Krishnamurthy; Korean Community – Whansik Choi, Kunsang Choi and Kaye Won; Chinese Community – Bernard Wu and Barry Wong; Taiwanese Community – Sam Huang; Asian Community – Astria Wong and Albert Lin.
4c529514ade743666d77ab881376fe348fa21561.translatedText: 出席的聯盟成員及其嘉賓包括：來自越南社區的Kevin Dang、Mai Le、Sang Nguyen博士和Eileen Nguyen；印度社區 – Venkat Kommineni 和 Jega Nguyen博士和Eileen Nguyen； Barry Wong；台灣社區 – Sam Huang；亞洲社區 – Astria Wong 和 Albert Lin。

c4bca3c2d8cfb749f25c10c725107f94493d41d4.sourceText: Senator Lee, an Arizona native until his father moved the family to Utah, was elected to represent Utah four years ago to become one of the youngest senators to serve in the United States Senate. Because of his youthful looks, he said Senate security personnel initially blocked him from accessing the Senate Floor and Dining Room mistaking him for a staff person or intern.
c4bca3c2d8cfb749f25c10c725107f94493d41d4.translatedText: 李參議員是亞利桑那州人，直到他的父親舉家搬到猶他州，四年前被選為猶他州代表，成為美國參議院最年輕的參議員之一。他說，由於他年輕的外表，參議院保全人員最初阻止他進入參議院樓層和餐廳，誤以為他是工作人員或實習生。

6573c45ab3b68b9777ea4f18af8ddf947c352f9e.sourceText: An aside, his father, Rex Lee, organized and became the first dean of the law school at Brigham Young University, and later became the U.S. Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan.
6573c45ab3b68b9777ea4f18af8ddf947c352f9e.translatedText: 另外，他的父親雷克斯·李 (Rex Lee) 組織並成為楊百翰大學法學院的第一任院長，後來成為羅納德·雷根總統領導下的美國副檢察長。

f32226f1bd6a75fa4ebc84753177f60ff1028f93.sourceText: Senator Lee was a practicing lawyer focusing on court case appeals including to the U.S. Supreme Court; he is an expert on U.S. Constitutional law. As a Senator he focuses on maintaining and restricting federal policies to the confines of the Constitution.
f32226f1bd6a75fa4ebc84753177f60ff1028f93.translatedText: 李參議員是一位專注於法庭的執業律師案件上訴，包括向美國最高法院提出上訴；他是美國憲法專家。作為參議員，他致力於在憲法的範圍內維持和限制聯邦政策。

Chinese Dance Celebration ($15.00/ each) (Chandler, AZ) Celebrate Chinese Mid-Autumn Festival locally?Embrace 2014 Mid-autumn Festival with incredible Chinese dance performance and complimentary Chinese cultural activities at the Chandler Center for the Arts (CCA), Sunday, September 14, 2014. Chinese Dance Celebration is a great outing for entire family with price tag of $15 per ticket. Tickets are available at Chandler Center for the Arts box office. 480.782.2680
7f359774894924c2f6a276cae4416c5426638578.translatedText: 2014年中秋中國舞蹈藝術節 下午1:30 中國工藝美術（免費對外開放） 下午4:00。中國舞蹈慶典（每場 15.00 美元）（亞利桑那州錢德勒）在當地慶祝中國中秋佳節？ 2014 年 9 月 14 日星期日，在錢德勒藝術中心 (CCA) 舉辦精彩的中國舞蹈表演和免費的中國文化活動，迎接 2014 年中秋節。藝術節的第一場活動「中國藝術與手工藝」於 1:30 在 CCA 大廳免費向公眾開放。誠摯邀請您體驗豐富多彩的文化活動、中國書法迷你工作坊、樂器示範、中國圖片展等。隨後下午 4:00 在 CCA 主舞台上演中國舞蹈慶典。經典、民族、民間，生動的表演帶您踏上一場精彩的中國表演藝術之旅、歷史之旅、生活之旅、激情之旅。中國舞蹈慶典是適合全家出遊的好去處，每張門票 15 美元。門票可在錢德勒藝術中心售票處購買。 480.782.2680

061974647bafb8aa59f590d65db7008f9be48674.sourceText: Mid-autumn Moon Festival: Mid-autumn Moon Festival, a centuries-old harvest festival, is one of the most important ancient festival in China and many Asian countries. Like American Thanksgiving in certain way, Mid-autumn Festival is deeply rooted in celebration of harvest time and spending quality time with family and friends. It is also uniquely associated with customs like appreciation of the full moon, enjoying moon cakes and watching themed performances. ”May we live long and share the beauty of the moon together, even if we are hundreds of miles apart,”says the romantic Chinese poem thousand years ago. 2014 Mid-Autumn Chinese Dance and Art Festival brings the opportunity of celebrating a ancient world festival l in Chandler, Arizona with a lots of fun. Who: Presented by the Eastern Art Academy and ASU Confucius Institute Eastern Art Academy is a Chandler art organization that has pride to serve its community and beyond. It provides focused, high-standard Chinese arts and cultural training programs for youth and adults including Chinese Dance Series, Fine Arts, Martial arts, Tai Chi, Traditional Chinese Painting, Bilingual Language Program, and more. ASU Confucius Institute: The Confucius Institute at Arizona State University aims in promoting Chinese language and culture studies in schools as well as throughout the Arizona’s general public. Through collaboration with campus, community, K-12 schools and China-based educational partners, the ASU Confucius Institute develops programs that provide opportunity for the study of Chinese language and culture in Arizona and China.
061974647bafb8aa59f590d65db7008f9be48674.translatedText: 中秋節：中秋節是一個有著數百年歷史的豐收節日，是中國和許多亞洲國家最重要的古代節日之一。在某種程度上，就像美國的感恩節一樣，中秋節深深植根於慶祝豐收的時刻以及與家人和朋友共度美好時光。它也與賞月、吃月餅、觀看主題表演等習俗有著獨特的連結。千年前的中國浪漫詩句寫道：「縱使相隔百里，壽終正寢，共賞月色。」2014年中秋中國舞蹈藝術節為亞利桑那州錢德勒帶來了慶祝古代世界節日的機會，充滿樂趣。人物：由東方藝術學院和亞利桑那州立大學孔子學院主辦 東方藝術學院是一個錢德勒藝術組織，以服務社區及其他領域為榮。為青少年和成人提供有針對性、高水準的中國藝術文化培訓項目，包括中國舞系列、美術、武術、太極拳、國畫、雙語課程等。亞利桑那州立大學孔子學院：亞利桑那州立大學孔子學院旨在促進學校以及亞利桑那州公眾的中國語言和文化研究。透過與校園、社區、K-12學校和中國教育合作夥伴合作，亞利桑那州立大學孔子學院開發項目，為亞利桑那州和中國學習中國語言和文化提供機會。

China Forum at ASU on Sept. 21 The ASU Confucius Institute (ASU CI), School of International Letters and Cultures (SILC) and the United Chinese Association of Arizona (UCAA ) cordially invite you to attend the sixth China forum’s working with China in the Global Market-from 1:30 to 3:30 p.m., Sept. 21 (Sunday) in the Memorial Union Turquoise Ballroom of ASU Tempe campus. 1627fc5f034838ee1ae6bcda8577ec14bcf08877.sourceText: OCA – Asian Pacific American Advocates is a national membership driven organization dedicated to advancing the social, political, and economic well-being of Asian Pacific Americans, touching tens of thousands of individuals each year through its extensive network of over 100 chapters, affiliates, and partners from around the country. In addition, the organization strives to foster development, leadership, and engagement through its various programs. OCA is engaged in organizing its over 100 chapters and affiliates across the nation to develop both leadership and community involvement. OCA chapters and our affiliates are establishing strong local programs in all parts of the country. OCA’s headquarters in Washington, D.C. gives the OCA National Center an effective vantage point for monitoring legislation and policy issues affecting Asian Pacific Americans. In addition, OCA is able to build national support and to work in coalition with other national groups around issues affecting Asian Pacific Americans.
1627fc5f034838ee1ae6bcda8577ec14bcf08877.translatedText: OCA – 亞太裔美國倡議者組織是一個全國性驅動會員的組織，致力於社會經濟和經濟福祉多個分會的廣泛網絡影響數以萬計的人，來自全國各地的分支機構和合作夥伴。此外，該組織還致力於透過各種計劃促進發展、領導力和參與度。 OCA 致力于组织全国 100 多个分会和附属机构，以培养领导力和社区参与。 OCA 分會和我們的附屬機構正在全國各地建立強大的本地計畫。 OCA 總部位於華盛頓特區，為 OCA 國家中心提供了有效的有利位置來監控影響亞太裔美國人的立法和政策問題。此外，OCA 能夠圍繞影響亞太裔美國人的問題建立全國性的支持並與其他國家團體合作。

74fec178a8f974ed915ed23c6ae8969702eaa92b.sourceText: On 28th June, 2014, The Rising Asian Pacific American Coalition for Diversity (RAPACD), Nevada, arranged a luau event at their newly opened RAPACD cultural center & Isla Vegas, The Ninth Island TV show studio. The event was organized to honor the Presidents and officers of two Arizona based nonprofit organizations. Ms. Mari C. Dillard, President of Arizona Asian American Association ( AAAA),and Ethel Luzario, CEO and President of 3000 club and many officers from both organizations were warmly greeted by Salve Vargas Edelman, Founder and President of RAPACD; Executive Director of RAPACD Cultural Center; and the Creator, Executive Producer, Director, and Host of Isla Vegas, the Ninth Island TV Show, which airs on My News3’s Dt3.2 and Cox Cable 123, COZI TV on Sundays from 8:00 to 8:30 a.m. Ms. Edelman will be profiled in the 16th Special Edition Distinguished Women in Nevada book for 2014. Her biography and portrait will highlight her many accomplishments through the years in the state of Nevada.
74fec178a8f974ed915ed23c6ae8969702eaa92b.translatedText: 2014年6月28日，內華達州崛起的亞太裔美國人多樣性聯盟（RAPACD）在其新開幕的RAPACD文化中心和第九島電視演播室舉辦了一場夏威夷活動。該活動的組織目的是為了表彰亞利桑那州兩個非營利組織的主席和官員。亞利桑那州亞裔協會（AAAA）主席Mari C. Dillard女士、3000俱樂部首席執行官兼主席Ethel Luzario及雙方多位官員受到RAPACD創始人兼主席Salve Vargas Edelman的熱情接待； RAPCD文化中心執行主任； Cable 123、COZI TV 上播出。 Edelman 女士將在 2014 年第 16 版內華達傑出女性特別版書中介紹。她的傳記和肖像將透過以下方式突出介紹她的許多成就：在內華達州的那些年。

531eb34755f432e189851b4cd6f5f54d5cb6ee98.sourceText: AAAA officers those who accompanied Ms. Mari Dillard were Farhana Shifa Ahmed – Vice President; Bianca Amin,-Secretary, Maridith Esquivel- Treasurer and Raphael Ahmed- Director at large and 2014 AAAA festival Chair. 3000 Club guests were Lolita Steele, August Heiss and Stephanie Angels. Along with Ms. Salve, Tusi Alston, RAPACD Treasurer and the Owner and Director of Operation, Heart of Polynesia; Pam Phan, RAPACD Membership Director; Shirley Rago, Maori Community Leader were present to make this event a delightful experience. The Heart of Polynesia Dancers who performed cultural dances from Hawaii, Samoa, and New Zealand entertained guests. It was a real educating and entertaining part for the audience. Ms. Dillard of AAAA expressed the richness of AAAA’s cultural, education resources, and many involvements of community works. AAAA is proudly collaborating with 3000 Club’s activities under Mari’ss lead for a long time. Ms. Luzario, who was past President of Lions Club and current CEO and President of 3000 club, is recently honored as Positively Powerful Women award, shared her initiatives of Market on the Move and medical helps to the Philippines. Ms. Edelman, President of RAPACD, shared her vision of collaboration of cultural groups regardless of their origin and nationality. These three powerful, amazingly active community leaders and creative women symbolized the power of true friendship and togetherness. Empowering members and creating successful leaders are the common goals of these leaders. RAPACD and AAAA members shared their vision of bringing the cultural treasures and community on the spotlight, community involvement and educating young generation about the heritage, culture and preserving the community treasures that are slowly fading away. AAAA and RAPACD also discussed about exchange programs and doing events jointly in the near future. This event confirmed a firm collaboration of efforts to bring Nevada and Arizona closer. Raphael Ahmed invited RAPACD, Isla Vegas, the Ninth Island TV show and Heart of Polynesia to attend AAAA’s 20th Festival, ”Asian Treasures”, which will be held at Mesa Art Center in Arizona on November 8th and 9Th, 2014. AAAA will feature 14 different cultures. This year AAAA will bring many guest cultures, special features to engage all ages. We are inviting you to join us this year in celebrating Asian arts, kids’ activities, foods, entertainment, and educational programs.
531eb34755f432e189851b4cd6f5f54d5cb6ee98.translatedText: 陪同 Mari Dillard 女士的 AAAA 官員是 Farhana Shifa Ahmed – 副總統； Bianca Amin（秘書）、Maridith Esquivel（財務主管）和 Raphael Ahmed（總導演兼 2014 年 AAAA 音樂節主席）。 3000 位俱樂部嘉賓包括 Lolita Steele、August Heiss 和 Stephanie Angels。與 Salve 女士一起，RAPACD 財務主管兼 Heart of Polynesia 所有者兼營運總監 Tusi Alston 女士； Pam Phan，RAPACD 會員總監；毛利社區領袖雪莉·拉戈 (Shirley Rago) 出席了本次活動，使這次活動成為一次愉快的經歷。波利尼西亞之心舞者表演了來自夏威夷、薩摩亞和紐西蘭的文化舞蹈，招待了來賓。對觀眾來說，這是一個真正具有教育意義和娛樂性的部分。 AAAA的Dillard女士表達了AAAA文化、教育資源的豐富性以及對社區工作的廣泛參與。 AAAA 很自豪能夠在 Mari 的領導下與 3000 俱樂部的活動進行長期合作。前任獅子會主席、現任3000俱樂部首席執行官兼主席的Luzario女士最近榮獲“積極力量女性獎”，她分享了她對移動市場和對菲律賓醫療援助的倡議。 RAPCD 主席 Edelman 女士分享了她對文化團體合作的願景，無論其來源和國籍為何。這三位強大而活躍的社區領袖和富有創造力的女性象徵著真正友誼和團結的力量。賦予成員權力並培養成功的領導者是這些領導者的共同目標。 RAPCD 和 AAAA 成員分享了他們的願景，讓文化寶藏和社區成為人們關注的焦點、社區參與以及教育年輕一代了解遺產、文化並保護正在慢慢消失的社區寶藏。 AAAA和RAPACD也討論了近期的交換計畫和共同舉辦活動的事宜。這項活動證實了為拉近內華達州和亞利桑那州的距離而做出的堅定合作。 Raphael Ahmed 邀請 RAPCD、維加斯島、第九島電視節目和波利尼西亞之心參加 AAAA 第 20 屆藝術節“亞洲瑰寶”，該藝術節將於 2014 年 11 月 8 日至 9 日在亞利桑那州梅薩藝術中心舉行。 AAAA 將展現 14 種不同的文化。今年，AAAA 將帶來多種賓客文化和特色活動，吸引各個年齡層的遊客。今年我們邀請您加入我們，慶祝亞洲藝術、兒童活動、美食、娛樂和教育計畫。

92b8c1c132e721ee788faf81c71c48691c18e369.sourceText: Chinese United Association of Greater Phoenix (CUAGP) welcomes our community to the 2014 4th of July celebration. This year, the festivities will be held at the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saints located at 3920 N. 44th Place in Phoenix (just east of 44th Street, on Indianola Street, south of Indian School Road). The admission is FREE with a FREE ticket that you can obtain at Super L Ranch Market, Great Wall Restaurant, The Eastern Art Academy, or at the church on the day of the 4th. The celebration will begin a 11:00 am when the American Legion Thomas Tang Post 50 will post our nation’s colors that will start the day’s activities. The traditional lion dance will be performed bringing everyone good luck and good fortune to everyone attending. A buffet lunch will be served from 12:00 noon until 2:00 pm. The traditional American hot dog and hamburger will be served with a buffet lunch of BBQ chicken, pulled pork and watermelon. Also, Chinese fried rice and stir-fried noodles will be on the menu. At 2:00pm a talent and fashion show for the whole family will be presented on stage with singing, dancing, and colorful Chinese costumes on display. There will be games for all ages that will be set up during the day’s activities. You will see a children art exhibit, Mahjong and chess open, ping-pong, and kid’s water volleyball. Participation is encouraged for these exciting events. Make sure you purchase raffle tickets and win big prizes. For only one dollar you can win something the whole family can enjoy. It’s the 4th of July and it’s FREE. Come on out and enjoy the fun on our nation’s birthday.
92b8c1c132e721ee788faf81c71c48691c18e369.translatedText: 大鳳凰城華人聯合會 (CUAGP) 歡迎社區參加 2014 年 7 月 4 日慶祝活動。今年的慶祝活動將在鳳凰城北 44 街 3920 號的耶穌基督後期聖徒教會舉行（就在第 44 街以東、印第安諾拉街、印第安學校路以南）。入場免費，您可以在超級L牧場市場、長城餐廳、東方藝術學院或4日當天在教堂獲得免費門票。慶祝活動將於上午 11:00 開始，屆時美國軍團 Thomas Tang Post 50 將張貼我們國家的顏色，開始當天的活動。傳統的舞獅表演將為大家帶來好運和好運。中午 12:00 至下午 2:00 供應自助午餐。傳統的美式熱狗和漢堡將搭配燒烤雞肉、手撕豬肉和西瓜的自助午餐。此外，菜單上還包括中式炒飯和炒麵。下午 2:00，舞台上將上演一場適合全家的才藝和時尚表演，有歌有舞，還有色彩繽紛的中國服飾。當天的活動期間將舉辦適合所有年齡層的遊戲。您將看到兒童藝術展覽、麻將和國際象棋公開賽、乒乓球和兒童水上排球。我們鼓勵您參與這些令人興奮的活動。確保您購買抽獎券並贏得大獎。只需一美元，您就可以贏得全家人都可以享受的東西。今天是 7 月 4 日，而且免費。快來享受我們國家生日的樂趣。

f5941a6e053f47ef1667dc89859ea1c69a4c4cee.sourceText: Oh, say! can you see by the dawn’s early light What so proudly we hailed at the twilight’s last gleaming; Whose broad stripes and bright stars, through the perilous fight, O’er the ramparts we watched were so gallantly streaming? And the rocket’s red glare, the bombs bursting in air, Gave proof through the night that our flag was still there: Oh, say! does that star-spangled banner yet wave O’er the land of the free and the home of the brave?
f5941a6e053f47ef1667dc89859ea1c69a4c4cee.translatedText: 哦，說吧！你能在黎明的曙光中看到什麼嗎我們在暮色最後的微光中如此自豪地歡呼；誰的寬條紋和明亮的星星，在危險的戰鬥中，在我們所看到的城牆上如此英勇地流淌？火箭的紅色光芒，炸彈在空中爆炸，整夜證明我們的旗幟仍然在那裡：哦，說！那面星條旗還飄揚在自由之地和勇敢者的家園嗎？

8adf36ddd4003d77575b314d1ed8349d18b57408.translatedText: 博士。 Anthony T. 和 Eileen K. Yeung 內視鏡脊椎中心醫生和病人受益於最小侵入性脊椎手術技術

7f8fc829da0dd9a43a8c48f1f513f6f7917aae57.sourceText: Phoenix, AZ, April 25, 2014: The University of New Mexico School of Medicine welcomed Dr. Anthony Yeung on April 25, 2014 for the dedication of the Anthony T. and Eileen K. Yeung Endoscopic Spine Center. A graduate of the UNM School of Medicine, Dr. Yeung was pleased to bring his endoscopic techniques and instrumentation to an academic setting at his alma mater, where physicians are trained in Yeung’s techniques and patients have access to the least invasive spine surgery in a multi-disciplinary team approach.
7f8fc829da0dd9a43a8c48f1f513f6f7917aae57.translatedText: 亞利桑那州菲尼克斯，2014 年 4 月 25 日：新墨西哥大學醫學院於 2014 年 4 月 25 日在 Anthony Anthony Tung 脊椎精神中心的精神內視鏡中找到精神中心。作為新墨西哥大學醫學院的畢業生，楊醫生很高興將他的內視鏡技術和儀器帶入母校的學術環境，在那裡醫生接受了楊醫生的技術培訓，患者可以通過多學科團隊的方法進行微創脊柱手術。

b88ba2531faeff0a45d394d449e16bacb892278a.sourceText: left to right: Dr. Howard Yonas, Eileen Yeung, Dr. Anthony Yeung, and Dean Paul Roth. Photo by Sara Mota
b88ba2531faeff0a45d394d449e16bacb892278a.translatedText: 從左到右：Howard Yonas 醫生、Eileen Yeung、Anthony Yeung 醫生和 Paul Roth 院長。攝影：Sara Mota

395c8419b53d84b85607939fc98178c4e94d81af.sourceText: Dr. Yeung, who lives and practices at Desert Institute for Spine Care in Phoenix, Arizona developed the FDA-approved Yeung Endoscopic Spine Surgery system (YESStm) in the 1990s, which is now performed by surgeons at UNM. He took the concept of the knee scope and brought it to the spine, using a transforaminal approach and visualized endoscopic instrumentation he pioneered allowing for significantly smaller incisions. For patients, this means outpatient surgery, preservation of muscle and bone equating to more movement, and a quicker recovery.
395c8419b53d84b85607939fc98178c4e94d81af.translatedText: 博士。 Yeung 在亞利桑那州鳳凰城的沙漠脊椎護理研究所生活和實踐，於 20 世紀 90 年代開發了 FDA 批准的 Yeung 內視鏡脊椎手術系統 (YESStm)，目前由新墨西哥大學的外科醫生進行。他採用了膝關節鏡的概念，並將其引入脊柱，採用經椎間孔入路和他首創的可視化內視鏡器械，允許顯著更小的切口。對患者來說，這意味著門診手術、保留肌肉和骨骼（相當於更多的運動）和更快的恢復。

1cc8d0fa6dfbb1041564ea7261baafeae71ed7d6.sourceText: Marrying the laser and the endoscope, Dr. Yeung developed a multi-channel device that allows surgeons to visualize and selectively remove portions of a herniated nucleus contributing to back and leg pain. The sleek 2.7mm operating channel uses a keyhole incision to access the damaged disc, dilating rather than cutting muscle and tissue, resulting in less tissue destruction, no need for general anesthesia, and a quicker recovery. This procedure is used to treat herniated, protruded, extruded, or degenerative discs in the lumbar spine, a very common condition.
1cc8d0fa6dfbb1041564ea7261baafeae71ed7d6.translatedText: 楊博士將雷射和內視鏡結合起來，開發了一種多通道設備，使外科醫生能夠可視化並選擇性地切除導致背部和腿部疼痛的突出髓核部分。光滑的 2.7 毫米操作通道使用鎖孔切口進入受損的椎間盤，擴張而不是切割肌肉和組織，從而減少組織破壞，無需全身麻醉，恢復更快。此手術用於治療腰椎間盤突出、突出、突出或退化性病變，這是一種非常常見的病症。

e4e23d8d82aea12c8f1e65f9becf3b841165966b.sourceText: ”What guided me was my own personal experience with my mother who had spine surgery when I was a resident. She was worse after her surgery. I thought there had to be a better way,” Dr. Yeung expressed. ”I wanted to bring this to UNM because there is already a team of like-minded physicians in place here who are interested in working with patients to find the source of their pain.”
e4e23d8d82aea12c8f1e65f9becf3b841165966b.translatedText: 「指導我的是我母親在住院期間接受脊椎手術的親身經歷。她手術後情況更糟。我認為必須有更好的方法。」楊醫師說。 「我想把這個帶到新墨西哥州，因為這裡已經有一個由志同道合的醫生組成的團隊，他們有興趣與患者合作，找到他們疼痛的根源。」

d8ced3aa9348f5b6a222679aabf3f45bbeb718f1.sourceText: ”Every patient who comes to us is evaluated by a multi-disciplinary team,” said Dr. J. Fred Harrington, assistant professor of neurosurgery and director of the new endoscopic spine surgery center. He explained that the Sandoval Regional Medical Center facility is part of the UNM Interdisciplinary Center for Spine Health.
d8ced3aa9348f5b6a222679aabf3f45bbeb718f1.translatedText: 「每一位來我們這裡的患者都會接受多學科團隊的評估，」神經外科助理教授兼新內視鏡脊椎手術中心主任 J. Fred Harrington 博士說。他解釋說，桑多瓦爾地區醫療中心設施是新墨西哥州脊椎健康跨學科中心的一部分。

644ab0ac4cf836b2d5797b79ca8123d7c723bb99.sourceText: Dr. Yeung stated, ”Endoscopic foraminal spine surgery offers the least invasive surgical solution to visualizing and treating the pain generators without burning any bridges for traditional more invasive procedures that have higher surgical morbidity.” Patients want less invasive options as opposed to fusion, and the faculty at UNM agree and practice what they preach, as one of their own is scheduled for surgery with Dr. Yeung in the coming month.
644ab0ac4cf836b2d5797b79ca8123d7c723bb99.translatedText: 楊醫師表示：「內視鏡椎間孔手術提供了侵入性最小的手術解決方案，可以觀察和治療疼痛源，而不會為傳統的侵入性手術（手術發病率較高）造成任何麻煩。」患者想要的是侵入性較小的選擇，而不是融合術，新墨西哥大學的教職人員同意並實踐他們的主張，因為他們自己的一位教職員計劃在下個月與楊手術。

4b8668c055989547aa5252f27016205aa2194740.sourceText: Madeline Spring, director of the Chinese Language Flagship program and Confucius Institute at ASU, is named Gary S. Krahenbuhl Difference Maker for 2014. Photo by: Tom Story
4b8668c055989547aa5252f27016205aa2194740.translatedText: 亞利桑那州立大學中文旗艦計畫與孔子學院主任馬德琳‧克拉恩（Madeline Spring）被評為2014年旗艦計畫與孔子學院主任馬德琳‧克拉恩（Madeline Spring）被評為2014年蓋瑞特·伊布隆德（GaryS.Sva.）。攝影：Tom Story

bc945515b674aa1525dc3a9d54d2b670f304bd50.sourceText: Professor Madeline Spring has been selected to receive the 2014 Gary S. Krahenbuhl Difference Maker Award presented by ASU’s Col lege of Liberal Arts and Sciences.
bc945515b674aa1525dc3a9d54d2b670f304bd50.translatedText: 馬德琳·斯普林教授入選由亞利桑那州立大學文理學院頒發的 2014 年加里·S·克拉恩布爾傑出貢獻者獎。

d8bc5932765433f9f817c4f0d8df4723adaf8e59.sourceText: The annual award was established through generous contributions of faculty, staff and friends of ASU to recognize and celebrate a faculty member who personifies the spirit of difference-making demonstrated by Krahenbuhl, a former dean of the college.
d8bc5932765433f9f817c4f0d8df4723adaf8e59.translatedText: 該年度獎項是在亞利桑那州立大學的教職員工和朋友們的慷慨捐助下設立的，旨在表彰和表彰一位體現了該學院前院長 Krahenbuhl 所展現的變革精神的教員。

57cc072d3aa37b68ae39be781ef5a702beee1d29.sourceText: A distinguished professor of Chinese, Spring is the director of the Chinese Language Program in the School of International Letters and Cultures. Her research endeavors include the study of medieval Chinese literature and current issues in Teaching Chinese as a Foreign Language (TCFL). In that area, her focus is on curricular design and implementation, teacher training, computer-based instruction, intercultural communication and second language acquisition and assessment. She is the author of ‘Making Connections: Improve Your Listening Comprehension in Chinese,’ now in its second edition.
57cc072d3aa37b68ae39be781ef5a702beee1d29.translatedText: Spring 是一位傑出的中文教授，國際文學學院漢語言專業主任。她的研究領域包括中世紀中國文學和對外漢語教學（TCFL）的當前問題。在該領域，她的重點是課程設計和實施、教師培訓、電腦教學、跨文化交流以及第二語言習得和評估。她是《建立連結：提升中文聽力理解》一書的作者，現已出版第二版。

618f8c2fe3a203dff4fed39e3b6a3eb6fa12c695.sourceText: Spring also is the director of two important institutional programs at ASU: the Confucius Institute and the Chinese Language Flagship program. The former is a partnership with Sichuan University and, unlike many Confucius Institutes, has a pronounced academic orientation and works closely with ASU faculty members, community groups and K-12 education. The latter is designed to move students to superior levels of Chinese language proficiency during their time at ASU.
618f8c2fe3a203dff4fed39e3b6a3eb6fa12c695.translatedText: 斯普林也是亞利桑那州立大學兩個重要機構計畫的主任：孔子學院和漢語旗艦計畫。前者與四川大學合作，與許多孔子學院不同，它具有明顯的學術導向，並與亞利桑那州立大學教師、社區團體和 K-12 教育密切合作。後者旨在幫助學生在亞利桑那州立大學就讀期間提高漢語水平。

bb233750c8c1ef857572c24c7ad41eafa7c4d356.sourceText: ”Professor Spring has transformed ASU and our state, creating programs that set up our students at ASU and in Arizona to be among the top professionals in their chosen career fields, internationally,”said Patrick Kenney, interim dean of the College of Liberal Arts and Sciences.
bb233750c8c1ef857572c24c7ad41eafa7c4d356.translatedText: 「斯普林教授改變了亞利桑那州立大學和我們的州，他創建的計畫使我們在亞利桑那州立大學和亞利桑那州的學生成為其所選職業領域的國際頂尖專業人士，」文理學院臨時院長帕特里克·肯尼 (Patrick Kenney) 說道。

6af28dae9854845319eb5f7c128f455865f35f7a.sourceText: ”Madeline Spring is that kind of rare difference maker in academia: a faculty member who energizes programs for the community along with top performance in the classroom and in her research,” said George Justice, dean of humanities in the College of Liberal Arts and Sciences. ”Because of Dr. Spring, students can come to ASU with no experience in Chinese and have their lives transformed personally and professionally. Her direct impact on campus and community is remarkable.”
6af28dae9854845319eb5f7c128f455865f35f7a.translatedText: 「馬德琳·斯普林是學術界罕見的改變者：一位為社區計畫注入活力的教員，在課堂和研究中表現出色，」文理學院人文學院院長喬治·賈斯蒂斯 (George Justice) 說。 “因為斯普林博士，沒有中文經驗的學生可以來到亞利桑那州立大學，並在個人和職業上改變他們的生活。她對校園和社區的直接影響是顯著的。”

a723ae5affaa12bdfa3861b6008439df51242701.sourceText: ASU’s Chinese Language Flagship is part of a network of 26 programs at 22 universities across the United States. Eleven of these are for Chinese. Due to her experience and talents, Spring was recruited to create a program at ASU that offered multi-level, intensive curricula for ASU undergraduates who seek to achieve superior professional-level language proficiency and advanced cultural skills in Chinese. In 2012, Flagship program added an ROTC component, making it one of three in the U.S. and the only one in the West. This program reaches out to highly motivated students of all majors in Army, Navy and Air Force ROTC whose schedules might previously have prevented the development of their critical language skills. These efforts are funded by the Department of Defense and National Security Education Program.
a723ae5affaa12bdfa3861b6008439df51242701.translatedText: 亞利桑那州立大學的中文旗艦計畫是由全美 22 所大學的 26 個計畫組成的網路的一部分。其中十一個是針對中國人的。由於她的經驗和才華，斯普林被聘請在亞利桑那州立大學創建一個項目，為尋求獲得卓越的專業水平語言能力和高級中文文化技能的亞利桑那州立大學本科生提供多層次的強化課程。 2012年，旗艦計畫增加了後備軍官訓練隊（ROTC）組成部分，使其成為美國三個項目之一，也是西方唯一一個項目。該計畫針對陸軍、海軍和空軍後備軍官訓練隊各專業的積極主動的學生，他們的日程安排可能阻礙了他們關鍵語言技能的發展。這些努力由國防部和國家安全教育計畫資助。

227ba49c5b60e47fd516917a8a34e0357335fe1b.sourceText: Under the leadership of ASU President Michael Crow, the Confucius Institute was developed by professor Stephen H. West, Spring and Cutter in partnership with Sichuan University and the Office of Chinese Language Council International. The institute supports numerous scholarly activities, provides language instructors to supplement those already teaching in the Chinese language program and works to enhance understanding about China and promote K-12 language training more broadly in Arizona. The institute now cooperates with partner schools, such as Boulder Creek High School, Cactus Shadows High School, Diamond Canyon School, Gavilan Peak School, Horseshoe Trails Elementary School, Lone Mountain Elementary School, Rhodes Junior High School and Sonoran Trails Middle School. Spring has also worked with community groups, as well as school districts and the Arizona Department of Education.
227ba49c5b60e47fd516917a8a34e0357335fe1b.translatedText: 孔子學院在亞利桑那州立大學校長邁克爾·克勞（Michael Crow）的領導下，由史蒂芬·H·韋斯特（Stephen H. West）教授、斯普林和卡特（Spring and Cutter）與四川大學、國家漢辦合作創辦。該學院支持眾多學術活動，提供語言教師來補充漢語課程中已有的教師，並致力於增進對中國的了解並在亞利桑那州更廣泛地推廣 K-12 語言培訓。學院現與Boulder Creek高中、Cactus Shadows高中、Diamond Canyon學校、Gavilan Peak學校、Horseshoe Trails小學、Lone Mountain小學、Rhodes初中和Sonoran Trails中學等合作學校合作。 Spring 也與社區團體、學區和亞利桑那州教育部合作。

deb2963978bbf577ceeb0e27a185f2a767839a8b.sourceText: ”Professor Spring has developed the Chinese language program at ASU into one of the best in the country,” said Joe Cutter, director of the School of International Letters and Cultures. ”Students come to ASU from outside Arizona specifically to be part of this program. She has made a huge difference in our students’ lives. It is truly heartwarming to hear these outstanding young people talk about their achievements and their sense of gratitude to professor Spring.”
deb2963978bbf577ceeb0e27a185f2a767839a8b.translatedText: 「Spring 教授將亞利桑那州立大學的中文計畫發展成為全國最好的計畫之一，」國際文學與文化學院院長 Joe Cutter 說。 “學生們從亞利桑那州以外的地方來到亞利桑那州立大學，就是為了參加這個計畫。她為我們學生的生活帶來了巨大的改變。聽到這些傑出的年輕人談論他們的成就以及他們對斯普林教授的感激之情，真的很溫暖。”

01a8c10869c89417506f1097aa42cbbbeae3ff2c.sourceText: The Gary S. Krahenbuhl Difference Maker Award has been awarded since 2003 to a tenured faculty member in the College of Liberal Arts and Sciences ”who demonstrates a broad vision for academic scholarship and a passion for engaging students in discovery and exploration.”
01a8c10869c89417506f1097aa42cbbbeae3ff2c.translatedText: Gary S. Krahenbuhl Difference Maker 獎自 2003 年起頒發給文理學院的一位終身教員，“他表現出對學術獎學金的廣闊視野以及讓學生參與發現和探索的熱情。”

781ee7881b6e8ffad18dc49115ec11366b3bdfdc.sourceText: March 25, 2014 – Hollywood management company Global One Ltd. is currently working with a major American technology brand to find the next Chinese family to star in their new ad campaign! The ad will feature Chinese-Americans showcasing a new technology product to be used for the Mainland China, Hong Kong and Taiwan market. Pay rate for this project is $1000 per person, so $4000 for a family of four!. Auditions are open to families with children aged three to sixteen years old, male and female. Full Chinese preferred, but mixed Chinese will be considered. No experience or professional pictures are necessary to audition. This is a golden opportunity for Chinese actors to break into Hollywood.
781ee7881b6e8ffad18dc49115ec11366b3bdfdc.translatedText: 2014 年 3 月 25 日 – <<CA_ZH_SPLIT>>>2014 年 3 月 25 日。是目前正在與美國主要科技品牌合作，尋找下一個在他們的新廣告活動中擔任主角的中國家庭！該廣告將由美籍華人展示一種用於中國大陸、香港和台灣市場的新技術產品。這個項目的收費是每人 1000 美元，所以一個四口之家需要 4000 美元！試鏡對象為有 3 至 16 歲兒童的家庭，不論男女。最好是全中文，但混合中文也會被考慮。試鏡不需要任何經驗或專業照片。這是中國演員進軍好萊塢的絕佳機會。

We want to reach out to Chinese communities across the nation to let people know that the opportunity is there for every kind of talent. We will not allow geography to keep the next Chinese superstar from getting discovered.” Established in 1986, Global One Ltd. is a media and entertainment gateway between the United States and Asia for artist management, event production and promotion, and celebrity endorsements. With offices in Los Angeles, Seattle WA Las Vegas Nevada and Seoul, South Korea, Global One, Ltd has established itself as the leading talent management company for Asian-Americans. Casting companies often seek us out first when they are looking for Asian talents. Since its launch in 2006, Global One$B!G(Bs Korean division has helped numerous Asian American talents create their success story. Consumers have seen Global One performers in commercials for Toyota, Hewlett-Packard, McDonald$B!G(Bs, Motorola, and other international corporate giants; in feature film actors work alongside Sean Penn, Harrison Ford, Scarlett Johansson, Sharon Stone, Chevy Chase, Brad Pitt and other super stars; and even in the ultra pop-group Wonder Girls.

d4b107b413a1f0c46f262a54f7997ece1795d485.sourceText: Global One broadened its scope to include the Chinese American communities in the summer of 2011. In the few short months during which the Chinese Division has been in full operations, Global One has accepted applications from Chinese talent all over the nation. Global One now represents a multitude of Chinese entertainers who are auditioning for television shows, movies, commercials, print advertisements, fashion shows, and voice-over projects. Global One Chinese Division has booked jobs for Disney, Apple, Amway, Hanmi Bank, Samsung, Bank of America, Wells Fargo and other well-known companies.
d4b107b413a1f0c46f262a54f7997ece1795d485.translatedText: 2011年夏天，全球一號將業務範圍擴大到了美國華人社區。在華人部全面運作的短短幾個月裡，全球一號已經接受了全國各地華人人才的申請。全球一現在代表眾多正在為電視節目、電影、廣告、平面廣告、時裝秀和配音項目試鏡的華人藝人。 Global One中國事業部已為迪士尼、蘋果、安麗、韓美銀行、三星、美國銀行、富國銀行等知名企業預定了工作。

Contact Chinese Division coordinator Elly Li to set up appointment or call (213) 217?4450 or by email at la@globaloneltd.com. Audition interviews may also be held over Skype. More information about Global One can be found at www.globaloneltd.com.

d0392799b85650a7bc41a55a87acc7afb901f7c5.sourceText: TORTILLA FLAT, Ariz. A University of Oklahoma student from China is dead and another was injured when a car went off an Arizona highway and over a 200-foot cliff early Wednesday morning, authorities said.
d0392799b85650a7bc41a55a87acc7afb901f7c5.translatedText: 亞利桑那州TORTILLA FLAT。當局稱，週三清晨，一輛汽車衝出亞利桑那州高速公路並衝過200英尺高的懸崖，一名來自中國的俄克拉荷馬大學學生死亡，另一人受傷。

57fe26b98f058464a89dd46df509b8d672803eba.sourceText: The man driving the car was killed and a male passenger survived the plunge but was injured, the Arizona Department of Public Safety said.
57fe26b98f058464a89dd46df509b8d672803eba.translatedText: 亞利桑那州公共安全部表示，一名駕駛汽車的男子在墜落中喪生，一名男性乘客在墜落中倖存，但受傷。

aa92f62d4035dcffa45ec7cdea7269b357de085c.sourceText: Catherine Bishop, a spokeswoman for the university, said the school is working with authorities to determine identities and notify next of kin.
aa92f62d4035dcffa45ec7cdea7269b357de085c.translatedText: 該大學發言人凱瑟琳畢肖普 (Catherine Bishop) 表示，學校正在與當局合作確定身份並通知近親。

5ec6122ea21e009b443900281270505768e82ab6.sourceText: Details on the passenger’s injuries were not immediately available.
5ec6122ea21e009b443900281270505768e82ab6.translatedText: 有關乘客受傷的詳細資訊尚未立即公佈。

5961d9bcbcd711a1db2e8c914d7853c52b2fe9eb.sourceText: DPS spokesman Bart Graves said two other Chinese students also from the University of Oklahoma were in another vehicle. They called 911 when one saw the car, a BMW sedan, go off the cliff, Graves said.
5961d9bcbcd711a1db2e8c914d7853c52b2fe9eb.translatedText: DPS 發言人 Bart Graves 表示，兩名乘客受傷另一輛車上也有其他來自俄克拉荷馬大學的中國學生。格雷夫斯說，當有人看到這輛寶馬轎車衝下懸崖時，他們撥打了 911。

1c1a1dd1fde30a0077ced07595c5e0440e68cfa5.sourceText: Graves said the car apparently was traveling too fast to make a curve on State Route 88. The narrow, twisting highway is in extremely rugged terrain in the Tonto National Forest east of the Phoenix area.
1c1a1dd1fde30a0077ced07595c5e0440e68cfa5.translatedText: 格雷夫斯說，這輛車顯然行駛速度太快，無法在 88 號國道上轉彎。這條狹窄、蜿蜒的高速公路位於菲尼克斯地區以東的通托國家森林，地形極為崎嶇。

9d008c05f9653111251f0cedbf04c476bb46c8a3.sourceText: The students, whose school is on spring break, were in the Phoenix area to visit a friend at Arizona State University.
9d008c05f9653111251f0cedbf04c476bb46c8a3.translatedText: 學校正在放春假的學生們正在菲尼克斯地區拜訪一位朋友

43a2b0f951cc54f6d548b5a9ddcf635aa8e8114a.sourceText: The DPS spokesman said the accident occurred while the students were headed toward the Phoenix area while on a drive to gaze at stars.
43a2b0f951cc54f6d548b5a9ddcf635aa8e8114a.translatedText: DPS 發言人表示，事故發生時，學生們正駕車前往鳳凰城地區觀賞星星。
