968ae432b7e968eed32bacd59dc6d2c8b3a5e4b4.sourceText: St. Luke’s Health Initiative, Anthony Yeung, and Josefina Barone Phoenix, Arizona: On the evening of May 10, 2014, Asian Pacific Community in Action (APCA) will honor St. Luke’s Health Initiative, Dr. Anthony Yeung, and Josefina”Jo” Barone, MBA, RN, for their contributions to improving the health and lives of countless Arizonans. Beginning at 5:30 pm, the event will be held at the Doubletree Paradise Valley Resort, 5401 N. Scottsdale Road in Scottsdale. Always a fun-filled evening, the banquet includes a talent showcase, silent auction, and Asian hors d’oeuvres. More than 350 local Asian and Pacific Islander community members, governmental officials, and health care providers are expected to attend.
968ae432b7e968eed32bacd59dc6d2c8b3a5e4b4.translatedText: 聖路易斯聖盧克健康倡議，Anthony Yeung 和 Josefina Barone，亞利桑那州菲尼克斯：2014 年 5 月 10 日晚，亞太健康倡議 (A Yeung) 博士Josefina“Jo” Barone，MBA、RN，感謝他們為改善無數亞利桑那州人的健康和生活做出的貢獻。活動將於下午 5:30 開始，在位於斯科茨代爾 (Scottsdale) N.斯科茨代爾路 5401 號的逸林天堂谷度假村 (Doubletree Paradise Valley Resort) 舉行。宴會始終是一個充滿樂趣的夜晚，包括才藝展示、無聲拍賣和亞洲開胃小菜。預計將有超過 350 名當地亞太島民​​社區成員、政府官員和醫療保健提供者參加。

45184df71bebfeeabb11e8529eb9860cfd73bacd.sourceText: St. Luke’s Health Initiatives (SLHI) is a Phoenix-based public foundation whose mission -to inform, connect and support efforts to improve the health of individuals and communities in Arizona-?is carried out through Health Policy, Community Development, and Capacity Building. Established in 1907 as a non-profit hospital, SLHI sold all of its facilities in 1995 and uses its financial assets to fund charitable activities and engage in public education activities.
45184df71bebfeeabb11e8529eb9860cfd73bacd.translatedText: St.盧克健康倡議 (SLHI) 是一家總部位於鳳凰城的公共基金會，其使命是透過健康政策、社區發展和能力建設來實現為改善亞利桑那州個人和社區的健康提供資訊、聯繫和支持的努力。 SLHI 成立於 1907 年，是一家非營利醫院，於 1995 年出售了所有設施，並利用其金融資產資助慈善活動和從事公共教育活動。

82eac0a6155741bfcb9104a85c15da73a8f6860d.sourceText: Dr. Anthony Yeung is a board certified orthopedic and spine surgeon who pioneered the development of the Yeung Endoscopic Spine System (YESS TM, a minimally invasive spinal diagnostic and surgical technique. Dr. Anthony Yeung and his wife, Eileen, have donated $2.5 Million to develop a comprehensive spine center at the University of New Mexico. Dr. Yeung is also a Past President of the Maricopa County Medical Society, the Arizona Orthopedic Society, and served on the Arizona Medical Association board.
82eac0a6155741bfcb9104a85c15da73a8f6860d.translatedText: Anthony Yeung 博士是一位委員會認證的骨科和脊椎外科醫生，他率先開發了 Yeung 內視鏡脊椎系統（YESS TM，一種微創脊椎診斷和手術技術）。 Anthony Yeung 博士和他的妻子 Eileen 捐贈了 250 萬美元，用於在新墨西哥大學建立綜合脊椎中心。 Yeung 博士也是馬里科帕縣醫學會、亞利桑那州骨科協會的前任主席，並在亞利桑那州醫學協會任職

80ae28a37fe03e6e0c249938a686a1d661621264.sourceText: Josefina ”Jo”Barone’s lifelong career in nursing started in 1977 when she graduated Cum Laude from the Central Philippine University. She settled in Phoenix in 1992 to work with St. Joseph’s Hospital and Medical Center and retired as Manager of the Internal Medicine Department’s Multi-Specialty and Residency Clinics and The Academic Hospitalists. Her profound passion to serve has taken her across the U.S. and overseas. She is an avid volunteer for the Philippine Nurse’s Association, APCA, The 3000 Club’s medical missions to the Philippines, and other organizations.
80ae28a37fe03e6e0c249938a686a1d661621264.translatedText: Josefina “Jo”Barone 的畢生護理生涯始於 1977 年，當時她以優異的成績從菲律賓中央大學畢業，並於 1992年定居在鳳凰城，在聖約瑟夫醫院和醫療中心工作，並以內科多專科和住院醫師診所和學術醫院經理的身份退休。她是菲律賓護理師協會、APCA、3000 俱樂部菲律賓醫療團和其他組織的熱心志工。

03599d1d6ee61f60aed05c51c3e61162dbaa1286.sourceText: Asian Pacific Community in Action is as a grassroots non-profit agency created to ensure culturally responsive health information and health services for low-income Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders in the greater Phoenix metropolitan area. Established in 2002, APCA remains the only organization in Arizona that provides comprehensive health services specifically for these communities. APCA also serves refugees from Asia and other continents. APCA’s mission is to provide services, advocacy and education for diverse communities resulting in a healthier and more empowered population overall.
03599d1d6ee61f60aed05c51c3e61162dbaa1286.translatedText: 亞太社區在行動是一個草根非營利機構，旨在確保為大鳳凰城大都會區的低收入亞裔美國人和太平洋島民提供文化上敏感的健康資訊和健康服務。 APCA 成立於 2002 年，仍然是亞利桑那州唯一專門為這些社區提供全面醫療服務的組織。 APCA 也為來自亞洲和其他大陸的難民提供服務。 APCA 的使命是為多元化社區提供服務、宣傳和教育，從而使整體人口更健康、更有能力。

1e111a7523fe8e215a13b6213258d977d98cbcae.sourceText: A colleague used those words to describe the last moments of Phoenix police Detective John Hobbs’s life.
1e111a7523fe8e215a13b6213258d977d98cbcae.translatedText: 一位同事用這些話來描述鳳凰城警探約翰‧霍布斯生命的最後時刻。

2597a2831cb3a0c841f5081a2b0ee9695e3e34b9.sourceText: We’re talking about an officer who got shot and doesn’t give up the fight,police spokesman Steve Martos said.
2597a2831cb3a0c841f5081a2b0ee9695e3e34b9.translatedText: 警方發言人史蒂夫·馬托斯說，我們談論的是一名中彈但沒有放棄戰鬥的警官。

7e70cb35fb602b25dde03007fecfc20ed90e0727.sourceText: Already mortally wounded and with his partner down, Hobbs managed to return fire at the fugitive who’s shot him and is believed to have killed the fugitive.
7e70cb35fb602b25dde03007fecfc20ed90e0727.translatedText: 已經受了致命傷，而且他的搭檔倒地，霍布斯設法向警察還擊。

7b9e93db478e45f5e87b031de214fbcfb31c02fd.sourceText: It was the final act of bravery for a man who’s spent the last seven years of his 21-year career tracking down the worst of the worst violent offenders.
7b9e93db478e45f5e87b031de214fbcfb31c02fd.translatedText: 對於一個在 21 年職業生涯的最後七年裡追查最嚴重暴力犯罪者的人來說，這是最後的英勇行為。

afaa53a956f6042b23bea13f902a24828408fba2.sourceText: Hobbs, who died Monday of gunshot wounds he suffered after trying to apprehend a man on an attempted-murder warrant, was part of a unit described as one of the special forces?of the Police Department: the Major Offenders Unit.
afaa53a956f6042b23bea13f902a24828408fba2.translatedText: 霍布斯週一在試圖逮捕一名謀殺未遂的男子後，因槍傷身亡。被描述為警察局特種部隊之一的單位：重犯單位。

49f9910c319df650800ed0bcecf1bcf5d0c972d2.sourceText: Another detective, a 43-year-old, nine-year veteran, was shot and underwent emergency surgery at St. Joseph’s Hospital and Medical Center in Phoenix. His family asked that his name not be released.
49f9910c319df650800ed0bcecf1bcf5d0c972d2.translatedText: 另一名警探，一名 43 歲、有 9 年退伍軍人經歷的人被槍殺，並在鳳凰城的聖約瑟夫醫院和醫療中心接受了緊急手術。他的家人要求不要公開他的名字。

1825e44353867f2504d5f4bb081ba7740e732b67.sourceText: Martos said that to test into the offenders unit, an officer must have the ability to conduct surveillance and know how to track people down.
1825e44353867f2504d5f4bb081ba7740e732b67.translatedText: 馬托斯說，要進入罪犯小組，警官必須具備進行監視並知道如何追蹤人員的能力。

76d30729e20b6ad1b7b9209c35993662fb9c1801.sourceText: ‘the entire unit is motivated, and they are certainly knowledgeable and well-respected,Martos said.’ they want to help?they want to catch the bad guys.’
76d30729e20b6ad1b7b9209c35993662fb9c1801.translatedText: 「整個小組都很積極，而且他們當然知識淵博且受人尊敬，馬托斯說。」他們想提供幫助？他們想抓住壞人。

8328863b43fa1e969364372002ce9032856b3381.sourceText: And that sums up Hobbs, 43, who was married and had three young children.
8328863b43fa1e969364372002ce9032856b3381.translatedText: 這是 43 歲的霍布斯的總結，他已婚並育有三個年幼的孩子。

b0bfab086a1d74ddc6c77aa77b12fb77f3fb2c97.sourceText: Sean Mattson, president of the 500-member Phoenix Police Sergeants and Lieutenants Association, was close friends with Hobbs and his wife, Cathy, for 17 years.
b0bfab086a1d74ddc6c77aa77b12fb77f3fb2c97.translatedText: 肖恩·馬特森 (Sean Mattson) 是擁有 500 名會員的菲尼克斯警官和中尉協會主席，與霍布斯和他的妻子凱西 (Cathy) 是 17 年的親密朋友。

0a08271398f6b305cf325a37e5ff75758308119d.sourceText: Mattson said he was relatively new to the department and joined a squad on the city’s south side, where Hobbs, who was older, worked as second-in-command.
0a08271398f6b305cf325a37e5ff75758308119d.translatedText: 馬特森說，他剛進入該部門，加入了該市南區的一個小隊，在那裡霍布斯年紀較大，擔任副把手。

c1258fcfb9781adabbf5d0ff3298b5c644c574dd.sourceText: ‘He kind of took me under his wing and taught me,’Mattson said. ”I was a little cocky, had a chip on my shoulder. He kind of calmed me down a lot.”
c1258fcfb9781adabbf5d0ff3298b5c644c574dd.translatedText: 「他將我置於他的保護之下並教導我，」馬特森說。 「我有點自大，心裡很不舒服。他讓我平靜了很多。」

45541df253d23e0308a20c83d0eec18cc9ee750f.sourceText: Mattson said Hobbs, who had also worked in the department’s narcotics division and other undercover assignments, had a way with people that made him a good police officer and a great friend.
45541df253d23e0308a20c83d0eec18cc9ee750f.translatedText: 馬特森說，霍布斯也曾在該部門的緝毒部門工作過，也從事過其他臥底工作，他與人相處的方式使他成為一名好警官和好朋友。

3aa12ca266da1ed998d45fa22cb39bc57f90b3bf.sourceText: He was able to comfort victims while also being able to chat up informants and suspects to obtain the vital information needed to make big busts, Mattson said.
3aa12ca266da1ed998d45fa22cb39bc57f90b3bf.translatedText: 他能夠安慰受害者，同時也能夠與線人和嫌疑人聊天，以了解他們的情況。馬特森說，「獲取大半身像所需的重要資訊。」

b57067efb3a6c29e935308d07bdb75efa1f00490.sourceText: ”John just looked to shoot the crap with everybody,”he said. ”Having the gift to make people comfortable around you was an asset.”
b57067efb3a6c29e935308d07bdb75efa1f00490.translatedText: 「約翰只是想和大家一起開槍，」他說。 「擁有讓周圍的人感到舒服的天賦是一種財富。」

f7f280709da9d02d6dd47ef2bd26cb2c22fd38c2.sourceText: As a young officer, Hobbs was involved in what was reported as the biggest drug bust in state history at the time. Hobbs and two other officers were responding to a burglary near 25th Avenue and Buckeye Road on May 5, 1999, when they discovered $500 million worth of Colombian cocaine.
f7f280709da9d02d6dd47ef2bd26cb2c22fd38c2.translatedText: 作為一名年輕警官，霍布斯參與了當時據稱是該州歷史上最大的一起緝毒行動。 1999 年 5 月 5 日，霍布斯和另外兩名警官在處理第 25 大道和七葉路附近的一起入室盜竊案時，發現了價值 5 億美元的哥倫比亞可卡因。

2be3cd6c2367568357a064733636ac3ef2c60f75.sourceText: The officers went into the backyard and found two men walking out of the house carrying boxes used for home appliances.
2be3cd6c2367568357a064733636ac3ef2c60f75.translatedText: 警官走進後院，發現兩名男子從房子裡走出，手裡拿著用於家用電器的箱子。

3a002d53fa64463ec2614ba811731dda5dae4361.sourceText: ”There was like a half-dozen of those boxes, just to give you a visualization,”Mattson said.
3a002d53fa64463ec2614ba811731dda5dae4361.translatedText: 「大概有六個盒子，只是為了給你一個視覺效果，」馬特森說。

f18e49cff91584c3445d4dda112a316687e4423e.sourceText: The bricks of cocaine literally weighed a ton, according to police.
f18e49cff91584c3445d4dda112a316687e4423e.translatedText: 根據警方的說法，可卡因塊實際上重達一噸。

e441efd6f6c456569bf4bdfd8cc8200de7d4e037.sourceText: Mattson said Hobbs was highly decorated, and his unit received the Police Chief’s Unit award from Phoenix Police Chief Daniel V. Garcia in 2013 for overall outstanding work.
e441efd6f6c456569bf4bdfd8cc8200de7d4e037.translatedText: 馬特森說霍布斯獲得了很高的榮譽，他的部隊在 2013 年因整體表現出色而獲得了鳳凰城警察局長丹尼爾·V·加西亞 (Daniel V. Garcia) 頒發的警察局長單位獎工作。

90dc0f642cc46ac9e81b8662317cfe813d9a63e5.sourceText: ‘It was presented to them like a month and a half ago,Mattson said. ”his group ‘that he’s part of has done such good work taking violent offenders off the street, the chief decided to give it to them.”
90dc0f642cc46ac9e81b8662317cfe813d9a63e5.translatedText: 「大約一個半月前，他們就收到了這個訊息，」馬特森說。 「他所在的『他所在的小組』在將暴力犯罪分子趕出街頭方面做了非常出色的工作，負責人決定將其交給他們。」

c408b20b93a0a942420944eff3c431236dcbaa61.sourceText: The Major Offenders Unit is geared at targeting violent criminals, Martos said. The unit chases those with felony warrants for homicides, shootings, aggravated assaults and child crimes.
c408b20b93a0a942420944eff3c431236dcbaa61.translatedText: 重犯小組的目標是打擊暴力犯罪分子，馬托斯說。該部門追捕因殺人、槍擊、嚴重攻擊和兒童犯罪而被重罪逮捕的人。

96323a53b07c2d38e8f7bbb82e9ce114bb848f02.sourceText: Martos said Hobbs spent some time doing undercover work before joining the unit, where he had worked for seven years.
96323a53b07c2d38e8f7bbb82e9ce114bb848f02.translatedText: 馬托斯說，霍布斯在加入該部門之前花了一些時間從事臥底工作，他在那裡工作了七年。

9e8b342ae521f63d8e8600c644e6315c1b983d52.sourceText: ”He was an absolute nice guy?one that would stop you in the hallway,”Martos said. ‘ I cannot think of one bad thing that anyone would say about him.”
9e8b342ae521f63d8e8600c644e6315c1b983d52.translatedText: 「他是一個絕對的好人？一個會在走廊上阻止你的人，」馬托斯說。 ‘我想不出任何人會說他的壞話。 ”

8e9a37388df0469043680610762d3b5594011d58.sourceText: Retired Phoenix police Officer Lisa Wilson Carnahan said she knew Hobbs as one of the three musketeers in the department.
8e9a37388df0469043680610762d3b5594011d58.translatedText: 鳳凰城退休警官麗莎·威爾遜·卡納漢 (Lisa Wilson Carnahan) 說，她知道霍布斯是該部門的三個火槍手之一。

fc61c93038c415df04d76e3ba298880549a6eba8.sourceText: ”He was funny, loving and let the people around him know they were special to him in their own individual way,”she wrote in an online memorial book. ”He was exemplary as a person, police officer and friend. He had a heart of gold and would do just about anything for anybody.”
fc61c93038c415df04d76e3ba298880549a6eba8.translatedText: 「他很有趣，充滿愛心，讓周圍的人知道他們以自己的方式對他來說是一個典人，」這位典人的方式對他來說是一個天才的方式對他來說。 「軍官和朋友。他有一顆金子般的心，願意為任何人做任何事。”

2ff9398717573e1c4f229b170cc7c19493046f4c.sourceText: By Tuesday evening, more than 230 people?many of whom had never met Hobbs and from as far away as Texas, Connecticut and South Dakota?used the online remembrance book to herald Hobbs as a hero and thank him for his service.
2ff9398717573e1c4f229b170cc7c19493046f4c.translatedText: 到週二晚上，已有 230 多人（其中許多人從未見過霍布斯，甚至遠至德克薩斯州、康涅狄格州和南達科他州）使用在線紀念冊將霍布斯視為英雄，並感謝他的服務。

622ff009eb8e3a37c1a836ac9a9324aeac5a6f7f.sourceText: Steven Durette, who said he knew Hobbs from childhood and from Apollo High School, said the young Hobbs was into firearms, Lamborghinis, the military and martial arts.” He always wanted to do the right thing and was a very good person,”Durette said.
622ff009eb8e3a37c1a836ac9a9324aeac5a6f7f.translatedText: 史蒂文·杜雷特 (Steven Durette) 說，他從小就認識霍布斯，從阿波羅高中就認識，他說年輕的霍布斯喜歡槍械、蘭博基尼、軍事和武術藝術」。杜雷特說：「他總是想做正確的事，而且是一個非常好的人。 」

e90ddd4667fcc1f5e84cd78fbb038d1eea3527bf.sourceText: Hobbs was an active fixture around his family-friendly Surprise neighborhood, neighbor James Brenn said.
e90ddd4667fcc1f5e84cd78fbb038d1eea3527bf.translatedText: 鄰居詹姆斯·布倫 (James Brenn) 說，霍布斯是他的家庭友好型 Surprise 社區的活躍分子。

a573d561be2ddb02e9235a39d1c82c34d619a687.sourceText: Brenn said he met first met Hobbs in December 2012 and described him as ”vigilant, caring and observant.
a573d561be2ddb02e9235a39d1c82c34d619a687.translatedText: 布倫說，他第一次見到霍布斯是在 2012 年 12 月，並形容他「警惕、關心和友善」。

90d79269959bb267c51fc72a9a546e541c95bde0.sourceText: ”He’s the best kind of neighbor you could have,’he said.’ He was welcoming to us, to the neighborhood.’

71f12386af8059a5926bd1e549b2371778a17925.sourceText: Another neighbor, Nick Arcan, said he would often see Hobbs in his garage watching his children play.
71f12386af8059a5926bd1e549b2371778a17925.translatedText: 另一位鄰居尼克·阿肯 (Nick Arcan) 說，他經常看到霍布斯在他的車庫裡看著他的孩子們玩耍。

809552bb79d982b363e2be5f9ad3eeea503bf8c8.sourceText: I can’t even say the number of times my daughter has fallen and gotten a boo-boo, and he took her inside and washed her and bandaged her up,’Arcan said.
809552bb79d982b363e2be5f9ad3eeea503bf8c8.translatedText: 我什至無法說出我女兒跌倒並受到噓聲的次數，而他把她帶進去，給她洗澡，她說。

9b8a3e7f6ff19e33db1cac16fbb7af0ff180f563.sourceText: He said Hobbs?two sons are both polite and respectful.
9b8a3e7f6ff19e33db1cac16fbb7af0ff180f563.translatedText: 他說霍布斯？兩個兒子都很有禮貌，也很尊重人。

29cfca29fcb5506861e0f1b259b3570ba76912e7.sourceText: ”It’s just the way he brought them up,”Arcan said. ”The respect they show for others, you can just tell what a good father he was.’
29cfca29fcb5506861e0f1b259b3570ba76912e7.translatedText: 「這就是他養育他們的方式，」阿坎說。 「他們對他人表現出的尊重，你可以看出他是一個多麼好的父親。」

a1bc92be508a5593b431c023e48f74d6e3ea750f.sourceText: Republic reporters Matthew Casey and D.S. Woodfill contributed to this article.
a1bc92be508a5593b431c023e48f74d6e3ea750f.translatedText: 《共和報》記者 Matthew Casey 和 D.S. Woodfill 對本文有貢獻。

3a6d245f1402d464f61a64ba0b885449f3efb375.sourceText: Phoenix Taipei Sister Cities, Greater Phoenix Taiwanese Chamber of Commerce and Global Federation of Chinese Business Women Arizona Chapter invited Master Chen Yang-Chun to have his exhibition at Phoenix City Hall from March 3-14, 2014 to honor Taipei and Phoenix 35th Anniversary of sister cities’strong relationship that established in March 1979, and to promote Taiwanese and American art and culture awareness and diversity. Chen Yang-Chun, a native from Yunlin, Taiwan, is the foremost watercolor artist in Taiwan. Mr. Chen has earned his fame as ”Master of Watercolor” and ”culture Ambassador” He has been awarded with ”Friend of Diplomacy Commemorative Medal”from Ministry of Foreign Affairs. His artworks are permanently included in many museums and private collections worldwide. March 7 at 12:00 noon at Phoenix City Hall 1st Floor Assembly Room: Master Chen welcomes everyone, unveils art to press and shares his 50 years of watercolor art experiences. March 13 at 9:00 am at Phoenix City Hall 1st Floor: Official Celebration lead by Phoenix Mayor Stanton to honor and celebrate Phoenix and Taipei 35th Anniversary of long lasting relationship and to recognize Master Chen’s 169th international individual exhibit in Phoenix with ribbon cutting and cake cutting.
3a6d245f1402d464f61a64ba0b885449f3efb375.translatedText: 鳳凰城台北姐妹城市、大鳳凰城台灣商會及全球華商婦女聯合會亞利桑那分會邀請陳養春大師於2014年3月3日至14日在鳳凰城市政廳舉辦畫展，以紀念台北與鳳凰城成立35月1979年陳陽春，台灣雲林人，台灣最著名的水彩畫家。陳先生被譽為“水彩大師”、“文化大使”，曾被外交部授予“外交之友紀念章”。他的藝術作品被世界各地的許多博物館和私人收藏永久收藏。 3月7日中午12：00鳳凰城政府一樓會議室：陳老師熱情歡迎大家，為媒體揭幕，並分享他50年的水彩藝術經驗。 3 月 13 日上午 9:00 在鳳凰城市政廳一樓：由鳳凰城市長斯坦頓主持的官方慶祝活動，以剪彩和切蛋糕方式紀念和慶祝鳳凰城與台北建立長期關係 35 週年，並表彰陳大師在鳳凰城舉行的第 169 屆國際個人展。

8c9fdc1db6f59e8fa8d9457f2262270c09fa9408.sourceText: Chinese Week 2014 celebrated its Chinese New Year of the Horse to thousands of spectators at its three day event at Margaret Hance Park. The Chinese festival opened with the traditional lion dance taking away any evil spirits from the festival and promoting good luck and fortune to the event.
8c9fdc1db6f59e8fa8d9457f2262270c09fa9408.translatedText: 2014 年中國週在瑪格麗特漢斯公園舉行為期三天的活動，向數千名觀眾慶祝馬來西亞。中國節日以傳統的舞獅拉開序幕，它可以驅除節日中的邪氣，為節日帶來好運和好運。

028ef9816dd14be8e7ae8001210b6ce83719d393.sourceText: The festival featured live entertainment for the whole family to enjoy and many other sights to visit. The Children’s Pavilion provided hands on experience for our younger kids, a Chinese cultural booth, photo and art contest exhibit, and most of all a chance to taste a bit of Chinese cuisine for all to enjoy.
028ef9816dd14be8e7ae8001210b6ce83719d393.translatedText: 節日的特色是適合全家人一起欣賞的現場娛樂表演以及許多其他值得參觀的景點。兒童館為年幼的孩子們提供了實踐體驗、中國文化攤位、攝影和藝術競賽展覽，最重要的是，大家有機會品嚐中國美食。

b74e8506bade07637e184d028b0b6f3c32ac8ddc.sourceText: Chinese Week also included a Koi Festival by the Valley of the Sun Koi Club of Phoenix with a special koi fish competition. Koi were also offered for sale to all fish lovers who wanted to take one home.
b74e8506bade07637e184d028b0b6f3c32ac8ddc.translatedText: 中國週還包括鳳凰城太陽谷錦鯉俱樂部舉辦的錦鯉節和一場特別的錦鯉比賽。也向所有想帶一條回家的魚愛好者出售錦鯉。

4ff44eb68c931e5a019fc1b3121030ea945763a9.sourceText: Phoenix Sister Cities Committee of Phoenix was a big supporter of Chinese Week 2014 and was a big help in making the festival a big success. Other major supporters included APS, Pepsi, SRP, and Wells Fargo Bank.
4ff44eb68c931e5a019fc1b3121030ea945763a9.translatedText: 鳳凰城姊妹城市委員會是2014年中國週的大力支持者，為該節日的成功舉辦做出了巨大的貢獻。其他主要支持者包括 APS、百事可樂、SRP 和富國銀行。

b5b006e430d0919945105d706504e8caccc1a874.sourceText: Chinese Week 2014 opened with the traditional lion dances to the delight of the many children who attended the event.
b5b006e430d0919945105d706504e8caccc1a874.translatedText: 2014 年中國週以傳統舞獅拉開序幕，眾多參加活動的孩子們欣喜不已。

94e44686d2f35ba5011ea5754c4b68128bfcd905.sourceText: Phoenix City Councilman Sal Diciccio and a Chengdu Representative exchanged gifts at the opening of Chinese Week 2014.

40f474e868efc4b13a0914091ec2a2c14a729601.sourceText: The inaugural Chinese Lantern & Folk Festival will be held Jan. 31 – Feb 9th along the lake in Fountain Hills. Coinciding with the Chinese New Year celebration of the Year of the Horse, the festival will feature dozens of large, richly-colored lit displays made from special silk material depicting animals, characters, gods, angels, flora and structures. The displays, which will be created by two dozen Chinese artisans, become a stunning kaleidoscope of colorful lights and visuals. A number of displays measure up to 60 feet long and 40 feet wide. The festival will also feature cultural dancing, puppets, food, Tai Chi and Kung Fu demonstrations, handmade crafts and music.
40f474e868efc4b13a0914091ec2a2c14a729601.translatedText: 首屆中國元宵節和民俗節將於 1 月 31 日至 2 月 9 日在噴泉山 (Fountain Hills) 湖畔舉行。適逢中國農曆馬年新年慶祝活動，該節日將展出數十個由特殊絲綢材料製成的大型、色彩豐富的燈光展示，描繪動物、人物、神靈、天使、植物和結構。這些展示將由兩打中國工匠創作，成為色彩繽紛的燈光和視覺效果的令人驚嘆的萬花筒。許多顯示器的長度可達 60 英尺，寬度可達 40 英尺。節日還將有文化舞蹈、木偶、美食、太極和功夫展示、手工藝品和音樂。

2681fefbbe86146ee652e8be54b08a12cadbb248.sourceText: Festival times will be Monday through Friday from 3 to 10 p.m., and Saturday and Sunday noon to 10 p.m. Tickets for adults will be $12, and $8 for children 5-12. Both adults and children will receive a free gift. Children under 5 are free. Business sponsorships are available for displays from $1,000 to $10,000.
2681fefbbe86146ee652e8be54b08a12cadbb248.translatedText: 節日時間為週一至週五下午 3 點至晚上 10 點，週六和週日中午至晚上 10 點。成人票價為 12 美元，5-12 歲兒童票價為 8 美元。成人和兒童都將收到一份免費禮物。 5 歲以下免費。商業贊助的展示費用從 1,000 美元到 10,000 美元不等。

a88bfe17e8cd9f5393a6f8c68fdea93e30b32e59.sourceText: ”The Chinese Lantern and Folk Festival will bring the colorful and historic Eastern culture to America,” said Festival Director Cathy Hum. ”This event will showcase the creative art of lantern making, along with featuring the Chinese arts and way of life.”
a88bfe17e8cd9f5393a6f8c68fdea93e30b32e59.translatedText: 「中國元宵節和民俗節將把豐富多彩、歷史悠久的東方文化帶到美國，」節慶總監 Cathy Hum 說。 “這次活動將展示燈籠製作的創意藝術，並展示中國藝術和生活方式。”

bb04392c6427b2471f5d05ef8677879574440042.sourceText: ”The Town of Fountain Hills it thrilled to host the very first Chinese Lantern & Folk Festival,?’said Fountain Hills Mayor Linda Kavanagh. Our town will be the meeting place for the colorful Eastern traditions and our American traditions. It is also another opportunity to show the world what Fountain Hills has to offer in both its residents, its way of life and our area’s beautiful scenery.
bb04392c6427b2471f5d05ef8677879574440042.translatedText: 噴泉山鎮長琳達·卡瓦納 (Linda Kavanagh) 表示：「噴泉山鎮很高興舉辦首屆中國元宵節和民俗節。」我們的小鎮將成為豐富多彩的東方傳統和美國傳統的交匯地。這也是向世界展示噴泉山居民、生活方式和我們地區美麗風景的另一個機會。

2d590cc7f94b38cd3fc6e8b59f21e66d0c53bf16.translatedText: 亞利桑那州錢德勒？ 2014年1月10日？ nbsp;漢密爾頓高中的學生 Sammi Tam 已入選卡內基音樂廳 2014 年高中榮譽表演系列。她將於2014年2月9日在卡內基音樂廳與榮譽管弦樂團一起作為中提琴演奏。

1dc323eeb3154690cece2d9a432bbbaac5e8c35d.sourceText: Sammi auditioned this fall for the Honors Performance Series and was accepted after a review by the Honors Selection Board. Acceptance to the elite group is a direct result of the talent, dedication, and achievements demonstrated in her application and audition recording. Sammi will join other performers from the United States, Canada, and select international schools for a special performance at world-famous Carnegie Hall, a venue that marks the pinnacle of musical achievement.
1dc323eeb3154690cece2d9a432bbbaac5e8c35d.translatedText: Sammi今年秋天參加了榮譽表演系列的試鏡，並在榮譽選拔委員會審查後被接受。被精英團體錄取是她在申請和試鏡錄音中所表現出的才華、奉獻精神和成就的直接結果。 Sammi將與來自美國、加拿大的其他表演者一起，並選擇國際學校在世界著名的卡內基音樂廳進行特別演出，這是一個標誌著音樂成就頂峰的場所。

c9e9ee2b63bb4df9187de7a495d5e2e4b8229cbc.sourceText: Sammi studies music with Dr. Jeffrey Norman, a violist with the Arizona Opera, principle violist with the Symphony of the Southwest, and a former member of the El Paso Symphony. Dr. Norman has also been an active private music teacher for over 20 years with many of his students being awarded music scholarships to a variety of colleges.
c9e9ee2b63bb4df9187de7a495d5e2e4b8229cbc.translatedText: Sammi師從亞利桑那歌劇院中提琴手、西南交響樂團首席中提琴手、埃爾帕索交響樂團前成員杰弗裡·諾曼博士學習音樂。諾曼博士也是活躍的私人音樂教師 20 多年，他的許多學生都獲得了多所大學的音樂獎學金。

753b28885af85afd9837f189913da5dad278615f.sourceText: Finalists will come together for five days in February 2014 in New York City to have the opportunity to learn from Jeffrey Grogan and work with other Finalists. The Honors Performance Series was created to showcase accomplished individual high school performers on an international level by allowing them to study under master conductors and perform in the celebrated venue, Carnegie Hall.
753b28885af85afd9837f189913da5dad278615f.translatedText: 決賽入圍者將於 2014 年 2 月在紐約齊聚五天，有機會向 Jeffrey Grogan 學習並與其他決賽入圍者合作。榮譽表演系列旨在展示國際水平上有成就的高中表演者，讓他們在指揮大師的指導下學習並在著名的卡內基音樂廳表演。

8c8def97d1d1b65a9fcc67ecc670e59e87a4fe5d.sourceText: On Nov 17th TAAA will Host A Family Friendly Event Dear TAAA members, Please mark your calender: TAAA Fun at the Zoo Day is coming on Nov 17th, 2013! The fall in Phoenix is so beautiful and we hope you are all enjoying the nice weather and outdoor activities. The TAAA is happy to announce our family friendly event this year at the Phoenix Zoo on Nov 17 th, 2013. Come join us for a day of fun in the sun! When: 9:00 AM ~2:00 PM, Sunday, Nov 17 th, 2013 Where: Phoenix Zoo, 455 North Galvin Parkway, Phoenix, Arizona 85008 Cost: We can get the benefit of group discount rates: $13 for adults, $7 for children ages 3-12, and free for children Ages 2 & under. Or if you have a zoo membership, you can get in for free. Lunch Time and Location: Pack your picnic lunch and we will meet at 12: 30PM at the picnic tables in the harmony farm. We will have trivia games and prizes for the kids! How to sign up: Please email Shan Lu ( shlu.2011@yahoo.com ) to sign up. If you need tickets, please provide the numbers of adult and child tickets you need by 11:59 PM Monday, Nov 11th. We will meet in front of the zoo ticket booth at 9:00 AM and the fee is due at the time to Shan Lu. If you need more information about the zoo, please check http://phoenixzoo.org/. All members and their families are welcome to attend the event. This is a perfect opportunity to meet other TAAA members, mingle with friends and have fun together! Looking forward to seeing you all at the zoo on Nov 17th! Thank you very much! TAAA Executive Committee
8c8def97d1d1b65a9fcc67ecc670e59e87a4fe5d.translatedText: 11 月 17 日 TAAA 將舉辦家庭友善活動 親愛的 TAAA 會員，請標記您的日曆：TAAA 動物園歡樂日將於 2013 年 11 月 17 日到來！鳳凰城的秋天是如此美麗，我們希望你們都享受美好的天氣和戶外活動。 TAAA 很高興地宣布今年將於 2013 年 11 月 17 日在鳳凰城動物園舉辦家庭友善活動。快來加入我們，在陽光下度過愉快的一天！時間：2013 年 11 月 17 日星期日，上午 9:00 ~下午 2:00 地點：菲尼克斯動物園，455 North Galvin Parkway, Phoenix, Arizona 85008 費用：我們可以享受團體折扣優惠：成人 13 美元，3-12 歲兒童 7 美元，2 歲及以下兒童免費。或者，如果您有動物園會員，則可以免費進入。午餐時間和地點：帶上您的野餐午餐，我們將於中午 12:30 在和諧農場的野餐桌上見面。我們將為孩子們準備問答遊戲和獎品！報名方式：請寄電子郵件至盧珊（shlu.2011@yahoo.com）報名。如果您需要門票，請在 11 月 11 日星期一晚上 11:59 之前提供您所需的成人票和兒童票數量。我們將於上午 9:00 在動物園售票亭前集合，屆時請向山麓支付費用。如果您需要有關動物園的更多信息，請查看http://phoenixzoo.org/。歡迎所有會員及其家人參加此活動。這是結識其他 TAAA 會員、與朋友交流並一起享受樂趣的絕佳機會！期待11月17日在動物園與大家見面！非常感謝！ TAAA執行委員會

4b45b50febf8c8c90b49daa9678419e405967aea.sourceText: On September 22nd, the China Forum on ‘Working with China in the Global Market’ hosted by ASU Confucius Institute (ASU CI), the ASU School of International Letters and Culture, and the United Chinese Association of Arizona (UCAA), successfully concluded with applause from a full house of enthusiastic audience members at the ASU Memorial Union. Consulate General Consul Zhaohe Che of People’s Republic of China at Los Angles kicked off the forum with a welcome keynote speech to explore the collaborative and strategic opportunities between the US and China. Professor Madeline K. Spring, the director of ASU CI, gave an overview of the presentations and introduced three distinguished guest speakers – Mr. Chuck Gray represented Congressman Matt Salmon, United States Representative, 5th District of Arizona; Briand Greer, President of Aerospace Asia Pacific, Honeywell International, Inc.; and Steven Tu, Chief Architect of Mobile Product Line, Intel Corporation.
4b45b50febf8c8c90b49daa9678419e405967aea.translatedText: 9月22日，由亞利桑那州立大學孔子學院、亞利桑那州立大學國際文化學院、亞利桑那州華人聯合會（中華人民共和國駐洛杉磯總領事車兆和先生在亞利桑那州立大學紀念聯盟的熱情觀眾中致歡迎詞，探討了中美之間的合作和戰略機遇，她對演講進行了概述，並介紹了三位傑出的演講嘉賓——美國亞利桑那州第五選區眾議員查克·格雷先生、航空航天架構師主席、德·格里爾先生、霍尼韋爾國際產品線架構師。

af72938e8f08cee169a9fd352570454684efacd5.sourceText: Organizers, speakers, and special guests are pictured at the recent ”Working with China in the Global Market”Forum.
af72938e8f08cee169a9fd352570454684efacd5.translatedText: 主辦單位、演講者和特邀嘉賓在最近舉行的「與中國合作全球市場」論壇上合影。

f4a421d1251da34a7772f8aeef95e665f5a1005f.sourceText: As a result of unforeseen events and the ongoing debate regarding the Debt Ceiling, Congressman Salmon was unable to attend the forum. Instead, Mr. Chuck Gray, who is the district director at U.S. Representative District 5, represented Congressman Salmon to present his speech. Mr. Gray oversees all district office operations and represents the Congressman in his absence. He also develops and implements policy objectives, strategies and operating plans for the Congressman’s district office and directs all activities and staff of the district office.
f4a421d1251da34a7772f8aeef95e665f5a1005f.translatedText: 由於不可預見的事件以及有關債務上限的持續辯論，國會議員薩蒙無法出席論壇。相反，美國代表第五選區的選區主任查克·格雷先生代表薩蒙議員發表演說。格雷先生負責監督所有地區辦事處的運作，並在國會議員缺席時代表他。他還為國會議員的選區辦公室制定和實施政策目標、策略和營運計劃，並指導選區辦公室的所有活動和工作人員。

8e515375e424d52327cff9842b6c65180507de4e.sourceText: In Congressman Salmon’s speech, he stated that there is a fine line we walk in being partners and competitors. ”It is a top priority for me to improve our relationship with China and push for the trade policies that will grow our economy and increase jobs, while also encouraging China to make improvements within their system of law to protect the rights of intellectual property owners.” ” In walking this line,”he continued, ”We must strike a balance by coupling those petitions for change with an open door policy for Chinese participation in the U.S. economy. Only then will we truly unshackle the free market and the many opportunities we have both in Arizona and around the country that will help us grow our economy and create jobs not only today but into the future.”Though Congressman Salmon was unable to attend the forum to deliver his speech in person, his intentions came across and was well received by the audience.
8e515375e424d52327cff9842b6c65180507de4e.translatedText: 薩爾蒙議員在演講中表示，我們在成為合作夥伴和競爭對手之間有一條微妙的界線。 “我的首要任務是改善與中國的關係，推動促進經濟成長和就業的貿易政策，同時鼓勵中國改進法律體係以保護智慧財產權所有者的權利。” 「在走這條路線時，」他繼續說道，「我們必須透過將這些要求變革的請願與中國參與美國經濟的開放政策結合起來來取得平衡。只有這樣，我們才能真正釋放自由市場以及我們在亞利桑那州和全國各地擁有的許多機會，這些機會將幫助我們發展經濟並創造就業機會，不僅在今天，而且在未來。」儘管薩蒙議員無法親自出席了他的演講。

1f82728c817822c8299191990caadbb5994d57e3.sourceText: Mr. Briand Greer is the President of Honeywell Aerospace Asia-Pacific and is responsible for business across the region. Mr. Greer presented the audience with a close-up view of business in China. Over the years, Honeywell has become a Fortune 100 company with 39 billion in revenues, 55% of it outside of the U.S. It has 130,000 employees operating in 100+ countries. Honeywell’s Aerospace Businesses is headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona with 38,000 employee worldwide and annual revenue of ~$12 billion. According to Mr. Greer, Honeywell China generates 2.2 Billion in sales with 12,000 employees in over 30 cities and 1,600 scientists and engineers. Mr. Greer stated that Honeywell is committed to be a long-term partner in China. In areas of customers & partners, it will continue to set up strategic engagement with a focus of aftermarket focus. In area of regulatory and industry, it will continue to have a stronger industry voice and work with government to continue aviation growth. Honeywell would like to continue to establish industry strategic collaborations in China with a focus on new solution development. To succeed in China, Mr. Greer stated that localization will be part of the landscape in all areas including manufacturing, sourcing, local talents and local practices.
1f82728c817822c8299191990caadbb5994d57e3.translatedText: Briand Greer先生是霍尼韋爾航空航太亞太區總裁，負責整個地區的業務。格里爾先生向觀眾展示了中國商業的近距離視角。多年來，霍尼韋爾已成為財富 100 強公司，收入達 390 億美元，其中 55% 位於美國以外地區，在 100 多個國家擁有 13 萬名員工。霍尼韋爾航空航太業務部總部位於亞利桑那州菲尼克斯，在全球擁有 38,000 名員工，年收入約 120 億美元。格里爾先生表示，霍尼韋爾中國銷售額達22億美元，在30多個城市擁有12,000名員工，擁有1,600名科學家和工程師。格里爾先生表示，霍尼韋爾致力於成為中國的長期合作夥伴。在客戶和合作夥伴領域，它將繼續建立以售後市場為重點的策略合作關係。在監管和產業領域，它將繼續擁有更強的產業話語權，並與政府合作，繼續航空業的成長。霍尼韋爾希望繼續在中國建立產業策略合作，專注於開發新的解決方案。格里爾先生表示，為了在中國取得成功，在地化將成為所有領域的一部分，包括製造、採購、本地人才和本地實踐。

7b4adf4d60d6433e5e8cc81a3ab6d1cc4b6178ec.sourceText: Mr. Steven Tu focused on Intel’s next goal, which is to take its business to China?to be mobile in China. Mr. Tu, the Chief Architect of Mobile Product Line at the Intel Corporation, noted that China is a market with great potential. Since 2011, it has been leading the number one personal computer consumption. In area of global internet users, there is 2.4 billion Global Internet Users with a rate of 8% annual growth. In China, there is 564 million Internet users with 10% annual growth. Smartphone subscriber growth rate is 31% in China versus 28% in the U.S. in 2013. Intel will continue to develop strategy in the wearable and everywhere mobile products by delivering both performance and value based smartphone products.
7b4adf4d60d6433e5e8cc81a3ab6d1cc4b6178ec.translatedText: 屠呦呦先生重點介紹了英特爾的下一個目標，那就是把業務帶到中國——在中國做移動。英特爾公司行動產品線首席架構師塗先生表示，中國是個潛力巨大的市場。自2011年以來，一直引領個人電腦消費第一。在全球網路用戶方面，全球網路用戶已達24億，並以每年8%的速度成長。中國有5.64億網路用戶，每年成長10%。 2013 年，中國智慧型手機用戶成長率為 31%，而美國為 28%。英特爾將透過提供基於性能和價值的智慧型手機產品，繼續制定可穿戴和無處不在的行動產品策略。

fb6901cea3fad5c74899b4440045ce8230622259.sourceText: The forum’s enthusiastic attendees warmly welcomed the useful information and practical knowledge presented at the forum, which shed light on how to work with the Chinese. 7fc594b4221f2d33e4a1ff173f7a6cc37228859e.sourceText: In advance of a symposium ”Working with China in the Global Market” hosted by Arizona State University’s Confucius Institute, Asian American Times was granted an exclusive interview with Briand Greer, President, Honeywell Aerospace Asia-Pacific; this writer conducted the interview and this article follows therefrom.
7fc594b4221f2d33e4a1ff173f7a6cc37228859e.translatedText: 亞利桑那州立大學孔子學院主辦的「與中國在全球市場合作」研討會取得進展，《亞美尼亞時報》獨家專訪霍尼韋爾航空航天亞太區總裁Briand Greer；

8ff2951c4cc9a2cba3e8f0af8ddb6fd67afa5d22.sourceText: While many American and western companies conducting business with China today are ”newcomers” in the past three decades, Honeywell’s presence dates back to 1935. The company understands and aligns with China’s strategy of a long term vision.
8ff2951c4cc9a2cba3e8f0af8ddb6fd67afa5d22.translatedText: 雖然許多與中國開展業務的美國三十年和西方公司都是過去的“新來者”該公司了解並符合中國的長期戰略策略。

ff1c78975adbece9cb083f42ff6f365c7c611b15.sourceText: ” Honeywell in China ” More recently in 2003, Honeywell International’s Board Chairman made a significant commitment to doing business in China by moving its Honeywell Aerospace Asia-Pacific Headquarters to Shanghai. Following its move the company proceeded to invest $1 Billion in its China Aerospace operations where it now employs over 700 employees including over 400 engineers.
ff1c78975adbece9cb083f42ff6f365c7c611b15.translatedText: 「霍尼韋爾在中國」最近在2003年，霍尼韋爾國際公司董事會主席將霍尼韋爾航空航天亞太區總部遷至上海，是對在中國開展業務的重大承諾。此舉之後，該公司繼續向中國航太業務投資 10 億美元，目前該業務擁有 700 多名員工，其中包括 400 多名工程師。

a9fcc41fb61a1287c24ed4bfb8f39f2c2be5fc60.sourceText: Honeywell Aerospace is headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona with annual revenue exceeding $12 Billion, over 38,000 employees worldwide and over 100 global manufacturing and service sites. The Aerospace division grew through acquisitions in the Phoenix area combining familiar companies including Garrett AiResearch, Sperry and Allied-Signal.
a9fcc41fb61a1287c24ed4bfb8f39f2c2be5fc60.translatedText: 霍尼韋爾航空航太公司總部位於亞利桑那州菲尼克斯，年收入超過 120 億美元，在全球擁有超過 38,000 名員工，在全球擁有 100 多個製造和服務基地。航空航天部門透過在鳳凰城地區的收購，合併了 Garrett AiResearch、Sperry 和 Allied-Signal 等熟悉的公司而發展壯大。

3e21d77e1dab9cb2ea6e77699f9a1b3afeef7208.sourceText: ” China New Airplane C919 ” China recently embarked on a bold program to develop and build its own commercial airplane to compete with the dominant manufacturers Boeing and Airbus. The initial model is referred to as C919 and is comparable to the single aisle Boeing 737 and Airbus A320. Honeywell Aerospace successfully bid on providing major operational components for the C919. It will develop, manufacture, install and service the C919 navigation system, auxiliary power units, flight by wire flight control system (auto-pilot) and landing gear assemblies; the contract life is valued at $16 Billion.
3e21d77e1dab9cb2ea6e77699f9a1b3afeef7208.translatedText: 「中國新型飛機 C919」 中國最近開始了一項大膽的計劃，開發和建造自己的商用飛機，以與主導的製造商波音和空中巴士競爭。最初的型號被稱為 C919，與單通道波音 737 和空中巴士 A320 相當。霍尼韋爾宇航公司成功競標為 C919 提供主要運行部件。它將開發、製造、安裝和服務C919導航系統、輔助動力裝置、電傳飛行控制系統（自動駕駛儀）和起落架總成；合約期限價值160億美元。

d6ef478bc3baf51425585652a1f9567c0fe3e782.sourceText: China’s entry into the airplane manufacturing market could not be better timed. Boeing recently released its new aircraft demand forecast for the next 20 years: the Asia-Pacific Region will need 12,820 new commercial airplanes valued at $1.890 Trillion; China, alone, will need 6,000 new commercial aircraft valued at $780 Billion. The C919 is projected to fulfill 12% of the new demand in China.
d6ef478bc3baf51425585652a1f9567c0fe3e782.translatedText: 中國進入飛機製造市場的時機再好不過了。波音公司近日發布了未來20年新飛機需求預測：亞太地區將需要12,820架新商用飛機，價值18,900億美元；光是中國就需要 6,000 架新商用飛機，價值 7,800 億美元。 C919預計將滿足中國新增需求的12%。

6aecb04f4533f328fa1070487331772b302c3439.sourceText: ” Doing Business in China ”Entry into the China market can be daunting for any company. Honeywell Aerospace Asia-Pacific formed a joint venture (JV) partnership with a Chinese State-Owned Enterprise to jointly bid and develop components and systems for the C919. Western companies desiring to enter China may want to partner with a local company to help in working through the legal, regulatory and political systems and requirements. Regarding transfer of technology through JVs, such transfers will inevitably occur in a JV therefore it is imperative that companies stay ahead by continuing to innovate through research and development.
6aecb04f4533f328fa1070487331772b302c3439.translatedText: 「在中國做生意」 進入中國市場對任何公司來說都是令人畏懼的。霍尼韋爾亞太航空航太公司與一家中國國有企業建立了合資企業 (JV) 合作夥伴關係，共同投標和開發 C919 的零件和系統。想要進入中國的西方公司可能希望與當地公司合作，幫助他們滿足法律、監管和政治制度及要求。關於透過合資企業進行技術轉讓，此類轉讓不可避免地會在合資企業中發生，因此公司必須透過持續研發創新來保持領先地位。

010332624308505fad72b1ed0e13799dd50f012e.sourceText: ” Cultural Competency ”Honeywell and its expatriate employees learned early the importance of understanding and embracing the structures and norms of the local culture where they conduct business. Understanding the local culture in China is advantageous and helpful though not a guarantee of success. With regard to the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (illegal to bribe foreign officials) Honeywell is well aware of the law and makes conscious efforts to inform and educate its employees on not running afoul of the law. Honeywell’s corporate integrity is paramount and the company will guard and protect it. China’s new leaders have embarked on a campaign to reduce and stop public official corruption. This new policy directive hopefully will help relieve pressures on foreign companies from unscrupulous officials and companies. Succeeding in China is possible while also complying with the FCPA.
010332624308505fad72b1ed0e13799dd50f012e.translatedText: 「文化能力」霍尼韋爾及其外籍員工很早就認識到理解和接受其開展業務的當地文化的結構和規範的重要性。了解中國當地文化是有利且有幫助的，但不是成功的保證。對於美國《反海外腐敗法》（賄賂外國官員屬於違法行為），霍尼韋爾對該法律瞭如指掌，並有意識地對員工進行告知和教育，以免觸犯法律。霍尼韋爾的企業誠信至關重要，公司將捍衛和保護它。中國的新領導人已開始進行減少和停止公職人員腐敗的運動。這項新的政策指令有望有助於緩解不法官員和企業對外國企業的壓力。在遵守 FCPA 的同時，也有可能在中國取得成功。

0d20375aed014179af8b4076856fc62b57e9a7c0.sourceText: ” China Presence Required” ‘ ”Any business desiring to be global must be in China,” said Briand Greer, President, Honeywell Aerospace Asia-Pacific. China, the second largest economy in the world, will continue to expand; any global business without a presence there will be at a disadvantage.
0d20375aed014179af8b4076856fc62b57e9a7c0.translatedText: 「需要在中國開展業務」 「任何想要走向全球的企業都必須在中國開展業務，」霍尼韋爾航空航天亞太區總裁 Briand Greer 說道。中國作為世界第二大經濟體，將繼續擴張；任何沒有在那裡開展業務的全球企業都會處於不利地位。

ce21a6299186436f9b04eb0bc050e104b1733666.sourceText: Mr. Greer is a graduate of the U.S. Naval Academy receiving a Bachelor’s Degree in Political Science and International Affairs. He also holds an MBA from Duke University and his further academic experience includes graduate level management studies at Harvard University, the University of Tennessee and with the U.S. Department of Commerce.

2ae4ca790e4fef02d5e35ca19b6eac1aaf526d08.sourceText: Tzu Chi Named NVOAD Member of the Year

2ae55cf5af02839d9616dde8096c6cb005ca2331.sourceText: Tzu Chi USA was named Member of the Year at the 21st National Voluntary Organizations Active in Disaster (NVOAD) Conference. NVOAD is a network of organizations that provide disaster relief in the United States. Its 110 members represent the best of American volunteer organizations. Tzu Chi officially became a member in October 2006. It is the only Buddhist organization in the network. The blue and white uniforms of Tzu Chi volunteers and the way they have quietly inspired a culture of doing good deeds are widely respected by people in the US. The Member of the Year Award is only given to one organization each year. This year there were five nominees. Tzu Chi was nominated by Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA). In their nomination, FEMA pointed out that in their disaster relief efforts in 2012, Tzu Chi was a national role model in many ways. They inspired a culture of gratitude, respect and love in relief efforts and doing good deeds. They also promoted environmental protection as a way to care for the earth among the disaster victims and their communities. On May 14th, the award ceremony was held at the NVOAD Conference in Portland, Oregon. As the emcee announced Tzu Chi as the recipient of the award, a picture of Master Cheng Yen was shown on the screens, followed by pictures from the Buddha Bathing Ceremony at Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall with more than 10,000 participants and a heartwarming scene of Tzu Chi volunteers serving hot meals after Hurricane Sandy. These images moved the 450-plus representatives from other disaster relief organizations and they showed their support and admiration for Tzu Chi. NVOAD plays a role in connecting the federal government, non-profit agencies, religious organizations, companies and academia. It has a significant impact on establishing and promoting education for disaster response planning. Burgo Kim, chairman of this network, visited Tzu Chi in Taiwan in July 2010. In 2012, Tzu Chi USA participated in disaster relief efforts after Hurricane Sandy, Texas fertilizer plant explosion, floods in the Midwest, tornadoes in the Southwest, etc., as well as recycling efforts in American Samoa. Tzu Chi Foundation says that in 1985, Tzu Chi volunteers living abroad established a chapter in the US and extended the reach of Tzu Chi missions overseas. Currently, the organization has one national office, eight regional offices, 100 local offices, and over 200,000 members in the United States. Each time a major disaster strikes in America, Tzu Chi volunteers provide both immediate comfort and long-term support for the victims after the disaster. Their actions have touched and are respected by the American government’s disaster response personnel. They are a great partner for FEMA.
2ae55cf5af02839d9616dde8096c6cb005ca2331.translatedText: 美國慈濟在第21屆全國救災志工組織（NVOAD）大會上被評為年度會員。 NVOAD 是一個在美國提供救災服務的組織網路。其 110 名成員代表了美國最優秀的志工組織。慈濟於2006年10月正式成為會員，是慈濟網絡中唯一的佛教組織。慈濟志工藍白相間的製服，默默倡導的行善文化，受到美國民眾的廣泛尊重。年度會員獎每年僅頒發給一個組織。今年有五名提名者。慈濟獲聯邦緊急事務管理局（FEMA）提名。聯邦緊急管理局在提名中指出，在2012年的救災工作中，慈濟在許多方面都是全國的榜樣。他們在救災工作和行善中激發了感恩、尊重和愛心的文化。他們也向災民及其社區宣傳環境保護，以此作為關懷地球的方式。 5月14日，頒獎典禮在俄勒岡州波特蘭市的NVOAD會議上舉行。當主持人宣布慈濟獲獎時，螢幕上出現了證嚴上人的照片，接著是中正紀念堂浴佛儀式上萬餘人參與的畫面，以及颶風桑迪後慈濟志願者送上熱飯的溫馨場景。這些畫面感動了450多名其他救災組織的代表，他們表達了對慈濟的支持和讚賞。 NVOAD 發揮連結聯邦政府、非營利組織、宗教組織、公司和學術界的作用。它對建立和促進災害應對規劃教育有重大影響。該網絡主席Burgo Kim於2010年7月到訪台灣慈濟。 2012年，美國慈濟參與桑迪颶風、德州化肥廠爆炸、中西部洪水、西南龍捲風等救災工作，以及美屬薩摩亞的回收工作。慈濟基金會表示，1985年，旅居海外的慈濟志工在美國成立分會，將慈濟的任務延伸至海外。目前，該組織在美國設有 1 個國家辦事處、8 個地區辦事處、100 個地方辦事處，擁有超過 20 萬名會員。每次美國發生重大災難時，慈濟志工都會為災後災民提供即時安慰和長期支持。他們的行動感動了美國政府救災人員並受到尊重。他們是 FEMA 的重要合作夥伴。

8bd94221441f7a788246a56420f15f2f20a70616.sourceText: The stuff of Hollywood legend is rife in the story of El Tiradito, a little grotto in Tucson, Arizona, that may be the United States's only Catholic shrine dedicated to the memory of a sinner instead of a saint.
8bd94221441f7a788246a56420f15f2f20a70616.translatedText: 好萊塢傳奇故事充斥著亞利桑那州圖森 El Tiradito 的一個小石窟，它可能是美國唯一一座專門紀念罪人而不是聖人的天主教聖地。

6f79c09f4cfae2a65ea3efccb4c568eb0c8ae538.sourceText: The legend goes back to Tucson's Barrio Viejo in its early years, when a ranch hand named Juan Oliveras engaged in an affair with an older woman—his young wife's mother. Variations of the story exist, but most hinge on the sad demise of Oliveras, caught in the act and allegedly axed to death on the spot by the husband of his paramour, his own father-in-law.
6f79c09f4cfae2a65ea3efccb4c568eb0c8ae538.translatedText: 這個傳說可以追溯到圖森的 Barrio Viejo 早年，當時一位名叫胡安·奧利維拉斯 (Juan Oliveras) 的牧場工人與一位年長的女人（他年輕妻子的母親）有染。這個故事有很多版本，但大多數都取決於奧利維拉斯的悲慘死亡，他在行動中被捕，據稱被他的情人的丈夫，也就是他自己的岳父當場砍死。

03c6ee17bcbba44cc2c64d01423a079d73c6bab1.sourceText: Oliveras's disconsolate lover-in-law, unable to bury him in consecrated ground due to the nature of their sin, is supposed to have buried him near where he fell. In time, a shrine sprung up in Oliveras's memory. The legend of "El Tiradito" (the little castaway) was born.
03c6ee17bcbba44cc2c64d01423a079d73c6bab1.translatedText: 奧利維拉斯鬱悶的情人，由於他們的罪孽性質，無法將他埋葬在神聖的土地上，應該把他埋葬在他倒下的地方附近。隨著時間的推移，奧利維拉斯的記憶中出現了一座神殿。 「El Tiradito」（小漂流者）的傳說由此誕生。

3fc6ddecc25598acf7ed9e3204fa5d5a3893d42c.sourceText: While the shrine has moved from its original site, the grotto has been in its current location for close to 100 years and has evolved into a wishing shrine. Visitors leave candles, offerings, and photos, little slips of papers containing their heartbreaks and hopes rolled into the cracks of the crumbling adobe wall. Legend has it that if a candle burns through the night, the wish of the candle-lighter will be granted.
3fc6ddecc25598acf7ed9e3204fa5d5a3893d42c.translatedText: 雖然神社已從原址搬遷，但石窟已在現址保留了近 100 年，並已演變成一座許願神社。遊客留下蠟燭、祭品和照片，還有一些小紙片，裡面寫滿了他們的心碎和希望，這些小紙片被捲進搖搖欲墜的土坯牆的裂縫裡。傳說，如果一支蠟燭燃燒整夜，點燭人的願望就會實現。

7c7f197bf22f85a57dd67b4d7f222618d874ca1f.sourceText: The historic Pima County Courthouse is also home to the Tucson visitors center. The second-floor courtroom was restored to its original 1930's style where John Dillinger and his gang were brought before a judge.
7c7f197bf22f85a57dd67b4d7f222618d874ca1f.translatedText: 歷史悠久的皮馬縣法院也是圖森遊客中心的所在地。二樓法庭恢復了原來的 1930 年代風格，約翰·迪林格 (John Dillinger) 和他的團夥被帶到法官面前。

4c15d1c7381822cee61681141a07237649095d69.sourceText: Jun Shen received his PhD in Physics from the Univeristy of Notre Dame in 1990 and became a member of the technical staff at the Motorola Corporate Research Laboratory in Phoenix the same year. He moved to Arizona State University (ASU) in 1996 where he held a faculty position until 2006 when he dedicated full time to his entrepreneurial activities in the U.S. In fall, 2008, he started a new venture independently. His China operation started a year later focusing on a new generation of micro-magnetic relay products. Jun is an avid inventor, has an extensive invention portfolio. He received several awards in his career for his technical achievements. He is a world leading expert on microelectromechanical systems especially micro-magnetic switches.

2839f1b7fa8476c98da3e4f886b0c66800d89e78.sourceText: The 2012 ASU Chinese Language Camp will be held from June 10 to 24, 2012 in ASU Tempe Campus. The 15-day residential program provides students an opportunity to explore and expand their knowledge in Chinese language and culture through a highly structured theme- and task-based curriculum. During the program, students will receive intensive Chinese language instruction and participate in fun, hands-on cultural activities. The program boasts a living-learning setting where participants will gain first-hand college life experience. After the program, students will commit to continuing Chinese language learning.
2839f1b7fa8476c98da3e4f886b0c66800d89e78.translatedText: 2012年ASU漢語夏令營將於2012年6月10日至24日於ASU坦佩校區舉行。為期 15 天的住宿計畫透過高度結構化的主題和任務課程為學生提供了探索和擴展中國語言和文化知識的機會。在計畫期間，學生將接受強化漢語教學並參與有趣的實踐文化活動。該計畫擁有一個生活學習環境，參與者將獲得第一手的大學生活經驗。計畫結束後，學生將致力於繼續漢語學習。

f6b6dc31821aa6155a5f6b02fc4e3a2d752a063e.sourceText: The camp is for current 9-12 th grade Arizona high school students, whose proficiency level of Chinese language ranges from zero to intermediate. ONLY accepted applicants will pay $175 non-refundable registration fee upon acceptance of the program.
f6b6dc31821aa6155a5f6b02fc4e3a2d752a063e.translatedText: 該夏令營針對亞利桑那州目前9-12年級的高中生，漢語程度從零到中級。學費、住宿費、餐費、教學材料和實地考察都是免費的，並且將由 STARTALK 補助金支付。只有被錄取的申請者在接受該計劃後將支付 175 美元且不可退還的註冊費。

3e884551964893eb2c7dc8ee2184a32c9f299f64.sourceText: For much of the history of the United States, crossing the Colorado River proved a near insurmountable challenge. Impassable canyon cliffs lined the river for hundreds of miles, and in places where one was able to get down to the river's shore there were usually formidable rapids or cliffs awaiting on the opposite side. At one spot however, where the Paria River meets the Colorado River in what’s now northern Arizona, there’s a relatively calm section of river with lower banks. It was here, in the far corner of Mormon country, that Mormon president and Utah territorial governor Brigham Young dispatched John D. Lee to operate a ferry to allow the crossing of the Colorado River.
3e884551964893eb2c7dc8ee2184a32c9f299f64.translatedText: 在美國歷史的大部分時間裡，跨越科羅拉多河被證明是一項幾乎無法克服的挑戰。無法逾越的峽谷懸崖沿著河流綿延數百英里，在人們能夠到達河岸的地方，通常會有令人畏懼的急流或懸崖在對岸等待。然而，在帕里亞河與科羅拉多河在現在亞利桑那州北部交匯的地方，有一段相對平靜的河段，河岸較低。正是在這裡，在摩門教國家的偏遠角落，摩門教總統兼猶他州州長楊百翰 (Brigham Young) 派遣約翰·D·李 (John D. Lee) 運營一艘渡輪，以便穿越科羅拉多河。

cab31c5df64a771ab4d02b2b8fabd7cc72b845f1.sourceText: Lee arrived in the area that would come to bear his name in 1870, bringing two of his wives and many of his children with him. Although a prominent and influential early Mormon pioneer, Lee was sent to this faraway posting in an attempt to hide him from the federal government, which was working to prosecute the perpetrators of the Mountain Meadows Massacre , the slaughter of 120 pioneers from Arkansas who were passing through the Utah territory in 1857.
cab31c5df64a771ab4d02b2b8fabd7cc72b845f1.translatedText: 李於 1870 年抵達這個以他的名字命名的地區，並帶來了他的兩個妻子和許多孩子。儘管李是一位著名且有影響力的早期摩門教先驅，但他被派到這個遙遠的崗位，是為了向聯邦政府隱瞞他的情況，聯邦政府正在努力起訴 1857 年山地草甸大屠殺的肇事者，該事件屠殺了 120 名來自阿肯色州、途經猶他州領土的先驅者。

3f59c9bd838955859007a2b5d72a8bce7c58eee1.sourceText: In the first few years after Lee arrived, he constructed a ranch for his families that he named “Lonely Dell” and built the infrastructure for the ferry service, which was up and running in 1873 and soon attracted hordes of travelers. In 1874, relations between the Mormon settlers and the Navajo grew tense, so a fort was constructed at the ferry, although it never saw official use and was soon converted into a trading post.
3f59c9bd838955859007a2b5d72a8bce7c58eee1.translatedText: 李到達後的最初幾年，他為家人建造了一個牧場，將其命名為“孤獨戴爾”，並為渡輪服務建造了基礎設施，渡輪服務於 1873 年投入運行，很快就吸引了大批遊客。 1874 年，摩門教定居者與納瓦霍人之間的關係變得緊張，因此在渡口建造了一座堡壘，儘管它從未被正式使用，但很快就被改造成一個貿易站。

7c9aace689ba485e106e15902fe5ab9b9555d009.sourceText: In 1877, the law finally caught up to Lee and he was executed for his role in the Mountain Meadows Massacre 20 years prior. After Lee's execution, his wife Emma ran the ferry until 1879 when the Mormon Church purchased the ferry from her and sent new caretakers to operate it.
7c9aace689ba485e106e15902fe5ab9b9555d009.translatedText: 1877 年，法律最終追上了李，他因 20 年前在 Mountain Meadows 大屠殺中所扮演的角色而被處決。李被處決後，他的妻子艾瑪 (Emma) 負責經營渡輪，直到 1879 年摩門教會從她手中購買了渡輪，並派了新的看護人來運營。

1deba5ea92c89b159a0153845258f93bf593ee54.sourceText: Over the decades, Mormon pioneers continued to run the ferry and Lonely Dell was continually expanded. In the early 1900s there was a boom of gold prospecting in southern Utah and northern Arizona and mining companies used Lee's Ferry as a base of operations. The most notable of these was the American Placer Company, led by Charles Spencer. Spencer hauled in tons of equipment, including a 92-foot long steamboat, but the gold in the area was too meager and his expenses were too high.Spencer left the area broke in 1912, abandoning his equipment and the steamboat behind. The steamboat sank in 1921 but can still be seen today at the bottom of the Colorado River.
1deba5ea92c89b159a0153845258f93bf593ee54.translatedText: 幾十年來，摩門教先驅們繼續經營渡輪，孤獨戴爾 (Lonely Dell) 不斷擴建。 1900 年代初期，猶他州南部和亞利桑那州北部出現了黃金勘探熱潮，礦業公司以李氏渡口為營運基地。其中最著名的是查爾斯·史賓塞領導的美國普萊瑟公司。史賓塞拖運了大量設備，其中包括一艘 92 英尺長的汽船，但該地區的黃金太少，他的開支太高。史賓塞於 1912 年身無分文地離開了該地區，拋棄了他的設備和汽船。這艘汽船於 1921 年沈沒，但至今仍可在科羅拉多河底部看到。

987ce44cd34cc9f308a4753a65fa002eeb8a718e.sourceText: In 1928, in what became the last ever crossing at Lee's Ferry, the ferryboat sank and three people drowned. Navajo Bridge opened seven months later, four miles downstream from Lee's Ferry, and the settlement faded into quiet obscurity.
987ce44cd34cc9f308a4753a65fa002eeb8a718e.translatedText: 1928 年，在李氏渡口最後一次過境時，渡船沉沒，三人溺水身亡。七個月後，納瓦荷大橋在李渡口下游四英里處開通，定居點逐漸變得默默無聞。

f724735ec7cddaf122eeb0095fe2a2f3e51e3198.sourceText: 1. Mix dough: The night before, combine all ingredients in a big bowl with a wooden spoon until the dough just comes together. It will be a shaggy, doughy mess. Cover with plastic wrap and let sit 12-20 hours on countertop.
f724735ec7cddaf122eeb0095fe2a2f3e51e3198.translatedText: 1。混合面团：前一天晚上，用木勺将所有成分混合在一个大碗中，直到面团混合在一起。這將會是一個蓬鬆、鬆軟的爛攤子。蓋上保鮮膜，放在檯面上 12-20 小時。

794d2af5435df5173788e8886bf9427a6fc6b6f5.sourceText: Install smoke detectors in or near all sleeping areas and on every level of your home, including the basement. Check smoke detectors on a regular basis and replace the batteries twice yearly.
794d2af5435df5173788e8886bf9427a6fc6b6f5.translatedText: 在所有睡眠區域或附近以及家中的每一層（包括地下室）安裝煙霧偵測器。定期檢查煙霧偵測器，每年更換電池兩次。

cc3c42c127b5f0dcbf3e6add1aff3fc49bf1326a.sourceText: Have A-B-C type fire extinguishers. Teach family members how to use them.
cc3c42c127b5f0dcbf3e6add1aff3fc49bf1326a.translatedText: 擁有 A-B-C 型滅火器。教導家庭成員如何使用它們。

c5b46331583e943c1123824e37dbccbf26dacb99.sourceText: Know the location of all exits including windows. If you live in an apartment, count the number of doorways between your apartment and the two nearest exits.
c5b46331583e943c1123824e37dbccbf26dacb99.translatedText: 了解所有出口（包括窗戶）的位置。如果您住在公寓裡，請數一下您的公寓和兩個最近出口之間的門口數量。

9e8c36bd7f870b088a3a176b2bdf77ca6a87a919.sourceText: Know two ways out of every room in case smoke or flames block your primary exit.
9e8c36bd7f870b088a3a176b2bdf77ca6a87a919.translatedText: 了解每個房間的兩個出路，以防煙霧或火焰堵塞您的主要出口。

960dede6366ca20a1a892267e8b8c5e0cacd47b6.sourceText: Choose a meeting place outside the home.

723cdac5832ca898dcba849581b11f0e393be164.sourceText: Have an escape plan and practice it with your family. This will help ensure you can get out quickly when there is no time for mistakes.
723cdac5832ca898dcba849581b11f0e393be164.translatedText: 制定逃生計畫並與家人一起練習。這將有助於確保您能夠在沒有時間犯錯時快速離開。

2dd7b42147b48d23c780a2b297a3ab568e12bd42.sourceText: Keep folding or chain style ladders stored in each upstairs bedroom.
2dd7b42147b48d23c780a2b297a3ab568e12bd42.translatedText: 在樓上的每間臥室中存放折疊式或鍊式梯子。

1916649419c31914d57195196b2807d71ee0630e.sourceText: Use alternative heat sources, such as woodstoves or space heaters, safely: Never use gas ovens, gas ranges, barbecues, or most portable or propane heaters for indoor heating.
1916649419c31914d57195196b2807d71ee0630e.translatedText: 安全地使用替代熱源，例如木爐或空間加熱器：切勿使用瓦斯爐、瓦斯爐、燒烤架或大多數便攜式或丙烷加熱器進行室內加熱。

3764e30e1c74cb7963229a162ea0b06e81d4eceb.sourceText: Have fire-fighting materials available: dry powder, fire extinguisher, heavy tarp or blanket, and water.
3764e30e1c74cb7963229a162ea0b06e81d4eceb.translatedText: 有可用的消防材料：乾粉、滅火器、重型防水布或毯子以及水。

def9d3482ba8a6bd2d4b65cbc10db20ea827a672.sourceText: Before using an alternative heat source, read the manufacturer’s instructions.
def9d3482ba8a6bd2d4b65cbc10db20ea827a672.translatedText: 在使用替代熱源之前，請先閱讀製造商的說明。

37940da19150ff47697c3d6c80d8bd3917077af0.sourceText: Do not smoke in the bedroom, on the couch or anywhere you might fall asleep while smoking.
37940da19150ff47697c3d6c80d8bd3917077af0.translatedText: 請勿在臥室、沙發上或吸煙時可能睡著的任何地方吸煙。

c6245d54f1524f912f0645a17b1b390e62a348c6.sourceText: Sleep with your bedroom door closed.

dfb1455f3dbbcc211aa3c03c71e78880523aca46.sourceText: Make sure your house number is clearly visible from the street and that fire trucks can reach your home.
dfb1455f3dbbcc211aa3c03c71e78880523aca46.translatedText: 確保從街上可以清楚地看到您的門牌號，並且消防車可以到達您家。

41478af00d5e3db874e00f5778195892cc5160ce.sourceText: If there is a fire?evacuate. Do not go back inside. Call 9-1-1 from a neighbor’s house.
41478af00d5e3db874e00f5778195892cc5160ce.translatedText: 如果發生火災？請撤離。不要回到裡面。請從鄰居家撥打 9-1-1。

8b2466f39fdf9631b038a43614685af61a83ae67.sourceText: Never use water on an electrical fire.
8b2466f39fdf9631b038a43614685af61a83ae67.translatedText: 切勿用水撲滅電氣火災。

308f5baeac020cef3c0262a6b96b551fcaad2eaa.sourceText: Smother oil and grease fires in the kitchen with baking soda or salt, or put a lid over the flame if it is burning in a pan.
308f5baeac020cef3c0262a6b96b551fcaad2eaa.translatedText: 用小蘇打或鹽撲滅廚房中的油和油脂火，如果平底鍋中正在燃燒，請蓋上蓋子。

76195303adf6c3ed5c03e4d3c6572138b214f6f4.sourceText: If caught in smoke?drop to your hands and knees and crawl; breathe shallowly through your nose and use your blouse, shirt or jacket as a filter.
76195303adf6c3ed5c03e4d3c6572138b214f6f4.translatedText: 如果陷入煙霧？趴下，用手和膝蓋爬行；透過鼻子淺呼吸，並使用襯衫、襯衫或夾克作為過濾器。

0bff1685a451cb7f1533c51f7af4aeac6d818a29.sourceText: If you must move through flames?hold your breath, move quickly, cover your head and hair, keep your head down and close your eyes as much as possible.
0bff1685a451cb7f1533c51f7af4aeac6d818a29.translatedText: 如果您必須穿過火焰？請屏住呼吸，快速移動，遮住頭部和頭髮，低下頭並儘可能閉上眼睛。

8cdd7d449efdde4cfd4c803fde4fc06b4eebeadc.sourceText: If your clothes catch fire, top, drop and roll?until the fire is out.
8cdd7d449efdde4cfd4c803fde4fc06b4eebeadc.translatedText: 如果您的衣服著火，脫下、掉落並打滾？直到火被撲滅。

005271d793d77ff992cc6e690b726ba143d3d3ed.sourceText: If you are in a room and cannot escape, leave the door closed, stay low to the floor and hang a white or light-colored sheet outside the window.
005271d793d77ff992cc6e690b726ba143d3d3ed.translatedText: 如果您在房間內且無法行動逃生時，請將門關上，保持低至地板的位置，並在窗外掛一塊白色或淺色的床單。

3c686d62fd8c02be672590e2ddd766c7f218f77c.sourceText: Be sure all family members are accounted for. If someone is missing, let the fire department know.
3c686d62fd8c02be672590e2ddd766c7f218f77c.translatedText: 確保所有家庭成員都在。如果有人失踪，請通知消防局。

8b2f226dacb6b5ab30d5ad0cf148eee906ec3c3b.sourceText: Why higher ed, advanced energy systems will rescue global climate policy
8b2f226dacb6b5ab30d5ad0cf148eee906ec3c3b.translatedText: 為什麼高等教育、先進的能源系統將拯救全球氣候政策

ec8e193f26ba6eeef9cb4632cb96cc222ee21a46.sourceText: Why higher ed, advanced energy systems will rescue glob…
ec8e193f26ba6eeef9cb4632cb96cc222ee21a46.translatedText: 為什麼高等教育、先進的能源系統將拯救全球…

d770afc77f54065f718d2bc6d7ed3d5c6bfe5764.sourceText: So, the question remains: How can policymakers, institutions of higher education, and citizens from all over the world foster a conversation on global climate policy that sparks action? By demanding superior systems of energy use is one proposal, which will be discussed at an upcoming panel organized by ASU’s Global Institute of Sustainability.
d770afc77f54065f718d2bc6d7ed3d5c6bfe5764.translatedText: 所以，問題依然存在：政策制定者、高等教育機構和來自世界各地的公民如何促進關於全球氣候政策的對話，從而引發行動？其中一項提案是要求建立卓越的能源利用系統，該提案將在亞利桑那州立大學全球永續發展研究所組織的即將召開的小組討論會上進行討論。

d8e388694ca944c9eea6ea3e7e4238e8b6e40412.sourceText: The public panel discussion ‘Rescuing Climate Policy’ is scheduled to take place at 4 p.m., Feb. 5, inside Wrigley Hall, room 481, on ASU’s Tempe campus. The talk will blend American, European and Chinese perspectives on the development and adoption of advanced systems of energy use.
d8e388694ca944c9eea6ea3e7e4238e8b6e40412.translatedText: 「拯救氣候政策」公共小組討論定於 2 月 5 日下午 4 點在亞利桑那州立大學坦佩校區 481 室瑞格利大廳內舉行。該演講將融合美國、歐洲和中國對先進能源使用系統的開發和採用的觀點。

b01bb7bf652c2a9036c8bc16953e0047c16038c4.sourceText: Superior systems of energy use, the panel argues, would deliver energy not only with minimal emissions, but also at lower cost, and/or higher quality to the customers, thereby creating a global competition for creating and adopting such energy systems.
b01bb7bf652c2a9036c8bc16953e0047c16038c4.translatedText: 專家小組認為，先進的能源使用系統不僅可以以最小的排放量提供能源，而且可以以更低的成本和/或更高的品質向客戶提供能源，從而為創建和採用此類能源系統創造全球競爭。

da8c7b15bad21e1f805638b1ed661080218c0a24.sourceText: ? 0b04876b14e289debad0e4278cb41db73829ccf9.sourceText: Scratched, time-worn religious sculptures stand within the shade of the Congress Street Bridge, forming a lovely, peaceful sculpture garden. Quite miraculously, they’ve survived decades of floods, droughts, and vandalism.
0b04876b14e289debad0e4278cb41db73829ccf9.translatedText: 國會街大橋的樹蔭下矗立著一些被刮傷、磨損的宗教雕塑，形成了一個可愛、寧靜的雕塑花園。相當奇蹟的是，它們在數十年的洪水、乾旱和破壞行為中倖存下來。

ec2e3bd1bcad86b90f5868a1dfccb4a4d714bcf2.sourceText: They exist because during World War I, a man named Felix Lucero lay seriously injured on a battlefield in France . Wounded and in agony, he proposed a deal with God: If he survived, he’d use his natural skills as a sculptor to create religious statues.
ec2e3bd1bcad86b90f5868a1dfccb4a4d714bcf2.translatedText: 它們的存在是因為第一次世界大戰期間，一個名叫菲利克斯·盧塞羅的人在法國戰場上受了重傷。受傷和痛苦中的他向上帝提出了一項協議：如果他活下來，他將利用自己作為雕塑家的天賦來創作宗教雕像。

9f74550f223ba204cf71414270b1e6e5e9c6194b.sourceText: After returning home from the war, Lucero set about making good on his word. In the late 1930s, he lived in Tucson , Arizona , in a shack beneath a bridge. From there, he began creating beautiful works of art.
9f74550f223ba204cf71414270b1e6e5e9c6194b.translatedText: 從戰爭歸來後，盧塞羅開始兌現他的承諾。 1930 年代末，他住在亞利桑那州圖森市一座橋下的小屋。從那時起，他開始創作美麗的藝術作品。

2a9270dc8ed1c8ee9fe1272e5dd30f49a8db4fde.sourceText: While in Tucson, Lucero spent years crafting detailed statues of religious figures out of sand and debris from the Santa Cruz River, which he then slathered in a protective coat of plaster. He created iconic Biblical scenes, including the Last Supper, Joseph and Mary, and Jesus on the crucifix.
2a9270dc8ed1c8ee9fe1272e5dd30f49a8db4fde.translatedText: 在圖森期間，盧塞羅花了數年時間，用聖克魯斯河的沙子和碎片製作了詳細的宗教人物雕像，然後在雕像上塗上了一層保護性的石膏。他創作了標誌性的聖經場景，包括《最後的晚餐》、《約瑟夫和瑪麗》以及十字架上的耶穌。

e85aa28a7ef188b9aa451b63a6eb8141c2d46264.sourceText: Though Lucero died in 1951, his work is still standing—which is amazing, considering the statues weren’t built from lasting materials and have faced frequent vandalism over the years. Many are damaged, but they still stand tall. Dedicated locals have worked to salvage and repair the sculptures after each vandalism incident, and in the 1980s moved them to form this sculpture garden near the very bridge Lucero once lived beneath.
e85aa28a7ef188b9aa451b63a6eb8141c2d46264.translatedText: 儘管盧塞羅於 1951 年去世，但他的作品仍然屹立不倒，這令人驚嘆，因為這些雕像不是用耐久的材料建造的，而且多年來經常遭到破壞。許多都被損壞了，但它們仍然屹立不倒。每次破壞事件發生後，當地人都會盡心盡責地搶救和修復這些雕塑，並在 20 世紀 80 年代將它們搬到了盧塞羅曾經居住過的橋附近，形成了這個雕塑花園。

7f26407464b23a2317e8572a42f55f7dfed6d96a.sourceText: American Legion Thomas Tang Post 50 honored Chinese veterans at its annual 2013 fall banquet on Saturday, November 16, at the Great Wall Restaurant. The keynote speaker for the evening was WWII Veteran Henry Ong Jr. who described his experiences as a prisoner of war in a German prison camp. Legion Commander Jim Ong also welcomed Arizona Legion Commander Judith S. Beischel who said she was proud of American Legion Post 50 and the service that its members has done for its community. Over 150 veterans, family and friends attended the banquet to good food, dining music, door prizes, and dancing.
7f26407464b23a2317e8572a42f55f7dfed6d96a.translatedText: 11 月 16 日星期六，美國退伍軍人協會在長城餐廳舉行的 2013 年秋季年度宴會上向 50 名中國退伍軍人致敬。當晚的主講人是二戰老兵小亨利·翁（Henry Ong Jr.），他講述了自己在德國戰俘營中作為戰俘的經歷。軍團指揮官吉姆·翁 (Jim Ong) 也對亞利桑那州軍團指揮官朱迪思·S·貝舍爾 (Judith S. f6e311bd35601bf157b8de8a6ab6f7d5b7068b59.translatedText: USCIS 推出中文互動系列首次對話將於 2 月 16 日舉行 主題：成為美國公民

4e2ee3eb4e8e3067345d728f6156bf5416e87b50.sourceText: PHOENIX, Arizona -U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) will conduct its first national Chinese-language public engagement on Thursday, February 16, broadcast from its San Francisco office. The USCIS Office in Phoenix is inviting stakeholders to view and participate in the national engagement at the local Phoenix office from 11:30 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. MST. The topic will be ‘The Naturalization Process: Becoming a United States Citizen.’ This free session will feature a presentation in Chinese and a question and answer period.
4e2ee3eb4e8e3067345d728f6156bf5416e87b50.translatedText: 亞利桑那州菲尼克斯 - 美國公民及移民服務局 (USCIS) 將於 2 月 16 日星期四舉行首次全國公眾參與活動，並由其舊金山辦公室進行廣播。美國公民及移民服務局鳳凰城辦事處邀請利益相關者於上午 11:30 至下午 1:00 在當地鳳凰城辦事處觀看並參與全國活動。 MST。主題是「入籍過程：成為美國公民」。本次免費會議將有中文演示和問答環節。

f4788d52e2b84f1ee51cfe0252771613c744c968.sourceText: This will be the first in a series of engagements called ‘ jiao liu’ meaning engagement in Chinese. At these sessions, USCIS officials will provide agency updates, help customers understand how best to navigate through the immigration experience, and host a question-and-answer forum. Individuals are invited to participate in person in San Francisco, via live Web stream in Phoenix, or via live Web stream or teleconference elsewhere.
f4788d52e2b84f1ee51cfe0252771613c744c968.translatedText: 這將是一系列名為「jiao liu」的活動中的第一個，中文意思是「參與」。在這些會議上，美國移民局官員將提供機構最新訊息，幫助客戶了解如何最好地完成移民體驗，並舉辦問答論壇。邀請個人親自參加舊金山、鳳凰城的網路直播或其他地方的網路直播或電話會議。

270e986d886bcc0c84d0a2f5381559d33ca5081b.sourceText: This initiative underscores USCIS’s commitment to effectively engage with the diverse communities which it serves and to provide timely information about USCIS immigration benefits and services. For more information, please visit www.uscis.gov/jiaoliu.
270e986d886bcc0c84d0a2f5381559d33ca5081b.translatedText: 這項措施強調了 USCIS 致力於與其所服務的多元化社區進行有效互動，並及時提供有關 USCIS 移民福利和服務的資訊。欲了解更多信息，請訪問 www.uscis.gov/jiaoliu。

e9faf7a66b92666b9ebe138066e5e1003968465a.sourceText: For more information on USCIS and its programs, please visit www.uscis.gov or follow us on Twitter (@uscis), YouTube (/uscis) and the USCIS blog The Beacon.

1bc74865e261ee4b702c52af25818b46b1cf3e57.sourceText: A street fair is often the most vivid memory that many travelers retain from a visit to an Asian country. The winding passages and byways in small towns, as well as in large, metropolitan cities, are filled with loud-voiced vendors selling food, commemorative souvenirs, and arts and crafts at all levels of skill and quality. The booths are surrounded by avid shoppers who engage in a continuous stream of bargaining claims and counterclaims with the vendors. The rich and lively culture of the Asian street fair will be replicated at the 20 th Annual Asian Festival.
1bc74865e261ee4b702c52af25818b46b1cf3e57.translatedText: 街頭集市往往是許多遊客在訪問亞洲國家時留下的最生動的記憶。無論是小城鎮還是大城市，蜿蜒的通道和小巷裡都擠滿了大聲叫賣的小販，出售食品、紀念紀念品以及各種技術和品質的藝術品和手工藝品。攤位周圍都是狂熱的購物者，他們不斷地與供應商討價還價和反訴。亞洲街頭市集豐富熱鬧的文化將在第20屆亞洲節上複製。

6f63a9ce112a816491a558b76d5af5574e4c7322.sourceText: This Festival combines the ethnic character of dozens Asian cultures in a single celebration of native folklore, art, and exotic food. Entertainment for all ages will be provided in the form of music, dance, games, and unique shopping opportunities. Special presentations include Taiko drums, Folk Dancing, Fashion Shows and Martial Arts exhibitions.
6f63a9ce112a816491a558b76d5af5574e4c7322.translatedText: 這個節日將數十種亞洲文化的民族特色融合在本土民俗、藝術和異國美食的慶典中。將以音樂、舞蹈、遊戲和獨特的購物機會的形式為所有年齡段的人提供娛樂活動。特別展示包括太鼓、民俗舞蹈、時裝表演和武術展。

c3550391906b1c496658f5485547f39995decc6b.sourceText: An Avenue of Cultures will present detailed information on the traditions and attractions of over a dozen specific Asian cultures. Look for models posing in native dress and traditional costumes for photographic opportunities.
c3550391906b1c496658f5485547f39995decc6b.translatedText: 文化大道將詳細介紹十幾種特定亞洲文化的傳統和吸引力。尋找穿著當地服飾和傳統服裝的模特兒以獲得拍照機會。

84817e80dc23f54e339fed1cf7eded92c9f1bc70.sourceText: The Arizona Asian American Association is also offering, as supplementary events, a contest for students?Poster Drawing. The Contest is open to students in Grades K-2, 3-5, 6-8 and 9-12. There are monetary awards for all categories. Contest winners will be announced and receive their prizes at the Festival. (Further information and details for entries can be found on the Festival website: www.aaaa-az.org )

c38e7396268d0610ec341a196bf21728977f3279.sourceText: This desert watering hole has seen activity for thousands of years. Like its partner, the nearby Montezuma Castle , its name has nothing to do with the famous Aztec emperor, but everything to do with early European/American mistaken assumption that he had something to do with the area.
c38e7396268d0610ec341a196bf21728977f3279.translatedText: 這個沙漠水坑已經活動了數千年。和它的夥伴、附近的蒙特祖瑪城堡一樣，它的名字與著名的阿茲特克皇帝無關，但一切都與早期歐洲/美洲錯誤地認為他與該地區有關。

fa6a6ea7f3be66921aba830933441a52bd7aa1d8.sourceText: The part of Arizona where Montezuma Well sits has been inhabited by a number of groups over time, dating back as far as 10,000 years. You can find ruins of cliff dwellings around the rim of the well, which were inhabited by the Sinagua people between the 12th and 15th centuries.
fa6a6ea7f3be66921aba830933441a52bd7aa1d8.translatedText: 蒙特祖瑪井所在的亞利桑那州地區隨著時間的推移已經有許多群體居住，其歷史可以追溯到一萬年前。您可以在井的邊緣找到懸崖住宅的遺址，這裡是 12 世紀至 15 世紀期間西納瓜人居住的地方。

c213f734fc96ee006083f28b0c304d5076d3f6e7.sourceText: But the history of this desert water features dates back much further than that. About 12 million years ago, the Verde Valley was covered by a large shallow lake. After that lake dried up about 2 million years ago, leaving behind a bed of thick limestone. Over the years, underground streams carved out caverns within that stone. Montezuma Well is one of those caverns—when the layer of rock at the surface crumbled, it became a sinkhole. Its opening measures 368 feet across, and more than a million gallons of water flow through it every day.
c213f734fc96ee006083f28b0c304d5076d3f6e7.translatedText: 但這個沙漠水景的歷史可以追溯到更早的時候。大約1200萬年前，佛得角山谷被一個巨大的淺湖覆蓋。大約 200 萬年前，這個湖乾涸了，留下了厚厚的石灰岩床。多年來，地下溪流在石頭內鑿出了洞穴。蒙特祖瑪井就是其中之一——當地表的岩石層崩塌時，它就變成了一個天坑。它的開口寬 368 英尺，每天有超過一百萬加侖的水流過它。

d112c4749e90d7d7bdacb4bb97a00b8d7ef4e4e1.sourceText: The water in Montezuma Well is heavily carbonated and contains significant levels of arsenic, neither of which lend themselves to a thriving fish population. But the unique environment of this watering hole supports several species that are found nowhere else in the world, including a water scorpion ( Ranatra montezuma ) that feeds on the amphipods found in the water, a leech ( Motobdella montezuma ), and a tiny freshwater mollusk called the Montezuma Well springsnail ( Pyrgulopsis montezumensis ).
d112c4749e90d7d7bdacb4bb97a00b8d7ef4e4e1.translatedText: 蒙特祖瑪井的水富含碳酸，並且含有大量砷，這兩種物質都不適合魚類族群的繁盛。但這個水坑的獨特環境孕育了多種在世界其他地方找不到的物種，包括以水中發現的片腳類動物為食的水蠍 (Ranatra montezuma)、水蛭 (Motobdella montezuma) 和一種名為蒙特祖瑪井泉蝸牛 (Pyrgulopsis montezumensis) 的小型淡水軟體動物。

15c45dbe615864fea1438aa48c272e06e63bae40.sourceText: Some say that whatever exits the well, can never return. In 2006, the National Park Service sent divers into the water. They sent probes, cameras, and other equipment down and learned that what appeared to be the bottom of the well was actually a column of "fluidized sand" that more than doubled the estimated depth of the well.
15c45dbe615864fea1438aa48c272e06e63bae40.translatedText: 有人說凡是從井裡出來的，就再也回不來了。 2006年，國家公園管理局派潛水員下水。他們派出探測器、攝影機和其他設備，發現看似井底的東西實際上是一柱“流化沙”，其深度是井估計深度的兩倍多。

cbc2cef8a5abd4b92239b033db4759f5ff27ee1d.translatedText: 坦佩市副市長 Onnie Shekerjian 和社區領袖 Barry Wong 有幸為坦佩鎮湖龍舟比賽的開始點龍眼並「喚醒龍」。鳳凰小姐中國皇后李詩琳公主協助儀式。百年慶典為所有參加龍舟節的人們帶來了好運和好運。

e10d297d31650d0e938f8fe9e1284afa4715f354.sourceText: The 11th annual Arizona Dragon Boat Festival opening ceremony included many important people that made the festival a success.
e10d297d31650d0e938f8fe9e1284afa4715f354.translatedText: 第11屆亞利桑那州龍舟節開幕式上有許多重要人物，使龍舟節取得了成功。

6126288738262c302f7f060827092ff970234f04.sourceText: A record 75 dragon boat teams competed in the 11th year of racing on Tempe Town Lake.

4bb6b85cafaa19aa8eac96dd530c64d308522f18.sourceText: Naranja Park might be like thousands of others throughout the United States if not for the giant family of quails at the southern entrance. The tallest of these statues is over twelve feet tall. They hold objects normally expected at a park (although not among quails), such as a kite, a skateboard, and a soccer ball.
4bb6b85cafaa19aa8eac96dd530c64d308522f18.translatedText: 如果不是南入口處有巨大的鵪鶉家族，納蘭賈公園可能會像美國各地成千上萬的其他公園一樣。這些雕像中最高的有十二英尺高。他們拿著公園裡常見的物品（儘管不是鵪鶉），例如風箏、滑板和足球。

526ce4573f19d5a4954f3748c57144c7826076f2.sourceText: These humorous sculptures are appropriately the work of ten local high-school students, in partnership with the professional sculptors Jason Butler and Hiro Tashima. The statues consist of a steel skeleton surrounded by layers of foam and painted concrete. They are even supported underground by more concrete, making them sturdy enough to be played on by children.
526ce4573f19d5a4954f3748c57144c7826076f2.translatedText: 這些幽默的雕塑是十名當地高中生與專業雕塑家 Jason Butler 和 Hiro Tashima 合作的作品。這些雕像由鋼骨架組成，周圍是泡沫層和塗漆混凝土。它們甚至在地下由更多的混凝土支撐，使它們足夠堅固，可以讓孩子們玩耍。

a965a600bb277ee639ddec6e485d6fbc8435eb7b.sourceText: The sculptors paid extra attention to realism, adding features such as separate skateboard wheels that actually turn!
a965a600bb277ee639ddec6e485d6fbc8435eb7b.translatedText: 雕塑家特別注重現實主義，增加了諸如可以實際轉動的獨立滑板輪等功能！

4bee47cf9d0f2a88ac541c5355bc86b3a1720721.sourceText: Tradition is important at El Charro Cafe. Founded in 1922, it claims to be the oldest Mexican restaurant in the United States that's been continually operated by the same family. In that time, generations of chefs have passed down and perfected some seriously delicious recipes. The most important of these menu items can be seen drying in a dangling cage outside the restaurant every day.
4bee47cf9d0f2a88ac541c5355bc86b3a1720721.translatedText: El Charro 咖啡館的傳統非常重要。它成立於 1922 年，號稱是美國最古老的墨西哥餐廳，一直由同一家族經營。在那段時間裡，一代又一代的廚師傳承並完善了一些非常美味的食譜。這些菜單中最重要的菜餚每天都可以在餐廳外的懸掛籠子中看到晾乾。

3e2a1ed3477420fb81e64a2e942292db144bdbb2.sourceText: The dangling delicacy is El Charro’s carne seca . The jerky-like product starts as thinly sliced beef that gets marinated in garlic and lemon juice, then hoisted in the metal cage for a day’s worth of drying in the hot Sonoran sun. After baking further in an oven, the hard beef is then shredded into pillowy mounds of meat that adorn dishes ranging from tacos to enchiladas to cheese crisps.
3e2a1ed3477420fb81e64a2e942292db144bdbb2.translatedText: 懸掛的美食是 El Charro 的 carne seca 。這種肉乾狀的產品最初是切成薄片的牛肉，用大蒜和檸檬汁醃製，然後吊在金屬籠子裡，在索諾蘭炎熱的陽光下曬乾一天。在烤箱中進一步烘烤後，硬牛肉被切成枕頭狀的肉堆，用於裝飾從炸玉米餅到辣醬玉米餅餡再到起司薯片等菜餚。

252ab443174c375e0afe6df074d47b09e0760c80.sourceText: Long before it was a Tucson icon, El Charro was the brainchild of a stonemason’s daughter. Jules Flin came to Tucson from France after he was commissioned to build the city's Saint Augustine cathedral in the late 19th century. There, he met and married Carlota Brunet, who was of Mexican and French descent, and the couple had several children. But despite the holy overtones of Flin's occupation, his daughter, Monica, didn't exactly grow up to be the pious, quiet type. Carlotta Flores, Monica's great-niece and Charro’s current executive chef, told Biz Tucson that her great-aunt was a chainsmoker who “drank martinis from a teapot while playing card games during Prohibition.” That insatiability also applied to food. After briefly living in Mexico, Monica fell in love with the country's cuisine. When she returned north of the border, she opened a restaurant and named it El Charro, a term for a Mexican horseman.
252ab443174c375e0afe6df074d47b09e0760c80.translatedText: 早在 El Charro 成為圖森標誌之前，它就是一位石匠女兒的創意。 19 世紀末，朱爾斯·弗林 (Jules Flin) 受命建造該市的聖奧古斯丁大教堂，從法國來到圖森。在那裡，他遇到了墨西哥和法國血統的卡洛塔·布魯內特 (Carlota Brunet)，並與她結婚，夫妻倆育有幾個孩子。儘管弗林的職業帶有神聖的色彩，但他的女兒莫妮卡並沒有成長為虔誠、安靜的類型。莫妮卡的曾侄女、查羅的現任行政主廚卡洛塔·弗洛雷斯 (Carlotta Flores) 告訴 Biz Tucson，她的曾姨媽是個煙鬼，「在禁酒令期間一邊玩紙牌遊戲，一邊用茶壺喝馬提尼酒」。這種不知足的感覺也體現在食物上。在墨西哥短暫生活後，莫妮卡愛上了這個國家的美食。當她回到邊境以北時，她開了一家餐館，並將其命名為 El Charro（墨西哥騎手的意思）。

575dcb4cf9053658cb86bc6e1ff4738676af8919.sourceText: The restaurant had a slow start and, during a particularly difficult period, Flin had to relocate into the family home, which her father had built in 1896. This is the current site of El Charro's downtown branch on Court Avenue, and its oldest location. It retains some decorations brought over from the original restaurant as well as stone fixtures designed by Jules Flin himself. The spot became so successful, it spawned three additional locations in Arizona and one honorary "location" under the sea. Although they don't serve the restaurant's menu, the U.S.S. Tucson submarine wanted to pay tribute to one of its namesake city's most historic eateries. Its galley is officially named “El Charro Down Under.”
575dcb4cf9053658cb86bc6e1ff4738676af8919.translatedText: 餐廳起步緩慢，在一段特別困難的時期，弗林不得不搬進她父親於 1896 年建造的家中。這裡是 El Charro 市中心法院大道分店的現址，也是其最古老的位置。它保留了一些從原來餐廳帶來的裝飾以及朱爾斯·弗林親自設計的石製裝置。該景點非常成功，在亞利桑那州又增加了三個地點，並在海底設立了一個榮譽「地點」。雖然他們不提供餐廳的菜單，但 U.S.S.圖森潛艇想要向同名城市歷史最悠久的餐廳之一致敬。它的廚房正式命名為“El Charro Down Under”。

b353d6176924c9624331588c7243b2d33db24e97.sourceText: Tucson muralist Joe Pagac wanted to venture into art that was interactive and, literally, accessible to everyone. Using the ubiquitous javelina as a model, Joe placed one in the Captain's seat of a tandem waiting for his stoker. Folks love to pose on the rear saddle with Javier and will pet him for good luck on their rides.
b353d6176924c9624331588c7243b2d33db24e97.translatedText: 圖森壁畫家喬·帕加克 (Joe Pagac) 希望涉足互動藝術，並且實際上每個人都可以接觸到。喬以無處不在的標槍為模型，將其中一個放在等待他的補煤機的串聯船的船長座位上。人們喜歡與哈維爾一起在後座上擺姿勢，並撫摸他以祈求騎行好運。

40205143df2981c7c0fd80d57295adf537f88d11.sourceText: Located on the Rillito Loop Trail, at the intersection with the Mountain Avenue Bridge. After saying hola to Javier, you can relax at the nearby shops of St. Philips Plaza.
40205143df2981c7c0fd80d57295adf537f88d11.translatedText: 位於 Rillito Loop Trail 上，與 Mountain Avenue Bridge 的交叉口。向哈維爾問好後，您可以在聖飛利浦廣場附近的商店放鬆一下。
