e1c95cfa324842a17fe0d503cd1e1b9622ec43bd.translatedText: 位於 Baseline 路的坦佩中餐廳，提供自取和外帶服務。

651d8c153d909f0a648a5cf83f9ab94cafd8225e.sourceText: Chinese restaurant in Tempe on Baseline Road offering pickup, delivery, and a menu built around classic Chinese takeout dishes.
651d8c153d909f0a648a5cf83f9ab94cafd8225e.translatedText: 位於 Baseline 路的坦佩中餐廳，提供自取、外帶服務以及圍繞經典中式外帶菜餚的菜單。

0742bbae37f5fd6b1cd2b74d19d187df8f34f53c.sourceText: The city officially protects this location of ancient petroglyphs, which were engraved and/or pecked by the ancestors of the now a-day Hopi and Zuni tribes.
0742bbae37f5fd6b1cd2b74d19d187df8f34f53c.translatedText: 該市正式保護這一古代岩畫所在地，這些岩畫是由當今的霍皮族和祖尼部落的祖先雕刻和/或啄食的。

b60019233a2c8e050ce86b6e0b0082f88440d3c8.sourceText: In 2013 the site was recorded by archaeologists and volunteers. With the information forwarded into the Arizona Archives.
b60019233a2c8e050ce86b6e0b0082f88440d3c8.translatedText: 2013 年，考古學家和志工記錄了該遺址。這些資訊被轉發到亞利桑那州檔案館。

12c787c44cc0d122701896b398932a4dd3bb21c2.sourceText: In October 2015, the city council awarded a contract to Flagstaff -based American Conservation Experience to design and construct sustainable trails, retaining walls, water bars, and switchback details across the site. Work was completed in November of 2015 and has made the numerous features of the park easier to access.
12c787c44cc0d122701896b398932a4dd3bb21c2.translatedText: 2015 年 10 月，市議會向位於弗拉格斯塔夫的美國保護體驗公司授予了一份合同，負責設計和建造整個場地的可持續步道、擋土牆、水吧和之字形細節。工程於 2015 年 11 月竣工，使公園的眾多景點變得更加容易遊覽。

aa015220e838018d7fb2db3f84a580a3569f02c0.sourceText: The new trails and improvements allow visitors to safely explore the beautiful, but extremely fragile petroglyphs that are thousands of years old. The area also features a lake and is protected from hunting. Well over 200 bird species visit the area, making it a premier bird-watching location.
aa015220e838018d7fb2db3f84a580a3569f02c0.translatedText: 新步道和改進措施使遊客能夠安全地探索美麗但極其脆弱的數千年歷史的岩畫。該地區還設有一個湖泊，並禁止狩獵。該地區有超過 200 種鳥類，使其成為首要的觀鳥地點。

cc0f3e501c5e2b376372161cd6707011f0c4aea9.sourceText: Visitors can also ask to tour the Zuck Historic Ranch that archeologists believe is over 100 years old.
cc0f3e501c5e2b376372161cd6707011f0c4aea9.translatedText: 遊客還可以要求參觀扎克歷史牧場，考古學家認為該牧場已有 100 多年的歷史。

87044afe5e052cc04b9286b6b4f8b3d4c7f0de8a.sourceText: This statue of Puschiva stands at the entrance of Queen B Vinyl Café in Cottonwood, Arizona . It's a spinoff of the Hindu god Shiva, but Puscifer has replaced the head with their band logo. The statue has developed a cult following of sorts as people from around the world leave offerings and gifts for the statue.
87044afe5e052cc04b9286b6b4f8b3d4c7f0de8a.translatedText: 這座 Puschiva 雕像矗立在亞利桑那州卡頓伍德的 Queen B Vinyl 咖啡館入口處。這是印度教濕婆神的衍生作品，但 Puscifer 用他們的樂隊標誌取代了頭部。隨著來自世界各地的人們為雕像留下祭品和禮物，這座雕像吸引了一群狂熱的追隨者。

cb53938a5347b2dcd90d5d3a00c201d564ce626e.sourceText: The Queen B Vinyl Cafe is owned by musician Maynard James Keenan and his wife Jennifer, who formerly operated Puscifer the Store in Jerome, Arizona. Keenan is the frontman of the bands Tool, A Perfect Circle, and Puscifer. The Queen B Vinyl Cafe is home to a bar, art studio, music museum, barber shop, and band merchandise shop.
cb53938a5347b2dcd90d5d3a00c201d564ce626e.translatedText: Queen B Vinyl 咖啡館由音樂家梅納德·詹姆斯·基南 (Maynard James Keenan) 和他的妻子詹妮弗 (Jennifer) 擁有，他們之前在亞利桑那州傑羅姆經營 Puscifer the Store。 Keenan 是 Tool、A Perfect Circle 和 Puscifer 樂團的主唱。 Queen B Vinyl 咖啡館設有酒吧、藝術工作室、音樂博物館、理髮店和樂隊商品店。

bdb3d467f0a5586cae626e6102223467cf180086.sourceText: Business hours, 10 a.m. - 8 p.m. daily starting October 23, 2024. May vary for live performances (open later) feel free to call 928-639-3516.

6857f103654764d9ad10e724380f2b99cbc70ba1.sourceText: In Clarkdale, Arizona, a train line offers a chance to experience beautiful landscapes and a vintage railroad experience all in one.
6857f103654764d9ad10e724380f2b99cbc70ba1.translatedText: 在亞利桑那州的克拉克代爾，火車線路提供了將美麗風景和老式鐵路體驗融為一體的機會。

a0119da2f05d57bcf2f545dea435d2d19efd89eb.sourceText: The Mogollon (pronounced muggy-YOHN) Rim, made famous by numberless Westerns from Zane Grey onward, is a prominent escarpment that runs roughly east to west through much of central Arizona. It is the southern erosional edge of the Colorado Plateau, a large area of generally flat-lying strata that hosts many of the Southwest's most iconic national parks. Along the Mogollon Rim itself, south-draining streams have locally carved deep canyons through the scarp, which are made more spectacular by their red bedrock. Oak Creek Canyon south of Flagstaff, traversed by Arizona State Route 89A, is a well-known example. A lesser-known example is the canyon carved by the Verde River some 20 miles west of Oak Creek. In contrast to Oak Creek, it has difficult to nonexistent vehicle access, which no doubt accounts for its relative obscurity.
a0119da2f05d57bcf2f545dea435d2d19efd89eb.translatedText: 莫戈倫（發音為 muggy-YOHN）邊緣，自贊恩·格雷以來因無數西部片而聞名，是一處著名的懸崖，大致從東向西貫穿亞利桑那州中部的大部分地區。它是科羅拉多高原的南部侵蝕邊緣，是一大片整體平坦的地層，擁有許多西南部最具代表性的國家公園。沿著莫戈隆邊緣，向南流淌的溪流在陡坡上局部形成了深深的峽谷，紅色的基岩使峽谷變得更加壯觀。弗拉格斯塔夫以南的橡樹溪峽谷 (Oak Creek Canyon) 就是一個著名的例子，亞利桑那州 89A 號公路穿過該峽谷。一個鮮為人知的例子是橡樹溪以西約 20 英里處由佛得河沖刷而成的峽谷。與橡樹溪相反，這裡幾乎不存在車輛通行，這無疑解釋了它相對默默無聞的原因。

c57bac3c328c1041681645a46e8871cb8847d230.sourceText: However, the Verde River is paralleled by a short line, the Clarkdale Arizona Central Railroad. Under the name Verde Canyon Railroad, scenic excursion trains are run through the Verde River Canyon, providing stunning views of this otherwise inaccessible area.
c57bac3c328c1041681645a46e8871cb8847d230.translatedText: 然而，佛得角河與一條短線平行，即克拉克代爾亞利桑那中央鐵路。風景優美的遊覽火車以維德峽谷鐵路（Verde Canyon Railroad）的名義運行，穿過維德河峽谷（Verde River Canyon），提供這個原本難以到達的地區的壯麗景色。

a5d1df66cb05e8fb2a22dbbd71edd980ef9b84d1.sourceText: The Verde Canyon Railroad runs on tracks that first opened in 1912 to link copper mines and production facilities. The line ran until 1988, when it was purchased by a new owner. Passenger trains began running in the early 1990s, with cars pulled by vintage diesel locomotives, some of the few of this type still operating in North America.
a5d1df66cb05e8fb2a22dbbd71edd980ef9b84d1.translatedText: 佛得角峽谷鐵路 (Verde Canyon Railroad) 的軌道於 1912 年首次開通，用於連接銅礦和生產設施。該線路一直運行到 1988 年，隨後被新主人購買。客運列車於 20 世紀 90 年代初開始運行，車廂由老式柴油機車牽引，其中一些此類列車仍在北美運行。

486d652e20574244c90d8aefe895a72ffac5dd6f.sourceText: President Trump Meets the World’s Most Powerful Man in Beijing
486d652e20574244c90d8aefe895a72ffac5dd6f.translatedText: 川普總統在北京會見世界上最有權勢的人

171de854b3f55abcadd989d3919d349d952ad03f.sourceText: President Trump Meets the World’s Most Powerful Man in …
171de854b3f55abcadd989d3919d349d952ad03f.translatedText: 川普總統在…會見世界上最有權勢的人

d3cd79ebd6f30c2e5a448bebbc2a139a01456af8.sourceText: Through the winding Waterfall Canyon Trail, a few drawings stand out along the rocks. These drawings were left by nomadic people from around 500-1100CE, many of which are attributed to the Hohokam people who used water management techniques to farm and occupy permanent settlements in the White Tank Mountains.
d3cd79ebd6f30c2e5a448bebbc2a139a01456af8.translatedText: 穿過蜿蜒的瀑布峽谷步道，幾幅圖畫沿著岩石格外引人注目。這些圖畫是公元 500-1100 年左右的游牧民族留下的，其中許多歸功於霍霍卡姆人，他們利用水管理技術在白坦克山脈耕種並佔據永久定居點。

fb45a98aa20d5efad534d09b9061e8bcef943843.sourceText: These drawings are carved into the "desert varnish" that surrounds the rocks of this region. Desert varnish is a film of patina produced by a combination of airborne clay, dirt, and microorganisms that accumulate on the surface of rocks over hundreds of years.
fb45a98aa20d5efad534d09b9061e8bcef943843.translatedText: 這些圖畫被雕刻在該地區岩石周圍的「沙漠清漆」中。沙漠清漆是由空氣中的黏土、污垢和微生物結合而成的一層銅綠薄膜，這些微生物在岩石表面上數百年來累積起來。

6da70cf599919f123f5239f17aa1e0cf045e4f56.sourceText: Using a handheld rock, the desert varnish can be chipped away to reveal the lighter rock underneath, which is how the petroglyphs were made. Since they were created by different peoples across the span of hundreds, if not thousands, of years, some are easily viewable, while others can only be seen from an angle as uncolored indentations on the rock.
6da70cf599919f123f5239f17aa1e0cf045e4f56.translatedText: 使用手持岩石，可以將沙漠清漆削掉，露出下面較輕的岩石，這就是岩畫的形成方式。由於它們是由不同的民族在數百年甚至數千年的時間裡創造出來的，所以有些很容易看到，而另一些則只能從岩石上無色的凹痕的角度看到。

2ef59e80d6041623fbf30245a24a0b827749baff.sourceText: No one knows for sure what purpose the petroglyphs served, but common theories suggest they were used as trail-markers, recordings of events, and representations of religious concepts.
2ef59e80d6041623fbf30245a24a0b827749baff.translatedText: 沒有人確切知道這些岩畫的用途，但常見的理論表明它們被用作痕跡標記、事件記錄和宗教概念的代表。

7d07a8ddd6dd8ab70c405dcc4edd8fca7c9ca0cf.sourceText: While Frank Lloyd Wright’s buildings are widely celebrated, his work isn’t exactly rare. The prolific architect designed around 1,000 buildings in his lifetime, which range from corporate headquarters and private residences to a museum, skyscraper, and even a gas station . After his death, his output slowed considerably, but not quite to zero. One of his final designs to be constructed is the First Christian Church, which was constructed more than a decade after his death.
7d07a8ddd6dd8ab70c405dcc4edd8fca7c9ca0cf.translatedText: 雖然弗蘭克·勞埃德·賴特的建築廣受讚譽，但他的作品並不罕見。這位多產的建築師一生設計了大約 1,000 棟建築，從公司總部和私人住宅到博物館、摩天大樓，甚至加油站。在他死後，他的產出大大減慢，但並未完全為零。他最終要建造的設計之一是第一基督教教堂，該教堂是在他去世十多年後才建成的。

dba3ffabde227b08a35b629ee27a21a10f0f125f.sourceText: In 1949, the Southwest Christian Seminary commissioned Frank Lloyd Wright, then in his 80s, to design a sprawling university campus. Wright was no stranger to the Phoenix metropolitan area, having decamped to his winter studio, Taliesin West, since 1937. However, the seminary closed the next year, and the design, which included a centerpiece chapel, was never built.
dba3ffabde227b08a35b629ee27a21a10f0f125f.translatedText: 1949 年，西南基督教神學院委託當時 80 多歲的弗蘭克·勞埃德·賴特 (Frank Lloyd Wright) 設計一座龐大的大學校園。賴特對鳳凰城都會區並不陌生，自 1937 年起就搬到了他的冬季工作室塔里埃森西 (Taliesin West)。然而，神學院於第二年關閉，包括中心教堂在內的設計從未建成。

bf76984662a9d98d6bd7747e8a6dc5e86cbe9199.sourceText: Wright died in 1959, but in the early 1970s, First Christian Church was looking to expand and struggling to find a design. Church leaders approached Wright’s widow, Olgivanna Wright, to purchase and implement Wright’s lost design, and Taliesin Associated Architects, which was staffed by Wright’s former apprentices, was contracted to build his work posthumously. Construction was led by Wright’s son-in-law, William Wesley Peters, who during this period was navigating a whirlwind marriage, separation, and divorce from Josef Stalin’s daughter . Despite the distraction, the building was completed in 1973.
bf76984662a9d98d6bd7747e8a6dc5e86cbe9199.translatedText: 賴特於 1959 年去世，但在 1970 年代初，第一基督教教堂正在尋求擴張，並努力尋找設計方案。教會領袖找到賴特的遺孀奧爾吉瓦娜·賴特 (Olgivanna Wright)，購買並實施賴特丟失的設計，由賴特以前的學徒組成的塔里埃森聯合建築師事務所 (Taliesin Associated Architects) 簽約在賴特死後建造他的作品。施工由賴特的女婿威廉·韋斯利·彼得斯領導，在此期間，他正在與約瑟夫·史達林的女兒經歷一場旋風般的婚姻、分居和離婚。儘管受到干擾，該建築還是於 1973 年竣工。

9175cea91f156e9263ce0ff89f0658898ee491b1.sourceText: The church was well-received by critics and is generally considered among the most significant works ever produced by Taliesin Associated. The basic unit of the church is the triangle—a reference to the Holy Trinity. The building was designed to look like a triangle from all perspectives, and is supported by 23 triangular pillars. Made from local stone, First Church’s spire also resembles a triangle despite being four-sided.
9175cea91f156e9263ce0ff89f0658898ee491b1.translatedText: 該教堂受到評論家的好評，並被普遍認為是塔里埃森聯合公司有史以來最重要的作品之一。教堂的基本單位是三角形－指的是神聖的三位一體。建築物從各個角度看都呈現三角形，由 23 根三角形柱子支撐。第一教堂的尖頂由當地的石頭製成，儘管是四個邊，但也像三角形。

21519c71efa98f8c4f6bf2441576f1f962b50339.sourceText: The most striking feature is the 120-foot-tall bell tower whose four unequal sides, all self-supporting, and made from more than 300 tons of concrete, also look like a triangle. And resembles the Scottsdale Spire , which like the church is one of the few Frank Lloyd Wright designs to be built posthumously.
21519c71efa98f8c4f6bf2441576f1f962b50339.translatedText: 最引人注目的特徵是 120 英尺高的鐘樓，其四個不等邊、全部自支撐、由 300 多噸混凝土製成的，看起來也像一個三角形。與斯科茨代爾尖塔很像，它和教堂一樣，是弗蘭克·勞埃德·賴特為數不多的死後建造的設計之一。

321c4bfce91ca7c771cc757ab06036dda8c5fbc9.sourceText: The secret communications work of the Marine Corps during World War II was declassified in 1968, but it wasn’t until 1989 that the first memorial was dedicated to the encryption specialists now famously known as the Navajo Code Talkers.
321c4bfce91ca7c771cc757ab06036dda8c5fbc9.translatedText: 二戰期間海軍陸戰隊的秘密通訊工作於 1968 年被解密，但直到 1989 年，第一座紀念碑才專門獻給加密專家，現在被稱為「納瓦荷密碼語者」。

c8dd6649667699aee07f0704fcc265d8c3b99f5a.sourceText: The enormous sculpture is prominently positioned at the corner of Central Avenue and Thomas Road in midtown Phoenix , and sculptor Doug Hyde chose to represent a Code Talker in traditional attire carrying a traditional communications device: a flute.
c8dd6649667699aee07f0704fcc265d8c3b99f5a.translatedText: 這座巨大的雕塑位於鳳凰城市中心中央大道和托馬斯路拐角處的顯眼位置，雕塑家道格·海德選擇代表一位身著傳統服裝的密碼語者。傳統通訊設備：長笛。

c12da5dae08f67a5bddc4cf093decb6113dc06a0.sourceText: Serving in the Pacific in every major battle of the war, the Code Talkers used their notoriously difficult language as the basis for a code that was never broken. But Navajo was neither the first nor the only Native American language to be used by the U.S. military for wartime communications. Cherokee, Comanche, and Choctaw tribal members were deployed in World War I and, together with Seminole, Assiniboine, and others, they continued to work throughout World War II. More Native Americans have served in the U.S. military per capita than any other ethnic group, and their efforts were central to success in combat.
c12da5dae08f67a5bddc4cf093decb6113dc06a0.translatedText: 在太平洋戰爭中的每一次重大戰役中，密碼語者都使用他們出了名的難懂的語言作為從未被破解的密碼的基礎。但納瓦荷語並不是美國軍隊在戰時通信中使用的第一種也不是唯一一種美洲原住民語言。切羅基、科曼奇和喬克托部落成員在第一次世界大戰中被部署，並與塞米諾爾、阿西尼博因和其他部落一起在整個第二次世界大戰期間繼續工作。以人均計算，在美國軍隊服役的美洲原住民人數比任何其他族裔都要多，他們的努力對於戰鬥的成功至關重要。

210cdceeca9f1967b0c1cfd5f744eb5e0a5e800b.sourceText: Hyde, whose own heritage is Nez Perce, Assiniboine, and Chippewa, is a veteran himself of the Vietnam War. A master in stone as well as bronze, he has pieces in major museums throughout the United States , including at the Smithsonian’s National Museum of the American Indian. And while his memorial is distinctly Navajo, Hyde’s intention was to include symbols that would be understood by all Native American tribes.
210cdceeca9f1967b0c1cfd5f744eb5e0a5e800b.translatedText: 海德的血統是內茲珀斯人、阿西尼博因人和奇珀瓦人，他自己也是越戰的老兵。他是一位石材和青銅大師，他的作品遍佈美國各大博物館，包括史密森國家美洲印第安人博物館。雖然他的紀念碑明顯是納瓦霍語，但海德的目的是包括所有美洲原住民部落都能理解的符號。

61afa95db483783b2fc9b54cfac48896f5182f78.sourceText: The Phoenix memorial imparts the spirit of the Navajo Code Talkers by depicting a young boy with a flute, representing the communication of peace rather than war. The absence of military garb and the emblematic radios emphasizes that the new generation of Native peoples will live in peace as a result of the sacrifices of the Code Talkers. It is believed that fewer than 10 of the 400 Code Talkers who served in the 1940s are still alive today.
61afa95db483783b2fc9b54cfac48896f5182f78.translatedText: 鳳凰城紀念碑透過描繪一個拿著長笛的小男孩來傳達納瓦霍密碼說話者的精神，代表和平而不是戰爭的交流。軍裝和標誌性收音機的消失強調了新一代原住民將因密碼說話者的犧牲而過著和平的生活。據信，在 20 世紀 40 年代服役的 400 名密碼說話者中，如今還活著的人不到 10 人。

371a2e35840c4c2af678fc822d2a43ea99f7fb19.sourceText: Nellie Bly Kaleidoscopes features handmade kaleidoscopes from artists around the world. It is named for Nellie Bly, the pen name used by Elizabeth Cochran Seaman, a journalist who made a real trip around the world inspired by Jules Verne's Around the World in 80 Days .
371a2e35840c4c2af678fc822d2a43ea99f7fb19.translatedText: Nellie Bly 萬花筒擁有世界各地藝術家手工製作的萬花筒。它以內莉·布萊 (Nellie Bly) 的名字命名，伊麗莎白·科克倫·希曼 (Elizabeth Cochran Seaman) 是一名記者，受儒勒·凡爾納 (Jules Verne) 的《80 天環遊世界》的啟發，進行了一次真正的環遊世界。

943f3834ff8ce1e379c06c87c9b0c8306e2671e3.sourceText: Bly wrote for the New York World and was known for pioneering investigative journalism. She began her famous journey in 1889, traveling from New Jersey to London, across Europe, Egypt, Singapore, Japan, to San Francisco. A one-car train sped her across the United States in the middle of January 1890 to arrive to fanfare as she completed the journey in just 72 days.
943f3834ff8ce1e379c06c87c9b0c8306e2671e3.translatedText: 布萊為《紐約世界》撰稿，以開創性的調查新聞而聞名。她於 1889 年開始了她著名的旅程，從新澤西到倫敦，穿越歐洲、埃及、新加坡、日本，最後到達舊金山。 1890 年 1 月中旬，一列單節車廂的火車載著她穿越美國，她只花了 72 天就完成了旅程。

d7e30c9a81bbcf57598fd098e84d1e80c4c8e5cf.sourceText: They have options ranging from basic toys to amazing engineered glass kaleidoscopes. All of them are on display for visitors to gaze into and marvel at the spinning colors. Sometimes craftsmen can be seen bringing more stock into the store from the kaleidoscope workshop. Others are imported from places like Japan and Egypt with very unique styles and mechanisms.
d7e30c9a81bbcf57598fd098e84d1e80c4c8e5cf.translatedText: 他們有各種選擇，從基本的玩具到令人驚嘆的工程玻璃萬花筒。所有這些都展示給遊客觀看並驚嘆於旋轉的顏色。有時可以看到工匠們從萬花筒工坊將更多的庫存帶入商店。還有一些是從日本和埃及等地進口的，風格和機制非常獨特。

27a49589d9d02cf3e6db38bc277079956622509b.sourceText: Connected to the original kaleidoscope store is Around the World with Nellie Bly, a steampunk emporium and gift shop. This started with some artisan steampunk gadgets including plane models, gear-shaped clocks, and super intricate music boxes. Visitors in the shop can look closely to discover the secret door that opens into the back office!
27a49589d9d02cf3e6db38bc277079956622509b.translatedText: 與原來的萬花筒商店相連的是“Around the World with Nellie Bly”，這是一家蒸汽朋克商場和禮品店。這始於一些工匠蒸氣龐克小玩意，包括飛機模型、齒輪形時鐘和超級複雜的音樂盒。店裡的遊客可以仔細觀察，發現通往後台辦公室的秘密門！

10d7bae01034ebebaabb48f0fdb948eba0f7504e.sourceText: Nellie Bly is located along the main street in Jerome, Arizona. This former ghost town is a haven for artists and home to several unique shops. The town is located on a steep hillside and the shops are street level at the entrance, but the back of the shop has a balcony, high up the hillside, with a view of the Jerome valley.
10d7bae01034ebebaabb48f0fdb948eba0f7504e.translatedText: Nellie Bly 位於亞利桑那州傑羅姆的主要街道上。這座前鬼城是藝術家的天堂，也是許多獨特商店的所在地。小鎮位於陡峭的山坡上，商店入口處與街道齊平，但商店後面有一個陽台，位於山坡高處，可以看到傑羅姆山谷的景色。

85f59e3b2dec097df2b797af660194b4e4764d28.sourceText: Around the 1880's the town of Holbrook, Arizona was a wretched hive of scum and villainy where outlaws and cowboys could indulge their drinking, gambling, whoring, and general rakishness. Needless to say, gun fights were frequent and casual.
85f59e3b2dec097df2b797af660194b4e4764d28.translatedText: 大約在 1880 年代，亞利桑那州的霍爾布魯克鎮是一個骯髒的敗類和罪惡的巢穴，亡命之徒和牛仔可以盡情飲酒、賭博、嫖娼和放蕩。不用說，槍戰是頻繁而隨意的。

e5e93cc28ebe08715b5a04f77b90ffd30cf16f04.sourceText: Amidst this atmosphere, Terrill’s Cottage Saloon was able to distinguish itself as particularly violent. It was in this grim watering hole in 1886 that a gunfight took place that ended in so much death that the floors were said to be slick with a "bucket of blood." According to one version of events the shoot out occurred between two rival groups of cowboys, one of which accusing the other of horse thievin'. The other extant version of events describes the classic Wild West scene of a poker game gone wrong. Whichever is the case, a number of rootin-tootin cowpokes were murdered. Just a year later, a tough-as-nails sheriff rolled into Holbrook to bring some justice to the town, but the bar had already changed its name to the "Buckets of Blood Saloon."
e5e93cc28ebe08715b5a04f77b90ffd30cf16f04.translatedText: 在這種氣氛中，特里爾的小屋酒吧顯得格外暴力。 1886 年，正是在這個嚴峻的水坑里發生了一場槍戰，導致大量人員死亡，據說地板上沾滿了「一桶血」。根據事件的一個版本，槍戰發生在兩個敵對的牛仔群體之間，其中一個指控另一個偷馬。事件的另一個現存版本描述了撲克遊戲出錯的經典狂野西部場景。不管怎樣，一些頑固的牛仔被謀殺了。僅僅一年後，一位強硬的警長闖入霍爾布魯克，為小鎮伸張正義，但酒吧已更名為「Buckets of Blood Saloon」。

a424ecda8d22505b59df6c82ce753561faa5e863.sourceText: The bar remained well into the 20th century, becoming a touristy hotspot on Route 66. However the road trip culture that was keeping the bar alive eventually died out and the saloon eventually closed its doors. However while the bloody bar is gone, the street on which it stood still bears its morbid name, ensuring that the memory of the Wild West will not die out like so many gunfighters.
a424ecda8d22505b59df6c82ce753561faa5e863.translatedText: 酒吧一直延續到 20 世紀，成為 66 號公路上的旅遊熱點。然而，維持酒吧活力的公路旅行文化最終消失了，酒吧最終關門了。然而，儘管血腥的酒吧消失了，它所在的街道仍然保留著它那病態的名字，確保狂野西部的記憶不會像許多槍手一樣消失。

8bfe220c4b4aec5b968f39803be8cf9530142e44.sourceText: On I-40, follow the exit for 77 South. You'll see the sign just past the train tracks.
8bfe220c4b4aec5b968f39803be8cf9530142e44.translatedText: 在 I-40 上，沿著 77 South 的出口行駛。您會在經過火車軌道時看到該標誌。

8015e0144790f2ea60d42d8845b53bf43a837f80.sourceText: Holbrook, Arizona, is about the last place you’d expect to find world-class sake. With a current population of about 5,000, Holbrook’s heyday was during the Wild West days of the late 1800s, complete with cowboys, bandits, a notorious sheriff, and shootouts. Today it’s a place to stop for gas en route to Petrified Forest National Park and pick up Route 66 souvenirs. It’s also home to a brewery producing excellent sake.
8015e0144790f2ea60d42d8845b53bf43a837f80.translatedText: 亚利桑那州霍尔布鲁克是您最不可能找到世界级清酒的地方。霍爾布魯克目前人口約 5,000 人，其鼎盛時期是 1800 年代末的狂野西部時期，充斥著牛仔、土匪、臭名昭著的警長和槍戰。如今，这里是前往石化林国家公园途中停下来加油并购买 66 号公路纪念品的地方。这里也是一家生产优质清酒的啤酒厂的所在地。

9f5f1a3b9eac00f1a496c689699dccc622df7000.sourceText: Founder Atsuo Sakurai, a native of Yokohama, Japan, moved to Holbrook in 2015 to be closer to the family of his wife, Heather, who is Navajo and from the town. Soon after, he started brewing sake in his garage. Three years later, Arizona Sake won the gold medal for the best sake made outside of Japan in the Tokyo Sake Competition. The following year, it was named best of class at the 2019 Los Angeles International Wine Competition.
9f5f1a3b9eac00f1a496c689699dccc622df7000.translatedText: 創辦人 Atsuo Sakurai 是日本橫濱人，2015 年搬到霍爾布魯克，是為了離他的妻子希瑟 (Heather) 的家人更近，希瑟是納瓦霍人，來自該鎮。不久之后，他开始在车库里酿造清酒。三年后，亚利桑那清酒在东京清酒大赛中荣获日本境外最佳清酒金奖。次年，它在2019年洛杉矶国际葡萄酒大赛中被评为最佳。

1fcd9006256d7fbb310401cb28a15a474e1c49df.sourceText: In Japan, Sakurai had worked for more than a decade to earn the title of Certified First-Grade Sake Brewer. But because of strict regulations, he had to work for established sake producers. Moving to Holbrook allowed him to make his own sake and established him as the only First-Grade Sake Brewer in the United States.
1fcd9006256d7fbb310401cb28a15a474e1c49df.translatedText: 在日本，樱井苦苦耕耘十多年，才获得了一级清酒酿酒师认证的称号。但由于严格的规定，他不得不为老牌清酒生产商工作。搬到霍尔布鲁克使他能够自己酿造清酒，并使他成为美国唯一的一级清酒酿酒师。

0a346d54848fe879fdd48708688ac3b872664041.sourceText: In 2019, Sakurai freed up room for his wife to park in the garage and opened his Sake House in a 1,000-square-foot bunker-style building on a dusty acre between a Super 8 Motel and Dollar General store. This is where he handcrafts every batch of his sake and prepares it for delivery to stores, restaurants, and individuals in Arizona, New York, Hawaii, and California.
0a346d54848fe879fdd48708688ac3b872664041.translatedText: 2019 年，櫻井騰出車庫空間供妻子停車，並在 Super 8 汽車旅館和 Dollar General 商店之間的一英畝塵土飛揚的土地上一棟 1,000 平方英尺的地堡式建築中開設了他的清酒屋。在這裡，他手工製作每批清酒，並準備將其運送到亞利桑那州、紐約州、夏威夷州和加利福尼亞州的商店、餐廳和個人。

84ae16bbb274844f111d9ee948e7be05b8761705.sourceText: In addition to his original unpasteurized junmai ginjo, he has added a pasteurized version, a sparkling sake called Desert Snow, and, at the urging of his father-in-law, sake subtly infused with sprigs of Navajo Tea.
84ae16bbb274844f111d9ee948e7be05b8761705.translatedText: 除了他原來的未經高溫消毒的純米吟釀之外，他還添加了一種經過高溫消毒的版本，一種名為“沙漠雪”的起泡清酒，並且在他岳父的敦促下，在清酒中巧妙地加入了納瓦霍茶的枝條。

13b23abc4ce8d508bcfddbd42b133a0ab4f3b6bc.sourceText: A larger-than-life bronze statue memorializes Barry M. Goldwater, the five-term U.S. Senator from Arizona , 1964 Republican nominee for President, and arguably the founding father of postwar American conservatism.
13b23abc4ce8d508bcfddbd42b133a0ab4f3b6bc.translatedText: 一座比真人還要大的青銅雕像是為了紀念巴里·M·戈德華特 (Barry M. Goldwater)，他曾五任美國亞利桑那州參議員，1964 年共和黨總統候選人，可以說是戰後美國保守主義的奠基人。

d884bb393ee8c0967dcfa464677d9af6ccb019d8.sourceText: Commissioned by the Town of Paradise Valley, the senator's longtime home, the 1.5 times life-size statue was unveiled in 2004 by cowboy artist Joe Beeler. It stands in a small botanical garden that includes a path inlaid with stones inscribed with noteworthy Goldwater quotes.
d884bb393ee8c0967dcfa464677d9af6ccb019d8.translatedText: 受參議員長期居住地天堂谷鎮的委託，這座 1.5 倍真人大小的雕像於 2004 年由牛仔藝術家揭幕。喬·比勒。它坐落在一個小植物園中，花園裡有一條小路，上面鑲嵌著石頭，上面刻著戈德華特著名的名言。

62704f85f6f040dd8f3d9bb5279e8f21a3896fec.sourceText: The senator is depicted facing west, with a camera in his right hand, a reference to his photographic avocation. Medallions set into Anasazi-style stone walls mark milestones in his life.
62704f85f6f040dd8f3d9bb5279e8f21a3896fec.translatedText: 參議員面朝西方，右手拿著相機，暗示了他的攝影嗜好。鑲嵌在阿納薩齊風格石牆上的獎章標誌著他一生中的里程碑。

456005d1a4aadc5c68a336c4b07e484b077ba554.sourceText: Turn right into the small public park off Tatum Boulevard just north of its intersection with Lincoln Drive.
456005d1a4aadc5c68a336c4b07e484b077ba554.translatedText: 右轉進入塔圖姆大道旁的小公園，位於塔圖姆大道與林肯大道交叉口以北的地方。

4013d30ed2c8a6a89ac13430ebf48730c7b61f54.sourceText: Glendale Chinese buffet on 43rd Avenue offering takeout, delivery, and familiar favorites.
4013d30ed2c8a6a89ac13430ebf48730c7b61f54.translatedText: 位於 43 大道的格倫代爾中式自助餐，提供外帶、送餐和熟悉的美食。

c9118a97ad06ac8abb032a34b911cece1735d498.sourceText: Chinese buffet in Glendale with takeout, delivery, and a menu centered on familiar Chinese-American dishes.
c9118a97ad06ac8abb032a34b911cece1735d498.translatedText: 格倫代爾的中式自助餐，提供外帶、送餐和以熟悉的中式美式菜餚為主的菜單。

b121e4c975a1f805bf873e4723c3ff6ab7eeae00.sourceText: Glendale Chinese takeout spot with online ordering, pickup, and delivery.
b121e4c975a1f805bf873e4723c3ff6ab7eeae00.translatedText: 格倫代爾中餐外賣店，提供線上訂購、取貨和送貨服務。

7e8ef9d1d640089d4fe092386b3399eaea0321a1.sourceText: Chinese restaurant in Glendale near 55th Avenue and Northern with online ordering, pickup, and delivery for classic takeout favorites.
7e8ef9d1d640089d4fe092386b3399eaea0321a1.translatedText: 格倫代爾靠近 55 大道和北部的中餐廳，提供線上訂購、取貨和送貨服務，提供經典外帶美食。

d7d9002f070300269b285d639802bf6b123ce9b1.sourceText: A contoured neon martini, sandwiched by the words "Package Goods," beckons travelers along Route 66 in Williams, Arizona. Below the glow, the Sultana Bar—situated in a town best known as the gateway to the Grand Canyon—touts itself as "World Famous." In terms of longevity, they've got a point: This dive opened in 1912, 14 years before the historic highway on which it stands.
d7d9002f070300269b285d639802bf6b123ce9b1.translatedText: 輪廓鮮明的霓虹燈馬丁尼夾著「Package Goods」字樣，吸引亞利桑那州威廉斯 66 號公路沿線的遊客。光芒之下，蘇丹娜酒吧 (Sultana Bar) 坐落在一座被譽為大峽谷門戶的小鎮上，自詡為「世界聞名」。就壽命而言，他們有一個觀點：這個潛水點於 1912 年開業，比它所在的歷史悠久的高速公路早了 14 年。

b5f76796386edc7fefb2d7b56cda5245ced58d45.sourceText: As an article from the Phoenix New Times elaborates, the Sultana "traces its roots to a time when ranching, logging, and the Santa Fe Railroad were the big games in town." Desperados originally designed tunnels underneath the bar for drug-running—namely, opium—but were called upon with new purpose when Prohibition created a sudden demand for clandestine booze stockpiles across the United States. Above-ground, guests wandered a less harrowing passageway, which brought them to a theater that screened silent films prior to World War I.
b5f76796386edc7fefb2d7b56cda5245ced58d45.translatedText: 正如《鳳凰城新時報》的一篇文章所闡述的那樣，蘇丹娜「可以追溯到牧場、伐木和聖達菲鐵路成為城裡重要活動的時代」。亡命之徒最初在酒吧下方設計隧道用於販毒（即鴉片），但當禁酒令在美國各地突然產生了對秘密酒類庫存的需求時，亡命之徒們又被賦予了新的目的。在地面上，客人們漫步在一條不那麼痛苦的通道上，這將他們帶到了一個在第一次世界大戰之前放映無聲電影的劇院。

5a1e542cab6ce006081d0c8e018335ca2b85e14f.sourceText: Though visitors can (and should) still access the theater through this passage, the space now operates as a special events hall. Pool tables occupy the center of the main bar, and a modern jukebox sits backed against the wall. Beside the flat screens, a stuffed cougar gazes past the massive American flag hanging from the ceiling. Beer is the overarching theme of all lighting, signage, taps, bottles, and cans. Even the term "package goods" (alcohol sealed and labeled in its original container, as distributed by the manufacturer) refers to the bygone practice of bartenders selling booze for the road.
5a1e542cab6ce006081d0c8e018335ca2b85e14f.translatedText: 儘管遊客仍然可以（並且應該）通過這條通道進入劇院，但該空間現在作為一個特殊活動大廳。撞球桌位於主酒吧的中央，現代化的自動點唱機靠牆放置。在平面螢幕旁邊，一隻毛絨美洲獅凝視著天花板上懸掛的巨大美國國旗。啤酒是所有照明、標誌、水龍頭、瓶子和罐頭的首要主題。甚至「包裝貨物」這個術語（由製造商分發的原始容器中密封並貼有標籤的酒精）也指的是調酒師在路上出售酒類的過去做法。

25a9f930f4699a06c002cab8139506acee5f1030.sourceText: Even after more than a century, there's still an inimitable authenticity to the Sultana. Locals still account for the majority of drinkers—don't be surprised if someone asks where you came from, then offers you a beer.
25a9f930f4699a06c002cab8139506acee5f1030.translatedText: 即使過了一個多世紀，蘇丹娜仍然具有無與倫比的真實性。當地人仍然佔飲酒者的大多數——如果有人問你來自哪裡，然後給你一杯啤酒，請不要感到驚訝。

0385200af217538086611a42aa6c39d6607c6c0c.sourceText: In a restaurant with a name like “Hanny’s”, one would usually expect Hanny to be the owner, or perhaps the chef. But that's not the case here—the restaurant draws its name from Vic Hanny, a department store proprietor who built the store decades ago. Looking closely, you'll see the walls of the restaurant are covered in original Hanny’s logos and advertisements for menswear.
0385200af217538086611a42aa6c39d6607c6c0c.translatedText: 在一家名為“Hanny's”的餐廳中，人們通常會認為漢尼是老闆，或者也許是廚師。但這裡的情況並非如此——這家餐廳的名字取自維克·漢尼 (Vic Hanny)，他是一位百貨公司老闆，幾十年前創辦了這家商店。仔細一看，你會發現餐廳的牆上貼滿了漢尼原創的標誌和男裝廣告。

500d19d9dff59da92898df7bbc85eb610b778838.sourceText: The building was constructed in 1947 by architects Royal Lescher and Leslie Mahoney, as a late example of the “International Style” of architecture. Upon its completion, the Arizona Times praised it for bringing a “new look” to the city as a modern department store. After its closing in 1986, Hanny’s was purchased by the city of Phoenix and used to train firefighters.
500d19d9dff59da92898df7bbc85eb610b778838.translatedText: 該建築由建築師 Royal Lescher 和 Leslie Mahoney 於 1947 年建造，是「國際風格」建築的晚期典範。竣工後，《亞利桑那時報》稱讚它作為一家現代化百貨商店為這座城市帶來了「新面貌」。 1986 年關閉後，Hanny’s 被菲尼克斯市收購，用於培訓消防員。

33221b8fa29329553d4a52085664b2c5ecabf319.sourceText: The old Hanny’s building was purchased by Karl Kopp in 2005. Kopp understood the appeal in giving his restaurants an unconventional style. So, instead of concealing its past as a department store, he kept much of the original, fading decor, as well as an original elevator shaft with a glass bottom.
33221b8fa29329553d4a52085664b2c5ecabf319.translatedText: 舊 Hanny’s 建築於 2005 年被 Karl Kopp 購買。 Kopp 明白賦予他的餐廳非傳統風格的吸引力。因此，他沒有隱藏其作為百貨公司的過去，而是保留了大部分原來的、褪色的裝飾，以及原來的玻璃底電梯井。

ed5f6898138c500a52bba82f1f8f7597c0c91aff.sourceText: Kopp also added some new features: weird bathrooms, and an unnamed horned mannequin covered in a mosaic of colorful objects. If you’re looking for something unsettling, head on down to the basement, with its collection of creepy dolls. Legend says that these dolls move from time to time—whether this is simply a trick of artistry or actual paranormal activity is up for debate.
ed5f6898138c500a52bba82f1f8f7597c0c91aff.translatedText: Kopp 還添加了一些新功能：奇怪的浴室，以及一個覆蓋著彩色物體馬賽克的無名有角人體模型。如果您正在尋找令人不安的東西，請前往地下室，那裡收藏著令人毛骨悚然的娃娃。傳說這些玩偶會不時移動──這到底是單純的藝術把戲，還是真正的超自然現象，還有待商榷。

ffef076a3b9f13ba1fdcf08aa1e1916e52a41565.sourceText: The restaurant is open from 11:30 a.m. to 1 a.m. Tuesday through Friday, and 5 p.m. to 1 a.m. Saturday through Monday.
ffef076a3b9f13ba1fdcf08aa1e1916e52a41565.translatedText: 餐廳營業時間為週二至週五上午 11:30 至凌晨 1 點，以及下午 5 點。週六至週一凌晨 1 點。

8ceb9cc8efce0eb6e72a20db4a76081ebcdf6216.sourceText: Travelers might not expect a snow-covered mountain in Arizona, but Humphreys Peak at 12,633 feet in the San Francisco Peaks is the highest of the state's 27 summits exceeding 10,000 feet in elevation.
8ceb9cc8efce0eb6e72a20db4a76081ebcdf6216.translatedText: 旅客可能不會想到亞利桑那州會出現一座白雪覆蓋的山峰，但舊金山山峰中海拔 12,633 英尺的漢弗萊斯峰是該州 27 座海拔超過 10,000 英尺的山峰中最高的。

0fdd6a524be7b9836ab4dd51226537802e0a2143.sourceText: The San Francisco Peaks are the remains of an ancient eroded stratovolcano north of Flagstaff. This range is sacred to Native American tribes in the area. The Navajo call Humphreys Peak "Doko’oosliid" or "Abalone Shell Mountain," and the peak is their Sacred Mountain of the West that marks the border of their territory. The peak is also sacred to the Hopi, who associate it with the cardinal direction of southwest.
0fdd6a524be7b9836ab4dd51226537802e0a2143.translatedText: 舊金山山峰是弗拉格斯塔夫以北一座古老的被侵蝕的成層火山的遺跡。該山脈對該地區的美洲原住民部落來說是神聖的。納瓦霍人稱漢弗萊斯峰為“Doko’oosliid”或“鮑魚殼山”，這座山峰是他們的西部聖山，標誌著他們領土的邊界。這座山峰對霍皮人來說也是神聖的，他們將其與西南方向聯繫起來。

757871d386fd6e72a942d6a1c39120c65001cede.sourceText: In winter, the mountains are a prime skiing destination at the Arizona Snowbowl. The Humphreys Peak Trail starts at the base of the ski lifts. The trail is avalanche-prone in winter and very windy in spring, so summer is the preferred climbing season. There may even be snow on the trail as late as June, and monsoon storms, with lightning, may strike the Flagstaff area from July to September. The hike on this trail is 4.8 miles to the peak of this sacred mountain.
757871d386fd6e72a942d6a1c39120c65001cede.translatedText: 在冬季，這座山是亞利桑那州雪碗 (Arizona Snowbowl) 的主要滑雪目的地。漢弗萊斯峰步道（Humphreys Peak Trail）的起點是滑雪纜車的底部。這條路線冬季容易發生雪崩，春季風很大，因此夏季是首選的攀登季節。晚至六月，步道上甚至可能下雪，七月至九月，季風風暴和閃電可能會襲擊弗拉格斯塔夫地區。沿著這條步道徒步 4.8 英里即可到達這座聖山的山頂。

e11af6c5b0d0ae8827f511efdf8b158988169267.sourceText: From the Arizona Snow Bowl at the end of the ski lifts, take the Humphreys Peak Trail for 4.8 miles to the summit.
e11af6c5b0d0ae8827f511efdf8b158988169267.translatedText: 從滑雪纜車盡頭的亞利桑那州雪碗 (Arizona Snow Bowl) 出發，沿著漢弗萊斯峰步道 (Humphreys Peak Trail) 行駛 4.8 英里到達山頂。

ac330469edae2346c2f60c598b55d6fc972a0d7d.sourceText: Every Apollo astronaut who traveled to the moon first trained for their mission in Flagstaff, Arizona . The area’s hills and craters made of volcanic cinders were thought to closely approximate the surface of the moon and prepare astronauts for what to expect while navigating the lunar terrain. For the last three Apollo missions, NASA sent lunar roving vehicles along with the astronauts, to allow them to travel farther from the lunar module. Several facsimiles of the vehicles were constructed to further help the astronauts prepare to drive around on the moon's surface while conducting experiments and collecting samples and data.
ac330469edae2346c2f60c598b55d6fc972a0d7d.translatedText: 每位前往月球的阿波羅太空人首先在亞利桑那州弗拉格斯塔夫接受任務訓練。該地區由火山灰構成的山丘和隕石坑被認為非常接近月球表面，為太空人在月球地形上航行時做好準備。在過去的三次阿波羅任務中，美國太空總署與太空人一起發射了月球漫遊車，使他們能夠遠離登月艙。建造了幾個車輛的複製品，以進一步幫助太空人準備在月球表面行駛，同時進行實驗並收集樣本和數據。

49a4eacefcadecca936444f77d135f7c8c923706.sourceText: The lunar rovers that went to the moon had to be carefully constructed to exact specifications in scientific laboratories. Because they were built to carry astronauts, their equipment, and rock samples in the moon’s lower-gravity environment, they couldn’t be test-driven on Earth. The real lunar rovers would have collapsed under the weight of the astronauts if they were used during the astronauts’ training. Sturdier replicas were made for the astronauts to get a feel for how the vehicles maneuvered, how to make simple repairs to the vehicles, and how to use the scientific instruments.
49a4eacefcadecca936444f77d135f7c8c923706.translatedText: 前往月球的月球車必須在科學實驗室中按照精確的規格精心建造。由於它們是為了在月球的低重力環境中運載太空人、他們的設備和岩石樣本而建造的，因此無法在地球上進行試駕。真正的月球車如果在太空人訓練時使用，就會在太空人的重量下崩潰。為了讓太空人了解飛行器的操縱方式、如何對飛行器進行簡單的維修以及如何使用科學儀器，我們製作了更堅固的複製品。

d604b3bc4776a535f3eaedab6623a01a45fea1f5.sourceText: The Boeing corporation constructed four lunar rovers at a cost of about $9,500,000 each. The United States Geological Survey mechanics in Flagstaff built two practice rovers at a cost of about $1,900 each. To keep costs down, many of the parts came from scrapped cars and planes. These practice rovers were given the nickname “Grover,” short for “geologic rover”.
d604b3bc4776a535f3eaedab6623a01a45fea1f5.translatedText: 波音公司建造了四輛月球車，每輛的成本約為 9,500,000 美元。位於弗拉格斯塔夫的美國地質調查局機械師建造了兩輛練習車，每輛練習車成本約為 1,900 美元。為了降低成本，許多零件來自報廢的汽車和飛機。這些練習漫遊車被暱稱為“Grover”，是“地質漫遊車”的縮寫。

2b3ec4bcc7c117f9e204b3c3c387a2331aaeca6e.sourceText: Although primarily driven by astronauts on the expanses of volcanic cinders near Flagstaff, the Grovers were also test-driven in the Mojave Desert in California and the Rio Grande gorge in New Mexico . Extensive time spent practicing with the Grovers was necessary because it handled much differently than other vehicles. Each wheel had a separate battery-powered motor and the whole thing had a max speed of 7 miles per hour.
2b3ec4bcc7c117f9e204b3c3c387a2331aaeca6e.translatedText: 雖然主要由太空人在弗拉格斯塔夫附近廣闊的火山灰燼上駕駛，但格羅弗也在加州的莫哈韋沙漠和新墨西哥州的里奧格蘭德峽谷進行了試駕。花大量時間練習格羅佛是必要的，因為它的操控方式與其他車輛有很大不同。每個輪子都有一個獨立的電池供電電機，整個裝置的最高速度為每小時 7 英里。

84b51f16b8166e9ad811ff3461bbf64a507e9545.sourceText: NASA's human missions to the moon ended after Apollo 17 in 1972. The three lunar rovers that traveled with astronauts to the moon were left there, and still sit on the lunar surface today. For a while, Grover was on display at the United States Geological Survey headquarters in Virginia but in the 1980's it was moved to a museum in Alamogordo, New Mexico . It stayed there until 2002 when new facilities were built for the USGS Astrogeology Science Center in Flagstaff . Since then, the Grover along with other objects from Flagstaff's role in NASA's lunar missions have been on display in the lobby of the Shoemaker Building, including newspaper cutouts about the moon landings from local papers and handprints of various astronauts preserved in cement, including one from Neil Armstrong, the first man to walk on the moon.
84b51f16b8166e9ad811ff3461bbf64a507e9545.translatedText: 1972 年阿波羅 17 號登月後，美國太空總署 (NASA) 的載人登月任務結束。 與太空人一起前往月球的三輛月球車被留在了那裡，至今仍停留在月球表面。格羅佛曾一度在維吉尼亞州美國地質調查局總部展出，但在 20 世紀 80 年代，它被轉移到新墨西哥州阿拉莫戈多的博物館。它一直留在那裡，直到 2002 年為位於弗拉格斯塔夫的美國地質調查局天體地質科學中心建造了新設施。從那時起，格羅弗和弗拉格斯塔夫在美國宇航局登月任務中所扮演的角色的其他物品一直在舒梅克大廈的大廳展出，包括當地報紙上關於登月的報紙剪紙和水泥中保存的各種宇航員的手印，其中包括第一個登上月球的人尼爾·阿姆斯特朗的手印。

cd8c0978532ec8f04dc618a980c20e47d04815c1.sourceText: Like many an icon of Route 66, the Twin Arrows Trading Post has certainly seen better days. Situated on the side of I-40 in Arizona, the giant, yellow twin arrows still remain, standing out as a beacon to bored drivers, but the store and diner have fallen into disrepair.
cd8c0978532ec8f04dc618a980c20e47d04815c1.translatedText: 與 66 號公路的許多標誌一樣，雙箭貿易站也經歷了輝煌的歲月。位於亞利桑那州 40 號州際公路一側，巨大的黃色雙箭頭仍然存在，對無聊的司機來說就像一個燈塔，但商店和餐館已經年久失修。

1d49ce2b2ee53334f36a377fa2fc5c7d108caa30.sourceText: Built-in the late 1940s as Canyon Padre Trading Post, the store soon changed its name to Twin Arrows, seemingly inspired by the nearby town of Two Guns. It was then that the iconic wooden arrows were built, planted in the parking lot to guide motorists to the trading post's doors. The post included a gas station, gift shop, and a Valentine's diner.
1d49ce2b2ee53334f36a377fa2fc5c7d108caa30.translatedText: 這家商店建於 20 世紀 40 年代末，當時是 Canyon Padre 貿易站，很快就更名為 Twin Arrows，似乎受到了附近小鎮「兩槍」的啟發。就在那時，標誌性的木箭頭被建造出來，種植在停車場，引導駕駛人到達貿易站的門口。該貿易站包括一個加油站、禮品店和一家情人節餐廳。

d228ab2a3860ae29f5932bed41265f141a8b5f70.sourceText: Unfortunately, the creation of a nearby interstate led to a swift decrease in road traffic and combined with the changing cultural tastes that were moving away from kitschy roadside attractions, the trading post fell into decline. Twin Arrows operated under different owners as best it could until 1995 when it was finally abandoned.
d228ab2a3860ae29f5932bed41265f141a8b5f70.translatedText: 不幸的是，附近州際公路的建立導致道路交通迅速減少，再加上文化品味的變化，人們逐漸遠離俗氣的路邊景點，該貿易站陷入了衰落。雙箭盡可能由不同的所有者經營，直到 1995 年最終被廢棄。

3f841a08a772896342799086354a7c5e34cde720.sourceText: Currently, the land is owned by the state of Arizona, while the buildings are owned by the Hopi tribe, nestled off an exit across the interstate. In 2009, volunteers and the Hopi cleaned up the wooden arrows but the tribe has not made any other efforts toward restoration of the trading post or diner. The abandoned buildings have become a canvas for graffiti artists, adding to the site’s eerie charm.
3f841a08a772896342799086354a7c5e34cde720.translatedText: 目前，這片土地歸亞利桑那州所有，而建築物則歸霍皮部落所有，坐落在州際公路的一個出口旁。 2009年，志工和霍皮人清理了木箭，但部落沒有為恢復貿易站或餐廳做出任何其他努力。這些廢棄的建築已成為塗鴉藝術家的畫布，增添了該地點的怪異魅力。

96faa0981b4eb85d3a5d68522a5624add682232f.sourceText: Update as of May 2022: One of the two arrows has been removed.
96faa0981b4eb85d3a5d68522a5624add682232f.translatedText: 截至 2022 年 5 月的更新：兩個箭頭之一已移除。
