c7676e98961fab049e9afc47e669d1abe8148bdc.sourceText: Despite its arid climate, agriculture flourished in Arizona ’s Salt and Gila River valleys for thousands of years. The Hohokam Native Americans initially used floodwater farming to grow corn, beans, and squash close to the rivers. By the 7th century, communities built a system of giant canals at a scale not seen anywhere else in the Americas. The longest was 20 miles, with the whole network reaching up to 1,000 miles. Some near S’edav Va’aki were up to 85 feet wide and 20 feet deep. This allowed over 110,000 acres of land to be irrigated around Phoenix . With over 30,000 people, the area became the largest population in the southwestern United States.
c7676e98961fab049e9afc47e669d1abe8148bdc.translatedText: 儘管氣候乾旱，亞利桑那州鹽河谷和吉拉河谷的農業卻繁榮了數千年。霍霍卡姆美洲原住民最初利用洪水耕作在河流附近種植玉米、豆類和南瓜。到了七世紀，社區建造了一個巨型運河系統，規模在美洲其他地方都沒見過。最長可達20英里，整個網路可達1000英里。 S’edav Va’aki 附近的一些區域寬達 85 英尺，深 20 英尺。這使得菲尼克斯周圍超過 11 萬英畝的土地得以灌溉。該地區人口超過 30,000，成為美國西南部人口最多的地區。

8aa98f0a56df3b71f1ad26df54ab8a237197fca7.sourceText: The canals had specialized features such as weirs that directed water into them, and head gates that limited how much water entered them. They were able to maintain a constant flow rate and had a gradient of only a few feet per mile. As such, they were not prone to erosion or silt deposition. The political cooperation necessary to build and maintain the canals has been a matter of speculation today. The canals were not dug with shovels, but wooden sticks and stone “hoes” without handles that were used to loosen the soil, which was then removed by hand.
8aa98f0a56df3b71f1ad26df54ab8a237197fca7.translatedText: 運河具有特殊功能，例如引水的堰和限制進入水量的閘門。它們能夠保持恆定的流速，並且坡度僅為每英里幾英尺。因此，它們不易受到侵蝕或淤泥沉積。如今，建造和維護運河所需的政治合作一直是人們猜測的問題。運河不是用鏟子挖的，而是用沒有手柄的木棍和石「鋤頭」來鬆動土壤，然後用手將土壤移除。

6795ce639cc56a6ffdbe14a8288ecb4434de089c.sourceText: One mystery that remains is why and how these canals were abandoned in the 15th century. Some theories include a drought, the population straining the water supply, and fields becoming too saline. Today, the Hohokam's descendants, the O’odham people, continue to practice agriculture on a smaller scale.
6795ce639cc56a6ffdbe14a8288ecb4434de089c.translatedText: 仍然存在的一個謎團是這些運河在 15 世紀為何以及如何被廢棄。一些理論包括乾旱、人口供水緊張以及田地鹽分過高。如今，霍霍卡姆人的後裔奧德姆人繼續從事小規模農業。

fa4145780f4b5199dc348e96f87ea084d0800602.sourceText: Settlers crossing the United States were astonished by the then-dry canals. They realized that an agricultural civilization of immense complexity resided in the Salt River Valley, and named the city of Phoenix to reflect their hopes that a new settlement would rise from the ancient Hohokam ones. Settlers even began to reuse the canals for water once again. The Mormon founders of the City of Mesa were initially told that they could not channel water to their town, but instead found and used an ancient canal for irrigation. Today, many aqueducts in the Phoenix area follow the route of Hohokam canals, or were even constructed from the ancient canals themselves.
fa4145780f4b5199dc348e96f87ea084d0800602.translatedText: 穿越美國的定居者對當時乾涸的運河感到驚訝。他們意識到鹽河谷存在著極其複雜的農業文明，並將其命名為鳳凰城，以反映他們希望在古老的霍霍卡姆定居點上建立一個新的定居點。定居者甚至開始再次利用運河取水。梅薩市的摩門教創始人最初被告知，他們無法將水輸送到他們的城鎮，而是找到並使用了一條古老的運河進行灌溉。如今，菲尼克斯地區的許多渡槽都沿著霍霍卡姆運河的路線，甚至是根據古代運河本身建造的。

3ccb78980dd065c9f8810f2e860f3306cedf2fd9.sourceText: A portion of several interconnected canals, including one repurposed by Mormons only to again be abandoned, have been preserved at the Park of the Canals. A single path gives a view of the eroded canal ruins. Unfortunately, there are few descriptions on site and vegetation obscures some of what is left. But, one can use their imagination to picture how the canals were built and how they delivered water to a vast agricultural society over 500 years ago.
3ccb78980dd065c9f8810f2e860f3306cedf2fd9.translatedText: 幾條相互連接的運河的一部分，包括一條被摩門教徒重新利用但又被廢棄的運河，已被保存在運河公園中。一條小徑可以看到被侵蝕的運河遺址。不幸的是，現場的描述很少，植被掩蓋了一些剩餘的東西。但是，人們可以發揮想像力，想像 500 多年前，運河是如何建造的，以及它們如何將水輸送到廣闊的農業社會。

85c2617e9b83f301bacb406ba81045f2348dca9b.sourceText: The grounds are also home to botanical garden, exploring the history of the natural landscape.
85c2617e9b83f301bacb406ba81045f2348dca9b.translatedText: 這裡也是植物園的所在地，探索自然景觀的歷史。

f08e6fd2d3a7f3a05164beb96804e261e4658e83.sourceText: At the foot of the Superstition Mountains, the Superstition Mountain Museum is a tourist trap in the middle of the Arizona desert that remembers the filming of a number of Western films as well as exploring the legend of the Lost Dutchman's mine. Also, Elvis weddings.
f08e6fd2d3a7f3a05164beb96804e261e4658e83.translatedText: 迷信山博物館位於迷信山腳下，是亞利桑那州沙漠中部的旅遊陷阱，這裡記錄了許多西部電影的拍攝地，並探索失落的荷蘭人礦井的傳說。還有貓王的婚禮。

85ebc009e45d80d37f1731021c2725e694c8ac27.sourceText: Most of the old movie sets that once made up an extensive open-air museum known as "Apacheland" burned up in a fire in 2004, however two of the original buildings from the Apacheland attraction were moved to the Superstitions mountains site.
85ebc009e45d80d37f1731021c2725e694c8ac27.translatedText: 曾經構成名為「阿帕奇蘭」的大型露天博物館的大部分老電影佈景在 2004 年的一場火災中被燒毀，但阿帕奇蘭景點的兩座原始建築被移至迷信山遺址。

6af23a699a60d1c41182f78d48397dd63ec5eabf.sourceText: The Audie Murphy Apacheland Barn houses a number of horse-drawn buggies and carts used in the 17 television series, 29 full-length feature films, and hundreds of commercials filmed on the site. Scattered around the grounds are a few kitschy Old West scenes and full-size dioramas, complete with plenty creepy old mannequins. If you have a little change in your pocket, you can even try to toss a coin or two into the open mouth of the barber/dentist’s patient, posed with his plastic mouth wide open.
6af23a699a60d1c41182f78d48397dd63ec5eabf.translatedText: 奧迪·墨菲阿帕奇蘭穀倉存放著許多在阿帕奇蘭博物館中使用的馬車和手推車。 17 部電視劇、29 部長片以及數百個廣告均在該網站拍攝。場地周圍散佈著一些俗氣的舊西部場景和全尺寸立體模型，還有大量令人毛骨悚然的舊人體模型。如果你口袋裡有一點零錢，你甚至可以嘗試將一兩枚硬幣扔進理髮師/牙醫病人張開的嘴裡，擺出張開塑膠嘴的姿勢。

2357ab46a66e6f32d72a0965a2499ef835c4e623.sourceText: Just a stone’s throw away is the Elvis Chapel, a mini-museum and wedding chapel dedicated to “the King” and his unique western movie “Charro!” also filmed on site.
2357ab46a66e6f32d72a0965a2499ef835c4e623.translatedText: 距離貓王教堂僅一步之遙，這是一個迷你博物館和婚禮教堂，專門紀念“國王”和他獨特的西部電影“查羅！”

88e487da547eff4a77bd70a55fb4e70a0c26f871.sourceText: The museum devoted to the area itself is tucked behind the gift shop through an indoor iron gate and for a $5 fee you can go in and see a taxidermy display of native wildlife in action poses and a number of displays about life in the region.
88e487da547eff4a77bd70a55fb4e70a0c26f871.translatedText: 專門介紹該地區本身的博物館位於禮品店後面，通過室內鐵門，只需支付 5 美元的動物展示

12833fc83d01d9dc2d9cb4d41b1a11aab362731b.sourceText: Of special note are the crudely engraved local sandstone blocks. These are known as the Peralta Stones, widely believed to be key pieces in the search for the Lost Dutchman Mine. This legendary mine’s location has been unknown since the death of its most famous owner, a Dutchman who lived in the 1800's. He allegedly stumbled on the mine, shot the owners, and died late in life after giving only a list of cryptic clues as to the location of his incredibly lucrative gold mine. Generations of searchers have scoured the Superstitions and several have died in the search, with at least five deaths confirmed over the past 150 years. The museum features several artifacts surrounding the Lost Dutchman legend, and is often visited by those brave and stubborn individuals who still launch searches into these lethal mountains.
12833fc83d01d9dc2d9cb4d41b1a11aab362731b.translatedText: 特別值得注意的是當地粗糙雕刻的砂岩塊。這些被稱為佩拉爾塔石塊，人們普遍認為是尋找失落的荷蘭人礦的關鍵碎片。自從其最著名的礦主（一位生活在 1800 年代的荷蘭人）去世後，這座傳奇礦場的位置就一直無人知曉。據稱，他無意中發現了金礦，開槍射殺了礦主，並在只提供了一系列關於他利潤豐厚的金礦位置的神秘線索後去世。一代又一代的搜尋者對迷信進行了搜尋，有幾人在搜尋過程中喪生，過去 150 年來至少確認了 5 人死亡。博物館展示了一些與失落的荷蘭人傳說相關的文物，經常被那些仍然對這些致命山脈進行搜索的勇敢而頑固的人參觀。

99805ea44bf45623d8a671544f9102d8b56cf288.sourceText: Every February, the streets of Tucson ring with the clanging of horseshoes on pavement and the rattling of old wagon wheels. The Tucson Rodeo Parade has invited cowboys—and cowboys at heart—to celebrate La Fiesta de los Vaqueros, the Tucson Rodeo, since 1925. It's known as the largest non-motorized parade in the United States, as horses pull each "float."
99805ea44bf45623d8a671544f9102d8b56cf288.translatedText: 每年二月，圖森的街道上都會響起馬蹄鐵踩在人行道上的叮噹聲和舊馬車車輪的嘎嘎聲。自 1925 年以來，圖森牛仔競技遊行一直邀請牛仔——以及心中的牛仔——來慶祝 La Fiesta de los Vaqueros，即圖森牛仔競技表演。它被稱為美國最大的非機動遊行，馬匹拉著每個「花車」。

3e9179db15b8379eaea036d52e51ba6c24a30b33.sourceText: In the nearly 100 years since the parade commenced, the parade committee has collected more than 125 horse-drawn vehicles. Some of the donated specimens are a bit worn, whereas others proudly gleam in museum condition.
3e9179db15b8379eaea036d52e51ba6c24a30b33.translatedText: 自遊行開始以來的近 100 年裡，遊行委員會收集了超過 125 個馬車。有些捐贈的標本有點磨損，而有些則在博物館條件下閃閃發光。

a230893aafc19b011169eb0b4f252d64e164abaf.sourceText: The herd of wagons is spread across four main display buildings at the Tucson Rodeo Parade Museum. Stroll around the grounds, and you’ll find historic gems including Tucson’s first garbage truck, the city’s first chemical fire wagon, and Andrew Carnegie’s own personal buggy. You’ll also spot vehicles used in the movie Oklahoma! , and a horse trailer donated by Duncan Renaldo, the Cisco Kid.
a230893aafc19b011169eb0b4f252d64e164abaf.translatedText: 馬車群分佈在圖森牛仔競技遊行博物館的四個主要展示建築。漫步在場地內，您會發現歷史悠久的瑰寶，包括圖森的第一輛垃圾車、該市的第一輛化學消防車和安德魯卡內基自己的私人馬車。您還將看到電影《俄克拉荷馬》中使用的車輛！ ，以及思科小子鄧肯·雷納爾多 (Duncan Renaldo) 捐贈的一輛馬車。

7d1275e54a737a780a17e4ec3cdcc02fc2d14c44.sourceText: And of course, you’ll come across an assortment of wagons still used in the annual parade. You can even rent a vehicle —say, a charming buggy or a hefty freight wagon—to use during the festivities.
7d1275e54a737a780a17e4ec3cdcc02fc2d14c44.translatedText: 當然，您還會遇到每年遊行中仍在使用的各種馬車。您甚至可以租一輛車——例如一輛迷人的越野車或一輛重型貨車——在慶祝活動期間使用。

b287eeea17ff3e891e472a9568d5ac54534bc356.sourceText: But the wagons aren’t the only exhibits worth checking out. The museum showcases railroad displays, complete with a diorama depicting Tucson in the late 19th century. Another section of the institution recreates Tucson in the early 1900s, featuring city staples such as a blacksmith, a jail cell, a saloon, and a saddle shop.
b287eeea17ff3e891e472a9568d5ac54534bc356.translatedText: 但貨車並不是唯一值得一看的展品。博物館展示鐵路展品，並配有描繪 19 世紀末圖森的立體模型。該機構的另一個部分再現了 1900 年代初期的圖森，以鐵匠、牢房、酒吧和馬鞍店等城市主要設施為特色。

59854f06f1de653d4c6ea850a0c735a9e537f4a5.sourceText: Even the grounds are historic—the museum is located on what was the United States 's first municipally owned airfield. The old airport hangar currently houses a portion of the wagon collection.
59854f06f1de653d4c6ea850a0c735a9e537f4a5.translatedText: 就連場地也具有歷史意義——博物館位於美國第一個市政機場。舊機場機庫目前存放部分貨車收藏。

678fbfac9e6c1d3e41a8be4bdfd8a773620279ef.sourceText: Part of the joy of swap meets is not knowing what you’ll find. Get to the Tohono O'odham Swap Meet early enough, however, and you know you’ll find some of Arizona's best tacos al pastor at Polo's Taqueria.
678fbfac9e6c1d3e41a8be4bdfd8a773620279ef.translatedText: 交換會的部分樂趣在於不知道你會發現什麼。不過，早點去 Tohono O'odham Swap Meet，你就會知道，你會在 Polo's Taqueria 找到一些亞利桑那州最好的玉米餅。

8695928fd670626a8850935e386ecad199dca77d.sourceText: Polo's is one of the few places around that cooks their pork on a traditional trompo , a vertical rotisserie of pork slivers marinated in red adobo paste and crowned with a thick chunk of pineapple that slowly melts into the perfectly juicy meat as the stack turns.
8695928fd670626a8850935e386ecad199dca77d.translatedText: Polo's 是周圍為數不多的用傳統 trompo 烹飪豬肉的地方之一，這是一種用紅色阿多波醬醃製的垂直烤肉架，上面放著一大塊慢慢融化的菠蘿。

02a2d409c558b0174c0b4d93d3593d4117488a68.sourceText: Try Polo’s taco al pastor or the equally beloved carne asada on a taco, on a sope , or in a burrito with one of the homemade sauces. The red morita sauce adds a sour, spicy kick, while the salsa verde brightens things up with cilantro and green tomatoes. Cool off in a shaded eating area with Mexican soda from a glass bottle.
02a2d409c558b0174c0b4d93d3593d4117488a68.translatedText: 嘗試將 Polo 的 taco al pattor 或同樣受人喜愛的 carne asada 配在炸玉米餅、sope 或墨西哥捲餅上，搭配其中一種自製醬汁。紅色的森田醬增添了酸辣的味道，而青莎莎醬則用香菜和綠色西紅柿提亮了一切。在陰涼的用餐區喝一杯玻璃瓶裝的墨西哥蘇打水降溫。

b2546294c487c9119e2aa26655b3e90ae473817b.sourceText: In Tempe, Arizona, the sky looms large. The horizons are broad, and the sun shines more than 300 days a year. It’s hard to imagine a more fitting location for an installation by the Arizona-based artist James Turrell, known for his Skyspaces , a series of works that inspire visitors to ponder the connections between light, space, color, and the natural world.
b2546294c487c9119e2aa26655b3e90ae473817b.translatedText: 在亞利桑那州坦佩，天空赫然聳現。視野開闊，一年有300多天陽光普照。亞利桑那州藝術家詹姆斯·特雷爾 (James Turrell) 因其《天空空間》而聞名，他的一系列作品激發遊客思考光、空間、色彩和自然世界之間的聯繫，很難想像還有比這更合適的地點了。

0ea459fc12ae4bb295c2dbb0033970efc08b3215.sourceText: Installed on the campus of Arizona State University in 2012 and titled “Air Apparent,” this remarkable work allows viewers to reset their connection with the sky. Visitors approach the space along a path that leads through a desert garden, before entering a roofless square open structure. Benches along the inside perimeter allow for about 50 people to sit. Above hangs a square sheet of steel, 45 feet on every side, with a cutout in the center, also square, measuring 15 feet per side.
0ea459fc12ae4bb295c2dbb0033970efc08b3215.translatedText: 這件非凡的作品於 2012 年安裝在亞利桑那州立大學校園，題為“空中”，讓觀眾重新建立與天空的聯繫。遊客沿著一條穿過沙漠花園的小路進入這個空間，然後進入一個無屋頂的方形開放結構。內部周邊設有長凳，可容納約 50 人。上面懸掛著一塊方形鋼板，每邊 45 英尺，中間有一個切口，也是方形的，每邊 15 英尺。

47bd7147947a1c6229efc0cafd20a6c6d3aa59ac.sourceText: “There is this sense of peace and everything stopping when you walk into the space,” said Deborah Sussman, who has been visiting the space regularly since it opened.
47bd7147947a1c6229efc0cafd20a6c6d3aa59ac.translatedText: 「當你走進這個空間時，會有一種平靜的感覺，一切都停止了，」黛博拉·蘇斯曼 (Deborah Sussman) 說，她自該空間開業以來一直定期參觀該空間。

670d57059c144345086713b410d9b524b5dde94f.sourceText: “People immediately speak a little bit more quietly,” added Sussman, the senior director of communications and marketing at ASU’s Herberger Institute for Design and the Arts.
670d57059c144345086713b410d9b524b5dde94f.translatedText: 「人們立刻說話小聲了一點，」大四學生 Sussman 補充道。亞利桑那州立大學赫伯格設計與藝術學院傳播與行銷總監。

a312f12b9473998831014eaf1cfa9403cb3f1a79.sourceText: Inside, visitors tend to be transfixed by the square patch of sky above, reframed by the artist in a way that tends to inspire awe. The sky, so vast and familiar that it rarely commands our attention, is renewed as something dynamic. The square plane changes color, of course, as the day proceeds, with occasional interruptions—clouds, airplanes, or birds.
a312f12b9473998831014eaf1cfa9403cb3f1a79.translatedText: 在裡面，遊客往往會被上面的方形天空所吸引，藝術家以一種激發敬畏的方式重新建構了天空。天空如此廣闊和熟悉，以至於很少引起我們的注意，但它被更新為動態的東西。當然，隨著時間的推移，方形平面會改變顏色，偶爾會有雲、飛機或鳥的干擾。

0cf4645d37f460fec006c2751bbfcfe6f0d27635.sourceText: But the most electrifying experience comes at sunrise and sunset, when Turrell’s deep understanding of light and color are fully revealed. A system of 480 colored LED lights, carefully concealed in the structure, illuminates the steel plate from below, in a programmed display that changes as the sun rises or sets. These lights in turn change the viewer’s perception of the sky and the surrounding environment, as the color combinations go from contrasting to complementary.
0cf4645d37f460fec006c2751bbfcfe6f0d27635.translatedText: 但最令人興奮的體驗是在日出和日落時，此時特瑞爾對光和顏色的深刻理解得到充分展現。由 480 個彩色 LED 燈組成的系統被精心隱藏在結構中，從下方照亮鋼板，程式化的顯示會隨著太陽的升起或落下而變化。隨著顏色組合從對比變為互補，這些燈光反過來改變了觀看者對天空和周圍環境的感知。

2f974f35094935a7b4c3c3553b35be7b67c0300c.sourceText: Robert P. McCulloch had many ventures throughout his life, but he is perhaps best known for moving the 1831 London Bridge brick-by-brick to Arizona. Done to bring visitors to his planned town at Lake Havasu City, McCulloch pursued a similarly unique project for another development near Phoenix. Fountain Hills is named after what was the world's tallest fountain when it first turned on in 1970.
2f974f35094935a7b4c3c3553b35be7b67c0300c.translatedText: 羅伯特·P·麥卡洛克 (Robert P. McCulloch) 一生進行過多次冒險，但他最出名的或許是將 1831 年倫敦橋一磚一瓦地移至亞利桑那州。為了將遊客帶到哈瓦蘇湖城他規劃的小鎮，麥卡洛克在鳳凰城附近的另一個開發項目中尋求了一個類似的獨特項目。噴泉山 (Fountain Hills) 因 1970 年首次開放時世界上最高的噴泉而得名。

95a8ee6c755f0d019d3f599cb9b04750d9d12f0b.sourceText: In the middle of a dammed lake, the fountain was proposed to McCulloch and designed by C.V. Wood of Disneyland fame. Although it lost its world record in 1980, it has since reclaimed the title of tallest in the United States after the Gateway Geyser shut off in 2024. Overall, it is still the third tallest fountain in the world, and can shoot up to 560 feet at full power. Usually it only shoots up to around 300 feet, still tall enough to be enjoyed from nearby mountain ranges.
95a8ee6c755f0d019d3f599cb9b04750d9d12f0b.translatedText: 這座噴泉位於一座堰塞湖中央，由麥卡洛克 (McCulloch) 提議建造，由 C.V. 設計。迪士尼樂園聲名大噪的伍德。儘管它在 1980 年失去了世界紀錄，但在 2024 年蓋特威間歇泉關閉後，它重新奪回了美國最高噴泉的稱號。總體而言，它仍然是世界上第三高的噴泉，全功率時可以噴出 560 英尺的高度。通常它只能噴到 300 英尺左右，但仍然足夠高，可以從附近的山脈欣賞。

f1969eaed4626364a201d7001820064f7b4b1540.sourceText: The fountain turns on at the top of every hour from 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. and runs for 15 minutes. As it uses recycled water, it does not operate when winds exceed 10 mph.
f1969eaed4626364a201d7001820064f7b4b1540.translatedText: 噴泉在上午 9:00 到晚上 9:00 的每小時整點開放。運行15分鐘。由於它使用循環水，因此當風速超過 10 英里/小時時，它就不會運行。

b3ad351f8c4e27d359d11e5cc802b76185981e50.sourceText: On a windswept mesa overlooking the Hopi reservation in northeast Arizona are the ruins of the Awat'ovi settlement, the site of a violent clash of religion and culture.
b3ad351f8c4e27d359d11e5cc802b76185981e50.translatedText: 在亞利桑那州東北部的一片狂風掃過的台地上，俯瞰著霍皮族保留地，是阿瓦特奧維定居點的廢墟，這裡是宗教和文化暴力衝突的場所。

6d331641b478500d6f32a103d5b6952cf14810e5.sourceText: In 1700, Hopi traditionalists massacred Christian converts and destroyed all remnants of Spanish influence in an effort to preserve their unique identity. During the 16th and 17th centuries, Spanish conquistadors, in their search for the legendary Seven Cities of Cibola, asserted control over the numerous Puebloan towns scattered throughout what are today Arizona and New Mexico .
6d331641b478500d6f32a103d5b6952cf14810e5.translatedText: 1700 年，霍皮族傳統主義者屠殺了基督教皈依者，並摧毀了西班牙影響力的所有殘餘，以保護他們獨特的身份。在 16 世紀和 17 世紀，西班牙征服者在尋找傳說中的西波拉七城的過程中，控制了散佈在今天的亞利桑那州和新墨西哥州的眾多普韋布洛城鎮。

3cfc22f79849212b07087f78bd474b953b411844.sourceText: Across European colonies, white settlers brought Christianity with them. They often used religion as a tool of oppression, and banned traditional spiritual practices. Attendant Franciscan and Jesuit priests succeeded in converting many Native Americans, although the Puebloans secretly blended their traditional spirituality with Christianity in their own ceremonies held in traditional kiva chambers.
3cfc22f79849212b07087f78bd474b953b411844.translatedText: 在歐洲殖民地，白人定居者帶來了基督教。他們經常利用宗教作為壓迫工具，並禁止傳統的精神實踐。隨從的方濟會和耶穌會牧師成功地改變了許多美洲原住民的信仰，儘管普韋布洛人在傳統基瓦廳舉行的儀式中秘密地將他們的傳統靈性與基督教融合在一起。

f92579647415e22c66fff04080c317c68e7a8b45.sourceText: Cultural tensions, famine, and brutal treatment of the native population eventually precipitated a coordinated rebellion in which the Spanish were overwhelmed by a surprise attack by every pueblo on the same day. Led by Popé from the San Juan Pueblo, the Pueblo Revolt of 1680 successfully eliminated European hegemony, but only briefly as the Spanish gradually reasserted control by 1692.
f92579647415e22c66fff04080c317c68e7a8b45.translatedText: 文化緊張、飢荒和對原住民的殘酷對待最終引發了一場協調一致的叛亂，西班牙人在同一天被每個普韋布洛人的突然襲擊所壓倒。在聖胡安普韋布洛的波佩的領導下，1680 年的普韋布洛起義成功地消除了歐洲霸權，但只是短暫的，西班牙人到 1692 年才逐漸重新奪回控制權。

b5f1f65feaa81552813ba339db00ba5eba0f342f.sourceText: The native inhabitants of Awat'ovi, however, were divided on the question of welcoming back European (read: Christian) influence. Following an ultimatum issued by Hopi traditionalists in 1700, all men who cooperated with the Spanish or adopted Christianity were slaughtered, and the church was destroyed.
b5f1f65feaa81552813ba339db00ba5eba0f342f.translatedText: 然而，阿瓦特奧維的當地居民在歡迎歐洲（即基督教）影響力回歸的問題上存在分歧。 1700年，霍皮族傳統主義者發出最後通牒，所有與西班牙人合作或皈依基督教的人都被屠殺，教堂也被摧毀。

86b9c49bdac278a8467e184967e0160ab4eed3b6.sourceText: Ironically, the word “Hopi” generally means “people of peace,” and violence is anathema to their belief system. Traditionalists, therefore, had to call upon a special Katsina ogre spirit to descend on the village and carry out the ultimatum.
86b9c49bdac278a8467e184967e0160ab4eed3b6.translatedText: 諷刺的是，“霍皮人”一詞通常意味著“和平人民”，而暴力對他們的信仰體系來說是令人厭惡的。因此，傳統主義者必須召喚一種特殊的卡齊納食人魔靈魂降臨到村莊並執行最後通牒。

892ff5c84d85d05b3ad64efe116205633f824cf6.sourceText: Walk along 8th Avenue in the Old Quarter of Page , Arizona , and you'll stroll down a street lined with motels. When compared to the newer accommodations that have popped up throughout the city, they don't look like much. But spend the night in one of these motels, and you'll be sleeping in one of the apartments once used by construction workers who built the nearby Glen Canyon Dam.
892ff5c84d85d05b3ad64efe116205633f824cf6.translatedText: 沿著亞利桑那州佩奇市老城區的第八大道漫步，您會在汽車旅館林立的街道上漫步。與整個城市湧現的新住宿相比，它們看起來並不多。但是，在這些汽車旅館中過夜，您將睡在曾經由建造附近格倫峽谷大壩的建築工人使用過的公寓中。

67af75b04f5eff05679e02b85e2a9acaaebd91bc.sourceText: Page is a relatively new city. It was founded in 1957, after starting out as a government camp for the construction of the massive Glen Canyon Dam. For seven years (1956 through 1963) large numbers of construction workers were housed temporarily in Page as construction on the dam, Rainbow Arch Bridge, and associated projects progressed.
67af75b04f5eff05679e02b85e2a9acaaebd91bc.translatedText: 佩吉是個相對較新的城市。它成立於 1957 年，最初是為了建造大型格倫峽谷大壩而設立的政府營地。七年來（1956 年至 1963 年），隨著大壩、彩虹拱橋和相關項目的建設進展，大量建築工人被臨時安置在佩吉。

fd7f6f396d97127f0df7f4e6bbc93cf793e8b776.sourceText: Since the construction's completion, Page has steadily grown from a town into a city and is now major tourist destination for the area's stunning visual landscapes and vistas, such as Glen Canyon National Recreation Area, Lower and Upper Antelope Canyon, Horseshoe Bend, Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument, and a variety of other beautiful natural features in the region.
fd7f6f396d97127f0df7f4e6bbc93cf793e8b776.translatedText: 自建設完成以來，佩吉已從一個城鎮穩步發展成為一座城市，現在是該地區令人驚嘆的視覺景觀和遠景的主要旅遊目的地，例如格倫峽谷國家休閒區、下羚羊峽谷和上羚羊峽谷、馬蹄灣、大階梯 - 埃特蘭特國家紀念碑，以及該地區其他各種美麗的自然景觀。

8aadd24edb3ddb8afcaced702c24d440a77c491e.sourceText: As a result, many new hotels and lodging establishments have been built in and around Page in recent years. However, the first motels that were constructed date back to the original development boom of the mid-to-late-1950s when construction of the dam and related projects were taking place.
8aadd24edb3ddb8afcaced702c24d440a77c491e.translatedText: 因此，近年來佩吉及其周邊地區建造了許多新的飯店和住宿場所。然而，第一批汽車旅館的建成可以追溯到 20 世紀 50 年代中後期的最初開發熱潮，當時正在進行大壩和相關項目的建設。

b62a2e38557512e06d7ae78f15fd5b8a235e9427.sourceText: These quaint mid-century motels are in many ways the historical foundation for Page. Today, several of them remain in operation and they are recognized with historical signage, street banners, and a special street name and designation: “Street of the Little Motels.”
b62a2e38557512e06d7ae78f15fd5b8a235e9427.translatedText: 這些古色古香的中世紀汽車旅館在許多方面都是佩奇的歷史基礎。如今，其中幾家仍在運營，並以歷史標誌、街道橫幅以及特殊的街道名稱和名稱來識別它們：「小汽車旅館街」。

b3d0cf70b818274007d718ea5c43d87cae6a3a4c.sourceText: Shelves lined with cracked geodes, boxes and bins full of glittering crystals and minerals, and displays of fossils fill this colorful store. Miners Rock Shop is full of Arizona 's geological wonders. Miner and jeweler Sonseeahray "Sonny" Baar and archeologist Sam Baar, owners of the shop, run their family business in the eclectic town of Tempe , Arizona. The family owns five mining claims across the state, offering earthly spectacles from the local landscape and beyond.
b3d0cf70b818274007d718ea5c43d87cae6a3a4c.translatedText: 貨架上擺滿了破裂的晶洞，盒子和箱子裡裝滿了閃閃發光的水晶和礦物，還有化石展示，充滿了這家色彩繽紛的商店。 Miners Rock Shop 充滿了亞利桑那州的地質奇觀。礦工兼珠寶商 Sonseeahray「Sonny」Baar 和考古學家 Sam Baar（商店老闆）在亞利桑那州兼收並蓄的坦佩鎮經營家族生意。該家族在全州擁有五個採礦權，提供當地及其他地區的地球奇觀。

aa518ca34a24ed8e8ba485b8bbffc1ce907cd28e.sourceText: Their wide collection includes ultraviolet light-reactive minerals, crystals, gemstones, geodes, fossils, and lapidary rough. Visitors can tour their UV mineral room and crack open mysterious geodes. Beyond their selection of glistening goods, the Baars offer lapidary supplies and equipment, including faceting machines and other tools for polishing, cutting, and engraving. Sonny is an accomplished silversmith who makes the majority of the jewelry in the shop herself.
aa518ca34a24ed8e8ba485b8bbffc1ce907cd28e.translatedText: 他們的收藏種類繁多，包括紫外線反應礦物、晶體、寶石、晶洞、化石和寶石原石。遊客可以參觀他們的紫外線礦物室並打開神秘的晶洞。除了精選的閃閃發光的商品外，巴爾夫婦還提供寶石用品和設備，包括刻面機和其他用於拋光、切割和雕刻的工具。 Sonny 是一位技藝精湛的銀匠，店裡的大部分珠寶都是她自己製作的。

46f42c4018f97e72607b306f08b6b5a33f7abd58.sourceText: Among the shelves of gems hang captivating wildlife paintings, all of which are made by the owner's 17-year-old son. The shop also features a selection of Native American art sourced directly from the artists themselves, including hand-carved Hopi Kachina, hand-woven Native baskets, Native pottery, and hand-carved Zuni fetishes.
46f42c4018f97e72607b306f08b6b5a33f7abd58.translatedText: 寶石架上掛著迷人的野生動物畫作，所有這些都是店主 17 歲的兒子製作的。該商店還出售一系列直接來自藝術家本人的美國原住民藝術品，包括手工雕刻的霍皮族卡奇納 (Hopi Kachina)、手工編織的原住民籃子、原住民陶器和手工雕刻的祖尼 (Zuni) 神物。

5ed3bfc8e1decb855da171b2d86ed5df0ca8dd52.sourceText: The shop is open 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. Wednesday through Sunday.
5ed3bfc8e1decb855da171b2d86ed5df0ca8dd52.translatedText: 商店的營業時間為上午 10 點至晚上 7 點。週三到週日。

c405d1f8f4436b16bd4b68f3462bd031aab6942a.sourceText: Here you'll find a delightfully curious passion project: an assorted collection of 180 lasers and holograms, from the 1970s to the modern era. It's fascinating seeing how the technology evolved from a giant tube that was water-cooled to a small diode that can be bought for less than the price of a burrito.
c405d1f8f4436b16bd4b68f3462bd031aab6942a.translatedText: 在這裡，您會發現一個令人愉悅、充滿好奇的激情項目：180 個雷射和全息圖的各種收藏，從 20 世紀 70 年代到現代。看到這項技術如何從一個巨大的水冷管演變為一個比墨西哥捲餅價格還低的小二極管，真是令人著迷。

8ad3c864d1198380fdf9c094f933993a3e3c32b0.sourceText: The owner, Bob Hess, is an active holographer and passionate about his craft. He has been working with lasers and making holograms since 1980.
8ad3c864d1198380fdf9c094f933993a3e3c32b0.translatedText: 老闆鮑伯‧赫斯 (Bob Hess) 是一位活躍的全息攝影師，對他的手藝充滿熱情。自 1980 年以來，他一直從事雷射和全息圖製作工作。

da74f57c5f280171e7429a433583dc82e6597277.sourceText: There is not much for children to do and a lot of stuff they could accidentally break.
da74f57c5f280171e7429a433583dc82e6597277.translatedText: 孩子們沒什麼好做的，而且很多東西可能會不小心弄壞。

c94f395fc213cfdeab3bddabb0a017f211bdaeeb.sourceText: All across the Four Corners region of the United States, visitors will often come across a half-kitsch, half-spiritual figure known as Kokopelli. The popularity of the Kokopelli figure crested across the Southwest during the early 21st century, but its origins lie before the dawn of the historical record. And with more than a thousand years of history behind it, the largest and most imposing likeness of this mythic flute-playing figure can be found in a roadside Starbucks parking lot near an interstate exit.
c94f395fc213cfdeab3bddabb0a017f211bdaeeb.translatedText: 在美國的四角地區，遊客常會遇到一個半庸俗、半精神的人物，名叫科科佩利。科科佩利雕像的流行於 21 世紀初在西南部達到頂峰，但其起源早於歷史記錄。背後有著一千多年的歷史，在州際出口附近的路邊星巴克停車場，可以找到這個吹笛神話人物最大、最雄偉的肖像。

865141e554bb0d06cf2bab033fc27040faca76af.sourceText: Before Kokopelli was a kitsch attraction, it was a symbol of fertility during the era of the Ancestral Puebloan peoples and of the Hohokam, an early American civilization that was likely a precursor of the Akimel and Tohono Oʼodham Nations. There were many representations of the Kokopelli in early petroglyphs and pictographs, as well as pottery and other archaeological finds. The Kokopelli is usually playing a flute, often with an erect phallus, likely a symbol of divine masculinity. Kokopelli has survived into modernity, as the Hopi and Zuni include a similar kachina god in their pantheon.
865141e554bb0d06cf2bab033fc27040faca76af.translatedText: 在科科佩利成為一個庸俗景點之前，它是祖先普韋布洛人和霍霍卡姆時代生育力的象徵，霍霍卡姆是一種早期的美國文明，很可能是阿基梅爾文明和霍霍卡姆文明的先驅。 Tohono O'odham 國。早期岩畫和象形文字以及陶器和其他考古發現中存在許多科科佩利人的形象。科科佩利通常吹奏長笛，通常帶有直立的陰莖，可能是神聖男子氣概的象徵。科科佩利在現代社會中倖存下來，因為霍皮人和祖尼人在他們的萬神殿中都有一個類似的卡奇納神。

2154e17ec0bd453917cd71e07f7e3082c4c1459d.sourceText: Surprisingly, it was a non-phallic humpbacked version that launched a million t-shirt prints. Ekkehart Malotki, author of Kokopelli: The Making of an Icon , notes the rise of what he terms “Kokopellimania” by the late 1990s, as the symbol crossed into kitsch art, finding its way into jewelry, ceramics, countless mail-order catalogs, Christmas ornaments, and “Golfer-Pelli,” a Kokopelli figure swinging a golf club that was “guaranteed to improve your swing!” Malotki cites the rise of interest in petroglyphs, New Age thinking, and capitalist appropriation of Indigenous culture for the Kokopelli craze.
2154e17ec0bd453917cd71e07f7e3082c4c1459d.translatedText: 令人驚訝的是，這是一個非陽具駝背版本，推出了百萬張 T 卹印花。 《科科佩利：偶像的誕生》一書的作者埃克哈特·馬洛特基 (Ekkehart Malotki) 指出，他所稱的「科科佩利狂熱」在 20 世紀 90年代末開始興起，因為這一符號融入了媚俗藝術，進入了珠寶、陶瓷、無數郵購目錄、聖誕裝飾品和“高爾夫球手佩利”，這是一個揮舞著高爾夫球桿的科科佩利人物，“保證可以提高你的揮桿水平！”馬洛特基引用了對岩畫興趣的興起、新時代思維以及對土著文化的挪用以及對土著文化的挪用。

4ba77f62458382b924bd26c5c0cbfc072b5c12f5.sourceText: It was at the height of Kokopellimania that the Krazy Kokopelli Trading Post was built. The owner, Lowell Johnson, was looking for a new roadside attraction to bring visitors to what was then the Montezuma Trading Post. He hired blacksmith Gerry Berg, who together with his son, Gerry Berg Jr. built a 32-foot tall sculpture out of plate steel. Originally, a speaker was placed in the sculpture to attract visitors. Unfortunately, much like a Kokopelli, the store couldn’t get over the hump, and it closed after a few decades. However, the roadside attraction still stands today in a commercial lot, both a symbol of the long history of the Southwest and its more recent journey of cultural exchange.
4ba77f62458382b924bd26c5c0cbfc072b5c12f5.translatedText: 瘋狂科科佩利貿易站正是在科科佩利狂熱的鼎盛時期建立的。業主洛威爾約翰遜 (Lowell Johnson) 正在尋找一個新的路邊景點，以吸引遊客前往當時的蒙特祖瑪貿易站 (Montezuma Trading Post)。他聘請了鐵匠格里·伯格 (Gerry Berg)，後者與他的兒子小格里·伯格 (Gerry Berg Jr.) 用鋼板建造了一座 32 英尺高的雕塑。最初，雕塑中放置了一個揚聲器來吸引遊客。不幸的是，就像科科佩利一樣，這家商店無法渡過難關，幾十年後就關門了。然而，這個路邊景點至今仍矗立在商業地段，既是西南地區悠久歷史的象徵，也是其最近的文化交流之旅的象徵。

71e6ccd527ce4fdbf11f5e9609f6f5e394b40d2e.sourceText: There is a small but worthy cabinet of mathematical models and calculating machines in the University of Arizona math building. Originally used to teach undergraduates, these models are now appreciated for their simple elegance.
71e6ccd527ce4fdbf11f5e9609f6f5e394b40d2e.translatedText: 亞利桑那大學數學大樓裡有一個小而有價值的櫃子，裡面有數學模型和計算器。這些模型最初用於本科生教學，現在因其簡單優雅而受到讚賞。

cdffdefcd5f8fecf5fb7d1b9f578296da10fb784.sourceText: The models are examples of a movement in the late 1880s to the 1930s to reform mathematics education. The models were used to demonstrate math concepts in a three-dimensional manner. One set of models, called the Baker models, were produced commercially by Richard P. Baker, an Oxford-educated mathematician who moved to Chicago in around 1900 and started selling models to universities and schools.
cdffdefcd5f8fecf5fb7d1b9f578296da10fb784.translatedText: 這些模型是 1880 年代末至 1930 年代數學教育改革運動的例子。這些模型用於以三維方式演示數學概念。一組稱為貝克模型的模型由理查德·P·貝克 (Richard P. Baker) 進行商業化生產，他是一位受過牛津大學教育的數學家，於 1900 年左右移居芝加哥，開始向大學和學校銷售模型。

a8355b5cf21c615752fd3e11c65b621cb14f00e8.sourceText: His first catalog described 100 models and had grown to over 500 by the time of his death in 1937. His catalog demonstrated an "enormous range, including solid geometry, projective geometry, algebraic geometry, Riemann surfaces, surfaces from the theories of electromagnetism and thermodynamics, and representations of probability distributions." He also made models of complex electromagnetic reflections which are included in the collection and are often not taught to undergraduate students.
a8355b5cf21c615752fd3e11c65b621cb14f00e8.translatedText: 他的第一份目錄描述了 100 個模型，到 1937 年去世時已增加到 500 多個。他的目錄展示了「巨大的範圍，包括立體幾何、射影幾何、代數幾何、黎曼曲面、電磁學和熱力學理論的曲面以及機率分佈的表示。」他還製作了複雜的電磁反射模型，這些模型包含在館藏中，但通常不會教給本科生。

5a75cc571f24c889b011f31a22561bc0b4918991.sourceText: The Baker model collection is the most extensive collection in the western US and one of only a few Baker collections in the United States, including one at the National Museum of American History at the Smithsonian Institution .
5a75cc571f24c889b011f31a22561bc0b4918991.translatedText: 貝克模型收藏是美國西部最廣泛的收藏，也是美國為數不多的貝克收藏之一，其中包括史密森尼學會美國國家歷史博物館的一個。

cb98dd2ad19d762642814aacd7e437f5572f040b.sourceText: The models may no longer be relevant in a computer age, but the skill and craftsmanship can still be appreciated as works of art.
cb98dd2ad19d762642814aacd7e437f5572f040b.translatedText: 這些模型可能不再與電腦時代相關，但其技巧和工藝仍然可以被欣賞藝術品。

059f407dce714c38c2b7ed501b2b6674ddedfe1a.sourceText: In 1891, the United States Army decommissioned Fort Lowell which was located about seven miles from Tucson .
059f407dce714c38c2b7ed501b2b6674ddedfe1a.translatedText: 1891 年，美國陸軍退役了距離圖森約 7 英里的洛威爾堡。

5a40d3c412c5f6438f16ab5842762fbd98441c23.sourceText: Mexican families from the Sonora region soon moved into the area. Utilizing materials from the fort's buildings, they constructed a thriving and growing community on land others considered barren. By harvesting mesquite, these settlers built a robust business in providing wood for Tucson. This early development was called El Barriada del Rillito or more commonly, El Fuerte.
5a40d3c412c5f6438f16ab5842762fbd98441c23.translatedText: 來自索諾拉地區的墨西哥家庭很快就搬進了該地區。他們利用堡壘建築中的材料，在其他人認為貧瘠的土地上建造了一個繁榮且不斷發展的社區。透過採伐豆科灌木，這些定居者建立了為圖森提供木材的強大業務。這個早期開發項目被稱為 El Barriada del Rillito，或更常見的名稱是 El Fuerte。

26be6a4f9d467b3c902bdb729c7d8bd1256a8986.sourceText: In need for a place to worship, the community established a tiny chapel called La Capillita in 1915. A Carmelite father would ride from the Holy Family Parish and hold services for the 15 Mexican families in the El Fuerte area. The priest would stand in the chapel and families would gather under the shade of a mesquite tree out front to hear the sermon.
26be6a4f9d467b3c902bdb729c7d8bd1256a8986.translatedText: 由於需要一個禮拜場所，該社區於 1915 年建立了一座名為 La Capillita 的小教堂。一位加爾默羅會的神父會從聖家教區騎馬前往，為 El Fuerte 地區的 15 個墨西哥家庭舉行儀式。神父會站在教堂裡，家人會聚集在門前的豆科灌木樹蔭下聆聽講道。

8f8a76f07dc6a43ece04a2ffe7e5fcee91c62fc9.sourceText: In 1917, Señora Josefa de Mule donated land to construct a larger chapel. The chapel was constructed from local materials including clay for the adobe walls. The church was called, Santo Ángel de la Guarda and stood on the site until 1929 when it was destroyed by a dust storm or possibly a tornado.
8f8a76f07dc6a43ece04a2ffe7e5fcee91c62fc9.translatedText: 1917 年，Señora Josefa de Mule 捐贈土地建造了一座更大的教堂。教堂採用當地材料建造，包括用於土坯牆的粘土。教堂被稱為 Santo Ángel de la Guarda，一直矗立在原址上，直到 1929 年被沙塵暴或可能是龍捲風摧毀。

15d3d61f8c787ac17d45594b4d5fbfb5ef387d6b.sourceText: The present church was established on the foundations of Santo Ángel de la Guarda. The church was served by the same order of priest until 1948 when St. Cyril’s became the community church. The church is still available for events and weddings.
15d3d61f8c787ac17d45594b4d5fbfb5ef387d6b.translatedText: 現在的教會是在 Santo Ángel de la Guarda 的基礎上建立的。直到 1948 年聖西里爾教會成為社區教會之前，該教會一直由同一位牧師服務。教堂仍然可以舉辦活動和婚禮。

c3b1407dc7883eeb8cb0009b32b2f0d2109b5f04.sourceText: Many places are described as time capsules, but few live up to the description like The Shelter in Tucson, Arizona. This dive bar has served thirsty Tucsonans since 1961, and despite the passage of time, it's as funky as ever.
c3b1407dc7883eeb8cb0009b32b2f0d2109b5f04.translatedText: 許多地方都被描述為時間膠囊，但很少有地方像亞利桑那州圖森市的 The Shelter 那樣符合描述。這家潛水酒吧自 1961 年以來一直為口渴的圖索納人提供服務，儘管時光流逝，它仍然一如既往的時髦。

2c10cc932c5809eb13bef8d39faab43f33544969.sourceText: The name, exterior, and decor are all nods to the Cold War. As in, the whole place was designed to look like a fallout shelter. Like a "real" fallout shelter, the exterior is windowless and clad in white stucco and stone, albeit topped with imposing neon signage. Inside, the walls are covered in old mirrors, patterned wallpaper, velvet paintings, period advertisements, and kitschy JFK memorabilia, including hand-crafted tapestries in his image. The U-shaped bar is surrounded with comfy red stools, and a Sputnik-inspired lamp orbits just above the vodka selection.
2c10cc932c5809eb13bef8d39faab43f33544969.translatedText: 名稱、外觀和裝飾都是對冷戰的致敬。就像這樣，整個地方被設計成看起來像一個避難所。就像一個「真正的」防空洞，外部沒有窗戶，覆蓋著白色灰泥和石頭，儘管頂部有令人印象深刻的霓虹燈標誌。裡面的牆上掛滿了舊鏡子、圖案的壁紙、天鵝絨畫作、時代廣告和俗氣的甘迺迪紀念品，包括以他的形象手工製作的掛毯。 U 型酒吧周圍擺滿了舒適的紅色凳子，一盞受人造衛星啟發的燈在伏特加酒上方旋轉。

f7acb65370818ab1b7a90300fb6cf40903cb2ff3.sourceText: The drinks are cheap and stiff, and the martini menu extensive. At last count, The Shelter offered 13 signature martinis ranging from traditional (vodka, dirty) to absolutely confounding (cucumber vodka, melon, cream, cayenne). The entire bar is suffused with red light, which adds to its vintage charm. Whether you find yourself staring at the blinking plastic visage of JFK or the martini-shaped bike racks outside, there's plenty to look at. So if you find yourself in Tucson, get out your go-go boots, grab a few friends, and head to The Shelter for a boozy trip back in time.
f7acb65370818ab1b7a90300fb6cf40903cb2ff3.translatedText: 飲料便宜又烈性，馬丁尼菜單豐富。根據最新統計，The Shelter 提供了 13 種招牌馬丁尼酒，從傳統的（伏特加、骯髒的）到絕對混雜的（黃瓜伏特加、甜瓜、奶油、辣椒）。整個酒吧瀰漫著紅色的燈光，更增添了復古的魅力。無論您是盯著甘迺迪機場閃爍的塑膠面孔，還是外面馬丁尼形狀的自行車架，都有很多東西值得一看。因此，如果您身在圖森，請脫下您的輕便靴子，帶上幾位朋友，前往 The Shelter 來一場時光倒流的醉酒之旅。

fd74d53d6325d84ce6d8bf4733c238f5c2cc79ac.sourceText: When you first encounter this massive wall embossed with 700, 1000-year-old petroglyphs, it's hard not to be impressed. After centuries of wear and erosion, it's amazing how clear and vibrant the drawings have remained. The entire V Bar V Heritage Site contains around 13 panels containing more than 1,000 petroglyphs. The various panels are also some of the easiest to locate.
fd74d53d6325d84ce6d8bf4733c238f5c2cc79ac.translatedText: 當您第一次看到這面刻有 700、1000 年歷史岩畫的巨大牆壁時，很難不留下深刻的印象。經過幾個世紀的磨損和侵蝕，令人驚訝的是，這些圖畫仍然如此清晰和充滿活力。整個 V Bar V 遺址包含約 13 個面板，其中包含 1,000 多個岩畫。各種面板也是最容易找到的。

9d041f2f4e68ec7e7994538ab852eefec4a8460e.sourceText: It's believed that these marvelous carvings were created by the Southern Sinagua culture between 900 and 1350. The petroglyphs were created in the "Beaver Creek Rock Art Style," which has been seen in other carvings across the heritage site and other rock art sites along Beaver Creek.
9d041f2f4e68ec7e7994538ab852eefec4a8460e.translatedText: 據信這些奇妙的雕刻是由 900 至 1350 年間的南西納瓜文化創作的。這些岩畫是按照「海狸溪岩石藝術風格」創作的，這種風格在遺產地的其他雕刻以及海狸溪沿岸的其他岩石藝術遺址中都可以看到。

fac274f0173d21a660b1b83a355e2571a7c055c1.sourceText: Call first to see if there will be a docent on site. Just viewing the glyphs is great, but having someone explain the history and describe what you're seeing makes a more fulfilling experience.
fac274f0173d21a660b1b83a355e2571a7c055c1.translatedText: 請先致電，看看是否會有現場解說員。僅僅查看字形就很棒，但讓有人解釋歷史並描述您所看到的內容會讓您獲得更充實的體驗。

3d8cfe02e9804c6cbd8cbe18198688eadccc8387.sourceText: The site is open year-round from 9 a.m.- 3 p.m., Monday through Friday. The site does close due to inclement weather. There are ample parking spaces, a visitor center, restrooms, and a small store on site. The walk back to the viewing area is an easy hike. However, the petroglyphs are not wheelchair accessible.
3d8cfe02e9804c6cbd8cbe18198688eadccc8387.translatedText: 網站全年開放，週一至週五上午 9 點至下午 3 點。該網站因惡劣天氣而關閉。現場有充足的停車位、遊客中心、衛浴和小商店。步行返回觀景區很輕鬆。然而，岩畫不適合輪椅通行。

57341a160d483790567b67adb046585465d0136f.sourceText: Occult enthusiasts and fans of assorted spooky stuff should check out Arizona's year-round Halloween shop. The store prides itself on stocking niche “creepy products not found in big box stores or Amazon.”
57341a160d483790567b67adb046585465d0136f.translatedText: 神秘學愛好者和各種怪異物品的粉絲應該去亞利桑那州全年開放的萬聖節商店。該商店以庫存“大型商店或亞馬遜上找不到的令人毛骨悚然的產品”而自豪。

ed5666b933e2457bcf86dbdf545c29844f3b3407.sourceText: Terror Trader houses the owner's personal horror collections on display as well as crafts and goods for sale by many local horror buffs. Staff here are incredibly friendly and generally happy to chat about all things paranormal or macabre. Visitors can even sign up for a membership to become one of the Fraternal Order of Creeps.
ed5666b933e2457bcf86dbdf545c29844f3b3407.translatedText: 恐怖商人展示了店主的個人恐怖收藏品，以及許多當地恐怖愛好者出售的工藝品和商品。這裡的工作人員非常友好，通常很樂意談論所有超自然或恐怖的事情。遊客甚至可以註冊成為會員，成為蠕蟲兄弟會的一員。

341ef777a01cb3fbf0f48622cc8f571b34ee8c10.sourceText: There is no fee to see any of the collections or to go browse. Keep an eye on the regular free events, such as the chance to take a photo with Krampus around Christmas.
341ef777a01cb3fbf0f48622cc8f571b34ee8c10.translatedText: 觀看任何收藏或瀏覽都是免費的。請留意定期的免費活動，例如聖誕節前後與坎普斯合影的機會。

0bd77a9b95299572e17ac5d97f9c16923e395809.sourceText: Post Tucson was established near the old Tucson Presidio by the California Column after the Battle of Picacho Peak in 1862. It was abandoned in 1864, but reestablished in 1865 and renamed Camp Lowell in 1866. By 1873, the camp had been moved seven miles east to the confluence of Tanque Verde and Pantano creeks for sanitary reasons. The name of the camp was changed to Fort Lowell in 1879.
0bd77a9b95299572e17ac5d97f9c16923e395809.translatedText: 1862 年皮卡喬峰戰役後，加州縱隊在舊圖森要塞附近建立了圖森後哨站。它於 1864 年被廢棄，但於 1865 年重建，並於 1866 年更名為洛厄爾營地。到 1873 年，出於衛生原因，該營地已向東移動 7 英里，位於 Tanque Verde 和潘塔諾溪的交匯處。 1879 年，營地更名為洛威爾堡。

198a1701e841193ed15a5725ca8ed3d6f957de2c.sourceText: The fort played a pivotal role during the Apache Wars. It was primarily used as a supply and support depot for outlying military posts.
198a1701e841193ed15a5725ca8ed3d6f957de2c.translatedText: 堡壘在阿帕契戰爭期間發揮了舉足輕重的作用。它主要用作邊遠軍事哨所的補給和支援站。

5b06f59397be7b74467b28691a5018fa8dc26e58.sourceText: At its peak, the fort contained around 30 adobe buildings surrounding a large parade ground. The buildings included a commissary, trading store, guardhouse, barracks, and other buildings. One of the lanes created for the fort included several cottonwood trees and is known as Cottonwood Lane to this day.
5b06f59397be7b74467b28691a5018fa8dc26e58.translatedText: 在其鼎盛時期，這座堡壘包含約 30 座土坯建築，周圍環繞著一個大型閱兵場。這些建築物包括小賣部、貿易商店、警衛室、營房和其他建築物。其中一條為堡壘建造的小巷種有幾棵三葉楊樹，至今仍被稱為三葉楊巷。

65ef20ece7e45968230e21618577f0ad9f625302.sourceText: One of the more intact buildings that still exist on the site is the former hospital. One of the most prominent members of the hospital's staff was Walter Reed.
65ef20ece7e45968230e21618577f0ad9f625302.translatedText: 該地點仍存在的較為完整的建築之一是前醫院。沃爾特·里德 (Walter Reed) 是醫院最傑出的工作人員之一。

b3ca379d974f68b3faf7ca1ad285c76e8b23be7a.sourceText: The fort was decommissioned in 1891 and was largely dismantled by people in the surrounding area. In 1945, with the assistance of Carlos Ronstadt (an uncle to Linda Ronstadt), local Boy Scout troops obtained 40 acres of the fort grounds to prevent developers from destroying what remained. The fort was eventually donated to Pima County when the scouts could no longer afford maintenance costs.
b3ca379d974f68b3faf7ca1ad285c76e8b23be7a.translatedText: 堡壘於 1891 年退役，大部分被周邊地區的人們拆除。 1945 年，在卡洛斯·朗斯塔特（琳達·朗斯塔特的叔叔）的幫助下，當地童子軍獲得了 40 英畝的堡壘場地，以防止開發商毀壞剩餘的土地。當偵察兵無法再承擔維護費用時，堡壘最終被捐贈給皮馬縣。

abc82452b712e8a46cab110bf7a12595707ae05f.sourceText: The location of the fort and the availability of a constant water source made the area attractive even during the formational years of Tucson. The entire region around the fort was a large Hohokam village that existed in the area from year 900 to about 1200.
abc82452b712e8a46cab110bf7a12595707ae05f.translatedText: 即使在圖森的形成時期，堡壘的位置和穩定的水源也使該地區具有吸引力。堡壘周圍的整個地區是一個大型 Hohokam 村莊，該村莊存在於 900 年至 1200 年左右。

c627ac0fba4b3d49f0b67e43ab0cf14076b0e22b.sourceText: A luxury automobile comparable to Cadillac in its heyday, the Franklin motor car has largely faded into obscurity. But enthusiasts have managed to keep the carmaker’s legacy alive at places like Tucson ’s Franklin Auto Museum.
c627ac0fba4b3d49f0b67e43ab0cf14076b0e22b.translatedText: 富蘭克林汽車是一款可與鼎盛時期的凱迪拉克相媲美的豪華汽車，但現在已經逐漸淡出人們的視線。但愛好者們設法在圖森富蘭克林汽車博物館等地方保留了這家汽車製造商的遺產。

78fd7875be86a1146d8dd16b626e1375d91afed5.sourceText: The Franklin motor car was invented by John Wilkinson in 1900 and manufactured by the industrialist Herbert H. Franklin. Its air-cooled engine set it apart from other vehicles—it had no need for the radiators, hoses, or pumps of water-cooled engines, which were heavy and prone to temperature fluctuations. The Syracuse, New York-based company quickly became the largest manufacturer of air-cooled automobiles in the United States .
78fd7875be86a1146d8dd16b626e1375d91afed5.translatedText: 富蘭克林汽車由約翰·威爾金森 (John Wilkinson) 於 1900 年發明，由實業家赫伯特·H·富蘭克林 (Herbert H. Franklin) 製造。它的風冷發動機使其有別於其他車輛——它不需要水冷發動機的散熱器、軟管或泵，這些東西很重並且容易出現溫度波動。這家總部位於紐約州錫拉丘茲的公司迅速成為美國最大的風冷式汽車製造商。

b75537017a0c5f8ee15fc07df1f20e76054b7077.sourceText: But like so many other businesses of the era, the Franklin Automobile Company was claimed by the Great Depression. Of the 150,000 Franklins manufactured between 1902 and 1934, approximately 3,700 remain. The H. H. Franklin Club was founded in 1951 to preserve the legacy of these unique cars. It has about 900 members and hosts an annual meeting in upstate New York . And thanks to one Tucson businessman, a sizable collection can be found in Arizona.
b75537017a0c5f8ee15fc07df1f20e76054b7077.translatedText: 但與那個時代的許多其他企業一樣，富蘭克林汽車公司也受到了大蕭條的影響。 1902 年至 1934 年間生產的 15 萬輛富蘭克林汽車中，僅剩約 3,700 輛。 H.H.富蘭克林俱樂部成立於 1951 年，旨在保護這些獨特汽車的遺產。它擁有約 900 名會員，並在紐約州北部舉辦年會。感謝一位圖森商人的幫助，在亞利桑那州可以找到大量藏品。

e3a36f392bf5d787bf4793ffcfe3157fb883a6cb.sourceText: Thomas Hubbard was born in New York in 1925, but was raised by his aunt in Tucson. Every year Hubbard's parents would make a cross-country trip to visit him in their Franklin, inspiring his love for the automaker. He stayed in Arizona and bought a Franklin of his own in 1953.
e3a36f392bf5d787bf4793ffcfe3157fb883a6cb.translatedText: 托馬斯·哈伯德 (Thomas Hubbard) 1925 年出生於紐約，由圖森的姑姑撫養長大。每年，哈伯德的父母都會開著富蘭克林汽車跨國旅行去看他，激發了他對這家汽車製造商的熱愛。 1953 年，他留在亞利桑那州並購買了一輛屬於自己的富蘭克林汽車。

21634710146cdf4076468ea498f8c80ed12a46a8.sourceText: Over the years, Hubbard amassed a collection of the cars and started running a restoration shop. By 1992, he had enough cars to fill three buildings, totaling 7,000 square feet. Hubbard wanted to ensure that his collection was preserved, so he created a nonprofit that would be able to carry on his work after his death.
21634710146cdf4076468ea498f8c80ed12a46a8.translatedText: 多年來，哈伯德收集了一系列汽車，並開始經營修復店。到 1992 年，他的汽車已經足以填滿三棟大樓，總面積達 7,000 平方英尺。哈伯德希望確保他的收藏得到保存，因此他創建了一個非營利組織，以便在他死後能夠繼續他的工作。

7b1a4a5063348ea483a7db26aee338182870242a.sourceText: The Thomas H. Hubbard/H.H. Franklin Foundation now maintains the museum, which holds 26 vehicles. Some of the highlights include a 1905 cross-engine (the only Franklin-made truck still known to exist), a 1910 Model G with just 6,000 miles on the odometer, and a 1927 sedan that's been maintained but unrestored—a tribute to the many well-loved Franklin cars that have not survived quite so long.
7b1a4a5063348ea483a7db26aee338182870242a.translatedText: 托馬斯H. 哈伯德/H.H.富蘭克林基金會現負責維護該博物館，館內藏有 26 輛車。其中的一些亮點包括一輛 1905 年的交叉引擎（唯一已知仍然存在的富蘭克林製造的卡車）、一輛里程表上僅行駛了 6,000 英里的 1910 年的 Model G，以及一輛經過維護但尚未修復的 1927 年轎車 - 向許多喜愛但倖存時間不長的富蘭克林深受汽車致敬。

a07acf738f7fe311b61ab96d8b960f806af23c28.sourceText: The Fort Mojave Twins are a pair of geoglyphs that represent large human figures that possibly date to 900 BCE. The twins are said to signify good and evil. The larger of the two has a massive head with attached limbs and is believed to represent good. It may also be representative of an ancient god.
a07acf738f7fe311b61ab96d8b960f806af23c28.translatedText: 莫哈韋堡雙胞胎是一對代表巨大人物的地畫，其歷史可能可以追溯到公元前 900 年。據說雙胞胎象徵善與惡。兩者中較大的一個有一個巨大的頭部並附有四肢，被認為代表著善良。它也可能代表一個古老的神。

c4ee62663210d30624a0b1aadfb0f0dff5401718.sourceText: The other twin has a smaller head with detached arms and signifies evil. The Mojave Desert along the Colorado River is the only place where figures of this type exist in North America. The Twins are located south of Fort Mojave and east of the Avi Casino, overlooking the river.
c4ee62663210d30624a0b1aadfb0f0dff5401718.translatedText: 另一個雙胞胎有一個較小的頭和分離的手臂，象徵著邪惡。科羅拉多河沿岸的莫哈韋沙漠是北美唯一存在此類人物的地方。雙胞胎位於莫哈韋堡以南、阿維賭場以東，俯瞰河流。

26f4cdb38c4a126ab3523b45fab201c2aa6b201f.sourceText: They can be accessed by heading west off Gardena Road in Fort Mojave and following the dirt road north and west to the fenced-off area at the edge of the bluffs. Do not enter the area beyond the fences.
26f4cdb38c4a126ab3523b45fab201c2aa6b201f.translatedText: 從莫哈韋堡的加迪納路向西行駛，沿著土路向北和向西到達懸崖邊緣的圍欄區域即可到達。請勿進入圍籬以外的區域。

873e60eb0bba2944f430384bb66b250006d868c3.sourceText: The American west is full of abandoned ghost towns. However, a ghost town can come back to life on rare occasions when its location becomes relevant again. Sometimes this is caused by a highway constructed nearby, but in this case, it is due to a large population of feral donkeys.
873e60eb0bba2944f430384bb66b250006d868c3.translatedText: 美國西部到處都是廢棄的鬼城。然而，當鬼城的位置再次變得重要時，鬼城可能會在極少數情況下復活。有時這是由附近建造的高速公路造成的，但在這種情況下，這是由於大量野驢造成的。

ac62e4a6f1b6eaf50c9a2d6b1f54d260c7e39a3b.sourceText: The town was formed in the mid-19th-century, starting out more as a camp than a town, only growing out into a proper settlement in the early 20th-century after gold was discovered. The town's population grew from a few people to over 3,000 in the course of a year. It functioned as the largest gold producer in the American west for about a decade. The town is named after Olive Oatman, who was famous for being abducted and enslaved by Native Americans in the mid-19th century. The bar still bears her name, as well as her portrait.
ac62e4a6f1b6eaf50c9a2d6b1f54d260c7e39a3b.translatedText: 該城鎮形成於 19 世紀中葉，一開始更像是一個營地而不是一個城鎮，直到 20 世紀初發現金礦後才發展成為一個適當的定居點。一年之內，鎮上的人口從幾個人增加到3,000多人。大約十年來，它一直是美國西部最大的黃金生產商。該鎮以奧利弗·奧特曼 (Olive Oatman) 的名字命名，他因在 19 世紀中葉被美洲原住民綁架和奴役而聞名。酒吧仍然保留著她的名字，還有她的肖像。

bfff060be172d14fcd2621607d01e4a031fcb7a8.sourceText: After the gold rush, the people left and the town died out, with most of its inhabitants being burros that were used to haul things around for prospectors. The donkeys were released and became feral. For about half a century, nobody cared about the town until it was re-enhabited by a small community who turned it into a tourist attraction centered around Oatman's persona and the burros.
bfff060be172d14fcd2621607d01e4a031fcb7a8.translatedText: 淘金熱過後，人們離開了，小鎮也隨之消亡，鎮上的居民大多是驢子，用來為探礦者馱運東西。驢子被釋放並變得野性。大約半個世紀以來，沒有人關心這個小鎮，直到一個小社區重新居住，將它變成了一個以奧特曼角色和驢子為中心的旅遊景點。

5b0c9736ad8a0a5d63f576242c326045214dc2b4.sourceText: Visitors can find many small museums that show the inside of the jail and a sample mine tunnel. There is also a saloon.
5b0c9736ad8a0a5d63f576242c326045214dc2b4.translatedText: 遊客可以找到許多小型博物館，展示監獄內部和礦井隧道樣本。還有一家酒吧。

17b0c1ecf695722e1bf268cacc45676862407d4a.sourceText: The burros still inhabit the town and while burro food is available for purchase at many of the shops, proceed with caution: they are not domesticated.
17b0c1ecf695722e1bf268cacc45676862407d4a.translatedText: 驢子仍然居住在鎮上，雖然許多商店都可以購買驢子食物，但請謹慎行事：它們並未被馴化。

eec9f7210be44afe904595a7e40f66bca7fb8c82.sourceText: (Phoenix) Arizona Governor Doug Ducey hosted a special send-off for Jay Shi, Olympic shooter representing the United States in Rio, on July 26, 2016 at the Governor’s Office. Governor Ducey extended well wishes to Jay and presented him with an Arizona flag and pins as he departs to Rio to compete in the Summer Olympics. Jay will be competing in the 10 meter air pistol ( August 6 ) and 50 meter free pistol ( August 10 ) events. He has been shooting for the past 10 years and spent the last two years qualifying. Jay and his family (wife, Yuanyuan Wang; father, Yu Min Shi; mother, Ping Yang) immigrated from China and Arizona is their home. His employer, the state of Arizona -Corporation Commission and, prior, Department of Public Safety -have been supportive of Jay in his quest for the Olympics. Governor Ducey and the state of Arizona is proud of Jay and wish him the best as he competes for a medal for Team USA! (Submitted by Barry Wong, Governor’s Office of Equal Opportunity.)
eec9f7210be44afe904595a7e40f66bca7fb8c82.translatedText: （菲尼克斯） 2016 年 7 月 26 日，亞利桑那州州長道格·杜西 (Doug Ducey) 在州長辦公室為代表美國參加里約奧運的射擊運動員 Jay Shi 舉行了特別歡送會。杜西州長向傑伊致以良好的祝愿，並在他啟程前往裡約參加夏季奧運會時向他贈送了亞利桑那州旗幟和別針。 Jay將參加10公尺氣手槍（8月6日）和50公尺自由手槍（8月10日）計畫。過去10年他一直從事射擊，最近兩年都在資格賽中度過。 Jay 和他的家人（妻子王媛媛、父親於敏史、母親平楊）從中國移民而來，亞利桑那州是他們的家。他的雇主、亞利桑那州公司委員會和先前的公共安全部一直支持傑伊爭取奧運。杜西州長和亞利桑那州為傑伊感到自豪，並祝他在為美國隊爭奪獎牌時一切順利！ （由州長平等機會辦公室 Barry Wong 提交。）

0cc66e419b0877a26d4f6dc4478eca2874b97c40.sourceText: A clear blue sky accompanied by a crisp morning air gradually warmed by the rising desert winter sun. It was the perfect backdrop for ushering in a team of newly elected statewide leaders led by Governor Doug Ducey at the State Capitol on January 5, 2015.
0cc66e419b0877a26d4f6dc4478eca2874b97c40.translatedText: 晴朗的藍天，伴隨著清新的早晨空氣，被初升的沙漠冬日逐漸溫暖。這是 2015 年 1 月 5 日在州議會大廈迎來由 Doug Ducey 州長領導的新當選全州領導人團隊的完美背景。

add9a8cd5a96c4f3f797745aae51bdc3a34f13cd.sourceText: Oath of Office. Several thousand Arizonans witnessed the inauguration ceremony where six top statewide officials were sworn into office. One-by-one, elected officers recited the oath of office, administered by Arizona’s Chief Justice Scott Bales (except Michele Reagan, whose father, Judge Michael Reagan administered her oath), followed by a speech. They were Joe Hart, Mine Inspector; Diane M. Douglas, Superintendent of Public Instruction; Jeffrey J. DeWit, Treasurer; Mark Brnovich, Attorney General; Michele L. Reagan, Secretary of State; and, lastly, Douglas A. Ducey, Governor.
add9a8cd5a96c4f3f797745aae51bdc3a34f13cd.translatedText: 就職宣誓。數千名亞利桑那州人見證了六名全州高級官員宣誓就職的就職典禮。當選官員一一宣讀就職誓言，由亞利桑那州首席大法官斯科特·貝爾斯主持（米歇爾·裡根除外，她的父親邁克爾·裡根法官主持了她的宣誓），然後發表講話。他們是礦場督察喬·哈特（Joe Hart）；黛安·道格拉斯 (Diane M. Douglas)，公共教育總監； Jeffrey J. DeWit，財務主管；馬克·布爾諾維奇，司法部長；米歇爾·L·裡根，國務卿；最後是道格拉斯·A·杜西 (Douglas A. Ducey) 州長。

33693a486e2551c01dd4a3d2cf45d51bd73e2fc7.sourceText: As each recited their Oath of Office, with the two story high giant Arizona flag as the stage backdrop, they were surrounded by immediate family members with their respective spouses holding up their family Bible upon which the official placed his or her right hand as the left hand was raised. Each new officer thanked their families, friends and campaign staff for their support and work in achieving election victory; some also spoke briefly about their plans for their respective offices.
33693a486e2551c01dd4a3d2cf45d51bd73e2fc7.translatedText: 當每個人宣讀就職誓言時，以兩層樓高的巨型亞利桑那州國旗為舞台背景，他們被直系親屬包圍，他們各自的配偶舉著家庭聖經，官員將右手放在上面，左手舉起。每位新官員都感謝他們的家人、朋友和競選工作人員為取得選舉勝利所給予的支持和努力；有些人還簡要介紹了他們各自辦公室的計劃。

06d892751b67edd35daef332b1ec952ea4190585.sourceText: Governor Ducey Sworn-In. The highlight of the Inauguration Ceremony was just after noon when master of ceremony Derrick Hall, president of the Arizona Diamondbacks professional baseball team, called up Doug Ducey to the front of the stage to be administered the Oath of Office for Governor of the State of Arizona. He was surrounded by his wife of 23 years, Angela, and sons, Jack (17), Joe (15) and Sam (11). As he recited the Oath everyone in the audience was standing with excitement as they witnessed a new beginning as the former CEO of ice cream company Cold Stone Creamery and current first term state treasurer became the 23rd Governor of Arizona.
06d892751b67edd35daef332b1ec952ea4190585.translatedText: 州長杜西宣誓就職。就職典禮的亮點是中午剛過，亞利桑那州響尾蛇職業棒球隊主席德里克·霍爾 (Derrick Hall) 將道格·杜西 (Doug Ducey) 叫到舞台前，主持亞利桑那州州長的就職宣誓。他周圍都是結婚 23 年的妻子安吉拉 (Angela) 和兒子傑克 (17 歲)、喬 (15 歲) 和山姆 (11 歲)。當他宣讀誓詞時，全場觀眾都興奮地起立，見證了冰淇淋公司冷石乳品廠前首席執行官、現任第一任州財政部長成為亞利桑那州第 23 任州長的新開始。

7d35577b9e2d22070ff599028eda6db58c713a06.sourceText: Governor Ducey delivered his first speech as the newest Arizona governor; he recognized his family and his mother who was in the audience. He also acknowledged in the audience former Governors Janice Brewer, Jane Dee Hull and Fife Symington, and former Governors Rose Mofford and Raul Castro.
7d35577b9e2d22070ff599028eda6db58c713a06.translatedText: 杜西州長作為新任亞利桑那州州長首次發表演講；他認出了觀眾席上的家人和母親。他還在觀眾席上向前州長賈尼絲·布魯爾、簡·迪·赫爾和法伊夫·賽明頓以及前州長羅斯·莫福德和勞爾·卡斯特羅表示感謝。

512534f08d2db3bcc4b0ecb734b7019f34ed743c.sourceText: ”No Tax Increase.” The new governor addressed policy issues head on. First, was the current state budget that is projected to be nearly $1billion short of balancing. He said spending cuts have been made and excess funds recaptured but some people believe the state should ask the people of Arizona for a tax increase; after a brief pause for effect, Governor Ducey declared emphatically that ”there will not be any tax increases under our watch!” That declaration was received by the audience with thunderous applause. He said the state budget will be balanced and shortfall eliminated in a plan that will not necessarily be popular, especially among special interests, but will be effective.
512534f08d2db3bcc4b0ecb734b7019f34ed743c.translatedText: “不加税。”新州长直接解决了政策问题。首先，当前的国家预算预计将短缺近 10 亿美元。他表示，支出已經削減，多餘資金已收回，但有些人認為該州應該要求亞利桑那州人民增加稅收；短暫停頓後，杜西州長強調，「在我們的監督下，不會有任何增稅！」這一宣言得到了觀眾的熱烈掌聲。他表示，國家預算將在一項計劃中實現平衡並消除缺口，該計劃不一定會受到歡迎，尤其是在特殊利益群體中，但會有效。

9b5e1aef3bd5aee7e82e5296f464e150066d91e8.sourceText: Governor Ducey also talked about his plans to focus on job creation and working to provide high quality education to all Arizonans. He emphasized that under his administration there will be opportunity for all the people, groups and communities in Arizona.
9b5e1aef3bd5aee7e82e5296f464e150066d91e8.translatedText: 杜西州長也談到了他的計劃，重點是創造就業機會和努力為所有亞利桑那州人提供高品質的教育。他强调，在他的管理下，亚利桑那州的所有人民、团体和社区都将获得机会。

d9308cd87f42a85b4f068923e4c1b98a16e55788.sourceText: ”Our new governor is a breath of fresh air in state government,” said Barry Wong, former Arizona legislator and corporation commissioner. ”As a former CEO of a major Arizona-based company, Governor Ducey brings a unique perspective to governing and solving problems in government.” Further, Wong said ”he has a lot of energy and ideas that will position Arizona well in the Southwest and nationally for business attraction and job creation.”
d9308cd87f42a85b4f068923e4c1b98a16e55788.translatedText: 「我們的新州長為州政府帶來了一股新鮮空氣，」亞利桑那州前議員兼公司專員 Barry Wong 表示。 “作為亞利桑那州一家大公司的前首席執行官，杜西州長為政府治理和解決問題帶來了獨特的視角。”此外，黃說，“他擁有大量的精力和想法，這將使亞利桑那州在西南部和全國範圍內吸引商業和創造就業機會。”

b67497012d52935486d9c96ee4c0b4123b8b4b25.sourceText: Asian American Presence. The Asian American community was well represented at the inauguration ceremony. The Inauguration Committee invited leaders including from the following communities: Korean (Jae Chin, Wansik Choi, Mike Woo), Chinese (John M. Yee, Garry Ong, Peter Chan), Taiwanese (Charles Chiu, Tony Kao, Michelle Chang), Vietnamese (Kevin Dang, Mai Le), Indian (Venkat Kommineni, Jegadesan Krishnamurthy), Filipino (Marie Cunning, Leo Aromin), Pakistani (Sardar Babar), Bangladesh (Raphael and Farhana Ahmed) and other Asian (Albert Lin, Astria Wong). Others in attendance were State Senator Kimberly Yee, Jack Yee, David Cui and Tony Tang.
b67497012d52935486d9c96ee4c0b4123b8b4b25.translatedText: 亞裔美國人的存在。亞裔美國人社區在就職典禮上得到了廣泛的代表。就職委員會邀請了以下社區的領導人：韓國人（Jae Chin、Wansik Choi、Mike Woo）、中國人（John M. Yee、Garry Ong、Peter Chan）、台灣人（Charles Chiu、Tony Kao、Michelle Chang）、越南人（Kevin Dang、Mai Le）、印度人（Venkat Kommineni、Jegadesanmur）、 Babar）、孟加拉人（Raphael 和 Farhana Ahmed）和其他亞洲人（Albert Lin、Astria Wong）。其他出席者包括州參議員 Kimberly Yee、Jack Yee、David Cui 和 Tony Tang。

25714b29812f189cb7dfef3e45f02ba14c46b98c.sourceText: The inauguration concluded with audience members feeling a sense of renewal with an energetic new governor along with other top statewide officials to move Arizona forward.
25714b29812f189cb7dfef3e45f02ba14c46b98c.translatedText: 就職典禮結束時，觀眾感受到充滿活力的新州長以及其他全州高級官員的復興感，推動亞利桑那州向前發展。

d06ad6f957024fc62c37a68fe52b32adbb4ecd35.sourceText: (Scottsdale/Phoenix, Ariz.) Your double-take confirmation was right; you did see 1,500 Asian Pacific American (APA) lawyers and legal-types converging at the Westin Kierland Resort & Spa last week from November 6-9, 2014 in Scottsdale and Phoenix, Arizona!
d06ad6f957024fc62c37a68fe52b32adbb4ecd35.translatedText: （亞利桑那州斯科茨代爾/菲尼克斯） 您的雙重確認是正確的；上週，2014 年 11 月 6 日至 9 日，1,500 名美國 (APA,500 名美國 (APA,500 名美國亞裔)律師和法律界人士齊聚亞利桑那州斯科茨代爾和菲尼克斯的威斯汀基爾蘭度假村及水療中心！

f5ba6514e1c732799452949c50fb9e69aebdce53.sourceText: APA lawyers, law students, judges, academics and others related to the legal profession from throughout the United States attended the 2014 Convention of the National Asian Pacific American Bar Association (NAPABA) in Arizona. This annual convention moves around the country and was last in Arizona (also Scottsdale) in 2001 when the attendance was 300.
f5ba6514e1c732799452949c50fb9e69aebdce53.translatedText: 美國各地的 APA 律師、法學院學生、法官、學者和其他與法律職業相關的人士參加了 2014 年全國亞太裔美國律師協會 (NAPABA) 大會在亞利桑那州。該年度大會在全國各地舉行，上一次於 2001 年在亞利桑那州（也是斯科茨代爾）舉行，當時出席人數為 300 人。

868bd7f0f93d80e7d934f89e3f282f99d6c6c24f.sourceText: NAPABA represents the interests of 40,000 APA lawyers and 70 affiliates (local APA associations) across the country. It also advocates on issues of importance to the APA community including civil rights, and promotes appointment of APA judges on the federal bench.
868bd7f0f93d80e7d934f89e3f282f99d6c6c24f.translatedText: NAPABA 代表全國 40,000 名 APA 律師和 70 個附屬機構（當地 APA 協會）的利益。它還倡導對 APA 社區重要的問題，包括公民權利，並促進在聯邦法官中任命 APA 法官。

68b21315c03b005b0fbc9b6f98bd35224baab481.sourceText: Arizona Outsize Influence. The four day convention was an opportunity for legal professionals to network, learn from each other at seminars on a variety of topics and catch up with old friends and make new ones. The highlight was the Saturday Gala Dinner where awards were presented, new officers and board members inducted and a special speaker delivering a keynote address. Notable at the Gala’s start was the presentation of colors by the Color Guards of the American Legion Thomas Tang Post 50, named after the Korean War veteran and late Ninth Circuit Federal Court of Appeals Judge.
68b21315c03b005b0fbc9b6f98bd35224baab481.translatedText: 亞利桑那州影響力巨大。為期四天的會議為法律專業人士提供了一個建立人際網絡、在各種主題的研討會上相互學習、結識老朋友和結交新朋友的機會。最精彩的是周六的晚宴，會上頒發了獎項、新任管理人員和董事會成員就職以及一位特別演講者發表了主題演講。晚會開始時值得注意的是美國退伍軍人協會顏色衛士 Thomas Tang Post 50 的顏色展示，該顏色以朝鮮戰爭退伍軍人和已故第九巡迴聯邦上訴法院法官的名字命名。

716703c639f52be355ccb514a95472082c745488.sourceText: Arizona lawyers, judges and luminaries had an outsized presence at the Convention. The Convention Chairman and Convention Planning Committee Co-chair was Phoenix-based intellectual property lawyer George Chen. Joining him as co-chairs were Phoenix attorneys Jared Leung, president of Arizona Asian American Bar Association (Arizona Asian Bar); Eileen Sullivan, NAPABA Southwest Regional Governor; and Barry Wong, a founding board member and past president of Arizona Asian Bar. These co-chairs were actively engaged in planning the convention for over a year. The attention to details made the difference in this successful convention.
716703c639f52be355ccb514a95472082c745488.translatedText: 亞利桑那州的律師、法官和名人在大會上亮相。會議主席兼會議規劃委員會聯合主席是鳳凰城的智慧財產權律師喬治·陳(George Chen)。與他一起擔任聯合主席的還有鳳凰城律師 Jared Leung、亞利桑那州亞裔美國律師協會 (Arizona Asian Bar) 主席； Eileen Sullivan，NAPABA 西南地區州長； Barry Wong 是亞利桑那亞洲律師協會的創始董事會成員兼前任主席。這些聯合主席在一年多的時間裡積極參與了會議的規劃。對細節的關注使這次會議取得了成功。

df8b3c46c6abbef794f775bff177f0a7463b5992.sourceText: Leadership Flows from Arizona. As president-elect, Chen was inducted as NAPABA president at the Gala Dinner; he will serve as president until next year’s convention. Following his induction he delivered his first-ever speech as NAPABA president to the over 1,200 Gala guests in the resort grand ballroom addressing his vision and plans for the upcoming year.
df8b3c46c6abbef794f775bff177f0a7463b5992.translatedText: 領導力來自亞利桑那州。作為當選主席，陳在晚宴上被任命為 NAPABA 主席；他將擔任主席直至明年的大會。入職後，他在度假村大宴會廳向 1,200 多名晚宴嘉賓發表了作為 NAPABA 主席的首次演講，闡述了他對來年的願景和計劃。

c188337df01934cf44e20ede89985dd9fad3c48c.sourceText: NAPABA’s top award, Daniel K. Inouye Trailblazers Award, was presented at a Friday evening ceremony and reception to five honorees including Arizona’s Marian Yim. Yim, a founding board member and the inaugural president of Arizona Asian Bar, was recognized for her years of advocating for rights, fairness and advancement of APAs.
c188337df01934cf44e20ede89985dd9fad3c48c.translatedText: NAPABA 的最高獎項 Daniel K. Inouye 開拓者獎在周五晚上的儀式和招待會上頒發給了包括亞利桑那州選手 Marian Yim 在內的五位獲獎者。 Yim 是亞利桑那州亞洲律師協會的創始董事會成員和首任主席，因其多年來倡導預約定價安排的權利、公平和進步而受到認可。

a3a0226b6016b673222fd8e38d516dec6bd1f157.sourceText: Further Arizonan involvement at the Convention extends to the late Ninth Circuit Federal Appeals Judge Thomas Tang and his wife, Pearl Tang, M.D. Years earlier, NAPABA named its Moot Court Competition after the late judge who was one of the initial supporters of NAPABA’s formation. The competition pitted APA law students from around the country against one another to argue cases in an appellate court setting. Pima County Judges Ken Lee and Paul Tang helped judge the competition. Atlanta Judge Alvin Wong led the awards ceremony with Dr. Pearl Tang helping to present the awards to the competition winners.
a3a0226b6016b673222fd8e38d516dec6bd1f157.translatedText: 亞利桑那州對大會的進一步參與延伸到已故的第九巡迴聯邦上訴法官 Thomas Tang 和他的妻子，醫學博士 Pearl Tang。多年前，NAPABA 以已故法官的名字命名了模擬法庭競賽，這位已故法官是 APA 的最初支持者之一。 NAPABA 的形成。這場比賽讓來自全國各地的 APA 法學院學生相互競爭，在上訴法院環境中辯論案件。皮馬縣法官 Ken Lee 和 Paul Tang 協助評判了比賽。亞特蘭大法官 Alvin Wong 主持了頒獎典禮，Pearl Tang 博士協助為比賽獲獎者頒獎。

010df17f9021e463f40e4cb4070c5af118cae759.sourceText: Supporting Military. The Convention concluded Sunday morning with a Service Project where NAPABA partners with a local charity. This year’s Service Project, directed by convention planning committee co-chair Wong, partnered with Phoenix-based non-profit ”Packages from Home” (PFH) where care boxes of comfort food and snacks are sent to military personnel stationed overseas. NAPABA donated over $10,000 to PFH and arranged for 150 convention volunteers to pack over 300 care boxes.
010df17f9021e463f40e4cb4070c5af118cae759.translatedText: 支持軍事。週日上午，大會以 NAPABA 與當地慈善機構合作的服務項目結束。今年的服務項目由大會規劃委員會聯合主席 Wong 指導，與鳳凰城的非營利組織「Packages from Home」（PFH）合作，將裝有舒適食品和零食的護理盒發送給駐紮海外的軍事人員。 NAPABA 向 PFH 捐贈了超過 10,000 美元，並安排了 150 名會議志工打包了 300 多個護理箱。

739f7f119546ad3e793569c6d6dae32dbc563da0.sourceText: Convention attendees gave high marks for this Convention including comments about the relaxed Southwest setting, the friendly atmosphere and the open spaces around the venue and city. They also commented about the ideal temperatures during the four days, with average highs in low 80’s and lows in mid- to upper 50’s – the one thing the planning co-chairs could not take credit but could only smile. With the success of the Convention, planning co-chairs Chen, Leung, Sullivan and Wong, and Arizona ended up on a high note!
739f7f119546ad3e793569c6d6dae32dbc563da0.translatedText: 會議與會者對本次會議給予了高度評價，包括對輕鬆的西南環境、友好的氛圍以及會場和城市周圍的開放空間的評價。他們還評論了這四天裡的理想氣溫，平均最高溫度在 80 度以下，最低溫度在 50 度中上——這一點規劃聯合主席不能相信，但只能微笑。隨著大會的成功，策劃聯合主席陳、梁、沙利文、黃以及亞利桑那州最終獲得了高度評價！

74cedf596ff6a546b5595e8334aabec3b44be37f.sourceText: A year has passed since the tragic Yarnell fire that felled 19 Granite Mountain Hotshot Firefighters, but the emotional wounds continue for surviving family members.
74cedf596ff6a546b5595e8334aabec3b44be37f.translatedText: Yarnell 火災造成 19 名 Granite Mountain Hotshot 消防員喪生，一年過去了，但倖存家庭成員的情感創傷仍在繼續。

2330a4293fbd0df905967e30b8386b427a14f85c.sourceText: Fateful Day. You may recall last June 30th: a wildfire in Yarnell, Arizona was growing larger by the hour when the ”SWAT” team of firefighters, Granite Mountain Hotshots, was dispatched to control and eventually put out the fire; without warning, weather conditions changed causing towering walls of flames to envelope the Hotshots eventually taking all 19 lives.
2330a4293fbd0df905967e30b8386b427a14f85c.translatedText: 決定命運的一天。您可能還記得去年 6 月 30 日：亞利桑那州亞內爾市的一場山火隨著時間的推移變得越來越大，“特警”消防隊員 Granite Mountain Hotshots 被派去控制並最終撲滅了火勢；在沒有任何警告的情況下，天氣條件發生了變化，導致高聳的火牆包圍了高手勢；在沒有任何警告的情況下，天氣條件發生了變化，導致高聳的火牆包圍了高手勢；在沒有任何警告的情況下，天氣條件發生了變化。

6bb546f5832c19818b2e1128ebf2f1c42510e43c.sourceText: In the aftermath of this tragedy, communities and organizations from Arizona and across the country along with fellow firefighters near and far rallied to pay tribute to the fallen and raised needed funds to support the surviving families. The Asian American Community of Maricopa County was among those groups lending emotional and financial support; the Community collectively raised $11,000.
6bb546f5832c19818b2e1128ebf2f1c42510e43c.translatedText: 這場悲劇發生後，來自亞利桑那州和全國各地的社區和組織以及遠近的消防隊員們聚集在一起向犧牲者致敬，並籌集了所需的資金來支持倖存的家庭。馬里科帕縣的亞裔美國人社區是提供情感和經濟支持的團體之一；社區總共籌集了 11,000 美元。

c0ccbf346565b2445385e045f711c1216dbbabc6.sourceText: Asian Americans Raise Funds. Within couple weeks following the tragedy the Filipino-American Community collected and donated $1,000 to the Phoenix-based 100 Club of Arizona (www.100Club.org) in support of fallen firefighters. Asian American Community leaders in Maricopa County wanted to do more so they formed a fundraising committee, chaired by Ms. Mai Le (Vice President External Affairs, Vietnamese Community of Arizona, and President of TNT Radio Arizona) and co-chaired by Ms. Maribel Dillard (then-President, Arizona Asian American Association) and Mr. Barry Wong (former Arizona Legislator and Corporation Commissioner). The Fundraising Committee, through its chair and co-chairs, raised $9,000 and presented the funds at an October ceremony in Prescott at Fire Station 71 to Prescott Fire Fighters Charities.
c0ccbf346565b2445385e045f711c1216dbbabc6.translatedText: 亞裔美國人籌集資金。悲劇發生後幾週內，菲律賓裔美國人社區向總部位於鳳凰城的亞利桑那州 100 俱樂部 (www.100Club.org) 籌集了 1,000 美元，以支持倒下的消防員。馬里科帕縣的亞裔美國人社區領導人希望做得更多，因此他們成立了一個籌款委員會，由 Mai Le 女士（亞利桑那州越南社區對外事務副總裁兼亞利桑那州 TNT 廣播電台總裁）擔任主席，由 Maribel Dillard 女士（時任亞利桑那州亞裔美國人協會主席）和 Barry Wong 先生（前亞利桑那州立法者和公司專員）擔任立法者和公司專員。籌款委員會透過其主席和聯合主席籌集了 9,000 美元，並在 10 月於普雷斯科特消防站 71 舉行的儀式上將資金捐贈給了普雷斯科特消防員慈善機構。

43c6b7ddf4ecbcf36c31b2d7099b0467100d9e14.sourceText: Remember 1 Year. A year later, the Fundraising Committee, desiring to recognize the anniversary of the tragedy, donated another $1,000 to the 100 Club of Arizona. At a Check Presentation Ceremony on July 30, 2014 at the 100 Club of Arizona office, Fundraising Committee Co-chairs Ms. Dillard and Mr. Wong presented the funds to Ms. Sharon Knutson-Felix, Executive Director of the 100 Club of Arizona. Other community leaders joining in the presentation were Mr. Chuong Tran (Vice President Internal Affairs, Vietnamese Community of Arizona) and Mr. Albert Lin (President, Arizona Asian American Association). Detective Christopher Abril, Phoenix Police Department Community Relations Bureau’s Liaison to the Asian American community, was also present.
43c6b7ddf4ecbcf36c31b2d7099b0467100d9e14.translatedText: 记得1年。一年后，筹款委员会希望纪念悲剧发生一周年，又向亚利桑那州 100 俱乐部捐赠了 1,000 美元。 2014 年 7 月 30 日，在亞利桑那州 100 俱樂部辦公室舉行的支票贈送儀式上，籌款委員會聯合主席 Dillard 女士和黃先生將資金贈送給亞利桑那州 100 俱樂部執行董事 Sharon Knutson-Felix 女士。其他參與演講的社區領袖包括 Chuong Tran 先生（亞利桑那州越南社區內政部副總裁）和 Albert Lin 先生（亞利桑那州亞裔美國人協會主席）。凤凰城警察局社区关系局亚裔美国人社区联络员克里斯托弗·阿布里尔 (Christopher Abril) 警探也出席了活动。

4c0a27270420becff309a924751ea60c5cb6a0c6.sourceText: A special guest at the Ceremony was Ms. Suzanne Wagner, Mother of fallen Hotshot Garret Zuppiger. She was touched by the generosity of the Asian American Community of Maricopa County, and said that the emotions of her loss continues even after a year but the memories of her son lives on.
4c0a27270420becff309a924751ea60c5cb6a0c6.translatedText: 儀式上的特別嘉賓是倒下的能人加勒特·祖皮格 (Garret Zuppiger) 的母親蘇珊娜·瓦格納 (Suzanne Wagner) 女士。她被馬里科帕縣亞裔美國人社區的慷慨所感動，並表示，即使一年後，她的悲痛仍在繼續，但對兒子的記憶仍然存在。

fefbf48b5f2fb6a9a7cf7b880224231965335622.sourceText: The tragedy in Yarnell, Arizona has passed but the memories of the fallen 19 Granite Mountain Hotshots will live forever.
fefbf48b5f2fb6a9a7cf7b880224231965335622.translatedText: 亚利桑那州亚内尔市的悲剧已经过去，但倒下的 19 名花岗岩山能手的记忆将永远存在。

329ba459a0ffba175f6cfd4908dfed649cfb7dd3.translatedText: 鳳凰城華裔美國公民聯盟慶祝 40 週年…

403e33f9797ed962f44751ed6e67e63164f49e0c.sourceText: For forty years Phoenix Chinese American Citizens Alliance (PCACA) has been serving the community in Phoenix and its brother chapters nation wide. On Saturday, May 3, 6:00 pm, at the Great Wall Restaurant, PCACA will hold a special celebration commemorating 40 years of service, cultural awareness and civil rights leadership to the Chinese community. Everyone is invited to join in on this historic gala event.
403e33f9797ed962f44751ed6e67e63164f49e0c.translatedText: 四十年來，鳳凰城華裔美國公民聯盟 (PCACA) 一直為鳳凰城及其全國兄弟分會服務。 5 月 3 日（週六）下午 6:00，PCACA 將在長城餐廳舉辦特別慶祝活動，紀念 40 年來對華人社區的服務、文化意識和民權領導力。每個人都被邀請參加這個歷史性的盛會。

50bb50746e60732919935f4e20e2d1778dbbfe9e.sourceText: It all started way back in 1974 when Wing F. Ong met with several leaders of the Phoenix Chinese Community in discussing the possibility of forming a Phoenix CACA chapter. By-laws were written and PCACA was launched. Wing F. Ong was elected as the new organization’s first President and represented Phoenix at the 1975 National CACA Convention held in Portland, Oregon. At this time CACA was an all men organization and it was Wing F. Ong that introduced a resolution allowing women in the organization. Phoenix was the CACA National Convention site in 1997.
50bb50746e60732919935f4e20e2d1778dbbfe9e.translatedText: 這一切都可以追溯到1974年，當時Wing F. Ong會見了鳳凰城華人社區的幾位領導人，討論成立鳳凰城CACA分會的可能性。制定了章程並啟動了 PCACA。 Wing F. Ong 當選為新組織的首任主席，並代表菲尼克斯出席 1975 年在俄勒岡州波特蘭舉行的全國 CACA 大會。此時 CACA 是一個全男性組織，Wing F. Ong 提出了一項允許女性加入該組織的決議。鳳凰城是 1997 年 CACA 全國大會的舉辦地。

e36efc66b58030658e294e4f6b5e2468c99e0aeb.sourceText: In 2011?2012 PCACA worked very hard in successfully gaining support necessary in the passing of S.R. 201 and H.R, 683 for an Expression of Regret for the passage of the Chinese Exclusion Act by Congress in 1882. ”For forty years, the Alliance has continued to work on issues that affect the rights and welfare of Chinese Americans locally and nationally. As we move forward, PCACA will partner energetically with other organizaitons in the community to be more effective in service,” said PCACA President Elaine Wong. ” We welcome the community to join us on Saturday, May 3, as we celebrate this milestone occasion of memories and the past accomplishments of the local Alliance while looking at the future.” For more information on this event contact Elaine Wong at 480-406-7470 or e-mail elainewong@cox.net.
e36efc66b58030658e294e4f6b5e2468c99e0aeb.translatedText: 2011 年至 2012 年，PCACA 非常努力地成功獲得了 S.R. 的通過所需的支持。 201 和 H.R, 683 對 1882 年國會通過排華法案表示遺憾。 「四十年來，聯盟一直致力於解決影響當地和全國華裔美國人權利和福祉的問題。隨著我們的前進，PCACA 將與社區中的其他組織積極合作，以更有效地提供服務，」PCACA 主席 Elaine Wong 說。 「我們歡迎社區在 5 月 3 日星期六加入我們，慶祝這一具有里程碑意義的時刻，紀念當地聯盟過去取得的成就，同時展望未來。」有關此活動的更多信息，請致電 480-406-7470 聯繫 Elaine Wong，或發送電子郵件至 elainwong@cox.net。

95ea8ff50304ee292ae6b7a3913ad22e7b4ae7c1.sourceText: Wing F. Ong taking the oath of office as 1st President of Phoenix Chinese American Citizens Alliance(PCACA) in 1974. He was instrumental in allowing women into the CACA organization.
95ea8ff50304ee292ae6b7a3913ad22e7b4ae7c1.translatedText: Wing F. Ong 於 1974 年宣誓就任菲尼克斯華裔美國公民聯盟 (PCACA) 第一任主席。他在允許女性加入 CACA 組織方面發揮了重要作用。
